   563→;; ------
   564→;; worker
   565→
   566→(defn event-attributes
   567→  [store
   568→   session-id
   569→   {:keys [op
   570→           client-event-id
   571→           total-delay-ms
   572→           ws-ping-latency-ms] :as event}]
   573→  (let [{:session/keys [auth creator versions]} (rs/session store session-id)]
   574→    (merge
   575→     {:op op
   576→      :client-event-id client-event-id
   577→      :session-id session-id
   578→      :total-delay-ms total-delay-ms
   579→      :ws-ping-latency-ms ws-ping-latency-ms
   580→      :combined (::grouped-queue/combined event 1)}
   581→     (auth-and-creator-attrs auth creator versions))))
   582→
   583→(defn validate-room-id [event]
   584→  (ex/get-param! event [:room-id] (fn [s]
   585→                                    (when (string? s)
   586→                                      s))))
   587→
   588→(defn- handle-join-room! [store sess-id {:keys [client-event-id data] :as event}]
   589→  (let [auth (get-auth! store sess-id)
   590→        app-id (-> auth :app :id)
   591→        current-user (-> auth :user)
   592→        room-id (validate-room-id event)]
   593→    (eph/join-room! app-id sess-id current-user room-id data)
   594→    (join-room-logger/log-join-room! app-id)
   595→    (rs/send-event! store app-id sess-id {:op :join-room-ok
   596→                                          :room-id room-id
   597→                                          :client-event-id client-event-id})))
   598→
   599→(defn- handle-leave-room! [store sess-id {:keys [client-event-id] :as event}]
   600→  (let [auth (get-auth! store sess-id)
   601→        app-id (-> auth :app :id)
   602→        room-id (validate-room-id event)]
   603→    (eph/leave-room! app-id sess-id room-id)
   604→    (rs/send-event! store app-id sess-id {:op :leave-room-ok
   605→                                          :room-id room-id
   606→                                          :client-event-id client-event-id})))
   607→
   608→(defn assert-in-room! [app-id room-id sess-id]
   609→  (when-not (eph/in-room? app-id room-id sess-id)
   610→    (ex/throw-validation-err!
   611→     :room
   612→     {:app-id app-id :room-id room-id :session-id sess-id}
   613→     [{:message "You have not entered this room yet."}])))
   614→
   615→(defn- handle-set-presence!
   616→  [store sess-id {:keys [client-event-id data] :as event}]
   617→  (let [auth (get-auth! store sess-id)
   618→        app-id (-> auth :app :id)
   619→        room-id (validate-room-id event)
   620→        _ (assert-in-room! app-id room-id sess-id)]
   621→    (eph/set-presence! app-id sess-id room-id data)
   622→    (rs/send-event! store app-id sess-id {:op :set-presence-ok
   623→                                          :room-id room-id
   624→                                          :client-event-id client-event-id})))
   625→
   626→(defn- handle-refresh-presence! [store sess-id {:keys [app-id data edits] :as event}]
   627→  (let [features (-> (rs/session store sess-id) :session/features)
   628→        room-id (validate-room-id event)]
   629→    (cond
   630→      (and edits (empty? edits))
   631→      :nop
   632→
   633→      (and edits
   634→           (supports-patch-presence? features))
   635→      (rs/send-event! store app-id sess-id
   636→                      {:op      :patch-presence
   637→                       :room-id room-id
   638→                       :edits   edits})
   639→
   640→      :else
   641→      (rs/send-event! store app-id sess-id
   642→                      {:op      :refresh-presence
   643→                       :room-id room-id
   644→                       :data    data}))))
   645→
   646→(defn- handle-client-broadcast!
   647→  "Broadcasts a client message to other sessions in the room"
   648→  [store sess-id {:keys [client-event-id topic data] :as event}]
   649→  (let [auth (get-auth! store sess-id)
   650→        app-id (-> auth :app :id)
   651→        room-id (validate-room-id event)
   652→        _ (assert-in-room! app-id room-id sess-id)
   653→        current-user (-> auth :user)
   654→        {:keys [local-ids remote-ids]} (eph/get-room-session-ids app-id room-id)
   655→        base-msg {:room-id room-id
   656→                  :topic topic
   657→                  :data {:peer-id sess-id
   658→                         :user (when current-user
   659→                                 {:id (:id current-user)})
   660→                         :data data}}]
   661→
   662→    (doseq [notify-sess-id local-ids
   663→            :let [q (-> (rs/session store notify-sess-id) :session/socket :receive-q)]
   664→            :when (and q (not= sess-id notify-sess-id))]
   665→      (receive-queue/put! q
   666→                          (assoc base-msg
   667→                                 :op :server-broadcast
   668→                                 :session-id notify-sess-id
   669→                                 :app-id app-id)))
   670→    (when (seq remote-ids)
   671→      (eph/broadcast app-id remote-ids base-msg))
   672→
   673→    (rs/send-event! store app-id sess-id (assoc base-msg
   674→                                                :op :client-broadcast-ok
   675→                                                :client-event-id client-event-id))))
   676→
   677→(defn- handle-server-broadcast! [store sess-id {:keys [app-id] :as event}]
   678→  (let [room-id (validate-room-id event)
   679→        batch-messages? (-> (rs/session store sess-id)
   680→                            :features
   681→                            supports-batch-messages?)]
   682→    (when (eph/in-room? app-id room-id sess-id)
   683→      (let [messages (for [{:keys [topic data]} (or (::payloads event)
   684→                                                    [event])]
   685→                       {:op :server-broadcast
   686→                        :room-id room-id
   687→                        :topic topic
   688→                        :data data})]
   689→        (cond (= 1 (count messages))
   690→              (rs/send-event! store app-id sess-id (first messages))
   691→
   692→              batch-messages?
   693→              (doseq [batch (partition-all 500 messages)]
   694→                (rs/send-event! store app-id sess-id batch))
   695→
   696→              :else
   697→              (doseq [message messages]
   698→                (rs/send-event! store app-id sess-id message)))))))
   699→
   700→(defn handle-event [store session event debug-info]
   701→  (let [{:keys [op]} event
   702→        {:keys [session/socket]} session
   703→        {:keys [id]} socket]
   704→    (tracer/add-data! {:attributes (event-attributes store id event)})
   705→    (case op
   706→      :init         (handle-init! store id event)
   707→      :sse-init     (handle-sse-init! store id event)
   708→      :add-query    (handle-add-query! store id event)
   709→      :remove-query (handle-remove-query! store id event)
   710→      :refresh      (handle-refresh! store id event debug-info)
   711→      :transact     (handle-transact! store id event)
   712→      :error        (handle-error! store id event)
   713→      ;; ----------
   714→      ;; sync-table
   715→      :start-sync (handle-start-sync! store id event)
   716→      :remove-sync (handle-remove-sync! store id event)
   717→      :refresh-sync-table (handle-refresh-sync-table! store id event)
   718→      :resync-table (handle-resync-table! store id event)
   719→      ;; ----------
   720→      ;; EPH events
   721→      :join-room        (handle-join-room! store id event)
   722→      :leave-room       (handle-leave-room! store id event)
   723→      :set-presence     (handle-set-presence! store id event)
   724→      :refresh-presence (handle-refresh-presence! store id event)
   725→      :client-broadcast (handle-client-broadcast! store id event)
   726→      :server-broadcast (handle-server-broadcast! store id event)
   727→
   728→      (handle-error! store id {:status 400
   729→                               :app-id (-> (rs/session store id)
   730→                                           :session/auth
   731→                                           :app
   732→                                           :id)
   733→                               :client-event-id (:client-event-id event)
   734→                               :original-event event
   735→                               :type :param-malformed
   736→                               :message "Invalid op"
   737→                               :hint {:op op}}))))
   738→
   739→;; --------------
   740→;; Receive Workers
   741→
   742→(declare on-close)
   743→
   744→(defn- handle-instant-exception [store session app-id original-event instant-ex debug-info]
   745→  (let [sess-id (:session/id session)
   746→        q (:receive-q (:session/socket session))
   747→        {:keys [client-event-id]} original-event
   748→        {:keys [::ex/type ::ex/message ::ex/hint] :as err-data} (ex-data instant-ex)]
   749→    (tracer/add-data! {:attributes {:err-data (pr-str err-data)}})
   750→    (if (= :error (:op original-event))
   751→      ;; Don't send an error if we failed to send the error or we'll get into an
   752→      ;; infinite loop of errors
   753→      (tracer/add-data! {:attributes {:error-on-error true}})
   754→      (case type
   755→        (::ex/record-not-found
   756→         ::ex/record-expired
   757→         ::ex/record-not-unique
   758→         ::ex/record-foreign-key-invalid
   759→         ::ex/record-check-violation
   760→         ::ex/sql-raise
   761→
   762→         ::ex/permission-denied
   763→         ::ex/permission-evaluation-failed
   764→
   765→         ::ex/param-missing
   766→         ::ex/param-malformed
   767→
   768→         ::ex/validation-failed)
   769→        (receive-queue/put! q
   770→                            {:op :error
   771→                             :app-id app-id
   772→                             :status 400
   773→                             :client-event-id client-event-id
   774→                             :original-event (merge original-event
   775→                                                    debug-info)
   776→                             :type (keyword (name type))
   777→                             :message message
   778→                             :hint hint
   779→                             :session-id sess-id})
   780→
   781→        ::ex/socket-missing
   782→        (do
   783→          (tracer/record-exception-span! instant-ex
   784→                                         {:name "receive-worker/socket-unreachable"})
   785→          (when-let [socket (:session/socket session)]
   786→            (on-close store socket)))
   787→
   788→        (::ex/session-missing
   789→         ::ex/socket-error)
   790→        (tracer/record-exception-span! instant-ex
   791→                                       {:name "receive-worker/socket-unreachable"})
   792→
   793→        (do
   794→          (tracer/add-exception! instant-ex {:escaping? false})
   795→          (receive-queue/put! q
   796→                              {:op :error
   797→                               :app-id app-id
   798→                               :status 500
   799→                               :client-event-id client-event-id
   800→                               :original-event (merge original-event
   801→                                                      debug-info)
   802→                               :type (keyword (name type))
   803→                               :message message
   804→                               :hint hint
   805→                               :session-id sess-id}))))))
   806→
   807→(defn- handle-uncaught-err [session app-id original-event root-err debug-info]
   808→  (let [sess-id (:session/id session)
   809→        q (:receive-q (:session/socket session))
   810→        {:keys [client-event-id]} original-event]
   811→    (tracer/add-exception! root-err {:escaping? false})
   812→    (if (= :error (:op original-event))
   813→      ;; Don't send an error if we failed to send the error or we'll get into an
   814→      ;; infinite loop of errors
   815→      (tracer/add-data! {:attributes {:error-on-error true}})
   816→      (receive-queue/put! q
   817→                          {:op :error
   818→                           :app-id app-id
   819→                           :client-event-id client-event-id
   820→                           :status 500
   821→                           :original-event (merge original-event
   822→                                                  debug-info)
   823→                           :message (str "Yikes, something broke on our end! Sorry about that."
   824→                                         " Please ping us (Joe and Stopa) on Discord and let us know!")
   825→                           :session-id sess-id}))))
   826→
   827→(defn handle-receive-attrs [store session event metadata]
   828→  (let [{:keys [session/socket]} session
   829→        sess-id (:session/id session)
   830→        event-attrs (event-attributes store sess-id event)]
   831→    (assoc (merge metadata event-attrs)
   832→           :socket-origin (rs/socket-origin socket)
   833→           :socket-ip (rs/socket-ip socket)
   834→           :session-id sess-id
   835→           :x-amzn-trace-id (rs/socket-x-amzn-trace-id socket)
   836→           :x-amzn-cf-id (rs/socket-x-amz-cf-id socket)

   841→(defn handle-receive [store session event metadata]
   842→  (tracer/with-exceptions-silencer [silence-exceptions]
   843→    (tracer/with-span! {:name "receive-worker/handle-receive"
   844→                        :attributes (handle-receive-attrs store session event metadata)}
   845→      (let [in-progress-stmts (sql/make-statement-tracker)
   846→            debug-info (atom nil)
   847→            app-id (-> session :session/auth :app :id)
   848→            timeout-ms (or (when app-id
   849→                             (flags/handle-receive-timeout app-id))
   850→                           handle-receive-timeout-ms)
   851→            event-fut (binding [sql/*in-progress-stmts* in-progress-stmts]
   852→                        (if-not (flags/use-more-vfutures?)
   853→                          (ua/tracked-future (handle-event store
   854→                                                           session
   855→                                                           event
   856→                                                           debug-info))
   857→                          (ua/vfuture (handle-event store
   858→                                                    session
   859→                                                    event
   860→                                                    debug-info))))
   861→            handler-id (add-pending-handler session {:future event-fut
   862→                                                     :op (:op event)
   863→                                                     :in-progress-stmts in-progress-stmts
   864→                                                     :silence-exceptions silence-exceptions})]
   865→        (tracer/add-data! {:attributes {:timeout-ms timeout-ms
   866→                                        :concurrent-handler-count (pending-handler-count session)}})
   867→        (try
   868→          (let [ret (deref event-fut timeout-ms :timeout)]
   869→            (when (= :timeout ret)
   870→              (let [in-progress-count (count @(:stmts in-progress-stmts))
   871→                    _ (sql/cancel-in-progress in-progress-stmts (flags/statement-cancel-wait-ms))
   872→                    cancel-res (future-cancel event-fut)]
   873→                (tracer/add-data! {:attributes
   874→                                   {:timedout true
   875→                                    :in-progress-query-count in-progress-count
   876→                                    ;; If false, then canceling the queries let
   877→                                    ;; the future complete before we could cancel it
   878→                                    :future-cancel-result cancel-res}}))
   879→              (ex/throw-operation-timeout! :handle-receive timeout-ms)))
   880→
   881→          (catch CancellationException _e
   882→            ;; We must have cancelled this in the on-close, so don't try to do any
   883→            ;; error handling
   884→            (tracer/record-info! {:name "handle-receive-cancelled"}))
   885→          (catch Throwable e
   886→            (tracer/record-info! {:name "caught-throwable"})
   887→            (let [original-event event
   888→                  instant-ex (ex/find-instant-exception e)
   889→                  root-err (root-cause e)
   890→                  app-id (some-> (rs/session store (:session/id session))
   891→                                 :session/auth
   892→                                 :app
   893→                                 :id)]
   894→              (cond
   895→                instant-ex (handle-instant-exception store
   896→                                                     session
   897→                                                     app-id
   898→                                                     original-event
   899→                                                     instant-ex
   900→                                                     @debug-info)
   901→                :else (handle-uncaught-err session
   902→                                           app-id
   903→                                           original-event
   904→                                           root-err
   905→                                           @debug-info))))
   906→          (finally
   907→            (remove-pending-handler session handler-id)))))))

   951→  (let [socket (:session/socket (rs/session store session-id))
   952→        stored-token-hash (:sse-token-hash socket)]
   953→    (when (or (not stored-token-hash)

   979→                          :attributes {:op op

   981→        (when before-cancel (before-cancel))

  1129→(defmulti combine

  1131→    [(:op event1) (:op event2)]))
  1132→
  1133→(defmethod combine :default [_ _]

  1135→
  1136→(defmethod combine [:refresh :refresh] [event1 event2]
  1137→  (e2e-tracer/invalidator-tracking-step!

  1141→  event2)

  1145→
  1146→(defmethod combine [:set-presence :set-presence] [_event1 event2]

  1151→
  1152→(defmethod combine [:server-broadcast :server-broadcast] [event1 event2]
  1153→  (if-let [payloads (::payloads event1)]

  1155→                                             :data (:data event2)}))
  1156→    (-> event2

  1158→                            :data (:data event1)}
  1159→                           {:topic (:topic event2)
  1160→                            :data (:data event2)}])
  1161→        (dissoc :topic :data))))

    42→(defn ws-listener
    43→  "Creates an `AbstractReceiveListener`. This relays calls to
    44→   `on-message`, `on-close-message`, and `on-error` callbacks.
    45→
    46→   See `ws-callback` for more details."
    47→  [{:keys [on-message on-close-message on-error channel-wrapper
    48→           ^AtomicLong atomic-last-received-at
    49→           ^AtomicLong atomic-last-ping-at
    50→           set-ping-latency-nanos]}]
    51→  (let [on-message       (or on-message (constantly nil))
    52→        on-error         (or on-error (constantly nil))
    53→        on-close-message (or on-close-message (constantly nil))]
    54→    (proxy [AbstractReceiveListener] []
    55→      (onFullTextMessage [^WebSocketChannel channel ^BufferedTextMessage message]
    56→
    57→        (.set atomic-last-received-at (System/currentTimeMillis))
    58→        (on-message {:channel (channel-wrapper channel)
    59→                     :data    (.getData message)}))
    60→      (onFullBinaryMessage [^WebSocketChannel channel ^BufferedBinaryMessage message]
    61→        (.set atomic-last-received-at (System/currentTimeMillis))
    62→        (let [pooled (.getData message)]
    63→          (try
    64→            (let [payload (.getResource pooled)]
    65→              (on-message {:channel (channel-wrapper channel)
    66→                           :data    (Util/toArray payload)}))
    67→            (finally (.free pooled)))))
    68→      (onPong [^WebSocketChannel channel ^StreamSourceFrameChannel channel]

    70→          (set-ping-latency-nanos (- (System/nanoTime) (.get atomic-last-ping-at))))
    71→        (.set atomic-last-received-at (System/currentTimeMillis)))
    72→      (onCloseMessage [^CloseMessage message ^WebSocketChannel channel]
    73→        (on-close-message {:channel (channel-wrapper  channel)
    74→                           :message message}))
    75→      (onError [^WebSocketChannel channel ^Throwable error]

   111→(defn ws-callback
   112→  "Creates a `WebsocketConnectionCallback`. This relays data to the
   113→   following callbacks:
   114→
   115→   on-open: Called when the websocket connection is opened.
   116→     :exchange - The underlying `WebSocketHttpExchange` object
   117→     :channel - The `WebSocketChannel` object
   118→
   119→   Note: `exchange` is useful when you want to extract information
   120→         from the underlying http request. i.e: headers, params, etc
   121→
   122→   on-message: Called when the client sends us a message
   123→     :channel - The `WebSocketChannel` object
   124→     :data - The message data
   125→
   126→   on-close-message: Called when the client closes the connection
   127→     :channel - The `WebSocketChannel` object
   128→     :message - The `CloseMessage` object
   129→
   130→     Note: on-close-message isn't _always_ called. If you want a
   131→           _guaranteed_ `close` callback, use `on-close` instead
   132→
   133→   on-close: Called when the connection is closed.
   134→    :channel - The `WebSocketChannel` object
   135→
   136→   on-error: Called when the server encounters an error sending a message
   137→     :channel - The `WebSocketChannel` object
   138→     :error - The error Throwable
   139→
   140→   We also kick off a ping worker. It sends a `ping` message every
   141→   `ping-interval-ms`. If the client doesn't send any message for
   142→   `idle-timeout-ms`, we close the connection.
   143→   "

   472→    const dfd = this.mutationDeferredStore.get(eventId);
   473→    this.mutationDeferredStore.delete(eventId);
   474→    const ok = status !== 'error' && status !== 'timeout';
   475→
   476→    if (!dfd && !ok) {
   477→      // console.erroring here, as there are no listeners to let know
   478→      console.error('Mutation failed', { status, eventId, ...errorMsg });
   479→    }
   480→    if (!dfd) {
   481→      return;
   482→    }
   483→    if (ok) {
   484→      dfd.resolve({ status, eventId });
   485→    } else {
   486→      // Check if error comes from server or client
   487→      if (errorMsg?.type) {
   488→        const { status, ...body } = errorMsg;
   489→        dfd.reject(
   490→          new InstantAPIError({
   491→            // @ts-expect-error body.type is not constant typed
   492→            body,
   493→            status: status ?? 0,
   494→          }),
   495→        );
   496→      } else {
   497→        dfd.reject(
   498→          new InstantError(
   499→            errorMsg?.message || 'Unknown error',
   500→            errorMsg?.hint,
   501→          ),
   502→        );
   503→      }
   504→    }
   505→  }
   506→
   507→  _setStatus(status, err) {
   508→    this.status = status;
   509→    this._errorMessage = err;
   510→    this.notifyConnectionStatusSubs(status);
   511→  }
   512→
   513→  _onMergeKv = (key, storageV, inMemoryV) => {
   514→    switch (key) {
   515→      case 'pendingMutations': {
   516→        const storageEntries = storageV?.entries() ?? [];
   517→        const inMemoryEntries = inMemoryV?.entries() ?? [];
   518→        const muts = new Map([...storageEntries, ...inMemoryEntries]);
   519→        const rewrittenStorageMuts = storageV
   520→          ? this._rewriteMutationsSorted(this.attrs, storageV)
   521→          : [];
   522→        rewrittenStorageMuts.forEach(([k, mut]) => {
   523→          if (!inMemoryV?.pendingMutations?.has(k) && !mut['tx-id']) {
   524→            this._sendMutation(k, mut);
   525→          }
   526→        });
   527→        return muts;
   528→      }
   529→      default:
   530→        return inMemoryV || storageV;
   531→    }
   532→  };
   533→
   534→  _flushEnqueuedRoomData(roomId) {
   535→    const enqueuedUserPresence = this._presence[roomId]?.result?.user;
   536→    const enqueuedBroadcasts = this._broadcastQueue[roomId];
   537→
   538→    this._broadcastQueue[roomId] = [];
   539→
   540→    if (enqueuedUserPresence) {
   541→      this._trySetPresence(roomId, enqueuedUserPresence);
   542→    }
   543→
   544→    if (enqueuedBroadcasts) {
   545→      for (const item of enqueuedBroadcasts) {
   546→        const { topic, roomType, data } = item;
   547→        this._tryBroadcast(roomId, roomType, topic, data);
   548→      }
   549→    }
   550→  }
   551→
   552→  _handleReceive(connId, msg) {
   553→    // opt-out, enabled by default if schema
   554→    const enableCardinalityInference =
   555→      Boolean(this.config.schema) &&
   556→      ('cardinalityInference' in this.config
   557→        ? Boolean(this.config.cardinalityInference)
   558→        : true);
   559→    if (!ignoreLogging[msg.op]) {
   560→      this._log.info('[receive]', connId, msg.op, msg);
   561→    }
   562→    switch (msg.op) {
   563→      case 'init-ok': {
   564→        this._setStatus(STATUS.AUTHENTICATED);
   565→        this._reconnectTimeoutMs = 0;
   566→        this._setAttrs(msg.attrs);
   567→        this._flushPendingMessages();
   568→        // (EPH): set session-id, so we know
   569→        // which item is us
   570→        this._sessionId = msg['session-id'];
   571→
   572→        for (const roomId of Object.keys(this._rooms)) {
   573→          const enqueuedUserPresence = this._presence[roomId]?.result?.user;
   574→          this._tryJoinRoom(roomId, enqueuedUserPresence);
   575→        }
   576→        break;
   577→      }
   578→      case 'add-query-exists': {
   579→        this.notifyOneQueryOnce(weakHash(msg.q));
   580→        break;
   581→      }
   582→      case 'add-query-ok': {
   583→        const { q, result } = msg;
   584→        const hash = weakHash(q);
   585→        if (!this._hasQueryListeners() && !this.querySubs.currentValue[hash]) {
   586→          break;
   587→        }
   588→        const pageInfo = result?.[0]?.data?.['page-info'];
   589→        const aggregate = result?.[0]?.data?.['aggregate'];
   590→        const triples = extractTriples(result);
   591→        const attrsStore = this.ensureAttrs();
   592→        const store = s.createStore(
   593→          attrsStore,
   594→          triples,
   595→          enableCardinalityInference,
   596→          this.config.useDateObjects,
   597→        );
   598→
   599→        this.querySubs.updateInPlace((prev) => {
   600→          if (!prev[hash]) {
   601→            this._log.info('Missing value in querySubs', { hash, q });
   602→            return;
   603→          }
   604→          prev[hash].result = {
   605→            store,
   606→            attrsStore,
   607→            pageInfo,
   608→            aggregate,
   609→            processedTxId: msg['processed-tx-id'],
   610→          };
   611→        });
   612→        this._cleanupPendingMutationsQueries();
   613→        this.notifyOne(hash);
   614→        this.notifyOneQueryOnce(hash);
   615→        this._cleanupPendingMutationsTimeout();
   616→        break;
   617→      }
   618→      case 'start-sync-ok': {
   619→        this._syncTable.onStartSyncOk(msg);
   620→        break;
   621→      }
   622→      case 'sync-load-batch': {
   623→        this._syncTable.onSyncLoadBatch(msg);
   624→        break;
   625→      }
   626→      case 'sync-init-finish': {
   627→        this._syncTable.onSyncInitFinish(msg);
   628→        break;
   629→      }
   630→      case 'sync-update-triples': {
   631→        this._syncTable.onSyncUpdateTriples(msg);
   632→        break;
   633→      }
   634→      case 'refresh-ok': {
   635→        const { computations, attrs } = msg;
   636→        const processedTxId = msg['processed-tx-id'];
   637→        if (attrs) {
   638→          this._setAttrs(attrs);
   639→        }
   640→
   641→        this._cleanupPendingMutationsTimeout();
   642→
   643→        const rewrittenMutations = this._rewriteMutations(
   644→          this.ensureAttrs(),
   645→          this._pendingMutations(),
   646→          processedTxId,
   647→        );
   648→
   649→        if (rewrittenMutations !== this._pendingMutations()) {
   650→          // We know we've changed the mutations to fix the attr ids and removed
   651→          // processed attrs, so we'll persist those changes to prevent optimisticAttrs
   652→          // from using old attr definitions
   653→          this.kv.updateInPlace((prev) => {
   654→            prev.pendingMutations = rewrittenMutations;
   655→          });
   656→        }
   657→
   658→        const mutations = sortedMutationEntries(rewrittenMutations.entries());
   659→
   660→        const updates = computations.map((x) => {
   661→          const q = x['instaql-query'];
   662→          const result = x['instaql-result'];
   663→          const hash = weakHash(q);
   664→          const triples = extractTriples(result);
   665→          const attrsStore = this.ensureAttrs();
   666→          const store = s.createStore(
   667→            attrsStore,
   668→            triples,
   669→            enableCardinalityInference,
   670→            this.config.useDateObjects,
   671→          );
   672→          const { store: newStore, attrsStore: newAttrsStore } =
   673→            this._applyOptimisticUpdates(
   674→              store,
   675→              attrsStore,
   676→              mutations,
   677→              processedTxId,
   678→            );
   679→          const pageInfo = result?.[0]?.data?.['page-info'];
   680→          const aggregate = result?.[0]?.data?.['aggregate'];
   681→          return {
   682→            q,
   683→            hash,
   684→            store: newStore,
   685→            attrsStore: newAttrsStore,
   686→            pageInfo,
   687→            aggregate,
   688→          };
   689→        });
   690→
   691→        updates.forEach(
   692→          ({ hash, q, store, attrsStore, pageInfo, aggregate }) => {
   693→            this.querySubs.updateInPlace((prev) => {
   694→              if (!prev[hash]) {
   695→                this._log.error('Missing value in querySubs', { hash, q });
   696→                return;
   697→              }
   698→              prev[hash].result = {
   699→                store,
   700→                attrsStore,
   701→                pageInfo,
   702→                aggregate,
   703→                processedTxId,
   704→              };
   705→            });
   706→          },
   707→        );
   708→
   709→        this._cleanupPendingMutationsQueries();
   710→
   711→        updates.forEach(({ hash }) => {
   712→          this.notifyOne(hash);
   713→        });
   714→        break;
   715→      }
   716→      case 'transact-ok': {
   717→        const { 'client-event-id': eventId, 'tx-id': txId } = msg;
   718→
   719→        this._inFlightMutationEventIds.delete(eventId);
   720→
   721→        const muts = this._rewriteMutations(
   722→          this.ensureAttrs(),
   723→          this._pendingMutations(),
   724→        );
   725→        const prevMutation = muts.get(eventId);
   726→        if (!prevMutation) {
   727→          break;
   728→        }
   729→
   730→        // update pendingMutation with server-side tx-id
   731→        this._updatePendingMutations((prev) => {
   732→          prev.set(eventId, {
   733→            ...prev.get(eventId),
   734→            'tx-id': txId,
   735→            confirmed: Date.now(),
   736→          });
   737→        });
   738→
   739→        const newAttrs = [];
   740→        for (const step of prevMutation['tx-steps']) {
   741→          if (step[0] === 'add-attr') {
   742→            const attr = step[1];
   743→            newAttrs.push(attr);
   744→          }
   745→        }
   746→        if (newAttrs.length) {
   747→          const existingAttrs = Object.values(this.ensureAttrs().attrs);
   748→          this._setAttrs([...existingAttrs, ...newAttrs]);
   749→        }
   750→
   751→        this._finishTransaction('synced', eventId);
   752→
   753→        this._cleanupPendingMutationsTimeout();
   754→
   755→        break;
   756→      }
   757→      case 'patch-presence': {
   758→        const roomId = msg['room-id'];
   759→        this._trySetRoomConnected(roomId, true);
   760→        this._patchPresencePeers(roomId, msg['edits']);
   761→        this._notifyPresenceSubs(roomId);
   762→        break;
   763→      }
   764→      case 'refresh-presence': {
   765→        const roomId = msg['room-id'];
   766→        this._trySetRoomConnected(roomId, true);
   767→        this._setPresencePeers(roomId, msg['data']);
   768→        this._notifyPresenceSubs(roomId);
   769→        break;
   770→      }
   771→      case 'server-broadcast': {
   772→        const room = msg['room-id'];
   773→        const topic = msg.topic;
   774→        this._trySetRoomConnected(room, true);
   775→        this._notifyBroadcastSubs(room, topic, msg);
   776→        break;
   777→      }
   778→      case 'join-room-ok': {
   779→        const loadingRoomId = msg['room-id'];
   780→        const joinedRoom = this._rooms[loadingRoomId];
   781→
   782→        if (!joinedRoom) {
   783→          if (this._roomsPendingLeave[loadingRoomId]) {
   784→            this._tryLeaveRoom(loadingRoomId);
   785→            delete this._roomsPendingLeave[loadingRoomId];
   786→          }
   787→
   788→          break;
   789→        }
   790→
   791→        this._trySetRoomConnected(loadingRoomId, true);
   792→        this._flushEnqueuedRoomData(loadingRoomId);
   793→        break;
   794→      }
   795→      case 'leave-room-ok': {
   796→        const roomId = msg['room-id'];
   797→        this._trySetRoomConnected(roomId, false);
   798→        break;
   799→      }
   800→      case 'join-room-error':
   801→        const errorRoomId = msg['room-id'];
   802→        const errorRoom = this._rooms[errorRoomId];
   803→        if (errorRoom) {
   804→          errorRoom.error = msg['error'];
   805→        }
   806→        this._notifyPresenceSubs(errorRoomId);
   807→        break;
   808→      case 'error':
   809→        this._handleReceiveError(msg);
   810→        break;
   811→      default:
   812→        this._log.info('Uknown op', msg.op, msg);
   813→        break;
   814→    }
   815→  }
   816→
   817→  _pendingMutations() {
   818→    return this.kv.currentValue.pendingMutations ?? new Map();
   819→  }
   820→
   821→  _updatePendingMutations(f) {
   822→    this.kv.updateInPlace((prev) => {
   823→      const muts = prev.pendingMutations ?? new Map();
   824→      prev.pendingMutations = muts;
   825→      f(muts);
   826→    });
   827→  }
   828→
   829→  /**
   830→   * @param {'timeout' | 'error'} status
   831→   * @param {string} eventId
   832→   * @param {{message?: string, type?: string, status?: number, hint?: unknown}} errorMsg
   833→   */
   834→  _handleMutationError(status, eventId, errorMsg) {
   835→    const mut = this._pendingMutations().get(eventId);
   836→
   837→    if (mut && (status !== 'timeout' || !mut['tx-id'])) {
   838→      this._updatePendingMutations((prev) => {
   839→        prev.delete(eventId);
   840→        return prev;
   841→      });
   842→      this._inFlightMutationEventIds.delete(eventId);
   843→      const errDetails = {
   844→        message: errorMsg.message,
   845→        hint: errorMsg.hint,
   846→      };
   847→      this.notifyAll();
   848→      this.notifyAttrsSubs();
   849→      this.notifyMutationErrorSubs(errDetails);
   850→      this._finishTransaction(status, eventId, errorMsg);
   851→    }
   852→  }
   853→
   854→  _handleReceiveError(msg) {
   855→    console.log('error', msg);
   856→    const eventId = msg['client-event-id'];
   857→    // This might not be a mutation, but it can't hurt to delete it
   858→    this._inFlightMutationEventIds.delete(eventId);
   859→    const prevMutation = this._pendingMutations().get(eventId);
   860→    const errorMessage = {
   861→      message: msg.message || 'Uh-oh, something went wrong. Ping Joe & Stopa.',
   862→    };
   863→
   864→    if (msg.hint) {
   865→      errorMessage.hint = msg.hint;
   866→    }
   867→
   868→    if (prevMutation) {
   869→      this._handleMutationError('error', eventId, msg);
   870→      return;
   871→    }
   872→
   873→    if (
   874→      msg['original-event']?.hasOwnProperty('q') &&
   875→      msg['original-event']?.op === 'add-query'
   876→    ) {
   877→      const q = msg['original-event']?.q;
   878→      const hash = weakHash(q);
   879→      this.notifyQueryError(weakHash(q), errorMessage);
   880→      this.notifyQueryOnceError(q, hash, eventId, errorMessage);
   881→      return;
   882→    }
   883→
   884→    const isInitError = msg['original-event']?.op === 'init';
   885→    if (isInitError) {
   886→      if (
   887→        msg.type === 'record-not-found' &&
   888→        msg.hint?.['record-type'] === 'app-user'
   889→      ) {
   890→        // User has been logged out
   891→        this.changeCurrentUser(null);
   892→        return;
   893→      }
   894→
   895→      // We failed to init
   896→
   897→      this._setStatus(STATUS.ERRORED, errorMessage);
   898→      this.notifyAll();
   899→      return;
   900→    }
   901→
   902→    if (msg['original-event']?.op === 'resync-table') {
   903→      this._syncTable.onResyncError(msg);
   904→      return;
   905→    }
   906→
   907→    if (msg['original-event']?.op === 'start-sync') {
   908→      this._syncTable.onStartSyncError(msg);
   909→      return;
   910→    }
   911→    // We've caught some error which has no corresponding listener.
   912→    // Let's console.error to let the user know.
   913→    const errorObj = { ...msg };
   914→    delete errorObj.message;
   915→    delete errorObj.hint;
   916→    console.error(msg.message, errorObj);
   917→    if (msg.hint) {
   918→      console.error(
   919→        'This error comes with some debugging information. Here it is: \n',
   920→        msg.hint,
   921→      );
   922→    }
   923→  }
   924→
   925→  notifyQueryOnceError(q, hash, eventId, e) {
   926→    const r = this.queryOnceDfds[hash]?.find((r) => r.eventId === eventId);
   927→    if (!r) return;
   928→    r.dfd.reject(e);
   929→    this._completeQueryOnce(q, hash, r.dfd);
   930→  }
   931→
   932→  _setAttrs(attrs) {
   933→    this.attrs = new s.AttrsStoreClass(
   934→      attrs.reduce((acc, attr) => {
   935→        acc[attr.id] = attr;
   936→        return acc;
   937→      }, {}),
   938→      this._linkIndex,
   939→    );
   940→
   941→    this.notifyAttrsSubs();
   942→  }
   943→
   944→  // ---------------------------
   945→  // Queries
   946→
   947→  getPreviousResult = (q) => {
   948→    const hash = weakHash(q);
   949→    return this.dataForQuery(hash)?.data;
   950→  };
   951→
   952→  _startQuerySub(q, hash) {
   953→    const eventId = uuid();
   954→    this.querySubs.updateInPlace((prev) => {
   955→      prev[hash] = prev[hash] || { q, result: null, eventId };
   956→      prev[hash].lastAccessed = Date.now();
   957→    });
   958→    this._trySendAuthed(eventId, { op: 'add-query', q });
   959→
   960→    return eventId;
   961→  }
   962→
   963→  subscribeTable(q, cb) {
   964→    return this._syncTable.subscribe(q, cb);
   965→  }
   966→
   967→  /**
   968→   *  When a user subscribes to a query the following side effects occur:
   969→   *
   970→   *  - We update querySubs to include the new query
   971→   *  - We update queryCbs to include the new cb
   972→   *  - If we already have a result for the query we call cb immediately
   973→   *  - We send the server an `add-query` message
   974→   *
   975→   *  Returns an unsubscribe function
   976→   */
   977→  subscribeQuery(q, cb, opts) {
   978→    if (!this.config.disableValidation) {
   979→      validateQuery(q, this.config.schema);
   980→    }
   981→    if (opts && 'ruleParams' in opts) {
   982→      q = { $$ruleParams: opts['ruleParams'], ...q };
   983→    }
   984→
   985→    const hash = weakHash(q);
   986→
   987→    const prevResult = this.getPreviousResult(q);
   988→    if (prevResult) {
   989→      cb(prevResult);
   990→    }
   991→
   992→    this.queryCbs[hash] = this.queryCbs[hash] ?? [];
   993→    this.queryCbs[hash].push({ q, cb });
   994→
   995→    this._startQuerySub(q, hash);
   996→
   997→    return () => {
   998→      this._unsubQuery(q, hash, cb);
   999→    };
  1000→  }
  1001→
  1002→  queryOnce(q, opts) {
  1003→    if (!this.config.disableValidation) {
  1004→      validateQuery(q, this.config.schema);
  1005→    }
  1006→
  1007→    if (opts && 'ruleParams' in opts) {
  1008→      q = { $$ruleParams: opts['ruleParams'], ...q };
  1009→    }
  1010→
  1011→    const dfd = new Deferred();
  1012→
  1013→    if (!this._isOnline) {
  1014→      dfd.reject(
  1015→        new Error("We can't run `queryOnce`, because the device is offline."),
  1016→      );
  1017→      return dfd.promise;
  1018→    }
  1019→
  1020→    if (!this.querySubs) {
  1021→      dfd.reject(
  1022→        new Error(
  1023→          "We can't run `queryOnce` on the backend. Use adminAPI.query instead: https://www.instantdb.com/docs/backend#query",
  1024→        ),
  1025→      );
  1026→      return dfd.promise;
  1027→    }
  1028→
  1029→    const hash = weakHash(q);
  1030→
  1031→    const eventId = this._startQuerySub(q, hash);
  1032→
  1033→    this.queryOnceDfds[hash] = this.queryOnceDfds[hash] ?? [];
  1034→    this.queryOnceDfds[hash].push({ q, dfd, eventId });
  1035→
  1036→    setTimeout(
  1037→      () => dfd.reject(new Error('Query timed out')),
  1038→      QUERY_ONCE_TIMEOUT,
  1039→    );
  1040→
  1041→    return dfd.promise;
  1042→  }
  1043→
  1044→  _completeQueryOnce(q, hash, dfd) {
  1045→    if (!this.queryOnceDfds[hash]) return;
  1046→
  1047→    this.queryOnceDfds[hash] = this.queryOnceDfds[hash].filter(
  1048→      (r) => r.dfd !== dfd,
  1049→    );
  1050→
  1051→    this._cleanupQuery(q, hash);
  1052→  }
  1053→
  1054→  _unsubQuery(q, hash, cb) {
  1055→    if (!this.queryCbs[hash]) return;
  1056→
  1057→    this.queryCbs[hash] = this.queryCbs[hash].filter((r) => r.cb !== cb);
  1058→
  1059→    this._cleanupQuery(q, hash);
  1060→  }
  1061→
  1062→  _hasQueryListeners(hash) {
  1063→    return !!(this.queryCbs[hash]?.length || this.queryOnceDfds[hash]?.length);
  1064→  }
  1065→
  1066→  _cleanupQuery(q, hash) {
  1067→    const hasListeners = this._hasQueryListeners(hash);
  1068→    if (hasListeners) return;
  1069→    delete this.queryCbs[hash];
  1070→    delete this.queryOnceDfds[hash];
  1071→    delete this._dataForQueryCache[hash];
  1072→    this.querySubs.unloadKey(hash);
  1073→
  1074→    this._trySendAuthed(uuid(), { op: 'remove-query', q });
  1075→  }
  1076→
  1077→  // When we `pushTx`, it's possible that we don't yet have `this.attrs`
  1078→  // This means that `tx-steps` in `pendingMutations` will include `add-attr`
  1079→  // commands for attrs that already exist.
  1080→  //
  1081→  // This will also affect `add-triple` and `retract-triple` which
  1082→  // reference attr-ids that do not match the server.
  1083→  //
  1084→  // We fix this by rewriting `tx-steps` in each `pendingMutation`.
  1085→  // We remove `add-attr` commands for attrs that already exist.
  1086→  // We update `add-triple` and `retract-triple` commands to use the
  1087→  // server attr-ids.
  1088→  /**
  1089→   *
  1090→   * @param {s.AttrsStore} attrs
  1091→   * @param {any} muts
  1092→   * @param {number} [processedTxId]
  1093→   */
  1094→  _rewriteMutations(attrs, muts, processedTxId) {
  1095→    if (!attrs) return muts;
  1096→    if (!muts) return new Map();
  1097→    const findExistingAttr = (attr) => {
  1098→      const [_, etype, label] = attr['forward-identity'];
  1099→      const existing = s.getAttrByFwdIdentName(attrs, etype, label);
  1100→      return existing;
  1101→    };
  1102→    const findReverseAttr = (attr) => {
  1103→      const [_, etype, label] = attr['forward-identity'];
  1104→      const revAttr = s.getAttrByReverseIdentName(attrs, etype, label);
  1105→      return revAttr;
  1106→    };
  1107→    const mapping = { attrIdMap: {}, refSwapAttrIds: new Set() };
  1108→    let mappingChanged = false;
  1109→
  1110→    const rewriteTxSteps = (txSteps, txId) => {
  1111→      const retTxSteps = [];
  1112→      for (const txStep of txSteps) {
  1113→        const [action] = txStep;
  1114→
  1115→        // Handles add-attr
  1116→        // If existing, we drop it, and track it
  1117→        // to update add/retract triples
  1118→        if (action === 'add-attr') {
  1119→          const [_action, attr] = txStep;
  1120→          const existing = findExistingAttr(attr);
  1121→          if (existing && attr.id !== existing.id) {
  1122→            mapping.attrIdMap[attr.id] = existing.id;
  1123→            mappingChanged = true;
  1124→            continue;
  1125→          }
  1126→          if (attr['value-type'] === 'ref') {
  1127→            const revAttr = findReverseAttr(attr);
  1128→            if (revAttr) {
  1129→              mapping.attrIdMap[attr.id] = revAttr.id;
  1130→              mapping.refSwapAttrIds.add(attr.id);
  1131→              mappingChanged = true;
  1132→              continue;
  1133→            }
  1134→          }
  1135→        }
  1136→
  1137→        if (
  1138→          (processedTxId &&
  1139→            txId &&
  1140→            processedTxId >= txId &&
  1141→            action === 'add-attr') ||
  1142→          action === 'update-attr' ||
  1143→          action === 'delete-attr'
  1144→        ) {
  1145→          mappingChanged = true;
  1146→          // Don't add this step because we already have the newer attrs
  1147→          continue;
  1148→        }
  1149→        // Handles add-triple|retract-triple
  1150→        // If in mapping, we update the attr-id
  1151→        const newTxStep = mappingChanged
  1152→          ? instaml.rewriteStep(mapping, txStep)
  1153→          : txStep;
  1154→
  1155→        retTxSteps.push(newTxStep);
  1156→      }
  1157→
  1158→      return mappingChanged ? retTxSteps : txSteps;
  1159→    };
  1160→
  1161→    const rewritten = new Map();
  1162→    for (const [k, mut] of muts.entries()) {
  1163→      rewritten.set(k, {
  1164→        ...mut,
  1165→        'tx-steps': rewriteTxSteps(mut['tx-steps'], mut['tx-id']),
  1166→      });
  1167→    }
  1168→    if (!mappingChanged) {
  1169→      return muts;
  1170→    }
  1171→    return rewritten;
  1172→  }
  1173→
  1174→  _rewriteMutationsSorted(attrs, muts) {
  1175→    return sortedMutationEntries(this._rewriteMutations(attrs, muts).entries());
  1176→  }
  1177→
  1178→  // ---------------------------
  1179→  // Transact
  1180→
  1181→  /**
  1182→   * @returns {s.AttrsStore}
  1183→   */
  1184→  optimisticAttrs() {
  1185→    const pendingMutationSteps = [...this._pendingMutations().values()] // hack due to Map()
  1186→      .flatMap((x) => x['tx-steps']);
  1187→
  1188→    const deletedAttrIds = new Set(
  1189→      pendingMutationSteps
  1190→        .filter(([action, _attr]) => action === 'delete-attr')
  1191→        .map(([_action, id]) => id),
  1192→    );
  1193→
  1194→    const pendingAttrs = [];
  1195→    for (const [_action, attr] of pendingMutationSteps) {
  1196→      if (_action === 'add-attr') {
  1197→        pendingAttrs.push(attr);
  1198→      } else if (
  1199→        _action === 'update-attr' &&
  1200→        attr.id &&
  1201→        this.attrs?.getAttr(attr.id)
  1202→      ) {
  1203→        const fullAttr = { ...this.attrs.getAttr(attr.id), ...attr };
  1204→        pendingAttrs.push(fullAttr);
  1205→      }
  1206→    }
  1207→
  1208→    if (!deletedAttrIds.size && !pendingAttrs.length) {
  1209→      return this.attrs || new s.AttrsStoreClass({}, this._linkIndex);
  1210→    }
  1211→
  1212→    const attrs = { ...(this.attrs?.attrs || {}) };
  1213→    for (const attr of pendingAttrs) {
  1214→      attrs[attr.id] = attr;
  1215→    }
  1216→    for (const id of deletedAttrIds) {
  1217→      delete attrs[id];
  1218→    }
  1219→
  1220→    return new s.AttrsStoreClass(attrs, this._linkIndex);
  1221→  }
  1222→
  1223→  /** Runs instaql on a query and a store */
  1224→  dataForQuery(hash) {
  1225→    const errorMessage = this._errorMessage;
  1226→    if (errorMessage) {
  1227→      return { error: errorMessage };
  1228→    }
  1229→    if (!this.querySubs) return;
  1230→    if (!this.kv.currentValue.pendingMutations) return;
  1231→    const querySubVersion = this.querySubs.version();
  1232→    const querySubs = this.querySubs.currentValue;
  1233→    const pendingMutationsVersion = this.kv.version();
  1234→    const pendingMutations = this._pendingMutations();
  1235→
  1236→    const { q, result } = querySubs[hash] || {};
  1237→    if (!result) return;
  1238→
  1239→    const cached = this._dataForQueryCache[hash];
  1240→    if (
  1241→      cached &&
  1242→      querySubVersion === cached.querySubVersion &&
  1243→      pendingMutationsVersion === cached.pendingMutationsVersion
  1244→    ) {
  1245→      return cached;
  1246→    }
  1247→
  1248→    const { store, attrsStore, pageInfo, aggregate, processedTxId } = result;
  1249→    const mutations = this._rewriteMutationsSorted(
  1250→      attrsStore,
  1251→      pendingMutations,
  1252→    );
  1253→    const { store: newStore, attrsStore: newAttrsStore } =
  1254→      this._applyOptimisticUpdates(store, attrsStore, mutations, processedTxId);
  1255→    const resp = instaql(
  1256→      { store: newStore, attrsStore: newAttrsStore, pageInfo, aggregate },
  1257→      q,
  1258→    );
  1259→
  1260→    return { data: resp, querySubVersion, pendingMutationsVersion };
  1261→  }
  1262→
  1263→  _applyOptimisticUpdates(store, attrsStore, mutations, processedTxId) {
  1264→    for (const [_, mut] of mutations) {
  1265→      if (!mut['tx-id'] || (processedTxId && mut['tx-id'] > processedTxId)) {
  1266→        const result = s.transact(store, attrsStore, mut['tx-steps']);
  1267→        store = result.store;
  1268→        attrsStore = result.attrsStore;
  1269→      }
  1270→    }
  1271→    return { store, attrsStore };
  1272→  }
  1273→
  1274→  /** Re-run instaql and call all callbacks with new data */
  1275→  notifyOne = (hash) => {
  1276→    const cbs = this.queryCbs[hash] ?? [];
  1277→    const prevData = this._dataForQueryCache[hash]?.data;
  1278→    const resp = this.dataForQuery(hash);
  1279→
  1280→    if (!resp?.data) return;
  1281→    this._dataForQueryCache[hash] = resp;
  1282→    if (areObjectsDeepEqual(resp.data, prevData)) return;
  1283→
  1284→    cbs.forEach((r) => r.cb(resp.data));
  1285→  };
  1286→
  1287→  notifyOneQueryOnce = (hash) => {
  1288→    const dfds = this.queryOnceDfds[hash] ?? [];
  1289→    const data = this.dataForQuery(hash)?.data;
  1290→
  1291→    dfds.forEach((r) => {
  1292→      this._completeQueryOnce(r.q, hash, r.dfd);
  1293→      r.dfd.resolve(data);
  1294→    });
  1295→  };
  1296→
  1297→  notifyQueryError = (hash, error) => {
  1298→    const cbs = this.queryCbs[hash] || [];
  1299→    cbs.forEach((r) => r.cb({ error }));
  1300→  };
  1301→
  1302→  /** Re-compute all subscriptions */
  1303→  notifyAll() {
  1304→    Object.keys(this.queryCbs).forEach((hash) => {
  1305→      this.querySubs
  1306→        .waitForKeyToLoad(hash)
  1307→        .then(() => this.notifyOne(hash))
  1308→        .catch(() => this.notifyOne(hash));
  1309→    });
  1310→  }
  1311→
  1312→  loadedNotifyAll() {
  1313→    this.kv
  1314→      .waitForKeyToLoad('pendingMutations')
  1315→      .then(() => this.notifyAll())
  1316→      .catch(() => this.notifyAll());
  1317→  }
  1318→
  1319→  /** Applies transactions locally and sends transact message to server */
  1320→  pushTx = (chunks) => {
  1321→    // Throws if transactions are invalid
  1322→    if (!this.config.disableValidation) {
  1323→      validateTransactions(chunks, this.config.schema);
  1324→    }
  1325→    try {
  1326→      const txSteps = instaml.transform(
  1327→        {
  1328→          attrsStore: this.optimisticAttrs(),
  1329→          schema: this.config.schema,
  1330→          stores: Object.values(this.querySubs.currentValue).map(
  1331→            (sub) => sub?.result?.store,
  1332→          ),
  1333→          useDateObjects: this.config.useDateObjects,
  1334→        },
  1335→        chunks,
  1336→      );
  1337→      return this.pushOps(txSteps);
  1338→    } catch (e) {
  1339→      return this.pushOps([], e);
  1340→    }
  1341→  };
  1342→
  1343→  /**
  1344→   * @param {*} txSteps
  1345→   * @param {*} [error]
  1346→   * @returns
  1347→   */
  1348→  pushOps = (txSteps, error) => {
  1349→    const eventId = uuid();
  1350→    const mutations = [...this._pendingMutations().values()];
  1351→    const order = Math.max(0, ...mutations.map((mut) => mut.order || 0)) + 1;
  1352→    const mutation = {
  1353→      op: 'transact',
  1354→      'tx-steps': txSteps,
  1355→      created: Date.now(),
  1356→      error,
  1357→      order,
  1358→    };
  1359→    this._updatePendingMutations((prev) => {
  1360→      prev.set(eventId, mutation);
  1361→    });
  1362→
  1363→    const dfd = new Deferred();
  1364→    this.mutationDeferredStore.set(eventId, dfd);
  1365→    this._sendMutation(eventId, mutation);
  1366→
  1367→    this.notifyAll();
  1368→
  1369→    return dfd.promise;
  1370→  };
  1371→
  1372→  shutdown() {
  1373→    this._log.info('[shutdown]', this.config.appId);
  1374→    this._isShutdown = true;
  1375→    this._transport?.close();
  1376→  }
  1377→
  1378→  /**
  1379→   * Sends mutation to server and schedules a timeout to cancel it if
  1380→   * we don't hear back in time.
  1381→   * Note: If we're offline we don't schedule a timeout, we'll schedule it
  1382→   * later once we're back online and send the mutation again
  1383→   *
  1384→   */
  1385→  _sendMutation(eventId, mutation) {
  1386→    if (mutation.error) {
  1387→      this._handleMutationError('error', eventId, {
  1388→        message: mutation.error.message,
  1389→      });
  1390→      return;
  1391→    }
  1392→    if (this.status !== STATUS.AUTHENTICATED) {
  1393→      this._finishTransaction('enqueued', eventId);
  1394→      return;
  1395→    }
  1396→    const timeoutMs = Math.max(
  1397→      6000,
  1398→      Math.min(
  1399→        this._inFlightMutationEventIds.size + 1,
  1400→        // Defensive code in case we don't clean up in flight mutation event ids
  1401→        this._pendingMutations().size + 1,
  1402→      ) * 6000,
  1403→    );
  1404→
  1405→    if (!this._isOnline) {
  1406→      this._finishTransaction('enqueued', eventId);
  1407→    } else {
  1408→      this._trySend(eventId, mutation);
  1409→
  1410→      setTimeout(() => {
  1411→        if (!this._isOnline) {
  1412→          return;
  1413→        }
  1414→        // If we are here, this means that we have sent this mutation, we are online
  1415→        // but we have not received a response. If it's this long, something must be wrong,
  1416→        // so we error with a timeout.
  1417→        this._handleMutationError('timeout', eventId, {
  1418→          message: 'transaction timed out',
  1419→        });
  1420→      }, timeoutMs);
  1421→    }
  1422→  }
  1423→
  1424→  // ---------------------------
  1425→  // Websocket
  1426→
  1427→  /** Send messages we accumulated while we were connecting */
  1428→  _flushPendingMessages() {
  1429→    const subs = Object.keys(this.queryCbs).map((hash) => {
  1430→      return this.querySubs.currentValue[hash];
  1431→    });
  1432→    // Note: we should not have any nulls in subs, but we're
  1433→    // doing this defensively just in case.
  1434→    const safeSubs = subs.filter((x) => x);
  1435→    safeSubs.forEach(({ eventId, q }) => {
  1436→      this._trySendAuthed(eventId, { op: 'add-query', q });
  1437→    });
  1438→
  1439→    Object.values(this.queryOnceDfds)
  1440→      .flat()
  1441→      .forEach(({ eventId, q }) => {
  1442→        this._trySendAuthed(eventId, { op: 'add-query', q });
  1443→      });
  1444→
  1445→    const muts = this._rewriteMutationsSorted(
  1446→      this.ensureAttrs(),
  1447→      this._pendingMutations(),
  1448→    );
  1449→    muts.forEach(([eventId, mut]) => {
  1450→      if (!mut['tx-id']) {
  1451→        this._sendMutation(eventId, mut);
  1452→      }
  1453→    });
  1454→
  1455→    this._syncTable.flushPending();
  1456→  }
  1457→
  1458→  /**
  1459→   * Clean up pendingMutations that all queries have seen
  1460→   */
  1461→  _cleanupPendingMutationsQueries() {
  1462→    let minProcessedTxId = Number.MAX_SAFE_INTEGER;
  1463→    for (const { result } of Object.values(this.querySubs.currentValue)) {
  1464→      if (result?.processedTxId) {
  1465→        minProcessedTxId = Math.min(minProcessedTxId, result?.processedTxId);
  1466→      }
  1467→    }
  1468→
  1469→    this._updatePendingMutations((prev) => {
  1470→      for (const [eventId, mut] of Array.from(prev.entries())) {
  1471→        if (mut['tx-id'] && mut['tx-id'] <= minProcessedTxId) {
  1472→          prev.delete(eventId);
  1473→        }
  1474→      }
  1475→    });
  1476→  }
  1477→
  1478→  /**
  1479→   * After mutations is confirmed by server, we give each query 30 sec
  1480→   * to update its results. If that doesn't happen, we assume query is
  1481→   * unaffected by this mutation and it’s safe to delete it from local queue
  1482→   */
  1483→  _cleanupPendingMutationsTimeout() {
  1484→    if (this._pendingMutations().size < this._pendingMutationCleanupThreshold) {
  1485→      return;
  1486→    }
  1487→
  1488→    const now = Date.now();
  1489→
  1490→    this._updatePendingMutations((prev) => {
  1491→      for (const [eventId, mut] of Array.from(prev.entries())) {
  1492→        if (
  1493→          mut.confirmed &&
  1494→          mut.confirmed + this._pendingTxCleanupTimeout < now
  1495→        ) {
  1496→          prev.delete(eventId);
  1497→        }
  1498→      }
  1499→    });
  1500→  }
  1501→
  1502→  _trySendAuthed(...args) {
  1503→    if (this.status !== STATUS.AUTHENTICATED) {
  1504→      return;
  1505→    }
  1506→    this._trySend(...args);
  1507→  }
  1508→
  1509→  _trySend(eventId, msg, opts) {
  1510→    if (!this._transport.isOpen()) {
  1511→      return;
  1512→    }
  1513→    if (!ignoreLogging[msg.op]) {
  1514→      this._log.info('[send]', this._transport.id, msg.op, msg);
  1515→    }
  1516→    switch (msg.op) {
  1517→      case 'transact': {
  1518→        this._inFlightMutationEventIds.add(eventId);
  1519→        break;
  1520→      }
  1521→      case 'init': {
  1522→        // New connection, so we can't have any mutations in flight
  1523→        this._inFlightMutationEventIds.clear();
  1524→      }
  1525→    }
  1526→    this._transport.send({ 'client-event-id': eventId, ...msg });
  1527→  }
  1528→
  1529→  _transportOnOpen = (e) => {
  1530→    const targetTransport = e.target;
  1531→    if (this._transport !== targetTransport) {
  1532→      this._log.info(
  1533→        '[socket][open]',
  1534→        targetTransport.id,
  1535→        'skip; this is no longer the current transport',
  1536→      );
  1537→      return;
  1538→    }
  1539→    this._log.info('[socket][open]', this._transport.id);
  1540→    this._setStatus(STATUS.OPENED);
  1541→
  1542→    this.getCurrentUser()
  1543→      .then((resp) => {
  1544→        this._trySend(uuid(), {
  1545→          op: 'init',
  1546→          'app-id': this.config.appId,
  1547→          'refresh-token': resp.user?.['refresh_token'],
  1548→          versions: this.versions,
  1549→          // If an admin token is provided for an app, we will
  1550→          // skip all permission checks. This is an advanced feature,
  1551→          // to let users write internal tools
  1552→          // This option is not exposed in `Config`, as it's
  1553→          // not ready for prime time
  1554→          '__admin-token': this.config.__adminToken,
  1555→        });
  1556→      })
  1557→      .catch((e) => {
  1558→        this._log.error('[socket][error]', targetTransport.id, e);
  1559→      });
  1560→  };
  1561→
  1562→  _transportOnMessage = (e) => {
  1563→    const targetTransport = e.target;
  1564→    const m = e.message;
  1565→    if (this._transport !== targetTransport) {
  1566→      this._log.info(
  1567→        '[socket][message]',
  1568→        targetTransport.id,
  1569→        m,
  1570→        'skip; this is no longer the current transport',
  1571→      );
  1572→      return;
  1573→    }
  1574→
  1575→    if (!this._wsOk && targetTransport.type === 'ws') {
  1576→      this._wsOk = true;
  1577→    }
  1578→    // Try to reconnect via websocket the next time we connect
  1579→    this._transportType = 'ws';
  1580→    if (Array.isArray(e.message)) {
  1581→      for (const msg of e.message) {
  1582→        this._handleReceive(targetTransport.id, msg);
  1583→      }
  1584→    } else {
  1585→      this._handleReceive(targetTransport.id, e.message);
  1586→    }
  1587→  };
  1588→
  1589→  _transportOnError = (e) => {
  1590→    const targetTransport = e.target;
  1591→    if (this._transport !== targetTransport) {
  1592→      this._log.info(
  1593→        '[socket][error]',
  1594→        targetTransport.id,
  1595→        'skip; this is no longer the current transport',
  1596→      );
  1597→      return;
  1598→    }
  1599→    this._log.error('[socket][error]', targetTransport.id, e);
  1600→  };
  1601→
  1602→  _scheduleReconnect = () => {
  1603→    // If we couldn't connect with a websocket last time, try sse
  1604→    if (!this._wsOk && this._transportType !== 'sse') {
  1605→      this._transportType = 'sse';
  1606→      this._reconnectTimeoutMs = 0;
  1607→    }
  1608→    setTimeout(() => {
  1609→      this._reconnectTimeoutMs = Math.min(
  1610→        this._reconnectTimeoutMs + 1000,
  1611→        10000,
  1612→      );
  1613→      if (!this._isOnline) {
  1614→        this._log.info(
  1615→          '[socket][close]',
  1616→          this._transport.id,
  1617→          'we are offline, no need to start socket',
  1618→        );
  1619→        return;
  1620→      }
  1621→
  1622→      this._startSocket();
  1623→    }, this._reconnectTimeoutMs);
  1624→  };
  1625→
  1626→  _transportOnClose = (e) => {
  1627→    const targetTransport = e.target;
  1628→    if (this._transport !== targetTransport) {
  1629→      this._log.info(
  1630→        '[socket][close]',
  1631→        targetTransport.id,
  1632→        'skip; this is no longer the current transport',
  1633→      );
  1634→      return;
  1635→    }
  1636→
  1637→    this._setStatus(STATUS.CLOSED);
  1638→
  1639→    for (const room of Object.values(this._rooms)) {
  1640→      room.isConnected = false;
  1641→    }
  1642→
  1643→    if (this._isShutdown) {
  1644→      this._log.info(
  1645→        '[socket][close]',
  1646→        targetTransport.id,
  1647→        'Reactor has been shut down and will not reconnect',
  1648→      );
  1649→      return;
  1650→    }
  1651→    this._log.info(
  1652→      '[socket][close]',
  1653→      targetTransport.id,
  1654→      'schedule reconnect, ms =',
  1655→      this._reconnectTimeoutMs,
  1656→    );
  1657→    this._scheduleReconnect();
  1658→  };
  1659→
  1660→  _startSocket() {
  1661→    // Reset whether we support websockets each time we connect
  1662→    // new networks may not support websockets
  1663→    this._wsOk = null;
  1664→    if (this._isShutdown) {
  1665→      this._log.info(
  1666→        '[socket][start]',
  1667→        this.config.appId,
  1668→        'Reactor has been shut down and will not start a new socket',
  1669→      );
  1670→      return;
  1671→    }
  1672→    if (this._transport && this._transport.isConnecting()) {
  1673→      // Our current websocket is in a 'connecting' state.
  1674→      // There's no need to start another one, as the socket is
  1675→      // effectively fresh.
  1676→      this._log.info(
  1677→        '[socket][start]',
  1678→        this._transport.id,
  1679→        'maintained as current transport, we were still in a connecting state',
  1680→      );
  1681→      return;
  1682→    }
  1683→    const prevTransport = this._transport;
  1684→    this._transport = createTransport({
  1685→      transportType: this._transportType,
  1686→      appId: this.config.appId,
  1687→      apiURI: this.config.apiURI,
  1688→      wsURI: this.config.websocketURI,
  1689→      EventSourceImpl: this._EventSource,
  1690→    });
  1691→    this._transport.onopen = this._transportOnOpen;
  1692→    this._transport.onmessage = this._transportOnMessage;
  1693→    this._transport.onclose = this._transportOnClose;
  1694→    this._transport.onerror = this._transportOnError;
  1695→    this._log.info('[socket][start]', this._transport.id);
  1696→    if (prevTransport?.isOpen()) {
  1697→      // When the network dies, it doesn't always mean that our
  1698→      // socket connection will fire a close event.
  1699→      //
  1700→      // We _could_ re-use the old socket, if the network drop was a
  1701→      // few seconds. But, to be safe right now we always create a new socket.
  1702→      //
  1703→      // This means that we have to make sure to kill the previous one ourselves.
  1704→      // c.f https://issues.chromium.org/issues/41343684
  1705→      this._log.info(
  1706→        '[socket][start]',
  1707→        this._transport.id,
  1708→        'close previous transport id = ',
  1709→        prevTransport.id,
  1710→      );
  1711→      prevTransport.close();
  1712→    }
  1713→  }

  1715→  /**
  1716→   * Given a key, returns a stable local id, unique to this device and app.
  1717→   *
  1718→   * This can be useful if you want to create guest ids for example.
  1719→   *
  1720→   * Note: If the user deletes their local storage, this id will change.
  1721→   *
  1722→   */
  1723→  async getLocalId(name) {
  1724→    const k = `localToken_${name}`;
  1725→    if (this.kv.currentValue[k]) {
  1726→      return this.kv.currentValue[k];
  1727→    }
  1728→
  1729→    const current = await this.kv.waitForKeyToLoad(k);
  1730→    if (current) {
  1731→      return current;
  1732→    }
  1733→    const newId = uuid();
  1734→    this.kv.updateInPlace((prev) => {
  1735→      if (prev[k]) return;
  1736→      prev[k] = newId;
  1737→    });
  1738→    return await this.kv.waitForKeyToLoad(k);
  1739→  }

  1741→  // ----
  1742→  // Auth
  1743→  _replaceUrlAfterOAuth() {
  1744→    if (typeof URL === 'undefined') {
  1745→      return;
  1746→    }
  1747→    const url = new URL(window.location.href);
  1748→    if (url.searchParams.get(OAUTH_REDIRECT_PARAM)) {
  1749→      const startUrl = url.toString();
  1750→      url.searchParams.delete(OAUTH_REDIRECT_PARAM);
  1751→      url.searchParams.delete('code');
  1752→      url.searchParams.delete('error');
  1753→      const newPath =
  1754→        url.pathname +
  1755→        (url.searchParams.size ? '?' + url.searchParams : '') +
  1756→        url.hash;
  1757→      // Note: In next.js, this will revert to the old state if user navigates
  1758→      //       back. We would need to allow framework specific routing to work
  1759→      //       around that problem.
  1760→      history.replaceState(history.state, '', newPath);
  1761→
  1762→      // navigation is part of the HTML spec, but not supported by Safari
  1763→      // or Firefox yet:
  1764→      // https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/API/Navigation_API#browser_compatibility
  1765→      if (
  1766→        // @ts-ignore (waiting for ts support)
  1767→        typeof navigation === 'object' &&
  1768→        // @ts-ignore (waiting for ts support)
  1769→        typeof navigation.addEventListener === 'function' &&
  1770→        // @ts-ignore (waiting for ts support)
  1771→        typeof navigation.removeEventListener === 'function'
  1772→      ) {
  1773→        let ran = false;
  1774→
  1775→        // The next.js app router will reset the URL when the router loads.
  1776→        // This puts it back after the router loads.
  1777→        const listener = (e) => {
  1778→          if (!ran) {
  1779→            ran = true;
  1780→            // @ts-ignore (waiting for ts support)
  1781→            navigation.removeEventListener('navigate', listener);
  1782→            if (
  1783→              !e.userInitiated &&
  1784→              e.navigationType === 'replace' &&
  1785→              e.destination?.url === startUrl
  1786→            ) {
  1787→              history.replaceState(history.state, '', newPath);
  1788→            }
  1789→          }
  1790→        };
  1791→        // @ts-ignore (waiting for ts support)
  1792→        navigation.addEventListener('navigate', listener);
  1793→      }
  1794→    }
  1795→  }
  1796→
  1797→  /**
  1798→   *
  1799→   * @returns Promise<null | {error: {message: string}}>
  1800→   */
  1801→  async _oauthLoginInit() {
  1802→    if (
  1803→      typeof window === 'undefined' ||
  1804→      typeof window.location === 'undefined' ||
  1805→      typeof URLSearchParams === 'undefined'
  1806→    ) {
  1807→      return null;
  1808→    }
  1809→    const params = new URLSearchParams(window.location.search);
  1810→    if (!params.get(OAUTH_REDIRECT_PARAM)) {
  1811→      return null;
  1812→    }
  1813→
  1814→    const error = params.get('error');
  1815→    if (error) {
  1816→      this._replaceUrlAfterOAuth();
  1817→      return { error: { message: error } };
  1818→    }
  1819→    const code = params.get('code');
  1820→    if (!code) {
  1821→      return null;
  1822→    }
  1823→    this._replaceUrlAfterOAuth();
  1824→    try {
  1825→      const currentUser = await this._getCurrentUser();
  1826→      const isGuest = currentUser?.type === 'guest';
  1827→      const { user } = await authAPI.exchangeCodeForToken({
  1828→        apiURI: this.config.apiURI,
  1829→        appId: this.config.appId,
  1830→        code,
  1831→        refreshToken: isGuest ? currentUser.refresh_token : undefined,
  1832→      });
  1833→      this.setCurrentUser(user);
  1834→      return null;
  1835→    } catch (e) {
  1836→      if (
  1837→        e?.body?.type === 'record-not-found' &&
  1838→        e?.body?.hint?.['record-type'] === 'app-oauth-code' &&
  1839→        (await this._hasCurrentUser())
  1840→      ) {
  1841→        // We probably just weren't able to clean up the URL, so
  1842→        // let's just ignore this error
  1843→        return null;
  1844→      }
  1845→      const message = e?.body?.message || 'Error logging in.';
  1846→      return { error: { message } };
  1847→    }
  1848→  }
  1849→
  1850→  async _waitForOAuthCallbackResponse() {
  1851→    return await this._oauthCallbackResponse;
  1852→  }
  1853→
  1854→  __subscribeMutationErrors(cb) {
  1855→    this.mutationErrorCbs.push(cb);
  1856→
  1857→    return () => {
  1858→      this.mutationErrorCbs = this.mutationErrorCbs.filter((x) => x !== cb);
  1859→    };
  1860→  }
  1861→
  1862→  subscribeAuth(cb) {
  1863→    this.authCbs.push(cb);
  1864→    const currUserCached = this._currentUserCached;
  1865→    if (!currUserCached.isLoading) {
  1866→      cb(this._currentUserCached);
  1867→    }
  1868→    let unsubbed = false;
  1869→    this.getCurrentUser().then((resp) => {
  1870→      if (unsubbed) return;
  1871→      if (areObjectsDeepEqual(resp, currUserCached)) return;
  1872→      cb(resp);
  1873→    });
  1874→    return () => {
  1875→      unsubbed = true;
  1876→      this.authCbs = this.authCbs.filter((x) => x !== cb);
  1877→    };
  1878→  }
  1879→
  1880→  async getAuth() {
  1881→    const { user, error } = await this.getCurrentUser();
  1882→    if (error) {
  1883→      throw new InstantError('Could not get current user: ' + error.message);
  1884→    }
  1885→    return user;
  1886→  }
  1887→
  1888→  subscribeConnectionStatus(cb) {
  1889→    this.connectionStatusCbs.push(cb);
  1890→
  1891→    return () => {
  1892→      this.connectionStatusCbs = this.connectionStatusCbs.filter(
  1893→        (x) => x !== cb,
  1894→      );
  1895→    };
  1896→  }
  1897→
  1898→  subscribeAttrs(cb) {
  1899→    this.attrsCbs.push(cb);
  1900→
  1901→    if (this.attrs) {
  1902→      cb(this.attrs.attrs);
  1903→    }
  1904→
  1905→    return () => {
  1906→      this.attrsCbs = this.attrsCbs.filter((x) => x !== cb);
  1907→    };
  1908→  }
  1909→
  1910→  notifyAuthSubs(user) {
  1911→    this.authCbs.forEach((cb) => cb(user));
  1912→  }
  1913→
  1914→  notifyMutationErrorSubs(error) {
  1915→    this.mutationErrorCbs.forEach((cb) => cb(error));
  1916→  }
  1917→
  1918→  notifyAttrsSubs() {
  1919→    if (!this.attrs) return;
  1920→    const oas = this.optimisticAttrs();
  1921→    this.attrsCbs.forEach((cb) => cb(oas.attrs));
  1922→  }
  1923→
  1924→  notifyConnectionStatusSubs(status) {
  1925→    this.connectionStatusCbs.forEach((cb) => cb(status));
  1926→  }
  1927→
  1928→  async setCurrentUser(user) {
  1929→    this.kv.updateInPlace((prev) => {
  1930→      prev[currentUserKey] = user;
  1931→    });
  1932→    await this.kv.waitForKeyToLoad(currentUserKey);
  1933→  }
  1934→
  1935→  getCurrentUserCached() {
  1936→    return this._currentUserCached;
  1937→  }
  1938→
  1939→  async _getCurrentUser() {
  1940→    const user = await this.kv.waitForKeyToLoad(currentUserKey);
  1941→    return typeof user === 'string' ? JSON.parse(user) : user;
  1942→  }
  1943→
  1944→  async getCurrentUser() {
  1945→    const oauthResp = await this._waitForOAuthCallbackResponse();
  1946→    if (oauthResp?.error) {
  1947→      const errorV = { error: oauthResp.error, user: undefined };
  1948→      this._currentUserCached = { isLoading: false, ...errorV };
  1949→      return errorV;
  1950→    }
  1951→    try {
  1952→      const user = await this._getCurrentUser();
  1953→      const userV = { user: user, error: undefined };
  1954→      this._currentUserCached = {
  1955→        isLoading: false,
  1956→        ...userV,
  1957→      };
  1958→      return userV;
  1959→    } catch (e) {
  1960→      return {
  1961→        user: undefined,
  1962→        isLoading: false,
  1963→        error: { message: e?.message || 'Error loading user' },
  1964→      };
  1965→    }
  1966→  }
  1967→
  1968→  async _hasCurrentUser() {
  1969→    const user = await this.kv.waitForKeyToLoad(currentUserKey);
  1970→    return typeof user === 'string' ? JSON.parse(user) != null : user != null;
  1971→  }
  1972→
  1973→  async changeCurrentUser(newUser) {
  1974→    const { user: oldUser } = await this.getCurrentUser();
  1975→    if (areObjectsDeepEqual(oldUser, newUser)) {
  1976→      // We were already logged in as the newUser, don't
  1977→      // bother updating
  1978→      return;
  1979→    }
  1980→    await this.setCurrentUser(newUser);
  1981→    // We need to remove all `result` from querySubs,
  1982→    // as they are no longer valid for the new user
  1983→    this.updateUser(newUser);
  1984→
  1985→    try {
  1986→      this._broadcastChannel?.postMessage({ type: 'auth' });
  1987→    } catch (error) {
  1988→      console.error('Error posting message to broadcast channel', error);
  1989→    }
  1990→  }
  1991→
  1992→  updateUser(newUser) {
  1993→    const newV = { error: undefined, user: newUser };
  1994→    this._currentUserCached = { isLoading: false, ...newV };
  1995→    this._dataForQueryCache = {};
  1996→    this.querySubs.updateInPlace((prev) => {
  1997→      Object.keys(prev).forEach((k) => {
  1998→        delete prev[k].result;
  1999→      });
  2000→    });
  2001→    this._reconnectTimeoutMs = 0;
  2002→    this._transport.close();
  2003→    this._oauthCallbackResponse = null;
  2004→    this.notifyAuthSubs(newV);
  2005→  }
  2006→
  2007→  sendMagicCode({ email }) {

  2009→      apiURI: this.config.apiURI,
  2010→      appId: this.config.appId,
  2011→      email: email,
  2012→    });
  2013→  }
  2014→
  2015→  async signInWithMagicCode({ email, code }) {
  2016→    const currentUser = await this.getCurrentUser();

  2018→    const res = await authAPI.verifyMagicCode({
  2019→      apiURI: this.config.apiURI,
  2020→      appId: this.config.appId,
  2021→      email,
  2022→      code,
  2023→      refreshToken: isGuest ? currentUser.user.refresh_token : undefined,
  2024→    });
  2025→    await this.changeCurrentUser(res.user);
  2026→    return res;
  2027→  }

  2039→  async signInAsGuest() {

  2048→  potentiallyInvalidateToken(currentUser, opts) {

  2051→      return;

  2053→    const wantsToSkip = opts.invalidateToken === false;

  2064→      .then(() => {

  2067→      .catch((e) => {});

  2070→  async signOut(opts) {

  2076→  /**
  2077→   * Creates an OAuth authorization URL.
  2078→   *
  2079→   * @param {Object} params - The parameters to create the authorization URL.

  2089→  /**

  2108→  issuerURI() {

  2112→
  2113→  /**
  2114→   * @param {Object} params

  2116→   * @param {string} params.idToken - The id_token from the external service
