  2135→  // --------
  2136→  // Rooms
  2137→
  2138→  /**
  2139→   * @param {string} roomId
  2140→   * @param {any | null | undefined} [initialPresence] -- initial presence data to send when joining the room
  2141→   * @returns () => void
  2142→   */
  2143→  joinRoom(roomId, initialPresence) {
  2144→    let needsToSendJoin = false;
  2145→    if (!this._rooms[roomId]) {
  2146→      needsToSendJoin = true;
  2147→      this._rooms[roomId] = {
  2148→        isConnected: false,
  2149→        error: undefined,
  2150→      };
  2151→    }
  2152→
  2153→    this._presence[roomId] = this._presence[roomId] || {};
  2154→    const previousResult = this._presence[roomId].result;
  2155→    if (initialPresence && !previousResult) {
  2156→      this._presence[roomId].result = this._presence[roomId].result || {};
  2157→      this._presence[roomId].result.user = initialPresence;
  2158→      this._notifyPresenceSubs(roomId);
  2159→    }
  2160→
  2161→    if (needsToSendJoin) {
  2162→      this._tryJoinRoom(roomId, initialPresence);
  2163→    }
  2164→
  2165→    return () => {
  2166→      this._cleanupRoom(roomId);
  2167→    };
  2168→  }
  2169→
  2170→  _cleanupRoom(roomId) {
  2171→    if (
  2172→      !this._presence[roomId]?.handlers?.length &&
  2173→      !Object.keys(this._broadcastSubs[roomId] ?? {}).length
  2174→    ) {
  2175→      const isConnected = this._rooms[roomId]?.isConnected;
  2176→
  2177→      delete this._rooms[roomId];
  2178→      delete this._presence[roomId];
  2179→      delete this._broadcastSubs[roomId];
  2180→
  2181→      if (isConnected) {
  2182→        this._tryLeaveRoom(roomId);
  2183→      } else {
  2184→        this._roomsPendingLeave[roomId] = true;
  2185→      }
  2186→    }
  2187→  }
  2188→
  2189→  // --------
  2190→  // Presence
  2191→
  2192→  // TODO: look into typing again
  2193→  getPresence(roomType, roomId, opts = {}) {
  2194→    const room = this._rooms[roomId];
  2195→    const presence = this._presence[roomId];
  2196→    if (!room || !presence || !presence.result) return null;
  2197→
  2198→    return {
  2199→      ...buildPresenceSlice(presence.result, opts, this._sessionId),
  2200→      isLoading: !room.isConnected,
  2201→      error: room.error,
  2202→    };
  2203→  }
  2204→
  2205→  // TODO: look into typing again
  2206→  publishPresence(roomType, roomId, partialData) {
  2207→    const room = this._rooms[roomId];
  2208→    const presence = this._presence[roomId];
  2209→
  2210→    if (!room || !presence) {
  2211→      return;
  2212→    }
  2213→
  2214→    presence.result = presence.result || {};
  2215→    const data = {
  2216→      ...presence.result.user,
  2217→      ...partialData,
  2218→    };
  2219→
  2220→    presence.result.user = data;
  2221→
  2222→    if (!room.isConnected) {
  2223→      return;
  2224→    }
  2225→
  2226→    this._trySetPresence(roomId, data);
  2227→    this._notifyPresenceSubs(roomId);
  2228→  }
  2229→
  2230→  _trySetPresence(roomId, data) {
  2231→    this._trySendAuthed(uuid(), {
  2232→      op: 'set-presence',
  2233→      'room-id': roomId,
  2234→      data,
  2235→    });
  2236→  }
  2237→
  2238→  _tryJoinRoom(roomId, data) {
  2239→    this._trySendAuthed(uuid(), { op: 'join-room', 'room-id': roomId, data });
  2240→    delete this._roomsPendingLeave[roomId];
  2241→  }
  2242→
  2243→  _tryLeaveRoom(roomId) {
  2244→    this._trySendAuthed(uuid(), { op: 'leave-room', 'room-id': roomId });
  2245→  }
  2246→
  2247→  _trySetRoomConnected(roomId, isConnected) {
  2248→    const room = this._rooms[roomId];
  2249→    if (room) {
  2250→      room.isConnected = isConnected;
  2251→    }
  2252→  }
  2253→
  2254→  // TODO: look into typing again
  2255→  subscribePresence(roomType, roomId, opts, cb) {
  2256→    const leaveRoom = this.joinRoom(
  2257→      roomId,
  2258→      // Oct 28, 2025
  2259→      // Note: initialData is deprecated.
  2260→      // Keeping here for backwards compatibility
  2261→      opts.initialPresence || opts.initialData,
  2262→    );
  2263→
  2264→    const handler = { ...opts, roomId, cb, prev: null };
  2265→
  2266→    this._presence[roomId] = this._presence[roomId] || {};
  2267→    this._presence[roomId].handlers = this._presence[roomId].handlers || [];
  2268→    this._presence[roomId].handlers.push(handler);
  2269→
  2270→    this._notifyPresenceSub(roomId, handler);
  2271→
  2272→    return () => {
  2273→      this._presence[roomId].handlers =
  2274→        this._presence[roomId]?.handlers?.filter((x) => x !== handler) ?? [];
  2275→
  2276→      leaveRoom();
  2277→    };
  2278→  }

  2280→  _notifyPresenceSubs(roomId) {

   363→## Key Technical Discoveries
   364→
   365→### 1. `includedLinks` Parameter Implementation
   366→
   367→The recovery revealed an artifact where `includedLinks` was used but never implemented. This has now been fully implemented:
   368→
   369→```swift
   370→// TripleStore+Extensions.swift
   371→public func resolve(
   372→    id: String,
   373→    attrsStore: AttrsStore,
   374→    depth: Int = 0,
   375→    maxDepth: Int = 10,
   376→    includedLinks: Set<String>? = nil  // NEW PARAMETER
   377→) -> [String: Any]
   378→
   379→public func get<T: Decodable>(
   380→    id: String,
   381→    attrsStore: AttrsStore,
   382→    includedLinks: Set<String>? = nil
   383→) -> T?
   384→```
   385→
   386→Behavior:
   387→- `nil` → resolve ALL links (default, backward-compatible)
   388→- `[]` (empty set) → resolve NO links (only scalar attributes)
   389→- `["posts", "author"]` → resolve only specified links
   390→
   391→### 2. `unique?` Field (Clojure Naming Convention)
   392→
   393→The server uses Clojure predicate naming with `?` suffix. This was causing decode failures:
   394→
   395→```swift
   396→// WRONG - won't be decoded
   397→dict["unique"] = true
   398→
   399→// CORRECT - matches server encoding
   400→dict["unique?"] = true
   401→```
   402→
   403→The `unique?` field encodes REVERSE cardinality:
   404→- `unique? = true` → reverse link is singular (e.g., `posts.author: Profile?`)
   405→- `unique? = false/nil` → reverse link is array (e.g., `bookshelves.users: [User]?`)
   406→
   407→### 3. Reverse Cardinality Fix
   408→
   409→Fixed the cardinality determination in `TripleStore+Extensions.swift`:
   410→
   411→```swift
   412→// BEFORE (wrong):
   413→let isReverseSingular = attr.cardinality == .one
   414→
   415→// AFTER (correct):
   416→let isReverseSingular = attr.unique == true
   417→```
   418→
   419→## Test Results
   420→
   421→All 25 new tests pass:
   422→- `TripleStoreLinkTests`: 8 tests
   423→- `TripleStoreQueryTests`: 9 tests
   424→- `IncludedLinksTests`: 7 tests
   425→- `TripleStoreReverseLinkResolutionTests`: 1 test
   426→
   427→## Lessons Learned
   428→
   429→1. **Always push work to remote frequently** - The recovery was only possible because we had commits on the remote
   430→2. **Document quirky conventions** - The `unique?` Clojure naming caused hours of debugging
   431→3. **Link to upstream sources** - All tests now include GitHub links to TypeScript SDK equivalents
   432→4. **Keep recovery documentation** - This file serves as institutional memory

     4→extension SharedReaderKey {
     5→  /// Creates a shared key for sharing data in-memory for the lifetime of an application.
     6→  ///
     7→  /// For example, one could initialize a key with the date and time at which the application was
     8→  /// most recently launched, and access this date from anywhere using the ``Shared`` property
     9→  /// wrapper:
    10→  ///
    11→  /// ```swift
    12→  /// @main
    13→  /// struct MyApp: App {
    14→  ///   init() {
    15→  ///     @Shared(.inMemory("appLaunchedAt")) var appLaunchedAt = Date()
    16→  ///   }
    17→  ///   // ...
    18→  /// }
    19→  /// ```
    20→  ///
    21→  /// - Parameter key: A string key identifying a value to share in memory.
    22→  /// - Returns: An in-memory shared key.
    23→  public static func inMemory<Value>(_ key: String) -> Self
    24→  where Self == InMemoryKey<Value> {
    25→    InMemoryKey(key)
    26→  }
    27→}
    28→
    29→/// A type defining an in-memory persistence strategy
    30→///
    31→/// See ``SharedReaderKey/inMemory(_:)`` to create values of this type.
    32→public struct InMemoryKey<Value: Sendable>: SharedKey {
    33→  private let key: String
    34→  private let store: InMemoryStorage
    35→  fileprivate init(_ key: String) {
    36→    @Dependency(\.defaultInMemoryStorage) var defaultInMemoryStorage
    37→    self.key = key
    38→    self.store = defaultInMemoryStorage
    39→  }
    40→  public var id: InMemoryKeyID {
    41→    InMemoryKeyID(key: key, store: store)
    42→  }
    43→  public func load(context: LoadContext<Value>, continuation: LoadContinuation<Value>) {
    44→    switch context {
    45→    case .initialValue(let initialValue):
    46→      continuation.resume(returning: store.values[key, default: initialValue])
    47→    case .userInitiated:
    48→      switch store.values[key] {
    49→      case let .some(value as Value):
    50→        continuation.resume(returning: value)
    51→      default:
    52→        continuation.resumeReturningInitialValue()
    53→      }
    54→    }
    55→  }
    56→  public func subscribe(
    57→    context _: LoadContext<Value>, subscriber _: SharedSubscriber<Value>
    58→  ) -> SharedSubscription {
    59→    SharedSubscription {}
    60→  }
    61→  public func save(_ value: Value, context _: SaveContext, continuation: SaveContinuation) {
    62→    store.values[key] = value
    63→    continuation.resume()
    64→  }
    65→}
    66→
    67→extension InMemoryKey: CustomStringConvertible {
    68→  public var description: String {
    69→    ".inMemory(\(String(reflecting: key)))"

     6→  /// [`@Shared`](<doc:Shared>).

     9→  /// when there is no value in user defaults, then you can define a shared key like so:
    10→  ///

    24→  public typealias Default = _SharedKeyDefault<Self>

    26→export interface TransactionChunk<

    39→
    40→  /**

    43→   * mode by providing { upsert: false } option as second argument:
    44→   *
    45→   * @example

    56→  ) => TransactionChunk<Schema, EntityName>;
    57→
    58→  /**

    60→   *
    61→   * @example
    62→   * const goalId = id();
    63→   * const todoId = id();

    65→   *   db.tx.goals[goalId].update({title: "Get fit"}),
    66→   *   db.tx.todos[todoId].update({title: "Go on a run"}),
    67→   *   db.tx.goals[goalId].link({todos: todoId}),
    68→   * ])
    69→   *
    70→   * // Now, if you query:
    71→   * useQuery({ goals: { todos: {} } })
    72→   * // You'll get back:
    73→   *
    74→   * // { goals: [{ title: "Get fit", todos: [{ title: "Go on a run" }]}
    75→   */
    76→  link: (
    77→    args: LinkParams<Schema, EntityName>,
    78→  ) => TransactionChunk<Schema, EntityName>;

    85→  unlink: (

   134→// This is a hack to get typescript to enforce that
   135→// `allTransactionChunkKeys` contains all the keys of `TransactionChunk`
   136→type TransactionChunkKey = keyof TransactionChunk<any, any>;
   137→function getAllTransactionChunkKeys(): Set<TransactionChunkKey> {
   138→  const v: any = 1;
   139→  const _dummy: TransactionChunk<any, any> = {
   140→    __etype: v,
   141→    __ops: v,
   142→    create: v,
   143→    update: v,
   144→    link: v,
   145→    unlink: v,
   146→    delete: v,
   147→    merge: v,
   148→    ruleParams: v,
   149→  };
   150→  return new Set(Object.keys(_dummy)) as Set<TransactionChunkKey>;
   151→}
   152→const allTransactionChunkKeys = getAllTransactionChunkKeys();
   153→
   154→export interface ETypeChunk<
   155→  Schema extends IContainEntitiesAndLinks<any, any>,
   156→  EntityName extends keyof Schema['entities'],
   157→> {
   158→  [id: Id]: TransactionChunk<Schema, EntityName>;
   159→}
   160→
   161→export type TxChunk<Schema extends IContainEntitiesAndLinks<any, any>> = {
   162→  [EntityName in keyof Schema['entities']]: ETypeChunk<Schema, EntityName>;
   163→};
   164→
   165→function transactionChunk(
   166→  etype: EType,
   167→  id: Id | LookupRef,
   168→  prevOps: Op[],
   169→): TransactionChunk<any, any> {
   170→  const target = {
   171→    __etype: etype,
   172→    __ops: prevOps,
   173→  };
   174→  return new Proxy(target as unknown as TransactionChunk<any, any>, {
   175→    get: (_target, cmd: keyof TransactionChunk<any, any>) => {
   176→      if (cmd === '__ops') return prevOps;
   177→      if (cmd === '__etype') return etype;
   178→      if (!allTransactionChunkKeys.has(cmd)) {
   179→        return undefined;
   180→      }
   181→      return (args: Args, opts?: Opts) => {
   182→        return transactionChunk(etype, id, [
   183→          ...prevOps,
   184→          opts ? [cmd, etype, id, args, opts] : [cmd, etype, id, args],
   185→        ]);
   186→      };
   187→    },
   188→  });
   189→}
   190→
   191→/**
   192→ * Creates a lookup to use in place of an id in a transaction
   193→ *
   194→ * @example
   195→ * db.tx.users[lookup('email', 'lyndon@example.com')].update({name: 'Lyndon'})
   196→ */
   197→export function lookup(attribute: string, value: any): Lookup {
   198→  return `lookup__${attribute}__${JSON.stringify(value)}`;
   199→}
   200→
   201→export function isLookup(k: string): boolean {
   202→  return k.startsWith('lookup__');
   203→}
   204→
   205→export function parseLookup(k: string): LookupRef {
   206→  const [_, attribute, ...vJSON] = k.split('__');
   207→  return [attribute, JSON.parse(vJSON.join('__'))];
   208→}
   209→
   210→function etypeChunk(etype: EType): ETypeChunk<any, EType> {
   211→  return new Proxy(
   212→    {
   213→      __etype: etype,
   214→    } as unknown as ETypeChunk<any, EType>,
   215→    {
   216→      get(_target, cmd: Id) {
   217→        if (cmd === '__etype') return etype;
   218→        const id = cmd;
   219→        if (isLookup(id)) {
   220→          return transactionChunk(etype, parseLookup(id), []);
   221→        }
   222→        return transactionChunk(etype, id, []);
   223→      },
   224→    },
   225→  );
   226→}
   227→
   228→export function txInit<
   229→  Schema extends IContainEntitiesAndLinks<any, any>,
   230→>(): TxChunk<Schema> {
   231→  return new Proxy(
   232→    {},
   233→    {
   234→      get(_target, ns: EType) {
   235→        return etypeChunk(ns);
   236→      },
   237→    },
   238→  ) as any;
   239→}
   240→
   241→/**
   242→ * A handy builder for changes.
   243→ *
   244→ * You must start with the `namespace` you want to change:
   245→ *
   246→ * @example
   247→ *   db.tx.goals[goalId].update({title: "Get fit"})
   248→ *   // Note: you don't need to create `goals` ahead of time.
   249→ */
   250→export const tx = txInit();
   251→
   252→export function getOps(x: TransactionChunk<any, any>): Op[] {
   253→  return x.__ops;
   254→}

   233→  return v;
   234→}
   235→
   236→function valueAttrPat(
   237→  makeVar: MakeVar,
   238→  attrsStore: s.AttrsStore,
   239→  valueEtype: string,
   240→  valueLevel: number,
   241→  valueLabel: string,
   242→  v: any,
   243→): Pat {
   244→  const fwdAttr = s.getAttrByFwdIdentName(attrsStore, valueEtype, valueLabel);
   245→  const revAttr = s.getAttrByReverseIdentName(
   246→    attrsStore,
   247→    valueEtype,
   248→    valueLabel,
   249→  );
   250→  const attr = fwdAttr || revAttr;
   251→
   252→  if (!attr) {
   253→    throw new AttrNotFoundError(
   254→      `No attr for etype = ${valueEtype} label = ${valueLabel}`,
   255→    );
   256→  }
   257→
   258→  if (v?.hasOwnProperty('$isNull')) {
   259→    const idAttr = s.getAttrByFwdIdentName(attrsStore, valueEtype, 'id');
   260→    if (!idAttr) {
   261→      throw new AttrNotFoundError(
   262→        `No attr for etype = ${valueEtype} label = id`,
   263→      );
   264→    }
   265→
   266→    return [
   267→      makeVar(valueEtype, valueLevel),
   268→      idAttr.id,
   269→      { $isNull: { attrId: attr.id, isNull: v.$isNull, reverse: !fwdAttr } },
   270→      wildcard('time'),
   271→    ];
   272→  }
   273→
   274→  if (fwdAttr) {
   275→    return [
   276→      makeVar(valueEtype, valueLevel),
   277→      attr.id,
   278→      parseValue(attr, v),
   279→      wildcard('time'),
   280→    ];
   281→  }
   282→  return [v, attr.id, makeVar(valueEtype, valueLevel), wildcard('time')];
   283→}
   284→
   285→function refAttrPats(
   286→  makeVar: MakeVar,
   287→  attrsStore: s.AttrsStore,
   288→  etype: string,
   289→  level: number,
   290→  refsPath: string[],
   291→): [string, number, Pats] {
   292→  const [lastEtype, lastLevel, attrPats] = refsPath.reduce(
   293→    (acc, label) => {
   294→      const [etype, level, attrPats] = acc;
   295→      const [nextEtype, nextLevel, attrPat] = refAttrPat(
   296→        makeVar,
   297→        attrsStore,
   298→        etype,
   299→        level,
   300→        label,
   301→      );
   302→      return [nextEtype, nextLevel, [...attrPats, attrPat]];
   303→    },
   304→    [etype, level, []],
   305→  );
   306→
   307→  return [lastEtype, lastLevel, attrPats];
   308→}
   309→
   310→function whereCondAttrPats(
   311→  makeVar: MakeVar,
   312→  attrsStore: s.AttrsStore,
   313→  etype: string,
   314→  level: number,
   315→  path: string[],
   316→  v: any,
   317→): Pats {
   318→  const refsPath = path.slice(0, path.length - 1);
   319→  const valueLabel = path[path.length - 1];
   320→  const [lastEtype, lastLevel, refPats] = refAttrPats(
   321→    makeVar,
   322→    attrsStore,
   323→    etype,
   324→    level,
   325→    refsPath,
   326→  );
   327→  const valuePat = valueAttrPat(
   328→    makeVar,
   329→    attrsStore,
   330→    lastEtype,
   331→    lastLevel,
   332→    valueLabel,
   333→    v,
   334→  );
   335→
   336→  return refPats.concat([valuePat]);
   337→}
   338→
   339→function withJoin(where, join) {
   340→  return join ? [join].concat(where) : where;
   341→}
   342→
   343→function isOrClauses([k, v]): boolean {
   344→  return k === 'or' && Array.isArray(v);
   345→}
   346→
   347→function isAndClauses([k, v]): boolean {
   348→  return k === 'and' && Array.isArray(v);
   349→}
   350→
   351→// Creates a makeVar that will namespace symbols for or clauses
   352→// to prevent conflicts, except for the base etype
   353→function genMakeVar(baseMakeVar: MakeVar, joinSym: string, orIdx: number) {
   354→  return (x, lvl) => {
   355→    const base = baseMakeVar(x, lvl);
   356→    if (joinSym == base) {
   357→      return base;
   358→    }
   359→    return `${base}-${orIdx}`;
   360→  };
   361→}
   362→
   363→function parseWhereClauses(
   364→  makeVar: MakeVar,
   365→  clauseType: 'or' | 'and' /* 'or' | 'and' */,
   366→  attrsStore: s.AttrsStore,
   367→  etype: string,
   368→  level: number,
   369→  whereValue: any,
   370→): FullPat {
   371→  const joinSym = makeVar(etype, level);
   372→  const patterns: FullPats = whereValue.map((w, i) => {
   373→    const makeNamespacedVar = genMakeVar(makeVar, joinSym, i);
   374→    return parseWhere(makeNamespacedVar, attrsStore, etype, level, w);
   375→  });
   376→  return { [clauseType]: { patterns, joinSym } } as AndPat | OrPat;
   377→}
   378→
   379→// Given a path, returns a list of paths leading up to this path:
   380→// growPath([1, 2, 3]) -> [[1], [1, 2], [1, 2, 3]]
   381→function growPath<T>(path: T[]) {
   382→  const ret: Array<T[]> = [];
   383→  for (let i = 1; i <= path.length; i++) {
   384→    ret.push(path.slice(0, i));
   385→  }
   386→  return ret;
   387→}
   388→
   389→// Returns array of pattern arrays that should be grouped in OR
   390→// to capture any intermediate nulls
   391→function whereCondAttrPatsForNullIsTrue(
   392→  makeVar: MakeVar,
   393→  attrsStore: s.AttrsStore,
   394→  etype: string,
   395→  level: number,
   396→  path: string[],
   397→): Pats[] {
   398→  return growPath(path).map((path) =>
   399→    whereCondAttrPats(makeVar, attrsStore, etype, level, path, {
   400→      $isNull: true,
   401→    }),
   402→  );
   403→}
   404→
   405→function parseWhere(
   406→  makeVar: MakeVar,
   407→  attrsStore: s.AttrsStore,
   408→  etype: string,
   409→  level: number,
   410→  where: Record<string, any>,
   411→): FullPats {
   412→  return Object.entries(where).flatMap(([k, v]) => {
   413→    if (isOrClauses([k, v])) {
   414→      return parseWhereClauses(makeVar, 'or', attrsStore, etype, level, v);
   415→    }
   416→    if (isAndClauses([k, v])) {
   417→      return parseWhereClauses(makeVar, 'and', attrsStore, etype, level, v);
   418→    }
   419→
   420→    // Temporary hack until we have support for a uuid index on `id`
   421→    if (k === '$entityIdStartsWith') {
   422→      return [];
   423→    }
   424→
   425→    const path = k.split('.');
   426→
   427→    // Normalize $ne to $not
   428→    if (v?.hasOwnProperty('$ne')) {
   429→      v = { ...v, $not: v.$ne };
   430→      delete v.$ne;
   431→    }
   432→
   433→    if (v?.hasOwnProperty('$not')) {
   434→      // `$not` won't pick up entities that are missing the attr, so we
   435→      // add in a `$isNull` to catch those too.
   436→      const notPats = whereCondAttrPats(
   437→        makeVar,
   438→        attrsStore,
   439→        etype,
   440→        level,
   441→        path,
   442→        v,
   443→      );
   444→      const nilPats = whereCondAttrPatsForNullIsTrue(
   445→        makeVar,
   446→        attrsStore,
   447→        etype,
   448→        level,
   449→        path,
   450→      );
   451→      return [
   452→        {
   453→          or: {
   454→            patterns: [notPats, ...nilPats],
   455→            joinSym: makeVar(etype, level),
   456→          },
   457→        },
   458→      ];
   459→    }
   460→
   461→    if (v?.hasOwnProperty('$isNull') && v.$isNull === true && path.length > 1) {
   462→      // Make sure we're capturing all of the intermediate paths that might be null
   463→      // by checking for null at each step along the path
   464→      return [
   465→        {
   466→          or: {
   467→            patterns: whereCondAttrPatsForNullIsTrue(
   468→              makeVar,
   469→              attrsStore,
   470→              etype,
   471→              level,
   472→              path,
   473→            ),
   474→            joinSym: makeVar(etype, level),
   475→          },
   476→        },
   477→      ];
   478→    }
   479→
   480→    return whereCondAttrPats(makeVar, attrsStore, etype, level, path, v);
   481→  });
   482→}
   483→
   484→function makeWhere(
   485→  attrsStore: s.AttrsStore,
   486→  etype: string,
   487→  level: number,
   488→  where: Record<string, any> | null,
   489→): FullPats {
   490→  const makeVar = makeVarImpl;
   491→  if (!where) {
   492→    return defaultWhere(makeVar, attrsStore, etype, level);
   493→  }
   494→  const parsedWhere = parseWhere(makeVar, attrsStore, etype, level, where);
   495→  return parsedWhere.concat(defaultWhere(makeVar, attrsStore, etype, level));
   496→}
   497→
   498→// Find
   499→// -----------------
   500→
   501→function makeFind(makeVar: MakeVar, etype: string, level: number) {
   502→  return [makeVar(etype, level), makeVar('time', level)];
   503→}
   504→
   505→// extendObjects
   506→// -----------------
   507→
   508→function makeJoin(
   509→  makeVar: MakeVar,
   510→  attrsStore: s.AttrsStore,
   511→  etype: string,
   512→  level: number,
   513→  label: string,
   514→  eid: string,
   515→) {
   516→  const [nextEtype, nextLevel, pat, attr, isForward] = refAttrPat(
   517→    makeVar,
   518→    attrsStore,
   519→    etype,
   520→    level,
   521→    label,
   522→  );
   523→  const actualized = replaceInAttrPat(pat, makeVar(etype, level), eid);
   524→  return [nextEtype, nextLevel, actualized, attr, isForward];
   525→}
   526→
   527→function extendObjects(
   528→  makeVar: MakeVar,
   529→  store: s.Store,
   530→  attrsStore: s.AttrsStore,
   531→  { etype, level, form },
   532→  objects,
   533→) {
   534→  const childQueries = Object.keys(form).filter((c) => c !== '$');
   535→  if (!childQueries.length) {
   536→    return Object.values(objects);
   537→  }
   538→  return Object.entries(objects).map(function extendChildren([eid, parent]) {
   539→    const childResults = childQueries.map(function getChildResult(label) {
   540→      const isSingular = Boolean(
   541→        store.cardinalityInference &&
   542→          attrsStore.linkIndex?.[etype]?.[label]?.isSingular,
   543→      );
   544→
   545→      try {
   546→        const [nextEtype, nextLevel, join] = makeJoin(
   547→          makeVar,
   548→          attrsStore,
   549→          etype,
   550→          level,
   551→          label,
   552→          eid,
   553→        );
   554→
   555→        const childrenArray = queryOne(store, attrsStore, {
   556→          etype: nextEtype,
   557→          level: nextLevel,
   558→          form: form[label],
   559→          join,
   560→        });
   561→
   562→        const childOrChildren = isSingular ? childrenArray[0] : childrenArray;
   563→
   564→        return { [label]: childOrChildren };
   565→      } catch (e) {
   566→        if (e instanceof AttrNotFoundError) {
   567→          return { [label]: isSingular ? undefined : [] };
   568→        }
   569→        throw e;
   570→      }
   571→    });
   572→
   573→    return childResults.reduce(function reduceChildren(parent, child) {
   574→      return { ...parent, ...child };
   575→    }, parent);
   576→  });
   577→}
   578→
   579→// resolveObjects
   580→// -----------------
   581→
   582→function shouldIgnoreAttr(attrs, id) {
   583→  const attr = attrs[id];
   584→  return attr['value-type'] === 'ref' && attr['forward-identity'][2] !== 'id';
   585→}
   586→
   587→// Compares values where we already know that the two values are distinct
   588→// and not null.
   589→// Takes into account the data type.
   590→function compareDisparateValues(a, b, dataType) {
   591→  if (dataType === 'string') {
   592→    return stringCompare(a, b);
   593→  }
   594→  if (a > b) {
   595→    return 1;
   596→  }
   597→  return -1;
   598→}
   599→
   600→export function compareOrder(id_a: string, v_a, id_b: string, v_b, dataType) {
   601→  if (v_a === v_b || (v_a == null && v_b == null)) {
   602→    return uuidCompare(id_a, id_b);
   603→  }
   604→
   605→  if (v_b == null) {
   606→    return 1;
   607→  }
   608→  if (v_a == null) {
   609→    return -1;
   610→  }
   611→
   612→  return compareDisparateValues(v_a, v_b, dataType);
   613→}
   614→
   615→function compareOrderTriples(
   616→  [id_a, v_a]: [string, any],
   617→  [id_b, v_b]: [string, any],
   618→  dataType,
   619→) {
   620→  return compareOrder(id_a, v_a, id_b, v_b, dataType);
   621→}
   622→
   623→function comparableDate(x) {
   624→  if (x == null) {
   625→    return x;
   626→  }
   627→  return new Date(x).getTime();
   628→}
   629→
   630→function isBefore(startCursor, orderAttr, direction, idVec) {
   631→  const [c_e, _c_a, c_v, c_t] = startCursor;
   632→  const compareVal = direction === 'desc' ? 1 : -1;
   633→  if (orderAttr['forward-identity']?.[2] === 'id') {
   634→    return compareOrderTriples(idVec, [c_e, c_t], null) === compareVal;
   635→  }
   636→  const [e, v] = idVec;
   637→  const dataType = orderAttr['checked-data-type'];
   638→  const v_new = dataType === 'date' ? comparableDate(v) : v;
   639→  const c_v_new = dataType === 'date' ? comparableDate(c_v) : c_v;
   640→
   641→  return (
   642→    compareOrderTriples([e, v_new], [c_e, c_v_new], dataType) === compareVal
   643→  );
   644→}
   645→
   646→function orderAttrFromCursor(attrsStore: s.AttrsStore, cursor) {
   647→  const cursorAttrId = cursor[1];
   648→  return attrsStore.getAttr(cursorAttrId);
   649→}
   650→
   651→function orderAttrFromOrder(attrsStore: s.AttrsStore, etype, order) {
   652→  const label = Object.keys(order)[0];
   653→  return s.getAttrByFwdIdentName(attrsStore, etype, label);
   654→}
   655→
   656→function getOrderAttr(attrsStore: s.AttrsStore, etype, cursor, order) {
   657→  if (cursor) {
   658→    return orderAttrFromCursor(attrsStore, cursor);
   659→  }
   660→  if (order) {
   661→    return orderAttrFromOrder(attrsStore, etype, order);
   662→  }
   663→}
   664→
   665→function objectAttrs(
   666→  attrsStore: s.AttrsStore,
   667→  etype,
   668→  dq,
   669→): Map<string, InstantDBAttr> | undefined {
   670→  if (!Array.isArray(dq.fields)) {
   671→    return s.getBlobAttrs(attrsStore, etype);
   672→  }
   673→
   674→  const attrs = new Map();
   675→
   676→  for (const field of dq.fields) {
   677→    const attr = s.getAttrByFwdIdentName(attrsStore, etype, field);
   678→    const label = attr?.['forward-identity']?.[2];
   679→    if (label && s.isBlob(attr)) {
   680→      attrs.set(label, attr);
   681→    }
   682→  }
   683→  // Ensure we add the id field to avoid empty objects
   684→  if (!attrs.has('id')) {
   685→    const attr = s.getAttrByFwdIdentName(attrsStore, etype, 'id');
   686→    const label = attr?.['forward-identity']?.[2];
   687→    if (label) {
   688→      attrs.set(label, attr);
   689→    }
   690→  }
   691→
   692→  return attrs;
   693→}
   694→
   695→function runDataloadAndReturnObjects(
   696→  store: s.Store,
   697→  attrsStore: s.AttrsStore,
   698→  { etype, pageInfo, dq, form },
   699→) {
   700→  const order = form?.$?.order;
   701→  const isLeadingQuery = isLeading(form);
   702→  const direction = determineDirection(form);
   703→
   704→  let idVecs = datalogQuery(store, dq);
   705→
   706→  const startCursor = pageInfo?.['start-cursor'];
   707→  const orderAttr = getOrderAttr(attrsStore, etype, startCursor, order);
   708→
   709→  if (orderAttr && orderAttr?.['forward-identity']?.[2] !== 'id') {
   710→    const isDate = orderAttr['checked-data-type'] === 'date';
   711→    const a = orderAttr.id;
   712→    idVecs = idVecs.map(([id]) => {
   713→      // order attr is required to be cardinality one, so there will
   714→      // be at most one value here
   715→      let v = store.eav.get(id)?.get(a)?.values()?.next()?.value?.[2];
   716→      if (isDate) {
   717→        v = comparableDate(v);
   718→      }
   719→      return [id, v];
   720→    });
   721→  }
   722→
   723→  idVecs.sort(
   724→    direction === 'asc'
   725→      ? function compareIdVecs(a, b) {
   726→          return compareOrderTriples(a, b, orderAttr?.['checked-data-type']);
   727→        }
   728→      : function compareIdVecs(a, b) {
   729→          return compareOrderTriples(b, a, orderAttr?.['checked-data-type']);
   730→        },
   731→  );
   732→
   733→  let objects = {};
   734→  const attrs = objectAttrs(attrsStore, etype, dq);
   735→
   736→  for (const idVec of idVecs) {
   737→    const [id] = idVec;
   738→    if (objects[id]) {
   739→      continue;
   740→    }
   741→    if (
   742→      !isLeadingQuery &&
   743→      startCursor &&
   744→      orderAttr &&
   745→      isBefore(startCursor, orderAttr, direction, idVec)
   746→    ) {
   747→      continue;
   748→    }
   749→
   750→    const obj = s.getAsObject(store, attrs, id);
   751→    if (obj) {
   752→      objects[id] = obj;
   753→    }
   754→  }
   755→  return objects;
   756→}
   757→
   758→function determineDirection(form) {
   759→  const orderOpts = form.$?.order;
   760→  if (!orderOpts) {
   761→    return 'asc';
   762→  }
   763→
   764→  return orderOpts[Object.keys(orderOpts)[0]] || 'asc';
   765→}
   766→
   767→/**
   768→ * A "leading" query has no `offset`, `before`, or `after`
   769→ *
   770→ * It is at the 'beginning' of the order
   771→ */
   772→function isLeading(form) {
   773→  const offset = form.$?.offset;
   774→  const before = form.$?.before;
   775→  const after = form.$?.after;
   776→  return !offset && !before && !after;
   777→}
   778→
   779→/**
   780→ * Given a query like:
   781→ *
   782→ * {
   783→ *   users: {
   784→ *     $: { where: { name: "Joe" } },
   785→ *   },
   786→ * };
   787→ *
   788→ * `resolveObjects`, turns where clause: `{ name: "Joe" }`
   789→ * into a datalog query. We then run the datalog query,
   790→ * and reduce all the triples into objects.
   791→ */
   792→function resolveObjects(
   793→  store: s.Store,
   794→  attrsStore: s.AttrsStore,
   795→  { etype, level, form, join, pageInfo },
   796→) {
   797→  // Wait for server to tell us where we start if we don't start from the beginning
   798→  if (!isLeading(form) && (!pageInfo || !pageInfo['start-cursor'])) {
   799→    return [];
   800→  }
   801→
   802→  const where = withJoin(
   803→    makeWhere(attrsStore, etype, level, form.$?.where),
   804→    join,
   805→  );
   806→  const find = makeFind(makeVarImpl, etype, level);
   807→  const fields = form.$?.fields;
   808→
   809→  const objs = runDataloadAndReturnObjects(store, attrsStore, {
   810→    etype,
   811→    pageInfo,
   812→    form,
   813→    dq: { where, find, fields },
   814→  });
   815→
   816→  const limit = form.$?.limit || form.$?.first || form.$?.last;
   817→  if (limit != null) {
   818→    if (level > 0) {
   819→      console.warn(
   820→        'WARNING: Limits in child queries are only run client-side. Data returned from the server will not have a limit.',
   821→      );
   822→    }
   823→
   824→    const entries = Object.entries(objs);
   825→    if (entries.length <= limit) {
   826→      return objs;
   827→    }
   828→    return Object.fromEntries(entries.slice(0, limit));
   829→  }
   830→
   831→  return objs;
   832→}
   833→
   834→/**
   835→ * It's possible that we query
   836→ * for an attribute that doesn't exist yet.
   837→ *
   838→ * { users: { $: { where: { nonExistentProperty: "foo" } } } }
   839→ *
   840→ * This swallows the missing attr error and returns
   841→ * an empty result instead
   842→ */
   843→function guardedResolveObjects(store: s.Store, attrsStore: s.AttrsStore, opts) {
   844→  try {
   845→    return resolveObjects(store, attrsStore, opts);
   846→  } catch (e) {
   847→    if (e instanceof AttrNotFoundError) {
   848→      return {};
   849→    }
   850→    throw e;
   851→  }
   852→}
   853→/**
   854→ * Given a query like:
   855→ *
   856→ * {
   857→ *   users: {
   858→ *     $: { where: { name: "Joe" } },
   859→ *     posts: {},
   860→ *   },
   861→ * };
   862→ *
   863→ * `guardResolveObjects` will return the relevant `users` objects
   864→ * `extendObjects` will then extend each `user` object with relevant `posts`.
   865→ */
   866→function queryOne(store: s.Store, attrsStore: s.AttrsStore, opts) {
   867→  const objects = guardedResolveObjects(store, attrsStore, opts);
   868→  return extendObjects(makeVarImpl, store, attrsStore, opts, objects);
   869→}
   870→
   871→function formatPageInfo(
   872→  pageInfo: Record<
   873→    string,
   874→    {
   875→      'start-cursor'?: Cursor | null;
   876→      'end-cursor'?: Cursor | null;
   877→      'has-next-page?'?: boolean | null;
   878→      'has-previous-page?'?: boolean | null;
   879→    }
   880→  >,
   881→) {
   882→  const res = {};
   883→  for (const [k, v] of Object.entries(pageInfo)) {
   884→    res[k] = {
   885→      startCursor: v['start-cursor'],
   886→      endCursor: v['end-cursor'],
   887→      hasNextPage: v['has-next-page?'],
   888→      hasPreviousPage: v['has-previous-page?'],
   889→    };
   890→  }
   891→  return res;

   894→export default function query(
   895→  {
   896→    store,
   897→    attrsStore,
   898→    pageInfo,
   899→    aggregate,
   900→  }: {
   901→    store: s.Store;
   902→    attrsStore: s.AttrsStore;
   903→    pageInfo?: any;
   904→    aggregate?: any;
   905→  },
   906→  q,

   915→      etype: k,
   916→      form: q[k],
   917→      level: 0,
   918→      pageInfo: pageInfo?.[k],

   920→    return res;
   921→  }, {});
   922→
   923→  const result: { data: any; pageInfo?: any; aggregate?: any } = { data };
   924→  if (pageInfo) {
   925→    result.pageInfo = formatPageInfo(pageInfo);
   926→  }
   927→
   928→  if (aggregate) {
   929→    result.aggregate = aggregate;
   930→  }
   931→
   932→  return result;

   183→export function getInMap(obj, path) {
   184→  return path.reduce((acc, key) => acc && acc.get(key), obj);

   186→
   187→function deleteInMap(m, path) {
   188→  if (path.length === 0) throw new Error('path must have at least one element');
   189→  if (path.length === 1) {
   190→    m.delete(path[0]);
   191→    return;
   192→  }
   193→  const [head, ...tail] = path;
   194→  if (!m.has(head)) return;
   195→  deleteInMap(m.get(head), tail);
   196→}
   197→
   198→function setInMap(m: Map<any, any>, path: any[], value: any) {
   199→  let current = m;
   200→  const lastI = path.length - 1;
   201→  for (let i = 0; i < lastI; i++) {
   202→    const part = path[i];
   203→
   204→    let nextMap = current.get(part);
   205→    if (nextMap === undefined) {
   206→      nextMap = new Map();
   207→      current.set(part, nextMap);
   208→    }
   209→    current = nextMap;
   210→  }
   211→  if (lastI > -1) {
   212→    current.set(path[lastI], value);
   213→  }
   214→}

   222→  triples: Triple[],
   223→  useDateObjects: boolean | null | undefined,
   224→): Pick<Store, 'eav' | 'aev' | 'vae'> {

   244→
   245→    setInMap(eav, [eid, aid, v], triple);

   251→function createAttrIndexes(attrs: Record<string, InstantDBAttr>): AttrIndexes {
   252→  const blobAttrs = new Map();
   253→  const primaryKeys = new Map();
   254→  const forwardIdents = new Map();
   255→  const revIdents = new Map();
   256→  for (const attr of Object.values(attrs)) {
   257→    const fwdIdent = attr['forward-identity'];
   258→    const [_, fwdEtype, fwdLabel] = fwdIdent;
   259→    const revIdent = attr['reverse-identity'];
   260→
   261→    setInMap(forwardIdents, [fwdEtype, fwdLabel], attr);
   262→    if (isBlob(attr)) {
   263→      setInMap(blobAttrs, [fwdEtype, fwdLabel], attr);

   271→    }

   315→export function createStore(

   331→// We may have local triples with lookup refs in them,
   332→// we need to convert those lookup refs to eids to insert them
   333→// into the store. If we can't find the lookup ref locally,
   334→// then we drop the triple and have to wait for the server response
   335→// to see the optimistic updates.
   336→function resolveLookupRefs(store: Store, triple: Triple): Triple | null {
   337→  let eid;
   338→
   339→  // Check if `e` is a lookup ref
   340→  if (Array.isArray(triple[0])) {
   341→    const [a, v] = triple[0];
   342→    const eMaps = store.aev.get(a);
   343→    if (!eMaps) {
   344→      // We don't have the attr, so don't try to add the
   345→      // triple to the store
   346→      return null;
   347→    }
   348→    // This would be a lot more efficient with a ave index
   349→    const triples = allMapValues(eMaps, 2);
   350→    eid = triples.find((x) => x[2] === v)?.[0];
   351→  } else {
   352→    eid = triple[0];
   353→  }
   354→
   355→  if (!eid) {
   356→    // We don't know the eid that the ref refers to, so
   357→    // we can't add the triple to the store.
   358→    return null;
   359→  }
   360→
   361→  // Check if v is a lookup ref
   362→  const lookupV = triple[2];
   363→  if (
   364→    Array.isArray(lookupV) &&
   365→    lookupV.length === 2 &&
   366→    store.aev.get(lookupV[0])
   367→  ) {
   368→    const [a, v] = lookupV;
   369→    const eMaps = store.aev.get(a);
   370→    if (!eMaps) {
   371→      // We don't have the attr, so don't try to add the
   372→      // triple to the store
   373→      return null;
   374→    }
   375→    const triples = allMapValues(eMaps, 2);
   376→    const value = triples.find((x) => x[2] === v)?.[0];
   377→    if (!value) {
   378→      return null;
   379→    }
   380→    const [_e, aid, _v, ...rest] = triple;
   381→    return [eid, aid, value, ...rest];
   382→  } else {
   383→    const [_, ...rest] = triple;
   384→    return [eid, ...rest];
   385→  }
   386→}

   388→export function retractTriple(

   411→function getCreatedAt(
   412→  store: Store,
   413→  attr: InstantDBAttr,
   414→  triple: Triple,
   415→): Number {
   416→  const [eid, aid, v] = triple;

   418→
   419→  const t = getInMap(store.eav, [eid, aid, v]);

   424→  /**
   425→   * (XXX)
   426→   * Two hacks here, for generating a `createdAt`

   428→   * 1. We multiply Date.now() by 10, to make sure that
   429→   *  `createdAt` is always greater than anything the server
   430→   *   could return
   431→   *

   433→   *   triples as optimistic updates.
   434→   *
   435→   * 2. We increment by `_seed`, to make sure there are no
   436→   *    two triples with the same `createdAt`. This is
   437→   *    done to make tests more predictable.
   438→   *
   439→   * We may need to rethink this. Because we * 10, we can't
   440→   * use this value as an _actual_ `createdAt` timestamp.

   442→   * use `createdAt` for each triple, to infer a `createdAt` and
   443→   * `updatedAt` value for each object.
   444→   */
   445→  return createdAt || Date.now() * 10 + _seed++;

   491→function mergeTriple(store: Store, attrsStore: AttrsStore, rawTriple: Triple) {

   550→        // the store that didn't set `etype` in deleteEntity
   551→        !etype ||
   552→        // If we don't know about the attr, let's just get rid of it
   553→        !attr ||
   554→        // Make sure it matches the etype
   555→        attr['forward-identity']?.[1] === etype
   556→      ) {
   557→        deleteInMap(store.aev, [a, id]);
   558→        deleteInMap(store.eav, [id, a]);
   559→      }
   560→    }
   561→    // Clear out the eav index for `id` if we deleted all of the attributes
   562→    if (eMap.size === 0) {
   563→      deleteInMap(store.eav, [id]);
   564→    }
   565→  }
   566→
   567→  // delete reverse links
   568→  const vaeTriples = store.vae.get(id) && allMapValues(store.vae.get(id), 2);
   569→
   570→  if (vaeTriples) {
   571→    vaeTriples.forEach((triple: Triple) => {
   572→      const [e, a, v] = triple;
   573→      const attr = attrsStore.getAttr(a);
   574→      if (!etype || !attr || attr['reverse-identity']?.[1] === etype) {
   575→        deleteInMap(store.eav, [e, a, v]);
   576→        deleteInMap(store.aev, [a, e, v]);
   577→        deleteInMap(store.vae, [v, a, e]);
   578→      }
   579→      if (
   580→        attr &&
   581→        attr['on-delete'] === 'cascade' &&
   582→        attr['reverse-identity']?.[1] === etype
   583→      ) {
   584→        deleteEntity(store, attrsStore, [e, attr['forward-identity']?.[1]]);
   585→      }
   586→    });
   587→  }
   588→  // Clear out vae index for `id` if we deleted all the reverse attributes
   589→  if (store.vae.get(id)?.size === 0) {
   590→    deleteInMap(store.vae, [id]);
   591→  }
   592→}
   593→
   594→// (XXX): Whenever we change/delete attrs,
   595→// We indiscriminately reset the index map.
   596→// There are lots of opportunities for optimization:
   597→// * We _only_ need to run this indexes change. We could detect that
   598→// * We could batch this reset at the end
   599→// * We could add an ave index for all triples, so removing the
   600→//   right triples is easy and fast.
   601→function resetIndexMap(store: Store, attrsStore, newTriples: Triple[]) {
   602→  const newIndexMap = createTripleIndexes(
   603→    attrsStore,
   604→    newTriples,
   605→    store.useDateObjects,
   606→  );
   607→  Object.keys(newIndexMap).forEach((key) => {
   608→    store[key] = newIndexMap[key];
   609→  });
   610→}
   611→
   612→function addAttr(attrsStore: AttrsStore, [attr]: [InstantDBAttr]) {
   613→  attrsStore.addAttr(attr);
   614→}
   615→
   616→function getAllTriples(store: Store): Triple[] {
   617→  return allMapValues(store.eav, 3);
   618→}
   619→
   620→function deleteAttr(store: Store, attrsStore: AttrsStore, [id]: [string]) {
   621→  if (!attrsStore.getAttr(id)) return;
   622→  const newTriples = getAllTriples(store).filter(([_, aid]) => aid !== id);
   623→  attrsStore.deleteAttr(id);
   624→  resetIndexMap(store, attrsStore, newTriples);
   625→}
   626→
   627→function updateAttr(
   628→  store: Store,
   629→  attrsStore: AttrsStore,
   630→  [partialAttr]: [Partial<InstantDBAttr> & { id: string }],
   631→) {
   632→  const attr = attrsStore.getAttr(partialAttr.id);
   633→  if (!attr) return;
   634→  attrsStore.updateAttr(partialAttr);
   635→  resetIndexMap(store, attrsStore, getAllTriples(store));
   636→}
   637→
   638→function applyTxStep(store: Store, attrsStore: AttrsStore, txStep) {
   639→  const [action, ...args] = txStep;
   640→  switch (action) {
   641→    case 'add-triple':
   642→      addTriple(store, attrsStore, args);
   643→      break;
   644→    case 'deep-merge-triple':
   645→      mergeTriple(store, attrsStore, args);
   646→      break;
   647→    case 'retract-triple':
   648→      retractTriple(store, attrsStore, args);
   649→      break;
   650→    case 'delete-entity':
   651→      deleteEntity(store, attrsStore, args);
   652→      break;
   653→    case 'add-attr':
   654→      addAttr(attrsStore, args);
   655→      break;
   656→    case 'delete-attr':
   657→      deleteAttr(store, attrsStore, args);
   658→      break;
   659→    case 'update-attr':
   660→      updateAttr(store, attrsStore, args);
   661→      break;
   662→    case 'restore-attr':
   663→      break;
   664→    case 'rule-params':
   665→      break;
   666→    default:
   667→      throw new Error(`unhandled transaction action: ${action}`);
   668→  }
   669→}
   670→
   671→export function allMapValues(m, level, res: any[] = []) {
   672→  if (!m) {
   673→    return res;
   674→  }
   675→  if (level === 0) {
   676→    return res;
   677→  }
   678→  if (level === 1) {
   679→    for (const v of m.values()) {
   680→      res.push(v);
   681→    }
   682→    return res;
   683→  }
   684→  for (const v of m.values()) {
   685→    allMapValues(v, level - 1, res);
   686→  }
   687→
   688→  return res;
   689→}
   690→
   691→function triplesByValue(store: Store, m: Map<any, Triple>, v: any) {
   692→  const res: Triple[] = [];
   693→  if (v?.hasOwnProperty('$not')) {
   694→    for (const candidate of m.keys()) {
   695→      if (v.$not !== candidate) {
   696→        res.push(m.get(candidate) as Triple);
   697→      }
   698→    }
   699→    return res;
   700→  }
   701→
   702→  if (v?.hasOwnProperty('$isNull')) {
   703→    const { attrId, isNull, reverse } = v.$isNull;
   704→
   705→    if (reverse) {
   706→      for (const candidate of m.keys()) {
   707→        const vMap = store.vae.get(candidate);
   708→        const isValNull = !vMap || !vMap.get(attrId);
   709→        if (isNull ? isValNull : !isValNull) {
   710→          res.push(m.get(candidate) as Triple);
   711→        }
   712→      }
   713→    } else {
   714→      const aMap = store.aev.get(attrId);
   715→      for (const candidate of m.keys()) {
   716→        const isValNull =
   717→          !aMap || aMap.get(candidate)?.get(null) || !aMap.get(candidate);
   718→        if (isNull ? isValNull : !isValNull) {
   719→          res.push(m.get(candidate) as Triple);
   720→        }
   721→      }
   722→    }
   723→    return res;
   724→  }
   725→
   726→  if (v?.$comparator) {
   727→    // TODO: A sorted index would be nice here
   728→    return allMapValues(m, 1).filter(v.$op);
   729→  }
   730→
   731→  const values = v.in || v.$in || [v];
   732→
   733→  for (const value of values) {
   734→    const triple = m.get(value);
   735→    if (triple) {
   736→      res.push(triple);
   737→    }
   738→  }
   739→
   740→  return res;
   741→}
   742→
   743→// A poor man's pattern matching
   744→// Returns either eav, ea, ev, av, v, or ''
   745→function whichIdx(e, a, v): 'eav' | 'ea' | 'ev' | 'av' | 'e' | 'a' | 'v' | '' {
   746→  let res = '';
   747→  if (e !== undefined) {
   748→    res += 'e';
   749→  }
   750→  if (a !== undefined) {
   751→    res += 'a';
   752→  }
   753→  if (v !== undefined) {
   754→    res += 'v';
   755→  }
   756→  return res as 'eav' | 'ea' | 'ev' | 'av' | 'e' | 'a' | 'v' | '';
   757→}
   758→
   759→export function getTriples(store, [e, a, v]) {
   760→  const idx = whichIdx(e, a, v);
   761→  switch (idx) {
   762→    case 'e': {
   763→      const eMap = store.eav.get(e);
   764→      return allMapValues(eMap, 2);
   765→    }
   766→    case 'ea': {
   767→      const aMap = store.eav.get(e)?.get(a);
   768→      return allMapValues(aMap, 1);
   769→    }
   770→    case 'eav': {
   771→      const aMap = store.eav.get(e)?.get(a);
   772→      if (!aMap) {
   773→        return [];
   774→      }
   775→      return triplesByValue(store, aMap, v);
   776→    }
   777→    case 'ev': {
   778→      const eMap = store.eav.get(e);
   779→      if (!eMap) {
   780→        return [];
   781→      }
   782→      const res: Triple[] = [];
   783→      for (const aMap of eMap.values()) {
   784→        res.push(...triplesByValue(store, aMap, v));
   785→      }
   786→      return res;
   787→    }
   788→    case 'a': {
   789→      const aMap = store.aev.get(a);
   790→      return allMapValues(aMap, 2);
   791→    }
   792→    case 'av': {
   793→      const aMap = store.aev.get(a);
   794→      if (!aMap) {
   795→        return [];
   796→      }
   797→      const res: Triple[] = [];
   798→      for (const eMap of aMap.values()) {
   799→        res.push(...triplesByValue(store, eMap, v));
   800→      }
   801→      return res;
   802→    }
   803→    case 'v': {
   804→      const res: Triple[] = [];
   805→      for (const eMap of store.eav.values()) {
   806→        for (const aMap of eMap.values()) {
   807→          res.push(...triplesByValue(store, aMap, v));
   808→        }
   809→      }
   810→      return res;
   811→    }
   812→    default: {
   813→      return allMapValues(store.eav, 3);
   814→    }
   815→  }
   816→}
   817→
   818→export function getAsObject(
   819→  store: Store,
   820→  attrs: Map<string, InstantDBAttr> | undefined,
   821→  e: string,
   822→) {
   823→  const obj = {};
   824→
   825→  if (!attrs) {
   826→    return obj;
   827→  }
   828→
   829→  for (const [label, attr] of attrs.entries()) {
   830→    const aMap = store.eav.get(e)?.get(attr.id);
   831→    const triples = allMapValues(aMap, 1);
   832→    for (const triple of triples) {
   833→      obj[label] = triple[2];
   834→    }
   835→  }
   836→
   837→  return obj;
   838→}
   839→
   840→export function getAttrByFwdIdentName(
   841→  attrsStore: AttrsStore,
   842→  inputEtype: string,
   843→  inputLabel: string,
   844→) {
   845→  return attrsStore.forwardIdents.get(inputEtype)?.get(inputLabel);
   846→}
   847→
   848→export function getAttrByReverseIdentName(

   851→  inputLabel: string,

   855→
   856→export function getBlobAttrs(attrsStore: AttrsStore, etype: string) {

   860→export function getPrimaryKeyAttr(attrsStore: AttrsStore, etype: string) {
   861→  const fromPrimary = attrsStore.primaryKeys.get(etype);
   862→  if (fromPrimary) {
   863→    return fromPrimary;
   864→  }

   867→
   868→function findTriple(
   869→  store: Store,
   870→  attrsStore: AttrsStore,
   871→  rawTriple: [string, string, any] | Triple,
   872→): Triple | undefined {

   878→  const [eid, aid, v] = triple;

   881→    // (XXX): Due to the way we're handling attrs, it's
   882→    // possible to enter a state where we receive a triple without an attr.

   886→  }
   887→

   890→
   891→export function transact(
   892→  store: Store,
   893→  attrsStore: AttrsStore,
   894→  txSteps,
   895→): { store: Store; attrsStore: AttrsStore } {
   896→  const txStepsFiltered = txSteps.filter(
   897→    ([action, eid, attrId, value, opts]) => {
   898→      if (action !== 'add-triple' && action !== 'deep-merge-triple') {
   899→        return true;
   900→      }
   901→
   902→      const mode = opts?.mode;
   903→      if (mode !== 'create' && mode !== 'update') {
   904→        return true;
   905→      }
   906→
   907→      let exists = false;
   908→
   909→      const attr = attrsStore.getAttr(attrId);

```
     1→# Issue: `InstantSyncKey.save()` Does Not Track Deletions
     2→
     3→## Summary
     4→
     5→When using `@Shared(.instantSync(...))` with `.withLock { $0.remove(id:) }` to delete items from a collection, the deletion is **not sent to InstantDB**. The item is removed from the local collection, but no `["delete", namespace, id]` operation is transmitted to the server.
     6→
     7→## Expected Behavior
     8→
     9→When calling:
    10→
    11→```swift
    12→$todos.withLock { todos in
    13→    todos.remove(atOffsets: offsets)
    14→}
    15→```
    16→
    17→The `InstantSyncKey.save()` method should:
    18→1. Compare the new collection state with the previous state
    19→2. Identify which IDs were removed
    20→3. Generate `["delete", namespace, id]` operations for each removed item
    21→4. Send those delete operations to InstantDB
    22→
    23→## Actual Behavior
    24→
    25→The `save()` method only iterates over items **currently in the collection** and sends `["update", ...]` and `["link", ...]` operations. It does not track which items were removed, so **no delete operations are ever sent**.
    26→
    27→### Evidence
    28→
    29→From `InstantSyncKey.swift` lines 367-598, the `save()` method:
    30→
    31→```swift
    32→public func save(
    33→    _ value: Value,
    34→    context: SaveContext,
    35→    continuation: SaveContinuation
    36→) {
    37→    // ...
    38→    
    39→    // Only iterates over current items - never tracks deletions
    40→    for item in value {
    41→        // Creates update ops for each item
    42→        // Creates link ops for relationships
    43→        // NEVER creates delete ops for removed items
    44→    }
    45→}
    46→```
    47→
    48→The `SaveContext` enum from swift-sharing only provides:
    49→- `.didSet` - mutation via `withLock`
    50→- `.userInitiated` - explicit `save()` call
    51→
    52→It does **not** provide the previous value, so `save()` has no way to know what was removed.
    53→
    54→### Test Case
    55→
    56→Created `RapidUpdateSharingInstantTest.swift` which:
    57→1. Creates test entities using `@Shared(.instantSync(...))` + `.withLock { append() }` ✅ Works
    58→2. Updates entities using `.withLock { $0[index].field = newValue }` ✅ Works  
    59→3. Deletes entities using `.withLock { $0.remove(id:) }` ❌ **Does not delete from InstantDB**
    60→
    61→The local collection updates correctly, but the InstantDB dashboard shows the items still exist.
    62→
    63→## Workaround
    64→
    65→Use `InstantClient` directly for deletions:
    66→
    67→```swift
    68→import InstantDB
    69→
    70→// Get the SDK client
    71→let db = InstantClientFactory.makeClient()
    72→
    73→// Build delete operations manually
    74→let deleteChunks: [TransactionChunk] = idsToDelete.map { id in
    75→    TransactionChunk(
    76→        namespace: "myNamespace",
    77→        id: id,
    78→        ops: [["delete", "myNamespace", id]]
    79→    )
    80→}
    81→
    82→// Send directly to InstantDB
    83→try db.transact(deleteChunks)
    84→
    85→// Also update local state so UI reflects the change
    86→$items.withLock { items in
    87→    for id in idsToDelete {
    88→        items.remove(id: id)
    89→    }
    90→}
    91→```
    92→
    93→## Proposed Fix
    94→
    95→The `InstantSyncKey` needs to track the previous set of IDs and compare with the new set on each `save()`. Options:
    96→
    97→### Option 1: Track Previous IDs in Key State
    98→
    99→```swift
   100→// In InstantSyncCollectionKey
   101→private var previousIds: Set<String> = []
   102→
   103→public func save(_ value: Value, context: SaveContext, continuation: SaveContinuation) {
   104→    let currentIds = Set(value.map { $0.id })
   105→    let deletedIds = previousIds.subtracting(currentIds)
   106→    
   107→    // Generate delete ops for removed items
   108→    for deletedId in deletedIds {
   109→        // Add ["delete", namespace, deletedId] to transaction
   110→    }
   111→    
   112→    // Update tracking
   113→    previousIds = currentIds
   114→    
   115→    // ... rest of save logic
   116→}
   117→```
   118→
   119→### Option 2: Request `oldValue` from swift-sharing
   120→
   121→The `SaveContext` could be extended to include the previous value:
   122→
   123→```swift
   124→public enum SaveContext: Hashable, Sendable {
   125→    case didSet(oldValue: Value?)  // Would need generic constraint
   126→    case userInitiated
   127→}
   128→```
   129→
   130→This would require changes to the swift-sharing library.
   131→
   132→## Impact
   133→
   134→This affects any SharingInstant user who expects `.withLock { remove() }` to sync deletions to InstantDB. The pattern shown in `AdvancedTodoDemo.swift`:
   135→
   136→```swift
   137→private func deleteTodos(at offsets: IndexSet) {
   138→    $todos.withLock { todos in
   139→        todos.remove(atOffsets: offsets)
   140→    }
   141→}
   142→```
   143→
   144→**Does not actually delete from InstantDB** - only from the local collection.
   145→
   146→## Related Files
   147→
   148→- `Sources/SharingInstant/InstantSyncKey.swift` - The `save()` method that needs fixing
   149→- `Sources/SharingInstant/Internal/Reactor.swift` - Already handles `"delete"` operations when received
   150→- `Examples/CaseStudies/AdvancedTodoDemo.swift` - Uses the broken deletion pattern
   151→
   152→## Environment
   153→
   154→- SharingInstant: Current main branch
   155→- swift-sharing: Latest
   156→- InstantDB Swift SDK: Latest
   157→- Date discovered: 2025-12-30
   158→

     1→(ns instant.reactive.store
     2→  "In-memory store that tracks all data for active sessions.
     3→
     4→   Serves the following purposes:
     5→
     6→   1. Invalidation. Given a mutation, the store can find relevant data to
     7→      refresh.
     8→
     9→   2. Caching. Datalog queries can be shared across instaql queries.
    10→      By caching datalog results we improve perf.
    11→
    12→   3. Novelty. By storing instaql query results we can compute changesets to
    13→      send to clients
    14→
    15→   4. Metadata. Sessions have auth, sockets, and other misc data for handling
    16→      events across the lifetime of a session"
    17→  (:require
    18→   [clojure.string :as string]
    19→   [datascript.core :as d]

   126→(defn duration-ms [t0 t1]
   127→  (-> t1 (- t0) (/ 1000000) double))
   128→
   129→(defrecord TxInput [tx-data result-promise])
   130→(defrecord TxResult [type result lock-time-ms tx-time-ms])
   131→
   132→(deftype RunTxes [conn]
   133→  Runnable
   134→  (run [this]
   135→    (let [{:keys [tx-queue lock executor]} (meta conn)
   136→          items (loop [items (transient [])]
   137→                  (if (< 50 (count items))
   138→                    (persistent! items)
   139→                    (if-let [next-item (ConcurrentLinkedQueue/.poll tx-queue)]
   140→                      (recur (conj! items next-item))
   141→                      (persistent! items))))]
   142→      (when (seq items)
   143→        (let [t0 (System/nanoTime)
   144→              reports (lang/with-reentrant-lock lock
   145→                        (let [lock-time-ms (duration-ms t0 (System/nanoTime))]
   146→                          (loop [db @conn
   147→                                 items items
   148→                                 reports (transient [])]
   149→                            (if (seq items)
   150→                              (let [tx-data (:tx-data (first items))
   151→                                    start (System/nanoTime)
   152→                                    report (try
   153→                                             (->TxResult :ok
   154→                                                         (d-conn/with db tx-data nil)
   155→                                                         lock-time-ms
   156→                                                         (duration-ms start (System/nanoTime)))
   157→                                             (catch Throwable t
   158→                                               (->TxResult :error
   159→                                                           t
   160→                                                           lock-time-ms
   161→                                                           (duration-ms start (System/nanoTime)))))]
   162→                                (recur (if (= :ok (:type report))
   163→                                         (:db-after (:result report))
   164→                                         db)
   165→                                       (rest items)
   166→                                       (conj! reports report)))
   167→                              (do
   168→                                (reset! conn db)
   169→                                (persistent! reports))))))]
   170→          (loop [items items
   171→                 reports reports]
   172→            (when (seq items)
   173→              (deliver (:result-promise (first items)) (first reports))
   174→              (recur (rest items) (rest reports)))))
   175→        (when-not (ConcurrentLinkedQueue/.isEmpty tx-queue)
   176→          (ExecutorService/.submit executor ^Runnable this))))))
   177→
   178→(def datalog-query-byte-len
   179→  (if (config/prod?)
   180→    (fn [v]
   181→      (or (:sql-byte-len (meta v))
   182→          ;; This should never be null, but just in case
   183→          (* 1024 1024)))
   184→    (fn [v]
   185→      (let [byte-len (:sql-byte-len (meta v))]
   186→        (assert byte-len ":sql-byte-len is missing from datalog result")
   187→        byte-len))))

   189→(defn create-datalog-query-cache [executor]
   190→  (cache/make-async {:max-weight (flags/flag :datalog-cache-max-weight
   191→                                             ;; 500mb
   192→                                             (* 1024 1024 500))
   193→                     :ttl (flags/flag :datalog-cache-ttl
   194→                                      ;; 1 hour
   195→                                      (* 1000 60 60))
   196→                     :weigher (fn [_k v]
   197→                                (* (datalog-query-byte-len v)
   198→                                   ;; We use more memory to build the data than
   199→                                   ;; postgres uses to send it to us. This flag accounts
   200→                                   ;; for that difference
   201→                                   (flags/flag :datalog-cache-size-multiple 4)))
   202→                     :record-stats true
   203→                     :executor executor}))
   204→
   205→(defn create-conn [schema app-id]
   206→  (let [conn (-> (d/empty-db schema)
   207→                 (d/with [{:tx-meta/app-id app-id
   208→                           :tx-meta/processed-tx-id (tx-model/max-seen-tx-id)}])
   209→                 :db-after
   210→                 d/conn-from-db)
   211→        cache-executor (ua/make-vfuture-executor)]
   212→    (alter-meta! conn
   213→                 assoc
   214→                 :app-id app-id
   215→                 :executor (Executors/newSingleThreadExecutor (.factory (Thread/ofVirtual)))
   216→                 :run-txes (RunTxes. conn)
   217→                 :lock (ReentrantLock. false)
   218→                 :tx-queue (ConcurrentLinkedQueue.)
   219→                 :cache-executor cache-executor
   220→                 :datalog-query-cache (create-datalog-query-cache cache-executor)
   221→                 :app-id app-id)
   222→    conn))
   223→
   224→(defn app-conn [store app-id]
   225→  (Map/.computeIfAbsent (:conns store) app-id #(create-conn schema %)))

   230→(defn conn->datalog-query-cache [conn]
   231→  (-> conn meta :datalog-query-cache))

   233→(defn translate-datascript-exceptions [exinfo]
   234→  (let [{:keys [error entity-id]} (ex-data exinfo)]
   235→    (if (and (= :entity-id/missing error)
   236→             (coll? entity-id)
   237→             (= :session/id (first entity-id)))
   238→      (ex/throw-session-missing! (last entity-id))
   239→      (throw exinfo))))
   240→
   241→(defn cancel-in-progress-datalog-query [cache datalog-query-ent]
   242→  (when-let [stmts (:datalog-query/stmt-tracker datalog-query-ent)]
   243→    (sql/cancel-in-progress stmts (flags/statement-cancel-wait-ms)))
   244→  (when-let [children (:datalog-query/child-vfutures datalog-query-ent)]
   245→    (ua/cancel-children children true))
   246→  (cache/invalidate-async cache (:db/id datalog-query-ent)))

   248→(defn clean-datalog-query-cache
   249→  "Evicts datalog results we no longer care about and cancels any in-progress
   250→   queries that nobody is waiting on a result for.
   251→
   252→   Should run after `transact!`"
   253→  [conn {:keys [tx-data]}]
   254→  (let [deleted-datalog-query-ids (keep (fn [datom]
   255→                                          (when (and (= (:a datom)
   256→                                                        :datalog-query/app-id+query)
   257→                                                     (not (:added datom)))
   258→                                            (:e datom)))
   259→                                        tx-data)
   260→        cache (conn->datalog-query-cache conn)]
   261→    (when (seq deleted-datalog-query-ids)
   262→      (cache/invalidate-all-async cache deleted-datalog-query-ids)
   263→      (let [stats (cache/stats-async cache)]
   264→        (tracer/add-data! {:attributes {:cache.hits (.hitCount stats)
   265→                                        :cache.misses (.missCount stats)
   266→                                        :cache.success (.loadSuccessCount stats)
   267→                                        :cache.failure (.loadFailureCount stats)
   268→                                        :cache.load-time (.totalLoadTime stats)
   269→                                        :cache.evicts (.evictionCount stats)
   270→                                        :cache.eviction-weight (.evictionWeight stats)
   271→                                        :cache.current-weight (cache/weight-async cache)}})))))
   272→
   273→(defn transact-new! [span-name conn tx-data]
   274→  (let [t1 (System/nanoTime)]
   275→    (tracer/with-span! {:name span-name
   276→                        :attributes {:version "new"}}
   277→      (try
   278→        (let [t2 (System/nanoTime)
   279→              {:keys [tx-queue executor run-txes]} (meta conn)
   280→              result-promise (promise)
   281→              _ (ConcurrentLinkedQueue/.add tx-queue (->TxInput tx-data result-promise))
   282→              _ (ExecutorService/.submit executor ^Runnable run-txes)
   283→              result @result-promise
   284→              _ (when (= :error (:type result))
   285→                  (throw (:result result)))
   286→              report (:result result)
   287→              tx-time-ms (:tx-time-ms result)]
   288→          (tracer/add-data! {:attributes {:app-id (:app-id (meta conn))
   289→                                          :changed-datoms-count (count (:tx-data report))
   290→                                          :span-time-ms (-> t2 (- t1) (/ 1000000) double)
   291→                                          :lock-time-ms (:lock-time-ms result)
   292→                                          :tx-time-ms tx-time-ms
   293→                                          :db-before-size (count (:db-before report))
   294→                                          :db-after-size (count (:db-after report))}})
   295→          (when (> tx-time-ms 15000)
   296→            (tracer/with-new-trace-root
   297→              (tracer/with-span! {:name "really-long-tx"
   298→                                  :attributes {:tx-ms tx-time-ms
   299→                                               :v "new"
   300→                                               :tx-data tx-data
   301→                                               :app-id (:app-id (meta conn))}}))
   302→            (def -new-long-tx-data tx-data)
   303→            (def -new-long-tx report))
   304→          (clean-datalog-query-cache conn report)
   305→          report)
   306→        (catch clojure.lang.ExceptionInfo e
   307→          (translate-datascript-exceptions e))))))
   308→
   309→(defn transact-old! [span-name conn tx-data]
   310→  (let [t1 (System/nanoTime)]
   311→    (tracer/with-span! {:name span-name
   312→                        :attributes {:version "old"}}
   313→      (try
   314→        (let [t2          (System/nanoTime)
   315→              [t3 ret t4] (lang/with-reentrant-lock (:lock (meta conn))
   316→                            [(System/nanoTime)
   317→                             (d/transact! conn tx-data)
   318→                             (System/nanoTime)])
   319→              tx-time-ms (-> t4 (- t3) (/ 1000000) double)]
   320→          (tracer/add-data! {:attributes {:app-id               (:app-id (meta conn))
   321→                                          :changed-datoms-count (count (:tx-data ret))
   322→                                          :span-time-ms         (-> t2 (- t1) (/ 1000000) double)
   323→                                          :lock-time-ms         (-> t3 (- t2) (/ 1000000) double)
   324→                                          :tx-time-ms           tx-time-ms
   325→                                          :db-before-size       (count (:db-before ret))
   326→                                          :db-after-size        (count (:db-after ret))}})
   327→          (when (> tx-time-ms 15000)
   328→            (tracer/with-new-trace-root
   329→              (tracer/with-span! {:name "really-long-tx"
   330→                                  :attributes {:tx-ms tx-time-ms
   331→                                               :v "old"
   332→                                               :tx-data tx-data
   333→                                               :app-id (:app-id (meta conn))}}))
   334→            (def -old-long-tx-data tx-data)
   335→            (def -old-long-tx ret))
   336→          (clean-datalog-query-cache conn ret)
   337→          ret)
   338→        (catch clojure.lang.ExceptionInfo e
   339→          (translate-datascript-exceptions e))))))
   340→
   341→(defn deleted-subscriptions-datalog-query-ids [report]
   342→  (keep (fn [datom]
   343→          (when (and (= (:a datom)
   344→                        :subscription/datalog-query)
   345→                     (not (:added datom))
   346→                     (d/entity (:db-after report) (:v datom)))
   347→            (:v datom)))
   348→        (:tx-data report)))
   349→
   350→(defn clean-stale-datalog-queries-tx-data [db datalog-query-eids]
   351→  (ucoll/reduce-tr (fn [acc e]
   352→                     (if-not (d/find-datom db :avet :subscription/datalog-query e)
   353→                       (conj! acc [:db/retractEntity e])
   354→                       acc))
   355→                   []
   356→                   datalog-query-eids))
   357→
   358→(defn transact! [span-name conn tx-data]
   359→  (let [report (if (or (flags/toggled? :enable-store-batching-globally)
   360→                       (contains? (flags/flag :enable-store-batching-apps)
   361→                                  (:app-id (meta conn))))
   362→                 (transact-new! span-name conn tx-data)
   363→                 (transact-old! span-name conn tx-data))]
   364→    (if-let [eids (seq (deleted-subscriptions-datalog-query-ids report))]
   365→      (do
   366→        (transact! "store/clean-datalog-queries"
   367→                   conn
   368→                   [[:db.fn/call clean-stale-datalog-queries-tx-data (distinct eids)]])
   369→        report)
   370→      report)))

   413→(defn report-active-sessions [store]
   414→  (let [db @(:sessions store)]
   415→    (for [datom (d/datoms db :aevt :session/id)
   416→          :let [ent (d/entity db (:e datom))
   417→                {:session/keys [auth creator]} ent]]
   418→      {:app-title      (-> auth :app :title)
   419→       :app-id         (-> auth :app :id)
   420→       :app-user-email (-> auth :user :email)
   421→       :creator-email  (-> creator :email)
   422→       :session-id     (:session/id ent)
   423→       :socket-origin  (some-> ent
   424→                               :session/socket
   425→                               socket-origin)})))

   428→  (report-active-sessions store))

   461→
   462→(defn get-stale-instaql-queries [store app-id sess-id]
   463→  (let [db @(app-conn store app-id)]
   464→    (for [datom (d/datoms db :avet :instaql-query/session-id sess-id)
   465→          :let [ent (d/entity db (:e datom))]
   466→          :when (:instaql-query/stale? ent)]
   467→      ent)))

   469→(defn bump-instaql-version-tx-data
   470→  "Should be used in a db.fn/call. Returns transactions.
   471→   Bumps the query version and marks query as not stale, creating the query
   472→   if needed."
   473→  [db lookup-ref session-id instaql-query return-type inference?]
   474→  (if-let [existing (d/entity db lookup-ref)]
   475→    (let [v  (:instaql-query/version existing)
   476→          v' (inc (or v 0))]
   477→      [{:db/id (:db/id existing)
   478→        :instaql-query/version v'
   479→        :instaql-query/stale? false}])
   480→    [{:instaql-query/session-id session-id
   481→      :instaql-query/query instaql-query
   482→      :instaql-query/forms-hash (forms-hash instaql-query)
   483→      :instaql-query/stale? false
   484→      :instaql-query/version 1
   485→      :instaql-query/return-type return-type
   486→      :instaql-query/inference? (or inference? false)}]))
   487→
   488→(defn bump-instaql-version! [store app-id sess-id q return-type inference?]
   489→  (let [lookup-ref [:instaql-query/session-id+query [sess-id q]]
   490→        conn       (app-conn store app-id)
   491→        tx         [[:db.fn/call bump-instaql-version-tx-data lookup-ref sess-id q return-type inference?]]
   492→        report     (transact! "store/bump-instaql-version!" conn tx)]
   493→    (d/entity (:db-after report) lookup-ref)))
   494→
   495→(defn set-instaql-topic! [store app-id instaql-query-eid topic]
   496→  (let [conn (app-conn store app-id)]
   497→    (transact! "store/set-instaql-topic!"
   498→               conn
   499→               [[:db/add instaql-query-eid :instaql-query/topic topic]])))

   501→;; ----
   502→;; remove instaql queries
   503→
   504→(defn- remove-subscriptions-tx-data
   505→  "Should be used in a db.fn/call. Returns transactions.
   506→   Retracts the instaql-query and subscriptions for the query."
   507→  [db session-id instaql-query]
   508→  (if-some [query-eid (d/entid db [:instaql-query/session-id+query [session-id instaql-query]])]
   509→    (concat
   510→     (for [datom (d/datoms db :avet :subscription/instaql-query query-eid)]
   511→       [:db/retractEntity (:e datom)])
   512→     [[:db/retractEntity query-eid]])
   513→    []))
   514→
   515→(defn remove-query! [store app-id sess-id q]
   516→  (transact! "store/remove-query!"
   517→             (app-conn store app-id)
   518→             [[:db.fn/call remove-subscriptions-tx-data sess-id q]]))

   520→;; --------------
   521→;; adding queries
   522→
   523→(defn- clean-stale-subscriptions-tx-data
   524→  "Should be used in a db.fn/call. Returns transactions.
   525→   Retracts subscriptions for an older version of an instaql query."
   526→  [db instaql-query-lookup-ref version]
   527→  (if-some [query-eid (d/entid db instaql-query-lookup-ref)]
   528→    (keep (fn [datom]
   529→            (let [sub-version (:v (d/find-datom db :eavt (:e datom) :subscription/v))]
   530→              (when (or (not sub-version)
   531→                        (< sub-version version))
   532→                [:db/retractEntity (:e datom)])))
   533→          (d/datoms db :avet :subscription/instaql-query query-eid))
   534→    []))
   535→
   536→(defn- set-instaql-query-result-tx-data
   537→  "Should be used in a db.fn/call. Returns transactions.
   538→   Sets the hash for the query result."
   539→  [db lookup-ref result-hash]
   540→  (if-some [e (d/entid db lookup-ref)]
   541→    [[:db/add e :instaql-query/hash result-hash]]
   542→    []))
   543→
   544→(defn add-instaql-query! [store {:keys [app-id session-id instaql-query v] :as _ctx} result-hash]
   545→  (let [conn            (app-conn store app-id)
   546→        lookup-ref      [:instaql-query/session-id+query [session-id instaql-query]]
   547→        report          (transact! "store/add-instaql-query!"
   548→                                   conn
   549→                                   [[:db.fn/call clean-stale-subscriptions-tx-data lookup-ref v]
   550→                                    [:db.fn/call set-instaql-query-result-tx-data lookup-ref result-hash]])
   551→        hash-before     (:instaql-query/hash (d/entity (:db-before report) lookup-ref))
   552→        hash-after      (:instaql-query/hash (d/entity (:db-after report) lookup-ref))
   553→        result-changed? (or (not= hash-before hash-after)
   554→                            (and (nil? hash-before)
   555→                                 (nil? hash-after)))]
   556→    (assoc report :result-changed? result-changed?)))

   561→(defn session-instaql-queries [store app-id sess-id]
   562→  (let [db @(app-conn store app-id)]
   563→    (set
   564→     (for [datom (d/datoms db :avet :instaql-query/session-id sess-id)
   565→           :let  [ent (d/entity db (:e datom))]]
   566→       (:instaql-query/query ent)))))

   568→(defn- remove-session-queries-tx-data
   569→  "Should be used in a db.fn/call. Returns transactions.
   570→   Retracts queries for the session."
   571→  [db sess-id]
   572→  (for [datom (d/datoms db :avet :instaql-query/session-id sess-id)]
   573→    [:db/retractEntity (:e datom)]))
   574→
   575→(defn- remove-session-subscriptions-tx-data
   576→  "Should be used in a db.fn/call. Returns transactions.
   577→   Retracts subscriptions for the session."
   578→  [db sess-id]
   579→  (for [datom (d/datoms db :avet :subscription/session-id sess-id)]
   580→    [:db/retractEntity (:e datom)]))
