   582→(defn remove-session! [store app-id sess-id]
   583→  ;; sync so new sessions are not added while we clean up this one
   584→  (when (and app-id
   585→             (Map/.containsKey (:conns store) app-id))
   586→    (transact! "store/remove-session-data!"
   587→               (app-conn store app-id)
   588→               [[:db.fn/call remove-session-queries-tx-data sess-id]
   589→                [:db.fn/call remove-session-subscriptions-tx-data sess-id]]))
   590→  (let [sessions-conn (:sessions store)]
   591→    (transact! "store/remove-session!"
   592→               sessions-conn
   593→               [[:db.fn/retractEntity [:session/id sess-id]]])
   594→    (when-let [removed-conn
   595→               ;; Be careful not to use `lang/with-reentrant-lock` around
   596→               ;; code that uses `transact!` or you will deadlock
   597→               (lang/with-reentrant-lock (:lock (meta sessions-conn))
   598→                 (when (and app-id
   599→                            (empty? (d/datoms @sessions-conn :avet :session/app-id app-id)))
   600→                   (Map/.remove (:conns store) app-id)))]
   601→      (ExecutorService/.shutdown (:executor (meta removed-conn)))
   602→      (ExecutorService/.shutdown (:cache-executor (meta removed-conn))))))
   603→
   604→;; ------
   605→;; datalog cache
   606→
   607→(defn- swap-datalog-cache-tx-data
   608→  "Should be used in a db.fn/call. Returns transactions.
   609→   Updates or creates the datalog query with data needed to manage the cache."
   610→  [db app-id query watcher-id]
   611→  (when-let [existing (d/entity db [:datalog-query/app-id+query [app-id query]])]
   612→    (let [watchers (:datalog-query/watchers existing)
   613→          id (:db/id existing)]
   614→      (if (or (not watchers)
   615→              ;; We were canceled, so let's start over
   616→              (:canceled? @watchers)
   617→              (:canceled? (swap! watchers
   618→                                 (fn [x]
   619→                                   (if (:canceled? x)
   620→                                     x
   621→                                     (update x :watchers conj watcher-id))))))
   622→        [[:db/add id :datalog-query/watchers (atom {:canceled? false
   623→                                                    :watchers #{watcher-id}})]
   624→         [:db/add id :datalog-query/stmt-tracker (sql/make-top-level-statement-tracker)]
   625→         [:db/add id :datalog-query/child-vfutures (ua/new-child-vfutures)]]
   626→
   627→        []))))
   628→
   629→(defn swap-datalog-cache!
   630→  "Adds a query to the datalog cache.
   631→   The underlying cache is an instant.util.cache/async-cache that lives in the
   632→   metadata of the datascript store (one per app).
   633→
   634→   Here we lookup or add the result of the query to the cache and register ourselves
   635→   as interested in the result of the query.
   636→
   637→   When the datalog query is evicted from the store, the cached result will be
   638→   removed from the cache (see `clean-datalog-query-cache`). If it is in progress
   639→   and there are no watchers, then the query will be canceled."
   640→  [store app-id datalog-query-fn ctx datalog-query]
   641→  (let [lookup-ref [:datalog-query/app-id+query [app-id datalog-query]]
   642→        conn (app-conn store app-id)
   643→        watcher-id (Object.)
   644→        {:keys [db-after]} (transact! "store/swap-datalog-cache!"
   645→                                      conn
   646→                                      [[:db.fn/call
   647→                                        swap-datalog-cache-tx-data
   648→                                        app-id
   649→                                        datalog-query
   650→                                        watcher-id]])]
   651→    (if-let [query-ent (d/entity db-after lookup-ref)]
   652→      (let [query-id (:db/id query-ent)
   653→
   654→            stmt-tracker (:datalog-query/stmt-tracker query-ent)
   655→
   656→            child-vfutures (:datalog-query/child-vfutures query-ent)
   657→
   658→            cache (conn->datalog-query-cache conn)
   659→
   660→            ^CompletableFuture existing-result
   661→            (when-let [res (cache/get-if-present-async cache query-id)]
   662→              (if (.isCompletedExceptionally res)
   663→                ;; caffeine invalidates errors, but sometimes it takes a bit
   664→                (cache/invalidate-async cache query-id)
   665→                res))
   666→
   667→            ^CompletableFuture result
   668→            (or existing-result
   669→                ;; bindings to let us cancel in-progress queries
   670→                ;; once all listeners drop off
   671→                (binding [ua/*child-vfutures* child-vfutures
   672→                          sql/*in-progress-stmts* stmt-tracker]
   673→                  (cache/get-async cache
   674→                                   query-id
   675→                                   (fn [_]
   676→                                     (binding [ua/*child-vfutures* child-vfutures
   677→                                               sql/*in-progress-stmts* stmt-tracker]
   678→                                       (datalog-query-fn ctx datalog-query))))))]
   679→
   680→        (tracer/add-data! {:attributes {:cache-hit (not (nil? existing-result))
   681→                                        :realized (and (not (nil? existing-result))
   682→                                                       (.isDone existing-result))}})
   683→
   684→        (try
   685→          (deref result)
   686→          (catch Throwable t
   687→            (when (and (not (.isDone result))
   688→                       (or (instance? InterruptedException t)
   689→                           (instance? CancellationException t))
   690→                       (:canceled? (swap! (:datalog-query/watchers query-ent)
   691→                                          (fn [watchers]
   692→                                            (let [watchers' (update watchers :watchers disj watcher-id)]
   693→                                              (if (empty? (:watchers watchers'))
   694→                                                (assoc watchers' :canceled? true)
   695→                                                watchers'))))))
   696→              (cancel-in-progress-datalog-query cache query-ent))
   697→            (throw t))
   698→          (finally
   699→            (swap! (:datalog-query/watchers query-ent) update :watchers disj watcher-id))))
   700→      ;; There was no query in the store, it was likely removed by the session leaving.
   701→      ;; We're going to run it just in case
   702→      ;; TODO: Throw an exception here once we confirm that it's not running in prod
   703→      (tracer/with-span! {:name "orphaned-datalog-query"}
   704→        (datalog-query-fn ctx datalog-query)))))
   705→
   706→;; --------------
   707→;; datalog loader
   708→
   709→(defn- upsert-datalog-loader-tx-data [db sess-id make-loader-fn]
   710→  (when-not (d/find-datom db :eavt [:session/id sess-id] :session/datalog-loader)
   711→    [[:db/add [:session/id sess-id] :session/datalog-loader (make-loader-fn)]]))
   712→
   713→(defn upsert-datalog-loader! [store sess-id make-loader-fn]
   714→  (let [conn (:sessions store)]
   715→    (if-some [loader (:session/datalog-loader (d/entity @conn [:session/id sess-id]))]
   716→      loader
   717→      (let [{:keys [db-after]}
   718→            (transact! "store/upsert-datalog-loader!"
   719→                       conn
   720→                       [[:db.fn/call upsert-datalog-loader-tx-data sess-id make-loader-fn]])]
   721→        (:session/datalog-loader (d/entity db-after [:session/id sess-id]))))))
   722→
   723→;; -------------
   724→;; subscriptions
   725→
   726→(defn record-datalog-query-start! [store ctx datalog-query coarse-topics]
   727→  (let [{:keys [app-id session-id instaql-query v]} ctx
   728→        conn (app-conn store app-id)]
   729→    (transact! "store/record-datalog-query-start!"
   730→               conn
   731→               [[:db.fn/call
   732→                 (fn [db]
   733→                   (let [lookup-ref [:datalog-query/app-id+query [app-id datalog-query]]
   734→                         existing-datalog-query (d/entity db lookup-ref)
   735→                         datalog-query-eid (or (:db/id existing-datalog-query) -1)]
   736→                     (concat
   737→                      (if existing-datalog-query
   738→                        (when-not (:datalog-query/topics existing-datalog-query)
   739→                          [{:db/id datalog-query-eid
   740→                            :datalog-query/topics coarse-topics}])
   741→                        [{:db/id datalog-query-eid
   742→                          :datalog-query/app-id app-id
   743→                          :datalog-query/query  datalog-query
   744→                          :datalog-query/topics coarse-topics}])
   745→                      (when-some [query-eid (d/entid db [:instaql-query/session-id+query [session-id instaql-query]])]
   746→                        [{:subscription/app-id app-id
   747→                          :subscription/session-id session-id
   748→                          :subscription/v v
   749→                          :subscription/instaql-query query-eid
   750→                          :subscription/datalog-query datalog-query-eid}]))))]])))
   751→
   752→(defn record-datalog-query-finish! [store
   753→                                    ctx
   754→                                    datalog-query
   755→                                    {:keys [topics] :as _result}]
   756→
   757→  (let [{:keys [app-id]} ctx
   758→        conn (app-conn store app-id)
   759→        lookup-ref [:datalog-query/app-id+query [app-id datalog-query]]]
   760→    (transact!
   761→     "store/record-datalog-query-finish!"
   762→     conn
   763→     [[:db.fn/call
   764→       (fn [db]
   765→         (when-some [existing (d/entity db lookup-ref)]
   766→           [[:db/add (:db/id existing) :datalog-query/topics topics]]))]])))
   767→
   768→;; ------------
   769→;; invalidation
   770→
   771→(defn intersects?
   772→  "Like (not (empty? (set/intersection set-a set-b))), but it returns early
   773→   instead of calculating the full intersection."
   774→  [set-a set-b]
   775→  (let [[big small] (if (> (count set-a) (count set-b))
   776→                      [set-a set-b]
   777→                      [set-b set-a])]
   778→    (reduce (fn [_ item]
   779→              (if (contains? big item)
   780→                (reduced true)
   781→                false))
   782→            false
   783→            small)))
   784→
   785→(defn like-parts
   786→  "Splits the like pattern into parts, quoting strings
   787→  (like-parts \"%hello%\")
   788→  -> [^ .* quoted-string<hello> .* $]"
   789→  [pattern]
   790→  (loop [pattern pattern
   791→         s (StringBuilder.)
   792→         parts (transient ["^"])]
   793→    (if (not (seq pattern))
   794→      (cond-> parts
   795→        (pos? (count s)) (conj! (Pattern/quote (.toString s)))
   796→        true (conj! "$")
   797→        true (persistent!))
   798→      (case (first pattern)
   799→        \_ (recur (rest pattern)
   800→                  (StringBuilder.)
   801→                  (cond-> parts
   802→                    (pos? (count s)) (conj! (Pattern/quote (.toString s)))
   803→                    true (conj! ".")))
   804→        \% (recur (rest pattern)
   805→                  (StringBuilder.)
   806→                  (cond-> parts
   807→                    (pos? (count s)) (conj! (Pattern/quote (.toString s)))
   808→                    true (conj! ".*")))
   809→        (recur (rest pattern)
   810→               (.append s (first pattern))
   811→               parts)))))
   812→
   813→(defn like-pattern
   814→  "Creates a regex pattern for a like pattern, taking into account
   815→   case insensitivity."
   816→  [case-insensitive? pattern]
   817→  (let [parts (like-parts pattern)]
   818→    (Pattern/compile (string/join "" parts)
   819→                     (if case-insensitive?
   820→                       Pattern/CASE_INSENSITIVE
   821→                       0))))
   822→
   823→(defn make-like-match? [case-insensitive? text pattern]
   824→  (let [regex-pattern (like-pattern case-insensitive? pattern)]
   825→    (re-matches regex-pattern text)))
   826→
   827→(def like-match?
   828→  (partial make-like-match? false))
   829→
   830→(def ilike-match?
   831→  (partial make-like-match? true))
   832→
   833→(defn instant-gt [^Instant a ^Instant b]
   834→  (.isAfter a b))
   835→
   836→(defn instant-gte [^Instant a ^Instant b]
   837→  (or (.equals a b)
   838→      (.isAfter a b)))
   839→
   840→(defn instant-lt [^Instant a ^Instant b]
   841→  (.isBefore a b))
   842→
   843→(defn instant-lte [^Instant a ^Instant b]
   844→  (or (.equals a b)
   845→      (.isBefore a b)))
   846→
   847→(defn string-gt [^String a ^String b]
   848→  (pos? (.compareTo a b)))
   849→
   850→(defn string-gte [^String a ^String b]
   851→  (<= 0 (.compareTo a b)))
   852→
   853→(defn string-lt [^String a ^String b]
   854→  (neg? (.compareTo a b)))
   855→
   856→(defn string-lte [^String a ^String b]
   857→  (>= 0 (.compareTo a b)))
   858→
   859→(defn bool-gt [^Boolean a ^Boolean b]
   860→  (pos? (.compareTo a b)))
   861→
   862→(defn bool-gte [^Boolean a ^Boolean b]
   863→  (<= 0 (.compareTo a b)))
   864→
   865→(defn bool-lt [^Boolean a ^Boolean b]
   866→  (neg? (.compareTo a b)))
   867→
   868→(defn bool-lte [^Boolean a ^Boolean b]
   869→  (>= 0 (.compareTo a b)))
   870→
   871→(defn match-nil
   872→  "nil is always the smallest value and the comparator value can't be nil"
   873→  [op]
   874→  (case op
   875→    :$gt false
   876→    :$gte false
   877→    :$lt true
   878→    :$lte true
   879→    :$like false
   880→    :$ilike false))
   881→
   882→(defn- match-topic-part? [iv-part dq-part]
   883→  (cond
   884→    (keyword? iv-part)
   885→    (= iv-part dq-part)
   886→
   887→    (or (symbol? dq-part) (symbol? iv-part))
   888→    true
   889→
   890→    (set? dq-part)
   891→    (intersects? iv-part dq-part)
   892→
   893→    (map? dq-part)
   894→    (if-some [{:keys [op value data-type]} (:$comparator dq-part)]
   895→      (let [f (case data-type
   896→                :number (case op
   897→                          :$gt >
   898→                          :$gte >=
   899→                          :$lt <
   900→                          :$lte <=)
   901→                :boolean (case op
   902→                           :$gt bool-gt
   903→                           :$gte bool-gte
   904→                           :$lt bool-lt
   905→                           :$lte bool-lte)
   906→                :string (case op
   907→                          :$gt string-gt
   908→                          :$gte string-gte
   909→                          :$lt string-lt
   910→                          :$lte string-lte
   911→                          :$like like-match?
   912→                          :$ilike ilike-match?)
   913→                :date (case op
   914→                        :$gt instant-gt
   915→                        :$gte instant-gte
   916→                        :$lt instant-lt
   917→                        :$lte instant-lte))]
   918→        (ucoll/exists? (fn [v]
   919→                         (if (nil? v)
   920→                           (match-nil op)
   921→                           (f v value)))
   922→                       iv-part))
   923→      (when (contains? dq-part :$not)
   924→        (let [not-val (:$not dq-part)]
   925→          (ucoll/exists? (partial not= not-val) iv-part))))))
   926→
   927→(defn match-topic?
   928→  [[iv-idx iv-e iv-a iv-v]
   929→   [dq-idx dq-e dq-a dq-v]]
   930→  (and
   931→   (match-topic-part? iv-idx dq-idx)
   932→   (match-topic-part? iv-e   dq-e)
   933→   (match-topic-part? iv-a   dq-a)
   934→   (match-topic-part? iv-v   dq-v)))
   935→
   936→(defn matching-topic-intersection? [iv-topics dq-topics]
   937→  (ucoll/seek
   938→   (fn [iv-topic]
   939→     (ucoll/seek
   940→      (fn [dq-topic]
   941→        (match-topic? iv-topic dq-topic))
   942→      dq-topics))
   943→   iv-topics))
   944→
   945→(defn- mark-instaql-queries-stale-tx-data
   946→  "Should be used in a db.fn/call. Returns transactions.
   947→   Marks instaql-queries that have subscriptions that reference the datalog
   948→   query stale."
   949→  [db datalog-query-eids]
   950→  (for [datalog-query-eid datalog-query-eids
   951→        sub-datom         (d/datoms db :avet :subscription/datalog-query datalog-query-eid)
   952→        :let [sub-eid             (:e sub-datom)
   953→              instaql-query-datom (d/find-datom db :eavt sub-eid :subscription/instaql-query)
   954→              instaql-query-eid   (:v instaql-query-datom)]
   955→        :when instaql-query-eid]
   956→    [:db/add instaql-query-eid :instaql-query/stale? true]))
   957→
   958→(defn- set-tx-id
   959→  "Should be used in a db.fn/call. Returns transactions.
   960→   Sets the processed-tx-id to the max of the given value and current value."
   961→  [db app-id tx-id]
   962→  (if-some [current (:tx-meta/processed-tx-id (d/entity db [:tx-meta/app-id app-id]))]
   963→    [{:tx-meta/app-id app-id
   964→      :tx-meta/processed-tx-id (max current tx-id)}]
   965→    [{:tx-meta/app-id app-id
   966→      :tx-meta/processed-tx-id tx-id}]))
   967→
   968→(defn- mark-datalog-queries-stale!
   969→  "Stale-ing a datalog query has the following side-effects:
   970→   1. Removes the datalog query from the datalog-cache
   971→   2. Marks associated instaql entries as stale
   972→   3. Updates store's latest processed tx-id for the app-id"
   973→  [conn app-id tx-id datalog-query-eids]
   974→  (transact!
   975→   "store/mark-datalog-queries-stale!"
   976→   conn
   977→   (concat
   978→    [[:db.fn/call set-tx-id app-id tx-id]
   979→     [:db.fn/call mark-instaql-queries-stale-tx-data datalog-query-eids]]
   980→    (for [e datalog-query-eids]
   981→      [:db.fn/retractEntity e]))))
   982→
   983→;; ----------
   984→;; Topic Trie
   985→
   986→(def empty-topic-trie
   987→  {:children {}
   988→   :wildcard nil
   989→   :topics ()})
   990→
   991→(def ^:private topic-trie-order
   992→  "Topic structure: [idx e a v]
   993→
   994→  Our traversal order: idx -> a -> e -> v.
   995→
   996→  Reasoning: most selective parts first."
   997→  [0 2 1 3])
   998→
   999→(defn- topic->ordered-parts [topic]
  1000→  (map #(nth topic %) topic-trie-order))
  1001→
  1002→(defn- topic-part->trie-keys [part]
  1003→  (if-not (set? part)
  1004→    [:wildcard]
  1005→    part))
  1006→
  1007→(defn- insert-topic-into-trie [trie topic]
  1008→  (letfn [(step [node [part & rest-parts]]
  1009→            (let [ks (topic-part->trie-keys part)]
  1010→              (reduce
  1011→               (fn [n k]
  1012→                 (let [child-path (if (= k :wildcard)
  1013→                                    [:wildcard]
  1014→                                    [:children k])
  1015→                       child (get-in n child-path empty-topic-trie)
  1016→                       child' (if (seq rest-parts)
  1017→                                (step child rest-parts)
  1018→                                (update child :topics conj topic))]
  1019→                   (assoc-in n child-path child')))
  1020→               node
  1021→               ks)))]
  1022→    (step trie (topic->ordered-parts topic))))
  1023→
  1024→(defn- topics->topic-trie [topics]
  1025→  (reduce insert-topic-into-trie empty-topic-trie topics))
  1026→
  1027→(defn- topic-trie-next-nodes [node part]
  1028→  (let [{:keys [children wildcard]} (or node {})
  1029→        children (or children {})
  1030→        base (cond-> [] wildcard (conj wildcard))]
  1031→    (if-not (set? part)
  1032→      (into base (vals children))
  1033→      (if (< (count children) (count part))
  1034→        (into base (keep (fn [[k v]] (when (contains? part k) v)) children))
  1035→        (into base (keep children part))))))
  1036→
  1037→(defn- topic-trie-match? [trie topic]
  1038→  (letfn [(step [node [part & rest-parts]]
  1039→            (let [candidates (topic-trie-next-nodes node part)]
  1040→              (if (empty? rest-parts)
  1041→                (ucoll/seek
  1042→                 (fn [child]
  1043→                   (ucoll/seek
  1044→                    (fn [iv-topic] (match-topic? iv-topic topic))
  1045→                    (:topics child)))
  1046→                 candidates)
  1047→                (ucoll/seek #(step % rest-parts) candidates))))]
  1048→    (step trie (topic->ordered-parts topic))))
  1049→
  1050→(defn matching-topic-intersection-trie? [iv-topic-trie dq-topics]
  1051→  (ucoll/seek
  1052→   (fn [dq-topic]
  1053→     (topic-trie-match? iv-topic-trie dq-topic))
  1054→   dq-topics))
  1055→
  1056→(defn- get-datalog-queries-for-topics-v3 [db app-id iv-topics]
  1057→  (let [iv-topic-trie (topics->topic-trie iv-topics)]
  1058→    (vec (for [datom (d/datoms db :avet :datalog-query/app-id app-id)
  1059→               :let [dq-topics (:datalog-query/topics (d/entity db (:e datom)))]
  1060→               :when dq-topics
  1061→               :when (matching-topic-intersection-trie? iv-topic-trie dq-topics)]
  1062→           (:e datom)))))
  1063→
  1064→;; ----------
  1065→;; Topic Index based on attribute values
  1066→
  1067→(defn- topics->topic-index
  1068→  "Given a list of topics, returns an index for attribute values
  1069→  i.e:
  1070→  [#{:ea} _ {uid1} _]
  1071→  [#{:ea} _ _ v1]
  1072→
  1073→  Would produce the index:
  1074→
  1075→  {uid1 #{[#{:ea} _ {uid1} _]}
  1076→
  1077→   :catchall #{[#{:ea} _ _ v1]}
  1078→
  1079→   :all #{[#{:ea} _ {uid1} _]
  1080→          [#{:ea} _ _ v1]}}
  1081→
  1082→  This helps us quickly prune topics when trying to do a match."
  1083→  [topics]
  1084→  (reduce
  1085→   (fn [acc [_idx _e a :as topic]]
  1086→     (let [acc (update acc :all conj topic)]
  1087→       (if-not (set? a)
  1088→         (update acc :catchall conj topic)
  1089→         (reduce
  1090→          (fn [acc' a-val]
  1091→            (update acc' a-val (fnil conj ()) topic))
  1092→          acc
  1093→          a))))
  1094→   {:catchall ()
  1095→    :all ()}
  1096→   topics))
  1097→
  1098→(defn- topic-index-candidates
  1099→  [iv-topic-index [_idx _e a :as _topic]]
  1100→  (if-not (set? a)
  1101→    (get iv-topic-index :all ())
  1102→    (concat (get iv-topic-index :catchall ())
  1103→            (mapcat iv-topic-index a))))
  1104→
  1105→(defn matching-topic-intersection-indexed? [iv-topic-a-index dq-topics]
  1106→  (ucoll/seek
  1107→   (fn [dq-topic]
  1108→     (let [iv-candidates (topic-index-candidates iv-topic-a-index dq-topic)]
  1109→       (ucoll/seek
  1110→        (fn [iv-topic]
  1111→          (match-topic? iv-topic dq-topic))
  1112→        iv-candidates)))
  1113→   dq-topics))
  1114→
  1115→(defn- get-datalog-queries-for-topics-v2 [db app-id iv-topics]
  1116→  (let [iv-topic-index (topics->topic-index iv-topics)]
  1117→    (vec (for [datom (d/datoms db :avet :datalog-query/app-id app-id)
  1118→               :let [dq-topics (:datalog-query/topics (d/entity db (:e datom)))]
  1119→               :when dq-topics
  1120→               :when (matching-topic-intersection-indexed? iv-topic-index dq-topics)]
  1121→           (:e datom)))))
  1122→
  1123→(defn- get-datalog-queries-for-topics [db app-id iv-topics]
  1124→  (for [datom (d/datoms db :avet :datalog-query/app-id app-id)
  1125→        :let [dq-topics (:datalog-query/topics (d/entity db (:e datom)))]
  1126→        :when dq-topics
  1127→        :when (matching-topic-intersection? iv-topics dq-topics)]
  1128→    (:e datom)))
  1129→
  1130→(defn get-stale-sync-subs [store app-id iv-topics]
  1131→  (let [db @(app-conn store app-id)]
  1132→    (for [datom (d/datoms db :avet :sync/id)
  1133→          :let [ent (d/entity db (:e datom))
  1134→                ;; Wait until initialization has finished
  1135→                sent-tx-id (:sync/sent-tx-id ent)
  1136→                topics (:sync/topics ent)]
  1137→          :when (and sent-tx-id topics (matching-topic-intersection? iv-topics topics))]
  1138→      ent)))
  1139→
  1140→(defn hard-coded-should-remove-query? [app-id db iv-topics eid]
  1141→  (when-let [q (some->> (d/datoms db :avet :subscription/datalog-query eid)
  1142→                        first
  1143→                        :e
  1144→                        (d/entity db)
  1145→                        :subscription/instaql-query)]
  1146→    (when (= (:instaql-query/forms-hash q)
  1147→             889158316)
  1148→      (let [wid (some-> q
  1149→                        :instaql-query/query
  1150→                        :edenItem
  1151→                        :$
  1152→                        :where
  1153→                        :workspaceId)
  1154→            deleted-nil? (some-> q
  1155→                                 :instaql-query/query
  1156→                                 :edenItem
  1157→                                 :$
  1158→                                 :where
  1159→                                 :deleted
  1160→                                 :$isNull)
  1161→            type (some-> q
  1162→                         :instaql-query/query
  1163→                         :edenItem
  1164→                         :$
  1165→                         :where
  1166→                         :type)]
  1167→        (when (and wid deleted-nil? type)
  1168→          (let [attrs (attr-model/get-by-app-id app-id)
  1169→                waid (:id (attr-model/seek-by-fwd-ident-name ["edenItem" "workspaceId"] attrs))
  1170→                deleted-aid (:id (attr-model/seek-by-fwd-ident-name ["edenItem" "deleted"] attrs))
  1171→                type-aid (:id (attr-model/seek-by-fwd-ident-name ["edenItem" "type"] attrs))
  1172→                creates (reduce (fn [acc [_idx e a v]]
  1173→                                  (let [e (first e)
  1174→                                        a (first a)]
  1175→                                    (if (or (= a waid)
  1176→                                            (= a deleted-aid)
  1177→                                            (= a type-aid))
  1178→                                      (if (not= 1 (count v))
  1179→                                        ;; We got an update, so we'll just bail out
  1180→                                        (reduced nil)
  1181→                                        (assoc-in acc [e a] (first v)))
  1182→                                      acc)))
  1183→                                {}
  1184→                                iv-topics)]
  1185→            (when creates
  1186→              (not (some (fn [[_e ent]]
  1187→                           (and (= (get ent waid) wid)
  1188→                                (= deleted-nil? (nil? (get ent deleted-aid)))
  1189→                                (= (get ent type-aid) type)))
  1190→                         creates)))))))))
  1191→
  1192→(defn instaql-query-ent-for-datalog-query-eid [db eid]
  1193→  (->> (d/find-datom db :avet :subscription/datalog-query eid)
  1194→       :e
  1195→       (d/entity db)
  1196→       :subscription/instaql-query))
  1197→
  1198→(defn instaql-topic-matching-item [{:keys [program]} entities]
  1199→  (reduce-kv
  1200→   (fn [_ etype by-eid]
  1201→     (when-let [found (reduce-kv
  1202→                       (fn [_ _eid attrs]
  1203→                         (let [item {:etype etype
  1204→                                     :attrs attrs}]
  1205→                           (if (program item)
  1206→                             (reduced item)
  1207→                             nil)))
  1208→                       nil
  1209→                       by-eid)]
  1210→       (reduced found)))
  1211→   nil
  1212→   entities))
  1213→
  1214→(defn instaql-topic-should-remove-query? [app-id db wal-record eid]
  1215→  (try
  1216→    (when (or (seq (:messages wal-record))
  1217→              (seq (:wal-logs wal-record)))
  1218→      (when-let [iql-topic (-> (instaql-query-ent-for-datalog-query-eid db eid)
  1219→                               :instaql-query/topic)]
  1220→        (let [entities-after (topics/extract-entities-after wal-record)]
  1221→          (and (not (instaql-topic-matching-item iql-topic entities-after))
  1222→               (let [entities-before (topics/extract-entities-before (attr-model/get-by-app-id app-id)
  1223→                                                                     entities-after
  1224→                                                                     wal-record)]
  1225→                 (not (instaql-topic-matching-item iql-topic entities-before)))))))
  1226→    (catch Throwable t
  1227→      (tracer/record-exception-span! t {:name "instaql-topic-should-remove-query?-error"}))))
  1228→
  1229→(defn filter-queries [app-id db iv-topics wal-record query-ids]
  1230→  (if-not (flags/toggled? :filter-query)
  1231→    query-ids
  1232→    (let [iql-topic-remove
  1233→          (remove (fn [eid]
  1234→                    (instaql-topic-should-remove-query? app-id db wal-record eid))
  1235→                  query-ids)
  1236→          hardcoded-remove
  1237→          (remove (fn [eid]
  1238→                    (hard-coded-should-remove-query? app-id db iv-topics eid))
  1239→                  iql-topic-remove)]
  1240→      (tracer/record-info! {:name "store/filter-queries-summary"
  1241→                            :attributes {:app-id app-id
  1242→                                         :wal-log-enabled (flags/enable-wal-entity-log? app-id)
  1243→                                         :iv-topics-count (count iv-topics)
  1244→                                         :initial-count (count query-ids)
  1245→                                         :iq-topic-removed (- (count query-ids) (count iql-topic-remove))
  1246→                                         :hardcode-removed (- (count iql-topic-remove) (count hardcoded-remove))}})
  1247→      hardcoded-remove)))

  1249→(defn mark-stale-topics!
  1250→  "Given topics, invalidates all relevant datalog qs and associated instaql queries.
  1251→
  1252→  Returns affected session-ids"
  1253→  [store app-id tx-id topics wal-record]
  1254→  (let [conn (app-conn store app-id)
  1255→        db @conn
  1256→        datalog-query-eids
  1257→        (vec (filter-queries app-id
  1258→                             db
  1259→                             topics
  1260→                             wal-record
  1261→                             (cond
  1262→                               (flags/use-get-datalog-queries-for-topics-v3?)
  1263→                               (get-datalog-queries-for-topics-v3 db app-id topics)
  1264→
  1265→                               (flags/use-get-datalog-queries-for-topics-v2?)
  1266→                               (get-datalog-queries-for-topics-v2 db app-id topics)
  1267→
  1268→                               :else
  1269→                               (vec (get-datalog-queries-for-topics db app-id topics)))))
  1270→
  1271→        report
  1272→        (mark-datalog-queries-stale! conn app-id tx-id datalog-query-eids)
  1273→
  1274→        session-ids (d/q '[:find [?session-id ...]
  1275→                           :in   $ [?datalog-query ...]
  1276→                           :where
  1277→                           [?e :subscription/datalog-query ?datalog-query]
  1278→                           [?e :subscription/session-id ?session-id]]
  1279→                         (:db-before report)
  1280→                         datalog-query-eids)]
  1281→    session-ids))

  1317→(defn sync-query-resync [store app-id sess-id subscription-id tx-id topics]
  1318→  (let [conn (app-conn store app-id)
  1319→        lookup [:sync/id subscription-id]

  1324→                                   (let [{:db/keys [id]} (d/entity db lookup)]
  1325→                                     (if id
  1326→                                       [[:db/add id :sync/session-id sess-id]
  1327→                                        [:db/add id :sync/topics topics]

  1329→                                       [{:db/id -1

  1344→;; This serves as a placeholder for storing transaction data durably
  1345→;; Right now it's just stored in memory, but we will want to have it
  1346→;; live somewhere permanent (probably a combination of db + s3/google storage)
  1347→(defonce sync-table-txes (atom PersistentQueue/EMPTY))

  1349→(defn add-transaction-to-sync-table-txes [wal-record]
  1350→  (swap! sync-table-txes (fn [txes]
  1351→                           (let [res (conj txes wal-record)]
  1352→                             (if (> (count res) 10000)
  1353→                               (pop res)
  1354→                               res)))))

  1356→(defn sync-query-changes-for-wal-record [wal-record topics]
  1357→  (reduce (fn [acc {:keys [action identity columns] :as record}]
  1358→            (if (matching-topic-intersection? (topics/topics-for-change record)
  1359→                                              topics)
  1360→              (case action
  1361→                :update (-> acc
  1362→                            (conj {:action :removed
  1363→                                   :triple (topics/columns->triple identity)})
  1364→                            (conj {:action :added
  1365→                                   :triple (topics/columns->triple columns)}))
  1366→                :delete (conj acc {:action :removed
  1367→                                   :triple (topics/columns->triple identity)})
  1368→                :insert (conj acc {:action :added
  1369→                                   :triple (topics/columns->triple columns)}))
  1370→              acc))
  1371→          []
  1372→          (:triple-changes wal-record)))
  1373→
  1374→(defn sync-query-unread-txes [app-id sync-ent]
  1375→  (let [{:sync/keys [topics sent-tx-id]} sync-ent]
  1376→    (keep (fn [wal-record]
  1377→            (when (and (= app-id (:app-id wal-record))
  1378→                       (< sent-tx-id (:tx-id wal-record)))
  1379→              (let [changes (sync-query-changes-for-wal-record wal-record topics)]
  1380→                (when (seq changes)
  1381→                  {:tx-id (:tx-id wal-record)
  1382→                   :changes changes}))))
  1383→          @sync-table-txes)))

  1388→(defn send-event! [store app-id sess-id event]
  1389→  (let [socket (:session/socket (session store sess-id))
  1390→        event (assoc event :trace-id (tracer/current-trace-id))]
  1391→    (when-not socket
  1392→      (ex/throw-socket-missing! sess-id))
  1393→    (when-let [sse-conn (:sse-conn socket)]
  1394→      (try
  1395→        (sse/send-json! app-id event {:conn sse-conn})
  1396→        (catch java.io.IOException e
  1397→          (ex/throw-socket-error! sess-id e))))
  1398→    (when-let [ws-conn (:ws-conn socket)]
  1399→      (try
  1400→        (ws/send-json! app-id event ws-conn)
  1401→        (catch java.io.IOException e
  1402→          (ex/throw-socket-error! sess-id e))))))
  1403→
  1404→(defn try-send-event!
  1405→  "Does a best-effort send. If it fails, we record and swallow the exception"
  1406→  [store app-id sess-id event]
  1407→  (try
  1408→    (send-event! store app-id sess-id event)
  1409→    (catch Exception e
  1410→      (tracer/with-span! {:name "rs/try-send-event-swallowed-err"}
  1411→        (tracer/record-exception-span!
  1412→         e
  1413→         {:name "rs/try-send-event-err"
  1414→          :attributes {:event (str event)
  1415→                       :escaping? false}})))))

    78→    (:delete-attr :restore-attr)

    86→     :aid       second

   135→(defn coerce-attr-args [[action args :as tx-step]]
   136→  (if (#{:add-attr :update-attr} action)
   137→    [action (-> args
   138→                (coll/update-in-when [:value-type] keyword)
   139→                (coll/update-in-when [:cardinality] keyword))]
   140→    tx-step))

   142→(defn coerce-opts [tx-step]

   146→(defn coerce!

   158→     (let [action-idx 0]

   161→           coerce-attr-args
   162→           coerce-opts
   163→           uuid/walk-uuids)))

   194→         [{:message (format "Invalid entity ID '%s'. Entity IDs must be UUIDs. Use id() or lookup() to generate a valid UUID." e)
   195→           :in [idx 1]}]))
   196→
   197→      (when (triple-model/eid-lookup-ref? e)
   198→        (throw-on-invalid-id-lookup! attrs tx-step [idx 1] e))
   199→
   200→      (when (triple-model/value-lookup-ref? v)
   201→        (throw-on-invalid-id-lookup! attrs tx-step [idx 3] v)))))
   202→
   203→(defn validate! [ctx tx-steps]
   204→  (let [valid? (s/valid? ::tx-steps tx-steps)]
   205→    (check-for-invalid-entity-ids! (:attrs ctx) tx-steps)
   206→    (when-not valid?
   207→      ;; Fall back to generic spec error
   208→      (ex/throw-validation-err!
   209→       :tx-steps
   210→       tx-steps
   211→       (ex/explain->validation-errors
   212→        (s/explain-data ::tx-steps tx-steps))))))
   213→

   216→

   218→  (gen/generate (s/gen ::tx-steps)))

   220→(defn prevent-system-catalog-updates! [app-id opts]
   221→  (when (and (= app-id system-catalog-app-id)
   222→             (not (:allow-system-catalog-updates? opts)))
   223→    (ex/throw-validation-err!
   224→     :app
   225→     app-id
   226→     [{:message (format "You can't make updates to this app.")}])))

   228→(defn resolve-lookups
   229→  "Given [[attr-id value] [attr-id value] ...],
   230→   returns {[attr-id value] eid,
   231→            [attr-id value] eid,
   232→            ...}"
   233→  [conn app-id lookups]
   234→  (if (empty? lookups)
   235→    {}
   236→    (let [lookups (map (fn [[a v]] [a (->json v)]) lookups)
   237→          query   {:with [[[:lookups {:columns [:attr_id :value]}]
   238→                           {:values lookups}]]
   239→                   :from :triples
   240→                   :where [:= :app_id app-id]
   241→                   :join [:lookups
   242→                          [:and
   243→                           :triples.av
   244→                           [:= :triples.attr_id :lookups.attr_id]
   245→                           [:= :triples.value [:cast :lookups.value :jsonb]]]]
   246→                   :select [:triples.attr_id :triples.value :triples.entity_id]}
   247→          results (sql/do-execute! conn (hsql/format query))]
   248→      (into {}
   249→            (for [{:triples/keys [attr_id value entity_id]} results]
   250→              [[attr_id value] entity_id])))))
   251→
   252→(comment
   253→  (resolve-lookups
   254→   (aurora/conn-pool :read)
   255→   #uuid "92cb730c-8b4f-46ef-9925-4fab953694c6"
   256→   [[#uuid "20b65ea3-faad-4e80-863e-87468ff7792f" "joe@instantdb.com"]
   257→    [#uuid "6a089759-2a2f-4898-9bb8-a7bc9f6f791a" "stopa"]]))
   258→
   259→(defn resolve-etypes
   260→  "Given [id id id], returns map of {id [etype etype ...], ...}"
   261→  [conn app-id entity-ids]
   262→  (if (empty? entity-ids)
   263→    {}
   264→    (let [query {:from            :triples
   265→                 :join            [:attrs [:= :triples.attr_id :attrs.id]
   266→                                   :idents [:= :attrs.forward_ident :idents.id]]
   267→                 :where           [:and
   268→                                   [:= :triples.app_id app-id]
   269→                                   [:in :triples.entity_id entity-ids]]
   270→                 :select-distinct [:triples.entity_id :idents.etype]}
   271→          res (sql/do-execute! conn (hsql/format query))]
   272→      (coll/group-by-to :triples/entity_id :idents/etype res))))
   273→
   274→(comment
   275→  (resolve-etypes
   276→   (aurora/conn-pool :read)
   277→   #uuid "0e563ace-d25f-44f6-ae00-4e6b9b6d1b2e"
   278→   [#uuid "4d39508b-9ee2-48a3-b70d-8192d9c5a059"
   279→    #uuid "005a8767-c0e7-4158-bb9a-62ce1a5858ed"
   280→    #uuid "005b08a1-4046-4fba-b1d1-a78b0628901c"]))
   281→
   282→(defn validate-mode [conn app-id tx-step-maps]
   283→  (let [tx-step-maps (filter #(#{:add-triple :deep-merge-triple} (:op %)) tx-step-maps)
   284→        create-steps (filter #(= :create (:mode (:opts %))) tx-step-maps)
   285→        update-steps (filter #(= :update (:mode (:opts %))) tx-step-maps)
   286→        eid+etypes   (into #{}
   287→                           (keep (fn [{:keys [eid etype]}]
   288→                                   (when (uuid? eid)
   289→                                     [eid etype])))
   290→                           (concat create-steps update-steps))
   291→        lookups      (into #{}
   292→                           (keep (fn [{:keys [eid]}]
   293→                                   (when (triple-model/eid-lookup-ref? eid)
   294→                                     eid)))
   295→                           (concat create-steps update-steps))]
   296→    (when (or (seq eid+etypes) (seq lookups))
   297→      (tracer/with-span! {:name "transaction/validate-mode"
   298→                          :attributes {:app-id app-id}}
   299→        (let [query    "WITH eid_etypes AS (
   300→                          SELECT CAST(elem ->> 0 AS UUID) AS id,
   301→                                 CAST(elem ->> 1 AS TEXT) as etype
   302→                          FROM JSONB_ARRAY_ELEMENTS(CAST(?eid+etypes AS JSONB)) AS elem
   303→                        ),
   304→                        check_eids AS (
   305→                          SELECT DISTINCT eid_etypes.id, eid_etypes.etype, triples.entity_id
   306→                          FROM eid_etypes
   307→                          LEFT JOIN triples
   308→                                 ON triples.app_id = ?app-id
   309→                                AND triples.entity_id = eid_etypes.id
   310→                          LEFT JOIN attrs
   311→                                 ON triples.attr_id = attrs.id
   312→                          WHERE attrs.etype = eid_etypes.etype
   313→                        ),
   314→                        lookups AS (
   315→                          SELECT CAST(elem ->> 0 AS uuid) AS attr_id,
   316→                                 CAST(elem ->> 1 AS jsonb) AS value
   317→                          FROM JSONB_ARRAY_ELEMENTS(CAST(?lookups AS JSONB)) AS elem
   318→                        ),
   319→                        check_lookups AS (
   320→                          SELECT DISTINCT lookups.attr_id, lookups.value, triples.entity_id
   321→                          FROM lookups
   322→                          LEFT JOIN triples
   323→                                 ON app_id = ?app-id
   324→                                AND triples.av
   325→                                AND lookups.attr_id = triples.attr_id
   326→                                AND lookups.value = triples.value
   327→                        )
   328→                        SELECT id, etype, NULL AS attr_id, NULL AS value, entity_id
   329→                        FROM check_eids
   330→                        UNION
   331→                        SELECT NULL as id, NULL as etype, attr_id, value, entity_id
   332→                        FROM check_lookups"
   333→              params   {"?eid+etypes" (->json eid+etypes)
   334→                        "?lookups"    (->json (map (fn [[a v]] [a (->json v)]) lookups))
   335→                        "?app-id"     app-id}
   336→              resolved (->> (sql/select ::validate-mode conn (sql/format query params))
   337→                            (map (fn [{:keys [id attr_id value entity_id]}]
   338→                                   [(or id [attr_id value]) entity_id]))
   339→                            (into {}))]
   340→
   341→          ;; check create over existing entities
   342→          (when-some [existing (->> create-steps
   343→                                    (filter (fn [{:keys [eid]}] (resolved eid)))
   344→                                    not-empty)]
   345→            (ex/throw-validation-err!
   346→             :tx-step
   347→             existing
   348→             [{:message (str "Creating entities that exist: " (string/join ", " (map :eid existing)))}]))
   349→
   350→          ;; check update over missing entities
   351→          (when-some [missing (->> update-steps
   352→                                   (filter (fn [{:keys [eid]}] (nil? (resolved eid))))
   353→                                   not-empty)]
   354→            (ex/throw-validation-err!
   355→             :tx-step
   356→             missing
   357→             [{:message (str "Updating entities that don't exist: " (string/join ", " (map :eid missing)))}])))))))
   358→
   359→(defn resolve-lookups-for-delete-entity [conn app-id tx-step-maps]
   360→  (let [[lookup-ref-deletes rest] (coll/split-by
   361→                                   #(and (= :delete-entity (:op %))
   362→                                         (triple-model/eid-lookup-ref? (:eid %)))
   363→                                   tx-step-maps)
   364→        lookup-refs               (map :eid lookup-ref-deletes)
   365→        resolved                  (resolve-lookups conn app-id lookup-refs)]
   366→    (concat
   367→     ;; Update rule-params ops to use resolved eids
   368→     (map (fn [tx-step]
   369→            (if (and (= :rule-params (:op tx-step))
   370→                     (get resolved (:eid tx-step)))
   371→              (assoc tx-step :eid (get resolved (:eid tx-step)))
   372→              tx-step))
   373→          rest)
   374→     (for [{:keys [eid] :as tx-step} lookup-ref-deletes
   375→           :let [eid' (get resolved eid)]
   376→           :when (uuid? eid')]
   377→       (assoc tx-step :eid eid')))))
   378→
   379→(defn resolve-etypes-for-delete-entity [conn app-id tx-step-maps]
   380→  (let [[untyped-deletes rest] (coll/split-by
   381→                                #(and (= :delete-entity (:op %))
   382→                                      (nil? (:etype %)))
   383→                                tx-step-maps)
   384→        untyped-ids (map :eid untyped-deletes)
   385→        resolved    (resolve-etypes conn app-id untyped-ids)]
   386→    (concat
   387→     rest
   388→     (for [{:keys [eid] :as tx-step} untyped-deletes
   389→           etype                     (get resolved eid [nil])]
   390→       (assoc tx-step :etype etype)))))
   391→
   392→(defn expand-delete-entity-cascade [conn app-id attrs tx-step-maps]
   393→  (let [ids+etypes (for [{:keys [op eid etype]} tx-step-maps
   394→                         :when  (and (= :delete-entity op)
   395→                                     (uuid? eid)
   396→                                     (some? etype))]
   397→                     [eid etype])]
   398→    (if (empty? ids+etypes)
   399→      tx-step-maps
   400→      (let [attrs+etypes
   401→            (->> attrs
   402→                 (filter #(= :ref (:value-type %)))
   403→                 (filter #(= :cascade (:on-delete %)))
   404→                 (mapv #(vector (:id %) (-> % :forward-identity second) (-> % :reverse-identity second))))
   405→
   406→            reverse-attrs+etypes
   407→            (->> attrs
   408→                 (filter #(= :ref (:value-type %)))
   409→                 (filter #(= :cascade (:on-delete-reverse %)))
   410→                 (mapv #(vector (:id %) (-> % :forward-identity second) (-> % :reverse-identity second))))
   411→
   412→            query+args
   413→            (sql/format
   414→             "WITH RECURSIVE
   415→
   416→              attrs_forward (id, forward_etype, reverse_etype) AS (
   417→                SELECT
   418→                  cast(elem ->> 0 AS uuid),
   419→                  cast(elem ->> 1 AS text),
   420→                  cast(elem ->> 2 AS text)
   421→                FROM
   422→                  jsonb_array_elements(cast(?attrs+etypes AS jsonb)) AS elem
   423→              ),
   424→
   425→              attrs_reverse (id, forward_etype, reverse_etype) AS (
   426→                SELECT
   427→                  cast(elem ->> 0 AS uuid),
   428→                  cast(elem ->> 1 AS text),
   429→                  cast(elem ->> 2 AS text)
   430→                FROM
   431→                  jsonb_array_elements(cast(?reverse-attrs+etypes AS jsonb)) AS elem
   432→              ),
   433→
   434→              entids (entity_id, etype, parent_id) AS (
   435→                -- Starting entities (the parents being deleted)
   436→                SELECT
   437→                  cast(elem ->> 0 AS uuid) as entity_id,
   438→                  cast(elem ->> 1 AS text) as etype,
   439→                  cast(elem ->> 0 AS uuid) as parent_id,  -- parent_id is itself for root entities
   440→                  cast(elem ->> 1 as text) as parent_etype -- parent_etype is itself for root entities
   441→                FROM
   442→                  jsonb_array_elements(cast(?ids+etypes AS jsonb)) AS elem
   443→
   444→                UNION
   445→
   446→                SELECT
   447→                  *
   448→                FROM (
   449→                  -- can't reference entids twice, but can bind it to entids_inner and then it's okay
   450→                  WITH entids_inner AS (
   451→                    SELECT
   452→                      entity_id,
   453→                      etype,
   454→                      parent_id,
   455→                      parent_etype
   456→                    FROM
   457→                      entids
   458→                  )
   459→
   460→                  -- follow forward refs → entid (cascaded children inherit parent_id)
   461→                  SELECT
   462→                    triples.entity_id AS entity_id,
   463→                    attrs_forward.forward_etype AS etype,
   464→                    entids_inner.parent_id AS parent_id,  -- inherit parent from the entity that triggered cascade
   465→                    entids_inner.parent_etype as parent_etype
   466→                  FROM
   467→                    entids_inner
   468→                  JOIN triples
   469→                    ON triples.app_id = ?app-id
   470→                  JOIN attrs_forward
   471→                    ON triples.attr_id = attrs_forward.id
   472→                  WHERE
   473→                    triples.vae
   474→                    AND entids_inner.entity_id = json_uuid_to_uuid(triples.value)
   475→                    AND entids_inner.etype = attrs_forward.reverse_etype
   476→
   477→                  UNION
   478→
   479→                  -- follow entid → reverse refs (cascaded children inherit parent_id)
   480→                  SELECT
   481→                    json_uuid_to_uuid(triples.value) AS entity_id,
   482→                    attrs_reverse.reverse_etype AS etype,
   483→                    entids_inner.parent_id AS parent_id,  -- inherit parent from the entity that triggered cascade
   484→                    entids_inner.parent_etype as parent_etype
   485→                  FROM
   486→                    entids_inner
   487→                  JOIN triples
   488→                    ON triples.app_id = ?app-id
   489→                    AND entids_inner.entity_id = triples.entity_id
   490→                  JOIN attrs_reverse
   491→                    ON triples.attr_id = attrs_reverse.id
   492→                  WHERE
   493→                    triples.eav
   494→                    AND entids_inner.etype = attrs_reverse.forward_etype
   495→                )
   496→              )
   497→
   498→              SELECT
   499→                entity_id, etype, parent_id, parent_etype
   500→              FROM
   501→                entids"
   502→             {"?app-id"               app-id
   503→              "?ids+etypes"           (->json ids+etypes)
   504→              "?attrs+etypes"         (->json attrs+etypes)
   505→              "?reverse-attrs+etypes" (->json reverse-attrs+etypes)})
   506→            res (sql/execute! conn query+args)
   507→            parent-id->rule-params (into {}
   508→                                         (for [{:keys [op eid value]} tx-step-maps
   509→                                               :when (and (= :rule-params op) (uuid? eid))]
   510→                                           [eid value]))
   511→            ;; Only get the cascaded entities (where parent_id != entity_id)
   512→            cascaded-entities (remove #(and (= (:parent_id %) (:entity_id %))
   513→                                            (= (:parent_etype %) (:etype %)))
   514→                                      res)]
   515→        (concat
   516→         tx-step-maps
   517→         ;; Add delete operations for cascaded entities only
   518→         (for [{:keys [entity_id etype]} cascaded-entities]
   519→           {:op :delete-entity
   520→            :eid entity_id
   521→            :etype etype})
   522→         ;; Add rule-params for cascaded entities that have a parent with rule-params
   523→         (for [{:keys [entity_id etype parent_id]} cascaded-entities
   524→               :let [rule-params (get parent-id->rule-params parent_id)]
   525→               :when rule-params]
   526→           {:op :rule-params
   527→            :eid entity_id
   528→            :etype etype
   529→            :value rule-params}))))))
   530→
   531→(defn validate-value-lookup-etypes
   532→  "Check that in the case of
   533→
   534→     [op eid fwd-attr [lookup-attr lookup-value]]
   535→
   536→   etype from reverse of fwd-attr matches etype from lookup-attr"
   537→  [attrs tx-step-maps]
   538→  (doseq [{:keys [op aid value] :as tx-step} tx-step-maps
   539→          :when (#{:add-triple :deep-merge-triple :retract-triple} op)
   540→          :let [rev-etype (attr-model/rev-etype (attr-model/seek-by-id aid attrs))]
   541→          :when (and rev-etype
   542→                     (triple-model/value-lookup-ref? value))
   543→          :let [[value-lookup-attr-id _] value
   544→                value-lookup-etype       (attr-model/fwd-etype (attr-model/seek-by-id value-lookup-attr-id attrs))]]
   545→    (when-not value-lookup-etype
   546→      (ex/throw-validation-err! :lookup value
   547→                                [{:message "Invalid lookup. Could not determine namespace from lookup attribute."
   548→                                  :tx-step tx-step}]))
   549→    (when (and rev-etype (not= value-lookup-etype rev-etype))
   550→      (ex/throw-validation-err! :tx-step tx-step
   551→                                [{:message (string-util/multiline->single-line
   552→                                            "Invalid transaction. The namespace in the lookup attribute is
   553→                                             different from the namespace of the attribute that is
   554→                                             being set")}])))
   555→  tx-step-maps)
   556→
   557→(defn get-attr-for-exception
   558→  "Used by exception.clj to lookup the attr by its attr id when it gets an attr id
   559→   in a sql exception."
   560→  [attrs attr-id]
   561→  (attr-model/seek-by-id attr-id attrs))
   562→
   563→(defn transact-without-tx-conn-impl! [conn attrs app-id tx-step-maps opts]
   564→  (binding [ex/*get-attr-for-exception* (partial get-attr-for-exception attrs)]
   565→    (let [tx-step-vecs     (map vectorize-tx-step tx-step-maps)
   566→          grouped-tx-steps (group-by first tx-step-vecs)]
   567→      (tracer/with-span! {:name "transaction/transact!"
   568→                          :attributes {:app-id app-id
   569→                                       :num-tx-steps (count tx-step-vecs)
   570→                                       :detailed-tx-steps (pr-str tx-step-vecs)}}
   571→        (prevent-system-catalog-updates! app-id opts)
   572→        (validate-mode conn app-id tx-step-maps)
   573→        ;; n.b. transaction-model/create! must be the first write to the db
   574→        ;;      or else the invalidator will miss the transaction.
   575→        (let [tx (transaction-model/create! conn {:app-id app-id})
   576→              results
   577→              (reduce-kv
   578→               (fn [acc op tx-steps]
   579→                 (cond
   580→                   (empty? tx-steps)
   581→                   acc
   582→
   583→                   (= :rule-params op)
   584→                   acc
   585→
   586→                   :else
   587→                   (assoc acc op
   588→                          (case op
   589→                            :add-attr
   590→                            (attr-model/insert-multi! conn app-id (map second tx-steps))
   591→
   592→                            :delete-attr
   593→                            (attr-model/soft-delete-multi! conn app-id (map second tx-steps))
   594→
   595→                            :restore-attr
   596→                            (attr-model/restore-multi! conn app-id (map second tx-steps))
   597→
   598→                            :update-attr
   599→                            (attr-model/update-multi! conn app-id (map second tx-steps))
   600→
   601→                            :delete-entity
   602→                            (triple-model/delete-entity-multi! conn app-id (map next tx-steps))
   603→
   604→                            :add-triple
   605→                            (triple-model/insert-multi! conn attrs app-id (map next tx-steps))
   606→
   607→                            :deep-merge-triple
   608→                            (triple-model/deep-merge-multi! conn attrs app-id (map next tx-steps))
   609→
   610→                            :retract-triple
   611→                            (triple-model/delete-multi! conn app-id (map next tx-steps))))))
   612→               {}
   613→               grouped-tx-steps)
   614→              eid+attr-ids (distinct
   615→                            (concat
   616→                             (:delete-entity results)
   617→                             (:add-triple results)
   618→                             (:deep-merge-triple results)
   619→                             (:retract-triple results)))
   620→              _  (triple-model/validate-required! conn attrs app-id eid+attr-ids)
   621→              updated-attrs (->> tx-step-maps
   622→                                 (filter #(= :update-attr (:op %)))
   623→                                 (map :value))
   624→              _  (attr-model/validate-update-required! conn app-id updated-attrs)]
   625→          (let [tx-created-at (Date/.toInstant (:created_at tx))]
   626→            (e2e-tracer/start-invalidator-tracking! {:tx-id (:id tx)
   627→                                                     :tx-created-at tx-created-at})
   628→            (e2e-tracer/invalidator-tracking-step! {:tx-id (:id tx)
   629→                                                    :tx-created-at tx-created-at
   630→                                                    :name "transact"}))
   631→          (assoc tx :results results))))))
   632→
   633→(defn- tx-step-op [tx-step]
   634→  (if (map? tx-step)
   635→    :add-triple
   636→    (first tx-step)))
   637→
   638→(defn tx-steps-order
   639→  "For backwards compatibility, we group steps by op but execute groups
   640→   in order they first appeared in tx-steps"
   641→  [tx-step-vecs]
   642→  (distinct (map tx-step-op tx-step-vecs)))
   643→
   644→(defn reorder-tx-steps
   645→  [ops-order tx-step-maps]
   646→  (let [groups (group-by :op tx-step-maps)]
   647→    (mapcat #(get groups %) ops-order)))
   648→
   649→(defn optimistic-attrs [attrs tx-step-vecs]
   650→  (->> tx-step-vecs
   651→       (reduce
   652→        (fn [acc tx-step]
   653→          (case (tx-step-op tx-step)
   654→            (:add-attr
   655→             :update-attr) (let [[_ value] tx-step]
   656→                             (assoc! acc (:id value) value))
   657→            :delete-attr   (let [[_ value] tx-step]
   658→                             (dissoc! acc value))
   659→            acc))
   660→        (transient (attr-model/map-by-id attrs)))
   661→       persistent!
   662→       vals
   663→       attr-model/wrap-attrs))
   664→
   665→(defn- expand-maps
   666→  "Lets you write sequence of :add-triple as a map. Will resolve attributes
   667→   to their ids. Map must contain :id and :etype keys.
   668→
   669→     (transact! [{:id    user-id
   670→                  :etype \"$users\"
   671→                  :email \"stopa@instantdb.com\"}])
   672→
   673→   is equivalent to
   674→
   675→     (let [attr-id (fn [label]
   676→                     (attr-model/resolve-attr-id attrs \"$users\" label))]
   677→       (transact! [[:add-triple user-id (attr-id :id) user-id]
   678→                   [:add-triple user-id (attr-id :email) \"stopa@instantdb.com\"]]))"
   679→  [attrs tx-step-vecs]
   680→  (for [tx-step tx-step-vecs
   681→        tx-step (if (map? tx-step)
   682→                  (let [{:keys [id etype]} tx-step]
   683→                    (for [[k v] tx-step
   684→                          :when (not= :etype k)
   685→                          :let  [attr-id (if (uuid? k)
   686→                                           k
   687→                                           (attr-model/resolve-attr-id attrs etype k))]]
   688→                      [:add-triple id attr-id v]))
   689→                  [tx-step])]
   690→    tx-step))
   691→
   692→(defn preprocess-tx-steps [conn attrs app-id tx-step-vecs]
   693→  (->> tx-step-vecs
   694→       (expand-maps attrs)
   695→       (mapify-tx-steps attrs)
   696→       (resolve-lookups-for-delete-entity conn app-id)
   697→       (resolve-etypes-for-delete-entity conn app-id)
   698→       (expand-delete-entity-cascade conn app-id attrs)))

   700→(defn transact-without-tx-conn! [conn attrs app-id tx-step-vecs opts]
   701→  (let [ops-order     (tx-steps-order tx-step-vecs)
   702→        attrs'        (optimistic-attrs attrs tx-step-vecs)
   703→        tx-step-maps  (->> tx-step-vecs
   704→                           (preprocess-tx-steps conn attrs' app-id)
   705→                           (reorder-tx-steps ops-order))]
   706→    (transact-without-tx-conn-impl! conn attrs' app-id tx-step-maps opts)))

   708→(defn transact!
   709→  ([conn attrs app-id tx-steps]
   710→   (transact! conn attrs app-id tx-steps {}))
   711→  ([conn attrs app-id tx-steps opts]
   712→   (next-jdbc/with-transaction [tx-conn conn]
   713→     (transact-without-tx-conn! tx-conn attrs app-id tx-steps opts))))

    44→(defn- validate-system-delete-entity! [{:keys [admin?]} {:keys [etype] :as tx-step}]

    49→                              admin?)]

    77→(defn prevent-system-column-updates
    78→  "What do we do if a user tries to run a `transact` and update a row 
    79→   in a system table? 
    80→
    81→   Here's what we do: 
    82→
    83→   There are _some_ system columns that we let users edit: 
    84→      
    85→      1. The $files 'path' attribute can be changed. 
    86→
    87→      2. The `id` attribute
    88→         
    89→         This is because the user may have their own columns defined, and 
    90→         are running a patch. The client _always_ sends an 
    91→         `id` triple as part of a patch.  
    92→
    93→  For the remaining columns: 
    94→
    95→  1. If the user is an admin, they can update system columns. 
    96→
    97→     *Note*: we special case $files, so _even admins can't update_ those columns. 
    98→     This is because $files includes information like `file size`, 
    99→     which only Instant can set."
   100→  [ctx tx-step-maps]
   101→  (doseq [{:keys [op etype] :as tx-step} tx-step-maps
   102→          :when (and etype (string/starts-with? etype "$"))
   103→          :when (#{:add-triple :deep-merge-triple :retract-triple :delete-entity} op)]
   104→    (if (= :delete-entity op)
   105→      (validate-system-delete-entity! ctx  tx-step)
   106→      (validate-system-triple-op! ctx tx-step))))

   116→                                  [{:message "Expected link value to be a uuid."
   117→                                    :hint {:tx-step (tx/vectorize-tx-step tx-step)}}]))

   138→(defn load-entities-map
   139→  "Takes tx-steps, fetches from DB map of
   140→
   141→     {{:eid :etype} -> <entity map>}"
   142→  [{:keys [datalog-query-fn attrs] :as ctx} tx-steps]
   143→  (let [eids+etypes (for [{:keys [eid etype value rev-etype]} tx-steps
   144→                          :when eid
   145→                          [eid etype] (if rev-etype
   146→                                        [[eid etype]
   147→                                         [value rev-etype]]
   148→                                        [[eid etype]])]
   149→                      {:eid eid :etype etype})]
   150→    (when (seq eids+etypes)
   151→      (let [query {:children
   152→                   {:pattern-groups
   153→                    (for [{:keys [eid etype]} eids+etypes]
   154→                      {:patterns
   155→                       [[:ea eid (attr-model/ea-ids-for-etype etype attrs)]]})}}
   156→            ;; you might be tempted to simplify the query to [[:ea (set eids)]]
   157→            ;; but the eid might be a lookup ref and you won't know how to get
   158→            ;; the join rows for that lookup
   159→            datalog-result (datalog-query-fn ctx query)]
   160→        (zipmap
   161→         eids+etypes
   162→         (for [data (:data datalog-result)
   163→               :let [rows    (:join-rows (:result data))
   164→                     triples (mapcat identity rows)]]
   165→           (when (seq triples)
   166→             (-> (entity-model/triples->map ctx triples)
   167→                 (assoc "id" (ffirst triples))))))))))

   199→(defn deep-merge-and-delete
   200→  "Applies a `merge()` patch to a record. Analogous to immutableDeepMerge in JS
   201→   and deep_merge in Postgres"
   202→  [orig updates]
   203→  (if (and (map? orig) (map? updates))
   204→    (reduce-kv
   205→     (fn [accum key updated-value]
   206→       (cond
   207→         (and (map? (get accum key))
   208→              (map? updated-value))
   209→         (assoc accum key (deep-merge-and-delete (get accum key) updated-value))
   210→
   211→         (nil? updated-value)
   212→         (dissoc accum key)
   213→
   214→         :else
   215→         (assoc accum key updated-value)))
   216→     orig
   217→     updates)
   218→    updates))

   221→  "Applies local tx-steps to entities in entities-map, producing entities

   223→  [{:keys [attrs]} entities-map tx-steps]

   238→            ;; apply tx-step

   246→
   247→                    :deep-merge-triple
   248→                    (ucoll/update! acc' key update label deep-merge-and-delete value)
   249→
   250→                    :retract-triple
   251→                    (ucoll/update! acc' key dissoc label)
   252→
   253→                    acc')]
   254→        acc''))
   255→    (transient entities-map)

   580→(defn run-checks!
   581→  "Runs checks, returning results (admin-check?) or throwing"
   582→  [ctx checks]
   583→  (let [checks (distinct checks)
   584→        ctx    (assoc ctx :preloaded-refs (cel/create-preloaded-refs-cache))
   585→        _      (doseq [check checks
   586→                       :let [{:keys [eid]} check]
   587→                       :when (lookup-ref? eid)]
   588→                 (ex/throw-validation-err! :lookup eid [{:message "Could not find the entity for this lookup"}]))
   589→        results (cel/eval-programs! ctx checks)]
   590→    (doall
   591→     (for [{:keys [scope etype result] :as check} results]
   592→       (do
   593→         (when-not (:admin-check? ctx)
   594→           (ex/assert-permitted! :perms-pass? [etype scope] result))
   595→         (-> check
   596→             (dissoc :result)
   597→             (assoc
   598→              :check-result result
   599→              :check-pass?  (boolean result))))))))

   601→(defn transact!
   602→  "Runs transactions alongside permission checks. The overall flow looks like this:
   603→
   604→   1. Take a list of tx-steps (add-attr, delete-attr, add-triple, etc)
   605→   2. Load existing triples that correspond to these steps from DB
   606→   3. Resolve lookup-refs where possible
   607→   4. Run update and delete checks
   608→   5. Transact tx-steps
   609→   6. Fetch new lookup-ref data for newly inserted data
   610→   7. Run create checks
   611→
   612→   We run `create` checks _after_ the transaction, so we can query off of the
   613→   object. For example, if we created a new `post`, we may want a check that says:
   614→   `auth.id in data.ref('creator.id')`"
   615→  [{:keys [db app-id admin? admin-check? admin-dry-run? attrs] :as ctx} tx-step-vecs]
   616→  (tracer/with-span! {:name "permissioned-transaction/transact!"
   617→                      :attributes {:app-id app-id
   618→                                   :transact-version "2"}}
   619→    (when (flags/rate-limit-tx-based-on-conn-pool?)
   620→      (let [^HikariDataSource pool (:conn-pool db)]
   621→        (when (instance? HikariDataSource pool)
   622→          (let [mx-bean (.getHikariPoolMXBean pool)
   623→                active (.getActiveConnections mx-bean)
   624→                total (.getTotalConnections mx-bean)
   625→                remaining-connections (- total active)
   626→                buffer (flags/rate-limit-tx-based-on-conn-pool-buffer)]
   627→            (when (> buffer remaining-connections)
   628→              (tracer/record-info! {:name "permissioned-transaction/transact-rate-limit"
   629→                                    :attributes {:app-id app-id
   630→                                                 :active-connections active
   631→                                                 :total-connections total}})
   632→
   633→              (ex/throw-rate-limited!))))))
   634→    (next-jdbc/with-transaction [tx-conn (:conn-pool db)]
   635→      (io/warn-io :permissioned-transact!
   636→        (let [ops-order        (tx/tx-steps-order tx-step-vecs)
   637→              optimistic-attrs (tx/optimistic-attrs attrs tx-step-vecs)
   638→              tx-step-maps     (io/expect-io
   639→                                (tx/preprocess-tx-steps tx-conn optimistic-attrs app-id tx-step-vecs))
   640→              ;; Use the db connection we have so that we don't cause a deadlock
   641→              ;; Also need to be able to read our own writes for the create checks
   642→              ctx              (assoc ctx
   643→                                      :db {:conn-pool tx-conn}
   644→                                      :attrs optimistic-attrs)]
   645→          (prevent-system-column-updates ctx tx-step-maps)
   646→          (if admin?
   647→            (let [tx-steps (tx/reorder-tx-steps ops-order tx-step-maps)]
   648→              (io/expect-io
   649→               (tx/transact-without-tx-conn-impl! tx-conn optimistic-attrs app-id tx-steps {})))
   650→            (let [;; pre-processing tx
   651→                  tx-step-maps         (->> tx-step-maps
   652→                                            (coerce-value-uuids ctx)
   653→                                            (validate-lookup-etypes ctx)
   654→                                            (tx/validate-value-lookup-etypes optimistic-attrs))
   655→                  ;; TODO somehow fetch update-delete data-ref dependencies in the same go
   656→                  entities-map         (io/expect-io
   657→                                        (load-entities-map ctx tx-step-maps))
   658→                  tx-step-maps         (resolve-lookups-tx-steps ctx entities-map tx-step-maps)
   659→                  entities-map         (resolve-lookups-entities-map ctx entities-map)
   660→                  updated-entities-map (update-entities-map ctx entities-map tx-step-maps)
   661→                  rule-params-map      (persistent!
   662→                                        (reduce
   663→                                         (fn [acc {:keys [op eid etype value]}]
   664→                                           (if (= :rule-params op)
   665→                                             (ucoll/update! acc {:eid eid :etype etype} merge value)
   666→                                             acc))
   667→                                         (transient {})
   668→                                         tx-step-maps))
   669→
   670→                  ;; pre checks
   671→                  pre-checks           (pre-checks ctx
   672→                                                   entities-map
   673→                                                   updated-entities-map
   674→                                                   rule-params-map
   675→                                                   tx-step-maps)
   676→                  pre-check-results    (io/expect-io
   677→                                        (run-checks! ctx pre-checks))
   678→
   679→                  ;; transact to DB
   680→                  tx-step-maps         (tx/reorder-tx-steps ops-order tx-step-maps)
   681→                  tx-data              (io/expect-io
   682→                                        (tx/transact-without-tx-conn-impl! tx-conn (:attrs ctx) app-id tx-step-maps {}))
   683→
   684→                  ;; post checks
   685→                  create-lookups-map   (io/expect-io
   686→                                        (->> tx-step-maps
   687→                                             (map :eid)
   688→                                             (filter lookup-ref?)
   689→                                             (triple-model/fetch-lookups->eid tx-conn app-id)))
   690→                  post-checks          (post-create-checks ctx
   691→                                                           entities-map
   692→                                                           updated-entities-map
   693→                                                           rule-params-map
   694→                                                           create-lookups-map
   695→                                                           tx-step-maps)
   696→                  post-check-results   (io/expect-io
   697→                                        (run-checks! ctx post-checks))
   698→
   699→                  ;; finalizing
   700→                  check-results        (concat pre-check-results post-check-results)
   701→                  all-checks-ok?       (every? :check-result check-results)
   702→                  rollback?            (and admin-check?
   703→                                            (or admin-dry-run?
   704→                                                (not all-checks-ok?)))]
   705→              (when rollback?
   706→                (io/expect-io
   707→                 (.rollback tx-conn)))
   708→              (assoc tx-data
   709→                     :check-results  check-results
   710→                     :all-checks-ok? all-checks-ok?
   711→                     :committed?     (not rollback?)))))))))
   712→

     9→/// The central coordinator for InstantDB data.
