   212→(defn extract-duplicate-ident-data [pg-data]
   213→  (when (and (= "idents" (:table pg-data))
   214→             (= "app_ident_uq" (:constraint pg-data)))
   215→    (safely-extract-data
   216→     (fn [pg-data]
   217→       (let [details (parse-unique-detail (:detail pg-data))
   218→             etype (get details "etype")
   219→             label (get details "label")]
   220→         (when (and etype label)
   221→           {:message (format "`%s` already exists on `%s`"
   222→                             label
   223→                             etype)
   224→            :hint {:etype etype
   225→                   :label label}})))
   226→     pg-data
   227→     "ex/extract-duplicate-ident-data")))
   228→
   229→(defn extract-unique-triple-data [pg-data]
   230→  (when (and (= "triples" (:table pg-data))
   231→             (= "av_index" (:constraint pg-data)))
   232→    (safely-extract-data
   233→     (fn [pg-data]
   234→       (let [details (parse-unique-detail (:detail pg-data))
   235→             value   (get details "json_null_to_null(value)")
   236→             app-id  (uuid-util/coerce (get details "app_id"))
   237→             attr-id (uuid-util/coerce (get details "attr_id"))
   238→             {:keys [etype label]} (get-attr-details app-id attr-id)]
   239→         (cond (and etype label value)
   240→               {:message (format "`%s` is a unique attribute on `%s` and an entity already exists with `%s.%s` = %s"
   241→                                 label
   242→                                 etype
   243→                                 etype
   244→                                 label
   245→                                 value)
   246→                :hint {:attr-id attr-id
   247→                       :etype etype
   248→                       :label label
   249→                       :value value}}
   250→
   251→               attr-id
   252→               {:hint {:attr-id attr-id
   253→                       :value value}}
   254→
   255→               :else nil)))
   256→     pg-data
   257→     "ex/extract-unique-triple-data")))
   258→
   259→(defn build-not-unqiue-hint [pg-data]
   260→  (or (extract-duplicate-ident-data pg-data)
   261→      (extract-unique-triple-data pg-data)))

   263→(defn throw-record-not-unique!
   264→  ([record-type] (throw-record-not-unique! record-type nil nil))
   265→  ([record-type pg-data e]
   266→   (let [extra-hint-data (build-not-unqiue-hint pg-data)]
   267→     (throw+ {::type ::record-not-unique
   268→              ::message (or (:message extra-hint-data)
   269→                            (format "Record not unique: %s" (name record-type)))
   270→              ::hint (merge {:record-type record-type} (:hint extra-hint-data))}
   271→             e))))

   284→(defn throw-permission-evaluation-failed! [etype action ^CelEvaluationException e show-cel-errors?]
   285→  (let [cause-type (.name (.getErrorCode e))
   286→        err-message (.getMessage e)
   287→        cause-message (if (and err-message show-cel-errors?)
   288→                        err-message
   289→                        "You may have a typo")
   290→        hint-message (format "Could not evaluate permission rule for `%s.%s`. %s. Debug this in the sandbox and then update your permission rules."
   291→                             etype
   292→                             action
   293→                             cause-message)]
   294→    (throw+ {::type ::permission-evaluation-failed
   295→             ::message hint-message
   296→             ::hint (cond-> {:rule [etype action]}
   297→                      cause-type (assoc :error {:type (keyword cause-type)
   298→                                                :message hint-message
   299→                                                :hint cause-message}))}
   300→            e)))

   310→(defn throw-validation-err!
   311→  "Note: the way we use this function, we always had a descriptive 
   312→  `message` passed in an `errors` entry. 
   313→
   314→  We moved that up into the top-level `message`, so it's easier for users to read. 
   315→
   316→  We may want to refactor this function, to perhaps pass in the message directly."
   317→  [input-type input errors]
   318→  (let [base-msg (str "Validation failed for " (name input-type))
   319→        hint-msgs (keep :message errors)
   320→        full-msg (if-not (seq hint-msgs)
   321→                   base-msg
   322→                   (str base-msg ": " (string/join ", " hint-msgs)))]
   323→    (throw+ {::type ::validation-failed
   324→             ::message full-msg
   325→             ::hint {:data-type input-type
   326→                     :input input
   327→                     :errors errors}})))
   328→
   329→(defn assert-valid! [input-type input errors]
   330→  (when (seq errors)
   331→    (throw-validation-err! input-type input errors)))

   374→
   375→        param (get-in obj found-path)

   434→
   435→(defn- best-problem
   436→  "Picks the most specific problem.
   437→   We use a heuristic: we sort by `path`, `in` length, and the last element in `in`."
   438→  [explain]
   439→  (->> explain
   440→       ::s/problems
   441→       (sort-by
   442→        (fn [{:keys [in path]}]
   443→          [(count path) (count in) (last in)]))
   444→       last))
   445→
   446→(defn- ns-to-remove? [x]
   447→  (#{"clojure.core"} (namespace x)))
   448→
   449→(defn- walk-pred
   450→  "explain-data returns a `pred`. To make it a bit cleaner,
   451→   we walk it and remove the `namespace` part for common symbols and keywords"
   452→  [pred]
   453→  (w/postwalk
   454→   (fn [x]
   455→     (cond
   456→       (and (symbol? x) (ns-to-remove? x)) (symbol (name x))
   457→       (and (keyword? x) (ns-to-remove? x)) (keyword (name x))
   458→       :else x))
   459→   pred))
   460→
   461→(defn explain->validation-errors [explain]
   462→  (let [problem (best-problem explain)
   463→        {:keys [in pred]} problem]
   464→    [{:expected (walk-pred pred)
   465→      :in in}]))

   470→(defn kw-table-name [str-table]
   471→  (-> (or str-table "unknown")
   472→      inflections/dasherize
   473→      inflections/singular
   474→      keyword
   475→      keyword))
   476→
   477→(comment
   478→  (kw-table-name "app_oauth_codes"))

   480→(defn extract-triple-from-constraint [{:keys [table detail]}]
   481→  (when (and (= table "triples")
   482→             detail
   483→             (string/starts-with? detail "Failing row contains"))
   484→    ;; The error detail looks like "Failing row contains (app_id, entity_id, ...),
   485→    ;; so we extract all of those values by looking for what's between the commas
   486→    (let [borders (conj (into [(string/index-of detail "(")]
   487→                              (indexes-of detail ","))
   488→                        (string/last-index-of detail ")"))
   489→          ;; Skip any `,` in the value
   490→          borders (concat (take 4 borders)
   491→                          (take-last 10 borders))]
   492→      (zipmap [:app-id
   493→               :entity-id
   494→               :attr-id
   495→               :value
   496→               :value-md5
   497→               :ea
   498→               :eav
   499→               :av
   500→               :ave
   501→               :vae
   502→               :created-at
   503→               :checked-data-type]
   504→              (map (fn [[start end]]
   505→                     (string/trim (subs detail (inc start) end)))
   506→                   (partition 2 1 borders))))))

   508→(defn default-psql-throw! [e {:keys [condition] :as data} hint]
   509→  (throw+ {::type ::sql-exception
   510→           ::message (format "SQL Exception: %s" (name condition))
   511→           ::hint hint
   512→           ::pg-error-data data}
   513→          e))
   514→
   515→(def ^:dynamic *get-attr-for-exception* nil)
   516→
   517→(defn translate-and-throw-psql-exception!
   518→  [^PSQLException e]
   519→  (let [{:keys [server-message condition table] :as data} (pgerrors/extract-data e)
   520→        hint (select-keys data [:table :condition :constraint])]
   521→    (case condition
   522→      :unique-violation
   523→      (throw-record-not-unique! (kw-table-name table) data e)
   524→
   525→      :foreign-key-violation
   526→      (cond (and (= "apps_org_id_fkey"
   527→                    (:constraint data))
   528→                 (string/starts-with? (:server-message data)
   529→                                      "update or delete on table \"orgs\""))
   530→            (throw+ {::type ::record-foreign-key-invalid
   531→                     ::message "The org can't be deleted while it still has apps."
   532→                     ::hint hint
   533→                     ::pg-error-data data}
   534→                    e)
   535→
   536→            :else
   537→            (throw+ {::type ::record-foreign-key-invalid
   538→                     ::message (format "Foreign Key Invalid: %s" (name condition))
   539→                     ::hint hint
   540→                     ::pg-error-data data}
   541→                    e))
   542→
   543→      :check-violation
   544→      (if-let [triple (extract-triple-from-constraint data)]
   545→        (let [attr (when-let [get-attr *get-attr-for-exception*]
   546→                     (some-> triple
   547→                             :attr-id
   548→                             uuid-util/coerce
   549→                             get-attr))
   550→              attr-name (when attr
   551→                          (format "%s.%s"
   552→                                  (-> attr
   553→                                      :forward-identity
   554→                                      second)
   555→                                  (-> attr
   556→                                      :forward-identity
   557→                                      last)))

   578→                    "indexed_values_are_constrained"
   579→                    (if (= "t" (:av triple))
   580→                      "Value is too large for a unique attribute."
   581→                      "Value is too large for an indexed attribute.")
   582→                    "valid_ref_value" "Linked value must be a valid uuid."
   583→
   584→                    (format "Check Violation: %s" (name (:constraint data))))]
   585→          (throw+ {::type ::validation-failed
   586→                   ::message msg
   587→                   ::hint (merge (when attr
   588→                                   {:namespace (-> attr
   589→                                                   :forward-identity
   590→                                                   second)
   591→                                    :attribute (-> attr
   592→                                                   :forward-identity
   593→                                                   last)})
   594→                                 {:value value
   595→                                  :checked-data-type (:checked-data-type triple)
   596→                                  :attr-id (:attr-id triple)
   597→                                  :entity-id (:entity-id triple)}
   598→                                 (when (= (:constraint data)
   599→                                          "indexed_values_are_constrained")
   600→                                   {:value-too-large? true}))}))

   602→          "orgs_title_check"

   608→          (throw+ {::type ::record-check-violation
   609→                   ::message (format "Check Violation: %s" (name condition))
   610→                   ::hint hint
   611→                   ::pg-error-data data}
   612→                  e)))
   613→
   614→      ;; This could be other things besides a timeout,
   615→      ;; but we don't have any way to check :/
   616→      :query-canceled
   617→      (throw+ {::type ::timeout
   618→               ::message "The query took too long to complete."}
   619→              e)
   620→
   621→      :idle-in-transaction-session-timeout
   622→      (throw+ {::type ::timeout
   623→               ::message "The transaction took too long to complete."}
   624→              e)
   625→
   626→      :invalid-parameter-value
   627→      (if (string/starts-with? (.getMessage e) "PreparedStatement can have at most")
   628→        (throw+ {::type ::parameter-limit-exceeded
   629→                 ::message "There are too many parameters in the transaction or query."
   630→                 ::hint {:message "Consider batching transactions to reduce the number of writes in a single transaction."
   631→                         :doc-urls ["https://www.instantdb.com/docs/instaml#batching-transactions"]}
   632→                 ::pg-error-data data})
   633→        (default-psql-throw! e data hint))
   634→
   635→      :raise-exception
   636→      (case server-message
   637→        "modify_org_id_on_org_member"
   638→        (throw+ {::type ::validation-failed
   639→                 ::message "Org members can not move between orgs."})
   640→
   641→        "remove_last_org_owner"
   642→        (throw+ {::type ::validation-failed
   643→                 ::message "There must be at least one member of the org that is an owner."})
   644→
   645→        "required_set_on_reserved_attrs"
   646→        (throw+ {::type ::validation-failed
   647→                 ::message (str
   648→                            "You can't create a required system attribute. Make sure it's optional."
   649→                            " Check out the docs to learn more:"
   650→                            " https://www.instantdb.com/docs/modeling-data#required-constraints")})
   651→
   652→        #_else
   653→        (throw+ {::type ::sql-raise
   654→                 ::message (format "Raised Exception: %s" server-message)
   655→                 ::hint hint
   656→                 ::pg-error-data data}
   657→                e))
   658→
   659→      (default-psql-throw! e data hint))))
   660→
   661→;; -----
   662→;; Oauth
   663→
   664→(defn throw-oauth-err!
   665→  ([message]
   666→   (throw-oauth-err! message nil))
   667→  ([message cause]
   668→   (throw+ {::type ::oauth-error
   669→            ::message message}
   670→           cause)))
   671→
   672→(defn throw-missing-scope! [required-scope]
   673→  (throw+ {::type ::permission-denied
   674→           ::message (format "You are missing the %s scope" required-scope)
   675→           ::hint {:required-scope required-scope}}))
   676→
   677→;; --------
   678→;; Wrappers
   679→
   680→(defn find-instant-exception ^Exception [^Exception e]
   681→  (loop [cause e]
   682→    (cond
   683→      (::type (ex-data cause)) cause
   684→      ;; Unwrap errors from next-jdbc/with-transaction
   685→      (:handling (ex-data cause)) (:handling (ex-data cause))
   686→      (nil? (.getCause cause)) nil
   687→      :else (recur (.getCause cause)))))

   133→(defn or-where-cond? [[k v]]
   134→  (and (= "or" (name k))
   135→       (sequential? v)))
   136→
   137→(defn and-where-cond? [[k v]]
   138→  (and (= "and" (name k))

   141→(defn- collapse-coerced-conds
   142→  "Converts {:or [{:or [{:k v}]}]} to its simplest form of {:k v}.
   143→   Will collapse both nested `and`s and `or`s."
   144→  [conds]
   145→  (reduce (fn [acc c]
   146→            (cond (:or c)
   147→                  (let [cs (reduce (fn [acc cs]
   148→                                     (if-let [ors (:or cs)]
   149→                                       (apply conj acc ors)
   150→                                       (conj acc cs)))
   151→                                   []
   152→                                   (collapse-coerced-conds (:or c)))]
   153→                    (if (= 1 (count cs))
   154→                      (conj acc (first cs))
   155→                      (conj acc {:or cs})))
   156→
   157→                  (:and c)
   158→                  (let [cs (reduce (fn [acc cs]
   159→                                     (if-let [ands (:and cs)]
   160→                                       (apply conj acc ands)
   161→                                       (conj acc cs)))
   162→                                   []
   163→                                   (collapse-coerced-conds (:and c)))]
   164→                    (if (= 1 (count cs))
   165→                      (conj acc (first cs))
   166→                      (conj acc {:and cs})))
   167→
   168→                  :else
   169→                  (conj acc c)))
   170→          []
   171→          conds))

   175→(defn link-etype [attrs etype link-attr-name]
   176→  (or (when-let [attr (attr-model/seek-by-fwd-ident-name
   177→                       [etype link-attr-name]
   178→                       attrs)]
   179→        (attr-model/rev-etype attr))
   180→      (when-let [attr (attr-model/seek-by-rev-ident-name
   181→                       [etype link-attr-name]
   182→                       attrs)]
   183→        (attr-model/fwd-etype attr))))

   185→(defn indexed-attr?
   186→  "Checks if the cond path is a top-level indexed attr so that we can
   187→   avoid checking for `isNull` on a `not` query."
   188→  [attrs initial-etype path]
   189→  (loop [etype initial-etype
   190→         [segment & rest-path] path]
   191→    (if (seq rest-path) ;; we're in a link
   192→      (recur (link-etype attrs etype segment)
   193→             rest-path)
   194→      (let [attr (attr-model/seek-by-fwd-ident-name [etype segment] attrs)]
   195→        (and (:index? attr)
   196→             (not (:indexing? attr)))))))

   198→(defn- combine-or-where-conds
   199→  "Converts {:or [{:a 1} {:a 2}] -> {:or [{:a {:in [1 2]}}]}"
   200→  [attrs initial-etype conds]
   201→  (let [{:keys [uncombined optimized]}
   202→        (reduce (fn [acc c]
   203→                  (if-not (or (and (= (count c) 1)
   204→                                   (= (second (first c)) {:$isNull true})
   205→                                   (indexed-attr? attrs initial-etype (string/split (name (ffirst c)) #"\.")))
   206→                              (and (= (count c) 1)
   207→                                   (where-value-valid? (second (first c)))
   208→                                   (not (string/starts-with? (name (ffirst c)) "$"))))
   209→                    (update acc :uncombined conj c)
   210→                    (let [[k v] (first c)
   211→                          v (if (= v {:$isNull true})
   212→                              nil
   213→                              v)
   214→                          existing (get-in acc [:optimized k] sentinel)]
   215→                      (if (= existing sentinel)
   216→                        (assoc-in acc [:optimized k] {:in [v]})
   217→                        (update-in acc [:optimized k :in] conj v)))))
   218→
   219→                {:uncombined []
   220→                 :optimized {}}
   221→                conds)]
   222→    (into uncombined (map (fn [[k v]]
   223→                            {k v})
   224→                          optimized))))

   226→(defn grow-paths
   227→  "Given a path, creates a list of paths leading up to that path,
   228→   including the path itself.
   229→   (grow-paths [1 2 3]) => ((1) (1 2) (1 2 3))"
   230→  [path]
   231→  (mapv (fn [i]
   232→          (take (inc i) path))
   233→        (range (count path))))

   235→(defn- normalize-ne-to-not

   239→    (-> where-cond-v
   240→        (assoc :$not (:$ne where-cond-v))
   241→        (dissoc :$ne))
   242→    where-cond-v))

   244→(defn- coerce-where-cond

   252→                                 {:and

   259→              :query
   260→              (:root state)

   271→             [{:and conds}]
   272→
   273→             (ex/throw-validation-err!
   274→              :query
   275→              (:root state)
   276→              [{:expected 'non-empty-list?
   277→                :in (conj (:in state) :and)

   303→             [{:or conds}]))
   304→
   305→         :else [[(string/split (name k) #"\.") v]])))

   307→(defn coerce-order [state order-map]

   323→                              (->json direction))}])))

   340→(defn- assert-cursor! [{:keys [in root]} x]

   342→              (ex/throw-validation-err!
   343→               :query
   344→               root

   363→                     (->json t))))

   402→  (if (and (int? offset) (not (neg? offset)))
   403→    offset
   404→    (ex/throw-validation-err!
   405→     :query
   406→     (:root state)
   407→     [{:expected 'supported-options?
   408→       :in (conj (:in state) :offset)
   409→       :message (format "The offset field must be a non-negative integer. Got %s."
   410→                        (->json offset))}])))
   411→
   412→(defn- coerce-aggregate! [state aggregate]
   413→  (if (#{"count" :count} aggregate)
   414→    :count
   415→    (ex/throw-validation-err!
   416→     :query
   417→     (:root state)
   418→     [{:expected 'supported-options?
   419→       :in (conj (:in state) :aggregate)
   420→       :message (format "The aggregate field only accepts \"count\", got %s."
   421→                        (->json aggregate))}])))
   422→
   423→(defn- coerce-option-map!
   424→  "Coerce the where conditions into paths and values."
   425→  [state attrs x]
   426→  (let [where-conds (some->> (get x :where)
   427→                             (assert-map! (update state :in conj :where))
   428→                             (mapcat (partial coerce-where-cond state attrs)))
   429→        order (let [order-state (update state :in conj :order)]
   430→                (some->> (:order x)
   431→                         (assert-map! order-state)
   432→                         (coerce-order order-state)))
   433→
   434→        limit (when-let [limit (:limit x)]
   435→                (coerce-limit! state limit))
   436→
   437→        first (when-let [first (:first x)]
   438→                (coerce-first! state first))
   439→
   440→        last (when-let [last (:last x)]
   441→               (coerce-last! state last))
   442→
   443→        offset (when-let [offset (:offset x)]
   444→                 (coerce-offset! state offset))
   445→
   446→        after (when-let [after (:after x)]
   447→                (assert-cursor! (update state :in conj :after) after))
   448→
   449→        before (when-let [before (:before x)]
   450→                 (assert-cursor! (update state :in conj :before) before))
   451→
   452→        aggregate (when-let [aggregate (:aggregate x)]
   453→                    (coerce-aggregate! state aggregate))
   454→
   455→        fields (:fields x)
   456→
   457→        x (dissoc x :where :order :limit :first :last :offset :before :after :aggregate :fields)]
   458→
   459→    (when (seq x)
   460→      (ex/throw-validation-err!
   461→       :query
   462→       (:root state)
   463→       [{:expected 'supported-options?
   464→         :in (:in state)
   465→         :message "We only support `where`, `order`, `limit`, `offset`, `before`, and `after` clauses."}]))
   466→
   467→    (when (and (< 0 (:level state))
   468→               (or offset after before))
   469→      (ex/throw-validation-err!
   470→       :query
   471→       (:root state)
   472→       [{:expected 'supported-options?
   473→         :in (:in state)
   474→         :message "We currently only support `offset`, `before`, and `after` clauses on the top-level field. Limit fields will be ignored"}]))
   475→
   476→    (let [limit-opts (filter identity [(when limit "`limit`")
   477→                                       (when first "`first`")
   478→                                       (when last "`last`")])]
   479→      (when (< 1 (count limit-opts))
   480→        (ex/throw-validation-err!
   481→         :query
   482→         (:root state)
   483→         [{:expected 'supported-options?
   484→           :in (:in state)
   485→           :message (format "Only provide one of %s." (string/join " or " limit-opts))}])))
   486→
   487→    (cond-> x
   488→      (seq where-conds) (assoc :where-conds where-conds)
   489→      order (assoc :order order)
   490→      limit (assoc :limit limit)
   491→      first (assoc :first first)
   492→      last (assoc :last last)
   493→      offset (assoc :offset offset)
   494→      after (assoc :after after)
   495→      before (assoc :before before)
   496→      aggregate (assoc :aggregate aggregate)
   497→      fields (assoc :fields fields))))
   498→
   499→(defn- coerce-forms!
   500→  "Converts our InstaQL object into a list of forms."
   501→  [state attrs o]
   502→  (assert-map! state o)
   503→  (->> o
   504→       (map (fn [[k v]]
   505→              (let [state' (-> state
   506→                               (update :in conj k)
   507→                               (update :etype (fn [etype]
   508→                                                (if etype
   509→                                                  (link-etype attrs etype (name k))
   510→                                                  (name k)))))
   511→                    _ (assert-map! state' v)
   512→                    option (coerce-option-map! (update state' :in conj :$)
   513→                                               attrs
   514→                                               (get v :$ {}))
   515→                    child-forms (dissoc v :$)]
   516→                {:k (name k)
   517→                 :etype (:etype state')
   518→                 :option-map option
   519→                 :child-forms (coerce-forms! (update state' :level inc)
   520→                                             attrs
   521→                                             child-forms)})))))
   522→
   523→(defn ->forms! [attrs o]
   524→  (let [o (cond-> o (associative? o) (dissoc :$$ruleParams))
   525→        coerced (coerce-forms! {:root o :in [] :level 0} attrs o)
   526→        conformed (s/conform ::forms coerced)]
   527→    (when (s/invalid? conformed)
   528→      (ex/throw-validation-err!
   529→       :coerced-query
   530→       coerced
   531→       (ex/explain->validation-errors
   532→        (s/explain-data ::forms coerced))))
   533→    conformed))
   534→
   535→(comment
   536→  (coerce-option-map!
   537→   {:in []
   538→    :level 0}
   539→   (attr-model/wrap-attrs [])
   540→   {:where {:bookshelves.books.title "The Count of Monte Cristo"
   541→            :email {:in ["test@example.com"]}
   542→            :or [{:email "test"}
   543→                 {:or [{:a "b"}]}]
   544→            :and [{:email "test"}
   545→                  {:handle "test"}]}})
   546→  (coerce-forms!
   547→   {:in []}
   548→   (attr-model/wrap-attrs [])
   549→   {:users {:$ {:where {:bookshelves.books.title "The Count of Monte Cristo"
   550→                                        ;:email "test@example.com"
   551→                        }}
   552→            :books {}}})
   553→
   554→  (coerce-forms!
   555→   {:in []}
   556→   (attr-model/wrap-attrs [])
   557→   {:users {:$ {:where {:bookshelves.books.title "The Count of Monte Cristo"}
   558→                :order {:serverCreatedAt "desc"}}
   559→            :books {}}})
   560→
   561→  (->forms!
   562→   (attr-model/wrap-attrs [])
   563→   {:users {:$ {:where {:bookshelves.books.title "The Count of Monte Cristo"
   564→                        :email "test@example.com"}}
   565→            :books {}}
   566→    :bookshelves {}})
   567→
   568→  (->forms!
   569→   (attr-model/wrap-attrs [])
   570→   {:users {:$ {:where {:handle {:in ["stopa", "joe"]}
   571→                        :or [{:email "test"}
   572→                             {:or [{:a "b"}]}]
   573→                        :and [{:email "test"}
   574→                              {:handle "test"}]}}
   575→            :books {}}})
   576→
   577→  (->forms!
   578→   (attr-model/wrap-attrs [])
   579→   {:users {:$ {:where {:and [{:or [{:handle "somebody"}
   580→                                    {:handle "joe"}
   581→                                    {:handle "nobody"}]}]}}}}))
