   583→;; ------
   584→;; Node
   585→
   586→(s/def ::child-nodes (s/coll-of ::node))
   587→(s/def ::datalog-query ::d/patterns)
   588→(s/def ::datalog-result ::d/result)
   589→(s/def ::data (s/keys :req-un [::datalog-query ::datalog-result]))
   590→
   591→(s/def ::node
   592→  (s/keys :req-un [::data ::child-nodes]))
   593→
   594→(defn make-node [data]
   595→  {:data data :child-nodes []})
   596→
   597→(defn add-children [node children]
   598→  (update node :child-nodes into children))
   599→
   600→(defn data-seq
   601→  "Given a node, return the tree as a sequence in dfs order."
   602→  [node]
   603→  (lazy-seq
   604→   (cons (:data node)
   605→         (mapcat data-seq (:child-nodes node)))))
   606→
   607→;; ----
   608→;; ->where-cond-attr-pats
   609→
   610→(defn- level-sym-gen
   611→  "Generates a level-sym function that will namespace all but the join variable."
   612→  [base-level-sym join-sym idx]
   613→  (fn level-sym [x level]
   614→    (let [base (base-level-sym x level)]
   615→      (if (= join-sym base)
   616→        base
   617→        (symbol (str base "-" idx))))))
   618→
   619→(defn- ->where-cond-attr-pats
   620→  "Take the where-cond:
   621→
   622→   [\"users\" \"bookshelves\" \"books\" \"title\"] \"Foo\"
   623→
   624→   This creates the attr-pats for the where-cond:
   625→
   626→   [[?users bookshelves-attr ?bookshelves]
   627→    [?bookshelves books-attr ?books]
   628→    [?books title-attr \"Foo\"]]"
   629→  [{:keys [level-sym attrs] :as ctx}
   630→   {:keys [etype level] :as _form}
   631→   {:keys [path v] :as _where-cond}]
   632→  (let [level-sym (or level-sym
   633→                      attr-pat/default-level-sym)
   634→        [v-type v-value] v
   635→        v (case v-type
   636→            :value v-value
   637→            :args-map (let [[func args-map-val] (first v-value)]
   638→                        (case func
   639→                          (:$in :in) args-map-val
   640→                          {func args-map-val})))
   641→        [refs-path value-label] (ucoll/split-last path)
   642→
   643→        [last-etype last-level ref-attr-pats referenced-etypes]
   644→        (attr-pat/->ref-attr-pats ctx level-sym etype level refs-path)
   645→
   646→        value-attr-pats
   647→        (cond (and (map? v) (contains? v :$isNull))
   648→              (let [id-attr (attr-model/seek-by-fwd-ident-name [last-etype "id"] attrs)
   649→                    fwd-attr (attr-model/seek-by-fwd-ident-name [last-etype value-label] attrs)
   650→                    rev-attr (attr-model/seek-by-rev-ident-name [last-etype value-label] attrs)
   651→                    value-attr (or fwd-attr
   652→                                   rev-attr)]
   653→                (ex/assert-record!
   654→                 id-attr :attr {:args [last-etype "id"]})
   655→                (ex/assert-record!
   656→                 value-attr :attr {:args [last-etype value-label]})
   657→
   658→                [[(level-sym last-etype last-level)
   659→                  (:id id-attr)
   660→                  {:$isNull {:attr-id (:id value-attr)
   661→                             :indexed? (and (:index? value-attr)
   662→                                            (not (:indexing? value-attr)))
   663→                             :indexed-checked-type (when (and (:index? value-attr)
   664→                                                              (not (:indexing? value-attr)))
   665→                                                     (:checked-data-type value-attr))
   666→                             :nil? (:$isNull v)
   667→                             :ref? (= :ref (:value-type value-attr))
   668→                             :reverse? (= value-attr rev-attr)}}]])
   669→
   670→              (= value-label "$entityIdStartsWith")
   671→              (let [id-attr (attr-model/seek-by-fwd-ident-name [last-etype "id"] attrs)]
   672→                [[(level-sym last-etype last-level) (:id id-attr) {:$entityIdStartsWith v}]])
   673→
   674→              :else
   675→              [(attr-pat/->value-attr-pat ctx
   676→                                          level-sym
   677→                                          last-etype
   678→                                          last-level
   679→                                          value-label
   680→                                          v)])]
   681→
   682→    {:pats (concat ref-attr-pats value-attr-pats)
   683→     :referenced-etypes (conj referenced-etypes
   684→                              etype)}))
   685→
   686→;; ----
   687→;; ->all-ids-attr-pat
   688→
   689→(defn- ->all-ids-attr-pat
   690→  "consider the plain query: {users: {}}
   691→
   692→   This has no where-cond or a join. In this case, we want to get all ids
   693→   for the etype.
   694→
   695→   This function does just that.
   696→
   697→   Note: We rely on the fact that all objects have
   698→   an `id` attr."
   699→  [ctx etype level]
   700→  (let [esym (attr-pat/default-level-sym etype level)
   701→        {:keys [id]} (attr-pat/id-attr-by-etype ctx etype)]
   702→    [esym id '_]))
   703→
   704→;; ---
   705→;; optimize-attr-pats
   706→
   707→(defn- some-constant
   708→  "Returns either e or v if they are a constant
   709→   [?e attr-id ?v] => nil
   710→   [?e attr-id 5] => 5
   711→   [5 attr-id ?v] => 5"
   712→  [[e _ v :as _attr-pat]]
   713→  (some attr-pat/constant-component? [e v]))
   714→
   715→(defn- optimize-attr-pats
   716→  "Given a list of attr pats, this tries to return a list that will be more
   717→   efficient to query. For example:
   718→
   719→   [[?users bookshelves ?bookshelves]
   720→    [?bookshelves title \"Foo\"]]
   721→
   722→   It's more efficient to write:
   723→
   724→   [[?bookshelves title \"Foo\"]
   725→    [?users bookshelves ?bookshelves]]"
   726→  [attr-pats]
   727→  (cond
   728→    ;; If there is only one attr-pat, we don't need to optimize
   729→    (<= (count attr-pats) 1)
   730→    attr-pats
   731→
   732→    ;; If the first attr-pat has a constant in it, it's optimized-enough for now
   733→    (and (vector? (first attr-pats))
   734→         (some-constant (first attr-pats)))
   735→    attr-pats
   736→
   737→    ;; If the last-attr-pat has constant in it, we'd gain a lot by reversing!
   738→    (and (vector? (last attr-pats))
   739→         (some-constant (last attr-pats)))
   740→    (reverse attr-pats)
   741→
   742→    :else attr-pats))
   743→
   744→;; ----
   745→;; where-query
   746→
   747→(declare where-cond->patterns)
   748→
   749→(defn- where-conds->patterns [ctx form where-conds]
   750→  (reduce (fn [acc [i where-cond]]
   751→            (let [{:keys [pats referenced-etypes]}
   752→                  (where-cond->patterns (if (zero? i)
   753→                                          ctx
   754→                                          (assoc ctx :skip-optimize? true))
   755→                                        form where-cond)]
   756→              (-> acc
   757→                  (update :pats into pats)
   758→                  (update :referenced-etypes set/union referenced-etypes))))
   759→          {:pats []
   760→           :referenced-etypes #{}}
   761→          (map-indexed vector where-conds)))
   762→
   763→(defn- where-cond->patterns [ctx form [tag where-cond]]
   764→  (let [level-sym (or (:level-sym ctx)
   765→                      attr-pat/default-level-sym)]
   766→    (case tag
   767→      :cond
   768→      (let [ret (->where-cond-attr-pats ctx form where-cond)]
   769→        (if (:skip-optimize? ctx)
   770→          ret
   771→          (update ret :pats optimize-attr-pats)))
   772→      :or (-> (reduce
   773→               (fn [acc [i cond]]
   774→                 (let [join-sym (level-sym
   775→                                 (:etype form)
   776→                                 (:level form))
   777→                       level-sym (level-sym-gen level-sym join-sym i)]
   778→                   (as-> (where-cond->patterns (assoc ctx :level-sym level-sym)
   779→                                               form
   780→                                               cond) %
   781→                     (update % :pats (fn [pats] [{:and pats}]))
   782→                     (merge-with into acc %))))
   783→               {:pats []
   784→                :referenced-etypes #{}}
   785→               (map-indexed vector (:or where-cond)))
   786→              (update :pats (fn [pats]
   787→                              [{:or {:patterns pats
   788→                                     :join-sym (attr-pat/default-level-sym
   789→                                                (:etype form)
   790→                                                (:level form))}}])))
   791→
   792→      :and (-> (reduce
   793→                (fn [acc [i cond]]
   794→                  (let [join-sym (level-sym
   795→                                  (:etype form)
   796→                                  (:level form))
   797→                        level-sym (level-sym-gen level-sym join-sym i)]
   798→                    (as-> (where-cond->patterns (assoc ctx :level-sym level-sym)
   799→                                                form
   800→                                                cond) %
   801→                      (update % :pats (fn [pats] [{:and pats}]))
   802→                      (merge-with into acc %))))
   803→                {:pats []
   804→                 :referenced-etypes #{}}
   805→                (map-indexed vector (:and where-cond)))
   806→               (update :pats (fn [pats]
   807→                               [{:and pats}]))))))
   808→
   809→(defn- where-query
   810→  "Given a form, return the query that could get the relevant ids,
   811→   and the symbol that represents the ids.
   812→
   813→   i.e {users: {where: {handle: \"stopa\"}}} =>
   814→
   815→   (?users, [[:av ?users handle-attr \"stopa\"]]])
   816→
   817→   This considers:
   818→
   819→   - a plain scan: {users: {}}
   820→
   821→   - a join: {users: {bookshelves: {}}}
   822→
   823→   - a where clause: {users: {where: {handle: \"stopa\"}}}
   824→
   825→   We also do some light optimizations:
   826→    - If we have a pattern with a constant, we put that pattern first.
   827→
   828→   Note: there's an implicit assumption here:
   829→     - When we generate the patterns, we assume that the variable for eids
   830→       will be (? etype level) "
   831→  [ctx {:keys [option-map join-attr-pat etype level] :as form}]
   832→  (let [{:keys [where-conds]} option-map
   833→        {where-cond-patterns :pats
   834→         referenced-etypes :referenced-etypes}
   835→        (if where-conds
   836→          (where-conds->patterns (assoc ctx
   837→                                        :skip-optimize? false) form where-conds)
   838→          {:pats nil
   839→           :referenced-etypes #{}})
   840→        with-join (cond-> []
   841→                    join-attr-pat (conj join-attr-pat))
   842→        with-where-cond (cond-> with-join
   843→                          where-cond-patterns (into where-cond-patterns))
   844→        with-fallback (if (seq with-where-cond)
   845→                        with-where-cond
   846→                        [(->all-ids-attr-pat ctx etype level)])
   847→        optimized (optimize-attr-pats (distinct with-fallback))
   848→        datalog-query (attr-pat/attr-pats->patterns ctx optimized)]
   849→    (list false
   850→          (attr-pat/default-level-sym etype level)
   851→          etype
   852→          datalog-query
   853→          (conj referenced-etypes etype))))
   854→
   855→(defn guarded-where-query [ctx {:keys [etype level] :as form}]
   856→  (try
   857→    (where-query ctx form)
   858→    (catch clojure.lang.ExceptionInfo e
   859→      (if (contains? #{::ex/validation-failed}
   860→                     (::ex/type (ex-data e)))
   861→        (throw e)
   862→        (list true
   863→              (attr-pat/default-level-sym etype level)
   864→              etype
   865→              [[:ea (attr-pat/default-level-sym etype level)]
   866→               [:eav]]
   867→              #{etype})))))
   868→
   869→;; ----------
   870→;; pagination
   871→
   872→;; A default order if the user only provides a limit/offset/cursor without
   873→;; an order.
   874→(def default-order {:k "serverCreatedAt" :direction :asc})
   875→
   876→(defn wrong-attribute-msg [{:keys [attrs]} order-attr cursor-attr-id]
   877→  (let [order-label (fn [attr]
   878→                      (let [lbl (attr-model/fwd-label attr)]
   879→                        (if (= lbl "id")
   880→                          "serverCreatedAt"
   881→                          lbl)))]
   882→    (if-let [cursor-attr (attr-model/seek-by-id cursor-attr-id attrs)]
   883→      (format "The query orders by `%s`, but the query that returned the cursor orders by `%s`."
   884→              (order-label order-attr)
   885→              (order-label cursor-attr))
   886→      (format "The query orders by `%s`, but the query that returned the cursor orders by a missing attribute."
   887→              (order-label order-attr)))))
   888→
   889→(defn page-info-of-form [{:keys [state] :as ctx}
   890→                         {:keys [etype level option-map] :as _form}]
   891→  (let [{:keys [order limit first last offset before after]} option-map]
   892→    (when (and (= level 0) ;; Don't bother ordering child forms since you can't paginate them
   893→               (or limit first last offset before after order))
   894→      (let [{:keys [k direction]} (or order default-order)
   895→            eid-sym (attr-pat/default-level-sym etype level)
   896→            order-sym (if (= "serverCreatedAt" k)
   897→                        (symbol (str "?t-" level))
   898→                        (attr-pat/default-level-sym k level))
   899→            order-attr (if (= "serverCreatedAt" k)
   900→                         (attr-model/seek-by-fwd-ident-name [etype "id"] (:attrs ctx))
   901→                         (attr-model/seek-by-fwd-ident-name [etype k] (:attrs ctx)))]
   902→
   903→        (when (not order-attr)
   904→          (ex/throw-validation-err!
   905→           :query
   906→           (:root state)
   907→           [{:expected 'supported-order?
   908→             :in (apply conj (:in (:state ctx)) [:$ :order])
   909→             :message (format "There is no `%s` attribute for %s."
   910→                              (if (= "serverCreatedAt" k)
   911→                                "id"
   912→                                k)
   913→                              etype)}]))
   914→
   915→        (when (not= "serverCreatedAt" k)
   916→          (let [errors (keep identity
   917→                             [(when (:checking-data-type? order-attr)
   918→                                (format "The `%s` attribute is still in the process of validating its type. It must finish before ordering by the attribute."
   919→                                        (attr-model/fwd-friendly-name order-attr)))
   920→                              (when (:indexing? order-attr)
   921→                                (format "The `%s` attribute is still in the process of indexing. It must finish before ordering by the attribute."
   922→                                        (attr-model/fwd-friendly-name order-attr)))
   923→                              (when (not (:index? order-attr))
   924→                                (format "The `%s` attribute is not indexed. Only indexed and typed attributes can be used to order by."
   925→                                        (attr-model/fwd-friendly-name order-attr)))
   926→                              (when (not (:checked-data-type order-attr))
   927→                                (format "The `%s` attribute is not typed. Only typed and indexed attributes can be used to order by."
   928→                                        (attr-model/fwd-friendly-name order-attr)))
   929→                              (when (not= :one (:cardinality order-attr))
   930→                                (format "The `%s` attribute has cardinality `%s`. Only attributes with cardinality `one` can be used to order by."
   931→                                        (attr-model/fwd-friendly-name order-attr)
   932→                                        (name (:cardinality order-attr))))])]
   933→            (when (seq errors)
   934→              (ex/throw-validation-err!
   935→               :query
   936→               (:root state)
   937→               (map (fn [message]
   938→                      {:expected 'supported-order?
   939→                       :in (apply conj (:in (:state ctx)) [:$ :order])
   940→                       :message message})
   941→                    errors)))))
   942→
   943→        (when (and before
   944→                   (not= (:id order-attr) (second before)))
   945→          (ex/throw-validation-err!
   946→           :query
   947→           (:root state)
   948→           [{:expected 'valid-cursor?
   949→             :in (apply conj (:in (:state ctx)) [:$ :before])
   950→             :message (format "Invalid before cursor. %s"
   951→                              (wrong-attribute-msg ctx order-attr (second before)))}]))
   952→
   953→        (when (and after
   954→                   (not= (:id order-attr) (second after)))
   955→          (ex/throw-validation-err!
   956→           :query
   957→           (:root state)
   958→           [{:expected 'valid-cursor?
   959→             :in (apply conj (:in (:state ctx)) [:$ :after])
   960→             :message (format "Invalid after cursor. %s"
   961→                              (wrong-attribute-msg ctx order-attr (second after)))}]))
   962→
   963→        {:limit (or limit first last)
   964→         :last? (not (nil? last))
   965→         :offset offset
   966→         :direction direction
   967→         :order-sym order-sym
   968→         :eid-sym eid-sym
   969→         :order-col-type (if (= k "serverCreatedAt")
   970→                           :created-at-timestamp
   971→                           (:checked-data-type order-attr))
   972→         :pattern (if (= "serverCreatedAt" k)
   973→                    [:ea eid-sym (:id order-attr) '_ order-sym]
   974→                    [{:idx-key :ave
   975→                      :data-type (:checked-data-type order-attr)}
   976→                     eid-sym
   977→                     (:id order-attr)
   978→                     order-sym])
   979→         :attr-id (:id order-attr)
   980→         :before before
   981→         :after after}))))
   982→
   983→;; -----
   984→;; query
   985→
   986→(defn- form->child-forms
   987→  "Given a form and eid, return a seq of all the possible child queries.
   988→   This determines the etype for the child form, and adds a join condition on
   989→   the eid"
   990→  [ctx {:keys [etype child-forms level]} eid]
   991→  (for [form child-forms]
   992→    (let [{:keys [k]} form
   993→
   994→          [next-etype next-level attr-pat]
   995→          (attr-pat/->guarded-ref-attr-pat ctx etype level k)
   996→
   997→          join-attr-pat (attr-pat/replace-in-attr-pat
   998→                         attr-pat (attr-pat/default-level-sym etype level) eid)
   999→          form' (-> form
  1000→                    (assoc :etype next-etype)
  1001→                    (assoc :level next-level)
  1002→                    (assoc :join-attr-pat join-attr-pat))]
  1003→      form')))
  1004→
  1005→(defn find-row-by-aid [rows aid]
  1006→  (->> rows
  1007→       (filter #(= aid (second (first %))))
  1008→       first))
  1009→
  1010→(def $file-location-id-attr-id (system-catalog/get-attr-id "$files" "location-id"))
  1011→(def $file-url-attr-id (system-catalog/get-attr-id "$files" "url"))
  1012→
  1013→(defn- add-url-to-join-rows [join-rows {:keys [app-id]}]
  1014→  (let [[eid _ _ t] (ffirst join-rows)
  1015→        location-id (some-> (find-row-by-aid join-rows $file-location-id-attr-id)
  1016→                            first
  1017→                            (nth 2))]
  1018→    (if-not (and eid location-id)
  1019→      join-rows
  1020→      (conj join-rows
  1021→            [[eid
  1022→              $file-url-attr-id
  1023→              (instant-s3/create-signed-download-url! app-id location-id)
  1024→              t]]))))
  1025→
  1026→(defn remove-location-id-from-join-rows  [join-rows]
  1027→  (->> join-rows
  1028→       (remove (fn [row]
  1029→                 (let [first-triple (first row)
  1030→                       [_ aid] first-triple]
  1031→                   (= aid $file-location-id-attr-id))))))
  1032→
  1033→(defn transform-$files-result [ctx form result]
  1034→  (let [fields (some-> form :option-map :fields set)
  1035→        asked-for-url? (or (not fields)
  1036→                           (contains? fields "url"))
  1037→        did-not-ask-for-location-id? (and fields
  1038→                                          (not (contains? fields "location-id")))]
  1039→    (cond-> result
  1040→      asked-for-url? (update :join-rows add-url-to-join-rows ctx)
  1041→      did-not-ask-for-location-id? (update :join-rows remove-location-id-from-join-rows))))
  1042→
  1043→(defn collect-query-results
  1044→  "Takes the datalog result from a nested query and the forms to constructs the
  1045→   query output.
  1046→
  1047→   Assumes the structure of the datalog result matches the structure of the forms."
  1048→  [ctx datalog-result forms]
  1049→  (mapv (fn [form child]
  1050→          (let [nodes (map (fn [child]
  1051→                             (add-children
  1052→                              (make-node {:etype (:etype form)
  1053→                                          :datalog-query (:datalog-query (first child))
  1054→                                          :datalog-result (let [result (:result (first child))]
  1055→                                                            (if (= (:etype form) "$files")
  1056→                                                              (transform-$files-result ctx form result)
  1057→                                                              result))})
  1058→
  1059→                              (collect-query-results ctx (first (:children (first child)))
  1060→                                                     (:child-forms form))))
  1061→                           (:children child))]
  1062→            (add-children
  1063→             (make-node {:k (:k form)
  1064→                         :etype (:etype form)
  1065→                         :option-map (:option-map form)
  1066→                         :datalog-query (:datalog-query child)
  1067→                         :datalog-result (:result child)})
  1068→             nodes)))
  1069→        forms datalog-result))
  1070→
  1071→(defn- replace-sym-placeholders
  1072→  "Updates the patterns to replace the placeholder with the join-sym.
  1073→   We use a placeholder so that `guarded-where-query` will use a good
  1074→   index.
  1075→
  1076→   The index works because the join-sym will reference the value from
  1077→   the parent query in the actual sql query."
  1078→  [placeholders patterns]
  1079→  (mapv (fn [p]
  1080→          (cond (:or p)
  1081→                (update-in p [:or :patterns] (partial replace-sym-placeholders placeholders))
  1082→
  1083→                (:and p)
  1084→                (update p :and (partial replace-sym-placeholders placeholders))
  1085→
  1086→                :else
  1087→                (mapv (fn [c] (get placeholders c c))
  1088→                      p)))
  1089→        patterns))
  1090→
  1091→(defn collect-query-one [query-one-results]
  1092→  (reduce (fn [acc {:keys [pattern-group referenced-etypes form]}]
  1093→            (-> acc
  1094→                (update :forms conj form)
  1095→                (update :pattern-groups conj pattern-group)
  1096→                (update :referenced-etypes into referenced-etypes)))
  1097→          {:forms []
  1098→           :pattern-groups []
  1099→           :referenced-etypes #{}}
  1100→          query-one-results))
  1101→
  1102→(defn etype-attr-ids [{:keys [attrs]} etype fields]
  1103→  (if fields
  1104→    (let [attr-ids (reduce (fn [acc field]
  1105→                             (let [attr (attr-model/seek-by-fwd-ident-name
  1106→                                         [etype field]
  1107→                                         attrs)]
  1108→                               (if (= :one (:cardinality attr))
  1109→                                 (conj acc (:id attr))
  1110→                                 acc)))
  1111→                           #{}
  1112→                           ;; Make sure we give them the id or else the client
  1113→                           ;; won't be able to find the entity
  1114→                           (conj fields "id"))]
  1115→      (if (contains? attr-ids $file-url-attr-id)
  1116→        ;; If the user asked for the url, we need to make sure to
  1117→        ;; include `location-id` too; we use location-id to generate the url.
  1118→        (conj attr-ids $file-location-id-attr-id)
  1119→        attr-ids))
  1120→    (attr-model/ea-ids-for-etype etype attrs)))
  1121→
  1122→(defn- query-one
  1123→  "Generates nested datalog query that combines all datalog queries into a
  1124→   single sql query."
  1125→  [ctx {:keys [k] :as form}]
  1126→  (let [ctx (update-in ctx [:state :in] conj k)
  1127→
  1128→        [missing-attr? sym etype patterns where-etypes]
  1129→        (guarded-where-query ctx form)
  1130→
  1131→        page-info (when-not missing-attr?
  1132→                    (page-info-of-form ctx form))
  1133→
  1134→        ;; Create an eid placeholder for the sym so that `guarded-where-query`
  1135→        ;; will use good indexes, then we'll replace it in the patterns later
  1136→        sym-placeholder (or (get-in ctx [:sym-placeholders sym])
  1137→                            (random-uuid))
  1138→        ctx (assoc-in ctx [:sym-placeholders sym] sym-placeholder)
  1139→        aggregate (get-in form [:option-map :aggregate])
  1140→        fields (get-in form [:option-map :fields])
  1141→        attr-ids (etype-attr-ids ctx etype fields)
  1142→        child-patterns (collect-query-one
  1143→                        (mapv (partial query-one ctx)
  1144→                              (form->child-forms ctx form sym-placeholder)))
  1145→        child-forms (:forms child-patterns)]
  1146→    (when (and aggregate (not (:admin? ctx)))
  1147→      (ex/throw-validation-err!
  1148→       :query
  1149→       (:root (:state ctx))
  1150→       [{:expected 'admin?
  1151→         :in (apply conj (:in (:state ctx)) [:$ :aggregate])
  1152→         :message "Aggregates are currently only available for admin queries."}]))
  1153→
  1154→    (when (and aggregate (seq child-forms))
  1155→      (ex/throw-validation-err!
  1156→       :query
  1157→       (:root (:state ctx))
  1158→       [{:expected 'valid-query?
  1159→         :in (apply conj (:in (:state ctx)) [:$ :aggregate])
  1160→         :message "You can not combine aggregates with child queries at this time."}]))
  1161→
  1162→    {:form (assoc form :child-forms child-forms)
  1163→     :referenced-etypes (set/union #{etype}
  1164→                                   (:referenced-etypes child-patterns)
  1165→                                   where-etypes)
  1166→     :pattern-group
  1167→     (merge
  1168→      {:patterns (replace-sym-placeholders (map-invert (:sym-placeholders ctx))
  1169→                                           patterns)
  1170→       :children {:pattern-groups
  1171→                  [(merge {:patterns [[:ea sym attr-ids]]}
  1172→                          (when (seq child-forms)
  1173→                            {:children {:pattern-groups (:pattern-groups child-patterns)
  1174→                                        :join-sym sym}}))]
  1175→                  :join-sym sym}}
  1176→      (when missing-attr?
  1177→        {:missing-attr? missing-attr?})
  1178→      (when page-info
  1179→        {:page-info page-info})
  1180→      (when aggregate
  1181→        {:aggregate aggregate
  1182→         :children nil}))}))
  1183→
  1184→(defn instaql-query->patterns [ctx o]
  1185→  (let [forms* (->> (->forms! (:attrs ctx) o)
  1186→                    ;; at the top-level, `k` _must_ be the etype
  1187→                    (mapv (fn [{:keys [k] :as form}]
  1188→                            (assoc form :etype k :level 0))))
  1189→        {:keys [pattern-groups
  1190→                referenced-etypes
  1191→                forms]}
  1192→        (collect-query-one
  1193→         (map (partial query-one (assoc ctx :state {:root o :in []}))
  1194→              forms*))]
  1195→    {:patterns {:children {:pattern-groups pattern-groups}}
  1196→     :forms forms
  1197→     :referenced-etypes referenced-etypes}))
  1198→
  1199→(defn query-normal
  1200→  "Generates and runs a nested datalog query, then collects the results into nodes."
  1201→  [ctx o]
  1202→  (let [query-normalized (instaql-util/normalized-forms o)
  1203→        query-hash (hash query-normalized)]
  1204→    (tracer/with-span! {:name "instaql/query-nested"
  1205→                        :attributes {:app-id (:app-id ctx)
  1206→                                     :forms o
  1207→                                     :query-normalized query-normalized
  1208→                                     :query-hash query-hash}}
  1209→      (let [datalog-query-fn (or (:datalog-query-fn ctx)
  1210→                                 #'d/query)
  1211→            {:keys [patterns forms]} (instaql-query->patterns ctx o)
  1212→            datalog-result (datalog-query-fn (assoc ctx :query-hash query-hash)
  1213→                                             patterns)]
  1214→        (collect-query-results ctx (:data datalog-result) forms)))))
  1215→
  1216→(defn explain
  1217→  "Generates a nested datalog query, then runs explain."
  1218→  [ctx o]
  1219→  (let [query-hash (instaql-util/forms-hash o)
  1220→        explain-fn (or (:datalog-explain-fn ctx)
  1221→                       d/explain)
  1222→        {:keys [patterns]} (instaql-query->patterns ctx o)]
  1223→    (explain-fn (assoc ctx :query-hash query-hash)
  1224→                patterns)))
  1225→
  1226→;; BYOP InstaQL
  1227→
  1228→(defn safe-table
  1229→  "Ensures that we only allow known tables to prevent sql injection."
  1230→  [state table-info table-name]
  1231→  (if (contains? table-info table-name)
  1232→    (keyword table-name)
  1233→    (ex/throw-validation-err!
  1234→     :query
  1235→     (:root state)
  1236→     [{:expected 'valid-table
  1237→       :in (:in state)
  1238→       :message (str table-name " is not a recognized table.")}])))
  1239→
  1240→(defn select-fields
  1241→  "Generates list of select fields for a table."
  1242→  [state table-info table-name]
  1243→  (if (contains? table-info table-name)
  1244→    (keys (get-in table-info [table-name :fields]))
  1245→    (ex/throw-validation-err!
  1246→     :query
  1247→     (:root state)
  1248→     [{:expected 'valid-table
  1249→       :in (:in state)
  1250→       :message (str table-name " is not a recognized table.")}])))
  1251→
  1252→(defn safe-field
  1253→  "Ensures that we only allow known fields to prevent sql injection."
  1254→  [state table-info table-name field-name]
  1255→  (if (contains? table-info table-name)
  1256→    (let [fields (get-in table-info [table-name :fields])]
  1257→      (if (contains? fields (keyword field-name))
  1258→        (keyword field-name)
  1259→        (ex/throw-validation-err!
  1260→         :query
  1261→         (:root state)
  1262→         [{:expected 'valid-table
  1263→           :in (:in state)
  1264→           :message (str field-name " is not a recognized field on " table-name ".")}])))
  1265→    (ex/throw-validation-err!
  1266→     :query
  1267→     (:root state)
  1268→     [{:expected 'valid-table
  1269→       :in (:in state)
  1270→       :message (str table-name " is not a recognized table.")}])))
  1271→
  1272→(defn t-field
  1273→  "Gets the field we'll use to populate the `t` field in the triple."
  1274→  [table-info table-name]
  1275→  (-> table-info (get table-name) :t-field))
  1276→
  1277→(defn safe-order-by-field
  1278→  "Ensures that we only allow known fields to prevent sql injection.
  1279→   Also prevents ordering by unindexed fields."
  1280→  [state table-info table-name field-name]
  1281→  (let [field (safe-field state table-info table-name field-name)
  1282→        field-info (get-in table-info [table-name :fields field])]
  1283→    (if (:indexed? field-info)
  1284→      field
  1285→      (ex/throw-validation-err!
  1286→       :query
  1287→       (:root state)
  1288→       [{:expected 'indexed-field?
  1289→         :in (:in state)
  1290→         :message (str field-name " on " table-name " needs an index to be used for ordering")}]))))
  1291→
  1292→(declare where-conds->sql)
  1293→
  1294→(defn relations->conds
  1295→  "Creates sql conditions for filtering by relations, e.g.
  1296→   {:where {:apps.members.name \"some-name\"}}
  1297→   -> exists (select * from apps
  1298→              where apps.id = users.app_id
  1299→                and exists (select * from members
  1300→                             where apps.id = members.app_id
  1301→                               and exists (select * from members
  1302→                                            where name = 'some-name')))
  1303→   Also generates topics."
  1304→  [state table-info relations field values]
  1305→  (let [[{:keys [table table-field
  1306→                 other-table other-table-field] :as _relation} & rest] relations
  1307→
  1308→        {:keys [topics sql-conds]}
  1309→        (if (seq rest)
  1310→          (relations->conds state table-info rest field values)
  1311→          {:topics [] :sql-conds []})]
  1312→    {:sql-conds
  1313→     [:exists
  1314→      {:select :*
  1315→       :from other-table
  1316→       :where [:and
  1317→               [:=
  1318→                (keyword (str (name table) "." (name table-field)))
  1319→                (keyword (str (name other-table) "." (name other-table-field)))]
  1320→               (if (seq rest)
  1321→                 sql-conds
  1322→                 (let [field-type (get-in table-info [(name other-table)
  1323→                                                      :fields
  1324→                                                      field
  1325→                                                      :db-type])]
  1326→                   (list* :or
  1327→                          (for [value values]
  1328→                            [:= field [:cast value field-type]]))))]}]
  1329→     :topics (if (seq rest)
  1330→               topics
  1331→               [[#{:ea}
  1332→                 '_
  1333→                 (get-in table-info [(name other-table) :fields field :attr-id])
  1334→                 ;; TODO(byop): Should be able to use values to narrow the topics,
  1335→                 ;;       but need a way to convert "variables", e.g. t.id
  1336→                 '_]])}))
  1337→
  1338→(defn cond-where-cond->sql [state table-info table-name where-cond]
  1339→  (let [{:keys [path v]} where-cond
  1340→        values (case (first v)
  1341→                 :value [(second v)]
  1342→                 :args-map (cond (contains? (second v) :in)
  1343→                                 (:in (second v))
  1344→
  1345→                                 (contains? (second v) :gt)
  1346→                                 [(:gt (second v))]
  1347→
  1348→                                 (contains? (second v) :lt)
  1349→                                 [(:lt (second v))]
  1350→
  1351→                                 (contains? (second v) :$like)
  1352→                                 (when-let [like-val (:$like (second v))]
  1353→                                   like-val)
  1354→
  1355→                                 (contains? (second v) :$ilike)
  1356→                                 (when-let [like-val (:$ilike (second v))]
  1357→                                   like-val)))]
  1358→
  1359→    (if (< 1 (count path))
  1360→      (let [relations-fields (butlast path)
  1361→
  1362→            [_ relations]
  1363→            (reduce
  1364→             (fn [[previous-table relations] relation-field]
  1365→               (if-let [relation (get-in table-info [previous-table
  1366→                                                     :relations
  1367→                                                     relation-field])]
  1368→                 [(name (:other-table relation)) (conj relations relation)]
  1369→                 (ex/throw-validation-err!
  1370→                  :query
  1371→                  (:root state)
  1372→                  [{:expected 'not-implemented
  1373→                    :in (:in state)
  1374→                    :message (str relation-field
  1375→                                  " is not a recognized relation on "
  1376→                                  previous-table)}])))
  1377→             [table-name []]
  1378→             relations-fields)
  1379→            field (safe-field state
  1380→                              table-info
  1381→                              (name (:other-table (last relations)))
  1382→                              (last path))]
  1383→        (relations->conds state table-info relations field values))
  1384→
  1385→      (let [field (safe-field state table-info table-name (first path))
  1386→            field-info (get-in table-info [table-name :fields field])
  1387→            field-type (:db-type field-info)
  1388→            comparison (case (first v)
  1389→                         :value :=
  1390→                         :args-map (cond (contains? (second v) :in)
  1391→                                         :=
  1392→
  1393→                                         (contains? (second v) :gt)
  1394→                                         :>
  1395→
  1396→                                         (contains? (second v) :lt)
  1397→                                         :<
  1398→
  1399→                                         (contains? (second v) :$like)
  1400→                                         :like
  1401→
  1402→                                         (contains? (second v) :$ilike)
  1403→                                         :ilike))]
  1404→        {:sql-conds (list* :or
  1405→                           (for [value values]
  1406→                             [comparison field [:cast value field-type]]))
  1407→         :topics [[#{:ea} '_ #{(:attr-id field-info)} '_]]}))))
  1408→
  1409→(defn where-cond->sql [state table-info table-name [tag where-cond]]
  1410→  (case tag
  1411→    :cond (cond-where-cond->sql state table-info table-name where-cond)
  1412→    :or (let [{:keys [sql-conds topics]}
  1413→              (reduce (fn [acc where-cond]
  1414→                        (merge-with concat
  1415→                                    acc
  1416→                                    (where-conds->sql state
  1417→                                                      table-info
  1418→                                                      table-name
  1419→                                                      where-cond)))
  1420→                      {:sql-conds []
  1421→                       :topics []}
  1422→                      (:or where-cond))]
  1423→          {:sql-conds (list* :or sql-conds)
  1424→           :topics topics})
  1425→
  1426→    :and (let [{:keys [sql-conds topics]}
  1427→               (reduce (fn [acc where-cond]
  1428→                         (merge-with concat
  1429→                                     acc
  1430→                                     (where-conds->sql state
  1431→                                                       table-info
  1432→                                                       table-name
  1433→                                                       where-cond)))
  1434→                       {:sql-conds []
  1435→                        :topics []}
  1436→                       (:and where-cond))]
  1437→           {:sql-conds (list* :and sql-conds)
  1438→            :topics topics})))
  1439→
  1440→(defn where-conds->sql [state table-info table-name where-conds]
  1441→  (if (contains? table-info table-name)
  1442→    (let [{:keys [sql-conds topics]}
  1443→          (reduce (fn [acc where-cond]
  1444→                    (merge-with concat
  1445→                                acc
  1446→                                (where-cond->sql state
  1447→                                                 table-info
  1448→                                                 table-name
  1449→                                                 where-cond)))
  1450→                  {:sql-conds []
  1451→                   :topics []}
  1452→                  where-conds)]
  1453→      {:sql-conds [:and sql-conds]
  1454→       :topics topics})
  1455→    (ex/throw-validation-err!
  1456→     :query
  1457→     (:root state)
  1458→     [{:expected 'valid-table
  1459→       :in (:in state)
  1460→       :message (str table-name " is not a recognized table.")}])))
  1461→
  1462→(defn needs-page-info? [form]
  1463→  (let [{:keys [offset limit before after first last]} (:option-map form)]
  1464→    (or offset limit before after first last)))
  1465→
  1466→(defn order-of-form [state table-info form]
  1467→  (when-let [{:keys [field direction]}
  1468→             (if-let [user-provided-field (get-in form [:option-map :order :k])]
  1469→               {:field (safe-order-by-field state
  1470→                                            table-info
  1471→                                            (:etype form)
  1472→                                            user-provided-field)
  1473→                :direction (get-in form [:option-map :order :direction])}
  1474→               (when (needs-page-info? form)
  1475→                 {:field (get-in table-info [(:etype form) :primary-key :field])
  1476→                  :direction :asc}))]
  1477→    (if (get-in form [:option-map :last])
  1478→      {:field field
  1479→       :reversed? true
  1480→       :direction (d/reverse-direction direction)}
  1481→      {:field field
  1482→       :reversed? false
  1483→       :direction direction})))
  1484→
  1485→(defn limit-of-form [form]
  1486→  (or (get-in form [:option-map :limit])
  1487→      (get-in form [:option-map :first])
  1488→      (get-in form [:option-map :last])))
  1489→
  1490→(defn where-conds-for-cursors [state table-info form]
  1491→  (let [{:keys [before after]} (:option-map form)
  1492→        cursor (or before after)]
  1493→    (when cursor
  1494→      (let [[_e a v] cursor
  1495→            field (get-in table-info [(:etype form) :attr-id->field a])
  1496→            direction (:direction (order-of-form state table-info form))]
  1497→        (when (not field)
  1498→          (ex/throw-validation-err!
  1499→           :query
  1500→           (:root state)
  1501→           [{:expected 'valid-cursor?
  1502→             :in (:in state)
  1503→             :message "Unable to determine field in cursor."}]))
  1504→        ;; TODO(byop): Secondary sorting field
  1505→        [[:cond {:path [(name field)]
  1506→                 :v [:args-map (if before
  1507→                                 (case direction
  1508→                                   :asc {:lt v}
  1509→                                   :desc {:gt v})
  1510→                                 (case direction
  1511→                                   :asc {:gt v}
  1512→                                   :desc {:lt v}))]}]]))))
  1513→
  1514→(defn relation-conds [table-info form child-form]
  1515→  (let [relation (get-in table-info [(:etype form)
  1516→                                     :relations
  1517→                                     (:k child-form)])]
  1518→    [:cond {:path [(name (:other-table-field relation))]
  1519→            :v [:value (keyword (str "t." (name (:table-field relation))))]}]))
  1520→
  1521→(defn sql-data-field [state table-info form sql-conds children-sql-query]
  1522→  {:select (if-let [aggregate (get-in form [:option-map :aggregate])]
  1523→             [[[:json_build_object
  1524→                "aggregate"
  1525→                [:json_build_object (name aggregate) [aggregate :t]]]]]
  1526→
  1527→             [[[(list*
  1528→                 :json_build_object
  1529→                 "rows"
  1530→                 [:json_agg
  1531→                  (list*
  1532→                   :json_build_object
  1533→                   "row" [:row_to_json :t]
  1534→                   (concat
  1535→                    (when-let [t-field (t-field table-info (:etype form))]
  1536→                      ["t" [:cast [:* [:extract [:epoch-from t-field]] 1000] :bigint]])
  1537→                    (when (seq (:child-forms form))
  1538→                      ["children" children-sql-query])))]
  1539→
  1540→                 (when-let [{:keys [field reversed?]}
  1541→                            (order-of-form state table-info form)]
  1542→                   ["page-info" [:json_build_object
  1543→                                 "sort-field" (name field)
  1544→                                 "reversed" reversed?]]))]]])
  1545→
  1546→   :from [[(merge
  1547→            {:select (select-fields state table-info (:etype form))
  1548→             :from (safe-table state table-info (:etype form))}
  1549→            (when-let [limit (limit-of-form form)]
  1550→              {:limit limit})
  1551→            (when-let [offset (get-in form [:option-map :offset])]
  1552→              {:offset offset})
  1553→            (when-let [{:keys [field direction]}
  1554→                       (order-of-form state table-info form)]
  1555→              ;; TODO(byop): Add in secondary ordering field if ordering field isn't unique
  1556→              {:order-by [[field direction]]})
  1557→            (when sql-conds
  1558→              {:where sql-conds}))
  1559→           :t]]})
  1560→
  1561→(defn forms->sql-query [ctx table-info forms]
  1562→  (let [{:keys [queries topics]}
  1563→        (reduce (fn [{:keys [topics queries]} form]
  1564→                  (let [where-conds (concat (get-in form [:option-map :where-conds])
  1565→                                            (where-conds-for-cursors (:state ctx)
  1566→                                                                     table-info
  1567→                                                                     form))
  1568→                        {sql-conds :sql-conds where-topics :topics}
  1569→                        (when (seq where-conds)
  1570→                          (where-conds->sql (:state ctx)
  1571→                                            table-info
  1572→                                            (:etype form)
  1573→                                            where-conds))
  1574→
  1575→                        aggregate (get-in form [:option-map :aggregate])
  1576→
  1577→                        _ (when (and aggregate (not (:admin? ctx)))
  1578→                            (ex/throw-validation-err!
  1579→                             :query
  1580→                             (:root (:state ctx))
  1581→                             [{:expected 'admin?
  1582→                               :in (apply conj (:in (:state ctx)) [:$ :aggregate])
  1583→                               :message "Aggregates are currently only available for admin queries."}]))
  1584→
  1585→                        {children-sql-query :sql-query children-topics :topics}
  1586→                        (when (and (not aggregate)
  1587→                                   (seq (:child-forms form)))
  1588→                          (forms->sql-query
  1589→                           ctx
  1590→                           table-info
  1591→                           (map (fn [child-form]
  1592→                                  (-> child-form
  1593→                                      (assoc :etype (:k child-form))
  1594→                                      (update-in [:option-map :where-conds]
  1595→                                                 (fn [conds]
  1596→                                                   (conj conds
  1597→                                                         (relation-conds table-info
  1598→                                                                         form
  1599→                                                                         child-form))))))
  1600→                                (:child-forms form))))
  1601→
  1602→                        query
  1603→                        [:json_build_object
  1604→                         "k" (:k form)
  1605→                         "etype" (:etype form)
  1606→
  1607→                         "data" (sql-data-field (:state ctx)
  1608→                                                table-info
  1609→                                                form
  1610→                                                sql-conds
  1611→                                                children-sql-query)]]
  1612→                    {:topics (concat topics
  1613→                                     where-topics
  1614→                                     children-topics)
  1615→                     :queries (conj queries query)}))
  1616→                {:topics []
  1617→                 :queries []}
  1618→                forms)]
  1619→    {:topics topics
  1620→     :sql-query {:select [[[(list* :json_build_array queries)]]]}}))
  1621→
  1622→(defn row->cursor [sort-field attr-id id-field row]
  1623→  (when row
  1624→    [(get row id-field)
  1625→     attr-id
  1626→     (get row (name sort-field))]))
  1627→
  1628→(defn relation-join-rows [table-info etype id child]
  1629→  (let [relation (get-in table-info [etype
  1630→                                     :relations
  1631→                                     (get child "k")])
  1632→
  1633→        child-id-field (get-in table-info [(get child "etype")
  1634→                                           :primary-key
  1635→                                           :attr-name])]
  1636→    (map (fn [data]
  1637→           (let [child-row (get data "row")
  1638→                 child-id (get child-row child-id-field)]
  1639→             (case (:direction relation)
  1640→               :forward [id
  1641→                         (:attr-id relation)
  1642→                         child-id]
  1643→               :reverse [child-id
  1644→                         (:attr-id relation)
  1645→                         id])))
  1646→         (get-in child ["data" "rows"]))))
  1647→
  1648→(defn rows->join-rows [table-info etype rows]
  1649→  (let [id-field (name (get-in table-info [etype :primary-key :field]))]
  1650→    (map (fn [{:strs [t row children]}]
  1651→           (let [id (get row id-field)]
  1652→             (concat
  1653→              (for [[k v] row]
  1654→                (let [a (get-in table-info [etype :fields (keyword k) :attr-id])
  1655→                      join-row [id a v]]
  1656→                  (if t
  1657→                    (conj join-row t)
  1658→                    join-row)))
  1659→              (mapcat (partial relation-join-rows table-info etype id)
  1660→                      children))))
  1661→         rows)))
  1662→
  1663→(defn rows->topics [table-info etype rows]
  1664→  (let [primary-key (get-in table-info [etype :primary-key])
  1665→        id-field (name (:field primary-key))
  1666→        id-attr (:attr-id primary-key)
  1667→
  1668→        ;; TODO(byop): narrow this down if there is a where clause
  1669→        catch-all [[#{:ea} '_ #{id-attr} '_]]
  1670→        entity-topics (map (fn [{:strs [row]}]
  1671→                             [#{:ea} #{(get row id-field)} '_ '_])
  1672→                           rows)
  1673→
  1674→        relations (get-in table-info [etype :relations])
  1675→        relation-topics
  1676→        (mapcat
  1677→         (fn [{:strs [children]}]
  1678→           (map (fn [child]
  1679→                  (let [relation (get relations (get child "k"))]
  1680→                    ;; TODO(byop): narrow these down to relevant topics for this relation
  1681→                    [#{:ea} '_ #{(:attr-id relation)} '_]))
  1682→                children))
  1683→         rows)]
  1684→    (concat catch-all
  1685→            entity-topics
  1686→            relation-topics)))
  1687→
  1688→(defn data->page-info [table-info etype data]
  1689→  (when-let [sort-field-name (get-in data ["page-info" "sort-field"])]
  1690→    (let [sort-field (safe-field {} table-info etype sort-field-name)
  1691→          reversed? (get-in data ["page-info" "reversed"])
  1692→          id-field (name (get-in table-info [etype :primary-key :field]))
  1693→          attr-id (get-in table-info [etype :fields sort-field :attr-id])
  1694→          start-row (-> (get data "rows")
  1695→                        first
  1696→                        (get "row"))
  1697→          end-row (-> (get data "rows")
  1698→                      last
  1699→                      (get "row"))]
  1700→      {:start-cursor (row->cursor sort-field attr-id id-field (if reversed?
  1701→                                                                end-row
  1702→                                                                start-row))
  1703→       :end-cursor (row->cursor sort-field attr-id id-field (if reversed?
  1704→                                                              start-row
  1705→                                                              end-row))})))
  1706→
  1707→(defn query-results->rows [table-info results]
  1708→  (mapv (fn [{:strs [k etype data]}]
  1709→          {:data
  1710→           {:k k
  1711→            :datalog-result
  1712→            (merge
  1713→             {:join-rows (set (rows->join-rows table-info etype (get data "rows")))
  1714→              :topics (rows->topics table-info etype (get data "rows"))}
  1715→             (when-let [aggregate (get data "aggregate")]
  1716→               {:aggregate aggregate})
  1717→             (when-let [page-info (data->page-info table-info etype data)]
  1718→               {:page-info page-info}))}
  1719→           :child-nodes (if-let [children (seq (map #(get % "children")
  1720→                                                    (get data "rows")))]
  1721→                          (query-results->rows table-info
  1722→                                               (reduce
  1723→                                                ;; We get a list of children per row. This collects the
  1724→                                                ;; children for all of the rows together
  1725→                                                (fn [acc children]
  1726→                                                  (map (fn [x y]
  1727→                                                         (update-in x ["data" "rows"] concat (get-in y ["data" "rows"])))
  1728→                                                       acc children))
  1729→                                                children))
  1730→                          [])})
  1731→        results))
  1732→
  1733→(defn collect-topics [query-result]
  1734→  (reduce (fn [topics result]
  1735→            (set/union topics
  1736→                       (-> result :data :datalog-result :topics)
  1737→                       (when-let [child-nodes (seq (:child-nodes result))]
  1738→                         (collect-topics child-nodes))))
  1739→          #{}
  1740→          query-result))
  1741→
  1742→(defn query-byop [ctx o]
  1743→  (let [{:keys [table-info]} ctx
  1744→        {:keys [forms]} (instaql-query->patterns ctx o)
  1745→        {:keys [sql-query topics]} (forms->sql-query ctx table-info forms)
  1746→        topics-id (random-uuid)
  1747→        _ (when-let [record-coarse-topics (:record-datalog-query-start! ctx)]
  1748→            (record-coarse-topics topics-id topics))
  1749→        sql-result (sql/select-string-keys
  1750→                    (:conn-pool (:db ctx))
  1751→                    (hsql/format sql-query :quoted true))
  1752→
  1753→        result (query-results->rows table-info
  1754→                                    (-> sql-result
  1755→                                        first
  1756→                                        (get "json_build_array")))]
  1757→
  1758→    (when-let [record-topics (:record-datalog-query-finish! ctx)]
  1759→      (record-topics topics-id {:topics (concat (collect-topics result)
  1760→                                                topics)}))
  1761→    result))
  1762→
  1763→(defn query [ctx o]
  1764→  (if (:table-info ctx)
  1765→    (query-byop ctx o)
  1766→    (query-normal ctx o)))
  1767→
  1768→(defn- join-rows->etype-maps
  1769→  "Takes a set of join-rows and returns maps from entity id to etype and
  1770→   etype to program."
  1771→  [acc {:keys [attrs rules rule-wheres]} data]
  1772→  (reduce
  1773→   (fn [acc join-rows]
  1774→     (reduce
  1775→      (fn [acc [e a]]
  1776→        (let [[etype label] (-> (attr-model/seek-by-id a attrs)
  1777→                                attr-model/fwd-ident-name)
  1778→              rule-where (get rule-wheres (:etype data))
  1779→              checked-by-rule-where? (and rule-where
  1780→                                          (= etype (:etype data))
  1781→                                          (not (:short-circuit? rule-where)))]
  1782→
  1783→          (cond-> acc
  1784→            checked-by-rule-where? (update-in [:etype->eids+program etype :checked-eids]
  1785→                                              (fnil conj #{}) e)
  1786→            true (update-in [:etype->eids+program etype :eids]
  1787→                            (fnil conj #{}) e)
  1788→            true (update-in [:etype->eids+program etype :program]
  1789→                            (fn [p]
  1790→                              (or p
  1791→                                  (rule-model/get-program! rules etype "view"))))
  1792→            true (update-in [:etype->eids+program etype :field-programs]
  1793→                            (fn [field-programs]
  1794→                              (if (contains? field-programs label)
  1795→                                field-programs
  1796→                                (assoc-some
  1797→                                 field-programs
  1798→                                 label
  1799→                                 (rule-model/get-field-program! rules etype label))))))))
  1800→
  1801→      acc
  1802→      join-rows))
  1803→   acc
  1804→   (get-in data [:datalog-result :join-rows])))
  1805→
  1806→(defn extract-permission-helpers*
  1807→  ([acc ctx instaql-res]
  1808→   (reduce (fn [acc {:keys [data child-nodes]}]
  1809→             (let [next-acc (-> acc
  1810→                                (assoc-in [:query-cache (:datalog-query data)]
  1811→                                          (:datalog-result data))
  1812→                                (join-rows->etype-maps ctx data))]
  1813→               (if (seq child-nodes)
  1814→                 (extract-permission-helpers* next-acc ctx child-nodes)
  1815→                 next-acc)))
  1816→           acc
  1817→           instaql-res)))
  1818→
  1819→(defn extract-permission-helpers
  1820→  "Takes the result of `query` and generates a query cache of
  1821→   datalog-query -> datalog-result, and maps for etype->program and eid->type."
  1822→  ([ctx instaql-res]
  1823→   (extract-permission-helpers {:etype->eids+program {}
  1824→                                :query-cache {}}
  1825→                               ctx
  1826→                               instaql-res))
  1827→
  1828→  ([acc ctx instaql-res]
  1829→   (tracer/with-span! {:name "extract-permission-helpers"}
  1830→     (extract-permission-helpers* acc ctx instaql-res))))
  1831→
  1832→(defn viewable-triple? [attrs etype+eid->check [e a]]
  1833→  (let [[etype label] (-> (attr-model/seek-by-id a attrs)
  1834→                          attr-model/fwd-ident-name)
  1835→        view-check (get etype+eid->check [etype e])
  1836→        field-check (get etype+eid->check [etype e label] {:result true})]
  1837→    (and (:result view-check)
  1838→         (:result field-check))))
  1839→
  1840→(defn viewable-join-row? [attrs etype+eid->check join-row]
  1841→  (every? (partial viewable-triple? attrs etype+eid->check) join-row))
  1842→
  1843→(defn permissioned-node [{:keys [attrs] :as ctx} etype+eid->check res]
  1844→  (let [cleaned-join-rows (->> res
  1845→                               :data
  1846→                               :datalog-result
  1847→                               :join-rows
  1848→                               (filter (partial viewable-join-row? attrs etype+eid->check))
  1849→                               set)
  1850→        cleaned-page-info
  1851→        (when (get-in res [:data :datalog-result :page-info])
  1852→          (let [filtered-rows (seq (filter
  1853→                                    (partial viewable-triple? attrs etype+eid->check)
  1854→                                    (get-in res [:data
  1855→                                                 :datalog-result
  1856→                                                 :page-info-rows])))]
  1857→            {:start-cursor (first filtered-rows)
  1858→             :end-cursor (last filtered-rows)
  1859→             ;; nb: this may be incorrect if rows are filtered by permissions
  1860→             :has-next-page? (get-in res [:data
  1861→                                          :datalog-result
  1862→                                          :page-info
  1863→                                          :has-next-page?])
  1864→             :has-previous-page? (get-in res [:data
  1865→                                              :datalog-result
  1866→                                              :page-info
  1867→                                              :has-previous-page?])}))]
  1868→    (-> res
  1869→        (assoc-in [:data :datalog-result :join-rows] cleaned-join-rows)
  1870→        (ucoll/assoc-in-when [:data :datalog-result :page-info] cleaned-page-info)
  1871→        (ucoll/dissoc-in [:data :datalog-result :page-info-rows])
  1872→        (update :child-nodes
  1873→                (fn [child-nodes]
  1874→                  (if (empty? cleaned-join-rows)
  1875→                    []
  1876→                    (->> child-nodes
  1877→                         (map (partial permissioned-node ctx etype+eid->check))
  1878→                         (filter
  1879→                          (fn [node]
  1880→                            (seq (-> node :data :datalog-result :join-rows))))
  1881→                         vec)))))))
  1882→
  1883→(defn entity-map [{:keys [datalog-query-fn attrs] :as ctx}
  1884→                  query-cache
  1885→                  etype
  1886→                  eid]
  1887→  (let [datalog-query [[:ea eid (attr-model/ea-ids-for-etype etype attrs)]]
  1888→        datalog-result
  1889→        (or (get query-cache datalog-query)
  1890→            (datalog-query-fn ctx datalog-query))]
  1891→    (entity-model/datalog-result->map ctx datalog-result)))
  1892→
  1893→(defn preload-entity-maps
  1894→  "Returns a query cache for entities that are missing from the existing
  1895→  query cache, but that we'll need to fetch for a rule.
  1896→  If the user uses `:fields` in their query to limit what they fetch, we'll
  1897→  still need to fetch the full object to perform permission checks. We do it
  1898→  in a batch to reduce latency."
  1899→  [{:keys [datalog-query-fn attrs] :as ctx} query-cache etype->eids+program]
  1900→  (let [patterns (keep (fn [[etype {:keys [eids program field-programs]}]]
  1901→                         (when (or program
  1902→                                   (seq field-programs))
  1903→                           (let [attr-ids (attr-model/ea-ids-for-etype etype attrs)
  1904→                                 missing-eids (reduce (fn [acc eid]
  1905→                                                        (if (contains? query-cache [[:ea eid attr-ids]])
  1906→                                                          acc
  1907→                                                          (conj acc eid)))
  1908→                                                      #{}
  1909→                                                      eids)]
  1910→                             (when (seq missing-eids)
  1911→                               {:patterns [[:ea missing-eids attr-ids]]}))))
  1912→                       etype->eids+program)]
  1913→    (when (seq patterns)
  1914→      (let [query {:children {:pattern-groups patterns}}
  1915→            result (datalog-query-fn ctx query)]
  1916→        (reduce (fn [cache {:keys [result datalog-query]}]
  1917→                  (let [eid->join-rows (reduce (fn [acc join-row]
  1918→                                                 (update acc
  1919→                                                         (ffirst join-row)
  1920→                                                         (fnil conj #{})
  1921→                                                         join-row))
  1922→                                               {}
  1923→                                               (:join-rows result))
  1924→                        attr-ids (-> datalog-query
  1925→                                     first
  1926→                                     last)]
  1927→                    (reduce-kv (fn [cache eid join-rows]
  1928→                                 (assoc cache [[:ea eid attr-ids]] {:join-rows join-rows
  1929→                                                                    :symbol-values {}
  1930→                                                                    :topics [[#{:ea} #{eid} attr-ids '_]]}))
  1931→                               cache
  1932→                               eid->join-rows)))
  1933→                {}
  1934→                (:data result))))))
  1935→
  1936→(defn get-etype+eid-check-result! [ctx
  1937→                                   {:keys [etype->eids+program query-cache]}
  1938→                                   rule-params]
  1939→  (tracer/with-span! {:name "instaql/get-eid-check-result!"}
  1940→    (let [preloaded-entity-maps (tracer/with-span! {:name "instaql/preload-entity-maps"}
  1941→                                  (let [res (preload-entity-maps ctx
  1942→                                                                 query-cache
  1943→                                                                 etype->eids+program)]
  1944→                                    (tracer/add-data! {:attributes {:entity-count (count res)}})
  1945→                                    res))
  1946→          query-cache (merge query-cache preloaded-entity-maps)
  1947→
  1948→          acc-view-program (fn [acc etype {:keys [checked-eids eid program]}]
  1949→                             (let [k [etype eid]]
  1950→                               (cond (contains? checked-eids eid)
  1951→                                     (assoc-in acc
  1952→                                               [:no-programs k]
  1953→                                               {:result true
  1954→                                                :checked-by-rule-where true
  1955→                                                :program program})

  2022→(defn rule-wheres->where-conds [attrs etype wheres]
  2023→  (let [forms {etype {:$ {:where wheres}}}]

  2025→         (->forms! attrs)

  2027→         :option-map

  2030→(defn prefix-all-clauses
  2031→  "(prefix-all-clauses \"owner\" {\"id\" 1, \"tags.name\" \"tag\"})
  2032→   => {\"owner.id\" 1, \"owner.tags.name\" \"tag-name\"} "
  2033→  [prefix clauses]
  2034→  (reduce-kv (fn [acc k v]
  2035→               (case k
  2036→                 (:or :and)
  2037→                 (assoc acc k (mapv (partial prefix-all-clauses prefix) v))
  2038→
  2039→                 (assoc acc (str prefix "." (name k)) v)))
  2040→             {}
  2041→             clauses))

  2043→(defn get-rule-wheres [ctx rule-params rules o]
  2044→  (when (use-rule-wheres? ctx o)
  2045→    (tracer/with-span! {:name "instaql/get-rule-wheres"}
  2046→      (let [{:keys [referenced-etypes]} (instaql-query->patterns ctx o)
  2047→            programs (keep (fn [etype]

  2053→              (cel/get-all-where-clauses ctx rule-params programs))
  2054→            rule-wheres
  2055→            (reduce-kv
  2056→             (fn [acc etype result]

  2058→                 (when-let [t (:thrown result)]

  2062→                   (rule-wheres->where-conds (:attrs ctx)
  2063→                                             etype
  2064→                                             (:where-clauses result)))

  2066→                                   :where-clauses (:where-clauses result)})

  2069→                     {:name "instaql/rule-where-exception"
  2070→                      :attributes {:code (:code (rule-model/get-program! rules
  2071→                                                                         etype
  2072→                                                                         "view"))
  2073→                                   :error e}}
  2074→                     acc))))
  2075→             {}
  2076→             program-results)]
  2077→        (tracer/add-data! {:attributes {:rule-wheres rule-wheres}})
  2078→        rule-wheres))))

  2080→(defn update-where-with-rule-refs [initial-etype attrs rule-wheres where k v]
  2081→  (loop [[segment & rest-path] (string/split (name k) #"\.")
  2082→         current-path [segment]
  2083→         etype initial-etype
  2084→         where (assoc where k v)]
  2085→    (if-let [segment-etype (link-etype attrs etype segment)]
  2086→      (let [rule-where (if (-> rule-wheres (get segment-etype) :short-circuit?)
  2087→                         {:id (str (random-uuid))}
  2088→                         (-> rule-wheres (get segment-etype) :where-clauses))
  2089→            where (if-not (seq rule-where)
  2090→                    where
  2091→                    (update where
  2092→                            :and
  2093→                            (fnil conj [])
  2094→                            (prefix-all-clauses (string/join "." current-path) rule-where)))]
  2095→        (if-not (seq rest-path)
  2096→          where
  2097→          (recur rest-path
  2098→                 (conj current-path (first rest-path))
  2099→                 segment-etype
  2100→                 where)))
  2101→      where)))

     1→/// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
     2→/// SharedMutations.swift
     3→/// Explicit mutation methods for @Shared InstantDB collections
     4→/// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
     5→///
     6→/// This file provides explicit mutation methods (create, delete, update, link, unlink)
     7→/// that bypass the diff-based save() mechanism. These methods generate specific
     8→/// transaction chunks and send them directly to the server.
     9→///
    10→/// ## Why This Exists
    11→///
    12→/// The default `$collection.withLock { }` approach triggers `save()` which computes
    13→/// diffs between local and server state. This causes issues:
    14→/// - Race conditions when multiple subscriptions exist for the same namespace
    15→/// - Ghost deletions on app start
    16→/// - Re-sync of deleted items when creating new items
    17→///
    18→/// ## How It Works
    19→///
    20→/// Instead of computing diffs, these methods:
    21→/// 1. Apply the change optimistically to local state
    22→/// 2. Generate a specific transaction chunk for the operation
    23→/// 3. Send the chunk directly to the server via `directTransact()`
    24→///
    25→/// ## Usage
    26→///
    27→/// ```swift
    28→/// @Shared(.instantSync(Schema.goals)) var goals: [Goal]
    29→///
    30→/// // Create - explicit operation, no diff
    31→/// try await $goals.create(Goal(id: id, title: "New Goal"))
    32→///
    33→/// // Delete - explicit operation, no diff
    34→/// try await $goals.delete(id: goalId)
    35→///
    36→/// // Update - explicit operation, no diff
    37→/// try await $goals.update(id: goalId) { $0.title = "Updated" }
    38→///
    39→/// // Link - explicit operation
    40→/// try await $goals.link(goalId, "creator", to: profileId, namespace: "profiles")
    41→/// ```
    42→///
    43→/// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
    44→
    45→import Dependencies
    46→import Foundation
    47→import IdentifiedCollections
    48→import InstantDB
    49→import Sharing
    50→
    51→// MARK: - Mutation Callbacks
    52→
    53→/// TanStack Query-style callbacks for mutation operations.
    54→///
    55→/// These callbacks provide hooks into the mutation lifecycle, allowing you to
    56→/// respond to different stages of a mutation operation.
    57→///
    58→/// ## Why This Exists
    59→///
    60→/// TanStack Query popularized this callback pattern for mutations because it provides:
    61→/// - **Optimistic UI updates** via `onMutate` (before the server responds)
    62→/// - **Success handling** via `onSuccess` (update UI, show toast, navigate)
    63→/// - **Error handling** via `onError` (show error, revert optimistic update)
    64→/// - **Cleanup** via `onSettled` (always runs, like `finally`)
    65→///
    66→/// ## Example
    67→///
    68→/// ```swift
    69→/// $posts.createPost(
    70→///   content: "Hello world",
    71→///   callbacks: MutationCallbacks(
    72→///     onMutate: {
    73→///       print("Creating post...")
    74→///     },
    75→///     onSuccess: { post in
    76→///       print("Created post: \(post.id)")
    77→///     },
    78→///     onError: { error in
    79→///       print("Failed: \(error)")
    80→///     },
    81→///     onSettled: {
    82→///       print("Done (success or failure)")
    83→///     }
    84→///   )
    85→/// )
    86→/// ```
    87→public struct MutationCallbacks<T: Sendable>: Sendable {
    88→  /// Called immediately before the mutation is executed.
    89→  /// Use this for optimistic updates or loading states.
    90→  public var onMutate: (@Sendable () -> Void)?
    91→  
    92→  /// Called when the mutation succeeds.
    93→  /// Receives the result of the mutation (e.g., the created/updated entity).
    94→  public var onSuccess: (@Sendable (T) -> Void)?
    95→  
    96→  /// Called when the mutation fails.
    97→  /// Receives the error that occurred.
    98→  public var onError: (@Sendable (Error) -> Void)?
    99→  
   100→  /// Called after the mutation completes, regardless of success or failure.
   101→  /// Use this for cleanup, like dismissing loading states.
   102→  public var onSettled: (@Sendable () -> Void)?
   103→  
   104→  public init(
   105→    onMutate: (@Sendable () -> Void)? = nil,
   106→    onSuccess: (@Sendable (T) -> Void)? = nil,
   107→    onError: (@Sendable (Error) -> Void)? = nil,
   108→    onSettled: (@Sendable () -> Void)? = nil
   109→  ) {
   110→    self.onMutate = onMutate
   111→    self.onSuccess = onSuccess
   112→    self.onError = onError
   113→    self.onSettled = onSettled
   114→  }
   115→}
   116→
   117→// MARK: - MutationCallbacks Convenience Methods
   118→
   119→extension MutationCallbacks {
   120→  /// Create callbacks with only an error handler.
   121→  ///
   122→  /// This is the most common use case for fire-and-forget mutations where
   123→  /// you only care about logging errors.
   124→  ///
   125→  /// ## Example
   126→  /// ```swift
   127→  /// $posts.updateTitle(id, to: "New Title", callbacks: .onError { error in
   128→  ///     print("Failed: \(error)")
   129→  /// })
   130→  /// ```
   131→  public static func onError(_ handler: @escaping @Sendable (Error) -> Void) -> MutationCallbacks {
   132→    MutationCallbacks(onError: handler)
   133→  }
   134→
   135→  /// Create callbacks with only a success handler.
   136→  ///
   137→  /// ## Example
   138→  /// ```swift
   139→  /// $posts.createPost(title: "Hello", callbacks: .onSuccess { post in
   140→  ///     print("Created: \(post.id)")
   141→  /// })
   142→  /// ```
   143→  public static func onSuccess(_ handler: @escaping @Sendable (T) -> Void) -> MutationCallbacks {
   144→    MutationCallbacks(onSuccess: handler)
   145→  }
   146→
   147→  /// Create callbacks with only a settled handler.
   148→  ///
   149→  /// ## Example
   150→  /// ```swift
   151→  /// $posts.deletePost(id, callbacks: .onSettled {
   152→  ///     isLoading = false
   153→  /// })
   154→  /// ```
   155→  public static func onSettled(_ handler: @escaping @Sendable () -> Void) -> MutationCallbacks {
   156→    MutationCallbacks(onSettled: handler)
   157→  }
   158→}
