   138→   138→;; init
   139→   139→
   140→   140→(defn get-attrs [app]
   141→   141→  (if-let [connection-string (-> app :connection_string)]
   142→   142→    ;; TODO(byop): Separate connection for byop app
   143→   143→    (pg-introspect/introspect (aurora/conn-pool :read) (or (->> connection-string
   144→   144→                                                                (app-model/decrypt-connection-string (:id app))
   145→   145→                                                                uri/query-map
   146→   146→                                                                :currentSchema)
   147→   147→                                                           "public"))
   148→   148→    {:attrs (attr-model/get-by-app-id (:id app))}))
   149→   149→
   150→   150→(defn- handle-init! [store sess-id event]
   151→   151→  (let [{:keys [refresh-token client-event-id versions]
   152→   152→         admin-token :__admin-token} event
   153→   153→        prev-auth   (:session/auth (rs/session store sess-id))
   154→   154→        _           (when prev-auth
   155→   155→                      (ex/throw-validation-err! :init event [{:message "`init` has already run for this session."}]))
   156→   156→        app-id      (ex/get-param! event [:app-id] uuid-util/coerce)
   157→   157→        app         (app-model/get-by-id! {:id app-id})
   158→   158→        {:keys [attrs]} (get-attrs app)
   159→   159→        user        (when refresh-token
   160→   160→                      (app-user-model/get-by-refresh-token!
   161→   161→                       {:app-id app-id :refresh-token refresh-token}))
   162→   162→        creator     (instant-user-model/get-by-app-id {:app-id app-id})
   163→   163→        admin?      (and admin-token
   164→   164→                         (boolean
   165→   165→                          (app-admin-token-model/fetch! {:app-id app-id
   166→   166→                                                         :token admin-token})))
   167→   167→        auth        {:app    app
   168→   168→                     :user   user
   169→   169→                     :admin? admin?}
   170→   170→        features (get-supported-features versions)]
   171→   171→    (tracer/add-data! {:attributes (auth-and-creator-attrs auth creator versions)})
   172→   172→    (apply rs/assoc-session! store sess-id
   173→   173→           :session/auth auth
   174→   174→           :session/creator creator
   175→   175→           :session/features features
   176→   176→           (concat
   177→   177→            (when versions
   178→   178→              [:session/versions versions])
   179→   179→            (when (supports-skip-attrs? features)
   180→   180→              [:session/attrs-hash (hash attrs)])))
   181→   181→    (rs/send-event! store app-id sess-id {:op              :init-ok
   182→   182→                                          :session-id      sess-id
   183→   183→                                          :client-event-id client-event-id
   184→   184→                                          :auth            auth
   185→   185→                                          :attrs           attrs})))
   186→   186→
   187→   187→(defn- handle-sse-init! [store sess-id event]
   188→   188→  (rs/send-event! store (:app-id event) sess-id (select-keys event
   189→   189→                                                             [:op
   190→   190→                                                              :machine-id
   191→   191→                                                              :session-id
   192→   192→                                                              :sse-token])))
   193→   193→
   194→   194→(defn admin-init! [store sess-id ctx]
   195→   195→  (let [app (:app ctx)
   196→   196→        attrs (:attrs ctx)
   197→   197→        user (:current-user ctx)
   198→   198→        admin? (:admin? ctx)
   199→   199→        auth {:app app
   200→   200→              :user user
   201→   201→              :admin? admin?}
   202→   202→        creator (:creator ctx)]
   203→   203→    (apply rs/assoc-session! store sess-id
   204→   204→           :session/auth auth
   205→   205→           :session/creator creator
   206→   206→           (concat (when-let [versions (:versions ctx)]
   207→   207→                     [:session/versions versions])
   208→   208→                   [:session/attrs-hash (hash attrs)]))))
   209→   209→
   210→   210→(defn- get-auth! [store sess-id]
   211→   211→  (let [{:session/keys [auth]} (rs/session store sess-id)]
   212→   212→    (when-not (:app auth)
   213→   213→      (ex/throw-validation-err! :init {:sess-id sess-id} [{:message "`init` has not run for this session."}]))
   214→   214→    auth))
   215→   215→
   216→   216→(defn db-read-level [app-id]
   217→   217→  (if (and (flags/toggled? :refresh-from-replica)
   218→   218→           (not= app-id config/instant-config-app-id))
   219→   219→    :read-replica
   220→   220→    :read))
   221→   221→
   222→   222→(defn- handle-add-query! [store sess-id {:keys [q client-event-id return-type inference?] :as _event}]
   223→   223→  (let [{:keys [app user admin?]} (get-auth! store sess-id)
   224→   224→        {app-id :id} app
   225→   225→        instaql-queries (rs/session-instaql-queries store app-id sess-id)]
   226→   226→    (cond
   227→   227→      (contains? instaql-queries q)
   228→   228→      (rs/send-event! store app-id sess-id {:op :add-query-exists :q q
   229→   229→                                            :client-event-id client-event-id})
   230→   230→
   231→   231→      (nil? q)
   232→   232→      (ex/throw-validation-err! :add-query
   233→   233→                                {:q q}
   234→   234→                                [{:message "Query can not be null."}])
   235→   235→
   236→   236→      :else
   237→   237→      (let [return-type (keyword (or return-type "join-rows"))
   238→   238→            processed-tx-id (rs/get-processed-tx-id store app-id)
   239→   239→            {:keys [table-info]} (get-attrs app)
   240→   240→            attrs (attr-model/get-by-app-id app-id)
   241→   241→            ctx {:db {:conn-pool (aurora/conn-pool (db-read-level app-id))}
   242→   242→                 :datalog-loader (rs/upsert-datalog-loader! store sess-id d/make-loader)
   243→   243→                 :session-id     sess-id
   244→   244→                 :app-id         app-id
   245→   245→                 :attrs          attrs
   246→   246→                 :table-info     table-info
   247→   247→                 :admin?         admin?
   248→   248→                 :current-user   user}
   249→   249→            {:keys [instaql-result result-meta]} (rq/instaql-query-reactive! store ctx q return-type inference?)]
   250→   250→        (rs/send-event! store app-id sess-id {:op :add-query-ok
   251→   251→                                              :q q
   252→   252→                                              :result instaql-result
   253→   253→                                              :result-meta result-meta
   254→   254→                                              :processed-tx-id processed-tx-id
   255→   255→                                              :client-event-id client-event-id})))))
   256→   256→
   257→   257→(defn- handle-start-sync! [store sess-id {:keys [q client-event-id op] :as _event}]
   258→   258→  (let [{:keys [app user admin?]} (get-auth! store sess-id)
   259→   259→        {app-id :id} app]
   260→   260→    (cond
   261→   261→      (nil? q)
   262→   262→      (ex/throw-validation-err! :start-sync
   263→   263→                                {:q q}
   264→   264→                                [{:message "Query can not be null."}])
   265→   265→
   266→   266→      (not admin?)
   267→   267→      (ex/throw-validation-err! :start-sync
   268→   268→                                {:q q}
   269→   269→                                [{:message "start-sync is currently supported for admins only."}])
   270→   270→
   271→   271→      :else
   272→   272→      (let [attrs (attr-model/get-by-app-id app-id)
   273→   273→            ctx {:db {:conn-pool (aurora/conn-pool :read)}
   274→   274→                 :session-id sess-id
   275→   275→                 :app-id app-id
   276→   276→                 :attrs attrs
   277→   277→                 :admin? admin?
   278→   278→                 :current-user user}
   279→   279→            {:keys [start cancel canceled?] :as process}
   280→   280→            (sync-table/create-sync-process ctx q)
   281→   281→
   282→   282→            sub-id (random-uuid)
   283→   283→            token (random-uuid)
   284→   284→            query-ent (rs/register-sync-query store
   285→   285→                                              app-id
   286→   286→                                              sess-id
   287→   287→                                              sub-id
   288→   288→                                              (:coarse-topics process)
   289→   289→                                              process)
   290→   290→            receive-q (-> (rs/session store sess-id)
   291→   291→                          :session/socket
   292→   292→                          :receive-q)
   293→   293→
   294→   294→            _ (rs/send-event! store app-id sess-id
   295→   295→                              {:op :start-sync-ok
   296→   296→                               :q q
   297→   297→                               :client-event-id client-event-id
   298→   298→                               :subscription-id (:sync/id query-ent)
   299→   299→                               :token token})
   300→   300→            in-progress-stmts (sql/make-statement-tracker)
   301→   301→
   302→   302→            pending-handler-id (random-uuid)
   303→   303→            session (rs/session store sess-id)
   304→   304→            exceptions-silencer (atom false)
   305→   305→
   306→   306→            f (ua/vfuture
   307→   307→               (try
   308→   308→                 (binding [sql/*in-progress-stmts* in-progress-stmts
   309→   309→                           tracer/*silence-exceptions?* exceptions-silencer]
   310→   310→                   (start
   311→   311→                    {:batch-size 100
   312→   312→                     :on-batch (fn [batch]
   313→   313→                                 (rs/send-event! store app-id sess-id
   314→   314→                                                 {:op :sync-load-batch
   315→   315→                                                  :subscription-id (:sync/id query-ent)
   316→   316→                                                  :join-rows batch}))
   317→   317→
   318→   318→                     :on-init-finish (fn [{:keys [topics tx-id]}]
   319→   319→                                       (sync-sub-model/create! {:id sub-id
   320→   320→                                                                :app-id app-id
   321→   321→                                                                :query q
   322→   322→                                                                :user-id (:id user)
   323→   323→                                                                :admin? admin?
   324→   324→                                                                :token token
   325→   325→                                                                :topics topics})
   326→   326→                                        ;; Make sure this happens before we update the store
   327→   327→                                        ;; or else we could get a refresh before we send init
   328→   328→                                       (rs/send-event! store app-id sess-id
   329→   329→                                                       {:op :sync-init-finish
   330→   330→                                                        :subscription-id sub-id
   331→   331→                                                        :tx-id tx-id})
   332→   332→                                       (rs/sync-query-update-init store
   333→   333→                                                                  app-id
   334→   334→                                                                  (:db/id query-ent)
   335→   335→                                                                  tx-id
   336→   336→                                                                  topics)
   337→   337→                                        ;; This will cause us to catch up on any transactions that were
   338→   338→                                        ;; handled while we were syncing
   339→   339→                                       (receive-queue/put! receive-q
   340→   340→                                                           {:op :refresh-sync-table
   341→   341→                                                            :app-id (:app-id ctx)
   342→   342→                                                            :session-id sess-id
   343→   343→                                                            :subscription-id (:sync/id query-ent)}))}))
   344→   344→                 (catch Exception e
   345→   345→                   (when-not (canceled?)
   346→   346→                     (throw e)))
   347→   347→                 (finally
   348→   348→                   (remove-pending-handler session pending-handler-id))))]
   349→   349→        (add-pending-handler session
   350→   350→                             {:before-cancel cancel
   351→   351→                              :future f
   352→   352→                              :op op
   353→   353→                              :in-progress-stmts in-progress-stmts
   354→   354→                              :silence-exceptions (fn [x]
   355→   355→                                                    (reset! exceptions-silencer x))}
   356→   356→                             pending-handler-id)))))
   357→   357→
   358→   358→(defn- handle-remove-sync! [store sess-id {:keys [keep-subscription] :as event}]
   359→   359→  (let [subscription-id (ex/get-param! event [:subscription-id] uuid-util/coerce)
   360→   360→        app-id (-> (get-auth! store sess-id) :app :id)
   361→   361→        sync-ent (rs/get-sync-query store app-id sess-id subscription-id)]
   362→   362→    (when sync-ent
   363→   363→      (rs/remove-sync-query store app-id sess-id subscription-id)
   364→   364→      (when-not keep-subscription
   365→   365→        (sync-sub-model/delete! {:id (:sync/subscription-id sync-ent)
   366→   366→                                 :app-id app-id})))))
   367→   367→
   368→   368→(defn- handle-refresh-sync-table! [store sess-id {:keys [subscription-id] :as _event}]
   369→   369→  (let [{:keys [app]} (get-auth! store sess-id)
   370→   370→        {app-id :id} app
   371→   371→        ent (rs/get-sync-query store app-id sess-id subscription-id)]
   372→   372→    (when ent
   373→   373→      (let [unread-txes (rs/sync-query-unread-txes app-id ent)]
   374→   374→        (when (seq unread-txes)
   375→   375→          (let [max-txes 100
   376→   376→                txes-to-send (take max-txes unread-txes)]
   377→   377→            (rs/send-event! store app-id sess-id
   378→   378→                            {:op :sync-update-triples
   379→   379→                             :subscription-id subscription-id
   380→   380→                             :txes txes-to-send})
   381→   381→            (rs/sync-query-update-sent-tx store app-id (:db/id ent) (:tx-id (last txes-to-send)))
   382→   382→
   383→   383→            ;; There are still more txes to process, but we don't want to send too many in a single
   384→   384→            ;; websocket packet, so requeue
   385→   385→            (when (< max-txes (count unread-txes))
   386→   386→              (receive-queue/put! (-> (rs/session store sess-id) :session/socket :receive-q)
   387→   387→                                  {:op :refresh-sync-table
   388→   388→                                   :subscription-id subscription-id
   389→   389→                                   :app-id app-id
   390→   390→                                   :session-id sess-id}))))))))
   391→   391→
   392→   392→(defn- handle-resync-table! [store sess-id event]
   393→   393→  (let [{:keys [app user admin?]} (get-auth! store sess-id)
   394→   394→        {app-id :id} app
   395→   395→        tx-id (ex/get-param! event [:tx-id] (fn [v] (try (long v) (catch Throwable _ nil))))
   396→   396→        subscription-id (ex/get-param! event [:subscription-id] uuid-util/coerce)
   397→   397→        token (ex/get-param! event [:token] uuid-util/coerce)
   398→   398→        record (sync-sub-model/get-by-id-with-topics! {:id subscription-id
   399→   399→                                                       :token token
   400→   400→                                                       :admin? admin?
   401→   401→                                                       :user-id (:id user)})]
   402→   402→
   403→   403→    ;; TODO(sync-table): This will be replaced by a check that the tx is still in the db
   404→   404→    ;;                   when we have stable storage for the tx-data
   405→   405→    ;; Commenting it out for now so that we don't get a bunch of reconnects while testing
   406→   406→    #_(when-not (ucoll/seek (fn [x]
   407→   407→                              (= (:tx-id x) tx-id))
   408→   408→                            @rs/sync-table-txes)
   409→   409→        (ex/throw-validation-err! :subscription
   410→   410→                                  {:subscription-id subscription-id
   411→   411→                                   :tx-id tx-id}
   412→   412→                                  [{:message "transactions for the subscription are no longer available"}]))
   413→   413→    (rs/sync-query-resync store app-id sess-id
   414→   414→                          (:id record) tx-id (:topics record))
   415→   415→    (receive-queue/put! (-> (rs/session store sess-id) :session/socket :receive-q)
   416→   416→                        {:op :refresh-sync-table
   417→   417→                         :subscription-id subscription-id
   418→   418→                         :app-id app-id
   419→   419→                         :session-id sess-id})))
   420→   420→
   421→   421→(defn- handle-remove-query! [store sess-id {:keys [q client-event-id] :as _event}]
   422→   422→  (let [{:keys [app]} (get-auth! store sess-id)]
   423→   423→    (rs/remove-query! store (:id app) sess-id q)
   424→   424→    (rs/send-event! store (:id app) sess-id {:op :remove-query-ok :q q
   425→   425→                                             :client-event-id client-event-id})))
   426→   426→
   427→   427→(defn- recompute-instaql-query!
   428→   428→  [{:keys [store current-user app-id sess-id attrs table-info admin?]}
   429→   429→   {:keys [instaql-query/query instaql-query/return-type instaql-query/inference?
   430→   430→           instaql-query/forms-hash]}]
   431→   431→  (let [ctx {:db {:conn-pool (aurora/conn-pool (db-read-level app-id))}
   432→   432→             :session-id sess-id
   433→   433→             :app-id app-id
   434→   434→             :attrs attrs
   435→   435→             ;; Will only be present for byop apps
   436→   436→             :table-info table-info
   437→   437→             :current-user current-user
   438→   438→             :admin? admin?}
   439→   439→        start-ms (System/currentTimeMillis)
   440→   440→        {:keys [instaql-result result-meta result-changed? instaql-topic?]}
   441→   441→        (rq/instaql-query-reactive! store ctx query return-type inference?)
   442→   442→        end-ms (System/currentTimeMillis)]
   443→   443→    {:instaql-query query
   444→   444→     :instaql-query-hash forms-hash
   445→   445→     :instaql-result instaql-result
   446→   446→     :result-meta result-meta
   447→   447→     :result-changed? result-changed?
   448→   448→     :duration-ms (- end-ms start-ms)
   449→   449→     :instaql-topic? instaql-topic?}))
   450→   450→
   451→   451→(defn- handle-refresh! [store sess-id event debug-info]
   452→   452→  (e2e-tracer/invalidator-tracking-step! {:tx-id (:tx-id event)
   453→   453→                                          :tx-created-at (:tx-created-at event)
   454→   454→                                          :name "start-refresh"
   455→   455→                                          :attributes {:session-id sess-id}})
   456→   456→  (let [auth (get-auth! store sess-id)
   457→   457→        app-id (-> auth :app :id)
   458→   458→        current-user (-> auth :user)
   459→   459→        admin? (-> auth :admin?)
   460→   460→        {:keys [attrs table-info]} (get-attrs (:app auth))
   461→   461→        stale-queries (rs/get-stale-instaql-queries store app-id sess-id)
   462→   462→        opts {:store store
   463→   463→              :app-id app-id
   464→   464→              :current-user current-user
   465→   465→              :sess-id sess-id
   466→   466→              :attrs attrs
   467→   467→              :table-info table-info
   468→   468→              :admin? admin?}
   469→   469→        processed-tx-id (rs/get-processed-tx-id store app-id)
   470→   470→        _ (reset! debug-info {:processed-tx-id processed-tx-id
   471→   471→                              :instaql-queries (map :instaql-query/query stale-queries)})
   472→   472→        recompute-results (->> stale-queries
   473→   473→                               (ua/pmap (partial recompute-instaql-query! opts)))
   474→   474→        {computations true spam false} (group-by :result-changed? recompute-results)
   475→   475→        num-spam (count spam)
   476→   476→        num-computations (count computations)
   477→   477→        num-recomputations (count recompute-results)
   478→   478→        tracer-attrs {:num-recomputations num-recomputations
   479→   479→                      :num-spam num-spam
   480→   480→                      :num-computations num-computations
   481→   481→                      :dropped-spam? true
   482→   482→                      :tx-latency-ms (e2e-tracer/tx-latency-ms (:tx-created-at event))}
   483→   483→        {prev-attrs-hash :session/attrs-hash
   484→   484→         features :session/features} (rs/session store sess-id)
   485→   485→        can-skip-attrs? (supports-skip-attrs? features)
   486→   486→        attrs-hash      (hash attrs)
   487→   487→        attrs-changed?  (not= prev-attrs-hash attrs-hash)]
   488→   488→    (doseq [{:keys [instaql-query instaql-query-hash duration-ms instaql-topic?]} spam]
   489→   489→      (tracer/record-info! {:name "handle-refresh/spam"
   490→   490→                            :attributes {:app-id app-id
   491→   491→                                         :wal-log-enabled (flags/enable-wal-entity-log? app-id)
   492→   492→                                         :instaql-query instaql-query
   493→   493→                                         :instaql-query-hash instaql-query-hash
   494→   494→                                         :instaql-query-normalized (instaql-util/normalized-forms instaql-query)
   495→   495→                                         :duration-ms duration-ms
   496→   496→                                         :instaql-topic? instaql-topic?}}))
   497→   497→
   498→   498→    (when (and can-skip-attrs? attrs-changed?)
   499→   499→      (rs/assoc-session! store sess-id :session/attrs-hash attrs-hash))
   500→   500→    (e2e-tracer/invalidator-tracking-step! {:tx-id (:tx-id event)
   501→   501→                                            :tx-created-at (:tx-created-at event)
   502→   502→                                            :name "finish-refresh-queries"
   503→   503→                                            :attributes (assoc tracer-attrs
   504→   504→                                                               :session-id sess-id)})
   505→   505→    (tracer/with-span! {:name "handle-refresh/send-event!"
   506→   506→                        :attributes tracer-attrs}
   507→   507→      (when (seq computations)
   508→   508→        (rs/send-event! store app-id sess-id (with-meta
   509→   509→                                               (cond->
   510→   510→                                                {:op :refresh-ok
   511→   511→                                                 :processed-tx-id processed-tx-id
   512→   512→                                                 :computations computations}
   513→   513→                                                 (or (not can-skip-attrs?) attrs-changed?)
   514→   514→                                                 (assoc :attrs attrs))
   515→   515→                                               {:tx-id (:tx-id event)
   516→   516→                                                :tx-created-at (:tx-created-at event)
   517→   517→                                                :session-id sess-id}))))))
   518→   518→
   519→   519→;; -----
   520→   520→;; transact
   521→   521→
   522→   522→(defn handle-transact!
   523→   523→  [store sess-id {:keys [tx-steps client-event-id] :as _event}]
   524→   524→  (let [auth (get-auth! store sess-id)
   525→   525→        app-id (-> auth :app :id)
   526→   526→        coerced (tx/coerce! tx-steps)
   527→   527→        ctx {:db {:conn-pool (aurora/conn-pool :write)}
   528→   528→             :rules (rule-model/get-by-app-id {:app-id app-id})
   529→   529→             :app-id app-id
   530→   530→             :current-user (:user auth)
   531→   531→             :admin? (:admin? auth)
   532→   532→             :datalog-query-fn d/query
   533→   533→             :attrs (attr-model/get-by-app-id app-id)}
   534→   534→        _ (tx/validate! ctx coerced)
   535→   535→        {tx-id :id}
   536→   536→        (permissioned-tx/transact! ctx coerced)]
   537→   537→    (rs/send-event! store app-id sess-id
   538→   538→                    {:op :transact-ok
   539→   539→                     :tx-id tx-id
   540→   540→                     :client-event-id client-event-id})))
   541→   541→
   542→   542→;; -----
   543→   543→;; error
   544→   544→
   545→   545→(defn handle-error! [store sess-id {:keys [status
   546→   546→                                           app-id
   547→   547→                                           client-event-id
   548→   548→                                           original-event
   549→   549→                                           type
   550→   550→                                           message
   551→   551→                                           hint]}]
   552→   552→  (rs/send-event! store
   553→   553→                  app-id
   554→   554→                  sess-id
   555→   555→                  {:op :error
   556→   556→                   :status status
   557→   557→                   :client-event-id client-event-id
   558→   558→                   :original-event original-event
   559→   559→                   :type type
   560→   560→                   :message message
   561→   561→                   :hint hint}))
   562→   562→
   563→   563→;; ------
   564→   564→;; worker
   565→   565→
   566→   566→(defn event-attributes
   567→   567→  [store
   568→   568→   session-id
   569→   569→   {:keys [op
   570→   570→           client-event-id
   571→   571→           total-delay-ms
   572→   572→           ws-ping-latency-ms] :as event}]
   573→   573→  (let [{:session/keys [auth creator versions]} (rs/session store session-id)]
   574→   574→    (merge
   575→   575→     {:op op
   576→   576→      :client-event-id client-event-id
   577→   577→      :session-id session-id
   578→   578→      :total-delay-ms total-delay-ms
   579→   579→      :ws-ping-latency-ms ws-ping-latency-ms
   580→   580→      :combined (::grouped-queue/combined event 1)}
   581→   581→     (auth-and-creator-attrs auth creator versions))))
   582→   582→
   583→   583→(defn validate-room-id [event]
   584→   584→  (ex/get-param! event [:room-id] (fn [s]
   585→   585→                                    (when (string? s)
   586→   586→                                      s))))
   587→   587→
   588→   588→(defn- handle-join-room! [store sess-id {:keys [client-event-id data] :as event}]
   589→   589→  (let [auth (get-auth! store sess-id)
   590→   590→        app-id (-> auth :app :id)
   591→   591→        current-user (-> auth :user)
   592→   592→        room-id (validate-room-id event)]
   593→   593→    (eph/join-room! app-id sess-id current-user room-id data)
   594→   594→    (join-room-logger/log-join-room! app-id)
   595→   595→    (rs/send-event! store app-id sess-id {:op :join-room-ok
   596→   596→                                          :room-id room-id
   597→   597→                                          :client-event-id client-event-id})))
   598→   598→
   599→   599→(defn- handle-leave-room! [store sess-id {:keys [client-event-id] :as event}]
   600→   600→  (let [auth (get-auth! store sess-id)
   601→   601→        app-id (-> auth :app :id)
   602→   602→        room-id (validate-room-id event)]
   603→   603→    (eph/leave-room! app-id sess-id room-id)
   604→   604→    (rs/send-event! store app-id sess-id {:op :leave-room-ok
   605→   605→                                          :room-id room-id
   606→   606→                                          :client-event-id client-event-id})))
   607→   607→
   608→   608→(defn assert-in-room! [app-id room-id sess-id]
   609→   609→  (when-not (eph/in-room? app-id room-id sess-id)
   610→   610→    (ex/throw-validation-err!
   611→   611→     :room
   612→   612→     {:app-id app-id :room-id room-id :session-id sess-id}
   613→   613→     [{:message "You have not entered this room yet."}])))
   614→   614→
   615→   615→(defn- handle-set-presence!
   616→   616→  [store sess-id {:keys [client-event-id data] :as event}]
   617→   617→  (let [auth (get-auth! store sess-id)
   618→   618→        app-id (-> auth :app :id)
   619→   619→        room-id (validate-room-id event)
   620→   620→        _ (assert-in-room! app-id room-id sess-id)]
   621→   621→    (eph/set-presence! app-id sess-id room-id data)
   622→   622→    (rs/send-event! store app-id sess-id {:op :set-presence-ok
   623→   623→                                          :room-id room-id
   624→   624→                                          :client-event-id client-event-id})))
   625→   625→
   626→   626→(defn- handle-refresh-presence! [store sess-id {:keys [app-id data edits] :as event}]
   627→   627→  (let [features (-> (rs/session store sess-id) :session/features)
   628→   628→        room-id (validate-room-id event)]
   629→   629→    (cond
   630→   630→      (and edits (empty? edits))
   631→   631→      :nop
   632→   632→
   633→   633→      (and edits
   634→   634→           (supports-patch-presence? features))
   635→   635→      (rs/send-event! store app-id sess-id
   636→   636→                      {:op      :patch-presence
   637→   637→                       :room-id room-id
   638→   638→                       :edits   edits})
   639→   639→
   640→   640→      :else
   641→   641→      (rs/send-event! store app-id sess-id
   642→   642→                      {:op      :refresh-presence
   643→   643→                       :room-id room-id
   644→   644→                       :data    data}))))
   645→   645→
   646→   646→(defn- handle-client-broadcast!
   647→   647→  "Broadcasts a client message to other sessions in the room"
   648→   648→  [store sess-id {:keys [client-event-id topic data] :as event}]
   649→   649→  (let [auth (get-auth! store sess-id)
   650→   650→        app-id (-> auth :app :id)
   651→   651→        room-id (validate-room-id event)
   652→   652→        _ (assert-in-room! app-id room-id sess-id)
   653→   653→        current-user (-> auth :user)
   654→   654→        {:keys [local-ids remote-ids]} (eph/get-room-session-ids app-id room-id)
   655→   655→        base-msg {:room-id room-id
   656→   656→                  :topic topic
   657→   657→                  :data {:peer-id sess-id
   658→   658→                         :user (when current-user
   659→   659→                                 {:id (:id current-user)})
   660→   660→                         :data data}}]
   661→   661→
   662→   662→    (doseq [notify-sess-id local-ids
   663→   663→            :let [q (-> (rs/session store notify-sess-id) :session/socket :receive-q)]
   664→   664→            :when (and q (not= sess-id notify-sess-id))]
   665→   665→      (receive-queue/put! q
   666→   666→                          (assoc base-msg
   667→   667→                                 :op :server-broadcast
   668→   668→                                 :session-id notify-sess-id
   669→   669→                                 :app-id app-id)))
   670→   670→    (when (seq remote-ids)
   671→   671→      (eph/broadcast app-id remote-ids base-msg))
   672→   672→
   673→   673→    (rs/send-event! store app-id sess-id (assoc base-msg
   674→   674→                                                :op :client-broadcast-ok
   675→   675→                                                :client-event-id client-event-id))))
   676→   676→
   677→   677→(defn- handle-server-broadcast! [store sess-id {:keys [app-id] :as event}]
   678→   678→  (let [room-id (validate-room-id event)
   679→   679→        batch-messages? (-> (rs/session store sess-id)
   680→   680→                            :features
   681→   681→                            supports-batch-messages?)]
   682→   682→    (when (eph/in-room? app-id room-id sess-id)
   683→   683→      (let [messages (for [{:keys [topic data]} (or (::payloads event)
   684→   684→                                                    [event])]
   685→   685→                       {:op :server-broadcast
   686→   686→                        :room-id room-id
   687→   687→                        :topic topic
   688→   688→                        :data data})]
   689→   689→        (cond (= 1 (count messages))
   690→   690→              (rs/send-event! store app-id sess-id (first messages))
   691→   691→
   692→   692→              batch-messages?
   693→   693→              (doseq [batch (partition-all 500 messages)]
   694→   694→                (rs/send-event! store app-id sess-id batch))
   695→   695→
   696→   696→              :else
   697→   697→              (doseq [message messages]
   698→   698→                (rs/send-event! store app-id sess-id message)))))))
   699→   699→
   700→   700→(defn handle-event [store session event debug-info]
   701→   701→  (let [{:keys [op]} event
   702→   702→        {:keys [session/socket]} session
   703→   703→        {:keys [id]} socket]
   704→   704→    (tracer/add-data! {:attributes (event-attributes store id event)})
   705→   705→    (case op
   706→   706→      :init         (handle-init! store id event)
   707→   707→      :sse-init     (handle-sse-init! store id event)
   708→   708→      :add-query    (handle-add-query! store id event)
   709→   709→      :remove-query (handle-remove-query! store id event)
   710→   710→      :refresh      (handle-refresh! store id event debug-info)
   711→   711→      :transact     (handle-transact! store id event)
   712→   712→      :error        (handle-error! store id event)
   713→   713→      ;; ----------
   714→   714→      ;; sync-table
   715→   715→      :start-sync (handle-start-sync! store id event)
   716→   716→      :remove-sync (handle-remove-sync! store id event)
   717→   717→      :refresh-sync-table (handle-refresh-sync-table! store id event)
   718→   718→      :resync-table (handle-resync-table! store id event)
   719→   719→      ;; ----------
   720→   720→      ;; EPH events
   721→   721→      :join-room        (handle-join-room! store id event)
   722→   722→      :leave-room       (handle-leave-room! store id event)
   723→   723→      :set-presence     (handle-set-presence! store id event)
   724→   724→      :refresh-presence (handle-refresh-presence! store id event)
   725→   725→      :client-broadcast (handle-client-broadcast! store id event)
   726→   726→      :server-broadcast (handle-server-broadcast! store id event)
   727→   727→
   728→   728→      (handle-error! store id {:status 400
   729→   729→                               :app-id (-> (rs/session store id)
   730→   730→                                           :session/auth
   731→   731→                                           :app
   732→   732→                                           :id)
   733→   733→                               :client-event-id (:client-event-id event)
   734→   734→                               :original-event event
   735→   735→                               :type :param-malformed
   736→   736→                               :message "Invalid op"
   737→   737→                               :hint {:op op}}))))
   738→   738→
   739→   739→;; --------------
   740→   740→;; Receive Workers
   741→   741→
   742→   742→(declare on-close)
   743→   743→
   744→   744→(defn- handle-instant-exception [store session app-id original-event instant-ex debug-info]
   745→   745→  (let [sess-id (:session/id session)
   746→   746→        q (:receive-q (:session/socket session))
   747→   747→        {:keys [client-event-id]} original-event
   748→   748→        {:keys [::ex/type ::ex/message ::ex/hint] :as err-data} (ex-data instant-ex)]
   749→   749→    (tracer/add-data! {:attributes {:err-data (pr-str err-data)}})
   750→   750→    (if (= :error (:op original-event))
   751→   751→      ;; Don't send an error if we failed to send the error or we'll get into an
   752→   752→      ;; infinite loop of errors
   753→   753→      (tracer/add-data! {:attributes {:error-on-error true}})
   754→   754→      (case type
   755→   755→        (::ex/record-not-found
   756→   756→         ::ex/record-expired
   757→   757→         ::ex/record-not-unique
   758→   758→         ::ex/record-foreign-key-invalid
   759→   759→         ::ex/record-check-violation
   760→   760→         ::ex/sql-raise
   761→   761→
   762→   762→         ::ex/permission-denied
   763→   763→         ::ex/permission-evaluation-failed
   764→   764→
   765→   765→         ::ex/param-missing
   766→   766→         ::ex/param-malformed
   767→   767→
   768→   768→         ::ex/validation-failed)
   769→   769→        (receive-queue/put! q
   770→   770→                            {:op :error
   771→   771→                             :app-id app-id
   772→   772→                             :status 400
   773→   773→                             :client-event-id client-event-id
   774→   774→                             :original-event (merge original-event
   775→   775→                                                    debug-info)
   776→   776→                             :type (keyword (name type))
   777→   777→                             :message message
   778→   778→                             :hint hint
   779→   779→                             :session-id sess-id})
   780→   780→
   781→   781→        ::ex/socket-missing
   782→   782→        (do
   783→   783→          (tracer/record-exception-span! instant-ex
   784→   784→                                         {:name "receive-worker/socket-unreachable"})
   785→   785→          (when-let [socket (:session/socket session)]
   786→   786→            (on-close store socket)))
   787→   787→
   788→   788→        (::ex/session-missing
   789→   789→         ::ex/socket-error)
   790→   790→        (tracer/record-exception-span! instant-ex
   791→   791→                                       {:name "receive-worker/socket-unreachable"})
   792→   792→
   793→   793→        (do
   794→   794→          (tracer/add-exception! instant-ex {:escaping? false})
   795→   795→          (receive-queue/put! q
   796→   796→                              {:op :error
   797→   797→                               :app-id app-id
   798→   798→                               :status 500
   799→   799→                               :client-event-id client-event-id
   800→   800→                               :original-event (merge original-event
   801→   801→                                                      debug-info)
   802→   802→                               :type (keyword (name type))
   803→   803→                               :message message
   804→   804→                               :hint hint
   805→   805→                               :session-id sess-id}))))))
   806→   806→
   807→   807→(defn- handle-uncaught-err [session app-id original-event root-err debug-info]
   808→   808→  (let [sess-id (:session/id session)
   809→   809→        q (:receive-q (:session/socket session))
   810→   810→        {:keys [client-event-id]} original-event]
   811→   811→    (tracer/add-exception! root-err {:escaping? false})
   812→   812→    (if (= :error (:op original-event))
   813→   813→      ;; Don't send an error if we failed to send the error or we'll get into an
   814→   814→      ;; infinite loop of errors
   815→   815→      (tracer/add-data! {:attributes {:error-on-error true}})
   816→   816→      (receive-queue/put! q
   817→   817→                          {:op :error
   818→   818→                           :app-id app-id
   819→   819→                           :client-event-id client-event-id
   820→   820→                           :status 500
   821→   821→                           :original-event (merge original-event
   822→   822→                                                  debug-info)
   823→   823→                           :message (str "Yikes, something broke on our end! Sorry about that."
   824→   824→                                         " Please ping us (Joe and Stopa) on Discord and let us know!")
   825→   825→                           :session-id sess-id}))))
   826→   826→
   827→   827→(defn handle-receive-attrs [store session event metadata]
   828→   828→  (let [{:keys [session/socket]} session
   829→   829→        sess-id (:session/id session)
   830→   830→        event-attrs (event-attributes store sess-id event)]
   831→   831→    (assoc (merge metadata event-attrs)
   832→   832→           :socket-origin (rs/socket-origin socket)
   833→   833→           :socket-ip (rs/socket-ip socket)
   834→   834→           :session-id sess-id
   835→   835→           :x-amzn-trace-id (rs/socket-x-amzn-trace-id socket)
   836→   836→           :x-amzn-cf-id (rs/socket-x-amz-cf-id socket)
   837→   837→           :transport (if (contains? socket :sse-conn)
   838→   838→                        "sse"
   839→   839→                        "ws"))))
   840→   840→
   841→   841→(defn handle-receive [store session event metadata]
   842→   842→  (tracer/with-exceptions-silencer [silence-exceptions]
   843→   843→    (tracer/with-span! {:name "receive-worker/handle-receive"
   844→   844→                        :attributes (handle-receive-attrs store session event metadata)}
   845→   845→      (let [in-progress-stmts (sql/make-statement-tracker)
   846→   846→            debug-info (atom nil)
   847→   847→            app-id (-> session :session/auth :app :id)
   848→   848→            timeout-ms (or (when app-id
   849→   849→                             (flags/handle-receive-timeout app-id))
   850→   850→                           handle-receive-timeout-ms)
   851→   851→            event-fut (binding [sql/*in-progress-stmts* in-progress-stmts]
   852→   852→                        (if-not (flags/use-more-vfutures?)
   853→   853→                          (ua/tracked-future (handle-event store
   854→   854→                                                           session
   855→   855→                                                           event
   856→   856→                                                           debug-info))
   857→   857→                          (ua/vfuture (handle-event store
   858→   858→                                                    session
   859→   859→                                                    event
   860→   860→                                                    debug-info))))
   861→   861→            handler-id (add-pending-handler session {:future event-fut
   862→   862→                                                     :op (:op event)
   863→   863→                                                     :in-progress-stmts in-progress-stmts
   864→   864→                                                     :silence-exceptions silence-exceptions})]
   865→   865→        (tracer/add-data! {:attributes {:timeout-ms timeout-ms
   866→   866→                                        :concurrent-handler-count (pending-handler-count session)}})
   867→   867→        (try
   868→   868→          (let [ret (deref event-fut timeout-ms :timeout)]
   869→   869→            (when (= :timeout ret)
   870→   870→              (let [in-progress-count (count @(:stmts in-progress-stmts))
   871→   871→                    _ (sql/cancel-in-progress in-progress-stmts (flags/statement-cancel-wait-ms))
   872→   872→                    cancel-res (future-cancel event-fut)]
   873→   873→                (tracer/add-data! {:attributes
   874→   874→                                   {:timedout true
   875→   875→                                    :in-progress-query-count in-progress-count
   876→   876→                                    ;; If false, then canceling the queries let
   877→   877→                                    ;; the future complete before we could cancel it
   878→   878→                                    :future-cancel-result cancel-res}}))
   879→   879→              (ex/throw-operation-timeout! :handle-receive timeout-ms)))
   880→   880→
   881→   881→          (catch CancellationException _e
   882→   882→            ;; We must have cancelled this in the on-close, so don't try to do any
   883→   883→            ;; error handling
   884→   884→            (tracer/record-info! {:name "handle-receive-cancelled"}))
   885→   885→          (catch Throwable e
   886→   886→            (tracer/record-info! {:name "caught-throwable"})
   887→   887→            (let [original-event event
   888→   888→                  instant-ex (ex/find-instant-exception e)
   889→   889→                  root-err (root-cause e)
   890→   890→                  app-id (some-> (rs/session store (:session/id session))
   891→   891→                                 :session/auth
   892→   892→                                 :app
   893→   893→                                 :id)]
   894→   894→              (cond
   895→   895→                instant-ex (handle-instant-exception store
   896→   896→                                                     session
   897→   897→                                                     app-id
   898→   898→                                                     original-event
   899→   899→                                                     instant-ex
   900→   900→                                                     @debug-info)
   901→   901→                :else (handle-uncaught-err session
   902→   902→                                           app-id
   903→   903→                                           original-event
   904→   904→                                           root-err
   905→   905→                                           @debug-info))))
   906→   906→          (finally
   907→   907→            (remove-pending-handler session handler-id)))))))
   908→   908→
   909→   909→(defn process-receive-q-event [store event metadata]
   910→   910→  (let [{:keys [session-id]
   911→   911→         ::grouped-queue/keys [put-at]} event]
   912→   912→    (if-some [session (rs/session store session-id)]
   913→   913→      (let [session            (into {} session)
   914→   914→            total-delay-ms     (- (System/currentTimeMillis) put-at)
   915→   915→            ws-ping-latency-ms (some-> session
   916→   916→                                       :session/socket
   917→   917→                                       :get-ping-latency-ms
   918→   918→                                       (#(%)))
   919→   919→            event              (assoc event
   920→   920→                                      :total-delay-ms total-delay-ms
   921→   921→                                      :ws-ping-latency-ms ws-ping-latency-ms)
   922→   922→            metadata           (assoc metadata :skipped-size (dec (::grouped-queue/combined event 1)))]
   923→   923→        (handle-receive store session event metadata))
   924→   924→      (tracer/record-info! {:name "receive-worker/session-not-found"
   925→   925→                            :attributes (assoc metadata :session-id session-id)}))))
   926→   926→
   927→   927→(defn straight-jacket-process-receive-q-event [store group-key event]
   928→   928→  (let [metadata {:group-key group-key}]
   929→   929→    (try
   930→   930→      (process-receive-q-event store event metadata)
   931→   931→      (catch Throwable e
   932→   932→        (tracer/record-exception-span! e {:name "receive-worker/straight-jacket-process-receive-q-event"
   933→   933→                                          :attributes (assoc metadata
   934→   934→                                                             :session-id (:session-id event)
   935→   935→                                                             :event event)})))))
   936→   936→
   937→   937→;; -----------------
   938→   938→;; Websocket Interop
   939→   939→
   940→   940→(defn on-open [store {sess-id :id :as socket}]
   941→   941→  (tracer/with-span! {:name "socket/on-open"
   942→   942→                      :attributes {:session-id sess-id}}

   122→   122→(defn safe-char [s i]
   123→   123→  (when (< i (count s))
   124→   124→    (String/.charAt s i)))
   125→   125→
   126→   126→(defn parse-unique-detail-column!
   127→   127→  "Returns the column at the given starting position.
   128→   128→   Sets `i` to the start of the next column."
   129→   129→  [i s]
   130→   130→  (let [col (StringBuffer.)
   131→   131→        advance (fn []
   132→   132→                  (vswap! i inc))
   133→   133→        add-char (fn [c]
   134→   134→                   (.append col c)
   135→   135→                   (advance))]
   136→   136→    (loop [open-parens 0
   137→   137→           in-quote? false]
   138→   138→      (let [c (safe-char s @i)]
   139→   139→        (if-not c
   140→   140→          (.toString col)
   141→   141→          (case c
   142→   142→            \, (if in-quote?
   143→   143→                 (do
   144→   144→                   (add-char c)
   145→   145→                   (recur open-parens
   146→   146→                          in-quote?))
   147→   147→                 (do
   148→   148→                   (advance)
   149→   149→                   ;; Consume next space
   150→   150→                   (advance)
   151→   151→                   (.toString col)))
   152→   152→            \) (if (pos? open-parens)
   153→   153→                 (do
   154→   154→                   (add-char c)
   155→   155→                   (recur (dec open-parens)
   156→   156→                          in-quote?))
   157→   157→                 (.toString col))
   158→   158→            \( (do
   159→   159→                 (add-char c)
   160→   160→                 (recur (inc open-parens)
   161→   161→                        in-quote?))
   162→   162→            \" (let [escaped-quote? (= (safe-char s (dec @i))
   163→   163→                                       \\)]
   164→   164→                 (add-char c)
   165→   165→                 (recur open-parens
   166→   166→                        (if escaped-quote?
   167→   167→                          in-quote?
   168→   168→                          (not in-quote?))))
   169→   169→            (do (add-char c)
   170→   170→                (recur open-parens
   171→   171→                       in-quote?))))))))
   172→   172→
   173→   173→(defn parse-unique-detail-columns!
   174→   174→  "Finds the list of columns and returns them as a vector of strings.
   175→   175→   Sets `i` to the end of the columns.
   176→   176→   Given \"Key (a, b, c)=(1, 2, 3) already exists\"
   177→   177→   Returns [\"a\", \"b\", \"c\"] with i at the `=` char."
   178→   178→  [i s]
   179→   179→  (loop [columns []
   180→   180→         stage :find-columns-start]
   181→   181→    (let [c (safe-char s @i)]
   182→   182→      (if-not c
   183→   183→        columns
   184→   184→        (if (= c \))
   185→   185→          (do
   186→   186→            (vswap! i inc)
   187→   187→            columns)
   188→   188→          (case stage
   189→   189→            :find-columns-start (do (vswap! i inc)
   190→   190→                                    (if (= \( c)
   191→   191→                                      (recur columns
   192→   192→                                             :get-column)
   193→   193→                                      (recur columns
   194→   194→                                             :find-columns-start)))
   195→   195→            :get-column (recur (conj columns
   196→   196→                                     (parse-unique-detail-column! i s))
   197→   197→                               :get-column)))))))
   198→   198→
   199→   199→(defn parse-unique-detail [s]
   200→   200→  (let [i (volatile! 0)
   201→   201→        keys (parse-unique-detail-columns! i s)
   202→   202→        values (parse-unique-detail-columns! i s)]
   203→   203→    (zipmap keys values)))

   205→   205→(defn- safely-extract-data [f pg-data span-name]
   206→   206→  (try
   207→   207→    (f pg-data)
   208→   208→    (catch Exception e
   209→   209→      (tracer/record-exception-span! e {:name span-name})
   210→   210→      nil)))

   212→   212→(defn extract-duplicate-ident-data [pg-data]
   213→   213→  (when (and (= "idents" (:table pg-data))
   214→   214→             (= "app_ident_uq" (:constraint pg-data)))
   215→   215→    (safely-extract-data
   216→   216→     (fn [pg-data]
   217→   217→       (let [details (parse-unique-detail (:detail pg-data))
   218→   218→             etype (get details "etype")
   219→   219→             label (get details "label")]
   220→   220→         (when (and etype label)
   221→   221→           {:message (format "`%s` already exists on `%s`"
   222→   222→                             label
   223→   223→                             etype)
   224→   224→            :hint {:etype etype
   225→   225→                   :label label}})))
   226→   226→     pg-data
   227→   227→     "ex/extract-duplicate-ident-data")))
   228→   228→
   229→   229→(defn extract-unique-triple-data [pg-data]
   230→   230→  (when (and (= "triples" (:table pg-data))
   231→   231→             (= "av_index" (:constraint pg-data)))
   232→   232→    (safely-extract-data
   233→   233→     (fn [pg-data]
   234→   234→       (let [details (parse-unique-detail (:detail pg-data))
   235→   235→             value   (get details "json_null_to_null(value)")
   236→   236→             app-id  (uuid-util/coerce (get details "app_id"))
   237→   237→             attr-id (uuid-util/coerce (get details "attr_id"))
   238→   238→             {:keys [etype label]} (get-attr-details app-id attr-id)]
   239→   239→         (cond (and etype label value)
   240→   240→               {:message (format "`%s` is a unique attribute on `%s` and an entity already exists with `%s.%s` = %s"
   241→   241→                                 label
   242→   242→                                 etype
   243→   243→                                 etype
   244→   244→                                 label
   245→   245→                                 value)
   246→   246→                :hint {:attr-id attr-id
   247→   247→                       :etype etype
   248→   248→                       :label label
   249→   249→                       :value value}}
   250→   250→
   251→   251→               attr-id
   252→   252→               {:hint {:attr-id attr-id
   253→   253→                       :value value}}
   254→   254→
   255→   255→               :else nil)))
   256→   256→     pg-data
   257→   257→     "ex/extract-unique-triple-data")))
   258→   258→
   259→   259→(defn build-not-unqiue-hint [pg-data]
   260→   260→  (or (extract-duplicate-ident-data pg-data)
   261→   261→      (extract-unique-triple-data pg-data)))

   263→   263→(defn throw-record-not-unique!
   264→   264→  ([record-type] (throw-record-not-unique! record-type nil nil))
   265→   265→  ([record-type pg-data e]
   266→   266→   (let [extra-hint-data (build-not-unqiue-hint pg-data)]
   267→   267→     (throw+ {::type ::record-not-unique
   268→   268→              ::message (or (:message extra-hint-data)
   269→   269→                            (format "Record not unique: %s" (name record-type)))
   270→   270→              ::hint (merge {:record-type record-type} (:hint extra-hint-data))}
   271→   271→             e))))

   284→   284→(defn throw-permission-evaluation-failed! [etype action ^CelEvaluationException e show-cel-errors?]
   285→   285→  (let [cause-type (.name (.getErrorCode e))
   286→   286→        err-message (.getMessage e)
   287→   287→        cause-message (if (and err-message show-cel-errors?)
   288→   288→                        err-message
   289→   289→                        "You may have a typo")
   290→   290→        hint-message (format "Could not evaluate permission rule for `%s.%s`. %s. Debug this in the sandbox and then update your permission rules."
   291→   291→                             etype
   292→   292→                             action
   293→   293→                             cause-message)]
   294→   294→    (throw+ {::type ::permission-evaluation-failed
   295→   295→             ::message hint-message
   296→   296→             ::hint (cond-> {:rule [etype action]}
   297→   297→                      cause-type (assoc :error {:type (keyword cause-type)
   298→   298→                                                :message hint-message
   299→   299→                                                :hint cause-message}))}
   300→   300→            e)))

   310→   310→(defn throw-validation-err!
   311→   311→  "Note: the way we use this function, we always had a descriptive 
   312→   312→  `message` passed in an `errors` entry. 
   313→   313→
   314→   314→  We moved that up into the top-level `message`, so it's easier for users to read. 
   315→   315→
   316→   316→  We may want to refactor this function, to perhaps pass in the message directly."
   317→   317→  [input-type input errors]
   318→   318→  (let [base-msg (str "Validation failed for " (name input-type))
   319→   319→        hint-msgs (keep :message errors)
   320→   320→        full-msg (if-not (seq hint-msgs)
   321→   321→                   base-msg
   322→   322→                   (str base-msg ": " (string/join ", " hint-msgs)))]
   323→   323→    (throw+ {::type ::validation-failed
   324→   324→             ::message full-msg
   325→   325→             ::hint {:data-type input-type
   326→   326→                     :input input
   327→   327→                     :errors errors}})))
   328→   328→
   329→   329→(defn assert-valid! [input-type input errors]
   330→   330→  (when (seq errors)
   331→   331→    (throw-validation-err! input-type input errors)))

   347→   347→(defn get-param! [obj ks coercer]
   348→   348→  (let [param (get-in obj ks)
   349→   349→        _ (when-not param
   350→   350→            (throw-missing-param! ks))
   351→   351→        coerced (coercer param)
   352→   352→        _ (when-not coerced
   353→   353→            (throw-malformed-param! ks param))]
   354→   354→    coerced))

   356→   356→(defn get-optional-param! [obj ks coercer]
   357→   357→  (when-let [param (some-> obj
   358→   358→                           (get-in ks))]
   359→   359→    (if-let [coerced (coercer param)]
   360→   360→      coerced
   361→   361→      (throw+ {::type ::param-malformed
   362→   362→               ::message (format "Malformed parameter: %s" (mapv safe-name ks))
   363→   363→               ::hint {:in ks
   364→   364→                       :original-input param}}))))

   366→   366→(defn get-some-param!
   367→   367→  [obj list-of-paths coercer]
   368→   368→  (let [found-path (first (filter #(get-in obj %) list-of-paths))
   369→   369→        _ (when-not found-path
   370→   370→            (throw+ {::type ::param-missing
   371→   371→                     ::message (format "Missing parameter: %s" (mapv safe-name (first list-of-paths)))
   372→   372→                     ::hint {:in (first list-of-paths)
   373→   373→                             :possible-ins (rest list-of-paths)}}))
   374→   374→
   375→   375→        param (get-in obj found-path)
   376→   376→        coerced (coercer param)
   377→   377→        _ (when-not coerced
   378→   378→            (throw+ {::type ::param-malformed
   379→   379→                     ::message (format "Malformed parameter: %s" (mapv safe-name found-path))
   380→   380→                     ::hint {:in found-path
   381→   381→                             :possible-ins list-of-paths
   382→   382→                             :original-input param}}))]
   383→   383→    coerced))

   435→   435→(defn- best-problem
   436→   436→  "Picks the most specific problem.
   437→   437→   We use a heuristic: we sort by `path`, `in` length, and the last element in `in`."
   438→   438→  [explain]
   439→   439→  (->> explain
   440→   440→       ::s/problems
   441→   441→       (sort-by
   442→   442→        (fn [{:keys [in path]}]
   443→   443→          [(count path) (count in) (last in)]))
   444→   444→       last))

   446→   446→(defn- ns-to-remove? [x]
   447→   447→  (#{"clojure.core"} (namespace x)))
   448→   448→
   449→   449→(defn- walk-pred
   450→   450→  "explain-data returns a `pred`. To make it a bit cleaner,
   451→   451→   we walk it and remove the `namespace` part for common symbols and keywords"
   452→   452→  [pred]
   453→   453→  (w/postwalk
   454→   454→   (fn [x]
   455→   455→     (cond
   456→   456→       (and (symbol? x) (ns-to-remove? x)) (symbol (name x))
   457→   457→       (and (keyword? x) (ns-to-remove? x)) (keyword (name x))
   458→   458→       :else x))
   459→   459→   pred))
   460→   460→
   461→   461→(defn explain->validation-errors [explain]
   462→   462→  (let [problem (best-problem explain)
   463→   463→        {:keys [in pred]} problem]
   464→   464→    [{:expected (walk-pred pred)
   465→   465→      :in in}]))

   470→   470→(defn kw-table-name [str-table]
   471→   471→  (-> (or str-table "unknown")
   472→   472→      inflections/dasherize

   474→   474→      keyword

   480→   480→(defn extract-triple-from-constraint [{:keys [table detail]}]
   481→   481→  (when (and (= table "triples")
   482→   482→             detail
   483→   483→             (string/starts-with? detail "Failing row contains"))
   484→   484→    ;; The error detail looks like "Failing row contains (app_id, entity_id, ...),
   485→   485→    ;; so we extract all of those values by looking for what's between the commas
   486→   486→    (let [borders (conj (into [(string/index-of detail "(")]
   487→   487→                              (indexes-of detail ","))
   488→   488→                        (string/last-index-of detail ")"))
   489→   489→          ;; Skip any `,` in the value
   490→   490→          borders (concat (take 4 borders)
   491→   491→                          (take-last 10 borders))]
   492→   492→      (zipmap [:app-id
   493→   493→               :entity-id
   494→   494→               :attr-id
   495→   495→               :value
   496→   496→               :value-md5
   497→   497→               :ea
   498→   498→               :eav
   499→   499→               :av
   500→   500→               :ave
   501→   501→               :vae
   502→   502→               :created-at
   503→   503→               :checked-data-type]
   504→   504→              (map (fn [[start end]]
   505→   505→                     (string/trim (subs detail (inc start) end)))
   506→   506→                   (partition 2 1 borders))))))

   541→   541→                    e))
   542→   542→
   543→   543→      :check-violation

   545→   545→        (let [attr (when-let [get-attr *get-attr-for-exception*]
   546→   546→                     (some-> triple

   549→   549→                             get-attr))
   550→   550→              attr-name (when attr

   558→   558→              {:keys [value truncated-value?]}
   559→   559→              (try

   563→   563→                (catch Exception _e

   565→   565→                  {:value (:value triple)

   567→   567→              msg (case (:constraint data)

   572→   572→                                                 (when-let [data-type (:checked-data-type triple)]

   598→   598→                                 (when (= (:constraint data)

   680→   680→(defn find-instant-exception ^Exception [^Exception e]
   681→   681→  (loop [cause e]
   682→   682→    (cond
   683→   683→      (::type (ex-data cause)) cause
   684→   684→      ;; Unwrap errors from next-jdbc/with-transaction
   685→   685→      (:handling (ex-data cause)) (:handling (ex-data cause))
   686→   686→      (nil? (.getCause cause)) nil
   687→   687→      :else (recur (.getCause cause)))))

     1→     1→(ns instant.reactive.store

     3→     3→
     4→     4→   Serves the following purposes:
     5→     5→
     6→     6→   1. Invalidation. Given a mutation, the store can find relevant data to
     7→     7→      refresh.

   132→   132→(deftype RunTxes [conn]

   140→   140→                      (recur (conj! items next-item))

   143→   143→        (let [t0 (System/nanoTime)
   144→   144→              reports (lang/with-reentrant-lock lock
   145→   145→                        (let [lock-time-ms (duration-ms t0 (System/nanoTime))]
   146→   146→                          (loop [db @conn
   147→   147→                                 items items
   148→   148→                                 reports (transient [])]
   149→   149→                            (if (seq items)

   151→   151→                                    start (System/nanoTime)
   152→   152→                                    report (try
   153→   153→                                             (->TxResult :ok
   154→   154→                                                         (d-conn/with db tx-data nil)

   165→   165→                                       (rest items)

   170→   170→          (loop [items items
   171→   171→                 reports reports]
   172→   172→            (when (seq items)
   173→   173→              (deliver (:result-promise (first items)) (first reports))
   174→   174→              (recur (rest items) (rest reports)))))
   175→   175→        (when-not (ConcurrentLinkedQueue/.isEmpty tx-queue)
   176→   176→          (ExecutorService/.submit executor ^Runnable this))))))
   177→   177→
   178→   178→(def datalog-query-byte-len
   179→   179→  (if (config/prod?)
   180→   180→    (fn [v]
   181→   181→      (or (:sql-byte-len (meta v))
   182→   182→          ;; This should never be null, but just in case
   183→   183→          (* 1024 1024)))
   184→   184→    (fn [v]
   185→   185→      (let [byte-len (:sql-byte-len (meta v))]
   186→   186→        (assert byte-len ":sql-byte-len is missing from datalog result")
   187→   187→        byte-len))))
   188→   188→
   189→   189→(defn create-datalog-query-cache [executor]
   190→   190→  (cache/make-async {:max-weight (flags/flag :datalog-cache-max-weight
   191→   191→                                             ;; 500mb
   192→   192→                                             (* 1024 1024 500))
   193→   193→                     :ttl (flags/flag :datalog-cache-ttl
   194→   194→                                      ;; 1 hour
   195→   195→                                      (* 1000 60 60))
   196→   196→                     :weigher (fn [_k v]
   197→   197→                                (* (datalog-query-byte-len v)
   198→   198→                                   ;; We use more memory to build the data than
   199→   199→                                   ;; postgres uses to send it to us. This flag accounts
   200→   200→                                   ;; for that difference
   201→   201→                                   (flags/flag :datalog-cache-size-multiple 4)))
   202→   202→                     :record-stats true
   203→   203→                     :executor executor}))
   204→   204→
   205→   205→(defn create-conn [schema app-id]
   206→   206→  (let [conn (-> (d/empty-db schema)
   207→   207→                 (d/with [{:tx-meta/app-id app-id
   208→   208→                           :tx-meta/processed-tx-id (tx-model/max-seen-tx-id)}])
   209→   209→                 :db-after
   210→   210→                 d/conn-from-db)
   211→   211→        cache-executor (ua/make-vfuture-executor)]
   212→   212→    (alter-meta! conn
   213→   213→                 assoc
   214→   214→                 :app-id app-id
   215→   215→                 :executor (Executors/newSingleThreadExecutor (.factory (Thread/ofVirtual)))
   216→   216→                 :run-txes (RunTxes. conn)
   217→   217→                 :lock (ReentrantLock. false)
   218→   218→                 :tx-queue (ConcurrentLinkedQueue.)
   219→   219→                 :cache-executor cache-executor
   220→   220→                 :datalog-query-cache (create-datalog-query-cache cache-executor)
   221→   221→                 :app-id app-id)
   222→   222→    conn))
   223→   223→
   224→   224→(defn app-conn [store app-id]
   225→   225→  (Map/.computeIfAbsent (:conns store) app-id #(create-conn schema %)))
   226→   226→

   228→   228→;; misc
   229→   229→
   230→   230→(defn conn->datalog-query-cache [conn]
   231→   231→  (-> conn meta :datalog-query-cache))
   232→   232→
   233→   233→(defn translate-datascript-exceptions [exinfo]
   234→   234→  (let [{:keys [error entity-id]} (ex-data exinfo)]
   235→   235→    (if (and (= :entity-id/missing error)
   236→   236→             (coll? entity-id)
   237→   237→             (= :session/id (first entity-id)))
   238→   238→      (ex/throw-session-missing! (last entity-id))
   239→   239→      (throw exinfo))))
   240→   240→
   241→   241→(defn cancel-in-progress-datalog-query [cache datalog-query-ent]
   242→   242→  (when-let [stmts (:datalog-query/stmt-tracker datalog-query-ent)]
   243→   243→    (sql/cancel-in-progress stmts (flags/statement-cancel-wait-ms)))
   244→   244→  (when-let [children (:datalog-query/child-vfutures datalog-query-ent)]
   245→   245→    (ua/cancel-children children true))
   246→   246→  (cache/invalidate-async cache (:db/id datalog-query-ent)))
   247→   247→
   248→   248→(defn clean-datalog-query-cache
   249→   249→  "Evicts datalog results we no longer care about and cancels any in-progress
   250→   250→   queries that nobody is waiting on a result for.
   251→   251→
   252→   252→   Should run after `transact!`"
   253→   253→  [conn {:keys [tx-data]}]
   254→   254→  (let [deleted-datalog-query-ids (keep (fn [datom]
   255→   255→                                          (when (and (= (:a datom)
   256→   256→                                                        :datalog-query/app-id+query)
   257→   257→                                                     (not (:added datom)))
   258→   258→                                            (:e datom)))
   259→   259→                                        tx-data)
   260→   260→        cache (conn->datalog-query-cache conn)]
   261→   261→    (when (seq deleted-datalog-query-ids)
   262→   262→      (cache/invalidate-all-async cache deleted-datalog-query-ids)
   263→   263→      (let [stats (cache/stats-async cache)]
   264→   264→        (tracer/add-data! {:attributes {:cache.hits (.hitCount stats)
   265→   265→                                        :cache.misses (.missCount stats)
   266→   266→                                        :cache.success (.loadSuccessCount stats)
   267→   267→                                        :cache.failure (.loadFailureCount stats)
   268→   268→                                        :cache.load-time (.totalLoadTime stats)
   269→   269→                                        :cache.evicts (.evictionCount stats)
   270→   270→                                        :cache.eviction-weight (.evictionWeight stats)
   271→   271→                                        :cache.current-weight (cache/weight-async cache)}})))))
   272→   272→
   273→   273→(defn transact-new! [span-name conn tx-data]
   274→   274→  (let [t1 (System/nanoTime)]
   275→   275→    (tracer/with-span! {:name span-name
   276→   276→                        :attributes {:version "new"}}
   277→   277→      (try
   278→   278→        (let [t2 (System/nanoTime)
   279→   279→              {:keys [tx-queue executor run-txes]} (meta conn)
   280→   280→              result-promise (promise)
   281→   281→              _ (ConcurrentLinkedQueue/.add tx-queue (->TxInput tx-data result-promise))
   282→   282→              _ (ExecutorService/.submit executor ^Runnable run-txes)
   283→   283→              result @result-promise
   284→   284→              _ (when (= :error (:type result))
   285→   285→                  (throw (:result result)))
   286→   286→              report (:result result)
   287→   287→              tx-time-ms (:tx-time-ms result)]
   288→   288→          (tracer/add-data! {:attributes {:app-id (:app-id (meta conn))
   289→   289→                                          :changed-datoms-count (count (:tx-data report))
   290→   290→                                          :span-time-ms (-> t2 (- t1) (/ 1000000) double)
   291→   291→                                          :lock-time-ms (:lock-time-ms result)
   292→   292→                                          :tx-time-ms tx-time-ms
   293→   293→                                          :db-before-size (count (:db-before report))
   294→   294→                                          :db-after-size (count (:db-after report))}})
   295→   295→          (when (> tx-time-ms 15000)
   296→   296→            (tracer/with-new-trace-root
   297→   297→              (tracer/with-span! {:name "really-long-tx"
   298→   298→                                  :attributes {:tx-ms tx-time-ms
   299→   299→                                               :v "new"
   300→   300→                                               :tx-data tx-data
   301→   301→                                               :app-id (:app-id (meta conn))}}))
   302→   302→            (def -new-long-tx-data tx-data)
   303→   303→            (def -new-long-tx report))
   304→   304→          (clean-datalog-query-cache conn report)
   305→   305→          report)
   306→   306→        (catch clojure.lang.ExceptionInfo e
   307→   307→          (translate-datascript-exceptions e))))))
   308→   308→
   309→   309→(defn transact-old! [span-name conn tx-data]
   310→   310→  (let [t1 (System/nanoTime)]
   311→   311→    (tracer/with-span! {:name span-name
   312→   312→                        :attributes {:version "old"}}
   313→   313→      (try
   314→   314→        (let [t2          (System/nanoTime)
   315→   315→              [t3 ret t4] (lang/with-reentrant-lock (:lock (meta conn))
   316→   316→                            [(System/nanoTime)
   317→   317→                             (d/transact! conn tx-data)
   318→   318→                             (System/nanoTime)])
   319→   319→              tx-time-ms (-> t4 (- t3) (/ 1000000) double)]
   320→   320→          (tracer/add-data! {:attributes {:app-id               (:app-id (meta conn))
   321→   321→                                          :changed-datoms-count (count (:tx-data ret))
   322→   322→                                          :span-time-ms         (-> t2 (- t1) (/ 1000000) double)
   323→   323→                                          :lock-time-ms         (-> t3 (- t2) (/ 1000000) double)
   324→   324→                                          :tx-time-ms           tx-time-ms
   325→   325→                                          :db-before-size       (count (:db-before ret))
   326→   326→                                          :db-after-size        (count (:db-after ret))}})
   327→   327→          (when (> tx-time-ms 15000)
   328→   328→            (tracer/with-new-trace-root
   329→   329→              (tracer/with-span! {:name "really-long-tx"
   330→   330→                                  :attributes {:tx-ms tx-time-ms
   331→   331→                                               :v "old"
   332→   332→                                               :tx-data tx-data
   333→   333→                                               :app-id (:app-id (meta conn))}}))
   334→   334→            (def -old-long-tx-data tx-data)
   335→   335→            (def -old-long-tx ret))
   336→   336→          (clean-datalog-query-cache conn ret)
   337→   337→          ret)
   338→   338→        (catch clojure.lang.ExceptionInfo e
   339→   339→          (translate-datascript-exceptions e))))))
   340→   340→
   341→   341→(defn deleted-subscriptions-datalog-query-ids [report]
   342→   342→  (keep (fn [datom]
   343→   343→          (when (and (= (:a datom)
   344→   344→                        :subscription/datalog-query)
   345→   345→                     (not (:added datom))
   346→   346→                     (d/entity (:db-after report) (:v datom)))
   347→   347→            (:v datom)))
   348→   348→        (:tx-data report)))
   349→   349→
   350→   350→(defn clean-stale-datalog-queries-tx-data [db datalog-query-eids]
   351→   351→  (ucoll/reduce-tr (fn [acc e]
   352→   352→                     (if-not (d/find-datom db :avet :subscription/datalog-query e)
   353→   353→                       (conj! acc [:db/retractEntity e])
   354→   354→                       acc))
   355→   355→                   []
   356→   356→                   datalog-query-eids))
   357→   357→
   358→   358→(defn transact! [span-name conn tx-data]
   359→   359→  (let [report (if (or (flags/toggled? :enable-store-batching-globally)
   360→   360→                       (contains? (flags/flag :enable-store-batching-apps)
   361→   361→                                  (:app-id (meta conn))))
   362→   362→                 (transact-new! span-name conn tx-data)
   363→   363→                 (transact-old! span-name conn tx-data))]
   364→   364→    (if-let [eids (seq (deleted-subscriptions-datalog-query-ids report))]
   365→   365→      (do
   366→   366→        (transact! "store/clean-datalog-queries"
   367→   367→                   conn
   368→   368→                   [[:db.fn/call clean-stale-datalog-queries-tx-data (distinct eids)]])
   369→   369→        report)
   370→   370→      report)))
   371→   371→
