   375→   375→(defprotocol HasHeaderMap
   376→   376→  (get-header [this ^String header-name]))
   377→   377→
   378→   378→(extend-protocol HasHeaderMap
   379→   379→  WebSocketHttpExchange
   380→   380→  (get-header [req ^String header-name]
   381→   381→    (.getRequestHeader req header-name))
   382→   382→
   383→   383→  ServerSentEventConnection
   384→   384→  (get-header [req ^String header-name]
   385→   385→    (some-> (.getRequestHeaders req)
   386→   386→            (.getFirst header-name))))

   413→   413→(defn report-active-sessions [store]
   414→   414→  (let [db @(:sessions store)]
   415→   415→    (for [datom (d/datoms db :aevt :session/id)
   416→   416→          :let [ent (d/entity db (:e datom))
   417→   417→                {:session/keys [auth creator]} ent]]
   418→   418→      {:app-title      (-> auth :app :title)
   419→   419→       :app-id         (-> auth :app :id)
   420→   420→       :app-user-email (-> auth :user :email)
   421→   421→       :creator-email  (-> creator :email)
   422→   422→       :session-id     (:session/id ent)
   423→   423→       :socket-origin  (some-> ent
   424→   424→                               :session/socket
   425→   425→                               socket-origin)})))

   427→   427→(comment

   442→   442→(defn assoc-session! [store sess-id & kvs]

   460→   460→;; instaql queries
   461→   461→
   462→   462→(defn get-stale-instaql-queries [store app-id sess-id]
   463→   463→  (let [db @(app-conn store app-id)]
   464→   464→    (for [datom (d/datoms db :avet :instaql-query/session-id sess-id)
   465→   465→          :let [ent (d/entity db (:e datom))]
   466→   466→          :when (:instaql-query/stale? ent)]
   467→   467→      ent)))

   469→   469→(defn bump-instaql-version-tx-data
   470→   470→  "Should be used in a db.fn/call. Returns transactions.
   471→   471→   Bumps the query version and marks query as not stale, creating the query
   472→   472→   if needed."
   473→   473→  [db lookup-ref session-id instaql-query return-type inference?]
   474→   474→  (if-let [existing (d/entity db lookup-ref)]
   475→   475→    (let [v  (:instaql-query/version existing)
   476→   476→          v' (inc (or v 0))]
   477→   477→      [{:db/id (:db/id existing)
   478→   478→        :instaql-query/version v'
   479→   479→        :instaql-query/stale? false}])
   480→   480→    [{:instaql-query/session-id session-id
   481→   481→      :instaql-query/query instaql-query
   482→   482→      :instaql-query/forms-hash (forms-hash instaql-query)
   483→   483→      :instaql-query/stale? false
   484→   484→      :instaql-query/version 1
   485→   485→      :instaql-query/return-type return-type
   486→   486→      :instaql-query/inference? (or inference? false)}]))
   487→   487→
   488→   488→(defn bump-instaql-version! [store app-id sess-id q return-type inference?]
   489→   489→  (let [lookup-ref [:instaql-query/session-id+query [sess-id q]]
   490→   490→        conn       (app-conn store app-id)
   491→   491→        tx         [[:db.fn/call bump-instaql-version-tx-data lookup-ref sess-id q return-type inference?]]
   492→   492→        report     (transact! "store/bump-instaql-version!" conn tx)]
   493→   493→    (d/entity (:db-after report) lookup-ref)))
   494→   494→
   495→   495→(defn set-instaql-topic! [store app-id instaql-query-eid topic]
   496→   496→  (let [conn (app-conn store app-id)]
   497→   497→    (transact! "store/set-instaql-topic!"
   498→   498→               conn
   499→   499→               [[:db/add instaql-query-eid :instaql-query/topic topic]])))

   501→   501→;; ----
   502→   502→;; remove instaql queries
   503→   503→
   504→   504→(defn- remove-subscriptions-tx-data
   505→   505→  "Should be used in a db.fn/call. Returns transactions.
   506→   506→   Retracts the instaql-query and subscriptions for the query."
   507→   507→  [db session-id instaql-query]
   508→   508→  (if-some [query-eid (d/entid db [:instaql-query/session-id+query [session-id instaql-query]])]
   509→   509→    (concat
   510→   510→     (for [datom (d/datoms db :avet :subscription/instaql-query query-eid)]
   511→   511→       [:db/retractEntity (:e datom)])
   512→   512→     [[:db/retractEntity query-eid]])
   513→   513→    []))
   514→   514→
   515→   515→(defn remove-query! [store app-id sess-id q]
   516→   516→  (transact! "store/remove-query!"
   517→   517→             (app-conn store app-id)
   518→   518→             [[:db.fn/call remove-subscriptions-tx-data sess-id q]]))
   519→   519→
   520→   520→;; --------------
   521→   521→;; adding queries
   522→   522→
   523→   523→(defn- clean-stale-subscriptions-tx-data
   524→   524→  "Should be used in a db.fn/call. Returns transactions.
   525→   525→   Retracts subscriptions for an older version of an instaql query."
   526→   526→  [db instaql-query-lookup-ref version]
   527→   527→  (if-some [query-eid (d/entid db instaql-query-lookup-ref)]
   528→   528→    (keep (fn [datom]
   529→   529→            (let [sub-version (:v (d/find-datom db :eavt (:e datom) :subscription/v))]
   530→   530→              (when (or (not sub-version)
   531→   531→                        (< sub-version version))
   532→   532→                [:db/retractEntity (:e datom)])))
   533→   533→          (d/datoms db :avet :subscription/instaql-query query-eid))
   534→   534→    []))
   535→   535→
   536→   536→(defn- set-instaql-query-result-tx-data
   537→   537→  "Should be used in a db.fn/call. Returns transactions.
   538→   538→   Sets the hash for the query result."
   539→   539→  [db lookup-ref result-hash]
   540→   540→  (if-some [e (d/entid db lookup-ref)]
   541→   541→    [[:db/add e :instaql-query/hash result-hash]]
   542→   542→    []))
   543→   543→
   544→   544→(defn add-instaql-query! [store {:keys [app-id session-id instaql-query v] :as _ctx} result-hash]
   545→   545→  (let [conn            (app-conn store app-id)
   546→   546→        lookup-ref      [:instaql-query/session-id+query [session-id instaql-query]]
   547→   547→        report          (transact! "store/add-instaql-query!"
   548→   548→                                   conn
   549→   549→                                   [[:db.fn/call clean-stale-subscriptions-tx-data lookup-ref v]
   550→   550→                                    [:db.fn/call set-instaql-query-result-tx-data lookup-ref result-hash]])
   551→   551→        hash-before     (:instaql-query/hash (d/entity (:db-before report) lookup-ref))
   552→   552→        hash-after      (:instaql-query/hash (d/entity (:db-after report) lookup-ref))
   553→   553→        result-changed? (or (not= hash-before hash-after)
   554→   554→                            (and (nil? hash-before)
   555→   555→                                 (nil? hash-after)))]
   556→   556→    (assoc report :result-changed? result-changed?)))
   557→   557→

   560→   560→
   561→   561→(defn session-instaql-queries [store app-id sess-id]

   565→   565→           :let  [ent (d/entity db (:e datom))]]
   566→   566→       (:instaql-query/query ent)))))

   568→   568→(defn- remove-session-queries-tx-data

   575→   575→(defn- remove-session-subscriptions-tx-data
   576→   576→  "Should be used in a db.fn/call. Returns transactions.
   577→   577→   Retracts subscriptions for the session."
   578→   578→  [db sess-id]
   579→   579→  (for [datom (d/datoms db :avet :subscription/session-id sess-id)]

   582→   582→(defn remove-session! [store app-id sess-id]
   583→   583→  ;; sync so new sessions are not added while we clean up this one
   584→   584→  (when (and app-id
   585→   585→             (Map/.containsKey (:conns store) app-id))
   586→   586→    (transact! "store/remove-session-data!"
   587→   587→               (app-conn store app-id)
   588→   588→               [[:db.fn/call remove-session-queries-tx-data sess-id]
   589→   589→                [:db.fn/call remove-session-subscriptions-tx-data sess-id]]))
   590→   590→  (let [sessions-conn (:sessions store)]
   591→   591→    (transact! "store/remove-session!"
   592→   592→               sessions-conn
   593→   593→               [[:db.fn/retractEntity [:session/id sess-id]]])
   594→   594→    (when-let [removed-conn
   595→   595→               ;; Be careful not to use `lang/with-reentrant-lock` around
   596→   596→               ;; code that uses `transact!` or you will deadlock
   597→   597→               (lang/with-reentrant-lock (:lock (meta sessions-conn))
   598→   598→                 (when (and app-id
   599→   599→                            (empty? (d/datoms @sessions-conn :avet :session/app-id app-id)))
   600→   600→                   (Map/.remove (:conns store) app-id)))]
   601→   601→      (ExecutorService/.shutdown (:executor (meta removed-conn)))
   602→   602→      (ExecutorService/.shutdown (:cache-executor (meta removed-conn))))))
   603→   603→
   604→   604→;; ------
   605→   605→;; datalog cache
   606→   606→
   607→   607→(defn- swap-datalog-cache-tx-data
   608→   608→  "Should be used in a db.fn/call. Returns transactions.
   609→   609→   Updates or creates the datalog query with data needed to manage the cache."
   610→   610→  [db app-id query watcher-id]
   611→   611→  (when-let [existing (d/entity db [:datalog-query/app-id+query [app-id query]])]
   612→   612→    (let [watchers (:datalog-query/watchers existing)
   613→   613→          id (:db/id existing)]
   614→   614→      (if (or (not watchers)
   615→   615→              ;; We were canceled, so let's start over
   616→   616→              (:canceled? @watchers)
   617→   617→              (:canceled? (swap! watchers
   618→   618→                                 (fn [x]
   619→   619→                                   (if (:canceled? x)
   620→   620→                                     x
   621→   621→                                     (update x :watchers conj watcher-id))))))
   622→   622→        [[:db/add id :datalog-query/watchers (atom {:canceled? false
   623→   623→                                                    :watchers #{watcher-id}})]
   624→   624→         [:db/add id :datalog-query/stmt-tracker (sql/make-top-level-statement-tracker)]
   625→   625→         [:db/add id :datalog-query/child-vfutures (ua/new-child-vfutures)]]
   626→   626→
   627→   627→        []))))
   628→   628→
   629→   629→(defn swap-datalog-cache!
   630→   630→  "Adds a query to the datalog cache.
   631→   631→   The underlying cache is an instant.util.cache/async-cache that lives in the
   632→   632→   metadata of the datascript store (one per app).
   633→   633→
   634→   634→   Here we lookup or add the result of the query to the cache and register ourselves
   635→   635→   as interested in the result of the query.
   636→   636→
   637→   637→   When the datalog query is evicted from the store, the cached result will be
   638→   638→   removed from the cache (see `clean-datalog-query-cache`). If it is in progress
   639→   639→   and there are no watchers, then the query will be canceled."
   640→   640→  [store app-id datalog-query-fn ctx datalog-query]
   641→   641→  (let [lookup-ref [:datalog-query/app-id+query [app-id datalog-query]]
   642→   642→        conn (app-conn store app-id)
   643→   643→        watcher-id (Object.)
   644→   644→        {:keys [db-after]} (transact! "store/swap-datalog-cache!"
   645→   645→                                      conn
   646→   646→                                      [[:db.fn/call
   647→   647→                                        swap-datalog-cache-tx-data
   648→   648→                                        app-id
   649→   649→                                        datalog-query
   650→   650→                                        watcher-id]])]
   651→   651→    (if-let [query-ent (d/entity db-after lookup-ref)]
   652→   652→      (let [query-id (:db/id query-ent)
   653→   653→
   654→   654→            stmt-tracker (:datalog-query/stmt-tracker query-ent)
   655→   655→
   656→   656→            child-vfutures (:datalog-query/child-vfutures query-ent)
   657→   657→
   658→   658→            cache (conn->datalog-query-cache conn)
   659→   659→
   660→   660→            ^CompletableFuture existing-result
   661→   661→            (when-let [res (cache/get-if-present-async cache query-id)]
   662→   662→              (if (.isCompletedExceptionally res)
   663→   663→                ;; caffeine invalidates errors, but sometimes it takes a bit
   664→   664→                (cache/invalidate-async cache query-id)
   665→   665→                res))
   666→   666→
   667→   667→            ^CompletableFuture result
   668→   668→            (or existing-result
   669→   669→                ;; bindings to let us cancel in-progress queries
   670→   670→                ;; once all listeners drop off
   671→   671→                (binding [ua/*child-vfutures* child-vfutures
   672→   672→                          sql/*in-progress-stmts* stmt-tracker]
   673→   673→                  (cache/get-async cache
   674→   674→                                   query-id
   675→   675→                                   (fn [_]
   676→   676→                                     (binding [ua/*child-vfutures* child-vfutures
   677→   677→                                               sql/*in-progress-stmts* stmt-tracker]
   678→   678→                                       (datalog-query-fn ctx datalog-query))))))]
   679→   679→
   680→   680→        (tracer/add-data! {:attributes {:cache-hit (not (nil? existing-result))
   681→   681→                                        :realized (and (not (nil? existing-result))
   682→   682→                                                       (.isDone existing-result))}})
   683→   683→
   684→   684→        (try
   685→   685→          (deref result)
   686→   686→          (catch Throwable t
   687→   687→            (when (and (not (.isDone result))
   688→   688→                       (or (instance? InterruptedException t)
   689→   689→                           (instance? CancellationException t))
   690→   690→                       (:canceled? (swap! (:datalog-query/watchers query-ent)
   691→   691→                                          (fn [watchers]
   692→   692→                                            (let [watchers' (update watchers :watchers disj watcher-id)]
   693→   693→                                              (if (empty? (:watchers watchers'))
   694→   694→                                                (assoc watchers' :canceled? true)
   695→   695→                                                watchers'))))))
   696→   696→              (cancel-in-progress-datalog-query cache query-ent))
   697→   697→            (throw t))
   698→   698→          (finally
   699→   699→            (swap! (:datalog-query/watchers query-ent) update :watchers disj watcher-id))))
   700→   700→      ;; There was no query in the store, it was likely removed by the session leaving.
   701→   701→      ;; We're going to run it just in case
   702→   702→      ;; TODO: Throw an exception here once we confirm that it's not running in prod
   703→   703→      (tracer/with-span! {:name "orphaned-datalog-query"}
   704→   704→        (datalog-query-fn ctx datalog-query)))))
   705→   705→
   706→   706→;; --------------
   707→   707→;; datalog loader
   708→   708→
   709→   709→(defn- upsert-datalog-loader-tx-data [db sess-id make-loader-fn]
   710→   710→  (when-not (d/find-datom db :eavt [:session/id sess-id] :session/datalog-loader)
   711→   711→    [[:db/add [:session/id sess-id] :session/datalog-loader (make-loader-fn)]]))
   712→   712→
   713→   713→(defn upsert-datalog-loader! [store sess-id make-loader-fn]
   714→   714→  (let [conn (:sessions store)]
   715→   715→    (if-some [loader (:session/datalog-loader (d/entity @conn [:session/id sess-id]))]
   716→   716→      loader
   717→   717→      (let [{:keys [db-after]}
   718→   718→            (transact! "store/upsert-datalog-loader!"
   719→   719→                       conn
   720→   720→                       [[:db.fn/call upsert-datalog-loader-tx-data sess-id make-loader-fn]])]
   721→   721→        (:session/datalog-loader (d/entity db-after [:session/id sess-id]))))))
   722→   722→
   723→   723→;; -------------
   724→   724→;; subscriptions
   725→   725→
   726→   726→(defn record-datalog-query-start! [store ctx datalog-query coarse-topics]
   727→   727→  (let [{:keys [app-id session-id instaql-query v]} ctx
   728→   728→        conn (app-conn store app-id)]
   729→   729→    (transact! "store/record-datalog-query-start!"
   730→   730→               conn
   731→   731→               [[:db.fn/call
   732→   732→                 (fn [db]
   733→   733→                   (let [lookup-ref [:datalog-query/app-id+query [app-id datalog-query]]
   734→   734→                         existing-datalog-query (d/entity db lookup-ref)
   735→   735→                         datalog-query-eid (or (:db/id existing-datalog-query) -1)]
   736→   736→                     (concat
   737→   737→                      (if existing-datalog-query
   738→   738→                        (when-not (:datalog-query/topics existing-datalog-query)
   739→   739→                          [{:db/id datalog-query-eid
   740→   740→                            :datalog-query/topics coarse-topics}])
   741→   741→                        [{:db/id datalog-query-eid
   742→   742→                          :datalog-query/app-id app-id
   743→   743→                          :datalog-query/query  datalog-query
   744→   744→                          :datalog-query/topics coarse-topics}])
   745→   745→                      (when-some [query-eid (d/entid db [:instaql-query/session-id+query [session-id instaql-query]])]
   746→   746→                        [{:subscription/app-id app-id
   747→   747→                          :subscription/session-id session-id
   748→   748→                          :subscription/v v
   749→   749→                          :subscription/instaql-query query-eid
   750→   750→                          :subscription/datalog-query datalog-query-eid}]))))]])))
   751→   751→
   752→   752→(defn record-datalog-query-finish! [store
   753→   753→                                    ctx
   754→   754→                                    datalog-query
   755→   755→                                    {:keys [topics] :as _result}]
   756→   756→
   757→   757→  (let [{:keys [app-id]} ctx
   758→   758→        conn (app-conn store app-id)
   759→   759→        lookup-ref [:datalog-query/app-id+query [app-id datalog-query]]]
   760→   760→    (transact!
   761→   761→     "store/record-datalog-query-finish!"
   762→   762→     conn
   763→   763→     [[:db.fn/call
   764→   764→       (fn [db]
   765→   765→         (when-some [existing (d/entity db lookup-ref)]
   766→   766→           [[:db/add (:db/id existing) :datalog-query/topics topics]]))]])))
   767→   767→
   768→   768→;; ------------
   769→   769→;; invalidation
   770→   770→
   771→   771→(defn intersects?
   772→   772→  "Like (not (empty? (set/intersection set-a set-b))), but it returns early
   773→   773→   instead of calculating the full intersection."
   774→   774→  [set-a set-b]
   775→   775→  (let [[big small] (if (> (count set-a) (count set-b))
   776→   776→                      [set-a set-b]
   777→   777→                      [set-b set-a])]
   778→   778→    (reduce (fn [_ item]
   779→   779→              (if (contains? big item)
   780→   780→                (reduced true)
   781→   781→                false))
   782→   782→            false
   783→   783→            small)))
   784→   784→
   785→   785→(defn like-parts
   786→   786→  "Splits the like pattern into parts, quoting strings
   787→   787→  (like-parts \"%hello%\")
   788→   788→  -> [^ .* quoted-string<hello> .* $]"
   789→   789→  [pattern]
   790→   790→  (loop [pattern pattern
   791→   791→         s (StringBuilder.)
   792→   792→         parts (transient ["^"])]
   793→   793→    (if (not (seq pattern))
   794→   794→      (cond-> parts
   795→   795→        (pos? (count s)) (conj! (Pattern/quote (.toString s)))
   796→   796→        true (conj! "$")
   797→   797→        true (persistent!))
   798→   798→      (case (first pattern)
   799→   799→        \_ (recur (rest pattern)
   800→   800→                  (StringBuilder.)
   801→   801→                  (cond-> parts
   802→   802→                    (pos? (count s)) (conj! (Pattern/quote (.toString s)))
   803→   803→                    true (conj! ".")))
   804→   804→        \% (recur (rest pattern)
   805→   805→                  (StringBuilder.)
   806→   806→                  (cond-> parts
   807→   807→                    (pos? (count s)) (conj! (Pattern/quote (.toString s)))
   808→   808→                    true (conj! ".*")))
   809→   809→        (recur (rest pattern)
   810→   810→               (.append s (first pattern))
   811→   811→               parts)))))
   812→   812→
   813→   813→(defn like-pattern
   814→   814→  "Creates a regex pattern for a like pattern, taking into account
   815→   815→   case insensitivity."
   816→   816→  [case-insensitive? pattern]
   817→   817→  (let [parts (like-parts pattern)]
   818→   818→    (Pattern/compile (string/join "" parts)
   819→   819→                     (if case-insensitive?
   820→   820→                       Pattern/CASE_INSENSITIVE
   821→   821→                       0))))
   822→   822→
   823→   823→(defn make-like-match? [case-insensitive? text pattern]
   824→   824→  (let [regex-pattern (like-pattern case-insensitive? pattern)]
   825→   825→    (re-matches regex-pattern text)))
   826→   826→
   827→   827→(def like-match?
   828→   828→  (partial make-like-match? false))
   829→   829→
   830→   830→(def ilike-match?
   831→   831→  (partial make-like-match? true))
   832→   832→
   833→   833→(defn instant-gt [^Instant a ^Instant b]
   834→   834→  (.isAfter a b))
   835→   835→
   836→   836→(defn instant-gte [^Instant a ^Instant b]
   837→   837→  (or (.equals a b)
   838→   838→      (.isAfter a b)))
   839→   839→
   840→   840→(defn instant-lt [^Instant a ^Instant b]
   841→   841→  (.isBefore a b))
   842→   842→
   843→   843→(defn instant-lte [^Instant a ^Instant b]
   844→   844→  (or (.equals a b)
   845→   845→      (.isBefore a b)))
   846→   846→
   847→   847→(defn string-gt [^String a ^String b]
   848→   848→  (pos? (.compareTo a b)))
   849→   849→
   850→   850→(defn string-gte [^String a ^String b]
   851→   851→  (<= 0 (.compareTo a b)))
   852→   852→
   853→   853→(defn string-lt [^String a ^String b]
   854→   854→  (neg? (.compareTo a b)))
   855→   855→
   856→   856→(defn string-lte [^String a ^String b]
   857→   857→  (>= 0 (.compareTo a b)))
   858→   858→
   859→   859→(defn bool-gt [^Boolean a ^Boolean b]
   860→   860→  (pos? (.compareTo a b)))
   861→   861→
   862→   862→(defn bool-gte [^Boolean a ^Boolean b]
   863→   863→  (<= 0 (.compareTo a b)))
   864→   864→
   865→   865→(defn bool-lt [^Boolean a ^Boolean b]
   866→   866→  (neg? (.compareTo a b)))
   867→   867→
   868→   868→(defn bool-lte [^Boolean a ^Boolean b]
   869→   869→  (>= 0 (.compareTo a b)))
   870→   870→
   871→   871→(defn match-nil
   872→   872→  "nil is always the smallest value and the comparator value can't be nil"
   873→   873→  [op]
   874→   874→  (case op
   875→   875→    :$gt false
   876→   876→    :$gte false
   877→   877→    :$lt true
   878→   878→    :$lte true
   879→   879→    :$like false
   880→   880→    :$ilike false))
   881→   881→
   882→   882→(defn- match-topic-part? [iv-part dq-part]
   883→   883→  (cond
   884→   884→    (keyword? iv-part)
   885→   885→    (= iv-part dq-part)
   886→   886→
   887→   887→    (or (symbol? dq-part) (symbol? iv-part))
   888→   888→    true
   889→   889→
   890→   890→    (set? dq-part)
   891→   891→    (intersects? iv-part dq-part)
   892→   892→
   893→   893→    (map? dq-part)
   894→   894→    (if-some [{:keys [op value data-type]} (:$comparator dq-part)]
   895→   895→      (let [f (case data-type
   896→   896→                :number (case op
   897→   897→                          :$gt >
   898→   898→                          :$gte >=
   899→   899→                          :$lt <
   900→   900→                          :$lte <=)
   901→   901→                :boolean (case op
   902→   902→                           :$gt bool-gt
   903→   903→                           :$gte bool-gte
   904→   904→                           :$lt bool-lt
   905→   905→                           :$lte bool-lte)
   906→   906→                :string (case op
   907→   907→                          :$gt string-gt
   908→   908→                          :$gte string-gte
   909→   909→                          :$lt string-lt
   910→   910→                          :$lte string-lte
   911→   911→                          :$like like-match?
   912→   912→                          :$ilike ilike-match?)
   913→   913→                :date (case op
   914→   914→                        :$gt instant-gt
   915→   915→                        :$gte instant-gte
   916→   916→                        :$lt instant-lt
   917→   917→                        :$lte instant-lte))]
   918→   918→        (ucoll/exists? (fn [v]
   919→   919→                         (if (nil? v)
   920→   920→                           (match-nil op)
   921→   921→                           (f v value)))
   922→   922→                       iv-part))
   923→   923→      (when (contains? dq-part :$not)
   924→   924→        (let [not-val (:$not dq-part)]
   925→   925→          (ucoll/exists? (partial not= not-val) iv-part))))))
   926→   926→
   927→   927→(defn match-topic?
   928→   928→  [[iv-idx iv-e iv-a iv-v]
   929→   929→   [dq-idx dq-e dq-a dq-v]]
   930→   930→  (and
   931→   931→   (match-topic-part? iv-idx dq-idx)
   932→   932→   (match-topic-part? iv-e   dq-e)
   933→   933→   (match-topic-part? iv-a   dq-a)
   934→   934→   (match-topic-part? iv-v   dq-v)))
   935→   935→
   936→   936→(defn matching-topic-intersection? [iv-topics dq-topics]
   937→   937→  (ucoll/seek
   938→   938→   (fn [iv-topic]
   939→   939→     (ucoll/seek
   940→   940→      (fn [dq-topic]
   941→   941→        (match-topic? iv-topic dq-topic))
   942→   942→      dq-topics))
   943→   943→   iv-topics))
   944→   944→
   945→   945→(defn- mark-instaql-queries-stale-tx-data
   946→   946→  "Should be used in a db.fn/call. Returns transactions.
   947→   947→   Marks instaql-queries that have subscriptions that reference the datalog
   948→   948→   query stale."
   949→   949→  [db datalog-query-eids]
   950→   950→  (for [datalog-query-eid datalog-query-eids
   951→   951→        sub-datom         (d/datoms db :avet :subscription/datalog-query datalog-query-eid)
   952→   952→        :let [sub-eid             (:e sub-datom)
   953→   953→              instaql-query-datom (d/find-datom db :eavt sub-eid :subscription/instaql-query)
   954→   954→              instaql-query-eid   (:v instaql-query-datom)]
   955→   955→        :when instaql-query-eid]
   956→   956→    [:db/add instaql-query-eid :instaql-query/stale? true]))
   957→   957→
   958→   958→(defn- set-tx-id
   959→   959→  "Should be used in a db.fn/call. Returns transactions.
   960→   960→   Sets the processed-tx-id to the max of the given value and current value."
   961→   961→  [db app-id tx-id]
   962→   962→  (if-some [current (:tx-meta/processed-tx-id (d/entity db [:tx-meta/app-id app-id]))]
   963→   963→    [{:tx-meta/app-id app-id
   964→   964→      :tx-meta/processed-tx-id (max current tx-id)}]
   965→   965→    [{:tx-meta/app-id app-id
   966→   966→      :tx-meta/processed-tx-id tx-id}]))
   967→   967→
   968→   968→(defn- mark-datalog-queries-stale!
   969→   969→  "Stale-ing a datalog query has the following side-effects:
   970→   970→   1. Removes the datalog query from the datalog-cache
   971→   971→   2. Marks associated instaql entries as stale
   972→   972→   3. Updates store's latest processed tx-id for the app-id"
   973→   973→  [conn app-id tx-id datalog-query-eids]
   974→   974→  (transact!
   975→   975→   "store/mark-datalog-queries-stale!"
   976→   976→   conn
   977→   977→   (concat
   978→   978→    [[:db.fn/call set-tx-id app-id tx-id]
   979→   979→     [:db.fn/call mark-instaql-queries-stale-tx-data datalog-query-eids]]
   980→   980→    (for [e datalog-query-eids]
   981→   981→      [:db.fn/retractEntity e]))))
   982→   982→
   983→   983→;; ----------
   984→   984→;; Topic Trie
   985→   985→
   986→   986→(def empty-topic-trie
   987→   987→  {:children {}
   988→   988→   :wildcard nil
   989→   989→   :topics ()})
   990→   990→
   991→   991→(def ^:private topic-trie-order
   992→   992→  "Topic structure: [idx e a v]
   993→   993→
   994→   994→  Our traversal order: idx -> a -> e -> v.
   995→   995→
   996→   996→  Reasoning: most selective parts first."
   997→   997→  [0 2 1 3])
   998→   998→
   999→   999→(defn- topic->ordered-parts [topic]
  1000→  1000→  (map #(nth topic %) topic-trie-order))
  1001→  1001→
  1002→  1002→(defn- topic-part->trie-keys [part]
  1003→  1003→  (if-not (set? part)
  1004→  1004→    [:wildcard]
  1005→  1005→    part))
  1006→  1006→
  1007→  1007→(defn- insert-topic-into-trie [trie topic]
  1008→  1008→  (letfn [(step [node [part & rest-parts]]
  1009→  1009→            (let [ks (topic-part->trie-keys part)]
  1010→  1010→              (reduce
  1011→  1011→               (fn [n k]
  1012→  1012→                 (let [child-path (if (= k :wildcard)
  1013→  1013→                                    [:wildcard]
  1014→  1014→                                    [:children k])
  1015→  1015→                       child (get-in n child-path empty-topic-trie)
  1016→  1016→                       child' (if (seq rest-parts)
  1017→  1017→                                (step child rest-parts)
  1018→  1018→                                (update child :topics conj topic))]
  1019→  1019→                   (assoc-in n child-path child')))
  1020→  1020→               node
  1021→  1021→               ks)))]
  1022→  1022→    (step trie (topic->ordered-parts topic))))

  1027→  1027→(defn- topic-trie-next-nodes [node part]
  1028→  1028→  (let [{:keys [children wildcard]} (or node {})

  1030→  1030→        base (cond-> [] wildcard (conj wildcard))]

  1032→  1032→      (into base (vals children))
  1033→  1033→      (if (< (count children) (count part))
  1034→  1034→        (into base (keep (fn [[k v]] (when (contains? part k) v)) children))
  1035→  1035→        (into base (keep children part))))))

  1037→  1037→(defn- topic-trie-match? [trie topic]

  1039→  1039→            (let [candidates (topic-trie-next-nodes node part)]
  1040→  1040→              (if (empty? rest-parts)
  1041→  1041→                (ucoll/seek
  1042→  1042→                 (fn [child]
  1043→  1043→                   (ucoll/seek
  1044→  1044→                    (fn [iv-topic] (match-topic? iv-topic topic))
  1045→  1045→                    (:topics child)))
  1046→  1046→                 candidates)
  1047→  1047→                (ucoll/seek #(step % rest-parts) candidates))))]
  1048→  1048→    (step trie (topic->ordered-parts topic))))

  1066→  1066→
  1067→  1067→(defn- topics->topic-index
  1068→  1068→  "Given a list of topics, returns an index for attribute values
  1069→  1069→  i.e:
  1070→  1070→  [#{:ea} _ {uid1} _]
  1071→  1071→  [#{:ea} _ _ v1]
  1072→  1072→
  1073→  1073→  Would produce the index:
  1074→  1074→
  1075→  1075→  {uid1 #{[#{:ea} _ {uid1} _]}
  1076→  1076→
  1077→  1077→   :catchall #{[#{:ea} _ _ v1]}
  1078→  1078→
  1079→  1079→   :all #{[#{:ea} _ {uid1} _]
  1080→  1080→          [#{:ea} _ _ v1]}}
  1081→  1081→
  1082→  1082→  This helps us quickly prune topics when trying to do a match."
  1083→  1083→  [topics]
  1084→  1084→  (reduce
  1085→  1085→   (fn [acc [_idx _e a :as topic]]
  1086→  1086→     (let [acc (update acc :all conj topic)]
  1087→  1087→       (if-not (set? a)
  1088→  1088→         (update acc :catchall conj topic)
  1089→  1089→         (reduce
  1090→  1090→          (fn [acc' a-val]
  1091→  1091→            (update acc' a-val (fnil conj ()) topic))
  1092→  1092→          acc
  1093→  1093→          a))))
  1094→  1094→   {:catchall ()
  1095→  1095→    :all ()}
  1096→  1096→   topics))

  1098→  1098→(defn- topic-index-candidates
  1099→  1099→  [iv-topic-index [_idx _e a :as _topic]]
  1100→  1100→  (if-not (set? a)
  1101→  1101→    (get iv-topic-index :all ())
  1102→  1102→    (concat (get iv-topic-index :catchall ())
  1103→  1103→            (mapcat iv-topic-index a))))
  1104→  1104→
  1105→  1105→(defn matching-topic-intersection-indexed? [iv-topic-a-index dq-topics]
  1106→  1106→  (ucoll/seek
  1107→  1107→   (fn [dq-topic]
  1108→  1108→     (let [iv-candidates (topic-index-candidates iv-topic-a-index dq-topic)]
  1109→  1109→       (ucoll/seek
  1110→  1110→        (fn [iv-topic]
  1111→  1111→          (match-topic? iv-topic dq-topic))
  1112→  1112→        iv-candidates)))
  1113→  1113→   dq-topics))

  1118→  1118→               :let [dq-topics (:datalog-query/topics (d/entity db (:e datom)))]
  1119→  1119→               :when dq-topics
  1120→  1120→               :when (matching-topic-intersection-indexed? iv-topic-index dq-topics)]
  1121→  1121→           (:e datom)))))

  1140→  1140→(defn hard-coded-should-remove-query? [app-id db iv-topics eid]

  1142→  1142→                        first
  1143→  1143→                        :e
  1144→  1144→                        (d/entity db)
  1145→  1145→                        :subscription/instaql-query)]
  1146→  1146→    (when (= (:instaql-query/forms-hash q)
  1147→  1147→             889158316)
  1148→  1148→      (let [wid (some-> q
  1149→  1149→                        :instaql-query/query
  1150→  1150→                        :edenItem
  1151→  1151→                        :$
  1152→  1152→                        :where
  1153→  1153→                        :workspaceId)
  1154→  1154→            deleted-nil? (some-> q
  1155→  1155→                                 :instaql-query/query
  1156→  1156→                                 :edenItem
  1157→  1157→                                 :$
  1158→  1158→                                 :where
  1159→  1159→                                 :deleted
  1160→  1160→                                 :$isNull)
  1161→  1161→            type (some-> q
  1162→  1162→                         :instaql-query/query
  1163→  1163→                         :edenItem
  1164→  1164→                         :$
  1165→  1165→                         :where
  1166→  1166→                         :type)]
  1167→  1167→        (when (and wid deleted-nil? type)
  1168→  1168→          (let [attrs (attr-model/get-by-app-id app-id)
  1169→  1169→                waid (:id (attr-model/seek-by-fwd-ident-name ["edenItem" "workspaceId"] attrs))
  1170→  1170→                deleted-aid (:id (attr-model/seek-by-fwd-ident-name ["edenItem" "deleted"] attrs))

  1172→  1172→                creates (reduce (fn [acc [_idx e a v]]
  1173→  1173→                                  (let [e (first e)
  1174→  1174→                                        a (first a)]
  1175→  1175→                                    (if (or (= a waid)
  1176→  1176→                                            (= a deleted-aid)
  1177→  1177→                                            (= a type-aid))
  1178→  1178→                                      (if (not= 1 (count v))
  1179→  1179→                                        ;; We got an update, so we'll just bail out
  1180→  1180→                                        (reduced nil)
  1181→  1181→                                        (assoc-in acc [e a] (first v)))
  1182→  1182→                                      acc)))
  1183→  1183→                                {}
  1184→  1184→                                iv-topics)]
  1185→  1185→            (when creates
  1186→  1186→              (not (some (fn [[_e ent]]

  1188→  1188→                                (= deleted-nil? (nil? (get ent deleted-aid)))
  1189→  1189→                                (= (get ent type-aid) type)))
  1190→  1190→                         creates)))))))))

  1214→  1214→(defn instaql-topic-should-remove-query? [app-id db wal-record eid]
  1215→  1215→  (try
  1216→  1216→    (when (or (seq (:messages wal-record))
  1217→  1217→              (seq (:wal-logs wal-record)))
  1218→  1218→      (when-let [iql-topic (-> (instaql-query-ent-for-datalog-query-eid db eid)
  1219→  1219→                               :instaql-query/topic)]
  1220→  1220→        (let [entities-after (topics/extract-entities-after wal-record)]
  1221→  1221→          (and (not (instaql-topic-matching-item iql-topic entities-after))
  1222→  1222→               (let [entities-before (topics/extract-entities-before (attr-model/get-by-app-id app-id)
  1223→  1223→                                                                     entities-after
  1224→  1224→                                                                     wal-record)]
  1225→  1225→                 (not (instaql-topic-matching-item iql-topic entities-before)))))))

  1236→  1236→          hardcoded-remove

  1245→  1245→                                         :iq-topic-removed (- (count query-ids) (count iql-topic-remove))
  1246→  1246→                                         :hardcode-removed (- (count iql-topic-remove) (count hardcoded-remove))}})
  1247→  1247→      hardcoded-remove)))

  1249→  1249→(defn mark-stale-topics!
  1250→  1250→  "Given topics, invalidates all relevant datalog qs and associated instaql queries.
  1251→  1251→
  1252→  1252→  Returns affected session-ids"
  1253→  1253→  [store app-id tx-id topics wal-record]
  1254→  1254→  (let [conn (app-conn store app-id)
  1255→  1255→        db @conn
  1256→  1256→        datalog-query-eids
  1257→  1257→        (vec (filter-queries app-id
  1258→  1258→                             db
  1259→  1259→                             topics
  1260→  1260→                             wal-record
  1261→  1261→                             (cond
  1262→  1262→                               (flags/use-get-datalog-queries-for-topics-v3?)
  1263→  1263→                               (get-datalog-queries-for-topics-v3 db app-id topics)
  1264→  1264→
  1265→  1265→                               (flags/use-get-datalog-queries-for-topics-v2?)
  1266→  1266→                               (get-datalog-queries-for-topics-v2 db app-id topics)
  1267→  1267→
  1268→  1268→                               :else
  1269→  1269→                               (vec (get-datalog-queries-for-topics db app-id topics)))))
  1270→  1270→
  1271→  1271→        report
  1272→  1272→        (mark-datalog-queries-stale! conn app-id tx-id datalog-query-eids)
  1273→  1273→
  1274→  1274→        session-ids (d/q '[:find [?session-id ...]
  1275→  1275→                           :in   $ [?datalog-query ...]
  1276→  1276→                           :where
  1277→  1277→                           [?e :subscription/datalog-query ?datalog-query]
  1278→  1278→                           [?e :subscription/session-id ?session-id]]
  1279→  1279→                         (:db-before report)
  1280→  1280→                         datalog-query-eids)]
  1281→  1281→    session-ids))

  1344→  1344→;; This serves as a placeholder for storing transaction data durably

  1347→  1347→(defonce sync-table-txes (atom PersistentQueue/EMPTY))

  1349→  1349→(defn add-transaction-to-sync-table-txes [wal-record]

  1351→  1351→                           (let [res (conj txes wal-record)]
  1352→  1352→                             (if (> (count res) 10000)
  1353→  1353→                               (pop res)
  1354→  1354→                               res)))))

  1356→  1356→(defn sync-query-changes-for-wal-record [wal-record topics]

  1358→  1358→            (if (matching-topic-intersection? (topics/topics-for-change record)
  1359→  1359→                                              topics)
  1360→  1360→              (case action
  1361→  1361→                :update (-> acc
  1362→  1362→                            (conj {:action :removed
  1363→  1363→                                   :triple (topics/columns->triple identity)})
  1364→  1364→                            (conj {:action :added
  1365→  1365→                                   :triple (topics/columns->triple columns)}))
  1366→  1366→                :delete (conj acc {:action :removed
  1367→  1367→                                   :triple (topics/columns->triple identity)})
  1368→  1368→                :insert (conj acc {:action :added
  1369→  1369→                                   :triple (topics/columns->triple columns)}))
  1370→  1370→              acc))
  1371→  1371→          []
  1372→  1372→          (:triple-changes wal-record)))

  1374→  1374→(defn sync-query-unread-txes [app-id sync-ent]
  1375→  1375→  (let [{:sync/keys [topics sent-tx-id]} sync-ent]
  1376→  1376→    (keep (fn [wal-record]
  1377→  1377→            (when (and (= app-id (:app-id wal-record))

  1380→  1380→                (when (seq changes)

  1382→  1382→                   :changes changes}))))
  1383→  1383→          @sync-table-txes)))

     4→extension RangeReplaceableCollection {
     5→  /// Creates an collection of shared elements from a shared collection.
     6→  ///
     7→  /// Useful in deriving a shared element when looping over a shared collection, for example in a
     8→  /// SwiftUI `ForEach` view:
     9→  ///
    10→  /// ```swift
    11→  /// @Shared var users: [User]
    12→  ///
    13→  /// ForEach(Array($users)) { $user in
    14→  ///   UserView(user: $user)
    15→  /// }
    16→  /// ```
    17→  ///
    18→  /// - Parameter shared: A shared identified collection.
    19→  public init<Value: _MutableIdentifiedCollection>(
    20→    _ shared: Shared<Value>
    21→  ) where Element == Shared<Value.Element>, Value.Index == Value.IDs.Index {
    22→    self.init()
    23→    let value = shared.wrappedValue
    24→    self.reserveCapacity(value.count)
    25→    for id in value.ids {
    26→      self.append(Shared(shared[id: id])!)
    27→    }
    28→  }

   182→    public func get<T: Decodable>(id: String, attrsStore: AttrsStore, includedLinks: Set<String>? = nil) -> T? {

     1→/// Rapid Transcription Update Demo
     2→///
     3→/// This demo mirrors the SpeechRecorderApp's RapidUpdateSharingInstantTest to verify
     4→/// that SharingInstant can handle rapid segment text updates with the same timing
     5→/// as real-time speech transcription.
     6→///
     7→/// ## Test Pattern
     8→///
     9→/// Real speech transcription emits updates at irregular intervals:
    10→/// - Multiple updates within milliseconds (e.g., 7ms, 8ms apart)
    11→/// - Longer gaps between words (e.g., 800-1000ms)
    12→/// - Final segment with word-level timing data
    13→///
    14→/// This demo simulates that pattern and verifies optimistic updates work correctly.
    15→

    17→import IdentifiedCollections
    18→import SharingInstant
    19→

    21→
    22→private struct SegmentUpdate {
    23→  let delay: Int // milliseconds from start
    24→  let text: String
    25→}
    26→
    27→private struct WordData {
    28→  let text: String
    29→  let startTime: Double
    30→  let endTime: Double
    31→}
    32→
    33→private struct FinalUpdate {

    37→}

   275→   275→  (resolve-etypes
   276→   276→   (aurora/conn-pool :read)
   277→   277→   #uuid "0e563ace-d25f-44f6-ae00-4e6b9b6d1b2e"
   278→   278→   [#uuid "4d39508b-9ee2-48a3-b70d-8192d9c5a059"
   279→   279→    #uuid "005a8767-c0e7-4158-bb9a-62ce1a5858ed"
   280→   280→    #uuid "005b08a1-4046-4fba-b1d1-a78b0628901c"]))
   281→   281→
   282→   282→(defn validate-mode [conn app-id tx-step-maps]
   283→   283→  (let [tx-step-maps (filter #(#{:add-triple :deep-merge-triple} (:op %)) tx-step-maps)
   284→   284→        create-steps (filter #(= :create (:mode (:opts %))) tx-step-maps)
   285→   285→        update-steps (filter #(= :update (:mode (:opts %))) tx-step-maps)
   286→   286→        eid+etypes   (into #{}
   287→   287→                           (keep (fn [{:keys [eid etype]}]
   288→   288→                                   (when (uuid? eid)
   289→   289→                                     [eid etype])))
   290→   290→                           (concat create-steps update-steps))
   291→   291→        lookups      (into #{}
   292→   292→                           (keep (fn [{:keys [eid]}]
   293→   293→                                   (when (triple-model/eid-lookup-ref? eid)
   294→   294→                                     eid)))
   295→   295→                           (concat create-steps update-steps))]
   296→   296→    (when (or (seq eid+etypes) (seq lookups))
   297→   297→      (tracer/with-span! {:name "transaction/validate-mode"
   298→   298→                          :attributes {:app-id app-id}}
   299→   299→        (let [query    "WITH eid_etypes AS (
   300→   300→                          SELECT CAST(elem ->> 0 AS UUID) AS id,
   301→   301→                                 CAST(elem ->> 1 AS TEXT) as etype
   302→   302→                          FROM JSONB_ARRAY_ELEMENTS(CAST(?eid+etypes AS JSONB)) AS elem
   303→   303→                        ),
   304→   304→                        check_eids AS (
   305→   305→                          SELECT DISTINCT eid_etypes.id, eid_etypes.etype, triples.entity_id
   306→   306→                          FROM eid_etypes
   307→   307→                          LEFT JOIN triples
   308→   308→                                 ON triples.app_id = ?app-id
   309→   309→                                AND triples.entity_id = eid_etypes.id
   310→   310→                          LEFT JOIN attrs
   311→   311→                                 ON triples.attr_id = attrs.id
   312→   312→                          WHERE attrs.etype = eid_etypes.etype
   313→   313→                        ),
   314→   314→                        lookups AS (
   315→   315→                          SELECT CAST(elem ->> 0 AS uuid) AS attr_id,
   316→   316→                                 CAST(elem ->> 1 AS jsonb) AS value
   317→   317→                          FROM JSONB_ARRAY_ELEMENTS(CAST(?lookups AS JSONB)) AS elem
   318→   318→                        ),
   319→   319→                        check_lookups AS (
   320→   320→                          SELECT DISTINCT lookups.attr_id, lookups.value, triples.entity_id
   321→   321→                          FROM lookups
   322→   322→                          LEFT JOIN triples
   323→   323→                                 ON app_id = ?app-id
   324→   324→                                AND triples.av
   325→   325→                                AND lookups.attr_id = triples.attr_id
   326→   326→                                AND lookups.value = triples.value
   327→   327→                        )
   328→   328→                        SELECT id, etype, NULL AS attr_id, NULL AS value, entity_id
   329→   329→                        FROM check_eids
   330→   330→                        UNION
   331→   331→                        SELECT NULL as id, NULL as etype, attr_id, value, entity_id
   332→   332→                        FROM check_lookups"
   333→   333→              params   {"?eid+etypes" (->json eid+etypes)
   334→   334→                        "?lookups"    (->json (map (fn [[a v]] [a (->json v)]) lookups))
   335→   335→                        "?app-id"     app-id}
   336→   336→              resolved (->> (sql/select ::validate-mode conn (sql/format query params))
   337→   337→                            (map (fn [{:keys [id attr_id value entity_id]}]
   338→   338→                                   [(or id [attr_id value]) entity_id]))
   339→   339→                            (into {}))]
   340→   340→
   341→   341→          ;; check create over existing entities
   342→   342→          (when-some [existing (->> create-steps
   343→   343→                                    (filter (fn [{:keys [eid]}] (resolved eid)))
   344→   344→                                    not-empty)]
   345→   345→            (ex/throw-validation-err!
   346→   346→             :tx-step
   347→   347→             existing
   348→   348→             [{:message (str "Creating entities that exist: " (string/join ", " (map :eid existing)))}]))
   349→   349→
   350→   350→          ;; check update over missing entities
   351→   351→          (when-some [missing (->> update-steps
   352→   352→                                   (filter (fn [{:keys [eid]}] (nil? (resolved eid))))
   353→   353→                                   not-empty)]
   354→   354→            (ex/throw-validation-err!
   355→   355→             :tx-step
   356→   356→             missing
   357→   357→             [{:message (str "Updating entities that don't exist: " (string/join ", " (map :eid missing)))}])))))))
   358→   358→
   359→   359→(defn resolve-lookups-for-delete-entity [conn app-id tx-step-maps]
   360→   360→  (let [[lookup-ref-deletes rest] (coll/split-by
   361→   361→                                   #(and (= :delete-entity (:op %))
   362→   362→                                         (triple-model/eid-lookup-ref? (:eid %)))
   363→   363→                                   tx-step-maps)
   364→   364→        lookup-refs               (map :eid lookup-ref-deletes)
   365→   365→        resolved                  (resolve-lookups conn app-id lookup-refs)]
   366→   366→    (concat
   367→   367→     ;; Update rule-params ops to use resolved eids
   368→   368→     (map (fn [tx-step]
   369→   369→            (if (and (= :rule-params (:op tx-step))
   370→   370→                     (get resolved (:eid tx-step)))
   371→   371→              (assoc tx-step :eid (get resolved (:eid tx-step)))
   372→   372→              tx-step))
   373→   373→          rest)
   374→   374→     (for [{:keys [eid] :as tx-step} lookup-ref-deletes
   375→   375→           :let [eid' (get resolved eid)]
   376→   376→           :when (uuid? eid')]
   377→   377→       (assoc tx-step :eid eid')))))
   378→   378→
   379→   379→(defn resolve-etypes-for-delete-entity [conn app-id tx-step-maps]
   380→   380→  (let [[untyped-deletes rest] (coll/split-by
   381→   381→                                #(and (= :delete-entity (:op %))
   382→   382→                                      (nil? (:etype %)))
   383→   383→                                tx-step-maps)
   384→   384→        untyped-ids (map :eid untyped-deletes)
   385→   385→        resolved    (resolve-etypes conn app-id untyped-ids)]
   386→   386→    (concat
   387→   387→     rest
   388→   388→     (for [{:keys [eid] :as tx-step} untyped-deletes
   389→   389→           etype                     (get resolved eid [nil])]
   390→   390→       (assoc tx-step :etype etype)))))
   391→   391→
   392→   392→(defn expand-delete-entity-cascade [conn app-id attrs tx-step-maps]
   393→   393→  (let [ids+etypes (for [{:keys [op eid etype]} tx-step-maps
   394→   394→                         :when  (and (= :delete-entity op)
   395→   395→                                     (uuid? eid)
   396→   396→                                     (some? etype))]
   397→   397→                     [eid etype])]
   398→   398→    (if (empty? ids+etypes)
   399→   399→      tx-step-maps
   400→   400→      (let [attrs+etypes
   401→   401→            (->> attrs
   402→   402→                 (filter #(= :ref (:value-type %)))
   403→   403→                 (filter #(= :cascade (:on-delete %)))
   404→   404→                 (mapv #(vector (:id %) (-> % :forward-identity second) (-> % :reverse-identity second))))
   405→   405→
   406→   406→            reverse-attrs+etypes
   407→   407→            (->> attrs
   408→   408→                 (filter #(= :ref (:value-type %)))
   409→   409→                 (filter #(= :cascade (:on-delete-reverse %)))
   410→   410→                 (mapv #(vector (:id %) (-> % :forward-identity second) (-> % :reverse-identity second))))
   411→   411→
   412→   412→            query+args
   413→   413→            (sql/format
   414→   414→             "WITH RECURSIVE
   415→   415→
   416→   416→              attrs_forward (id, forward_etype, reverse_etype) AS (
   417→   417→                SELECT
   418→   418→                  cast(elem ->> 0 AS uuid),
   419→   419→                  cast(elem ->> 1 AS text),
   420→   420→                  cast(elem ->> 2 AS text)
   421→   421→                FROM
   422→   422→                  jsonb_array_elements(cast(?attrs+etypes AS jsonb)) AS elem
   423→   423→              ),
   424→   424→
   425→   425→              attrs_reverse (id, forward_etype, reverse_etype) AS (
   426→   426→                SELECT
   427→   427→                  cast(elem ->> 0 AS uuid),
   428→   428→                  cast(elem ->> 1 AS text),
   429→   429→                  cast(elem ->> 2 AS text)
   430→   430→                FROM
   431→   431→                  jsonb_array_elements(cast(?reverse-attrs+etypes AS jsonb)) AS elem
   432→   432→              ),
   433→   433→
   434→   434→              entids (entity_id, etype, parent_id) AS (
   435→   435→                -- Starting entities (the parents being deleted)
   436→   436→                SELECT
   437→   437→                  cast(elem ->> 0 AS uuid) as entity_id,
   438→   438→                  cast(elem ->> 1 AS text) as etype,
   439→   439→                  cast(elem ->> 0 AS uuid) as parent_id,  -- parent_id is itself for root entities
   440→   440→                  cast(elem ->> 1 as text) as parent_etype -- parent_etype is itself for root entities
   441→   441→                FROM
   442→   442→                  jsonb_array_elements(cast(?ids+etypes AS jsonb)) AS elem
   443→   443→
   444→   444→                UNION
   445→   445→
   446→   446→                SELECT
   447→   447→                  *
   448→   448→                FROM (
   449→   449→                  -- can't reference entids twice, but can bind it to entids_inner and then it's okay
   450→   450→                  WITH entids_inner AS (
   451→   451→                    SELECT
   452→   452→                      entity_id,
   453→   453→                      etype,
   454→   454→                      parent_id,
   455→   455→                      parent_etype
   456→   456→                    FROM
   457→   457→                      entids
   458→   458→                  )
   459→   459→
   460→   460→                  -- follow forward refs → entid (cascaded children inherit parent_id)
   461→   461→                  SELECT
   462→   462→                    triples.entity_id AS entity_id,
   463→   463→                    attrs_forward.forward_etype AS etype,
   464→   464→                    entids_inner.parent_id AS parent_id,  -- inherit parent from the entity that triggered cascade
   465→   465→                    entids_inner.parent_etype as parent_etype
   466→   466→                  FROM
   467→   467→                    entids_inner
   468→   468→                  JOIN triples
   469→   469→                    ON triples.app_id = ?app-id
   470→   470→                  JOIN attrs_forward
   471→   471→                    ON triples.attr_id = attrs_forward.id
   472→   472→                  WHERE
   473→   473→                    triples.vae
   474→   474→                    AND entids_inner.entity_id = json_uuid_to_uuid(triples.value)
   475→   475→                    AND entids_inner.etype = attrs_forward.reverse_etype
   476→   476→
   477→   477→                  UNION
   478→   478→
   479→   479→                  -- follow entid → reverse refs (cascaded children inherit parent_id)
   480→   480→                  SELECT
   481→   481→                    json_uuid_to_uuid(triples.value) AS entity_id,
   482→   482→                    attrs_reverse.reverse_etype AS etype,
   483→   483→                    entids_inner.parent_id AS parent_id,  -- inherit parent from the entity that triggered cascade
   484→   484→                    entids_inner.parent_etype as parent_etype
   485→   485→                  FROM
   486→   486→                    entids_inner
   487→   487→                  JOIN triples
   488→   488→                    ON triples.app_id = ?app-id
   489→   489→                    AND entids_inner.entity_id = triples.entity_id
   490→   490→                  JOIN attrs_reverse
   491→   491→                    ON triples.attr_id = attrs_reverse.id
   492→   492→                  WHERE
   493→   493→                    triples.eav
   494→   494→                    AND entids_inner.etype = attrs_reverse.forward_etype
   495→   495→                )
   496→   496→              )
   497→   497→
   498→   498→              SELECT
   499→   499→                entity_id, etype, parent_id, parent_etype
   500→   500→              FROM
   501→   501→                entids"
   502→   502→             {"?app-id"               app-id
   503→   503→              "?ids+etypes"           (->json ids+etypes)
   504→   504→              "?attrs+etypes"         (->json attrs+etypes)
   505→   505→              "?reverse-attrs+etypes" (->json reverse-attrs+etypes)})
   506→   506→            res (sql/execute! conn query+args)
   507→   507→            parent-id->rule-params (into {}
   508→   508→                                         (for [{:keys [op eid value]} tx-step-maps
   509→   509→                                               :when (and (= :rule-params op) (uuid? eid))]
   510→   510→                                           [eid value]))
   511→   511→            ;; Only get the cascaded entities (where parent_id != entity_id)
   512→   512→            cascaded-entities (remove #(and (= (:parent_id %) (:entity_id %))
   513→   513→                                            (= (:parent_etype %) (:etype %)))
   514→   514→                                      res)]
   515→   515→        (concat
   516→   516→         tx-step-maps
   517→   517→         ;; Add delete operations for cascaded entities only
   518→   518→         (for [{:keys [entity_id etype]} cascaded-entities]
   519→   519→           {:op :delete-entity
   520→   520→            :eid entity_id
   521→   521→            :etype etype})
   522→   522→         ;; Add rule-params for cascaded entities that have a parent with rule-params
   523→   523→         (for [{:keys [entity_id etype parent_id]} cascaded-entities
   524→   524→               :let [rule-params (get parent-id->rule-params parent_id)]
   525→   525→               :when rule-params]
   526→   526→           {:op :rule-params
   527→   527→            :eid entity_id
   528→   528→            :etype etype
   529→   529→            :value rule-params}))))))
   530→   530→
   531→   531→(defn validate-value-lookup-etypes
   532→   532→  "Check that in the case of
   533→   533→
   534→   534→     [op eid fwd-attr [lookup-attr lookup-value]]
   535→   535→
   536→   536→   etype from reverse of fwd-attr matches etype from lookup-attr"
   537→   537→  [attrs tx-step-maps]
   538→   538→  (doseq [{:keys [op aid value] :as tx-step} tx-step-maps
   539→   539→          :when (#{:add-triple :deep-merge-triple :retract-triple} op)
   540→   540→          :let [rev-etype (attr-model/rev-etype (attr-model/seek-by-id aid attrs))]
   541→   541→          :when (and rev-etype
   542→   542→                     (triple-model/value-lookup-ref? value))
   543→   543→          :let [[value-lookup-attr-id _] value
   544→   544→                value-lookup-etype       (attr-model/fwd-etype (attr-model/seek-by-id value-lookup-attr-id attrs))]]
   545→   545→    (when-not value-lookup-etype
   546→   546→      (ex/throw-validation-err! :lookup value
   547→   547→                                [{:message "Invalid lookup. Could not determine namespace from lookup attribute."
   548→   548→                                  :tx-step tx-step}]))
   549→   549→    (when (and rev-etype (not= value-lookup-etype rev-etype))
   550→   550→      (ex/throw-validation-err! :tx-step tx-step
   551→   551→                                [{:message (string-util/multiline->single-line
   552→   552→                                            "Invalid transaction. The namespace in the lookup attribute is
   553→   553→                                             different from the namespace of the attribute that is
   554→   554→                                             being set")}])))
   555→   555→  tx-step-maps)
   556→   556→
   557→   557→(defn get-attr-for-exception
   558→   558→  "Used by exception.clj to lookup the attr by its attr id when it gets an attr id
   559→   559→   in a sql exception."
   560→   560→  [attrs attr-id]
   561→   561→  (attr-model/seek-by-id attr-id attrs))
   562→   562→
   563→   563→(defn transact-without-tx-conn-impl! [conn attrs app-id tx-step-maps opts]
   564→   564→  (binding [ex/*get-attr-for-exception* (partial get-attr-for-exception attrs)]
   565→   565→    (let [tx-step-vecs     (map vectorize-tx-step tx-step-maps)
   566→   566→          grouped-tx-steps (group-by first tx-step-vecs)]
   567→   567→      (tracer/with-span! {:name "transaction/transact!"
   568→   568→                          :attributes {:app-id app-id
   569→   569→                                       :num-tx-steps (count tx-step-vecs)
   570→   570→                                       :detailed-tx-steps (pr-str tx-step-vecs)}}
   571→   571→        (prevent-system-catalog-updates! app-id opts)
   572→   572→        (validate-mode conn app-id tx-step-maps)
   573→   573→        ;; n.b. transaction-model/create! must be the first write to the db
   574→   574→        ;;      or else the invalidator will miss the transaction.
   575→   575→        (let [tx (transaction-model/create! conn {:app-id app-id})
   576→   576→              results
   577→   577→              (reduce-kv
   578→   578→               (fn [acc op tx-steps]
   579→   579→                 (cond
   580→   580→                   (empty? tx-steps)
   581→   581→                   acc
   582→   582→
   583→   583→                   (= :rule-params op)
   584→   584→                   acc
   585→   585→
   586→   586→                   :else
   587→   587→                   (assoc acc op
   588→   588→                          (case op
   589→   589→                            :add-attr
   590→   590→                            (attr-model/insert-multi! conn app-id (map second tx-steps))
   591→   591→
   592→   592→                            :delete-attr
   593→   593→                            (attr-model/soft-delete-multi! conn app-id (map second tx-steps))
   594→   594→
   595→   595→                            :restore-attr
   596→   596→                            (attr-model/restore-multi! conn app-id (map second tx-steps))
   597→   597→
   598→   598→                            :update-attr
   599→   599→                            (attr-model/update-multi! conn app-id (map second tx-steps))
   600→   600→
   601→   601→                            :delete-entity
   602→   602→                            (triple-model/delete-entity-multi! conn app-id (map next tx-steps))
   603→   603→
   604→   604→                            :add-triple
   605→   605→                            (triple-model/insert-multi! conn attrs app-id (map next tx-steps))
   606→   606→
   607→   607→                            :deep-merge-triple
   608→   608→                            (triple-model/deep-merge-multi! conn attrs app-id (map next tx-steps))
   609→   609→
   610→   610→                            :retract-triple
   611→   611→                            (triple-model/delete-multi! conn app-id (map next tx-steps))))))
   612→   612→               {}
   613→   613→               grouped-tx-steps)
   614→   614→              eid+attr-ids (distinct
   615→   615→                            (concat
   616→   616→                             (:delete-entity results)
   617→   617→                             (:add-triple results)
   618→   618→                             (:deep-merge-triple results)
   619→   619→                             (:retract-triple results)))
   620→   620→              _  (triple-model/validate-required! conn attrs app-id eid+attr-ids)
   621→   621→              updated-attrs (->> tx-step-maps
   622→   622→                                 (filter #(= :update-attr (:op %)))
   623→   623→                                 (map :value))
   624→   624→              _  (attr-model/validate-update-required! conn app-id updated-attrs)]
   625→   625→          (let [tx-created-at (Date/.toInstant (:created_at tx))]
   626→   626→            (e2e-tracer/start-invalidator-tracking! {:tx-id (:id tx)
   627→   627→                                                     :tx-created-at tx-created-at})
   628→   628→            (e2e-tracer/invalidator-tracking-step! {:tx-id (:id tx)
   629→   629→                                                    :tx-created-at tx-created-at
   630→   630→                                                    :name "transact"}))
   631→   631→          (assoc tx :results results))))))
   632→   632→
   633→   633→(defn- tx-step-op [tx-step]
   634→   634→  (if (map? tx-step)
   635→   635→    :add-triple
   636→   636→    (first tx-step)))
   637→   637→
   638→   638→(defn tx-steps-order
   639→   639→  "For backwards compatibility, we group steps by op but execute groups
   640→   640→   in order they first appeared in tx-steps"
   641→   641→  [tx-step-vecs]
   642→   642→  (distinct (map tx-step-op tx-step-vecs)))
   643→   643→
   644→   644→(defn reorder-tx-steps
   645→   645→  [ops-order tx-step-maps]
   646→   646→  (let [groups (group-by :op tx-step-maps)]
   647→   647→    (mapcat #(get groups %) ops-order)))
   648→   648→
   649→   649→(defn optimistic-attrs [attrs tx-step-vecs]
   650→   650→  (->> tx-step-vecs
   651→   651→       (reduce
   652→   652→        (fn [acc tx-step]
   653→   653→          (case (tx-step-op tx-step)
   654→   654→            (:add-attr
   655→   655→             :update-attr) (let [[_ value] tx-step]
   656→   656→                             (assoc! acc (:id value) value))
   657→   657→            :delete-attr   (let [[_ value] tx-step]
   658→   658→                             (dissoc! acc value))
   659→   659→            acc))
   660→   660→        (transient (attr-model/map-by-id attrs)))
   661→   661→       persistent!
   662→   662→       vals
   663→   663→       attr-model/wrap-attrs))
   664→   664→
   665→   665→(defn- expand-maps
   666→   666→  "Lets you write sequence of :add-triple as a map. Will resolve attributes
   667→   667→   to their ids. Map must contain :id and :etype keys.
   668→   668→
   669→   669→     (transact! [{:id    user-id
   670→   670→                  :etype \"$users\"
   671→   671→                  :email \"stopa@instantdb.com\"}])
   672→   672→
   673→   673→   is equivalent to
   674→   674→
   675→   675→     (let [attr-id (fn [label]
   676→   676→                     (attr-model/resolve-attr-id attrs \"$users\" label))]
   677→   677→       (transact! [[:add-triple user-id (attr-id :id) user-id]
   678→   678→                   [:add-triple user-id (attr-id :email) \"stopa@instantdb.com\"]]))"
   679→   679→  [attrs tx-step-vecs]
   680→   680→  (for [tx-step tx-step-vecs
   681→   681→        tx-step (if (map? tx-step)
   682→   682→                  (let [{:keys [id etype]} tx-step]
   683→   683→                    (for [[k v] tx-step
   684→   684→                          :when (not= :etype k)
   685→   685→                          :let  [attr-id (if (uuid? k)
   686→   686→                                           k
   687→   687→                                           (attr-model/resolve-attr-id attrs etype k))]]
   688→   688→                      [:add-triple id attr-id v]))
   689→   689→                  [tx-step])]
   690→   690→    tx-step))
   691→   691→
   692→   692→(defn preprocess-tx-steps [conn attrs app-id tx-step-vecs]
   693→   693→  (->> tx-step-vecs
   694→   694→       (expand-maps attrs)
   695→   695→       (mapify-tx-steps attrs)
   696→   696→       (resolve-lookups-for-delete-entity conn app-id)

    38→  race condition we record a coarse subscription before running the query. This way

     1→# Mutation API Design for SharingInstant
     2→
     3→## Executive Summary
     4→
     5→This document explores how to provide explicit mutation methods (create, update, delete, link, unlink) through Swift's `@Shared` property wrapper, avoiding the problematic diff-based approach.
     6→
     7→---
     8→
     9→## The Goal
    10→
    11→Instead of:
    12→```swift
    13→// ❌ Current approach - triggers diff computation, causes race conditions
    14→$goals.withLock { $0.insert(newGoal) }
    15→```
    16→
    17→We want:
    18→```swift
    19→// ✅ Explicit operation - generates transaction chunk directly
    20→$goals.create(title: "New Goal", difficulty: 5)
    21→$goals.delete(id: goalId)
    22→$goals.link(goalId, "creator", to: profileId)
    23→```
    24→
    25→---
    26→
    27→## Approach 1: Extension on Shared<[Entity]>
    28→
    29→We can extend `Shared` when the wrapped value is an array of entities:
    30→
    31→```swift
    32→extension Shared where Value == [Goal] {
    33→    /// Create a new goal and send to server
    34→    func create(title: String, difficulty: Int? = nil) async throws {
    35→        let id = UUID().uuidString.lowercased()
    36→        let goal = Goal(id: id, title: title, difficulty: difficulty)
    37→        
    38→        // 1. Apply optimistically to local state
    39→        withLock { $0.append(goal) }
    40→        
    41→        // 2. Send explicit transaction to server
    42→        let chunk = TransactionChunk(
    43→            namespace: "goals",
    44→            id: id,
    45→            ops: [["update", "goals", id, ["title": title, "difficulty": difficulty]]]
    46→        )
    47→        try await InstantSyncKey.reactor.transact(appID: appID, chunks: [chunk])
    48→    }
    49→    
    50→    /// Delete a goal by ID
    51→    func delete(id: String) async throws {
    52→        // 1. Apply optimistically
    53→        withLock { $0.removeAll { $0.id == id } }
    54→        
    55→        // 2. Send explicit delete transaction
    56→        let chunk = TransactionChunk(
    57→            namespace: "goals",
    58→            id: id,
    59→            ops: [["delete", "goals", id]]
    60→        )
    61→        try await InstantSyncKey.reactor.transact(appID: appID, chunks: [chunk])
    62→    }
    63→}
    64→```
    65→
    66→### Pros
    67→- Simple to implement
    68→- Type-safe
    69→- Works with existing `@Shared` infrastructure
    70→
    71→### Cons
    72→- Requires extension for EVERY entity type
    73→- Hardcodes namespace strings
    74→- Doesn't leverage the schema
    75→
    76→---
    77→
    78→## Approach 2: Protocol-Based with Entity Conformance
    79→
    80→Define a protocol that entities conform to:
    81→
    82→```swift
    83→protocol InstantMutableEntity: InstantEntity {
    84→    static var namespace: String { get }
    85→    static func createChunk(id: String, attributes: [String: Any]) -> TransactionChunk
    86→    static func deleteChunk(id: String) -> TransactionChunk
    87→    static func linkChunk(id: String, label: String, toId: String, toNamespace: String) -> TransactionChunk
    88→}
    89→
    90→// Generated by @Entity macro:
    91→extension Goal: InstantMutableEntity {
    92→    static var namespace: String { "goals" }
    93→    
    94→    static func createChunk(id: String, attributes: [String: Any]) -> TransactionChunk {
    95→        TransactionChunk(namespace: namespace, id: id, ops: [["update", namespace, id, attributes]])
    96→    }
    97→    
    98→    static func deleteChunk(id: String) -> TransactionChunk {
    99→        TransactionChunk(namespace: namespace, id: id, ops: [["delete", namespace, id]])
   100→    }
   101→    
   102→    static func linkChunk(id: String, label: String, toId: String, toNamespace: String) -> TransactionChunk {
   103→        TransactionChunk(namespace: namespace, id: id, ops: [
   104→            ["link", namespace, id, [label: ["id": toId, "namespace": toNamespace]]]
   105→        ])
   106→    }
   107→}
   108→
   109→// Then generic extension:
   110→extension Shared where Value: RangeReplaceableCollection, Value.Element: InstantMutableEntity {
   111→    func create(_ element: Value.Element) async throws {
   112→        // 1. Optimistic update
   113→        withLock { $0.append(element) }
   114→        
   115→        // 2. Extract attributes and send
   116→        let attrs = extractAttributes(from: element)
   117→        let chunk = Value.Element.createChunk(id: element.id, attributes: attrs)
   118→        try await reactor.transact(chunks: [chunk])
   119→    }
   120→    
   121→    func delete(id: String) async throws {
   122→        withLock { $0.removeAll { $0.id == id } }
   123→        let chunk = Value.Element.deleteChunk(id: id)
   124→        try await reactor.transact(chunks: [chunk])
   125→    }
   126→}
   127→```
   128→
   129→### Pros
   130→- Generic - works for any entity
   131→- Leverages existing `@Entity` macro
   132→- Type-safe
   133→
   134→### Cons
   135→- Requires protocol conformance
   136→- Still need to extract attributes via reflection
   137→
   138→---
   139→
   140→## Approach 3: Wrapper Type with Explicit API
   141→
   142→Create a wrapper type that provides explicit mutation methods:
   143→
   144→```swift
   145→/// A wrapper around @Shared that provides explicit mutation methods
   146→@propertyWrapper
   147→struct SharedInstant<Entity: InstantEntity> {
   148→    private var shared: Shared<[Entity]>
   149→    private let configuration: InstantSyncConfiguration<Entity>
   150→

Here's what I found about Swift Observable class patterns for triggering async work from synchronous methods:

## Key Patterns for Bridging Sync and Async in Observable Classes

### 1. Using Task.init Inside Synchronous Methods

You can use the `Task.init` method to call an asynchronous method from a new task that does support concurrency and assign the outcome result to a property in your view model.(no content)You must use the `@MainActor` attribute since you're updating a `@Published` property that triggers UI updates.

### 2. Using @MainActor on the Class

By marking the class as `@MainActor`, all of the async tasks it creates will automatically be managed on the main queue, which ensures state will never get updated on a background thread.

### 3. Swift 6.2 Observations (New in 2025)

Swift 6.2 enables streaming transactional state changes of observable types using the new `Observations` async sequence type. Updates include all synchronous changes to the observable properties, and the transaction ends at the next await that suspends.(no content)This avoids redundant UI updates, improves performance, and ensures that your code reacts to a consistent snapshot of the value.(no content)Despite the fact that `withObservationTracking` was released in OS 17, `Observations` has not been back-ported and requires OS 26.

### 4. AsyncStream Pattern for Property Changes

You can create an `AsyncStream` and use the `yield` method in `willSet` to publish new changes, then consume them in a Task within the initializer.(no content)AsyncStreams seem to be a more natural fit with async/await and a more future-proof solution given the direction Swift is heading towards.

### 5. Using withObservationTracking with AsyncStream

You can define a function that returns an `AsyncStream`, where the stream is created from the results of the apply closure of `withObservationTracking()` function.(no content)This method only works in Swift 5 language mode. In Swift 6 language mode, this code won't compile due to changes in how observation and closure capture work.

### 6. AsyncStream.Continuation for Bridging Synchronous Code

The `AsyncStream.Continuation` type provides a mechanism to interface synchronous code to an asynchronous stream. You obtain a continuation when creating a stream and call one of its yield methods to deliver values through the connected stream.

Based on the search results, here's what I found about Swift Sendable closures, @Sendable, and actor isolation in 2025:

## Key Concepts

The Sendable protocol and @Sendable attribute for functions make it possible to tell the compiler about thread safety when working with concurrency in Swift. Swift introduced both features to reach the bigger goal of the Swift Concurrency effort, which is providing a mechanism to isolate states in concurrent programs to eliminate data races.

## Common Errors and Solutions

### Main actor-isolated property in Sendable closure
When you turn on strict concurrency checking or you start using the Swift 6 language mode, you may encounter the error "Main actor-isolated property can not be referenced from a Sendable closure." This error tells us that we're trying to use something that we're only supposed to use on or from the main actor inside of a closure that's supposed to run anywhere.(no content)To fix this, you can mark the closure as running on the main actor, or ensure any UI state is accessed on the main thread. In SwiftUI, you can call `await MainActor.run` within the task to update UI state.

### @Sendable vs sending keyword
@Sendable is about type-safely "declaring thread safety," while sending is about ownership semantics of "guaranteeing single use rights." They are not mutually exclusive but apply to different contexts.(no content)The `sending` parameter modifier allows receiving non-Sendable parameters by transferring ownership. While the compiler no longer checks for Sendable conformance, it does check ownership flow. After transfer, you cannot use the transferred value elsewhere.

## Swift 6.2 Changes (2025)
Swift 6.2 introduced many changes during WWDC 2025, including a new @concurrent attribute needed when working with Swift Concurrency.(no content)The `nonsending` keyword has fundamentally different semantics from the previous keywords. It's used with nonisolated: `nonisolated(nonsending)`, indicating that an async method should inherit the caller's isolation domain rather than escaping from the current context.

## Actor Isolation with Closures
SE-0461 clarifies that (non-sending, non-@Sendable) async closures inherit the actor isolation where they're declared: "If the contextual type of the closure is neither @Sendable nor sending, the inferred isolation of the closure is the same as the enclosing context."(no content)You can extend Actor to add a general `performInIsolation` method that takes a `@Sendable (_ actor: isolated Self)` closure, allowing you to access the isolation domain of any actor and perform multiple operations on it in one go.

## Known Issues
There's a known bug in Swift 6.2 where local global isolated functions cannot be passed to Sendable closure parameters. "Main actor-isolated synchronous local function 't()' cannot be marked as '@Sendable'"
