  2135→  // --------
  2136→  // Rooms
  2137→
  2138→  /**
  2139→   * @param {string} roomId
  2140→   * @param {any | null | undefined} [initialPresence] -- initial presence data to send when joining the room
  2141→   * @returns () => void
  2142→   */
  2143→  joinRoom(roomId, initialPresence) {
  2144→    let needsToSendJoin = false;
  2145→    if (!this._rooms[roomId]) {
  2146→      needsToSendJoin = true;
  2147→      this._rooms[roomId] = {
  2148→        isConnected: false,
  2149→        error: undefined,
  2150→      };
  2151→    }
  2152→
  2153→    this._presence[roomId] = this._presence[roomId] || {};
  2154→    const previousResult = this._presence[roomId].result;
  2155→    if (initialPresence && !previousResult) {
  2156→      this._presence[roomId].result = this._presence[roomId].result || {};
  2157→      this._presence[roomId].result.user = initialPresence;
  2158→      this._notifyPresenceSubs(roomId);
  2159→    }
  2160→
  2161→    if (needsToSendJoin) {
  2162→      this._tryJoinRoom(roomId, initialPresence);
  2163→    }
  2164→
  2165→    return () => {
  2166→      this._cleanupRoom(roomId);
  2167→    };
  2168→  }
  2169→
  2170→  _cleanupRoom(roomId) {
  2171→    if (
  2172→      !this._presence[roomId]?.handlers?.length &&
  2173→      !Object.keys(this._broadcastSubs[roomId] ?? {}).length
  2174→    ) {
  2175→      const isConnected = this._rooms[roomId]?.isConnected;
  2176→
  2177→      delete this._rooms[roomId];
  2178→      delete this._presence[roomId];
  2179→      delete this._broadcastSubs[roomId];
  2180→
  2181→      if (isConnected) {
  2182→        this._tryLeaveRoom(roomId);
  2183→      } else {
  2184→        this._roomsPendingLeave[roomId] = true;
  2185→      }
  2186→    }
  2187→  }
  2188→
  2189→  // --------
  2190→  // Presence
  2191→
  2192→  // TODO: look into typing again
  2193→  getPresence(roomType, roomId, opts = {}) {
  2194→    const room = this._rooms[roomId];
  2195→    const presence = this._presence[roomId];
  2196→    if (!room || !presence || !presence.result) return null;
  2197→
  2198→    return {
  2199→      ...buildPresenceSlice(presence.result, opts, this._sessionId),
  2200→      isLoading: !room.isConnected,
  2201→      error: room.error,
  2202→    };
  2203→  }
  2204→
  2205→  // TODO: look into typing again
  2206→  publishPresence(roomType, roomId, partialData) {
  2207→    const room = this._rooms[roomId];
  2208→    const presence = this._presence[roomId];
  2209→
  2210→    if (!room || !presence) {
  2211→      return;
  2212→    }
  2213→
  2214→    presence.result = presence.result || {};
  2215→    const data = {
  2216→      ...presence.result.user,
  2217→      ...partialData,
  2218→    };
  2219→
  2220→    presence.result.user = data;
  2221→
  2222→    if (!room.isConnected) {
  2223→      return;
  2224→    }
  2225→
  2226→    this._trySetPresence(roomId, data);
  2227→    this._notifyPresenceSubs(roomId);
  2228→  }
  2229→
  2230→  _trySetPresence(roomId, data) {
  2231→    this._trySendAuthed(uuid(), {
  2232→      op: 'set-presence',
  2233→      'room-id': roomId,
  2234→      data,
  2235→    });
  2236→  }
  2237→
  2238→  _tryJoinRoom(roomId, data) {
  2239→    this._trySendAuthed(uuid(), { op: 'join-room', 'room-id': roomId, data });
  2240→    delete this._roomsPendingLeave[roomId];
  2241→  }
  2242→
  2243→  _tryLeaveRoom(roomId) {
  2244→    this._trySendAuthed(uuid(), { op: 'leave-room', 'room-id': roomId });
  2245→  }
  2246→
  2247→  _trySetRoomConnected(roomId, isConnected) {
  2248→    const room = this._rooms[roomId];
  2249→    if (room) {
  2250→      room.isConnected = isConnected;
  2251→    }
  2252→  }
  2253→
  2254→  // TODO: look into typing again
  2255→  subscribePresence(roomType, roomId, opts, cb) {
  2256→    const leaveRoom = this.joinRoom(
  2257→      roomId,
  2258→      // Oct 28, 2025
  2259→      // Note: initialData is deprecated.
  2260→      // Keeping here for backwards compatibility
  2261→      opts.initialPresence || opts.initialData,
  2262→    );
  2263→
  2264→    const handler = { ...opts, roomId, cb, prev: null };
  2265→
  2266→    this._presence[roomId] = this._presence[roomId] || {};
  2267→    this._presence[roomId].handlers = this._presence[roomId].handlers || [];
  2268→    this._presence[roomId].handlers.push(handler);
  2269→
  2270→    this._notifyPresenceSub(roomId, handler);
  2271→
  2272→    return () => {
  2273→      this._presence[roomId].handlers =
  2274→        this._presence[roomId]?.handlers?.filter((x) => x !== handler) ?? [];
  2275→
  2276→      leaveRoom();
  2277→    };
  2278→  }
  2279→
  2280→  _notifyPresenceSubs(roomId) {
  2281→    this._presence[roomId]?.handlers?.forEach((handler) => {
  2282→      this._notifyPresenceSub(roomId, handler);
  2283→    });
  2284→  }
  2285→
  2286→  _notifyPresenceSub(roomId, handler) {
  2287→    const slice = this.getPresence('', roomId, handler);
  2288→
  2289→    if (!slice) {
  2290→      return;
  2291→    }
  2292→
  2293→    if (handler.prev && !hasPresenceResponseChanged(slice, handler.prev)) {
  2294→      return;
  2295→    }
  2296→
  2297→    handler.prev = slice;
  2298→    handler.cb(slice);
  2299→  }
  2300→
  2301→  _patchPresencePeers(roomId, edits) {
  2302→    const peers = this._presence[roomId]?.result?.peers || {};
  2303→    let sessions = Object.fromEntries(
  2304→      Object.entries(peers).map(([k, v]) => [k, { data: v }]),
  2305→    );
  2306→    const myPresence = this._presence[roomId]?.result;
  2307→    const newSessions = create(sessions, (draft) => {
  2308→      for (let [path, op, value] of edits) {
  2309→        switch (op) {
  2310→          case '+':
  2311→            insertInMutative(draft, path, value);
  2312→            break;
  2313→          case 'r':
  2314→            assocInMutative(draft, path, value);
  2315→            break;
  2316→          case '-':
  2317→            dissocInMutative(draft, path);
  2318→            break;
  2319→        }
  2320→      }
  2321→      // Ignore our own edits
  2322→      delete draft[this._sessionId];
  2323→    });
  2324→
  2325→    this._setPresencePeers(roomId, newSessions);
  2326→  }
  2327→
  2328→  _setPresencePeers(roomId, data) {
  2329→    const sessions = { ...data };
  2330→    // no need to keep track of `user`
  2331→    delete sessions[this._sessionId];
  2332→    const peers = Object.fromEntries(
  2333→      Object.entries(sessions).map(([k, v]) => [k, v.data]),
  2334→    );
  2335→
  2336→    this._presence = create(this._presence, (draft) => {
  2337→      assocInMutative(draft, [roomId, 'result', 'peers'], peers);
  2338→    });
  2339→  }
  2340→
  2341→  // --------
  2342→  // Broadcast
  2343→
  2344→  publishTopic({ roomType, roomId, topic, data }) {
  2345→    const room = this._rooms[roomId];
  2346→
  2347→    if (!room) {
  2348→      return;
  2349→    }
  2350→
  2351→    if (!room.isConnected) {
  2352→      this._broadcastQueue[roomId] = this._broadcastQueue[roomId] ?? [];
  2353→      this._broadcastQueue[roomId].push({ topic, roomType, data });
  2354→
  2355→      return;
  2356→    }
  2357→
  2358→    this._tryBroadcast(roomId, roomType, topic, data);
  2359→  }
  2360→
  2361→  _tryBroadcast(roomId, roomType, topic, data) {
  2362→    this._trySendAuthed(uuid(), {
  2363→      op: 'client-broadcast',
  2364→      'room-id': roomId,
  2365→      roomType,
  2366→      topic,
  2367→      data,
  2368→    });
  2369→  }
  2370→
  2371→  subscribeTopic(roomId, topic, cb) {
  2372→    const leaveRoom = this.joinRoom(roomId);
  2373→
  2374→    this._broadcastSubs[roomId] = this._broadcastSubs[roomId] || {};
  2375→    this._broadcastSubs[roomId][topic] =
  2376→      this._broadcastSubs[roomId][topic] || [];
  2377→    this._broadcastSubs[roomId][topic].push(cb);
  2378→    this._presence[roomId] = this._presence[roomId] || {};
  2379→
  2380→    return () => {
  2381→      this._broadcastSubs[roomId][topic] = this._broadcastSubs[roomId][
  2382→        topic
  2383→      ].filter((x) => x !== cb);
  2384→
  2385→      if (!this._broadcastSubs[roomId][topic].length) {
  2386→        delete this._broadcastSubs[roomId][topic];
  2387→      }
  2388→
  2389→      leaveRoom();
  2390→    };
  2391→  }
  2392→
  2393→  _notifyBroadcastSubs(room, topic, msg) {
  2394→    this._broadcastSubs?.[room]?.[topic]?.forEach((cb) => {
  2395→      const data = msg.data?.data;
  2396→
  2397→      const peer =
  2398→        msg.data['peer-id'] === this._sessionId
  2399→          ? this._presence[room]?.result?.user
  2400→          : this._presence[room]?.result?.peers?.[msg.data['peer-id']];
  2401→
  2402→      return cb(data, peer);
  2403→    });
  2404→  }

    51→// MARK: - StateTracker REMOVED (TypeScript Parity)
    52→//
    53→// ## Why StateTracker Was Removed
    54→//
    55→// The StateTracker attempted to infer CHANGES from state by comparing the current
    56→// collection value against tracked server state. This required a fragile 50% heuristic
    57→// for deletion detection that could:
    58→// - Fail to detect real deletions (if overlap < 50%)
    59→// - Incorrectly detect deletions (if overlap >= 50% but items weren't in the view)
    60→//
    61→// ## TypeScript SDK Approach (Reactor.js)
    62→//
    63→// The TypeScript SDK NEVER uses diff-based deletion detection. Instead:
    64→// - Every mutation is explicit: `tx.todos[id].delete()`
    65→// - Mutations are stored with explicit tx-steps: `["delete", "todos", "id123"]`
    66→// - No inference of intent from state changes
    67→//
    68→// ## Migration Path
    69→//
    70→// Instead of using `$todos.withLock { $0.remove(todo) }`, use the generated
    71→// mutation methods:
    72→//
    73→// ```swift
    74→// // OLD (no longer syncs to server):
    75→// $todos.withLock { $0.remove(todo) }
    76→//
    77→// // NEW (explicit mutation, TypeScript parity):
    78→// try await $todos.delete(id: todo.id)
    79→// ```
    80→//
    81→// The `withLock` API still works for local UI state manipulation, but changes
    82→// made via `withLock` are NOT automatically sent to the server. Only explicit
    83→// mutation methods (`create`, `update`, `delete`, `link`, `unlink`) will sync.
    84→//
    85→// ## Reference
    86→// - TypeScript Reactor.js: Lines 1348-1370 (pushOps stores EXPLICIT mutation)
    87→// - Plan: Phase 4 "Remove StateTracker, Only Support Explicit Mutations"

   272→// MARK: - InstantSyncCollectionKey

   274→/// A type defining a bidirectional sync with InstantDB collections.
   275→///
   276→/// You typically do not refer to this type directly, and will use
   277→/// ``Sharing/SharedReaderKey/instantSync(_:client:)-swift.type.method`` or
   278→/// ``Sharing/SharedReaderKey/instantSync(configuration:client:)-swift.type.method`` to create instances.
   279→public struct InstantSyncCollectionKey<Value: RangeReplaceableCollection & Sendable>: SharedKey
   280→where Value.Element: EntityIdentifiable & Sendable {
   281→  typealias Element = Value.Element
   282→  let appID: String
   283→  let request: any SharingInstantSync.KeyCollectionRequest<Element>
   284→  
   285→  public typealias ID = UniqueRequestKeyID
   286→  
   287→  public var id: ID {
   288→    let configuration = request.configuration
   289→    return ID(
   290→      appID: appID,
   291→      namespace: configuration?.namespace ?? "",
   292→      orderBy: configuration?.orderBy,
   293→      whereClause: configuration?.whereClause,
   294→      includedLinks: configuration?.includedLinks ?? [],
   295→      linkTree: configuration?.linkTree ?? []
   296→    )
   297→  }
   298→  
   299→  init(
   300→    request: some SharingInstantSync.KeyCollectionRequest<Element>,
   301→    appID: String? = nil
   302→  ) {
   303→    @Dependency(\.instantAppID) var defaultAppID
   304→    self.appID = appID ?? defaultAppID
   305→    self.request = request
   306→  }
   307→  
   308→  #if canImport(SwiftUI)
   309→  func withResume(_ action: () -> Void) {
   310→    withAnimation(request.configuration?.animation) {
   311→      action()
   312→    }
   313→  }
   314→  #else
   315→  func withResume(_ action: () -> Void) {
   316→    action()
   317→  }
   318→  #endif
   319→  
   320→  public func load(context: LoadContext<Value>, continuation: LoadContinuation<Value>) {
   321→    @Dependency(\.instantReactor) var reactor
   322→    guard case .userInitiated = context, let configuration = request.configuration else {
   323→      logDebug("Load: non-userInitiated context or no configuration, returning initial value")
   324→      withResume {
   325→        continuation.resumeReturningInitialValue()
   326→      }
   327→      return
   328→    }
   329→    
   330→    // Handle testing mode
   331→    guard !isTesting else {
   332→      logDebug("Load: testing mode")
   333→      if let testingValue = configuration.testingValue {
   334→        withResume {
   335→          continuation.resume(returning: Value(testingValue))
   336→        }
   337→      } else {
   338→        withResume {
   339→          continuation.resumeReturningInitialValue()
   340→        }
   341→      }
   342→      return
   343→    }
   344→    
   345→    logInfo("Load: fetching data for namespace: \(configuration.namespace)")
   346→    
   347→    let loadId = UUID().uuidString.prefix(8)
   348→    logDebug("Load[\(loadId)]: starting load task via Reactor")
   349→    
   350→    Task { @MainActor in
   351→        let stream = await reactor.subscribe(appID: appID, configuration: configuration)
   352→        for await data in stream {
   353→            withResume {
   354→                continuation.resume(returning: Value(data))
   355→            }
   356→            break // One-shot
   357→        }
   358→    }
   359→  }
   360→  
   361→  public func subscribe(
   362→    context: LoadContext<Value>,
   363→    subscriber: SharedSubscriber<Value>
   364→  ) -> SharedSubscription {
   365→    @Dependency(\.instantReactor) var reactor
   366→    
   367→    guard let configuration = request.configuration else {
   368→      logDebug("Subscribe: no configuration provided, returning empty subscription")
   369→      return SharedSubscription {}
   370→    }
   371→    
   372→    // Handle testing mode
   373→    guard !isTesting else {
   374→      logDebug("Subscribe: testing mode, using testing value")
   375→      if let testingValue = configuration.testingValue {
   376→        withResume {
   377→          subscriber.yield(Value(testingValue))
   378→        }
   379→      }
   380→      return SharedSubscription {}
   381→    }
   382→    
   383→    logInfo("Subscribe: starting subscription for namespace: \(configuration.namespace)")
   384→
   385→    let subscriptionId = UUID().uuidString.prefix(8)
   386→    logDebug("Subscribe[\(subscriptionId)]: creating new subscription task via Reactor")
   387→
   388→    let task = Task { @MainActor in
   389→        let stream = await reactor.subscribe(appID: appID, configuration: configuration)
   390→        for await data in stream {
   391→            // Yield server data directly - no filtering or state tracking needed
   392→            // Deletions are handled explicitly via $collection.delete(id:) which
   393→            // calls Reactor.transact() with explicit delete operations
   394→            withResume {
   395→                subscriber.yield(Value(data))
   396→            }
   397→        }
   398→    }
   399→
   400→    return SharedSubscription {
   401→      logDebug("Subscribe[\(subscriptionId)]: SharedSubscription cancelled for \(configuration.namespace)")
   402→      task.cancel()
   403→    }
   404→  }

   406→  /// `save()` is a NO-OP - use explicit mutation methods instead.
   407→  ///
   408→  /// ## Why This Is A No-Op (TypeScript Parity)
   409→  ///
   410→  /// The TypeScript SDK never infers mutations from state changes. Every mutation
   411→  /// is explicit: `tx.todos[id].update({...})`, `tx.todos[id].delete()`.

   413→  /// The previous implementation used a `StateTracker` with a 50% heuristic for
   414→  /// deletion detection, which was fragile and didn't match TypeScript behavior.
   415→  ///
   416→  /// ## Migration
   417→  ///
   418→  /// Instead of relying on `save()` being called automatically when you use
   419→  /// `$todos.withLock { ... }`, use the generated explicit mutation methods:
   420→  ///
   421→  /// ```swift
   422→  /// // OLD (no longer syncs to server):
   423→  /// $todos.withLock { $0.append(newTodo) }
   424→  /// $todos.withLock { $0.remove(todo) }
   425→  ///
   426→  /// // NEW (explicit mutations, TypeScript parity):
   427→  /// try await $todos.create(newTodo)
   428→  /// try await $todos.delete(id: todo.id)
   429→  /// try await $todos.update(id: todo.id) { $0.title = "New Title" }
   430→  /// ```
   431→  ///
   432→  /// The `withLock` API still works for LOCAL state manipulation (e.g., UI
   433→  /// optimistic updates), but those changes are NOT automatically sent to
   434→  /// the server. Only explicit mutation methods sync with InstantDB.
   435→  ///
   436→  /// ## Reference
   437→  /// - TypeScript Reactor.js: Lines 1348-1370 (explicit tx-steps only)
   438→  /// - Plan: Phase 4 "Remove StateTracker, Only Support Explicit Mutations"
   439→  public func save(
   440→    _ value: Value,
   441→    context: SaveContext,
   442→    continuation: SaveContinuation
   443→  ) {
   444→    // No-op: Changes made via withLock are NOT sent to the server.
   445→    // Use explicit mutation methods ($collection.create, .update, .delete) instead.
   446→    //
   447→    // This matches TypeScript SDK behavior where mutations are always explicit.
   448→    continuation.resume()
   449→  }

    46→            // When a ref triple [subject, refAttr, target] is added, the target entity's
    47→            // "resolved view" changes (it now has an inbound link from subject).
    48→            // Without this, subscriptions driven by reverse links (e.g., media.transcriptionRuns)
    49→            // won't see new links until a server refresh.
    50→            if isRef, case .ref(let targetId) = triple.value {
    51→                changedIDs.insert(targetId)

    90→        
    91→        notifyObservers(for: idsChanged)
    92→    }
    93→    
    94→    // MARK: - Legacy / Helper Support
    95→    
    96→    /// Merges dictionaries (from Server Tree).
    97→    /// Used by legacy Reactor calls or if manual merging is needed.
    98→    func merge(dictionaries: [[String: Any]]) {
    99→        var changedIDs: Set<String> = []
   100→        for dict in dictionaries {
   101→            guard let id = dict["id"] as? String else { continue }
   102→            changedIDs.insert(id)
   103→        }
   104→        notifyObservers(for: changedIDs)
   105→    }
   106→    
   107→    // MARK: - Data Access
   108→
   109→    public func get<T: Decodable>(id: String, includedLinks: Set<String>? = nil) -> T? {
   110→        return inner.get(id: id, attrsStore: attrsStore, includedLinks: includedLinks)
   111→    }
   112→
   113→    // MARK: - Observation
   114→
   115→    @discardableResult
   116→    func addObserver(id: String, onChange: @escaping @Sendable () -> Void) -> UUID {
   117→        lock.withLock {
   118→            let token = UUID()
   119→            if observers[id] == nil {
   120→                observers[id] = [:]
   121→            }
   122→            observers[id]?[token] = onChange
   123→            return token
   124→        }
   125→    }
   126→
   127→    func removeObserver(id: String, token: UUID) {
   128→        lock.withLock {
   129→            observers[id]?.removeValue(forKey: token)
   130→            if observers[id]?.isEmpty == true {
   131→                observers[id] = nil
   132→            }
   133→        }
   134→    }
   135→
   136→    private func notifyObservers(for ids: Set<String>) {
   137→        if ids.isEmpty { return }
   138→        
   139→        // Snapshot callbacks synchronously to avoid data races
   140→        let snapshot: [@Sendable () -> Void] = lock.withLock {
   141→            var callbacks: [@Sendable () -> Void] = []
   142→            for id in ids {
   143→                if let tokens = observers[id] {
   144→                    callbacks.append(contentsOf: tokens.values)
   145→                }
   146→            }
   147→            return callbacks
   148→        }
   149→        
   150→        if snapshot.isEmpty { return }
   151→
   152→        // Execute callbacks asynchronously
   153→        Task {
   154→            for callback in snapshot {
   155→                callback()
   156→            }
   157→        }
   158→    }
   159→}

   183→export function getInMap(obj, path) {

   187→function deleteInMap(m, path) {
   188→  if (path.length === 0) throw new Error('path must have at least one element');
   189→  if (path.length === 1) {
   190→    m.delete(path[0]);
   191→    return;
   192→  }
   193→  const [head, ...tail] = path;
   194→  if (!m.has(head)) return;
   195→  deleteInMap(m.get(head), tail);
   196→}
   197→
   198→function setInMap(m: Map<any, any>, path: any[], value: any) {
   199→  let current = m;
   200→  const lastI = path.length - 1;
   201→  for (let i = 0; i < lastI; i++) {
   202→    const part = path[i];
   203→
   204→    let nextMap = current.get(part);
   205→    if (nextMap === undefined) {
   206→      nextMap = new Map();
   207→      current.set(part, nextMap);
   208→    }
   209→    current = nextMap;
   210→  }
   211→  if (lastI > -1) {
   212→    current.set(path[lastI], value);
   213→  }
   214→}

   331→// We may have local triples with lookup refs in them,

   336→function resolveLookupRefs(store: Store, triple: Triple): Triple | null {
   337→  let eid;

   340→  if (Array.isArray(triple[0])) {
   341→    const [a, v] = triple[0];
   342→    const eMaps = store.aev.get(a);
   343→    if (!eMaps) {
   344→      // We don't have the attr, so don't try to add the
   345→      // triple to the store
   346→      return null;
   347→    }
   348→    // This would be a lot more efficient with a ave index
   349→    const triples = allMapValues(eMaps, 2);
   350→    eid = triples.find((x) => x[2] === v)?.[0];
   351→  } else {
   352→    eid = triple[0];
   353→  }
   354→
   355→  if (!eid) {
   356→    // We don't know the eid that the ref refers to, so
   357→    // we can't add the triple to the store.
   358→    return null;
   359→  }
   360→
   361→  // Check if v is a lookup ref
   362→  const lookupV = triple[2];
   363→  if (
   364→    Array.isArray(lookupV) &&
   365→    lookupV.length === 2 &&
   366→    store.aev.get(lookupV[0])
   367→  ) {
   368→    const [a, v] = lookupV;
   369→    const eMaps = store.aev.get(a);
   370→    if (!eMaps) {
   371→      // We don't have the attr, so don't try to add the
   372→      // triple to the store
   373→      return null;
   374→    }
   375→    const triples = allMapValues(eMaps, 2);
   376→    const value = triples.find((x) => x[2] === v)?.[0];
   377→    if (!value) {
   378→      return null;
   379→    }
   380→    const [_e, aid, _v, ...rest] = triple;
   381→    return [eid, aid, value, ...rest];
   382→  } else {
   383→    const [_, ...rest] = triple;
   384→    return [eid, ...rest];
   385→  }
   386→}

   388→export function retractTriple(

   411→function getCreatedAt(

   413→  attr: InstantDBAttr,

   433→   *   triples as optimistic updates.
   434→   *
   435→   * 2. We increment by `_seed`, to make sure there are no
   436→   *    two triples with the same `createdAt`. This is
   437→   *    done to make tests more predictable.

   440→   * use this value as an _actual_ `createdAt` timestamp.

   442→   * use `createdAt` for each triple, to infer a `createdAt` and
   443→   * `updatedAt` value for each object.

   445→  return createdAt || Date.now() * 10 + _seed++;

   484→  }

   491→function mergeTriple(store: Store, attrsStore: AttrsStore, rawTriple: Triple) {

   507→
   508→  const currentTriple = eavValuesMap.values().next()?.value;
   509→  if (!currentTriple) return;
   510→
   511→  const currentValue = currentTriple[2];
   512→
   513→  const updatedValue = immutableDeepMerge(currentValue, update);
   514→  const enhancedTriple = [
   515→    eid,
   516→    aid,
   517→    updatedValue,
   518→    getCreatedAt(store, attr, currentTriple),
   519→  ];
   520→
   521→  setInMap(store.eav, [eid, aid], new Map([[updatedValue, enhancedTriple]]));
   522→  setInMap(store.aev, [aid, eid], new Map([[updatedValue, enhancedTriple]]));
   523→}

   525→function deleteEntity(store: Store, attrsStore: AttrsStore, args: any[]) {
   526→  const [lookup, etype] = args;
   527→  const triple = resolveLookupRefs(store, [lookup] as unknown as Triple);
   528→
   529→  if (!triple) {
   530→    return;
   531→  }
   532→  const [id] = triple;
   533→
   534→  // delete forward links and attributes + cardinality one links
   535→  const eMap = store.eav.get(id);
   536→  if (eMap) {
   537→    for (const a of eMap.keys()) {
   538→      const attr = attrsStore.getAttr(a);
   539→
   540→      // delete cascade refs
   541→      if (attr && attr['on-delete-reverse'] === 'cascade') {
   542→        allMapValues(eMap.get(a), 1).forEach(
   543→          ([e, a, v]: [string, string, any]) =>
   544→            deleteEntity(store, attrsStore, [v, attr['reverse-identity']?.[1]]),
   545→        );
   546→      }
   547→
   548→      if (
   549→        // Fall back to deleting everything if we've rehydrated tx-steps from
   550→        // the store that didn't set `etype` in deleteEntity
   551→        !etype ||
   552→        // If we don't know about the attr, let's just get rid of it
   553→        !attr ||
   554→        // Make sure it matches the etype
   555→        attr['forward-identity']?.[1] === etype
   556→      ) {
   557→        deleteInMap(store.aev, [a, id]);
   558→        deleteInMap(store.eav, [id, a]);
   559→      }
   560→    }
   561→    // Clear out the eav index for `id` if we deleted all of the attributes
   562→    if (eMap.size === 0) {
   563→      deleteInMap(store.eav, [id]);
   564→    }
   565→  }
   566→
   567→  // delete reverse links
   568→  const vaeTriples = store.vae.get(id) && allMapValues(store.vae.get(id), 2);
   569→
   570→  if (vaeTriples) {
   571→    vaeTriples.forEach((triple: Triple) => {
   572→      const [e, a, v] = triple;
   573→      const attr = attrsStore.getAttr(a);
   574→      if (!etype || !attr || attr['reverse-identity']?.[1] === etype) {
   575→        deleteInMap(store.eav, [e, a, v]);
   576→        deleteInMap(store.aev, [a, e, v]);
   577→        deleteInMap(store.vae, [v, a, e]);
   578→      }
   579→      if (
   580→        attr &&
   581→        attr['on-delete'] === 'cascade' &&
   582→        attr['reverse-identity']?.[1] === etype
   583→      ) {
   584→        deleteEntity(store, attrsStore, [e, attr['forward-identity']?.[1]]);
   585→      }
   586→    });
   587→  }
   588→  // Clear out vae index for `id` if we deleted all the reverse attributes
   589→  if (store.vae.get(id)?.size === 0) {
   590→    deleteInMap(store.vae, [id]);
   591→  }
   592→}
   593→
   594→// (XXX): Whenever we change/delete attrs,
   595→// We indiscriminately reset the index map.
   596→// There are lots of opportunities for optimization:
   597→// * We _only_ need to run this indexes change. We could detect that
   598→// * We could batch this reset at the end
   599→// * We could add an ave index for all triples, so removing the
   600→//   right triples is easy and fast.
   601→function resetIndexMap(store: Store, attrsStore, newTriples: Triple[]) {
   602→  const newIndexMap = createTripleIndexes(
   603→    attrsStore,
   604→    newTriples,
   605→    store.useDateObjects,
   606→  );
   607→  Object.keys(newIndexMap).forEach((key) => {
   608→    store[key] = newIndexMap[key];
   609→  });
   610→}
   611→
   612→function addAttr(attrsStore: AttrsStore, [attr]: [InstantDBAttr]) {
   613→  attrsStore.addAttr(attr);
   614→}
   615→
   616→function getAllTriples(store: Store): Triple[] {
   617→  return allMapValues(store.eav, 3);
   618→}
   619→
   620→function deleteAttr(store: Store, attrsStore: AttrsStore, [id]: [string]) {
   621→  if (!attrsStore.getAttr(id)) return;
   622→  const newTriples = getAllTriples(store).filter(([_, aid]) => aid !== id);
   623→  attrsStore.deleteAttr(id);
   624→  resetIndexMap(store, attrsStore, newTriples);
   625→}
   626→
   627→function updateAttr(
   628→  store: Store,
   629→  attrsStore: AttrsStore,
   630→  [partialAttr]: [Partial<InstantDBAttr> & { id: string }],
   631→) {
   632→  const attr = attrsStore.getAttr(partialAttr.id);
   633→  if (!attr) return;
   634→  attrsStore.updateAttr(partialAttr);
   635→  resetIndexMap(store, attrsStore, getAllTriples(store));
   636→}
   637→
   638→function applyTxStep(store: Store, attrsStore: AttrsStore, txStep) {
   639→  const [action, ...args] = txStep;
   640→  switch (action) {
   641→    case 'add-triple':
   642→      addTriple(store, attrsStore, args);
   643→      break;
   644→    case 'deep-merge-triple':
   645→      mergeTriple(store, attrsStore, args);
   646→      break;
   647→    case 'retract-triple':
   648→      retractTriple(store, attrsStore, args);
   649→      break;
   650→    case 'delete-entity':
   651→      deleteEntity(store, attrsStore, args);
   652→      break;
   653→    case 'add-attr':
   654→      addAttr(attrsStore, args);
   655→      break;
   656→    case 'delete-attr':
   657→      deleteAttr(store, attrsStore, args);
   658→      break;
   659→    case 'update-attr':
   660→      updateAttr(store, attrsStore, args);
   661→      break;
   662→    case 'restore-attr':
   663→      break;
   664→    case 'rule-params':
   665→      break;
   666→    default:
   667→      throw new Error(`unhandled transaction action: ${action}`);
   668→  }
   669→}
   670→
   671→export function allMapValues(m, level, res: any[] = []) {
   672→  if (!m) {
   673→    return res;
   674→  }
   675→  if (level === 0) {
   676→    return res;
   677→  }
   678→  if (level === 1) {
   679→    for (const v of m.values()) {
   680→      res.push(v);
   681→    }
   682→    return res;
   683→  }
   684→  for (const v of m.values()) {
   685→    allMapValues(v, level - 1, res);
   686→  }
   687→
   688→  return res;
   689→}
   690→
   691→function triplesByValue(store: Store, m: Map<any, Triple>, v: any) {
   692→  const res: Triple[] = [];
   693→  if (v?.hasOwnProperty('$not')) {
   694→    for (const candidate of m.keys()) {
   695→      if (v.$not !== candidate) {
   696→        res.push(m.get(candidate) as Triple);
   697→      }
   698→    }
   699→    return res;
   700→  }
   701→
   702→  if (v?.hasOwnProperty('$isNull')) {
   703→    const { attrId, isNull, reverse } = v.$isNull;
   704→
   705→    if (reverse) {
   706→      for (const candidate of m.keys()) {
   707→        const vMap = store.vae.get(candidate);
   708→        const isValNull = !vMap || !vMap.get(attrId);
   709→        if (isNull ? isValNull : !isValNull) {
   710→          res.push(m.get(candidate) as Triple);
   711→        }
   712→      }
   713→    } else {
   714→      const aMap = store.aev.get(attrId);
   715→      for (const candidate of m.keys()) {
   716→        const isValNull =
   717→          !aMap || aMap.get(candidate)?.get(null) || !aMap.get(candidate);
   718→        if (isNull ? isValNull : !isValNull) {
   719→          res.push(m.get(candidate) as Triple);
   720→        }
   721→      }
   722→    }
   723→    return res;
   724→  }
   725→
   726→  if (v?.$comparator) {
   727→    // TODO: A sorted index would be nice here
   728→    return allMapValues(m, 1).filter(v.$op);
   729→  }
   730→
   731→  const values = v.in || v.$in || [v];
   732→
   733→  for (const value of values) {
   734→    const triple = m.get(value);
   735→    if (triple) {
   736→      res.push(triple);
   737→    }
   738→  }
   739→
   740→  return res;
   741→}
   742→
   743→// A poor man's pattern matching
   744→// Returns either eav, ea, ev, av, v, or ''
   745→function whichIdx(e, a, v): 'eav' | 'ea' | 'ev' | 'av' | 'e' | 'a' | 'v' | '' {
   746→  let res = '';
   747→  if (e !== undefined) {
   748→    res += 'e';
   749→  }
   750→  if (a !== undefined) {
   751→    res += 'a';
   752→  }
   753→  if (v !== undefined) {
   754→    res += 'v';
   755→  }
   756→  return res as 'eav' | 'ea' | 'ev' | 'av' | 'e' | 'a' | 'v' | '';
   757→}
   758→
   759→export function getTriples(store, [e, a, v]) {
   760→  const idx = whichIdx(e, a, v);
   761→  switch (idx) {
   762→    case 'e': {
   763→      const eMap = store.eav.get(e);
   764→      return allMapValues(eMap, 2);
   765→    }
   766→    case 'ea': {
   767→      const aMap = store.eav.get(e)?.get(a);
   768→      return allMapValues(aMap, 1);
   769→    }
   770→    case 'eav': {
   771→      const aMap = store.eav.get(e)?.get(a);
   772→      if (!aMap) {
   773→        return [];
   774→      }
   775→      return triplesByValue(store, aMap, v);
   776→    }
   777→    case 'ev': {
   778→      const eMap = store.eav.get(e);
   779→      if (!eMap) {
   780→        return [];
   781→      }
   782→      const res: Triple[] = [];
   783→      for (const aMap of eMap.values()) {
   784→        res.push(...triplesByValue(store, aMap, v));
   785→      }
   786→      return res;
   787→    }
   788→    case 'a': {
   789→      const aMap = store.aev.get(a);
   790→      return allMapValues(aMap, 2);
   791→    }
   792→    case 'av': {
   793→      const aMap = store.aev.get(a);
   794→      if (!aMap) {
   795→        return [];
   796→      }
   797→      const res: Triple[] = [];
   798→      for (const eMap of aMap.values()) {
   799→        res.push(...triplesByValue(store, eMap, v));
   800→      }
   801→      return res;
   802→    }
   803→    case 'v': {
   804→      const res: Triple[] = [];
   805→      for (const eMap of store.eav.values()) {
   806→        for (const aMap of eMap.values()) {
   807→          res.push(...triplesByValue(store, aMap, v));
   808→        }
   809→      }
   810→      return res;
   811→    }
   812→    default: {
   813→      return allMapValues(store.eav, 3);
   814→    }
   815→  }
   816→}
   817→
   818→export function getAsObject(
   819→  store: Store,
   820→  attrs: Map<string, InstantDBAttr> | undefined,
   821→  e: string,
   822→) {
   823→  const obj = {};
   824→
   825→  if (!attrs) {
   826→    return obj;
   827→  }
   828→
   829→  for (const [label, attr] of attrs.entries()) {
   830→    const aMap = store.eav.get(e)?.get(attr.id);
   831→    const triples = allMapValues(aMap, 1);
   832→    for (const triple of triples) {
   833→      obj[label] = triple[2];
   834→    }
   835→  }
   836→
   837→  return obj;
   838→}

   841→  attrsStore: AttrsStore,

   860→export function getPrimaryKeyAttr(attrsStore: AttrsStore, etype: string) {
   861→  const fromPrimary = attrsStore.primaryKeys.get(etype);
   862→  if (fromPrimary) {
   863→    return fromPrimary;
   864→  }
   865→  return attrsStore.forwardIdents.get(etype)?.get('id');

   867→
   868→function findTriple(
   869→  store: Store,
   870→  attrsStore: AttrsStore,
   871→  rawTriple: [string, string, any] | Triple,
   872→): Triple | undefined {
   873→  const triple = resolveLookupRefs(store, rawTriple as Triple);
   874→  if (!triple) {
   875→    return;
   876→  }
   877→
   878→  const [eid, aid, v] = triple;
   879→  const attr = attrsStore.getAttr(aid);
   880→  if (!attr) {
   881→    // (XXX): Due to the way we're handling attrs, it's
   882→    // possible to enter a state where we receive a triple without an attr.
   883→    // See: https://github.com/jsventures/instant-local/pull/132 for details.
   884→    // For now, if we receive a command without an attr, we no-op.
   885→    return;
   886→  }
   887→
   888→  return getInMap(store.eav, [eid, aid]);
   889→}

   891→export function transact(
   892→  store: Store,
   893→  attrsStore: AttrsStore,
   894→  txSteps,
   895→): { store: Store; attrsStore: AttrsStore } {
   896→  const txStepsFiltered = txSteps.filter(
   897→    ([action, eid, attrId, value, opts]) => {
   898→      if (action !== 'add-triple' && action !== 'deep-merge-triple') {
   899→        return true;
   900→      }
   901→
   902→      const mode = opts?.mode;
   903→      if (mode !== 'create' && mode !== 'update') {
   904→        return true;
   905→      }
   906→
   907→      let exists = false;
   908→
   909→      const attr = attrsStore.getAttr(attrId);
   910→      if (attr) {
   911→        const idAttr = getPrimaryKeyAttr(
   912→          attrsStore,
   913→          attr['forward-identity'][1],
   914→        );
   915→        exists = !!findTriple(store, attrsStore, [
   916→          eid as string,
   917→          idAttr?.id as string,
   918→          eid,
   919→        ]);
   920→      }
   921→
   922→      if (mode === 'create' && exists) {
   923→        return false;
   924→      }
   925→
   926→      if (mode === 'update' && !exists) {
   927→        return false;
   928→      }
   929→
   930→      return true;
   931→    },
   932→  );
   933→
   934→  return create(
   935→    { store, attrsStore },
   936→    (draft) => {
   937→      txStepsFiltered.forEach((txStep) => {
   938→        applyTxStep(draft.store, draft.attrsStore, txStep);
   939→      });
   940→    },
   941→    {
   942→      mark: (target) => {
   943→        if (target instanceof AttrsStoreClass) {
   944→          return 'immutable';
   945→        }
   946→      },
   947→    },
   948→  );
   949→}

     6→/// A wrapper around InstantDB.TripleStore that adds Observation capabilities.

    26→    public func addTriple(_ triple: Triple, hasCardinalityOne: Bool, isRef: Bool) {
    27→        inner.addTriple(triple, hasCardinalityOne: hasCardinalityOne, isRef: isRef)
    28→        var changedIDs: Set<String> = [triple.entityId]

    30→        if isRef, case .ref(let targetId) = triple.value {

    36→    public func addTriples(_ triples: [Triple]) {
    37→        var changedIDs: Set<String> = []
    38→        for triple in triples {
    39→            let attr = attrsStore.getAttr(triple.attributeId)
    40→            let hasCardinalityOne = attr?.cardinality == .one
    41→            let isRef = attr?.valueType == .ref
    42→            inner.addTriple(triple, hasCardinalityOne: hasCardinalityOne, isRef: isRef)
    43→            changedIDs.insert(triple.entityId)
    44→
    45→            // For ref triples, also notify the target entity so reverse link views update.
    46→            // When a ref triple [subject, refAttr, target] is added, the target entity's
    47→            // "resolved view" changes (it now has an inbound link from subject).
    48→            // Without this, subscriptions driven by reverse links (e.g., media.transcriptionRuns)
    49→            // won't see new links until a server refresh.
    50→            if isRef, case .ref(let targetId) = triple.value {
    51→                changedIDs.insert(targetId)
    52→            }
    53→        }
    54→        notifyObservers(for: changedIDs)

    61→        if isRef, case .ref(let targetId) = triple.value {
    62→            changedIDs.insert(targetId)

    67→    public func deleteEntity(id: String) {
    68→        var idsChanged: Set<String> = [id]
    69→        
    70→        // 1. Delete forward attributes and links (triples where this entity is the subject)
    71→        let triples = inner.getTriples(entity: id)
    72→        for triple in triples {
    73→             let attr = attrsStore.getAttr(triple.attributeId)
    74→             let isRef = attr?.valueType == .ref

   136→    private func notifyObservers(for ids: Set<String>) {

     5→extension InstantDB.TripleStore {
     6→    
     7→    /// Recursively resolves an entity into a dictionary, following references.
     8→    /// This is used to hydrate `Codable` structs from the flat TripleStore.
     9→    ///
    10→    /// - Parameters:
    11→    ///   - id: The entity ID to resolve.
    12→    ///   - attrsStore: The store containing attribute definitions (schema).
    13→    ///   - depth: Current recursion depth (to prevent infinite loops if circular).
    14→    ///   - maxDepth: Maximum recursion depth.
    15→    ///   - includedLinks: Optional set of link names to resolve. If nil, all links are resolved.
    16→    ///                    If empty set, no links are resolved. This matches the TypeScript SDK's
    17→    ///                    query-driven link resolution behavior.
    18→    /// - Returns: A dictionary representation of the entity.
    19→    public func resolve(
    20→        id: String,
    21→        attrsStore: AttrsStore,
    22→        depth: Int = 0,
    23→        maxDepth: Int = 10,
    24→        includedLinks: Set<String>? = nil
    25→    ) -> [String: Any] {
    26→        if depth > maxDepth { return ["id": id] }
    27→        
    28→        let triples = self.getTriples(entity: id)
    29→        var obj: [String: Any] = ["id": id]
    30→        
    31→        // Group triples by Attribute ID
    32→        let triplesByAttr = Dictionary(grouping: triples, by: { $0.attributeId })
    33→        
    34→        let entityType = triplesByAttr.keys.lazy
    35→            .compactMap { attrId in
    36→                attrsStore.getAttr(attrId)?.forwardIdentity.dropFirst().first
    37→            }
    38→            .first
    39→
    40→        for (attrId, attrTriples) in triplesByAttr {
    41→            guard let attr = attrsStore.getAttr(attrId) else { continue }
    42→            
    43→            // Determine the key name (label)
    44→            // Forward identity: [id, namespace, label]
    45→            // If the schema is incomplete, fall back to using the attribute ID as the label.
    46→            let label = attr.forwardIdentity.last ?? attrId
    47→            
    48→            if attr.valueType == .ref {
    49→                // Allow nested forward links up to maxDepth
    50→                // Previously this was restricted to depth == 0, which prevented
    51→                // nested links like Media.transcriptionRuns.words from being resolved
    52→                if depth >= maxDepth {
    53→                    continue
    54→                }
    55→
    56→                // Skip links not in includedLinks (if specified)
    57→                // This matches the TypeScript SDK's query-driven link resolution:
    58→                // only resolve links that were explicitly requested in the query.
    59→                if let includedLinks = includedLinks, !includedLinks.contains(label) {
    60→                    continue
    61→                }
    62→
    63→                // Handle References (Links)
    64→                var resolvedRefs: [Any] = []
    65→
    66→                for triple in attrTriples {
    67→                    if case .ref(let targetId) = triple.value {
    68→                        let childObj = resolve(id: targetId, attrsStore: attrsStore, depth: depth + 1, maxDepth: maxDepth, includedLinks: includedLinks)
    69→                        // Skip entities that have been deleted or not fully loaded (only have "id" field).
    70→                        // This happens when a where clause references a linked entity (e.g., board.id)
    71→                        // but the entity wasn't explicitly requested via .with(). Including such
    72→                        // "ghost" entities would cause decode failures because required fields are missing.
    73→                        if childObj.count <= 1 {
    74→                            continue
    75→                        }
    76→                        resolvedRefs.append(childObj)
    77→                    } else if case .string(let targetId) = triple.value {
    78→                         // Fallback if ref stored as string? Should satisfy TripleValue.ref though.
    79→                        let childObj = resolve(id: targetId, attrsStore: attrsStore, depth: depth + 1, maxDepth: maxDepth, includedLinks: includedLinks)
    80→                        // Same guard for ghost entities
    81→                        if childObj.count <= 1 {
    82→                            continue
    83→                        }
    84→                        resolvedRefs.append(childObj)
    85→                    }
    86→                }
    87→                
    88→                if attr.cardinality == .many {
    89→                    obj[label] = resolvedRefs
    90→                } else {
    91→                    obj[label] = resolvedRefs.first
    92→                }
    93→                
    94→            } else {
    95→                // Handle Scalar Values
    96→                if attr.cardinality == .many {
    97→                    let values = attrTriples.map { $0.value.toAny() }
    98→                    obj[label] = values
    99→                } else {
   100→                    // Start LWW or any? Triples should be essentially unique by LWW if store enforces it?
   101→                    // Store.addTriple supports cardinality one overwriting.
   102→                    // But getTriples returns all?
   103→                    // SDK Store `addTriple` handles LWW overwrite for cardinality one.
   104→                    // So we expect 1 triple.
   105→                    if let triple = attrTriples.first {
   106→                        obj[label] = triple.value.toAny()
   107→                    }
   108→                }
   109→            }
   110→        }
   111→
   112→        // Resolve reverse links at all depths (not just depth 0)
   113→        // This enables nested queries like posts.with(\.comments) { $0.with(\.author) }
   114→        // where Comment.author is a reverse link (Profile.comments is the forward direction)
   115→        if depth < maxDepth, let entityType {
   116→            let reverseAttrs = attrsStore.revIdents[entityType] ?? [:]
   117→
   118→            for (reverseLabel, attr) in reverseAttrs {
   119→                // Skip reverse links not in includedLinks (if specified)
   120→                // This matches the TypeScript SDK's query-driven link resolution.
   121→                if let includedLinks = includedLinks, !includedLinks.contains(reverseLabel) {
   122→                    continue
   123→                }
   124→
   125→                let reverseTriples = getReverseRefs(entityId: id, attributeId: attr.id)
   126→                guard !reverseTriples.isEmpty else { continue }
   127→
   128→                var resolvedParents: [[String: Any]] = []
   129→                resolvedParents.reserveCapacity(reverseTriples.count)
   130→
   131→                for triple in reverseTriples {
   132→                    let parentObj = resolve(
   133→                        id: triple.entityId,
   134→                        attrsStore: attrsStore,
   135→                        depth: depth + 1,
   136→                        maxDepth: maxDepth,
   137→                        includedLinks: includedLinks
   138→                    )
   139→
   140→                    // Skip entities that have been deleted (only have "id" field)
   141→                    // This happens when a linked entity is deleted from the store but
   142→                    // the reverse reference triple still exists in VAE index.
   143→                    // Including such "ghost" entities would cause decode failures.
   144→                    if parentObj.count <= 1 {
   145→                        continue
   146→                    }
   147→
   148→                    resolvedParents.append(parentObj)
   149→                }
   150→
   151→                // Don't add empty arrays - this prevents decode issues when all
   152→                // reverse-linked entities have been deleted
   153→                guard !resolvedParents.isEmpty else { continue }
   154→
   155→                // Determine reverse cardinality using the `unique` field.
   156→                // Per InstantDB server encoding (schema.clj lines 199-200):
   157→                // - `unique? = true` means reverse has "one" (singular)
   158→                // - `unique? = false` or nil means reverse has "many" (array)
   159→                //
   160→                // See Types.swift Attribute documentation for full details.
   161→                let isReverseSingular = attr.unique == true
   162→
   163→                if isReverseSingular {
   164→                    obj[reverseLabel] = resolvedParents.first
   165→                } else {
   166→                    obj[reverseLabel] = resolvedParents
   167→                }
   168→            }
   169→        }
   170→        
   171→        return obj
   172→    }
   173→
   174→    /// Decodes an entity from the store into a Swift type.
   175→    ///
   176→    /// - Parameters:
   177→    ///   - id: The entity ID to decode.
   178→    ///   - attrsStore: The store containing attribute definitions (schema).
   179→    ///   - includedLinks: Optional set of link names to resolve. If nil, all links are resolved.
   180→    ///                    If empty set, no links are resolved.
   181→    /// - Returns: The decoded entity, or nil if decoding fails.
   182→    public func get<T: Decodable>(id: String, attrsStore: AttrsStore, includedLinks: Set<String>? = nil) -> T? {
   183→        let dict = resolve(id: id, attrsStore: attrsStore, includedLinks: includedLinks)
   184→        
   185→        do {
   186→            let data = try JSONSerialization.data(withJSONObject: dict, options: [])
   187→            let decoder = JSONDecoder()
   188→            // Configure decoder if needed (dates?)
   189→            // InstantDB uses ISO8601 strings for dates usually, or Timestamps?
   190→            // Types.swift says TripleValue.toAny() -> Date overrides to String ISO8601.
   191→            decoder.dateDecodingStrategy = .iso8601 
   192→            return try decoder.decode(T.self, from: data)
   193→        } catch {
   194→            SharingInstantInternalLog.debug("TripleStore decode failed for \(id): \(error)")
   195→            return nil
   196→        }
   197→    }
   198→}

     1→import Foundation
     2→import InstantDB
     3→
     4→/// Adapted from: instant-client/src/instant/store.ts
     5→///
     6→/// A wrapper around InstantDB.TripleStore that adds Observation capabilities.
     7→public final class SharedTripleStore: @unchecked Sendable {
     8→    // Backing SDK Store
     9→    public let inner: InstantDB.TripleStore = InstantDB.TripleStore()
    10→    public let attrsStore: AttrsStore = AttrsStore()
    11→    
    12→    // Observers [EntityID: [Token: Callback]]
    13→    private var observers: [String: [UUID: @Sendable () -> Void]] = [:]
    14→    private let lock = NSRecursiveLock()
    15→
    16→    public init() {}
    17→    
    18→    // MARK: - Primitives
    19→    
    20→    public func updateAttributes(_ attributes: [Attribute]) {
    21→        for attr in attributes {
    22→            attrsStore.addAttr(attr)
    23→        }
    24→    }
    25→    
    26→    public func addTriple(_ triple: Triple, hasCardinalityOne: Bool, isRef: Bool) {
    27→        inner.addTriple(triple, hasCardinalityOne: hasCardinalityOne, isRef: isRef)
    28→        var changedIDs: Set<String> = [triple.entityId]
    29→        // For ref triples, also notify the target entity so reverse link views update.
    30→        if isRef, case .ref(let targetId) = triple.value {
    31→            changedIDs.insert(targetId)
    32→        }
    33→        notifyObservers(for: changedIDs)
    34→    }
    35→    
    36→    public func addTriples(_ triples: [Triple]) {
    37→        var changedIDs: Set<String> = []
    38→        for triple in triples {
    39→            let attr = attrsStore.getAttr(triple.attributeId)
    40→            let hasCardinalityOne = attr?.cardinality == .one
    41→            let isRef = attr?.valueType == .ref
    42→            inner.addTriple(triple, hasCardinalityOne: hasCardinalityOne, isRef: isRef)
    43→            changedIDs.insert(triple.entityId)
    44→
    45→            // For ref triples, also notify the target entity so reverse link views update.
    46→            // When a ref triple [subject, refAttr, target] is added, the target entity's
    47→            // "resolved view" changes (it now has an inbound link from subject).
    48→            // Without this, subscriptions driven by reverse links (e.g., media.transcriptionRuns)
    49→            // won't see new links until a server refresh.
    50→            if isRef, case .ref(let targetId) = triple.value {
    51→                changedIDs.insert(targetId)
    52→            }
    53→        }
    54→        notifyObservers(for: changedIDs)
    55→    }
    56→    
    57→    public func retractTriple(_ triple: Triple, isRef: Bool) {
    58→        inner.retractTriple(triple, isRef: isRef)
    59→        var changedIDs: Set<String> = [triple.entityId]
    60→        // For ref triples, also notify the target entity so reverse link views update.
    61→        if isRef, case .ref(let targetId) = triple.value {
    62→            changedIDs.insert(targetId)
    63→        }
    64→        notifyObservers(for: changedIDs)
    65→    }
    66→    
    67→    public func deleteEntity(id: String) {
    68→        var idsChanged: Set<String> = [id]
    69→        
    70→        // 1. Delete forward attributes and links (triples where this entity is the subject)
    71→        let triples = inner.getTriples(entity: id)
    72→        for triple in triples {
    73→             let attr = attrsStore.getAttr(triple.attributeId)
    74→             let isRef = attr?.valueType == .ref
    75→             inner.retractTriple(triple, isRef: isRef)
    76→        }
    77→        
    78→        // 2. Delete reverse links (triples where this entity is the VALUE/target of a ref)
    79→        // This matches the TypeScript SDK behavior in store.ts deleteEntity()
    80→        // Without this, the VAE index retains stale references to the deleted entity,
    81→        // causing "ghost" entities to appear when resolving reverse links.
    82→        let reverseTriples = inner.getReverseRefs(entityId: id)
    83→        for triple in reverseTriples {
    84→            let attr = attrsStore.getAttr(triple.attributeId)
    85→            let isRef = attr?.valueType == .ref
    86→            inner.retractTriple(triple, isRef: isRef)
    87→            // Also notify the entity that had the forward link
    88→            idsChanged.insert(triple.entityId)
    89→        }
    90→        
    91→        notifyObservers(for: idsChanged)
    92→    }
    93→    
    94→    // MARK: - Legacy / Helper Support
    95→    
    96→    /// Merges dictionaries (from Server Tree).
    97→    /// Used by legacy Reactor calls or if manual merging is needed.
    98→    func merge(dictionaries: [[String: Any]]) {
    99→        var changedIDs: Set<String> = []
   100→        for dict in dictionaries {
   101→            guard let id = dict["id"] as? String else { continue }
   102→            changedIDs.insert(id)
   103→        }
   104→        notifyObservers(for: changedIDs)
   105→    }
   106→    
   107→    // MARK: - Data Access
   108→
   109→    public func get<T: Decodable>(id: String, includedLinks: Set<String>? = nil) -> T? {
   110→        return inner.get(id: id, attrsStore: attrsStore, includedLinks: includedLinks)
   111→    }
   112→
   113→    // MARK: - Observation
   114→
   115→    @discardableResult
   116→    func addObserver(id: String, onChange: @escaping @Sendable () -> Void) -> UUID {
   117→        lock.withLock {
   118→            let token = UUID()
   119→            if observers[id] == nil {
   120→                observers[id] = [:]
   121→            }
   122→            observers[id]?[token] = onChange
   123→            return token
   124→        }
   125→    }
   126→
   127→    func removeObserver(id: String, token: UUID) {
   128→        lock.withLock {
   129→            observers[id]?.removeValue(forKey: token)
   130→            if observers[id]?.isEmpty == true {
   131→                observers[id] = nil
   132→            }
   133→        }
   134→    }
   135→
   136→    private func notifyObservers(for ids: Set<String>) {
   137→        if ids.isEmpty { return }
   138→        
   139→        // Snapshot callbacks synchronously to avoid data races
   140→        let snapshot: [@Sendable () -> Void] = lock.withLock {
   141→            var callbacks: [@Sendable () -> Void] = []
   142→            for id in ids {
   143→                if let tokens = observers[id] {
   144→                    callbacks.append(contentsOf: tokens.values)
   145→                }
   146→            }
   147→            return callbacks
   148→        }
   149→        
   150→        if snapshot.isEmpty { return }
   151→
   152→        // Execute callbacks asynchronously
   153→        Task {
   154→            for callback in snapshot {
   155→                callback()
   156→            }
   157→        }
   158→    }
   159→}
   160→

     1→// EntityKey.swift
     2→// SharingInstant
     3→//
     4→// A type-safe key for syncing entity collections with InstantDB.
     5→// This enables the @Shared(Schema.todos) syntax.
     6→
     7→import Dependencies
     8→import Dispatch
     9→import IdentifiedCollections
    10→import InstantDB
    11→import Sharing
    12→
    13→#if canImport(SwiftUI)
    14→  import SwiftUI
    15→#endif
    16→
    17→// MARK: - EntityKey
    18→
    19→/// A type-safe key for syncing an entity collection with InstantDB.
    20→///
    21→/// `EntityKey` enables zero-configuration sync with type safety:
    22→///
    23→/// ```swift
    24→/// // Define your schema (usually generated from instant.schema.ts)
    25→/// enum Schema {
    26→///   static let todos = EntityKey<Todo>(namespace: "todos")
    27→///   static let users = EntityKey<User>(namespace: "users")
    28→/// }
    29→///
    30→/// // Use in SwiftUI views
    31→/// @Shared(Schema.todos)
    32→/// private var todos: IdentifiedArrayOf<Todo> = []
    33→///
    34→/// // With ordering
    35→/// @Shared(Schema.todos.orderBy(\.createdAt, .desc))
    36→/// private var todos: IdentifiedArrayOf<Todo> = []
    37→/// ```
    38→///
    39→/// ## Query Modifiers
    40→///
    41→/// Chain modifiers to customize the query:
    42→///
    43→/// ```swift
    44→/// Schema.todos
    45→///   .orderBy(\.createdAt, .desc)  // Type-safe ordering
    46→///   .limit(10)                     // Limit results
    47→/// ```
    48→///
    49→/// ## Generated from Schema
    50→///
    51→/// Typically, `EntityKey` instances are generated from your `instant.schema.ts`
    52→/// file using the `instant-schema` CLI tool or SPM build plugin.
    53→/// Internal node for recursive query structure (using indirect enum to allow nesting)
    54→public indirect enum EntityQueryNode: Hashable, Sendable {
    55→  case link(
    56→    name: String,
    57→    limit: Int? = nil,
    58→    orderBy: String? = nil,
    59→    orderDirection: EntityKeyOrderDirection? = nil,
    60→    whereClauses: [String: EntityKeyPredicate] = [:],
    61→    children: [EntityQueryNode] = []
    62→  )
    63→}
    64→
    65→public struct EntityKey<Entity: EntityIdentifiable & Sendable>: Hashable, Sendable {
    66→  /// The InstantDB namespace (entity type name)
    67→  public let namespace: String
    68→  
    69→  /// The field to order by (optional)
    70→  public var orderByField: String?
    71→  
    72→  /// The order direction (optional)
    73→  public var orderDirection: EntityKeyOrderDirection?
    74→  
    75→  /// Maximum number of results (optional)
    76→  public var limitCount: Int?
    77→  
    78→  /// Where clause predicates (stored as field -> predicate dictionary)
    79→  public var whereClauses: [String: EntityKeyPredicate]
    80→  
    81→  /// Links to include in query results (Legacy flat set)
    82→  public var includedLinks: Set<String>
    83→  
    84→  /// Recursive tree of included links (Supported way)
    85→  public var linkTree: [EntityQueryNode]
    86→  
    87→  /// Creates an EntityKey for the specified namespace.
    88→  ///
    89→  /// - Parameters:
    90→  ///   - namespace: The InstantDB namespace (entity type name)
    91→  ///   - orderByField: Optional field to order by
    92→  ///   - orderDirection: Optional order direction
    93→  ///   - limitCount: Optional limit on results
    94→  ///   - whereClauses: Optional where clauses
    95→  ///   - includedLinks: Optional links to include in results
    96→  ///   - linkTree: Optional recursive link tree
    97→  public init(
    98→    namespace: String,
    99→    orderByField: String? = nil,
   100→    orderDirection: EntityKeyOrderDirection? = nil,
   101→    limitCount: Int? = nil,
   102→    whereClauses: [String: EntityKeyPredicate] = [:],
   103→    includedLinks: Set<String> = [],
   104→    linkTree: [EntityQueryNode] = []
   105→  ) {
   106→    self.namespace = namespace
   107→    self.orderByField = orderByField
   108→    self.orderDirection = orderDirection
   109→    self.limitCount = limitCount
   110→    self.whereClauses = whereClauses
   111→    self.includedLinks = includedLinks
   112→    self.linkTree = linkTree
   113→  }
   114→  
   115→  // MARK: - Query Modifiers
   116→  
   117→  /// Order results by a field using a type-safe KeyPath.
   118→  ///
   119→  /// ```swift
   120→  /// Schema.todos.orderBy(\.createdAt, .desc)
   121→  /// ```
   122→  ///
   123→  /// - Parameters:
   124→  ///   - keyPath: KeyPath to the field to order by
   125→  ///   - direction: The order direction (.asc or .desc)
   126→  /// - Returns: A new EntityKey with the ordering applied
   127→  public func orderBy<V>(
   128→    _ keyPath: KeyPath<Entity, V>,
   129→    _ direction: EntityKeyOrderDirection
   130→  ) -> EntityKey<Entity> {
   131→    var copy = self
   132→    copy.orderByField = extractFieldName(from: keyPath)
   133→    copy.orderDirection = direction
   134→    return copy
   135→  }
   136→  
   137→  /// Order results by a field name string.
   138→  ///
   139→  /// ```swift
   140→  /// Schema.todos.orderBy("createdAt", .desc)
   141→  /// ```
   142→  ///
   143→  /// - Parameters:
   144→  ///   - field: The field name to order by
   145→  ///   - direction: The order direction (.asc or .desc)
   146→  /// - Returns: A new EntityKey with the ordering applied
   147→  public func orderBy(
   148→    _ field: String,
   149→    _ direction: EntityKeyOrderDirection
   150→  ) -> EntityKey<Entity> {
   151→    var copy = self
   152→    copy.orderByField = field
   153→    copy.orderDirection = direction
   154→    return copy
   155→  }
   156→  
   157→  /// Limit the number of results.
   158→  ///
   159→  /// ```swift
   160→  /// Schema.todos.limit(10)
   161→  /// ```
   162→  ///
   163→  /// - Parameter count: Maximum number of results to return
   164→  /// - Returns: A new EntityKey with the limit applied
   165→  public func limit(_ count: Int) -> EntityKey<Entity> {
   166→    var copy = self
   167→    copy.limitCount = count
   168→    return copy
   169→  }
   170→  
   171→  // MARK: - Where Clauses
   172→  
   173→  /// Filter results where a field equals a value.
   174→  ///
   175→  /// ```swift
   176→  /// Schema.todos.where(\.done, .equals(false))
   177→  /// Schema.todos.where(\.priority, .greaterThan(5))
   178→  /// ```
   179→  ///
   180→  /// - Parameters:
   181→  ///   - keyPath: KeyPath to the field to filter on
   182→  ///   - predicate: The predicate to apply
   183→  /// - Returns: A new EntityKey with the filter applied
   184→  public func `where`<V: Hashable & Sendable>(
   185→    _ keyPath: KeyPath<Entity, V>,
   186→    _ predicate: EntityKeyPredicate
   187→  ) -> EntityKey<Entity> {
   188→    var copy = self
   189→    let fieldName = extractFieldName(from: keyPath)
   190→    copy.whereClauses[fieldName] = predicate
   191→    return copy

   213→  // MARK: - Link Inclusion
   214→  
   215→  /// Include a related entity in the query results (type-safe, has-one).
   216→  ///
   217→  /// This is the preferred way to include links as it provides compile-time
   218→  /// validation that the link field exists on the entity type.
   219→  ///
   220→  /// ```swift

   230→  public func with<V>(_ keyPath: KeyPath<Entity, V?>) -> EntityKey<Entity> {

   250→  /// - Parameter keyPath: KeyPath to the link array field
   251→  /// - Returns: A new EntityKey with the link inclusion
   252→  public func with<V>(_ keyPath: KeyPath<Entity, [V]?>) -> EntityKey<Entity> {
   253→    var copy = self
   254→    let fieldName = extractFieldName(from: keyPath)
   255→    copy.includedLinks.insert(fieldName)

   262→
   263→  /// Include a related entity with a nested query builder (Recursive).
   264→  ///
   265→  /// This enables deep fetching and nested query modifiers.
   266→  ///
   267→  /// ```swift
   268→  /// Schema.users.with(\.posts) { posts in
   269→  ///   posts.orderBy(\.createdAt, .desc).limit(5)
   270→  ///        .with(\.comments)
   271→  /// }
   272→  /// ```
   273→  ///
   274→  /// - Parameters:
   275→  ///   - keyPath: KeyPath to the has-one link
   276→  ///   - builder: A closure that takes a base EntityKey for the linked type and returns a configured one
   277→  /// - Returns: A new EntityKey with the nested query included
   278→  public func with<V: EntityIdentifiable & Sendable>(
   279→    _ keyPath: KeyPath<Entity, V?>,
   280→    _ builder: (EntityKey<V>) -> EntityKey<V>
   281→  ) -> EntityKey<Entity> {
   282→    var copy = self
   283→    let fieldName = extractFieldName(from: keyPath)
   284→    copy.includedLinks.insert(fieldName)
   285→    
   286→    let base = EntityKey<V>(namespace: fieldName)
   287→    let configured = builder(base)
   288→    
   289→    // Convert the configured sub-key into a recursive node
   290→    let node = EntityQueryNode.link(
   291→      name: fieldName,
   292→      limit: configured.limitCount,
   293→      orderBy: configured.orderByField,
   294→      orderDirection: configured.orderDirection,
   295→      whereClauses: configured.whereClauses,
   296→      children: configured.linkTree
   297→    )
   298→    copy.linkTree.append(node)
   299→    
   300→    return copy
   301→  }
   302→
   303→  /// Include a related entity array with a nested query builder (Recursive).
   304→  ///
   305→  /// ```swift
   306→  /// Schema.users.with(\.posts) { posts in

   308→  /// }

   316→    _ keyPath: KeyPath<Entity, [V]?>,

   330→      orderDirection: configured.orderDirection,

   332→      children: configured.linkTree

   339→  /// Include multiple linked entities (type-safe, 2 links).

   402→// MARK: - Order Direction
   403→
   404→/// The order direction for EntityKey queries.
   405→public enum EntityKeyOrderDirection: String, Sendable, Hashable {
   406→  /// Ascending order (smallest to largest, oldest to newest)
   407→  case asc
   408→  
   409→  /// Descending order (largest to smallest, newest to oldest)
   410→  case desc
   411→}
   412→
   413→// MARK: - Predicate
   414→
   415→/// A predicate for filtering EntityKey queries.
   416→///
   417→/// Predicates support common comparison operations:
   418→///
   419→/// ```swift
   420→/// .equals(value)       // field == value
   421→/// .notEquals(value)    // field != value
   422→/// .greaterThan(value)  // field > value
   423→/// .greaterOrEqual(value) // field >= value
   424→/// .lessThan(value)     // field < value
   425→/// .lessOrEqual(value)  // field <= value
   426→/// .isIn([values])      // field in [values]
   427→/// .like(pattern)       // SQL LIKE pattern (case-sensitive)
   428→/// .ilike(pattern)      // SQL LIKE pattern (case-insensitive)
   429→/// .contains(text)      // Contains substring (case-insensitive)
   430→/// .startsWith(text)    // Starts with prefix (case-insensitive)
   431→/// .endsWith(text)      // Ends with suffix (case-insensitive)
   432→/// ```
   433→public enum EntityKeyPredicate: Hashable, Sendable {
   434→  /// Equals comparison
   435→  case equals(AnyHashableSendable)
   436→  
   437→  /// Not equals comparison
   438→  case notEquals(AnyHashableSendable)
   439→  
   440→  /// Greater than comparison
   441→  case greaterThan(AnyHashableSendable)
   442→  
   443→  /// Greater than or equal comparison
   444→  case greaterOrEqual(AnyHashableSendable)
   445→  
   446→  /// Less than comparison
   447→  case lessThan(AnyHashableSendable)
   448→  
   449→  /// Less than or equal comparison
   450→  case lessOrEqual(AnyHashableSendable)
   451→  
   452→  /// In set comparison
   453→  case isIn([AnyHashableSendable])
   454→  
   455→  /// Pattern matching (case-sensitive, SQL LIKE syntax: % for wildcard)
   456→  case like(String)
   457→  
   458→  /// Pattern matching (case-insensitive, SQL LIKE syntax: % for wildcard)
   459→  case ilike(String)
   460→  
   461→  // MARK: - Convenience Initializers
   462→  
   463→  /// Creates an equals predicate.
   464→  public static func eq<V: Hashable & Sendable>(_ value: V) -> EntityKeyPredicate {
   465→    .equals(AnyHashableSendable(value))
   466→  }
   467→  
   468→  /// Creates a not-equals predicate.
   469→  public static func neq<V: Hashable & Sendable>(_ value: V) -> EntityKeyPredicate {
   470→    .notEquals(AnyHashableSendable(value))
   471→  }
   472→  
   473→  /// Creates a greater-than predicate.
   474→  public static func gt<V: Hashable & Sendable>(_ value: V) -> EntityKeyPredicate {
   475→    .greaterThan(AnyHashableSendable(value))
   476→  }
   477→  
   478→  /// Creates a greater-or-equal predicate.
   479→  public static func gte<V: Hashable & Sendable>(_ value: V) -> EntityKeyPredicate {
   480→    .greaterOrEqual(AnyHashableSendable(value))
   481→  }
   482→  
   483→  /// Creates a less-than predicate.
   484→  public static func lt<V: Hashable & Sendable>(_ value: V) -> EntityKeyPredicate {
   485→    .lessThan(AnyHashableSendable(value))
   486→  }
   487→  
   488→  /// Creates a less-or-equal predicate.
   489→  public static func lte<V: Hashable & Sendable>(_ value: V) -> EntityKeyPredicate {
   490→    .lessOrEqual(AnyHashableSendable(value))
   491→  }
   492→  
   493→  /// Creates an in-set predicate.
   494→  public static func `in`<V: Hashable & Sendable>(_ values: [V]) -> EntityKeyPredicate {
   495→    .isIn(values.map { AnyHashableSendable($0) })
   496→  }
   497→  
   498→  /// Creates a contains predicate (case-insensitive).
   499→  /// Matches if the field contains the given substring.
   500→  public static func contains(_ substring: String) -> EntityKeyPredicate {
   501→    .ilike("%\(substring)%")
   502→  }
   503→  
   504→  /// Creates a starts-with predicate (case-insensitive).
   505→  /// Matches if the field starts with the given prefix.
   506→  public static func startsWith(_ prefix: String) -> EntityKeyPredicate {
   507→    .ilike("\(prefix)%")
   508→  }
   509→  
   510→  /// Creates an ends-with predicate (case-insensitive).
   511→  /// Matches if the field ends with the given suffix.
   512→  public static func endsWith(_ suffix: String) -> EntityKeyPredicate {
   513→    .ilike("%\(suffix)")
   514→  }
   515→  
   516→  /// Convert to InstantDB where clause dictionary format
   517→  func toWhereValue() -> Any {
   518→    switch self {
   519→    case .equals(let value):
   520→      return value.base
   521→    case .notEquals(let value):
   522→      return ["$ne": value.base]
   523→    case .greaterThan(let value):
   524→      return ["$gt": value.base]
   525→    case .greaterOrEqual(let value):
   526→      return ["$gte": value.base]
   527→    case .lessThan(let value):
   528→      return ["$lt": value.base]
   529→    case .lessOrEqual(let value):
   530→      return ["$lte": value.base]
   531→    case .isIn(let values):
   532→      return ["$in": values.map { $0.base }]
   533→    case .like(let pattern):
   534→      return ["$like": pattern]
   535→    case .ilike(let pattern):
   536→      return ["$ilike": pattern]
   537→    }
   538→  }
   539→}

   541→/// Type-erased hashable sendable value for predicate storage.
   542→public struct AnyHashableSendable: Hashable, Sendable {
   543→  public let base: any Sendable
   544→  private let _hashValue: Int
   545→  private let _isEqual: @Sendable (Any) -> Bool
   546→  
   547→  public init<T: Hashable & Sendable>(_ value: T) {
   548→    self.base = value
   549→    self._hashValue = value.hashValue
   550→    self._isEqual = { other in
   551→      guard let other = other as? T else { return false }
   552→      return value == other
   553→    }
   554→  }
   555→  
   556→  public func hash(into hasher: inout Hasher) {
   557→    hasher.combine(_hashValue)
   558→  }
   559→  
   560→  public static func == (lhs: AnyHashableSendable, rhs: AnyHashableSendable) -> Bool {
   561→    lhs._isEqual(rhs.base)
   562→  }
   563→}

   565→// MARK: - SharedReaderKey Extension
   566→
   567→extension SharedReaderKey {
   568→  /// Create a bidirectional sync key from an EntityKey.
   569→  ///
   570→  /// This enables the `@Shared(Schema.todos)` syntax:
   571→  ///
   572→  /// ```swift
   573→  /// @Shared(Schema.todos)
   574→  /// private var todos: IdentifiedArrayOf<Todo> = []
   575→  ///
   576→  /// // With ordering
   577→  /// @Shared(Schema.todos.orderBy(\.createdAt, .desc))
   578→  /// private var todos: IdentifiedArrayOf<Todo> = []
   579→  /// ```
   580→  ///
   581→  /// - Parameter key: The EntityKey defining the sync
   582→  /// - Returns: A SharedKey for use with @Shared
   583→  public static func instantSync<E: EntityIdentifiable & Sendable>(
   584→    _ key: EntityKey<E>
   585→  ) -> Self where Self == InstantSyncCollectionKey<IdentifiedArrayOf<E>>.Default {
   586→    Self[
   587→      InstantSyncCollectionKey(
   588→        request: EntityKeyRequest(key: key),
   589→        appID: nil
   590→      ),
   591→      default: []
   592→    ]
   593→  }
   594→  
   595→  /// Create a read-only query key from an EntityKey.
   596→  ///
   597→  /// This enables the `@SharedReader(Schema.todos)` syntax:
   598→  ///
   599→  /// ```swift
   600→  /// @SharedReader(Schema.todos)
   601→  /// private var todos: IdentifiedArrayOf<Todo> = []
   602→  ///
   603→  /// // With ordering and limit
   604→  /// @SharedReader(Schema.todos.orderBy(\.createdAt, .desc).limit(10))
   605→  /// private var todos: IdentifiedArrayOf<Todo> = []
   606→  /// ```
   607→  ///
   608→  /// - Parameter key: The EntityKey defining the query
   609→  /// - Returns: A SharedReaderKey for use with @SharedReader
   610→  public static func instantQuery<E: EntityIdentifiable & Sendable>(
   611→    _ key: EntityKey<E>
   612→  ) -> Self where Self == InstantQueryKey<IdentifiedArrayOf<E>>.Default {
   613→    Self[
   614→      InstantQueryKey(
   615→        request: EntityKeyQueryRequest(key: key),
   616→        appID: nil
   617→      ),
   618→      default: []
   619→    ]
   620→  }
   621→}
   622→
   623→// MARK: - Internal Request Types
   624→
   625→/// Internal request type that bridges EntityKey to the sync infrastructure.
   626→struct EntityKeyRequest<E: EntityIdentifiable & Sendable>: SharingInstantSync.KeyCollectionRequest {
   627→  typealias Value = E
   628→  let key: EntityKey<E>
   629→  
   630→  var configuration: SharingInstantSync.CollectionConfiguration<E>? {
   631→    var orderBy: OrderBy? = nil
   632→    if let field = key.orderByField, let direction = key.orderDirection {
   633→      orderBy = direction == .desc ? .desc(field) : .asc(field)
   634→    }
   635→    
   636→    // Convert EntityKey where clauses to dictionary format
   637→    var whereClause: [String: Any]? = nil
   638→    if !key.whereClauses.isEmpty {
   639→      var clause: [String: Any] = [:]
   640→      for (field, predicate) in key.whereClauses {
   641→        clause[field] = predicate.toWhereValue()
   642→      }
   643→      whereClause = clause
   644→    }
   645→    
   646→    return SharingInstantSync.CollectionConfiguration(
   647→      namespace: key.namespace,
   648→      orderBy: orderBy,
   649→      whereClause: whereClause,
   650→      includedLinks: key.includedLinks,
   651→      linkTree: key.linkTree
   652→    )
   653→  }
   654→}
   655→
   656→/// Internal request type that bridges EntityKey to the query infrastructure.
   657→struct EntityKeyQueryRequest<E: EntityIdentifiable & Sendable>: SharingInstantQuery.KeyRequest {
   658→  typealias Value = E
   659→  let key: EntityKey<E>
   660→  
   661→  var configuration: SharingInstantQuery.Configuration<E>? {
   662→    var orderBy: OrderBy? = nil
   663→    if let field = key.orderByField, let direction = key.orderDirection {
   664→      orderBy = direction == .desc ? .desc(field) : .asc(field)
   665→    }
   666→    
   667→    // Convert EntityKey where clauses to dictionary format
   668→    var whereClause: [String: Any]? = nil
   669→    if !key.whereClauses.isEmpty {
   670→      var clause: [String: Any] = [:]
   671→      for (field, predicate) in key.whereClauses {
   672→        clause[field] = predicate.toWhereValue()
   673→      }
   674→      whereClause = clause
   675→    }
   676→    
   677→    return SharingInstantQuery.Configuration(
   678→      namespace: key.namespace,
   679→      orderBy: orderBy,
   680→      limit: key.limitCount,
   681→      whereClause: whereClause,
   682→      includedLinks: key.includedLinks,
   683→      linkTree: key.linkTree
   684→    )
   685→  }
   686→}
