   103→  }
   104→
   105→  const [_f, fwdEtype] = attr['forward-identity'];
   106→  const [_r, revEtype] = attr['reverse-identity']!;
   107→  const nextLevel = level + 1;
   108→  const attrPat: Pat = fwdAttr
   109→    ? [
   110→        makeVar(fwdEtype, level),
   111→        attr.id,
   112→        makeVar(revEtype, nextLevel),
   113→        wildcard('time'),
   114→      ]
   115→    : [
   116→        makeVar(fwdEtype, nextLevel),
   117→        attr.id,
   118→        makeVar(revEtype, level),
   119→        wildcard('time'),
   120→      ];
   121→
   122→  const nextEtype = fwdAttr ? revEtype : fwdEtype;
   123→
   124→  const isForward = Boolean(fwdAttr);
   125→
   126→  return [nextEtype, nextLevel, attrPat, attr, isForward];
   127→}
   128→
   129→function makeLikeMatcher(caseSensitive: boolean, pattern: string) {
   130→  if (typeof pattern !== 'string') {
   131→    return function likeMatcher(_value) {
   132→      return false;
   133→    };
   134→  }
   135→
   136→  const escapedPattern = pattern.replace(/[.*+?^${}()|[\]\\]/g, '\\$&');
   137→  const regexPattern = escapedPattern.replace(/%/g, '.*').replace(/_/g, '.');
   138→
   139→  const regex = new RegExp(
   140→    `^${regexPattern}$`,
   141→    caseSensitive ? undefined : 'i',
   142→  );
   143→
   144→  return function likeMatcher(value) {
   145→    if (typeof value !== 'string') {
   146→      return false;
   147→    }
   148→    return regex.test(value);
   149→  };
   150→}
   151→
   152→function parseValue(attr: InstantDBAttr, v: any) {
   153→  if (
   154→    typeof v !== 'object' ||
   155→    v.hasOwnProperty('$in') ||
   156→    v.hasOwnProperty('in')
   157→  ) {
   158→    return v;
   159→  }
   160→
   161→  const isDate = attr['checked-data-type'] === 'date';
   162→
   163→  if (v.hasOwnProperty('$gt')) {
   164→    return {
   165→      $comparator: true,
   166→      $op: isDate
   167→        ? function gtDate(triple) {
   168→            return new Date(triple[2]) > new Date(v.$gt);
   169→          }
   170→        : function gt(triple) {
   171→            return triple[2] > v.$gt;
   172→          },
   173→    };
   174→  }
   175→  if (v.hasOwnProperty('$gte')) {
   176→    return {
   177→      $comparator: true,
   178→      $op: isDate
   179→        ? function gteDate(triple) {
   180→            return new Date(triple[2]) >= new Date(v.$gte);
   181→          }
   182→        : function gte(triple) {
   183→            return triple[2] >= v.$gte;
   184→          },
   185→    };
   186→  }
   187→
   188→  if (v.hasOwnProperty('$lt')) {
   189→    return {
   190→      $comparator: true,
   191→      $op: isDate
   192→        ? function ltDate(triple) {
   193→            return new Date(triple[2]) < new Date(v.$lt);
   194→          }
   195→        : function lt(triple) {
   196→            return triple[2] < v.$lt;
   197→          },
   198→    };
   199→  }
   200→  if (v.hasOwnProperty('$lte')) {
   201→    return {
   202→      $comparator: true,
   203→      $op: isDate
   204→        ? function lteDate(triple) {
   205→            return new Date(triple[2]) <= new Date(v.$lte);
   206→          }
   207→        : function lte(triple) {
   208→            return triple[2] <= v.$lte;
   209→          },
   210→    };
   211→  }
   212→
   213→  if (v.hasOwnProperty('$like')) {
   214→    const matcher = makeLikeMatcher(true, v.$like);
   215→    return {
   216→      $comparator: true,
   217→      $op: function like(triple) {
   218→        return matcher(triple[2]);
   219→      },
   220→    };
   221→  }
   222→
   223→  if (v.hasOwnProperty('$ilike')) {
   224→    const matcher = makeLikeMatcher(false, v.$ilike);
   225→    return {
   226→      $comparator: true,
   227→      $op: function ilike(triple) {
   228→        return matcher(triple[2]);
   229→      },
   230→    };
   231→  }
   232→
   233→  return v;
   234→}
   235→
   236→function valueAttrPat(
   237→  makeVar: MakeVar,
   238→  attrsStore: s.AttrsStore,
   239→  valueEtype: string,
   240→  valueLevel: number,
   241→  valueLabel: string,
   242→  v: any,
   243→): Pat {
   244→  const fwdAttr = s.getAttrByFwdIdentName(attrsStore, valueEtype, valueLabel);
   245→  const revAttr = s.getAttrByReverseIdentName(
   246→    attrsStore,
   247→    valueEtype,
   248→    valueLabel,
   249→  );
   250→  const attr = fwdAttr || revAttr;
   251→
   252→  if (!attr) {
   253→    throw new AttrNotFoundError(
   254→      `No attr for etype = ${valueEtype} label = ${valueLabel}`,
   255→    );
   256→  }
   257→
   258→  if (v?.hasOwnProperty('$isNull')) {
   259→    const idAttr = s.getAttrByFwdIdentName(attrsStore, valueEtype, 'id');
   260→    if (!idAttr) {
   261→      throw new AttrNotFoundError(
   262→        `No attr for etype = ${valueEtype} label = id`,
   263→      );
   264→    }
   265→
   266→    return [
   267→      makeVar(valueEtype, valueLevel),
   268→      idAttr.id,
   269→      { $isNull: { attrId: attr.id, isNull: v.$isNull, reverse: !fwdAttr } },
   270→      wildcard('time'),
   271→    ];
   272→  }
   273→
   274→  if (fwdAttr) {
   275→    return [
   276→      makeVar(valueEtype, valueLevel),
   277→      attr.id,
   278→      parseValue(attr, v),
   279→      wildcard('time'),
   280→    ];
   281→  }
   282→  return [v, attr.id, makeVar(valueEtype, valueLevel), wildcard('time')];
   283→}
   284→
   285→function refAttrPats(
   286→  makeVar: MakeVar,
   287→  attrsStore: s.AttrsStore,
   288→  etype: string,
   289→  level: number,
   290→  refsPath: string[],
   291→): [string, number, Pats] {
   292→  const [lastEtype, lastLevel, attrPats] = refsPath.reduce(
   293→    (acc, label) => {
   294→      const [etype, level, attrPats] = acc;
   295→      const [nextEtype, nextLevel, attrPat] = refAttrPat(
   296→        makeVar,
   297→        attrsStore,
   298→        etype,
   299→        level,
   300→        label,
   301→      );
   302→      return [nextEtype, nextLevel, [...attrPats, attrPat]];
   303→    },
   304→    [etype, level, []],
   305→  );
   306→
   307→  return [lastEtype, lastLevel, attrPats];
   308→}
   309→
   310→function whereCondAttrPats(
   311→  makeVar: MakeVar,
   312→  attrsStore: s.AttrsStore,
   313→  etype: string,
   314→  level: number,
   315→  path: string[],
   316→  v: any,
   317→): Pats {
   318→  const refsPath = path.slice(0, path.length - 1);
   319→  const valueLabel = path[path.length - 1];
   320→  const [lastEtype, lastLevel, refPats] = refAttrPats(
   321→    makeVar,
   322→    attrsStore,
   323→    etype,
   324→    level,
   325→    refsPath,
   326→  );
   327→  const valuePat = valueAttrPat(
   328→    makeVar,
   329→    attrsStore,
   330→    lastEtype,
   331→    lastLevel,
   332→    valueLabel,
   333→    v,
   334→  );
   335→
   336→  return refPats.concat([valuePat]);
   337→}
   338→
   339→function withJoin(where, join) {
   340→  return join ? [join].concat(where) : where;
   341→}
   342→
   343→function isOrClauses([k, v]): boolean {
   344→  return k === 'or' && Array.isArray(v);
   345→}
   346→
   347→function isAndClauses([k, v]): boolean {
   348→  return k === 'and' && Array.isArray(v);
   349→}
   350→
   351→// Creates a makeVar that will namespace symbols for or clauses
   352→// to prevent conflicts, except for the base etype
   353→function genMakeVar(baseMakeVar: MakeVar, joinSym: string, orIdx: number) {
   354→  return (x, lvl) => {
   355→    const base = baseMakeVar(x, lvl);
   356→    if (joinSym == base) {
   357→      return base;
   358→    }
   359→    return `${base}-${orIdx}`;
   360→  };
   361→}
   362→
   363→function parseWhereClauses(
   364→  makeVar: MakeVar,
   365→  clauseType: 'or' | 'and' /* 'or' | 'and' */,
   366→  attrsStore: s.AttrsStore,
   367→  etype: string,
   368→  level: number,
   369→  whereValue: any,
   370→): FullPat {
   371→  const joinSym = makeVar(etype, level);
   372→  const patterns: FullPats = whereValue.map((w, i) => {
   373→    const makeNamespacedVar = genMakeVar(makeVar, joinSym, i);
   374→    return parseWhere(makeNamespacedVar, attrsStore, etype, level, w);
   375→  });
   376→  return { [clauseType]: { patterns, joinSym } } as AndPat | OrPat;
   377→}
   378→
   379→// Given a path, returns a list of paths leading up to this path:
   380→// growPath([1, 2, 3]) -> [[1], [1, 2], [1, 2, 3]]
   381→function growPath<T>(path: T[]) {
   382→  const ret: Array<T[]> = [];
   383→  for (let i = 1; i <= path.length; i++) {
   384→    ret.push(path.slice(0, i));
   385→  }
   386→  return ret;
   387→}
   388→
   389→// Returns array of pattern arrays that should be grouped in OR
   390→// to capture any intermediate nulls
   391→function whereCondAttrPatsForNullIsTrue(
   392→  makeVar: MakeVar,
   393→  attrsStore: s.AttrsStore,
   394→  etype: string,
   395→  level: number,
   396→  path: string[],
   397→): Pats[] {
   398→  return growPath(path).map((path) =>
   399→    whereCondAttrPats(makeVar, attrsStore, etype, level, path, {
   400→      $isNull: true,
   401→    }),
   402→  );
   403→}
   404→
   405→function parseWhere(
   406→  makeVar: MakeVar,
   407→  attrsStore: s.AttrsStore,
   408→  etype: string,
   409→  level: number,
   410→  where: Record<string, any>,
   411→): FullPats {
   412→  return Object.entries(where).flatMap(([k, v]) => {
   413→    if (isOrClauses([k, v])) {
   414→      return parseWhereClauses(makeVar, 'or', attrsStore, etype, level, v);
   415→    }
   416→    if (isAndClauses([k, v])) {
   417→      return parseWhereClauses(makeVar, 'and', attrsStore, etype, level, v);
   418→    }
   419→
   420→    // Temporary hack until we have support for a uuid index on `id`
   421→    if (k === '$entityIdStartsWith') {
   422→      return [];
   423→    }
   424→
   425→    const path = k.split('.');
   426→
   427→    // Normalize $ne to $not
   428→    if (v?.hasOwnProperty('$ne')) {
   429→      v = { ...v, $not: v.$ne };
   430→      delete v.$ne;
   431→    }
   432→
   433→    if (v?.hasOwnProperty('$not')) {
   434→      // `$not` won't pick up entities that are missing the attr, so we
   435→      // add in a `$isNull` to catch those too.
   436→      const notPats = whereCondAttrPats(
   437→        makeVar,
   438→        attrsStore,
   439→        etype,
   440→        level,
   441→        path,
   442→        v,
   443→      );
   444→      const nilPats = whereCondAttrPatsForNullIsTrue(
   445→        makeVar,
   446→        attrsStore,
   447→        etype,
   448→        level,
   449→        path,
   450→      );
   451→      return [
   452→        {
   453→          or: {
   454→            patterns: [notPats, ...nilPats],
   455→            joinSym: makeVar(etype, level),
   456→          },
   457→        },
   458→      ];
   459→    }
   460→
   461→    if (v?.hasOwnProperty('$isNull') && v.$isNull === true && path.length > 1) {
   462→      // Make sure we're capturing all of the intermediate paths that might be null
   463→      // by checking for null at each step along the path
   464→      return [
   465→        {
   466→          or: {
   467→            patterns: whereCondAttrPatsForNullIsTrue(
   468→              makeVar,
   469→              attrsStore,
   470→              etype,
   471→              level,
   472→              path,
   473→            ),
   474→            joinSym: makeVar(etype, level),
   475→          },
   476→        },
   477→      ];
   478→    }
   479→
   480→    return whereCondAttrPats(makeVar, attrsStore, etype, level, path, v);
   481→  });
   482→}
   483→
   484→function makeWhere(
   485→  attrsStore: s.AttrsStore,
   486→  etype: string,
   487→  level: number,
   488→  where: Record<string, any> | null,
   489→): FullPats {
   490→  const makeVar = makeVarImpl;
   491→  if (!where) {
   492→    return defaultWhere(makeVar, attrsStore, etype, level);
   493→  }
   494→  const parsedWhere = parseWhere(makeVar, attrsStore, etype, level, where);
   495→  return parsedWhere.concat(defaultWhere(makeVar, attrsStore, etype, level));
   496→}
   497→
   498→// Find
   499→// -----------------
   500→
   501→function makeFind(makeVar: MakeVar, etype: string, level: number) {
   502→  return [makeVar(etype, level), makeVar('time', level)];
   503→}
   504→
   505→// extendObjects
   506→// -----------------
   507→
   508→function makeJoin(
   509→  makeVar: MakeVar,
   510→  attrsStore: s.AttrsStore,
   511→  etype: string,
   512→  level: number,
   513→  label: string,
   514→  eid: string,
   515→) {
   516→  const [nextEtype, nextLevel, pat, attr, isForward] = refAttrPat(
   517→    makeVar,
   518→    attrsStore,
   519→    etype,
   520→    level,
   521→    label,
   522→  );
   523→  const actualized = replaceInAttrPat(pat, makeVar(etype, level), eid);
   524→  return [nextEtype, nextLevel, actualized, attr, isForward];
   525→}
   526→
   527→function extendObjects(
   528→  makeVar: MakeVar,
   529→  store: s.Store,
   530→  attrsStore: s.AttrsStore,
   531→  { etype, level, form },
   532→  objects,
   533→) {
   534→  const childQueries = Object.keys(form).filter((c) => c !== '$');
   535→  if (!childQueries.length) {
   536→    return Object.values(objects);
   537→  }
   538→  return Object.entries(objects).map(function extendChildren([eid, parent]) {
   539→    const childResults = childQueries.map(function getChildResult(label) {
   540→      const isSingular = Boolean(
   541→        store.cardinalityInference &&
   542→          attrsStore.linkIndex?.[etype]?.[label]?.isSingular,
   543→      );
   544→
   545→      try {
   546→        const [nextEtype, nextLevel, join] = makeJoin(
   547→          makeVar,
   548→          attrsStore,
   549→          etype,
   550→          level,
   551→          label,
   552→          eid,
   553→        );
   554→
   555→        const childrenArray = queryOne(store, attrsStore, {
   556→          etype: nextEtype,
   557→          level: nextLevel,
   558→          form: form[label],
   559→          join,
   560→        });
   561→
   562→        const childOrChildren = isSingular ? childrenArray[0] : childrenArray;
   563→
   564→        return { [label]: childOrChildren };
   565→      } catch (e) {
   566→        if (e instanceof AttrNotFoundError) {
   567→          return { [label]: isSingular ? undefined : [] };
   568→        }
   569→        throw e;
   570→      }
   571→    });
   572→
   573→    return childResults.reduce(function reduceChildren(parent, child) {
   574→      return { ...parent, ...child };
   575→    }, parent);
   576→  });
   577→}
   578→
   579→// resolveObjects
   580→// -----------------
   581→
   582→function shouldIgnoreAttr(attrs, id) {
   583→  const attr = attrs[id];
   584→  return attr['value-type'] === 'ref' && attr['forward-identity'][2] !== 'id';
   585→}
   586→
   587→// Compares values where we already know that the two values are distinct
   588→// and not null.
   589→// Takes into account the data type.
   590→function compareDisparateValues(a, b, dataType) {
   591→  if (dataType === 'string') {
   592→    return stringCompare(a, b);
   593→  }
   594→  if (a > b) {
   595→    return 1;
   596→  }
   597→  return -1;
   598→}
   599→
   600→export function compareOrder(id_a: string, v_a, id_b: string, v_b, dataType) {
   601→  if (v_a === v_b || (v_a == null && v_b == null)) {
   602→    return uuidCompare(id_a, id_b);
   603→  }
   604→
   605→  if (v_b == null) {
   606→    return 1;
   607→  }
   608→  if (v_a == null) {
   609→    return -1;
   610→  }
   611→
   612→  return compareDisparateValues(v_a, v_b, dataType);
   613→}
   614→
   615→function compareOrderTriples(
   616→  [id_a, v_a]: [string, any],
   617→  [id_b, v_b]: [string, any],
   618→  dataType,
   619→) {
   620→  return compareOrder(id_a, v_a, id_b, v_b, dataType);
   621→}
   622→
   623→function comparableDate(x) {
   624→  if (x == null) {
   625→    return x;
   626→  }
   627→  return new Date(x).getTime();
   628→}
   629→
   630→function isBefore(startCursor, orderAttr, direction, idVec) {
   631→  const [c_e, _c_a, c_v, c_t] = startCursor;
   632→  const compareVal = direction === 'desc' ? 1 : -1;
   633→  if (orderAttr['forward-identity']?.[2] === 'id') {
   634→    return compareOrderTriples(idVec, [c_e, c_t], null) === compareVal;
   635→  }
   636→  const [e, v] = idVec;
   637→  const dataType = orderAttr['checked-data-type'];
   638→  const v_new = dataType === 'date' ? comparableDate(v) : v;
   639→  const c_v_new = dataType === 'date' ? comparableDate(c_v) : c_v;
   640→
   641→  return (
   642→    compareOrderTriples([e, v_new], [c_e, c_v_new], dataType) === compareVal
   643→  );
   644→}
   645→
   646→function orderAttrFromCursor(attrsStore: s.AttrsStore, cursor) {
   647→  const cursorAttrId = cursor[1];
   648→  return attrsStore.getAttr(cursorAttrId);
   649→}
   650→
   651→function orderAttrFromOrder(attrsStore: s.AttrsStore, etype, order) {
   652→  const label = Object.keys(order)[0];
   653→  return s.getAttrByFwdIdentName(attrsStore, etype, label);
   654→}
   655→
   656→function getOrderAttr(attrsStore: s.AttrsStore, etype, cursor, order) {
   657→  if (cursor) {
   658→    return orderAttrFromCursor(attrsStore, cursor);
   659→  }
   660→  if (order) {
   661→    return orderAttrFromOrder(attrsStore, etype, order);
   662→  }
   663→}
   664→
   665→function objectAttrs(
   666→  attrsStore: s.AttrsStore,
   667→  etype,
   668→  dq,
   669→): Map<string, InstantDBAttr> | undefined {
   670→  if (!Array.isArray(dq.fields)) {
   671→    return s.getBlobAttrs(attrsStore, etype);
   672→  }
   673→
   674→  const attrs = new Map();
   675→
   676→  for (const field of dq.fields) {
   677→    const attr = s.getAttrByFwdIdentName(attrsStore, etype, field);
   678→    const label = attr?.['forward-identity']?.[2];
   679→    if (label && s.isBlob(attr)) {
   680→      attrs.set(label, attr);
   681→    }
   682→  }
   683→  // Ensure we add the id field to avoid empty objects
   684→  if (!attrs.has('id')) {
   685→    const attr = s.getAttrByFwdIdentName(attrsStore, etype, 'id');
   686→    const label = attr?.['forward-identity']?.[2];
   687→    if (label) {
   688→      attrs.set(label, attr);
   689→    }
   690→  }
   691→
   692→  return attrs;
   693→}
   694→
   695→function runDataloadAndReturnObjects(
   696→  store: s.Store,
   697→  attrsStore: s.AttrsStore,
   698→  { etype, pageInfo, dq, form },
   699→) {
   700→  const order = form?.$?.order;
   701→  const isLeadingQuery = isLeading(form);
   702→  const direction = determineDirection(form);
   703→
   704→  let idVecs = datalogQuery(store, dq);
   705→
   706→  const startCursor = pageInfo?.['start-cursor'];
   707→  const orderAttr = getOrderAttr(attrsStore, etype, startCursor, order);
   708→
   709→  if (orderAttr && orderAttr?.['forward-identity']?.[2] !== 'id') {
   710→    const isDate = orderAttr['checked-data-type'] === 'date';
   711→    const a = orderAttr.id;
   712→    idVecs = idVecs.map(([id]) => {
   713→      // order attr is required to be cardinality one, so there will
   714→      // be at most one value here
   715→      let v = store.eav.get(id)?.get(a)?.values()?.next()?.value?.[2];
   716→      if (isDate) {
   717→        v = comparableDate(v);
   718→      }
   719→      return [id, v];
   720→    });
   721→  }
   722→
   723→  idVecs.sort(
   724→    direction === 'asc'
   725→      ? function compareIdVecs(a, b) {
   726→          return compareOrderTriples(a, b, orderAttr?.['checked-data-type']);
   727→        }
   728→      : function compareIdVecs(a, b) {
   729→          return compareOrderTriples(b, a, orderAttr?.['checked-data-type']);
   730→        },
   731→  );
   732→
   733→  let objects = {};
   734→  const attrs = objectAttrs(attrsStore, etype, dq);
   735→
   736→  for (const idVec of idVecs) {
   737→    const [id] = idVec;
   738→    if (objects[id]) {
   739→      continue;
   740→    }
   741→    if (
   742→      !isLeadingQuery &&
   743→      startCursor &&
   744→      orderAttr &&
   745→      isBefore(startCursor, orderAttr, direction, idVec)
   746→    ) {
   747→      continue;
   748→    }
   749→
   750→    const obj = s.getAsObject(store, attrs, id);
   751→    if (obj) {
   752→      objects[id] = obj;
   753→    }
   754→  }
   755→  return objects;
   756→}
   757→
   758→function determineDirection(form) {
   759→  const orderOpts = form.$?.order;
   760→  if (!orderOpts) {
   761→    return 'asc';
   762→  }
   763→
   764→  return orderOpts[Object.keys(orderOpts)[0]] || 'asc';
   765→}
   766→
   767→/**
   768→ * A "leading" query has no `offset`, `before`, or `after`
   769→ *
   770→ * It is at the 'beginning' of the order
   771→ */
   772→function isLeading(form) {
   773→  const offset = form.$?.offset;
   774→  const before = form.$?.before;
   775→  const after = form.$?.after;
   776→  return !offset && !before && !after;
   777→}
   778→
   779→/**
   780→ * Given a query like:
   781→ *
   782→ * {
   783→ *   users: {
   784→ *     $: { where: { name: "Joe" } },
   785→ *   },
   786→ * };
   787→ *
   788→ * `resolveObjects`, turns where clause: `{ name: "Joe" }`
   789→ * into a datalog query. We then run the datalog query,
   790→ * and reduce all the triples into objects.
   791→ */
   792→function resolveObjects(
   793→  store: s.Store,
   794→  attrsStore: s.AttrsStore,
   795→  { etype, level, form, join, pageInfo },
   796→) {
   797→  // Wait for server to tell us where we start if we don't start from the beginning
   798→  if (!isLeading(form) && (!pageInfo || !pageInfo['start-cursor'])) {
   799→    return [];
   800→  }
   801→
   802→  const where = withJoin(
   803→    makeWhere(attrsStore, etype, level, form.$?.where),
   804→    join,
   805→  );
   806→  const find = makeFind(makeVarImpl, etype, level);
   807→  const fields = form.$?.fields;
   808→
   809→  const objs = runDataloadAndReturnObjects(store, attrsStore, {
   810→    etype,
   811→    pageInfo,
   812→    form,
   813→    dq: { where, find, fields },
   814→  });
   815→
   816→  const limit = form.$?.limit || form.$?.first || form.$?.last;
   817→  if (limit != null) {
   818→    if (level > 0) {
   819→      console.warn(
   820→        'WARNING: Limits in child queries are only run client-side. Data returned from the server will not have a limit.',
   821→      );
   822→    }
   823→
   824→    const entries = Object.entries(objs);
   825→    if (entries.length <= limit) {
   826→      return objs;
   827→    }
   828→    return Object.fromEntries(entries.slice(0, limit));
   829→  }
   830→
   831→  return objs;
   832→}
   833→
   834→/**
   835→ * It's possible that we query
   836→ * for an attribute that doesn't exist yet.
   837→ *
   838→ * { users: { $: { where: { nonExistentProperty: "foo" } } } }
   839→ *
   840→ * This swallows the missing attr error and returns
   841→ * an empty result instead
   842→ */
   843→function guardedResolveObjects(store: s.Store, attrsStore: s.AttrsStore, opts) {
   844→  try {
   845→    return resolveObjects(store, attrsStore, opts);
   846→  } catch (e) {
   847→    if (e instanceof AttrNotFoundError) {
   848→      return {};
   849→    }
   850→    throw e;
   851→  }
   852→}
   853→/**
   854→ * Given a query like:
   855→ *
   856→ * {
   857→ *   users: {
   858→ *     $: { where: { name: "Joe" } },
   859→ *     posts: {},
   860→ *   },
   861→ * };
   862→ *
   863→ * `guardResolveObjects` will return the relevant `users` objects
   864→ * `extendObjects` will then extend each `user` object with relevant `posts`.
   865→ */
   866→function queryOne(store: s.Store, attrsStore: s.AttrsStore, opts) {
   867→  const objects = guardedResolveObjects(store, attrsStore, opts);
   868→  return extendObjects(makeVarImpl, store, attrsStore, opts, objects);
   869→}
   870→
   871→function formatPageInfo(
   872→  pageInfo: Record<
   873→    string,
   874→    {
   875→      'start-cursor'?: Cursor | null;
   876→      'end-cursor'?: Cursor | null;
   877→      'has-next-page?'?: boolean | null;
   878→      'has-previous-page?'?: boolean | null;
   879→    }
   880→  >,
   881→) {
   882→  const res = {};
   883→  for (const [k, v] of Object.entries(pageInfo)) {
   884→    res[k] = {
   885→      startCursor: v['start-cursor'],
   886→      endCursor: v['end-cursor'],
   887→      hasNextPage: v['has-next-page?'],
   888→      hasPreviousPage: v['has-previous-page?'],
   889→    };
   890→  }
   891→  return res;
   892→}
   893→
   894→export default function query(
   895→  {
   896→    store,
   897→    attrsStore,
   898→    pageInfo,
   899→    aggregate,
   900→  }: {
   901→    store: s.Store;
   902→    attrsStore: s.AttrsStore;
   903→    pageInfo?: any;
   904→    aggregate?: any;
   905→  },
   906→  q,
   907→) {
   908→  const data = Object.keys(q).reduce(function reduceResult(res, k) {
   909→    if (aggregate?.[k] || '$$ruleParams' === k) {
   910→      // Aggregate doesn't return any join rows and has no children,
   911→      // so don't bother querying further
   912→      return res;
   913→    }
   914→    res[k] = queryOne(store, attrsStore, {
   915→      etype: k,
   916→      form: q[k],
   917→      level: 0,
   918→      pageInfo: pageInfo?.[k],
   919→    });
   920→    return res;
   921→  }, {});
   922→
   923→  const result: { data: any; pageInfo?: any; aggregate?: any } = { data };
   924→  if (pageInfo) {
   925→    result.pageInfo = formatPageInfo(pageInfo);
   926→  }
   927→
   928→  if (aggregate) {
   929→    result.aggregate = aggregate;
   930→  }
   931→
   932→  return result;
   933→}
   934→

     1→// EntityKey.swift
     2→// SharingInstant
     3→//
     4→// A type-safe key for syncing entity collections with InstantDB.
     5→// This enables the @Shared(Schema.todos) syntax.
     6→
     7→import Dependencies
     8→import Dispatch
     9→import IdentifiedCollections
    10→import InstantDB
    11→import Sharing
    12→
    13→#if canImport(SwiftUI)
    14→  import SwiftUI
    15→#endif
    16→
    17→// MARK: - EntityKey
    18→
    19→/// A type-safe key for syncing an entity collection with InstantDB.
    20→///
    21→/// `EntityKey` enables zero-configuration sync with type safety:
    22→///
    23→/// ```swift
    24→/// // Define your schema (usually generated from instant.schema.ts)
    25→/// enum Schema {
    26→///   static let todos = EntityKey<Todo>(namespace: "todos")
    27→///   static let users = EntityKey<User>(namespace: "users")
    28→/// }
    29→///
    30→/// // Use in SwiftUI views
    31→/// @Shared(Schema.todos)
    32→/// private var todos: IdentifiedArrayOf<Todo> = []
    33→///
    34→/// // With ordering
    35→/// @Shared(Schema.todos.orderBy(\.createdAt, .desc))
    36→/// private var todos: IdentifiedArrayOf<Todo> = []
    37→/// ```
    38→///
    39→/// ## Query Modifiers
    40→///
    41→/// Chain modifiers to customize the query:
    42→///
    43→/// ```swift
    44→/// Schema.todos
    45→///   .orderBy(\.createdAt, .desc)  // Type-safe ordering
    46→///   .limit(10)                     // Limit results
    47→/// ```
    48→///
    49→/// ## Generated from Schema
    50→///
    51→/// Typically, `EntityKey` instances are generated from your `instant.schema.ts`
    52→/// file using the `instant-schema` CLI tool or SPM build plugin.
    53→/// Internal node for recursive query structure (using indirect enum to allow nesting)
    54→public indirect enum EntityQueryNode: Hashable, Sendable {
    55→  case link(
    56→    name: String,
    57→    limit: Int? = nil,
    58→    orderBy: String? = nil,
    59→    orderDirection: EntityKeyOrderDirection? = nil,
    60→    whereClauses: [String: EntityKeyPredicate] = [:],
    61→    children: [EntityQueryNode] = []
    62→  )
    63→}
    64→
    65→public struct EntityKey<Entity: EntityIdentifiable & Sendable>: Hashable, Sendable {
    66→  /// The InstantDB namespace (entity type name)
    67→  public let namespace: String
    68→  
    69→  /// The field to order by (optional)
    70→  public var orderByField: String?
    71→  
    72→  /// The order direction (optional)
    73→  public var orderDirection: EntityKeyOrderDirection?
    74→  
    75→  /// Maximum number of results (optional)
    76→  public var limitCount: Int?
    77→  
    78→  /// Where clause predicates (stored as field -> predicate dictionary)
    79→  public var whereClauses: [String: EntityKeyPredicate]
    80→  
    81→  /// Links to include in query results (Legacy flat set)
    82→  public var includedLinks: Set<String>
    83→  
    84→  /// Recursive tree of included links (Supported way)
    85→  public var linkTree: [EntityQueryNode]
    86→  
    87→  /// Creates an EntityKey for the specified namespace.
    88→  ///
    89→  /// - Parameters:
    90→  ///   - namespace: The InstantDB namespace (entity type name)
    91→  ///   - orderByField: Optional field to order by
    92→  ///   - orderDirection: Optional order direction
    93→  ///   - limitCount: Optional limit on results
    94→  ///   - whereClauses: Optional where clauses
    95→  ///   - includedLinks: Optional links to include in results
    96→  ///   - linkTree: Optional recursive link tree
    97→  public init(
    98→    namespace: String,
    99→    orderByField: String? = nil,
   100→    orderDirection: EntityKeyOrderDirection? = nil,
   101→    limitCount: Int? = nil,
   102→    whereClauses: [String: EntityKeyPredicate] = [:],
   103→    includedLinks: Set<String> = [],
   104→    linkTree: [EntityQueryNode] = []
   105→  ) {
   106→    self.namespace = namespace
   107→    self.orderByField = orderByField
   108→    self.orderDirection = orderDirection
   109→    self.limitCount = limitCount
   110→    self.whereClauses = whereClauses
   111→    self.includedLinks = includedLinks
   112→    self.linkTree = linkTree
   113→  }
   114→  
   115→  // MARK: - Query Modifiers
   116→  
   117→  /// Order results by a field using a type-safe KeyPath.
   118→  ///
   119→  /// ```swift
   120→  /// Schema.todos.orderBy(\.createdAt, .desc)
   121→  /// ```
   122→  ///
   123→  /// - Parameters:
   124→  ///   - keyPath: KeyPath to the field to order by
   125→  ///   - direction: The order direction (.asc or .desc)
   126→  /// - Returns: A new EntityKey with the ordering applied
   127→  public func orderBy<V>(
   128→    _ keyPath: KeyPath<Entity, V>,
   129→    _ direction: EntityKeyOrderDirection
   130→  ) -> EntityKey<Entity> {
   131→    var copy = self
   132→    copy.orderByField = extractFieldName(from: keyPath)
   133→    copy.orderDirection = direction
   134→    return copy
   135→  }
   136→  
   137→  /// Order results by a field name string.
   138→  ///
   139→  /// ```swift
   140→  /// Schema.todos.orderBy("createdAt", .desc)
   141→  /// ```
   142→  ///
   143→  /// - Parameters:
   144→  ///   - field: The field name to order by
   145→  ///   - direction: The order direction (.asc or .desc)
   146→  /// - Returns: A new EntityKey with the ordering applied
   147→  public func orderBy(
   148→    _ field: String,
   149→    _ direction: EntityKeyOrderDirection
   150→  ) -> EntityKey<Entity> {
   151→    var copy = self
   152→    copy.orderByField = field
   153→    copy.orderDirection = direction
   154→    return copy
   155→  }
   156→  
   157→  /// Limit the number of results.
   158→  ///
   159→  /// ```swift
   160→  /// Schema.todos.limit(10)
   161→  /// ```
   162→  ///
   163→  /// - Parameter count: Maximum number of results to return
   164→  /// - Returns: A new EntityKey with the limit applied
   165→  public func limit(_ count: Int) -> EntityKey<Entity> {
   166→    var copy = self
   167→    copy.limitCount = count
   168→    return copy
   169→  }
   170→  
   171→  // MARK: - Where Clauses
   172→  
   173→  /// Filter results where a field equals a value.
   174→  ///
   175→  /// ```swift
   176→  /// Schema.todos.where(\.done, .equals(false))
   177→  /// Schema.todos.where(\.priority, .greaterThan(5))
   178→  /// ```
   179→  ///
   180→  /// - Parameters:
   181→  ///   - keyPath: KeyPath to the field to filter on
   182→  ///   - predicate: The predicate to apply
   183→  /// - Returns: A new EntityKey with the filter applied
   184→  public func `where`<V: Hashable & Sendable>(
   185→    _ keyPath: KeyPath<Entity, V>,
   186→    _ predicate: EntityKeyPredicate
   187→  ) -> EntityKey<Entity> {
   188→    var copy = self
   189→    let fieldName = extractFieldName(from: keyPath)
   190→    copy.whereClauses[fieldName] = predicate
   191→    return copy
   192→  }
   193→  
   194→  /// Filter results where a field equals a value (string-based).
   195→  ///
   196→  /// ```swift
   197→  /// Schema.todos.where("done", .equals(false))
   198→  /// ```
   199→  ///
   200→  /// - Parameters:
   201→  ///   - field: The field name to filter on
   202→  ///   - predicate: The predicate to apply
   203→  /// - Returns: A new EntityKey with the filter applied
   204→  public func `where`(
   205→    _ field: String,
   206→    _ predicate: EntityKeyPredicate
   207→  ) -> EntityKey<Entity> {
   208→    var copy = self
   209→    copy.whereClauses[field] = predicate
   210→    return copy
   211→  }
   212→  
   213→  // MARK: - Link Inclusion
   214→  
   215→  /// Include a related entity in the query results (type-safe, has-one).
   216→  ///
   217→  /// This is the preferred way to include links as it provides compile-time
   218→  /// validation that the link field exists on the entity type.
   219→  ///
   220→  /// ```swift
   221→  /// // Type-safe: compiler validates that Post has an 'author' property
   222→  /// Schema.posts.with(\.author)
   223→  ///
   224→  /// // Chain multiple links
   225→  /// Schema.posts.with(\.author).with(\.comments)
   226→  /// ```
   227→  ///
   228→  /// - Parameter keyPath: KeyPath to the link field (must be an optional property)
   229→  /// - Returns: A new EntityKey with the link inclusion
   230→  public func with<V>(_ keyPath: KeyPath<Entity, V?>) -> EntityKey<Entity> {
   231→    var copy = self
   232→    let fieldName = extractFieldName(from: keyPath)
   233→    copy.includedLinks.insert(fieldName)
   234→    
   235→    // Add leaf node
   236→    copy.linkTree.append(.link(name: fieldName))
   237→    
   238→    return copy
   239→  }
   240→  
   241→  /// Include a related entity array in the query results (type-safe, has-many).
   242→  ///
   243→  /// Use this for has-many relationships where the link field is an optional array.
   244→  ///
   245→  /// ```swift
   246→  /// // Type-safe: compiler validates that Profile has a 'posts' property
   247→  /// Schema.profiles.with(\.posts)
   248→  /// ```
   249→  ///
   250→  /// - Parameter keyPath: KeyPath to the link array field
   251→  /// - Returns: A new EntityKey with the link inclusion
   252→  public func with<V>(_ keyPath: KeyPath<Entity, [V]?>) -> EntityKey<Entity> {
   253→    var copy = self
   254→    let fieldName = extractFieldName(from: keyPath)
   255→    copy.includedLinks.insert(fieldName)
   256→    
   257→    // Add leaf node
   258→    copy.linkTree.append(.link(name: fieldName))
   259→    
   260→    return copy
   261→  }
   262→
   263→  /// Include a related entity with a nested query builder (Recursive).
   264→  ///
   265→  /// This enables deep fetching and nested query modifiers.
   266→  ///
   267→  /// ```swift
   268→  /// Schema.users.with(\.posts) { posts in
   269→  ///   posts.orderBy(\.createdAt, .desc).limit(5)
   270→  ///        .with(\.comments)
   271→  /// }
   272→  /// ```
   273→  ///
   274→  /// - Parameters:
   275→  ///   - keyPath: KeyPath to the has-one link
   276→  ///   - builder: A closure that takes a base EntityKey for the linked type and returns a configured one
   277→  /// - Returns: A new EntityKey with the nested query included
   278→  public func with<V: EntityIdentifiable & Sendable>(
   279→    _ keyPath: KeyPath<Entity, V?>,
   280→    _ builder: (EntityKey<V>) -> EntityKey<V>
   281→  ) -> EntityKey<Entity> {
   282→    var copy = self
   283→    let fieldName = extractFieldName(from: keyPath)
   284→    copy.includedLinks.insert(fieldName)
   285→    
   286→    let base = EntityKey<V>(namespace: fieldName)
   287→    let configured = builder(base)
   288→    
   289→    // Convert the configured sub-key into a recursive node
   290→    let node = EntityQueryNode.link(
   291→      name: fieldName,
   292→      limit: configured.limitCount,
   293→      orderBy: configured.orderByField,
   294→      orderDirection: configured.orderDirection,
   295→      whereClauses: configured.whereClauses,
   296→      children: configured.linkTree
   297→    )
   298→    copy.linkTree.append(node)
   299→    
   300→    return copy
   301→  }
   302→
   303→  /// Include a related entity array with a nested query builder (Recursive).
   304→  ///
   305→  /// ```swift
   306→  /// Schema.users.with(\.posts) { posts in
   307→  ///   posts.with(\.comments)
   308→  /// }
   309→  /// ```
   310→  ///
   311→  /// - Parameters:
   312→  ///   - keyPath: KeyPath to the has-many link
   313→  ///   - builder: A closure that takes a base EntityKey for the linked type and returns a configured one
   314→  /// - Returns: A new EntityKey with the nested query included
   315→  public func with<V: EntityIdentifiable & Sendable>(
   316→    _ keyPath: KeyPath<Entity, [V]?>,
   317→    _ builder: (EntityKey<V>) -> EntityKey<V>
   318→  ) -> EntityKey<Entity> {
   319→    var copy = self
   320→    let fieldName = extractFieldName(from: keyPath)
   321→    copy.includedLinks.insert(fieldName)
   322→    
   323→    let base = EntityKey<V>(namespace: fieldName)
   324→    let configured = builder(base)
   325→    
   326→    let node = EntityQueryNode.link(
   327→      name: fieldName,
   328→      limit: configured.limitCount,
   329→      orderBy: configured.orderByField,
   330→      orderDirection: configured.orderDirection,
   331→      whereClauses: configured.whereClauses,
   332→      children: configured.linkTree
   333→    )
   334→    copy.linkTree.append(node)
   335→    
   336→    return copy
   337→  }
   338→  
   339→  /// Include multiple linked entities (type-safe, 2 links).
   340→  ///
   341→  /// ```swift
   342→  /// Schema.posts.with(\.author, \.comments)
   343→  /// ```
   344→  ///
   345→  /// - Parameters:
   346→  ///   - keyPath1: First link field
   347→  ///   - keyPath2: Second link field
   348→  /// - Returns: A new EntityKey with both link inclusions
   349→  public func with<V1, V2>(
   350→    _ keyPath1: KeyPath<Entity, V1?>,
   351→    _ keyPath2: KeyPath<Entity, V2?>
   352→  ) -> EntityKey<Entity> {
   353→    self.with(keyPath1).with(keyPath2)
   354→  }
   355→  
   356→  /// Include multiple linked entities (type-safe, 3 links).
   357→  ///
   358→  /// ```swift
   359→  /// Schema.posts.with(\.author, \.comments, \.likes)
   360→  /// ```
   361→  public func with<V1, V2, V3>(
   362→    _ keyPath1: KeyPath<Entity, V1?>,
   363→    _ keyPath2: KeyPath<Entity, V2?>,
   364→    _ keyPath3: KeyPath<Entity, V3?>
   365→  ) -> EntityKey<Entity> {
   366→    self.with(keyPath1).with(keyPath2).with(keyPath3)
   367→  }
   368→  
   369→  /// Include multiple linked entities (type-safe, 4 links).
   370→  public func with<V1, V2, V3, V4>(
   371→    _ keyPath1: KeyPath<Entity, V1?>,
   372→    _ keyPath2: KeyPath<Entity, V2?>,
   373→    _ keyPath3: KeyPath<Entity, V3?>,
   374→    _ keyPath4: KeyPath<Entity, V4?>
   375→  ) -> EntityKey<Entity> {
   376→    self.with(keyPath1).with(keyPath2).with(keyPath3).with(keyPath4)
   377→  }
   378→  
   379→  /// Include a related entity by field name.
   380→  ///
   381→  /// - Parameter linkName: The name of the link field to include
   382→  /// - Returns: A new EntityKey with the link inclusion
   383→  ///
   384→  /// - Note: Prefer the type-safe `.with(\.linkName)` overload when possible.
   385→  public func with(_ linkName: String) -> EntityKey<Entity> {
   386→    var copy = self
   387→    copy.includedLinks.insert(linkName)
   388→    return copy
   389→  }
   390→  
   391→  // MARK: - Helpers
   392→  
   393→  private func extractFieldName<V>(from keyPath: KeyPath<Entity, V>) -> String {
   394→    let keyPathString = String(describing: keyPath)
   395→    if let lastComponent = keyPathString.split(separator: ".").last {
   396→      return String(lastComponent)
   397→    }
   398→    return keyPathString
   399→  }
   400→}
   401→
   402→// MARK: - Order Direction
   403→
   404→/// The order direction for EntityKey queries.
   405→public enum EntityKeyOrderDirection: String, Sendable, Hashable {
   406→  /// Ascending order (smallest to largest, oldest to newest)
   407→  case asc
   408→  
   409→  /// Descending order (largest to smallest, newest to oldest)
   410→  case desc
   411→}
   412→
   413→// MARK: - Predicate
   414→
   415→/// A predicate for filtering EntityKey queries.
   416→///
   417→/// Predicates support common comparison operations:
   418→///
   419→/// ```swift
   420→/// .equals(value)       // field == value
   421→/// .notEquals(value)    // field != value
   422→/// .greaterThan(value)  // field > value
   423→/// .greaterOrEqual(value) // field >= value
   424→/// .lessThan(value)     // field < value
   425→/// .lessOrEqual(value)  // field <= value
   426→/// .isIn([values])      // field in [values]
   427→/// .like(pattern)       // SQL LIKE pattern (case-sensitive)
   428→/// .ilike(pattern)      // SQL LIKE pattern (case-insensitive)
   429→/// .contains(text)      // Contains substring (case-insensitive)
   430→/// .startsWith(text)    // Starts with prefix (case-insensitive)
   431→/// .endsWith(text)      // Ends with suffix (case-insensitive)
   432→/// ```
   433→public enum EntityKeyPredicate: Hashable, Sendable {
   434→  /// Equals comparison
   435→  case equals(AnyHashableSendable)
   436→  
   437→  /// Not equals comparison
   438→  case notEquals(AnyHashableSendable)
   439→  
   440→  /// Greater than comparison
   441→  case greaterThan(AnyHashableSendable)
   442→  
   443→  /// Greater than or equal comparison
   444→  case greaterOrEqual(AnyHashableSendable)
   445→  
   446→  /// Less than comparison
   447→  case lessThan(AnyHashableSendable)
   448→  
   449→  /// Less than or equal comparison
   450→  case lessOrEqual(AnyHashableSendable)
   451→  
   452→  /// In set comparison
   453→  case isIn([AnyHashableSendable])
   454→  
   455→  /// Pattern matching (case-sensitive, SQL LIKE syntax: % for wildcard)
   456→  case like(String)
   457→  
   458→  /// Pattern matching (case-insensitive, SQL LIKE syntax: % for wildcard)
   459→  case ilike(String)
   460→  
   461→  // MARK: - Convenience Initializers
   462→  
   463→  /// Creates an equals predicate.
   464→  public static func eq<V: Hashable & Sendable>(_ value: V) -> EntityKeyPredicate {
   465→    .equals(AnyHashableSendable(value))
   466→  }
   467→  
   468→  /// Creates a not-equals predicate.
   469→  public static func neq<V: Hashable & Sendable>(_ value: V) -> EntityKeyPredicate {
   470→    .notEquals(AnyHashableSendable(value))
   471→  }
   472→  
   473→  /// Creates a greater-than predicate.
   474→  public static func gt<V: Hashable & Sendable>(_ value: V) -> EntityKeyPredicate {
   475→    .greaterThan(AnyHashableSendable(value))
   476→  }
   477→  
   478→  /// Creates a greater-or-equal predicate.
   479→  public static func gte<V: Hashable & Sendable>(_ value: V) -> EntityKeyPredicate {
   480→    .greaterOrEqual(AnyHashableSendable(value))
   481→  }
   482→  
   483→  /// Creates a less-than predicate.
   484→  public static func lt<V: Hashable & Sendable>(_ value: V) -> EntityKeyPredicate {
   485→    .lessThan(AnyHashableSendable(value))
   486→  }
   487→  
   488→  /// Creates a less-or-equal predicate.
   489→  public static func lte<V: Hashable & Sendable>(_ value: V) -> EntityKeyPredicate {
   490→    .lessOrEqual(AnyHashableSendable(value))
   491→  }
   492→  
   493→  /// Creates an in-set predicate.
   494→  public static func `in`<V: Hashable & Sendable>(_ values: [V]) -> EntityKeyPredicate {
   495→    .isIn(values.map { AnyHashableSendable($0) })
   496→  }
   497→  
   498→  /// Creates a contains predicate (case-insensitive).
   499→  /// Matches if the field contains the given substring.
   500→  public static func contains(_ substring: String) -> EntityKeyPredicate {
   501→    .ilike("%\(substring)%")
   502→  }
   503→  
   504→  /// Creates a starts-with predicate (case-insensitive).
   505→  /// Matches if the field starts with the given prefix.
   506→  public static func startsWith(_ prefix: String) -> EntityKeyPredicate {
   507→    .ilike("\(prefix)%")
   508→  }
   509→  
   510→  /// Creates an ends-with predicate (case-insensitive).
   511→  /// Matches if the field ends with the given suffix.
   512→  public static func endsWith(_ suffix: String) -> EntityKeyPredicate {
   513→    .ilike("%\(suffix)")
   514→  }
   515→  
   516→  /// Convert to InstantDB where clause dictionary format
   517→  func toWhereValue() -> Any {
   518→    switch self {
   519→    case .equals(let value):
   520→      return value.base
   521→    case .notEquals(let value):
   522→      return ["$ne": value.base]
   523→    case .greaterThan(let value):
   524→      return ["$gt": value.base]
   525→    case .greaterOrEqual(let value):
   526→      return ["$gte": value.base]
   527→    case .lessThan(let value):
   528→      return ["$lt": value.base]
   529→    case .lessOrEqual(let value):
   530→      return ["$lte": value.base]
   531→    case .isIn(let values):
   532→      return ["$in": values.map { $0.base }]
   533→    case .like(let pattern):
   534→      return ["$like": pattern]
   535→    case .ilike(let pattern):
   536→      return ["$ilike": pattern]
   537→    }
   538→  }
   539→}
   540→
   541→/// Type-erased hashable sendable value for predicate storage.
   542→public struct AnyHashableSendable: Hashable, Sendable {
   543→  public let base: any Sendable
   544→  private let _hashValue: Int
   545→  private let _isEqual: @Sendable (Any) -> Bool
   546→  
   547→  public init<T: Hashable & Sendable>(_ value: T) {
   548→    self.base = value
   549→    self._hashValue = value.hashValue
   550→    self._isEqual = { other in
   551→      guard let other = other as? T else { return false }
   552→      return value == other
   553→    }
   554→  }
   555→  
   556→  public func hash(into hasher: inout Hasher) {
   557→    hasher.combine(_hashValue)
   558→  }
   559→  
   560→  public static func == (lhs: AnyHashableSendable, rhs: AnyHashableSendable) -> Bool {
   561→    lhs._isEqual(rhs.base)
   562→  }
   563→}
   564→
   565→// MARK: - SharedReaderKey Extension
   566→
   567→extension SharedReaderKey {
   568→  /// Create a bidirectional sync key from an EntityKey.
   569→  ///
   570→  /// This enables the `@Shared(Schema.todos)` syntax:
   571→  ///
   572→  /// ```swift
   573→  /// @Shared(Schema.todos)
   574→  /// private var todos: IdentifiedArrayOf<Todo> = []
   575→  ///
   576→  /// // With ordering
   577→  /// @Shared(Schema.todos.orderBy(\.createdAt, .desc))
   578→  /// private var todos: IdentifiedArrayOf<Todo> = []
   579→  /// ```
   580→  ///
   581→  /// - Parameter key: The EntityKey defining the sync
   582→  /// - Returns: A SharedKey for use with @Shared
   583→  public static func instantSync<E: EntityIdentifiable & Sendable>(
   584→    _ key: EntityKey<E>
   585→  ) -> Self where Self == InstantSyncCollectionKey<IdentifiedArrayOf<E>>.Default {
   586→    Self[
   587→      InstantSyncCollectionKey(
   588→        request: EntityKeyRequest(key: key),
   589→        appID: nil
   590→      ),
   591→      default: []
   592→    ]
   593→  }
   594→  
   595→  /// Create a read-only query key from an EntityKey.
   596→  ///
   597→  /// This enables the `@SharedReader(Schema.todos)` syntax:
   598→  ///
   599→  /// ```swift
   600→  /// @SharedReader(Schema.todos)
   601→  /// private var todos: IdentifiedArrayOf<Todo> = []
   602→  ///
   603→  /// // With ordering and limit
   604→  /// @SharedReader(Schema.todos.orderBy(\.createdAt, .desc).limit(10))
   605→  /// private var todos: IdentifiedArrayOf<Todo> = []
   606→  /// ```
   607→  ///
   608→  /// - Parameter key: The EntityKey defining the query
   609→  /// - Returns: A SharedReaderKey for use with @SharedReader
   610→  public static func instantQuery<E: EntityIdentifiable & Sendable>(
   611→    _ key: EntityKey<E>
   612→  ) -> Self where Self == InstantQueryKey<IdentifiedArrayOf<E>>.Default {
   613→    Self[
   614→      InstantQueryKey(
   615→        request: EntityKeyQueryRequest(key: key),
   616→        appID: nil
   617→      ),
   618→      default: []
   619→    ]
   620→  }
   621→}
   622→
   623→// MARK: - Internal Request Types
   624→
   625→/// Internal request type that bridges EntityKey to the sync infrastructure.
   626→struct EntityKeyRequest<E: EntityIdentifiable & Sendable>: SharingInstantSync.KeyCollectionRequest {
   627→  typealias Value = E
   628→  let key: EntityKey<E>
   629→  
   630→  var configuration: SharingInstantSync.CollectionConfiguration<E>? {
   631→    var orderBy: OrderBy? = nil
   632→    if let field = key.orderByField, let direction = key.orderDirection {
   633→      orderBy = direction == .desc ? .desc(field) : .asc(field)
   634→    }
   635→    
   636→    // Convert EntityKey where clauses to dictionary format
   637→    var whereClause: [String: Any]? = nil
   638→    if !key.whereClauses.isEmpty {
   639→      var clause: [String: Any] = [:]
   640→      for (field, predicate) in key.whereClauses {
   641→        clause[field] = predicate.toWhereValue()
   642→      }
   643→      whereClause = clause
   644→    }
   645→    
   646→    return SharingInstantSync.CollectionConfiguration(
   647→      namespace: key.namespace,
   648→      orderBy: orderBy,
   649→      whereClause: whereClause,
   650→      includedLinks: key.includedLinks,
   651→      linkTree: key.linkTree
   652→    )
   653→  }
   654→}
   655→
   656→/// Internal request type that bridges EntityKey to the query infrastructure.
   657→struct EntityKeyQueryRequest<E: EntityIdentifiable & Sendable>: SharingInstantQuery.KeyRequest {
   658→  typealias Value = E
   659→  let key: EntityKey<E>
   660→  
   661→  var configuration: SharingInstantQuery.Configuration<E>? {
   662→    var orderBy: OrderBy? = nil
   663→    if let field = key.orderByField, let direction = key.orderDirection {
   664→      orderBy = direction == .desc ? .desc(field) : .asc(field)
   665→    }
   666→    
   667→    // Convert EntityKey where clauses to dictionary format
   668→    var whereClause: [String: Any]? = nil
   669→    if !key.whereClauses.isEmpty {
   670→      var clause: [String: Any] = [:]
   671→      for (field, predicate) in key.whereClauses {
   672→        clause[field] = predicate.toWhereValue()
   673→      }
   674→      whereClause = clause
   675→    }
   676→    
   677→    return SharingInstantQuery.Configuration(
   678→      namespace: key.namespace,
   679→      orderBy: orderBy,
   680→      limit: key.limitCount,
   681→      whereClause: whereClause,
   682→      includedLinks: key.includedLinks,
   683→      linkTree: key.linkTree
   684→    )
   685→  }
   686→}

     7→    /// Recursively resolves an entity into a dictionary, following references.
     8→    /// This is used to hydrate `Codable` structs from the flat TripleStore.
     9→    ///
    10→    /// - Parameters:
    11→    ///   - id: The entity ID to resolve.
    12→    ///   - attrsStore: The store containing attribute definitions (schema).
    13→    ///   - depth: Current recursion depth (to prevent infinite loops if circular).
    14→    ///   - maxDepth: Maximum recursion depth.
    15→    ///   - includedLinks: Optional set of link names to resolve. If nil, all links are resolved.
    16→    ///                    If empty set, no links are resolved. This matches the TypeScript SDK's
    17→    ///                    query-driven link resolution behavior.
    18→    /// - Returns: A dictionary representation of the entity.
    19→    public func resolve(
    20→        id: String,
    21→        attrsStore: AttrsStore,
    22→        depth: Int = 0,
    23→        maxDepth: Int = 10,
    24→        includedLinks: Set<String>? = nil
    25→    ) -> [String: Any] {
    26→        if depth > maxDepth { return ["id": id] }
    27→        
    28→        let triples = self.getTriples(entity: id)
    29→        var obj: [String: Any] = ["id": id]
    30→        
    31→        // Group triples by Attribute ID
    32→        let triplesByAttr = Dictionary(grouping: triples, by: { $0.attributeId })
    33→        
    34→        let entityType = triplesByAttr.keys.lazy
    35→            .compactMap { attrId in
    36→                attrsStore.getAttr(attrId)?.forwardIdentity.dropFirst().first
    37→            }
    38→            .first
    39→
    40→        for (attrId, attrTriples) in triplesByAttr {
    41→            guard let attr = attrsStore.getAttr(attrId) else { continue }
    42→            
    43→            // Determine the key name (label)
    44→            // Forward identity: [id, namespace, label]
    45→            // If the schema is incomplete, fall back to using the attribute ID as the label.
    46→            let label = attr.forwardIdentity.last ?? attrId
    47→            
    48→            if attr.valueType == .ref {
    49→                // Allow nested forward links up to maxDepth
    50→                // Previously this was restricted to depth == 0, which prevented
    51→                // nested links like Media.transcriptionRuns.words from being resolved
    52→                if depth >= maxDepth {
    53→                    continue
    54→                }
    55→
    56→                // Skip links not in includedLinks (if specified)
    57→                // This matches the TypeScript SDK's query-driven link resolution:
    58→                // only resolve links that were explicitly requested in the query.
    59→                if let includedLinks = includedLinks, !includedLinks.contains(label) {
    60→                    continue
    61→                }
    62→
    63→                // Handle References (Links)
    64→                var resolvedRefs: [Any] = []
    65→
    66→                for triple in attrTriples {
    67→                    if case .ref(let targetId) = triple.value {
    68→                        let childObj = resolve(id: targetId, attrsStore: attrsStore, depth: depth + 1, maxDepth: maxDepth, includedLinks: includedLinks)
    69→                        // Skip entities that have been deleted or not fully loaded (only have "id" field).
    70→                        // This happens when a where clause references a linked entity (e.g., board.id)
    71→                        // but the entity wasn't explicitly requested via .with(). Including such
    72→                        // "ghost" entities would cause decode failures because required fields are missing.
    73→                        if childObj.count <= 1 {
    74→                            continue
    75→                        }
    76→                        resolvedRefs.append(childObj)
    77→                    } else if case .string(let targetId) = triple.value {
    78→                         // Fallback if ref stored as string? Should satisfy TripleValue.ref though.
    79→                        let childObj = resolve(id: targetId, attrsStore: attrsStore, depth: depth + 1, maxDepth: maxDepth, includedLinks: includedLinks)
    80→                        // Same guard for ghost entities
    81→                        if childObj.count <= 1 {
    82→                            continue
    83→                        }
    84→                        resolvedRefs.append(childObj)
    85→                    }
    86→                }
    87→                
    88→                if attr.cardinality == .many {
    89→                    obj[label] = resolvedRefs
    90→                } else {
    91→                    obj[label] = resolvedRefs.first
    92→                }
    93→                
    94→            } else {
    95→                // Handle Scalar Values

    99→                } else {

   101→                    // Store.addTriple supports cardinality one overwriting.
   102→                    // But getTriples returns all?
   103→                    // SDK Store `addTriple` handles LWW overwrite for cardinality one.
   104→                    // So we expect 1 triple.
   105→                    if let triple = attrTriples.first {

   107→                    }
   108→                }
   109→            }
   110→        }
   111→
   112→        // Resolve reverse links at all depths (not just depth 0)

   117→

   119→                // Skip reverse links not in includedLinks (if specified)
   120→                // This matches the TypeScript SDK's query-driven link resolution.
   121→                if let includedLinks = includedLinks, !includedLinks.contains(reverseLabel) {

   123→                }

   126→                guard !reverseTriples.isEmpty else { continue }

   128→                var resolvedParents: [[String: Any]] = []
   129→                resolvedParents.reserveCapacity(reverseTriples.count)

   134→                        attrsStore: attrsStore,
   135→                        depth: depth + 1,
   136→                        maxDepth: maxDepth,
   137→                        includedLinks: includedLinks

   139→
   140→                    // Skip entities that have been deleted (only have "id" field)

   143→                    // Including such "ghost" entities would cause decode failures.
   144→                    if parentObj.count <= 1 {

   146→                    }

   148→                    resolvedParents.append(parentObj)
   149→                }
   150→
   151→                // Don't add empty arrays - this prevents decode issues when all
   152→                // reverse-linked entities have been deleted
   153→                guard !resolvedParents.isEmpty else { continue }
   154→
   155→                // Determine reverse cardinality using the `unique` field.
   156→                // Per InstantDB server encoding (schema.clj lines 199-200):
   157→                // - `unique? = true` means reverse has "one" (singular)
   158→                // - `unique? = false` or nil means reverse has "many" (array)
   159→                //

   161→                let isReverseSingular = attr.unique == true
   162→

   164→                    obj[reverseLabel] = resolvedParents.first
   165→                } else {
   166→                    obj[reverseLabel] = resolvedParents
   167→                }
   168→            }
   169→        }

   174→    /// Decodes an entity from the store into a Swift type.
   175→    ///
   176→    /// - Parameters:
   177→    ///   - id: The entity ID to decode.
   178→    ///   - attrsStore: The store containing attribute definitions (schema).
   179→    ///   - includedLinks: Optional set of link names to resolve. If nil, all links are resolved.
   180→    ///                    If empty set, no links are resolved.
   181→    /// - Returns: The decoded entity, or nil if decoding fails.
   182→    public func get<T: Decodable>(id: String, attrsStore: AttrsStore, includedLinks: Set<String>? = nil) -> T? {
   183→        let dict = resolve(id: id, attrsStore: attrsStore, includedLinks: includedLinks)
   184→        
   185→        do {
   186→            let data = try JSONSerialization.data(withJSONObject: dict, options: [])
   187→            let decoder = JSONDecoder()
   188→            // Configure decoder if needed (dates?)
   189→            // InstantDB uses ISO8601 strings for dates usually, or Timestamps?
   190→            // Types.swift says TripleValue.toAny() -> Date overrides to String ISO8601.
   191→            decoder.dateDecodingStrategy = .iso8601 
   192→            return try decoder.decode(T.self, from: data)
   193→        } catch {
   194→            SharingInstantInternalLog.debug("TripleStore decode failed for \(id): \(error)")
   195→            return nil
   196→        }
   197→    }
   198→}

     4→/// A type that can be read/written from InstantDB via SharingInstant.
     5→///
     6→/// This protocol combines `InstantEntity` (which provides the namespace) with
     7→/// `Identifiable` (which provides the entity ID). Your entity types should conform
     8→/// to this protocol to work with `@Shared(.instantSync(...))`.
     9→///
    10→/// ## Example
    11→///
    12→/// ```swift
    13→/// struct Todo: Codable, EntityIdentifiable, Sendable {
    14→///   static var namespace: String { "todos" }
    15→///   
    16→///   var id: String
    17→///   var title: String
    18→///   var done: Bool
    19→///   var createdAt: Date
    20→/// }
    21→/// ```
    22→///
    23→/// The `id` property is used as the entity ID in InstantDB's triple store.
    24→/// It should be a stable, unique identifier (typically a UUID string).
    25→///
    26→/// The `namespace` property defines which InstantDB namespace this entity belongs to.
    27→public protocol EntityIdentifiable: InstantEntity, Identifiable where ID == String {
    28→  /// The unique identifier for this entity in InstantDB.
    29→  ///
    30→  /// This is used as the entity ID in the triple store and should be stable across
    31→  /// the lifetime of the entity. Typically this is a UUID string.
    32→  var id: String { get }
    33→}

commit d3934126e6f8d75f3e35b379f99f12613dec57e5
Author: Michael Lustig <lustig@knophy.com>
Date:   Mon Dec 22 22:55:15 2025 -0500

    Fix reverse-link hydration in TripleStore decoding
    
    Why: SharingInstant’s Reactor normalizes query results into a flat TripleStore and later re-emits entities by decoding them back into Codable models. Links like posts.author are *reverse* relationships (stored as forward triples on profiles.posts). The previous TripleStore resolver only walked forward refs, so Post.author was dropped on store re-emit, causing the UI to flip from the optimistic author to "Unknown Author" after a subsequent refresh.
    
    What: Teach InstantDB.TripleStore.resolve(id:attrsStore:) to also materialize reverse link properties (using AttrsStore.revIdents + TripleStore.getReverseRefs) while keeping nested entities shallow to avoid cycles.
    
    Tests: Add TripleStoreReverseLinkResolutionTests.testDecodingReverseLinkAuthorFromProfilePosts to lock in the behavior for the microblog schema (profiles.posts ↔ posts.author).
    
    Evidence: swift test --package-path sharing-instant --filter TripleStoreReverseLinkResolutionTests

     1→/// Rapid Transcription Update Demo
     2→///
     3→/// This demo mirrors the SpeechRecorderApp's RapidUpdateSharingInstantTest to verify
     4→/// that SharingInstant can handle rapid segment text updates with the same timing
     5→/// as real-time speech transcription.
     6→///
     7→/// ## Test Pattern
     8→///
     9→/// Real speech transcription emits updates at irregular intervals:
    10→/// - Multiple updates within milliseconds (e.g., 7ms, 8ms apart)
    11→/// - Longer gaps between words (e.g., 800-1000ms)

Author: Michael Lustig <lustig@knophy.com>
Date:   Fri Jan 9 11:06:06 2026 -0500

    fix: Apply pending mutations at query time (TypeScript SDK pattern)
    
    This fixes the issue where offline todos disappear when navigating away
    and back to a screen. The implementation now matches the TypeScript SDK's
    dataForQuery() -> _applyOptimisticUpdates() pattern:
    
    - SubscriptionState.handleStoreUpdate() now fetches pending mutations
      from SQLite and merges them on-the-fly before yielding results
    - Fixed attribute ID resolution: UUIDs are looked up via attrsStore.getAttr()
      then namespace/field extracted from forwardIdentity
    - Added debug logging infrastructure for troubleshooting offline issues
    - Added comprehensive tests for pending mutation restoration
    
    The key insight is that pending mutations are the source of truth for
    unconfirmed changes and must be applied at query evaluation time,
    not persisted to the store.
    
    Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
