   268→    if (revIdent) {
   269→      const [_, revEtype, revLabel] = revIdent;
   270→      setInMap(revIdents, [revEtype, revLabel], attr);
   271→    }
   272→  }
   273→
   274→  return { blobAttrs, primaryKeys, forwardIdents, revIdents };
   275→}
   276→
   277→export function toJSON(store: Store): StoreJsonVersion1 {
   278→  return {
   279→    triples: allMapValues(store.eav, 3),
   280→    cardinalityInference: store.cardinalityInference,
   281→    useDateObjects: store.useDateObjects,
   282→    version: 1,
   283→  };
   284→}
   285→
   286→export function fromJSON(attrsStore: AttrsStore, storeJSON: StoreJson): Store {
   287→  return createStore(
   288→    attrsStore,
   289→    storeJSON.triples,
   290→    storeJSON.cardinalityInference,
   291→    storeJSON.useDateObjects,
   292→  );
   293→}
   294→
   295→export function attrsStoreFromJSON(
   296→  attrsStoreJSON: AttrsStoreJson | null,
   297→  storeJSON: StoreJson | null,
   298→): AttrsStore | undefined {
   299→  if (attrsStoreJSON) {
   300→    return new AttrsStoreClass(attrsStoreJSON.attrs, attrsStoreJSON.linkIndex);
   301→  }
   302→  if (storeJSON && '__type' in storeJSON) {
   303→    return new AttrsStoreClass(storeJSON.attrs, storeJSON.linkIndex);
   304→  }
   305→}
   306→
   307→export function hasTriple(store: Store, [e, a, v]: [string, string, any]) {
   308→  return getInMap(store.eav, [e, a, v]) !== undefined;
   309→}
   310→
   311→export function hasEntity(store: Store, e: string) {
   312→  return getInMap(store.eav, [e]) !== undefined;
   313→}
   314→
   315→export function createStore(
   316→  attrsStore: AttrsStore,
   317→  triples: Triple[],
   318→  enableCardinalityInference?: boolean | null,
   319→  useDateObjects?: boolean | null,
   320→): Store {
   321→  const store = createTripleIndexes(
   322→    attrsStore,
   323→    triples,
   324→    useDateObjects,
   325→  ) as unknown as Store;
   326→  store.cardinalityInference = enableCardinalityInference;
   327→  store.useDateObjects = useDateObjects;
   328→  return store;
   329→}
   330→
   331→// We may have local triples with lookup refs in them,
   332→// we need to convert those lookup refs to eids to insert them
   333→// into the store. If we can't find the lookup ref locally,
   334→// then we drop the triple and have to wait for the server response
   335→// to see the optimistic updates.
   336→function resolveLookupRefs(store: Store, triple: Triple): Triple | null {
   337→  let eid;
   338→
   339→  // Check if `e` is a lookup ref
   340→  if (Array.isArray(triple[0])) {
   341→    const [a, v] = triple[0];
   342→    const eMaps = store.aev.get(a);
   343→    if (!eMaps) {
   344→      // We don't have the attr, so don't try to add the
   345→      // triple to the store
   346→      return null;
   347→    }
   348→    // This would be a lot more efficient with a ave index
   349→    const triples = allMapValues(eMaps, 2);
   350→    eid = triples.find((x) => x[2] === v)?.[0];
   351→  } else {
   352→    eid = triple[0];
   353→  }
   354→
   355→  if (!eid) {
   356→    // We don't know the eid that the ref refers to, so
   357→    // we can't add the triple to the store.
   358→    return null;
   359→  }
   360→
   361→  // Check if v is a lookup ref
   362→  const lookupV = triple[2];
   363→  if (
   364→    Array.isArray(lookupV) &&
   365→    lookupV.length === 2 &&
   366→    store.aev.get(lookupV[0])
   367→  ) {
   368→    const [a, v] = lookupV;
   369→    const eMaps = store.aev.get(a);
   370→    if (!eMaps) {
   371→      // We don't have the attr, so don't try to add the
   372→      // triple to the store
   373→      return null;
   374→    }
   375→    const triples = allMapValues(eMaps, 2);
   376→    const value = triples.find((x) => x[2] === v)?.[0];
   377→    if (!value) {
   378→      return null;
   379→    }
   380→    const [_e, aid, _v, ...rest] = triple;
   381→    return [eid, aid, value, ...rest];
   382→  } else {
   383→    const [_, ...rest] = triple;
   384→    return [eid, ...rest];
   385→  }
   386→}
   387→
   388→export function retractTriple(
   389→  store: Store,
   390→  attrsStore: AttrsStore,
   391→  rawTriple: Triple,
   392→): void {
   393→  const triple = resolveLookupRefs(store, rawTriple);
   394→  if (!triple) {
   395→    return;
   396→  }
   397→  const [eid, aid, v] = triple;
   398→  const attr = attrsStore.getAttr(aid);
   399→  if (!attr) {
   400→    return;
   401→  }
   402→
   403→  deleteInMap(store.eav, [eid, aid, v]);
   404→  deleteInMap(store.aev, [aid, eid, v]);
   405→  if (isRef(attr)) {
   406→    deleteInMap(store.vae, [v, aid, eid]);
   407→  }
   408→}
   409→
   410→let _seed = 0;
   411→function getCreatedAt(
   412→  store: Store,
   413→  attr: InstantDBAttr,
   414→  triple: Triple,
   415→): Number {
   416→  const [eid, aid, v] = triple;
   417→  let createdAt;
   418→
   419→  const t = getInMap(store.eav, [eid, aid, v]);
   420→  if (t) {
   421→    createdAt = t[3];
   422→  }
   423→
   424→  /**
   425→   * (XXX)
   426→   * Two hacks here, for generating a `createdAt`
   427→   *
   428→   * 1. We multiply Date.now() by 10, to make sure that
   429→   *  `createdAt` is always greater than anything the server
   430→   *   could return
   431→   *
   432→   *   We do this because right now we know we _only_ insert
   433→   *   triples as optimistic updates.
   434→   *
   435→   * 2. We increment by `_seed`, to make sure there are no
   436→   *    two triples with the same `createdAt`. This is
   437→   *    done to make tests more predictable.
   438→   *
   439→   * We may need to rethink this. Because we * 10, we can't
   440→   * use this value as an _actual_ `createdAt` timestamp.
   441→   * Eventually we may want too though; For example, we could
   442→   * use `createdAt` for each triple, to infer a `createdAt` and
   443→   * `updatedAt` value for each object.
   444→   */
   445→  return createdAt || Date.now() * 10 + _seed++;
   446→}
   447→
   448→export function addTriple(
   449→  store: Store,
   450→  attrsStore: AttrsStore,
   451→  rawTriple: Triple,
   452→) {
   453→  const triple = resolveLookupRefs(store, rawTriple);
   454→  if (!triple) {
   455→    return;
   456→  }
   457→  let [eid, aid, v] = triple;
   458→  const attr = attrsStore.getAttr(aid);
   459→  if (!attr) {
   460→    // (XXX): Due to the way we're handling attrs, it's
   461→    // possible to enter a state where we receive a triple without an attr.
   462→    // See: https://github.com/jsventures/instant-local/pull/132 for details.
   463→    // For now, if we receive a command without an attr, we no-op.
   464→    return;
   465→  }
   466→
   467→  if (attr['checked-data-type'] === 'date' && store.useDateObjects) {
   468→    v = coerceToDate(v);
   469→  }
   470→
   471→  const existingTriple = getInMap(store.eav, [eid, aid, v]);
   472→  // Reuse the created_at for a triple if it's already in the store.
   473→  // Prevents updates from temporarily pushing an entity to the top
   474→  // while waiting for the server response.
   475→  const t = existingTriple?.[3] ?? getCreatedAt(store, attr, triple);
   476→  const enhancedTriple = [eid, aid, v, t];
   477→
   478→  if (hasEA(attr)) {
   479→    setInMap(store.eav, [eid, aid], new Map([[v, enhancedTriple]]));
   480→    setInMap(store.aev, [aid, eid], new Map([[v, enhancedTriple]]));
   481→  } else {
   482→    setInMap(store.eav, [eid, aid, v], enhancedTriple);
   483→    setInMap(store.aev, [aid, eid, v], enhancedTriple);
   484→  }
   485→
   486→  if (isRef(attr)) {
   487→    setInMap(store.vae, [v, aid, eid], enhancedTriple);
   488→  }
   489→}
   490→
   491→function mergeTriple(store: Store, attrsStore: AttrsStore, rawTriple: Triple) {
   492→  const triple = resolveLookupRefs(store, rawTriple);
   493→  if (!triple) {
   494→    return;
   495→  }
   496→
   497→  const [eid, aid, update] = triple;
   498→  const attr = attrsStore.getAttr(aid);
   499→
   500→  if (!attr) return;
   501→
   502→  if (!isBlob(attr))
   503→    throw new Error('merge operation is not supported for links');
   504→
   505→  const eavValuesMap = getInMap(store.eav, [eid, aid]);
   506→  if (!eavValuesMap) return;
   507→
   508→  const currentTriple = eavValuesMap.values().next()?.value;
   509→  if (!currentTriple) return;
   510→
   511→  const currentValue = currentTriple[2];
   512→
   513→  const updatedValue = immutableDeepMerge(currentValue, update);
   514→  const enhancedTriple = [
   515→    eid,
   516→    aid,
   517→    updatedValue,
   518→    getCreatedAt(store, attr, currentTriple),
   519→  ];
   520→
   521→  setInMap(store.eav, [eid, aid], new Map([[updatedValue, enhancedTriple]]));
   522→  setInMap(store.aev, [aid, eid], new Map([[updatedValue, enhancedTriple]]));
   523→}
   524→
   525→function deleteEntity(store: Store, attrsStore: AttrsStore, args: any[]) {
   526→  const [lookup, etype] = args;
   527→  const triple = resolveLookupRefs(store, [lookup] as unknown as Triple);
   528→
   529→  if (!triple) {
   530→    return;
   531→  }
   532→  const [id] = triple;
   533→
   534→  // delete forward links and attributes + cardinality one links
   535→  const eMap = store.eav.get(id);
   536→  if (eMap) {
   537→    for (const a of eMap.keys()) {
   538→      const attr = attrsStore.getAttr(a);
   539→
   540→      // delete cascade refs
   541→      if (attr && attr['on-delete-reverse'] === 'cascade') {
   542→        allMapValues(eMap.get(a), 1).forEach(
   543→          ([e, a, v]: [string, string, any]) =>
   544→            deleteEntity(store, attrsStore, [v, attr['reverse-identity']?.[1]]),
   545→        );
   546→      }
   547→
   548→      if (
   549→        // Fall back to deleting everything if we've rehydrated tx-steps from
   550→        // the store that didn't set `etype` in deleteEntity
   551→        !etype ||
   552→        // If we don't know about the attr, let's just get rid of it
   553→        !attr ||
   554→        // Make sure it matches the etype
   555→        attr['forward-identity']?.[1] === etype
   556→      ) {
   557→        deleteInMap(store.aev, [a, id]);
   558→        deleteInMap(store.eav, [id, a]);
   559→      }
   560→    }
   561→    // Clear out the eav index for `id` if we deleted all of the attributes
   562→    if (eMap.size === 0) {
   563→      deleteInMap(store.eav, [id]);
   564→    }
   565→  }
   566→
   567→  // delete reverse links
   568→  const vaeTriples = store.vae.get(id) && allMapValues(store.vae.get(id), 2);
   569→
   570→  if (vaeTriples) {
   571→    vaeTriples.forEach((triple: Triple) => {
   572→      const [e, a, v] = triple;
   573→      const attr = attrsStore.getAttr(a);
   574→      if (!etype || !attr || attr['reverse-identity']?.[1] === etype) {
   575→        deleteInMap(store.eav, [e, a, v]);
   576→        deleteInMap(store.aev, [a, e, v]);
   577→        deleteInMap(store.vae, [v, a, e]);
   578→      }
   579→      if (
   580→        attr &&
   581→        attr['on-delete'] === 'cascade' &&
   582→        attr['reverse-identity']?.[1] === etype
   583→      ) {
   584→        deleteEntity(store, attrsStore, [e, attr['forward-identity']?.[1]]);
   585→      }
   586→    });
   587→  }
   588→  // Clear out vae index for `id` if we deleted all the reverse attributes
   589→  if (store.vae.get(id)?.size === 0) {
   590→    deleteInMap(store.vae, [id]);
   591→  }
   592→}
   593→
   594→// (XXX): Whenever we change/delete attrs,
   595→// We indiscriminately reset the index map.
   596→// There are lots of opportunities for optimization:
   597→// * We _only_ need to run this indexes change. We could detect that
   598→// * We could batch this reset at the end
   599→// * We could add an ave index for all triples, so removing the
   600→//   right triples is easy and fast.
   601→function resetIndexMap(store: Store, attrsStore, newTriples: Triple[]) {
   602→  const newIndexMap = createTripleIndexes(
   603→    attrsStore,
   604→    newTriples,
   605→    store.useDateObjects,
   606→  );
   607→  Object.keys(newIndexMap).forEach((key) => {
   608→    store[key] = newIndexMap[key];
   609→  });
   610→}
   611→
   612→function addAttr(attrsStore: AttrsStore, [attr]: [InstantDBAttr]) {
   613→  attrsStore.addAttr(attr);
   614→}
   615→
   616→function getAllTriples(store: Store): Triple[] {
   617→  return allMapValues(store.eav, 3);
   618→}
   619→
   620→function deleteAttr(store: Store, attrsStore: AttrsStore, [id]: [string]) {
   621→  if (!attrsStore.getAttr(id)) return;
   622→  const newTriples = getAllTriples(store).filter(([_, aid]) => aid !== id);
   623→  attrsStore.deleteAttr(id);
   624→  resetIndexMap(store, attrsStore, newTriples);
   625→}
   626→
   627→function updateAttr(
   628→  store: Store,
   629→  attrsStore: AttrsStore,
   630→  [partialAttr]: [Partial<InstantDBAttr> & { id: string }],
   631→) {
   632→  const attr = attrsStore.getAttr(partialAttr.id);
   633→  if (!attr) return;
   634→  attrsStore.updateAttr(partialAttr);
   635→  resetIndexMap(store, attrsStore, getAllTriples(store));
   636→}
   637→
   638→function applyTxStep(store: Store, attrsStore: AttrsStore, txStep) {
   639→  const [action, ...args] = txStep;
   640→  switch (action) {
   641→    case 'add-triple':
   642→      addTriple(store, attrsStore, args);
   643→      break;
   644→    case 'deep-merge-triple':
   645→      mergeTriple(store, attrsStore, args);
   646→      break;
   647→    case 'retract-triple':
   648→      retractTriple(store, attrsStore, args);
   649→      break;
   650→    case 'delete-entity':
   651→      deleteEntity(store, attrsStore, args);
   652→      break;
   653→    case 'add-attr':
   654→      addAttr(attrsStore, args);
   655→      break;
   656→    case 'delete-attr':
   657→      deleteAttr(store, attrsStore, args);
   658→      break;
   659→    case 'update-attr':
   660→      updateAttr(store, attrsStore, args);
   661→      break;
   662→    case 'restore-attr':
   663→      break;
   664→    case 'rule-params':
   665→      break;
   666→    default:
   667→      throw new Error(`unhandled transaction action: ${action}`);
   668→  }
   669→}
   670→
   671→export function allMapValues(m, level, res: any[] = []) {
   672→  if (!m) {
   673→    return res;
   674→  }
   675→  if (level === 0) {
   676→    return res;
   677→  }
   678→  if (level === 1) {
   679→    for (const v of m.values()) {
   680→      res.push(v);
   681→    }
   682→    return res;
   683→  }
   684→  for (const v of m.values()) {
   685→    allMapValues(v, level - 1, res);
   686→  }
   687→
   688→  return res;
   689→}
   690→
   691→function triplesByValue(store: Store, m: Map<any, Triple>, v: any) {
   692→  const res: Triple[] = [];
   693→  if (v?.hasOwnProperty('$not')) {
   694→    for (const candidate of m.keys()) {
   695→      if (v.$not !== candidate) {
   696→        res.push(m.get(candidate) as Triple);
   697→      }
   698→    }
   699→    return res;
   700→  }
   701→
   702→  if (v?.hasOwnProperty('$isNull')) {
   703→    const { attrId, isNull, reverse } = v.$isNull;
   704→
   705→    if (reverse) {
   706→      for (const candidate of m.keys()) {
   707→        const vMap = store.vae.get(candidate);
   708→        const isValNull = !vMap || !vMap.get(attrId);
   709→        if (isNull ? isValNull : !isValNull) {
   710→          res.push(m.get(candidate) as Triple);
   711→        }
   712→      }
   713→    } else {
   714→      const aMap = store.aev.get(attrId);
   715→      for (const candidate of m.keys()) {
   716→        const isValNull =
   717→          !aMap || aMap.get(candidate)?.get(null) || !aMap.get(candidate);
   718→        if (isNull ? isValNull : !isValNull) {
   719→          res.push(m.get(candidate) as Triple);
   720→        }
   721→      }
   722→    }
   723→    return res;
   724→  }
   725→
   726→  if (v?.$comparator) {
   727→    // TODO: A sorted index would be nice here
   728→    return allMapValues(m, 1).filter(v.$op);
   729→  }
   730→
   731→  const values = v.in || v.$in || [v];
   732→
   733→  for (const value of values) {
   734→    const triple = m.get(value);
   735→    if (triple) {
   736→      res.push(triple);
   737→    }
   738→  }
   739→
   740→  return res;
   741→}
   742→
   743→// A poor man's pattern matching
   744→// Returns either eav, ea, ev, av, v, or ''
   745→function whichIdx(e, a, v): 'eav' | 'ea' | 'ev' | 'av' | 'e' | 'a' | 'v' | '' {
   746→  let res = '';
   747→  if (e !== undefined) {
   748→    res += 'e';
   749→  }
   750→  if (a !== undefined) {
   751→    res += 'a';
   752→  }
   753→  if (v !== undefined) {
   754→    res += 'v';
   755→  }
   756→  return res as 'eav' | 'ea' | 'ev' | 'av' | 'e' | 'a' | 'v' | '';
   757→}
   758→
   759→export function getTriples(store, [e, a, v]) {
   760→  const idx = whichIdx(e, a, v);
   761→  switch (idx) {
   762→    case 'e': {
   763→      const eMap = store.eav.get(e);
   764→      return allMapValues(eMap, 2);
   765→    }
   766→    case 'ea': {
   767→      const aMap = store.eav.get(e)?.get(a);
   768→      return allMapValues(aMap, 1);
   769→    }
   770→    case 'eav': {
   771→      const aMap = store.eav.get(e)?.get(a);
   772→      if (!aMap) {
   773→        return [];
   774→      }
   775→      return triplesByValue(store, aMap, v);
   776→    }
   777→    case 'ev': {
   778→      const eMap = store.eav.get(e);
   779→      if (!eMap) {
   780→        return [];
   781→      }
   782→      const res: Triple[] = [];
   783→      for (const aMap of eMap.values()) {
   784→        res.push(...triplesByValue(store, aMap, v));
   785→      }
   786→      return res;
   787→    }
   788→    case 'a': {
   789→      const aMap = store.aev.get(a);
   790→      return allMapValues(aMap, 2);
   791→    }
   792→    case 'av': {
   793→      const aMap = store.aev.get(a);
   794→      if (!aMap) {
   795→        return [];
   796→      }
   797→      const res: Triple[] = [];
   798→      for (const eMap of aMap.values()) {
   799→        res.push(...triplesByValue(store, eMap, v));
   800→      }
   801→      return res;
   802→    }
   803→    case 'v': {
   804→      const res: Triple[] = [];
   805→      for (const eMap of store.eav.values()) {
   806→        for (const aMap of eMap.values()) {
   807→          res.push(...triplesByValue(store, aMap, v));
   808→        }
   809→      }
   810→      return res;
   811→    }
   812→    default: {
   813→      return allMapValues(store.eav, 3);
   814→    }
   815→  }
   816→}
   817→
   818→export function getAsObject(
   819→  store: Store,
   820→  attrs: Map<string, InstantDBAttr> | undefined,
   821→  e: string,
   822→) {
   823→  const obj = {};
   824→
   825→  if (!attrs) {
   826→    return obj;
   827→  }
   828→
   829→  for (const [label, attr] of attrs.entries()) {
   830→    const aMap = store.eav.get(e)?.get(attr.id);
   831→    const triples = allMapValues(aMap, 1);
   832→    for (const triple of triples) {
   833→      obj[label] = triple[2];
   834→    }
   835→  }
   836→
   837→  return obj;
   838→}
   839→
   840→export function getAttrByFwdIdentName(
   841→  attrsStore: AttrsStore,
   842→  inputEtype: string,
   843→  inputLabel: string,
   844→) {
   845→  return attrsStore.forwardIdents.get(inputEtype)?.get(inputLabel);
   846→}
   847→
   848→export function getAttrByReverseIdentName(
   849→  attrsStore: AttrsStore,
   850→  inputEtype: string,
   851→  inputLabel: string,
   852→) {
   853→  return attrsStore.revIdents.get(inputEtype)?.get(inputLabel);
   854→}
   855→
   856→export function getBlobAttrs(attrsStore: AttrsStore, etype: string) {
   857→  return attrsStore.blobAttrs.get(etype);
   858→}
   859→
   860→export function getPrimaryKeyAttr(attrsStore: AttrsStore, etype: string) {
   861→  const fromPrimary = attrsStore.primaryKeys.get(etype);
   862→  if (fromPrimary) {
   863→    return fromPrimary;
   864→  }
   865→  return attrsStore.forwardIdents.get(etype)?.get('id');
   866→}
   867→
   868→function findTriple(
   869→  store: Store,
   870→  attrsStore: AttrsStore,
   871→  rawTriple: [string, string, any] | Triple,
   872→): Triple | undefined {
   873→  const triple = resolveLookupRefs(store, rawTriple as Triple);
   874→  if (!triple) {
   875→    return;
   876→  }
   877→
   878→  const [eid, aid, v] = triple;
   879→  const attr = attrsStore.getAttr(aid);

   891→export function transact(
   892→  store: Store,
   893→  attrsStore: AttrsStore,
   894→  txSteps,
   895→): { store: Store; attrsStore: AttrsStore } {
   896→  const txStepsFiltered = txSteps.filter(
   897→    ([action, eid, attrId, value, opts]) => {
   898→      if (action !== 'add-triple' && action !== 'deep-merge-triple') {
   899→        return true;
   900→      }
   901→
   902→      const mode = opts?.mode;
   903→      if (mode !== 'create' && mode !== 'update') {
   904→        return true;
   905→      }

   907→      let exists = false;
   908→
   909→      const attr = attrsStore.getAttr(attrId);
   910→      if (attr) {
   911→        const idAttr = getPrimaryKeyAttr(
   912→          attrsStore,
   913→          attr['forward-identity'][1],
   914→        );

   916→          eid as string,
   917→          idAttr?.id as string,
   918→          eid,
   919→        ]);
   920→      }

   922→      if (mode === 'create' && exists) {
   923→        return false;
   924→      }
   925→
   926→      if (mode === 'update' && !exists) {
   927→        return false;
   928→      }
   929→
   930→      return true;
   931→    },
   932→  );
   933→
   934→  return create(
   935→    { store, attrsStore },
   936→    (draft) => {
   937→      txStepsFiltered.forEach((txStep) => {
   938→        applyTxStep(draft.store, draft.attrsStore, txStep);
   939→      });
   940→    },
   941→    {
   942→      mark: (target) => {
   943→        if (target instanceof AttrsStoreClass) {
   944→          return 'immutable';
   945→        }
   946→      },
   947→    },
   948→  );
   949→}

### 1. `_cleanupPendingMutationsQueries()` - Lines 1461-1476

```javascript
/**
 * Clean up pendingMutations that all queries have seen
 */
_cleanupPendingMutationsQueries() {
  let minProcessedTxId = Number.MAX_SAFE_INTEGER;
  for (const { result } of Object.values(this.querySubs.currentValue)) {
    if (result?.processedTxId) {
      minProcessedTxId = Math.min(minProcessedTxId, result?.processedTxId);
    }
  }

  this._updatePendingMutations((prev) => {
    for (const [eventId, mut] of Array.from(prev.entries())) {
      if (mut['tx-id'] && mut['tx-id'] <= minProcessedTxId) {
        prev.delete(eventId);
      }
    }
  });
}
```

**Algorithm Explanation:**

1. **Find Minimum Processed Transaction ID**: Iterates through all query subscriptions (`querySubs.currentValue`) to find the minimum `processedTxId` across all queries. This represents the "slowest" query - the one that has processed the fewest server confirmations.

2. **Cleanup Logic**: A pending mutation can be safely removed when:
   - It has a `tx-id` (meaning the server has confirmed it via `transact-ok`)
   - Its `tx-id` is less than or equal to the minimum `processedTxId` (meaning ALL queries have seen this mutation's effects)

3. **Why This Works**: Each query result comes with a `processedTxId` indicating which transactions the server has processed when computing that result. Once all queries have a `processedTxId` >= a mutation's `tx-id`, the optimistic update is no longer needed because the server's results already include it.

**Helper Methods Called:**
- `_updatePendingMutations(f)` - Lines 821-827 - Wrapper that updates `pendingMutations` in the `kv` store

**Data Structures:**
- `querySubs.currentValue`: `Record<string, QuerySub>` where `QuerySub.result.processedTxId` is a number
- `pendingMutations`: `Map<string, Mutation>` where `Mutation['tx-id']` is optional number

### 2. `_cleanupPendingMutationsTimeout()` - Lines 1483-1500

/**
 * After mutations is confirmed by server, we give each query 30 sec
 * to update its results. If that doesn't happen, we assume query is
 * unaffected by this mutation and it's safe to delete it from local queue
 */
_cleanupPendingMutationsTimeout() {
  if (this._pendingMutations().size < this._pendingMutationCleanupThreshold) {
    return;
  }

  const now = Date.now();

  this._updatePendingMutations((prev) => {
    for (const [eventId, mut] of Array.from(prev.entries())) {
      if (
        mut.confirmed &&
        mut.confirmed + this._pendingTxCleanupTimeout < now
      ) {
        prev.delete(eventId);
      }
    }
  });
}

**Algorithm Explanation:**

1. **Threshold Check**: Only runs cleanup if `pendingMutations.size >= _pendingMutationCleanupThreshold` (default: 200, from line 52). This is a performance optimization to avoid unnecessary iteration.

2. **Time-Based Cleanup**: For each mutation that has a `confirmed` timestamp (set when server sends `transact-ok`), check if `(now - confirmed) > _pendingTxCleanupTimeout` (default: 30,000ms from line 51).

3. **Rationale**: If a mutation was confirmed 30+ seconds ago but queries still haven't reflected it via `_cleanupPendingMutationsQueries()`, the mutation probably doesn't affect any active queries, so it's safe to remove.

### 4. `dataForQuery()` - Lines 1224-1261

```javascript
/** Runs instaql on a query and a store */
dataForQuery(hash) {
  const errorMessage = this._errorMessage;
  if (errorMessage) {
    return { error: errorMessage };
  }
  if (!this.querySubs) return;
  if (!this.kv.currentValue.pendingMutations) return;
  const querySubVersion = this.querySubs.version();
  const querySubs = this.querySubs.currentValue;
  const pendingMutationsVersion = this.kv.version();
  const pendingMutations = this._pendingMutations();

  const { q, result } = querySubs[hash] || {};
  if (!result) return;

  const cached = this._dataForQueryCache[hash];
  if (
    cached &&
    querySubVersion === cached.querySubVersion &&
    pendingMutationsVersion === cached.pendingMutationsVersion
  ) {
    return cached;
  }

  const { store, attrsStore, pageInfo, aggregate, processedTxId } = result;
  const mutations = this._rewriteMutationsSorted(
    attrsStore,
    pendingMutations,
  );
  const { store: newStore, attrsStore: newAttrsStore } =
    this._applyOptimisticUpdates(store, attrsStore, mutations, processedTxId);
  const resp = instaql(
    { store: newStore, attrsStore: newAttrsStore, pageInfo, aggregate },
    q,
  );

  return { data: resp, querySubVersion, pendingMutationsVersion };
}
```

**Algorithm Explanation:**

1. **Error Check**: If there's a global error message (e.g., authentication failure), return error immediately.

2. **Early Returns**: Return undefined if `querySubs` or `pendingMutations` aren't loaded yet.

3. **Version-Based Caching**:
   - Get current versions from `querySubs.version()` and `kv.version()`
   - Check if cached result exists with matching versions
   - If versions match, return cached result (no recomputation needed)

4. **Recomputation** (if cache miss):
   - Extract `store`, `attrsStore`, `pageInfo`, `aggregate`, `processedTxId` from the query result
   - Rewrite mutations to fix attribute IDs: `_rewriteMutationsSorted()`
   - Apply optimistic updates: `_applyOptimisticUpdates()`
   - Run InstaQL query on the optimistically-updated store

5. **Return Value**: `{ data: resp, querySubVersion, pendingMutationsVersion }`

**Cache Structure (`_dataForQueryCache`):**
```javascript
{
  [hash: string]: {
    data: any,                    // The InstaQL query result
    querySubVersion: number,      // Version when this was computed
    pendingMutationsVersion: number

}

### 5. `_applyOptimisticUpdates()` - Lines 1263-1272

```javascript
_applyOptimisticUpdates(store, attrsStore, mutations, processedTxId) {
  for (const [_, mut] of mutations) {
    if (!mut['tx-id'] || (processedTxId && mut['tx-id'] > processedTxId)) {
      const result = s.transact(store, attrsStore, mut['tx-steps']);
      store = result.store;
      attrsStore = result.attrsStore;
    }
  }
  return { store, attrsStore };
}
```

**Algorithm Explanation:**

1. **Iterate Through Mutations** (in sorted order by `order` field)

2. **Apply Mutation If**:
   - `!mut['tx-id']`: Mutation hasn't been confirmed by server yet (still optimistic), OR
   - `processedTxId && mut['tx-id'] > processedTxId`: Mutation was confirmed but this query result hasn't processed it yet

3. **Apply Transaction**: Call `s.transact(store, attrsStore, mut['tx-steps'])` which returns a new store with the mutation applied

4. **Immutable Update Pattern**: Each iteration creates new `store` and `attrsStore` objects

**Logic for `processedTxId`:**
- When server sends query results, it includes `processedTxId` indicating which transactions are reflected
- If a mutation's `tx-id > processedTxId`, the query result doesn't include that mutation's effects yet
- So we need to apply it optimistically to show the user their changes

**Example Scenario:**
```
Mutation A: tx-id = 100 (confirmed)
Mutation B: tx-id = 105 (confirmed)  
Mutation C: tx-id = null (not confirmed yet)
Query Result: processedTxId = 102

Applied optimistically: B (105 > 102) and C (no tx-id)
Not applied: A (100 <= 102, already in server result)
```

**Helper Method - `s.transact()`** (from `store.ts`):
Applies transaction steps (`add-triple`, `retract-triple`, `add-attr`, etc.) to a store.

/**
 * @param {*} txSteps
 * @param {*} [error]
 * @returns
 */
pushOps = (txSteps, error) => {
  const eventId = uuid();
  const mutations = [...this._pendingMutations().values()];
  const order = Math.max(0, ...mutations.map((mut) => mut.order || 0)) + 1;
  const mutation = {
    op: 'transact',
    'tx-steps': txSteps,
    created: Date.now(),
    error,
    order,
  };
  this._updatePendingMutations((prev) => {
    prev.set(eventId, mutation);
  });

  this.mutationDeferredStore.set(eventId, dfd);
  this._sendMutation(eventId, mutation);

  this.notifyAll();

  return dfd.promise;
};
```

**Algorithm Explanation:**

1. **Generate Event ID**: Create unique ID using `uuid()`

2. **Calculate Order**: Find max order among existing mutations, add 1. This ensures mutations are applied in the order they were created.
   ```javascript

   ```

3. **Create Mutation Object**:

     op: 'transact',
     'tx-steps': txSteps,    // The actual operations
     created: Date.now(),    // Timestamp for debugging
     error: error,           // If transformation failed
     order: order            // For sorting
   }

4. **Store Mutation**: Add to `pendingMutations` Map via `_updatePendingMutations()`

5. **Create Deferred Promise**: Store in `mutationDeferredStore` so it can be resolved/rejected later

6. **Send to Server**: Call `_sendMutation(eventId, mutation)`

7. **Notify All Queries**: Call `notifyAll()` so all queries recompute with the new optimistic update

8. **Return Promise**: The promise resolves when server confirms (`transact-ok`) or rejects on error/timeout

**Helper Method - `_sendMutation()` (Lines 1385-1422):**

_sendMutation(eventId, mutation) {
  if (mutation.error) {
    this._handleMutationError('error', eventId, {
      message: mutation.error.message,
    });
    return;
  }
  if (this.status !== STATUS.AUTHENTICATED) {
    this._finishTransaction('enqueued', eventId);
    return;
  }
  const timeoutMs = Math.max(
    6000,
    Math.min(
      this._inFlightMutationEventIds.size + 1,
      this._pendingMutations().size + 1,
    ) * 6000,
  );

  if (!this._isOnline) {
    this._finishTransaction('enqueued', eventId);
  } else {
    this._trySend(eventId, mutation);

    setTimeout(() => {
      if (!this._isOnline) {
        return;
      }
      this._handleMutationError('timeout', eventId, {
        message: 'transaction timed out',
      });
    }, timeoutMs);
  }
}
```

**Mutation Lifecycle:**

1. **Created**: `pushOps()` creates mutation, adds to `pendingMutations`
2. **Sent**: `_sendMutation()` sends to server if authenticated
3. **Enqueued**: If not authenticated/online, marked as enqueued
4. **In-Flight**: Added to `_inFlightMutationEventIds` Set
5. **Confirmed**: Server sends `transact-ok`, mutation gets `tx-id` and `confirmed` timestamp
6. **Cleaned Up**: Eventually removed by `_cleanupPendingMutationsQueries()` or `_cleanupPendingMutationsTimeout()`

**Data Structures Involved:**
- `pendingMutations`: `Map<eventId, Mutation>` - Persisted in IndexedDB
- `mutationDeferredStore`: `Map<eventId, Deferred>` - In-memory promises
- `_inFlightMutationEventIds`: `Set<eventId>` - Mutations sent but not yet confirmed

### `sortedMutationEntries()` - Lines 189-200
```javascript
function sortedMutationEntries(entries) {
  return [...entries].sort((a, b) => {
    const [ka, muta] = a;
    const [kb, mutb] = b;
    const a_order = muta.order || 0;
    const b_order = mutb.order || 0;
    if (a_order == b_order) {
      return ka < kb ? -1 : ka > kb ? 1 : 0;
    }
    return a_order - b_order;
  });
}
```

### `_finishTransaction()` - Lines 471-505
```javascript
/**
 * @param {'enqueued' | 'pending' | 'synced' | 'timeout' |  'error' } status
 * @param {string} eventId
 * @param {{message?: string, type?: string, status?: number, hint?: unknown}} [errorMsg]
 */
_finishTransaction(status, eventId, errorMsg) {
  const dfd = this.mutationDeferredStore.get(eventId);
  this.mutationDeferredStore.delete(eventId);
  const ok = status !== 'error' && status !== 'timeout';

  if (!dfd && !ok) {
    console.error('Mutation failed', { status, eventId, ...errorMsg });
  }
  if (!dfd) {
    return;
  }
  if (ok) {
    dfd.resolve({ status, eventId });
  } else {
    if (errorMsg?.type) {
      const { status, ...body } = errorMsg;
      dfd.reject(
        new InstantAPIError({
          body,
          status: status ?? 0,
        }),
      );
    } else {
      dfd.reject(
        new InstantError(
          errorMsg?.message || 'Unknown error',
          errorMsg?.hint,
        ),
      );
    }
  }
}
```

function createTripleIndexes(
  attrsStore: AttrsStore,
  triples: Triple[],
  useDateObjects: boolean | null | undefined,
): Pick<Store, 'eav' | 'aev' | 'vae'> {
  const eav = new Map();
  const aev = new Map();
  const vae = new Map();
  for (const triple of triples) {
    let [eid, aid, v] = triple;
    const attr = attrsStore.getAttr(aid);
    if (!attr) {
      console.warn('no such attr', aid, eid);
      continue;
    }

    if (attr['checked-data-type'] === 'date' && useDateObjects) {
      v = coerceToDate(v);
      triple[2] = v;
    }

    if (isRef(attr)) {
      setInMap(vae, [v, aid, eid], triple);
    }

    setInMap(eav, [eid, aid, v], triple);
    setInMap(aev, [aid, eid, v], triple);
  }
  return { eav, aev, vae };
}
```

### setInMap Helper (Lines 198-214)

```typescript
function setInMap(m: Map<any, any>, path: any[], value: any) {
  let current = m;
  const lastI = path.length - 1;
  for (let i = 0; i < lastI; i++) {
    const part = path[i];

    let nextMap = current.get(part);
    if (nextMap === undefined) {
      nextMap = new Map();
      current.set(part, nextMap);
    }
    current = nextMap;
  }
  if (lastI > -1) {
    current.set(path[lastI], value);
  }
}
```

**Algorithm:** Traverses nested maps, creating intermediate maps as needed, then sets the final value at the leaf.

## 2. transact() - How Store is Modified

```typescript
export function transact(
  store: Store,
  attrsStore: AttrsStore,
  txSteps,
): { store: Store; attrsStore: AttrsStore } {
  const txStepsFiltered = txSteps.filter(
    ([action, eid, attrId, value, opts]) => {
      if (action !== 'add-triple' && action !== 'deep-merge-triple') {
        return true;
      }

      const mode = opts?.mode;
      if (mode !== 'create' && mode !== 'update') {
        return true;
      }

      let exists = false;

      const attr = attrsStore.getAttr(attrId);
      if (attr) {
        const idAttr = getPrimaryKeyAttr(
          attrsStore,
          attr['forward-identity'][1],
        );
        exists = !!findTriple(store, attrsStore, [
          eid as string,
          idAttr?.id as string,
          eid,
        ]);
      }

      if (mode === 'create' && exists) {
        return false;
      }

      if (mode === 'update' && !exists) {
        return false;
      }

      return true;
    },
  );

  return create(
    { store, attrsStore },
    (draft) => {
      txStepsFiltered.forEach((txStep) => {
        applyTxStep(draft.store, draft.attrsStore, txStep);
      });
    },
    {
      mark: (target) => {
        if (target instanceof AttrsStoreClass) {
          return 'immutable';
        }
      },
    },
  );
}
```

### Key Points About Immutability

1. **Uses `mutative` library's `create()` function** (imported line 1) - This is similar to Immer but faster
2. **Creates an immutable copy** - The `create()` function provides a draft that can be mutated, but returns a new immutable object

```typescript
function applyTxStep(store: Store, attrsStore: AttrsStore, txStep) {
  const [action, ...args] = txStep;
  switch (action) {
    case 'add-triple':
      addTriple(store, attrsStore, args);
      break;
    case 'deep-merge-triple':
      mergeTriple(store, attrsStore, args);
      break;
    case 'retract-triple':
      retractTriple(store, attrsStore, args);
      break;
    case 'delete-entity':
      deleteEntity(store, attrsStore, args);
      break;
    case 'add-attr':
      addAttr(attrsStore, args);
      break;
    case 'delete-attr':
      deleteAttr(store, attrsStore, args);
      break;
    case 'update-attr':
      updateAttr(store, attrsStore, args);
      break;
    case 'restore-attr':
      break;
    case 'rule-params':
      break;
    default:
      throw new Error(`unhandled transaction action: ${action}`);
  }
}

## 3. deleteEntity() - How Cascade Deletes Work

**File:** `/Users/mlustig/Development/personal/instantdb/instant/client/packages/core/src/store.ts`  
**Lines:** 525-592

```typescript
function deleteEntity(store: Store, attrsStore: AttrsStore, args: any[]) {
  const [lookup, etype] = args;
  const triple = resolveLookupRefs(store, [lookup] as unknown as Triple);

  if (!triple) {
    return;
  }
  const [id] = triple;

  // delete forward links and attributes + cardinality one links
  const eMap = store.eav.get(id);
  if (eMap) {
    for (const a of eMap.keys()) {
      const attr = attrsStore.getAttr(a);

      // delete cascade refs
      if (attr && attr['on-delete-reverse'] === 'cascade') {
        allMapValues(eMap.get(a), 1).forEach(
          ([e, a, v]: [string, string, any]) =>
            deleteEntity(store, attrsStore, [v, attr['reverse-identity']?.[1]]),
        );
      }

      if (
        // Fall back to deleting everything if we've rehydrated tx-steps from
        // the store that didn't set `etype` in deleteEntity
        !etype ||
        // If we don't know about the attr, let's just get rid of it
        !attr ||
        // Make sure it matches the etype
        attr['forward-identity']?.[1] === etype
      ) {
        deleteInMap(store.aev, [a, id]);
        deleteInMap(store.eav, [id, a]);
      }
    }
    // Clear out the eav index for `id` if we deleted all of the attributes
    if (eMap.size === 0) {
      deleteInMap(store.eav, [id]);
    }
  }

  // delete reverse links
  const vaeTriples = store.vae.get(id) && allMapValues(store.vae.get(id), 2);

  if (vaeTriples) {
    vaeTriples.forEach((triple: Triple) => {
      const [e, a, v] = triple;
      const attr = attrsStore.getAttr(a);
      if (!etype || !attr || attr['reverse-identity']?.[1] === etype) {
        deleteInMap(store.eav, [e, a, v]);
        deleteInMap(store.aev, [a, e, v]);
        deleteInMap(store.vae, [v, a, e]);
      }
      if (
        attr &&
        attr['on-delete'] === 'cascade' &&
        attr['reverse-identity']?.[1] === etype
      ) {
        deleteEntity(store, attrsStore, [e, attr['forward-identity']?.[1]]);
      }
    });
  }
  // Clear out vae index for `id` if we deleted all the reverse attributes
  if (store.vae.get(id)?.size === 0) {
    deleteInMap(store.vae, [id]);
  }
}
```

### Cascade Delete Algorithm

1. **Resolve lookup refs** - Convert lookup refs (like `['attr-id', 'value']`) to actual entity IDs
2. **Get the entity's attributes from EAV index** - `store.eav.get(id)`
3. **For each attribute:**
   - If `attr['on-delete-reverse'] === 'cascade'`: **Recursively delete** referenced entities (forward cascade)
   - Delete from `aev` index: `[attrId, entityId]`
   - Delete from `eav` index: `[entityId, attrId]`
4. **Get reverse references from VAE index** - Entities that link TO this entity
5. **For each reverse reference:**
   - Delete from all three indexes (`eav`, `aev`, `vae`)
   - If `attr['on-delete'] === 'cascade'`: **Recursively delete** the referencing entity (reverse cascade)
6. **Clean up empty parent maps** in indexes

### deleteInMap Helper (Lines 187-196)

```typescript
function deleteInMap(m, path) {
  if (path.length === 0) throw new Error('path must have at least one element');
  if (path.length === 1) {
    m.delete(path[0]);
    return;
  }
  const [head, ...tail] = path;
  if (!m.has(head)) return;
  deleteInMap(m.get(head), tail);
}
```

## 5. _gc() Method - Full Garbage Collection Algorithm

**File:** `/Users/mlustig/Development/personal/instantdb/instant/client/packages/core/src/utils/PersistedObject.ts`  
**Lines:** 350-472

```typescript
private async _gc() {
  if (!this._gcOpts) {
    return;
  }
  const keys = new Set(await this._persister.getAllKeys());
  keys.delete(META_KEY);

  // Keys we can't delete
  const sacredKeys = new Set(Object.keys(this.currentValue));
  for (const k of Object.keys(this._loadingKeys)) {
    sacredKeys.add(k);
  }
  for (const k of this._loadedKeys) {
    sacredKeys.add(k);
  }

  // Refresh meta from the store so that we're less likely to
  // clobber data from other tabs
  const meta = await this._refreshMeta();
  if (!meta) {
    this._log.info('Could not gc because we were not able to load meta');
    return;
  }

  const promises: Promise<any>[] = [];

  const deets = {
    gcOpts: this._gcOpts,
    keys,
    sacredKeys,
    removed: [] as string[],
    metaRemoved: [],
    removedMissingCount: 0,
    removedOldCount: 0,
    removedThresholdCount: 0,
    removedSizeCount: 0,
  };

  // First, remove all keys we don't know about
  for (const key of keys) {
    if (sacredKeys.has(key) || key in meta.objects) {
      continue;
    }
    this._log.info('Lost track of key in meta', key);
    promises.push(this._persister.removeItem(key));
    deets.removed.push(key);
    deets.removedMissingCount++;
  }

  // Remove anything over the max age
  const now = Date.now();
  for (const [k, m] of Object.entries(meta.objects)) {
    if (
      !sacredKeys.has(k) &&
      (m as ObjectMeta).updatedAt < now - this._gcOpts.maxAgeMs
    ) {
      promises.push(this._persister.removeItem(k));
      delete meta.objects[k];
      deets.removed.push(k);
      deets.removedOldCount++;
    }
  }

  // Keep queries under max queries
  const maxEntries = Object.entries(meta.objects) as Array<[K, ObjectMeta]>;
  maxEntries.sort(([_k_a, a_meta], [_k_b, b_meta]) => {
    return a_meta.updatedAt - b_meta.updatedAt;
  });

  const deletableMaxEntries = maxEntries.filter(([x]) => !sacredKeys.has(x));
  if (maxEntries.length > this._gcOpts.maxEntries) {
    for (const [k] of deletableMaxEntries.slice(
      0,
      maxEntries.length - this._gcOpts.maxEntries,
    )) {
      promises.push(this._persister.removeItem(k));
      delete meta.objects[k];
      deets.removed.push(k);
      deets.removedThresholdCount++;
    }
  }

  // Remove oldest entries until we are under max size
  const delEntries = Object.entries(meta.objects) as Array<[K, ObjectMeta]>;
  delEntries.sort(([_k_a, a_meta], [_k_b, b_meta]) => {
    return a_meta.updatedAt - b_meta.updatedAt;
  });
  const deletableDelEntries = delEntries.filter(([x]) => !sacredKeys.has(x));

  let currentSize = delEntries.reduce((acc, [_k, m]) => {
    return acc + m.size;
  }, 0);

  while (
    currentSize > 0 &&
    currentSize > this._gcOpts.maxSize &&
    deletableDelEntries.length
  ) {
    const [[k, m]] = deletableDelEntries.splice(0, 1);
    currentSize -= m.size;
    promises.push(this._persister.removeItem(k));
    delete meta.objects[k];
    deets.removed.push(k);
    deets.removedSizeCount++;
  }

  // Update meta to remove keys that are no longer in the store
  for (const k of Object.keys(meta.objects)) {
    if (!keys.has(k) && !sacredKeys.has(k)) {
      delete meta.objects[k];
    }
  }

  if (deets.removed.length || deets.metaRemoved.length) {
    // Trigger a flush of the meta
    promises.push(this._enqueuePersist({ skipGc: true }));
  }

  this._log.info('Completed GC', deets);

  await Promise.all(promises);
  return deets;
}
```

### GC Algorithm Summary (4 Phases)

| Phase | Lines | Description | Eviction Policy |
|-------|-------|-------------|-----------------|
| **1. Orphan Cleanup** | 389-397 | Remove keys in storage but not in meta | Immediate delete |
| **2. Age-Based** | 400-410 | Remove entries older than `maxAgeMs` | `updatedAt < now - maxAgeMs` |
| **3. Entry Count** | 413-429 | Enforce `maxEntries` limit | LRU (oldest `updatedAt` first) |
| **4. Size-Based** | 432-454 | Enforce `maxSize` limit | LRU (oldest `updatedAt` first) |

### GC Scheduling (Lines 475-489)

```typescript
gc() {
  if (this._nextGc) {
    return;
  }
  this._nextGc = setTimeout(
    () => {
      safeIdleCallback(() => {
        this._nextGc = null;
        this._gc();
      }, 30 * 1000);
    },
    // 1 minute + some jitter to keep multiple tabs from running at same time
    1000 * 60 + Math.random() * 500,
  );
}
```

GC is scheduled:
- **Delay:** 1 minute + random jitter (0-500ms)
- **Idle callback timeout:** 30 seconds
- **Deduplication:** Only one GC can be scheduled at a time

## 6. unloadKey() - How Query Data is Evicted

**File:** `/Users/mlustig/Development/personal/instantdb/instant/client/packages/core/src/utils/PersistedObject.ts`  
**Lines:** 215-219

```typescript
// Unloads the key so that it can be garbage collected, but does not
// delete it. Removes the key from currentValue.
public unloadKey(k: K) {
  this._loadedKeys.delete(k);
  delete this._loadingKeys[k];
  delete this.currentValue[k];
}
```

### Data Structures Affected

| Data Structure | Operation | Purpose |
|----------------|-----------|---------|
| `_loadedKeys: Set<K>` | `.delete(k)` | Mark as no longer loaded (can be loaded again) |
| `_loadingKeys: Record<K, Promise<T>>` | `delete` | Cancel any pending load |
| `currentValue: Record<K, T>` | `delete` | Free the in-memory data |

### Key Difference from Delete

- **unloadKey:** Data remains in persistent storage, just freed from memory
- **delete (via GC):** Data is removed from persistent storage via `_persister.removeItem()`

### Version Increment in updateInPlace (Lines 517-538)

```typescript
public updateInPlace(f: (prev: Record<string, T>) => void) {
  this._version++;  // <-- INCREMENT ON EVERY UPDATE
  const [state, patches] = create(this.currentValue, f, {
    enablePatches: true,
  });
  for (const patch of patches) {
    const k = patch.path[0];
    if (k && typeof k === 'string') {
      this._pendingSaveKeys.add(k as K);
      if (!this._loadedKeys.has(k as K)) {
        this._loadKey(k as K);
      }
    }
  }

  this.currentValue = state;
  this._enqueuePersist();
  for (const cb of this._subs) {
    cb(this.currentValue);
  }
  return state;
}
```

### How Version is Used for Cache Invalidation

1. **Version increments on every `updateInPlace()` call**
2. **External code can call `version()`** to check if data has changed
3. **Pattern:** Compare previous version with current version to detect changes:

```typescript
// Example usage pattern (not in this file):
const prevVersion = persistedObject.version();
// ... some operation ...
if (persistedObject.version() !== prevVersion) {
  // Cache is stale, re-fetch
}
```

### Subscription System (Lines 540-547)

```typescript
public subscribe(cb: (value: Record<K, T>) => void) {
  this._subs.push(cb);
  cb(this.currentValue);

  return () => {
    this._subs = this._subs.filter((x) => x !== cb);
  };
}
```

Subscribers are notified on every `updateInPlace()` call after the version increment.

## Summary for Swift Implementation

### Key Data Structures to Implement

1. **Store Indexes:**
   - `eav: [EntityID: [AttrID: [Value: Triple]]]` - 3-level nested dictionary
   - `aev: [AttrID: [EntityID: [Value: Triple]]]` - 3-level nested dictionary  
   - `vae: [Value: [AttrID: [EntityID: Triple]]]` - 3-level nested dictionary (refs only)

2. **PersistedObject State:**
   - `currentValue: [Key: Value]` - Active in-memory data
   - `_loadedKeys: Set<Key>` - Keys that have been loaded
   - `_loadingKeys: [Key: Task<Value>]` - Keys currently loading
   - `_pendingSaveKeys: Set<Key>` - Keys waiting to be persisted
   - `_version: Int` - Monotonic counter for cache invalidation

3. **Meta Structure:**
   - `objects: [Key: ObjectMeta]` where `ObjectMeta = {createdAt, updatedAt, size}`

### Key Algorithms to Implement

1. **transact():** Use copy-on-write semantics (Swift's value types help here)
2. **deleteEntity():** Recursive cascade with forward (`on-delete-reverse`) and reverse (`on-delete`) cascades
3. **_gc():** 4-phase eviction: orphans -> age -> entry count -> size

public actor Reactor {
  // public static let shared = Reactor() // Removed for DI


  private let store: SharedTripleStore
  private let clientInstanceID: String
  private var activeSubscriptions: [UUID: SubscriptionHandle] = [:]

  /// Tracks whether we've restored pending mutations from SQLite.
  ///
  /// ## Why This Exists
  /// When the app restarts, pending mutations (optimistic updates that haven't been
  /// confirmed by the server) are persisted in SQLite but not in the in-memory
  /// SharedTripleStore. Without restoring them, the UI would show stale data until
  /// the server confirms the mutations (which requires network connectivity).
  ///
  /// This flag ensures we only restore once per app launch to avoid duplicate
  /// application of the same mutations.
  private var hasRestoredPendingMutations: Bool = false

  public init(store: SharedTripleStore, clientInstanceID: String = "default") {
    self.store = store
    self.clientInstanceID = clientInstanceID
  }

                        let isNowAuthenticated = (newState == .authenticated)

                        // Trigger re-query when becoming authenticated
                        if wasNotAuthenticated && isNowAuthenticated {
                            Task {
                                await subscriptionState?.handleStoreUpdate()
                            }
                        }

                        previousState = newState
                    }
            }
            connectionCancellableBox.pointee = connectionSubscription

            // Periodic health check interval (5 seconds)
            let healthCheckIntervalNs: UInt64 = 5_000_000_000

            // Wait for cancellation, with periodic health checks
            while !Task.isCancelled {
                try? await Task.sleep(nanoseconds: healthCheckIntervalNs)

                let currentState = await MainActor.run { client.connectionState }
                if case .disconnected = currentState {
                    await MainActor.run { client.connect() }
                } else if case .error = currentState {
                    await MainActor.run { client.connect() }
                }
            }

            // When cancelled, cleanup
            connectionCancellableBox.pointee?.cancel()
            // ... cleanup code
            await self.removeSubscriptionHandle(id: handleId)
            await subscriptionState.cleanup()
        }
    }
    
    // Ensure token is kept alive
    if let token = token {
        _ = "Token kept alive: \(token)"
    }
  }
```

**Current Limitations vs TypeScript:**
- **No query hashing/deduplication**: TypeScript uses `weakHash(q)` to dedupe identical queries
- **No `isLoading` emission**: TypeScript emits loading states
- **No error emission through stream**: Errors are logged but not propagated
- **No cursor/pagination support**: TypeScript supports `startCursor`, `endCursor`
- **No `aggregate` queries**: TypeScript supports count/sum/avg aggregations
- **Unsafe pointer usage**: Uses `UnsafeMutablePointer` for continuation management (fragile)

## 4. applyOptimisticUpdate() (Lines 681-761)

```swift
  private func applyOptimisticUpdate(chunks: [TransactionChunk]) async {
    let timestamp = ConflictResolution.optimisticTimestamp()

    // Track affected entities for targeted notifications
    var affectedNamespaces: Set<String> = []
    var upsertedIds: [(namespace: String, id: String)] = []
    var deletedIds: [(namespace: String, id: String)] = []

    for chunk in chunks {
      for op in chunk.ops {
        guard let action = op.first as? String else { continue }

        let namespace = (op.count > 1 ? op[1] as? String : nil) ?? chunk.namespace
        let id = (op.count > 2 ? op[2] as? String : nil) ?? chunk.id
        affectedNamespaces.insert(namespace)

        switch action {
        case "create", "update":
          guard op.count > 3, let payload = op[3] as? [String: Any] else { continue }
          var entity = payload
          entity["id"] = id

          let triples = Normalization.normalize(
            data: entity,
            namespace: namespace,
            attrsStore: store.attrsStore,
            createdAt: timestamp
          )
          store.addTriples(triples)
          upsertedIds.append((namespace: namespace, id: id))

        case "link":
          guard op.count > 3, let payload = op[3] as? [String: Any] else { continue }
          var entity: [String: Any] = ["id": id]
          for (key, value) in payload {
            entity[key] = value
          }

          let triples = Normalization.normalize(
            data: entity,
            namespace: namespace,
            attrsStore: store.attrsStore,
            createdAt: timestamp
          )
          store.addTriples(triples)
          upsertedIds.append((namespace: namespace, id: id))

        case "unlink":
          guard op.count > 3, let payload = op[3] as? [String: Any] else { continue }
          applyOptimisticUnlink(
            namespace: namespace,
            entityId: id,
            payload: payload,
            timestamp: timestamp
          )
          upsertedIds.append((namespace: namespace, id: id))

        case "delete":
          store.deleteEntity(id: id)
          deletedIds.append((namespace: namespace, id: id))

        default:
          continue
        }
      }
    }

    // Notify subscriptions of the specific changes
    // This ensures currentIDs gets updated with the new entity IDs
    for (namespace, id) in upsertedIds {
      await notifyOptimisticUpsert(namespace: namespace, id: id)
    }
    for (namespace, id) in deletedIds {
      await notifyOptimisticDelete(namespace: namespace, id: id)
    }

    // Also notify all subscriptions to ensure cross-namespace consistency
    // (e.g., a link mutation affects both sides of the relationship)
    // See Reactor.js pushOps() line 1367: this.notifyAll()
    await notifyAll()
  }
```

**Current Limitations vs TypeScript:**
- **No `merge` operation support**: TypeScript supports deep merge for nested objects
- **No transaction ID tracking**: TypeScript tracks `txId` for rollback
- **No rollback capability**: TypeScript can revert optimistic updates on server rejection
- **No conflict resolution**: TypeScript has sophisticated conflict resolution with server
- **No `lookup` attribute support**: TypeScript handles lookup constraints

## 5. notifyAll() and notifyOptimisticUpsert() (Lines 453-517)

### notifyAll() (Lines 466-472)
```swift
  /// Notifies ALL active subscriptions to recompute their data from the store.
  ///
  /// ## Why This Exists (TypeScript Parity)
  /// The TypeScript SDK's `notifyAll()` (Reactor.js lines 1303-1310) recomputes ALL
  /// subscriptions after any mutation. This ensures:
  /// - Cross-namespace consistency (e.g., a link mutation affects both sides)
  /// - Correct filtering (subscriptions with complex WHERE clauses recompute)
  /// - No missed updates (even if we can't predict which subscriptions are affected)
  ///
  /// ## Performance Note
  /// This is intentionally aggressive. The TypeScript SDK does the same because
  /// correctness trumps optimization. Each subscription reads from the normalized
  /// store which is fast, and deduplication happens at the UI layer.
  private func notifyAll() async {
    for (_, handle) in activeSubscriptions {
      // Trigger a recompute by calling upsert with a sentinel ID.
      // The SubscriptionState will re-read from the store and yield new values.
      await handle.upsert("__notifyAll__")
    }
  }
```

### notifyOptimisticUpsert() (Lines 474-503)
```swift
  private func notifyOptimisticUpsert(namespace: String, id: String) async {
    let matchingHandles = activeSubscriptions.values.filter { $0.namespace == namespace }
    reactorDebugLog("notifyOptimisticUpsert", data: [
      "namespace": namespace,
      "id": id,
      "totalSubscriptions": activeSubscriptions.count,
      "matchingSubscriptions": matchingHandles.count,
      "allNamespaces": activeSubscriptions.values.map { $0.namespace }
    ])

    for (_, handle) in activeSubscriptions where handle.namespace == namespace {
      switch handle.filter {
      case .matchAll:
        reactorDebugLog("notifyOptimisticUpsert: calling upsert (matchAll)", data: [
          "namespace": namespace,
          "id": id
        ])
        await handle.upsert(id)
      case .idEquals(let expectedId):
        guard expectedId == id else { continue }
        reactorDebugLog("notifyOptimisticUpsert: calling upsert (idEquals)", data: [
          "namespace": namespace,
          "id": id
        ])
        await handle.upsert(id)
      case .unsupported:
        continue
      }
    }
  }
```

### notifyOptimisticDelete() (Lines 505-517)
```swift
  private func notifyOptimisticDelete(namespace: String, id: String) async {
    for handle in activeSubscriptions.values where handle.namespace == namespace {
      switch handle.filter {
        case .matchAll:
          await handle.delete(id)
        case .idEquals(let expectedId):
          guard expectedId == id else { continue }
          await handle.delete(id)
        case .unsupported:
          continue
      }
    }
  }

## 6. SubscriptionState Actor - Full Implementation (Lines 1174-1449)

```swift
/// Actor to manage the state of a single subscription.
///
/// ## Query-Level Reactivity (TypeScript SDK Pattern)
/// This actor applies pending mutations at query evaluation time, matching the TypeScript
/// SDK's `dataForQuery()` -> `_applyOptimisticUpdates()` pattern.
///
/// Instead of persisting pending mutations to the store once, we merge them on-the-fly
/// every time `handleStoreUpdate()` is called. This ensures pending mutations are ALWAYS
/// visible, regardless of subscription lifecycle or store state.
///
/// See: instant-client/src/Reactor.js - dataForQuery(), _applyOptimisticUpdates()
private actor SubscriptionState<Value: EntityIdentifiable & Codable & Sendable> {
    private var currentIDs: [String] = [] // Keep order for consistent results
    private let continuation: AsyncStream<[Value]>.Continuation
    private let store: SharedTripleStore
    private let namespace: String
    private let orderByIsDescending: Bool

    /// Links to include when resolving entities from the store.
    /// This controls which linked entities are fetched during entity resolution.
    /// Without this, bidirectional links cause exponential memory growth.
    private let includedLinks: Set<String>

    /// For fetching pending mutations at query time (TypeScript SDK pattern).
    private let appID: String
    private let clientInstanceID: String

    /// IDs that have been introduced by local optimistic writes, but have not yet been
    /// observed in a server query result.
    ///
    /// ## Why This Exists
    /// SharingInstant applies optimistic writes to the local `TripleStore` immediately.
    /// However, InstantDB subscriptions can emit a server refresh *before* the mutation
    /// has round-tripped and appears in the query result. If we overwrite our `currentIDs`
    /// with the server-provided IDs in that window, the UI appears to "revert" or drop
    /// newly created entities, which is the exact "it gets overridden" symptom.
    ///
    /// By tracking optimistic IDs separately, we can keep them in `currentIDs` until the
    /// server eventually includes them (at which point they become confirmed and we can
    /// stop treating them as optimistic).
    private var optimisticIDs: [String] = []

    init(
      continuation: AsyncStream<[Value]>.Continuation,
      store: SharedTripleStore,
      namespace: String,
      orderByIsDescending: Bool,
      includedLinks: Set<String>,
      appID: String,
      clientInstanceID: String
    ) {
        self.continuation = continuation
        self.store = store
        self.namespace = namespace
        self.orderByIsDescending = orderByIsDescending
        self.includedLinks = includedLinks
        self.appID = appID
        self.clientInstanceID = clientInstanceID
    }
    
    func handleDBUpdate(data: [Value]) async {
        // 1. Merge data into store (Normalize Tree -> Triples)
        // Use manual dictionary merge to convert to Dict
        let dicts = data.compactMap { try? $0.asDictionary() }

        var allTriples: [Triple] = []
        for dict in dicts {
            // Normalize: dict -> triples
            let triples = Normalization.normalize(data: dict, namespace: namespace, attrsStore: store.attrsStore)
            allTriples.append(contentsOf: triples)
        }
        store.addTriples(allTriples)

        let serverIDs = data.map(\.id)
        let serverIDLowercasedSet = Set(serverIDs.map { $0.lowercased() })

        // Once the server has included an ID, it is no longer "optimistic".
        optimisticIDs.removeAll { serverIDLowercasedSet.contains($0.lowercased()) }

        let pendingOptimisticIDs = optimisticIDs.filter {
          !serverIDLowercasedSet.contains($0.lowercased())
        }
        let mergedIDs: [String]
        if orderByIsDescending {
          mergedIDs = pendingOptimisticIDs + serverIDs
        } else {
          mergedIDs = serverIDs + pendingOptimisticIDs
        }

        currentIDs = mergedIDs

        // Yield from the normalized store rather than the raw DB response.
        await handleStoreUpdate()
    }
    
    func handleStoreUpdate() async {
        reactorDebugLog("SubscriptionState.handleStoreUpdate", data: [
          "namespace": namespace,
          "currentIDsCount": currentIDs.count,
          "currentIDs": currentIDs,
          "optimisticIDsCount": optimisticIDs.count,
          "optimisticIDs": optimisticIDs
        ])

        // TypeScript SDK Pattern: Apply pending mutations at query time
        // See Reactor.js dataForQuery() -> _applyOptimisticUpdates()
        //
        // 1. Get pending mutations from SQLite
        let client = await MainActor.run {
            InstantClientFactory.makeClient(appID: appID, instanceID: clientInstanceID)
        }
        let pendingMutations = await client.getUnconfirmedPendingMutations()

        // 2. Extract entity data from pending mutations for our namespace
        var pendingEntityData: [String: [String: Any]] = [:]
        var pendingEntityOrder: [String] = [] // Maintain insertion order

        for mutation in pendingMutations {
            for step in mutation.txSteps {
                guard step.count >= 4,
                      let action = step[0].value as? String,
                      action == "add-triple",
                      let entityId = step[1].value as? String,
                      let attrId = step[2].value as? String else {
                    continue
                }

                // Resolve attribute ID to namespace and field name
                let attrNamespace: String
                let fieldName: String

                if let attr = store.attrsStore.getAttr(attrId),
                   attr.forwardIdentity.count >= 3 {
                    attrNamespace = attr.forwardIdentity[1]
                    fieldName = attr.forwardIdentity[2]
                } else {
                    let parts = attrId.components(separatedBy: "/")
                    guard parts.count >= 2 else { continue }
                    attrNamespace = parts[0]
                    fieldName = parts[1]
                }

                guard attrNamespace == namespace else { continue }

                let rawValue = step[3].value

                if pendingEntityData[entityId] == nil {
                    pendingEntityData[entityId] = ["id": entityId]
                    pendingEntityOrder.append(entityId)
                }

                pendingEntityData[entityId]?[fieldName] = rawValue
            }
        }

        // 3. Merge currentIDs with pending entity IDs
        var allIDs = currentIDs
        for entityId in pendingEntityOrder {
            if !allIDs.contains(entityId) {
                if orderByIsDescending {
                    allIDs.insert(entityId, at: 0)
                } else {
                    allIDs.append(entityId)
                }
            }
        }

        // 4. Build result by merging store data with pending mutations
        var values: [Value] = []

        for id in allIDs {
            var entityDict: [String: Any]

            // CRITICAL: Pass includedLinks to only resolve explicitly requested links.
            if let val: Value = store.get(id: id, includedLinks: includedLinks) {
                entityDict = (try? val.asDictionary()) ?? ["id": id]
            } else {
                entityDict = ["id": id]
            }

            // Merge pending mutation data (overwrites store data for same fields)
            if let pendingData = pendingEntityData[id] {
                for (key, value) in pendingData {
                    entityDict[key] = value
                }
            }

            // Decode back to Value type
            if let data = try? JSONSerialization.data(withJSONObject: entityDict),
               let val = try? JSONDecoder().decode(Value.self, from: data) {
                values.append(val)
            }
        }

        continuation.yield(values)
    }

    func handleOptimisticUpsert(id: String) async {
        // Handle notifyAll() sentinel
        if id == "__notifyAll__" {
          await handleStoreUpdate()
          return
        }

        if !optimisticIDs.contains(id) {
          if orderByIsDescending {
            optimisticIDs.insert(id, at: 0)
          } else {
            optimisticIDs.append(id)
          }
        }

        if !currentIDs.contains(id) {
          if orderByIsDescending {
            currentIDs.insert(id, at: 0)
          } else {
            currentIDs.append(id)
          }
        }

        await handleStoreUpdate()
    }
    
    func handleOptimisticDelete(id: String) async {
        currentIDs.removeAll { $0 == id }
        optimisticIDs.removeAll { $0 == id }
        await handleStoreUpdate()
    }

    func cleanup() async {
        // No observers to clean up - query-level reactivity doesn't use per-entity observers
    }
}
```

**Current Limitations vs TypeScript:**
- **No error state tracking**: TypeScript tracks and emits errors
- **No loading state**: TypeScript has `isLoading` property
- **No `pageInfo`**: TypeScript tracks pagination info
- **No WHERE clause evaluation**: Swift doesn't filter locally, relies on server
- **No `aggregate` support**: TypeScript supports aggregations
- **Inefficient pending mutation lookup**: Queries SQLite on every update instead of caching

10. **Aggregation queries** - No count/sum/avg support
11. **Merge operation** - No deep merge for nested objects
12. **Lookup attribute constraints** - No unique lookup handling

# SharingInstant Memory & Performance Fixes - Implementation Plan

## Executive Summary

This plan addresses **CRITICAL** and **HIGH** priority memory issues in the SharingInstant Swift SDK identified through comprehensive analysis of:
- TypeScript Reactor.js cleanup mechanisms
- TypeScript Store/PersistedObject GC patterns
- Swift Reactor current implementation gaps
- Git history of related fixes

**Priority Fixes:**
1. Cycle detection in entity resolution (CRITICAL)
2. TripleStore garbage collection (CRITICAL)
3. Pending mutation cleanup (HIGH)
4. Query result caching with version tracking (HIGH)
5. Pending mutation caching in Reactor (HIGH)

---

## Priority 1: Cycle Detection in Entity Resolution

### Problem

**File:** `Sources/SharingInstant/Extensions/TripleStore+Extensions.swift` (Lines 19-172)

Current `resolve()` uses depth limiting but NO cycle detection:

\```swift
public func resolve(id: String, attrsStore: AttrsStore, depth: Int = 0, maxDepth: Int = 10, includedLinks: Set<String>? = nil) -> [String: Any] {
    if depth > maxDepth { return ["id": id] }  // Only protection
    // ...recursive calls without tracking visited entities
}
\```

**Impact:** If Entity A links to B links to A, both are resolved 5 complete cycles before stopping, causing exponential memory growth.

### TypeScript Reference

TypeScript's InstaQL (`instaql.ts`) doesn't explicitly track visited entities, but its query-driven approach naturally limits resolution scope. The Swift implementation needs explicit protection because it resolves ALL links when `includedLinks` is nil.

### Proposed Implementation

\```swift
// File: Sources/SharingInstant/Extensions/TripleStore+Extensions.swift

/// Resolves an entity by ID from the TripleStore, with cycle detection.
///
/// - Parameters:
///   - id: The entity ID to resolve
///   - attrsStore: The attributes store for schema info
///   - depth: Current recursion depth (internal use)
///   - maxDepth: Maximum recursion depth (default: 5, reduced from 10)
///   - includedLinks: Links to resolve (nil = all, empty = none)
///   - visited: Set of already-visited entity IDs for cycle detection
/// - Returns: Dictionary representation of the entity
public func resolve(
    id: String,
    attrsStore: AttrsStore,
    depth: Int = 0,
    maxDepth: Int = 5,  // CHANGED: Reduced from 10 to 5
    includedLinks: Set<String>? = nil,
    visited: inout Set<String>  // NEW: Cycle detection
) -> [String: Any] {
    // Cycle detection
    guard !visited.contains(id) else {
        return ["id": id]  // Return minimal representation for cycles
    }
    visited.insert(id)
    defer { visited.remove(id) }  // Allow revisiting in different branches

    // Depth limit
    if depth > maxDepth { return ["id": id] }

    let triples = self.getTriples(entity: id)
    guard !triples.isEmpty else { return ["id": id] }

    var result: [String: Any] = ["id": id]

    // Group triples by attribute
    let triplesByAttr = Dictionary(grouping: triples) { $0.attributeId }

    for (attrId, attrTriples) in triplesByAttr {
        guard let attr = attrsStore.getAttr(attrId) else { continue }
        let label = attr.forwardIdentity.count > 2 ? attr.forwardIdentity[2] : attrId

        if attr.valueType == .ref {
            // Skip links not in includedLinks (if specified)
            if let includedLinks = includedLinks, !includedLinks.contains(label) {
                continue
            }

            // Resolve linked entities with cycle detection
            var resolvedRefs: [[String: Any]] = []
            for triple in attrTriples {
                if case .ref(let targetId) = triple.value {
                    let childObj = resolve(
                        id: targetId,
                        attrsStore: attrsStore,
                        depth: depth + 1,
                        maxDepth: maxDepth,
                        includedLinks: includedLinks,
                        visited: &visited  // Pass visited set
                    )
                    // Skip ghost entities (only have "id")
                    if childObj.count > 1 {
                        resolvedRefs.append(childObj)
                    }
                }
            }

            // Handle cardinality
            if attr.cardinality == .one || attr.isUnique == true {
                result[label] = resolvedRefs.first
            } else {
                result[label] = resolvedRefs
            }
        } else {
            // Non-ref attributes: take most recent value
            if let latestTriple = attrTriples.max(by: { $0.createdAt < $1.createdAt }) {
                result[label] = latestTriple.value.rawValue
            }
        }
    }

    // Resolve reverse links with cycle detection
    if depth < maxDepth, let entityType = attrsStore.getEntityType(forEntityId: id) {
        let reverseAttrs = attrsStore.revIdents[entityType] ?? [:]

        for (reverseLabel, attr) in reverseAttrs {
            if let includedLinks = includedLinks, !includedLinks.contains(reverseLabel) {
                continue
            }

            let reverseTriples = getReverseRefs(entityId: id, attributeId: attr.id)
            var resolvedParents: [[String: Any]] = []

            for triple in reverseTriples {
                let parentObj = resolve(
                    id: triple.entityId,
                    attrsStore: attrsStore,
                    depth: depth + 1,
                    maxDepth: maxDepth,
                    includedLinks: includedLinks,
                    visited: &visited  // Pass visited set
                )
                if parentObj.count > 1 {
                    resolvedParents.append(parentObj)
                }
            }

            if attr.cardinality == .one || attr.isUnique == true {
                result[reverseLabel] = resolvedParents.first
            } else {
                result[reverseLabel] = resolvedParents
            }
        }
    }

    return result
}

// Convenience overload that creates the visited set
public func resolve(
    id: String,
    attrsStore: AttrsStore,
    depth: Int = 0,
    maxDepth: Int = 5,
    includedLinks: Set<String>? = nil
) -> [String: Any] {
    var visited = Set<String>()
    return resolve(
        id: id,
        attrsStore: attrsStore,
        depth: depth,
        maxDepth: maxDepth,
        includedLinks: includedLinks,
        visited: &visited
    )
}
\```

    store.addTriples([
