   289→      config.verbose || flags.devBackend || flags.instantLogs,
   290→      () => this._reactorStats(),
   291→    );
   292→
   293→    this.versions = { ...(versions || {}), '@instantdb/core': version };
   294→
   295→    if (this.config.schema) {
   296→      this._linkIndex = createLinkIndex(this.config.schema);
   297→    }
   298→
   299→    // This is to protect us against running
   300→    // server-side.
   301→    if (!isClient()) {
   302→      return;
   303→    }
   304→
   305→    if (!config.appId) {
   306→      throw new Error('Instant must be initialized with an appId.');
   307→    }
   308→
   309→    if (!validateUUID(config.appId)) {
   310→      throw new Error(
   311→        `Instant must be initialized with a valid appId. \`${config.appId}\` is not a valid uuid.`,
   312→      );
   313→    }
   314→
   315→    if (typeof BroadcastChannel === 'function') {
   316→      this._broadcastChannel = new BroadcastChannel('@instantdb');
   317→      this._broadcastChannel.addEventListener('message', async (e) => {
   318→        try {
   319→          if (e.data?.type === 'auth') {
   320→            const res = await this.getCurrentUser();
   321→            this.updateUser(res.user);
   322→          }
   323→        } catch (e) {
   324→          this._log.error('[error] handle broadcast channel', e);
   325→        }
   326→      });
   327→    }
   328→
   329→    this._initStorage(Storage);
   330→
   331→    this._syncTable = new SyncTable(
   332→      this._trySendAuthed.bind(this),
   333→      new Storage(this.config.appId, 'syncSubs'),
   334→      {
   335→        useDateObjects: this.config.useDateObjects,
   336→      },
   337→      this._log,
   338→      (triples) => {
   339→        return s.createStore(
   340→          this.ensureAttrs(),
   341→          triples,
   342→          this.config.enableCardinalityInference,
   343→          this.config.useDateObjects,
   344→        );
   345→      },
   346→      () => this.ensureAttrs(),
   347→    );
   348→
   349→    this._oauthCallbackResponse = this._oauthLoginInit();
   350→
   351→    // kick off a request to cache it
   352→    this.getCurrentUser().then((userInfo) => {
   353→      this.syncUserToEndpoint(userInfo.user);
   354→    });
   355→
   356→    setInterval(async () => {
   357→      const currentUser = await this.getCurrentUser();
   358→      this.syncUserToEndpoint(currentUser.user);
   359→    }, ONE_MIN_MS);
   360→
   361→    NetworkListener.getIsOnline().then((isOnline) => {
   362→      this._isOnline = isOnline;
   363→      this._startSocket();
   364→      NetworkListener.listen((isOnline) => {
   365→        // We do this because react native's NetInfo
   366→        // fires multiple online events.
   367→        // We only want to handle one state change
   368→        if (isOnline === this._isOnline) {
   369→          return;
   370→        }
   371→        this._log.info('[network] online =', isOnline);
   372→        this._isOnline = isOnline;
   373→        if (this._isOnline) {
   374→          this._startSocket();
   375→        } else {
   376→          this._log.info(
   377→            'Changing status from',
   378→            this.status,
   379→            'to',
   380→            STATUS.CLOSED,
   381→          );
   382→          this._setStatus(STATUS.CLOSED);
   383→        }
   384→      });
   385→    });
   386→
   387→    if (typeof addEventListener !== 'undefined') {
   388→      this._beforeUnload = this._beforeUnload.bind(this);
   389→      addEventListener('beforeunload', this._beforeUnload);
   390→    }
   391→  }
   392→
   393→  ensureAttrs() {
   394→    if (!this.attrs) {
   395→      throw new Error('attrs have not loaded.');
   396→    }
   397→    return this.attrs;
   398→  }
   399→
   400→  updateSchema(schema) {
   401→    this.config = {
   402→      ...this.config,
   403→      schema: schema,
   404→      cardinalityInference: Boolean(schema),
   405→    };
   406→    this._linkIndex = schema ? createLinkIndex(this.config.schema) : null;
   407→  }
   408→
   409→  _reactorStats() {
   410→    return {
   411→      inFlightMutationCount: this._inFlightMutationEventIds.size,
   412→      storedMutationCount: this._pendingMutations().size,
   413→      transportType: this._transportType,
   414→    };
   415→  }
   416→
   417→  _onQuerySubLoaded(hash) {
   418→    this.kv
   419→      .waitForKeyToLoad('pendingMutations')
   420→      .then(() => this.notifyOne(hash));
   421→  }
   422→
   423→  _initStorage(Storage) {
   424→    this.querySubs = new PersistedObject({
   425→      persister: new Storage(this.config.appId, 'querySubs'),
   426→      merge: onMergeQuerySub,
   427→      serialize: querySubToStorage,
   428→      parse: (_key, x) => querySubFromStorage(x, this.config.useDateObjects),
   429→      // objectSize
   430→      objectSize: (x) => x?.result?.store?.triples?.length ?? 0,
   431→      logger: this._log,
   432→      preloadEntryCount: 10,
   433→      gc: {
   434→        maxAgeMs: 1000 * 60 * 60 * 24 * 7 * 52, // 1 year
   435→        maxEntries: 1000,
   436→        // Size of each query is the number of triples
   437→        maxSize: 1_000_000, // 1 million triples
   438→      },
   439→    });
   440→    this.querySubs.onKeyLoaded = (k) => this._onQuerySubLoaded(k);
   441→    this.kv = new PersistedObject({
   442→      persister: new Storage(this.config.appId, 'kv'),
   443→      merge: this._onMergeKv,
   444→      serialize: kvToStorage,
   445→      parse: kvFromStorage,
   446→      objectSize: () => 0,
   447→      logger: this._log,
   448→      saveThrottleMs: 100,
   449→      idleCallbackMaxWaitMs: 100,
   450→      // Don't GC the kv store
   451→      gc: null,
   452→    });
   453→    this.kv.onKeyLoaded = (k) => {
   454→      if (k === 'pendingMutations') {
   455→        this.notifyAll();
   456→      }
   457→    };
   458→    // Trigger immediate load for pendingMutations and currentUser
   459→    this.kv.waitForKeyToLoad('pendingMutations');
   460→    this.kv.waitForKeyToLoad(currentUserKey);
   461→    this._beforeUnloadCbs.push(() => {
   462→      this.kv.flush();
   463→      this.querySubs.flush();
   464→    });
   465→  }
   466→
   467→  _beforeUnload() {
   468→    for (const cb of this._beforeUnloadCbs) {
   469→      cb();
   470→    }
   471→    this._syncTable.beforeUnload();
   472→  }
   473→
   474→  /**
   475→   * @param {'enqueued' | 'pending' | 'synced' | 'timeout' |  'error' } status
   476→   * @param {string} eventId
   477→   * @param {{message?: string, type?: string, status?: number, hint?: unknown}} [errorMsg]
   478→   */
   479→  _finishTransaction(status, eventId, errorMsg) {
   480→    const dfd = this.mutationDeferredStore.get(eventId);
   481→    this.mutationDeferredStore.delete(eventId);
   482→    const ok = status !== 'error' && status !== 'timeout';
   483→
   484→    if (!dfd && !ok) {
   485→      // console.erroring here, as there are no listeners to let know
   486→      console.error('Mutation failed', { status, eventId, ...errorMsg });
   487→    }
   488→    if (!dfd) {
   489→      return;
   490→    }
   491→    if (ok) {
   492→      dfd.resolve({ status, eventId });
   493→    } else {
   494→      // Check if error comes from server or client
   495→      if (errorMsg?.type) {
   496→        const { status, ...body } = errorMsg;
   497→        dfd.reject(
   498→          new InstantAPIError({
   499→            // @ts-expect-error body.type is not constant typed
   500→            body,
   501→            status: status ?? 0,
   502→          }),
   503→        );
   504→      } else {
   505→        dfd.reject(
   506→          new InstantError(
   507→            errorMsg?.message || 'Unknown error',
   508→            errorMsg?.hint,
   509→          ),
   510→        );
   511→      }
   512→    }
   513→  }
   514→
   515→  _setStatus(status, err) {
   516→    this.status = status;
   517→    this._errorMessage = err;
   518→    this.notifyConnectionStatusSubs(status);
   519→  }
   520→
   521→  _onMergeKv = (key, storageV, inMemoryV) => {
   522→    switch (key) {
   523→      case 'pendingMutations': {
   524→        const storageEntries = storageV?.entries() ?? [];
   525→        const inMemoryEntries = inMemoryV?.entries() ?? [];
   526→        const muts = new Map([...storageEntries, ...inMemoryEntries]);
   527→        const rewrittenStorageMuts = storageV
   528→          ? this._rewriteMutationsSorted(this.attrs, storageV)
   529→          : [];
   530→        rewrittenStorageMuts.forEach(([k, mut]) => {
   531→          if (!inMemoryV?.pendingMutations?.has(k) && !mut['tx-id']) {
   532→            this._sendMutation(k, mut);
   533→          }
   534→        });
   535→        return muts;
   536→      }
   537→      default:
   538→        return inMemoryV || storageV;
   539→    }
   540→  };
   541→
   542→  _flushEnqueuedRoomData(roomId) {
   543→    const enqueuedUserPresence = this._presence[roomId]?.result?.user;
   544→    const enqueuedBroadcasts = this._broadcastQueue[roomId];
   545→
   546→    this._broadcastQueue[roomId] = [];
   547→
   548→    if (enqueuedUserPresence) {
   549→      this._trySetPresence(roomId, enqueuedUserPresence);
   550→    }
   551→
   552→    if (enqueuedBroadcasts) {
   553→      for (const item of enqueuedBroadcasts) {
   554→        const { topic, roomType, data } = item;
   555→        this._tryBroadcast(roomId, roomType, topic, data);
   556→      }
   557→    }
   558→  }
   559→
   560→  /**
   561→   * Does the same thing as add-query-ok
   562→   * but called as a result of receiving query info from ssr
   563→   * @param {any} q
   564→   * @param {{ triples: any; pageInfo: any; }} result
   565→   * @param {boolean} enableCardinalityInference
   566→   */
   567→  _addQueryData(q, result, enableCardinalityInference) {
   568→    if (!this.attrs) {
   569→      throw new Error('Attrs in reactor have not been set');
   570→    }
   571→    const queryHash = weakHash(q);
   572→    const attrsStore = this.ensureAttrs();
   573→    const store = s.createStore(
   574→      this.attrs,
   575→      result.triples,
   576→      enableCardinalityInference,
   577→      this.config.useDateObjects,
   578→    );
   579→    this.querySubs.updateInPlace((prev) => {
   580→      prev[queryHash] = {
   581→        result: {
   582→          store,
   583→          attrsStore,
   584→          pageInfo: result.pageInfo,
   585→          processedTxId: undefined,
   586→          isExternal: true,
   587→        },
   588→        q,
   589→      };
   590→    });
   591→    this._cleanupPendingMutationsQueries();
   592→    this.notifyOne(queryHash);
   593→    this.notifyOneQueryOnce(queryHash);
   594→    this._cleanupPendingMutationsTimeout();
   595→  }
   596→
   597→  _handleReceive(connId, msg) {
   598→    // opt-out, enabled by default if schema
   599→    const enableCardinalityInference =
   600→      Boolean(this.config.schema) &&
   601→      ('cardinalityInference' in this.config
   602→        ? Boolean(this.config.cardinalityInference)
   603→        : true);
   604→    if (!ignoreLogging[msg.op]) {
   605→      this._log.info('[receive]', connId, msg.op, msg);
   606→    }
   607→    switch (msg.op) {
   608→      case 'init-ok': {
   609→        this._setStatus(STATUS.AUTHENTICATED);
   610→        this._reconnectTimeoutMs = 0;
   611→        this._setAttrs(msg.attrs);
   612→        this._flushPendingMessages();
   613→        // (EPH): set session-id, so we know
   614→        // which item is us
   615→        this._sessionId = msg['session-id'];
   616→
   617→        for (const roomId of Object.keys(this._rooms)) {
   618→          const enqueuedUserPresence = this._presence[roomId]?.result?.user;
   619→          this._tryJoinRoom(roomId, enqueuedUserPresence);
   620→        }
   621→        break;
   622→      }
   623→      case 'add-query-exists': {
   624→        this.notifyOneQueryOnce(weakHash(msg.q));
   625→        break;
   626→      }
   627→      case 'add-query-ok': {
   628→        const { q, result } = msg;
   629→        const hash = weakHash(q);
   630→        if (!this._hasQueryListeners() && !this.querySubs.currentValue[hash]) {
   631→          break;
   632→        }
   633→        const pageInfo = result?.[0]?.data?.['page-info'];
   634→        const aggregate = result?.[0]?.data?.['aggregate'];
   635→        const triples = extractTriples(result);
   636→        const attrsStore = this.ensureAttrs();
   637→        const store = s.createStore(
   638→          attrsStore,
   639→          triples,
   640→          enableCardinalityInference,
   641→          this.config.useDateObjects,
   642→        );
   643→
   644→        this.querySubs.updateInPlace((prev) => {
   645→          if (!prev[hash]) {
   646→            this._log.info('Missing value in querySubs', { hash, q });
   647→            return;
   648→          }
   649→          prev[hash].result = {
   650→            store,
   651→            attrsStore,
   652→            pageInfo,
   653→            aggregate,
   654→            processedTxId: msg['processed-tx-id'],
   655→          };
   656→        });
   657→        this._cleanupPendingMutationsQueries();
   658→        this.notifyOne(hash);
   659→        this.notifyOneQueryOnce(hash);
   660→        this._cleanupPendingMutationsTimeout();
   661→        break;
   662→      }
   663→      case 'start-sync-ok': {
   664→        this._syncTable.onStartSyncOk(msg);
   665→        break;
   666→      }
   667→      case 'sync-load-batch': {
   668→        this._syncTable.onSyncLoadBatch(msg);
   669→        break;
   670→      }
   671→      case 'sync-init-finish': {
   672→        this._syncTable.onSyncInitFinish(msg);
   673→        break;
   674→      }
   675→      case 'sync-update-triples': {
   676→        this._syncTable.onSyncUpdateTriples(msg);
   677→        break;
   678→      }
   679→      case 'refresh-ok': {
   680→        const { computations, attrs } = msg;
   681→        const processedTxId = msg['processed-tx-id'];
   682→        if (attrs) {
   683→          this._setAttrs(attrs);
   684→        }
   685→
   686→        this._cleanupPendingMutationsTimeout();
   687→
   688→        const rewrittenMutations = this._rewriteMutations(
   689→          this.ensureAttrs(),
   690→          this._pendingMutations(),
   691→          processedTxId,
   692→        );
   693→
   694→        if (rewrittenMutations !== this._pendingMutations()) {
   695→          // We know we've changed the mutations to fix the attr ids and removed
   696→          // processed attrs, so we'll persist those changes to prevent optimisticAttrs
   697→          // from using old attr definitions
   698→          this.kv.updateInPlace((prev) => {
   699→            prev.pendingMutations = rewrittenMutations;
   700→          });
   701→        }
   702→
   703→        const mutations = sortedMutationEntries(rewrittenMutations.entries());
   704→
   705→        const updates = computations.map((x) => {
   706→          const q = x['instaql-query'];
   707→          const result = x['instaql-result'];
   708→          const hash = weakHash(q);
   709→          const triples = extractTriples(result);
   710→          const attrsStore = this.ensureAttrs();
   711→          const store = s.createStore(
   712→            attrsStore,
   713→            triples,
   714→            enableCardinalityInference,
   715→            this.config.useDateObjects,
   716→          );
   717→          const { store: newStore, attrsStore: newAttrsStore } =
   718→            this._applyOptimisticUpdates(
   719→              store,
   720→              attrsStore,
   721→              mutations,
   722→              processedTxId,
   723→            );
   724→          const pageInfo = result?.[0]?.data?.['page-info'];
   725→          const aggregate = result?.[0]?.data?.['aggregate'];
   726→          return {
   727→            q,
   728→            hash,
   729→            store: newStore,
   730→            attrsStore: newAttrsStore,
   731→            pageInfo,
   732→            aggregate,
   733→          };
   734→        });
   735→
   736→        updates.forEach(
   737→          ({ hash, q, store, attrsStore, pageInfo, aggregate }) => {
   738→            this.querySubs.updateInPlace((prev) => {
   739→              if (!prev[hash]) {
   740→                this._log.error('Missing value in querySubs', { hash, q });
   741→                return;
   742→              }
   743→              prev[hash].result = {
   744→                store,
   745→                attrsStore,
   746→                pageInfo,
   747→                aggregate,
   748→                processedTxId,
   749→              };
   750→            });
   751→          },
   752→        );
   753→
   754→        this._cleanupPendingMutationsQueries();
   755→
   756→        updates.forEach(({ hash }) => {
   757→          this.notifyOne(hash);
   758→        });
   759→        break;
   760→      }
   761→      case 'transact-ok': {
   762→        const { 'client-event-id': eventId, 'tx-id': txId } = msg;
   763→
   764→        this._inFlightMutationEventIds.delete(eventId);
   765→
   766→        const muts = this._rewriteMutations(
   767→          this.ensureAttrs(),
   768→          this._pendingMutations(),
   769→        );
   770→        const prevMutation = muts.get(eventId);
   771→        if (!prevMutation) {
   772→          break;
   773→        }
   774→
   775→        // update pendingMutation with server-side tx-id
   776→        this._updatePendingMutations((prev) => {
   777→          prev.set(eventId, {
   778→            ...prev.get(eventId),
   779→            'tx-id': txId,
   780→            confirmed: Date.now(),
   781→          });
   782→        });
   783→
   784→        const newAttrs = [];
   785→        for (const step of prevMutation['tx-steps']) {
   786→          if (step[0] === 'add-attr') {
   787→            const attr = step[1];
   788→            newAttrs.push(attr);
   789→          }
   790→        }
   791→        if (newAttrs.length) {
   792→          const existingAttrs = Object.values(this.ensureAttrs().attrs);
   793→          this._setAttrs([...existingAttrs, ...newAttrs]);
   794→        }
   795→
   796→        this._finishTransaction('synced', eventId);
   797→
   798→        this._cleanupPendingMutationsTimeout();
   799→
   800→        break;
   801→      }
   802→      case 'patch-presence': {
   803→        const roomId = msg['room-id'];
   804→        this._trySetRoomConnected(roomId, true);
   805→        this._patchPresencePeers(roomId, msg['edits']);
   806→        this._notifyPresenceSubs(roomId);
   807→        break;
   808→      }
   809→      case 'refresh-presence': {
   810→        const roomId = msg['room-id'];
   811→        this._trySetRoomConnected(roomId, true);
   812→        this._setPresencePeers(roomId, msg['data']);
   813→        this._notifyPresenceSubs(roomId);
   814→        break;
   815→      }
   816→      case 'server-broadcast': {
   817→        const room = msg['room-id'];
   818→        const topic = msg.topic;
   819→        this._trySetRoomConnected(room, true);
   820→        this._notifyBroadcastSubs(room, topic, msg);
   821→        break;
   822→      }
   823→      case 'join-room-ok': {
   824→        const loadingRoomId = msg['room-id'];
   825→        const joinedRoom = this._rooms[loadingRoomId];
   826→
   827→        if (!joinedRoom) {
   828→          if (this._roomsPendingLeave[loadingRoomId]) {
   829→            this._tryLeaveRoom(loadingRoomId);
   830→            delete this._roomsPendingLeave[loadingRoomId];
   831→          }
   832→
   833→          break;
   834→        }
   835→
   836→        this._trySetRoomConnected(loadingRoomId, true);
   837→        this._flushEnqueuedRoomData(loadingRoomId);
   838→        break;
   839→      }
   840→      case 'leave-room-ok': {
   841→        const roomId = msg['room-id'];
   842→        this._trySetRoomConnected(roomId, false);
   843→        break;
   844→      }
   845→      case 'join-room-error':
   846→        const errorRoomId = msg['room-id'];
   847→        const errorRoom = this._rooms[errorRoomId];
   848→        if (errorRoom) {
   849→          errorRoom.error = msg['error'];
   850→        }
   851→        this._notifyPresenceSubs(errorRoomId);
   852→        break;
   853→      case 'error':
   854→        this._handleReceiveError(msg);
   855→        break;
   856→      default:
   857→        this._log.info('Uknown op', msg.op, msg);
   858→        break;
   859→    }
   860→  }
   861→
   862→  _pendingMutations() {
   863→    return this.kv.currentValue.pendingMutations ?? new Map();
   864→  }
   865→
   866→  _updatePendingMutations(f) {
   867→    this.kv.updateInPlace((prev) => {
   868→      const muts = prev.pendingMutations ?? new Map();
   869→      prev.pendingMutations = muts;
   870→      f(muts);
   871→    });
   872→  }
   873→
   874→  /**
   875→   * @param {'timeout' | 'error'} status
   876→   * @param {string} eventId
   877→   * @param {{message?: string, type?: string, status?: number, hint?: unknown}} errorMsg
   878→   */
   879→  _handleMutationError(status, eventId, errorMsg) {
   880→    const mut = this._pendingMutations().get(eventId);
   881→
   882→    if (mut && (status !== 'timeout' || !mut['tx-id'])) {
   883→      this._updatePendingMutations((prev) => {
   884→        prev.delete(eventId);
   885→        return prev;
   886→      });
   887→      this._inFlightMutationEventIds.delete(eventId);
   888→      const errDetails = {
   889→        message: errorMsg.message,
   890→        hint: errorMsg.hint,
   891→      };
   892→      this.notifyAll();
   893→      this.notifyAttrsSubs();
   894→      this.notifyMutationErrorSubs(errDetails);
   895→      this._finishTransaction(status, eventId, errorMsg);
   896→    }
   897→  }
   898→
   899→  _handleReceiveError(msg) {
   900→    console.log('error', msg);
   901→    const eventId = msg['client-event-id'];
   902→    // This might not be a mutation, but it can't hurt to delete it
   903→    this._inFlightMutationEventIds.delete(eventId);
   904→    const prevMutation = this._pendingMutations().get(eventId);
   905→    const errorMessage = {
   906→      message: msg.message || 'Uh-oh, something went wrong. Ping Joe & Stopa.',
   907→    };
   908→
   909→    if (msg.hint) {
   910→      errorMessage.hint = msg.hint;
   911→    }
   912→
   913→    if (prevMutation) {
   914→      this._handleMutationError('error', eventId, msg);
   915→      return;
   916→    }
   917→
   918→    if (
   919→      msg['original-event']?.hasOwnProperty('q') &&
   920→      msg['original-event']?.op === 'add-query'
   921→    ) {
   922→      const q = msg['original-event']?.q;
   923→      const hash = weakHash(q);
   924→      this.notifyQueryError(weakHash(q), errorMessage);
   925→      this.notifyQueryOnceError(q, hash, eventId, errorMessage);
   926→      return;
   927→    }
   928→
   929→    const isInitError = msg['original-event']?.op === 'init';
   930→    if (isInitError) {
   931→      if (
   932→        msg.type === 'record-not-found' &&
   933→        msg.hint?.['record-type'] === 'app-user'
   934→      ) {
   935→        // User has been logged out
   936→        this.changeCurrentUser(null);
   937→        return;
   938→      }
   939→
   940→      // We failed to init
   941→
   942→      this._setStatus(STATUS.ERRORED, errorMessage);
   943→      this.notifyAll();
   944→      return;
   945→    }
   946→
   947→    if (msg['original-event']?.op === 'resync-table') {
   948→      this._syncTable.onResyncError(msg);
   949→      return;
   950→    }
   951→
   952→    if (msg['original-event']?.op === 'start-sync') {
   953→      this._syncTable.onStartSyncError(msg);
   954→      return;
   955→    }
   956→    // We've caught some error which has no corresponding listener.
   957→    // Let's console.error to let the user know.
   958→    const errorObj = { ...msg };
   959→    delete errorObj.message;
   960→    delete errorObj.hint;
   961→    console.error(msg.message, errorObj);
   962→    if (msg.hint) {
   963→      console.error(
   964→        'This error comes with some debugging information. Here it is: \n',
   965→        msg.hint,
   966→      );
   967→    }
   968→  }
   969→
   970→  notifyQueryOnceError(q, hash, eventId, e) {
   971→    const r = this.queryOnceDfds[hash]?.find((r) => r.eventId === eventId);
   972→    if (!r) return;
   973→    r.dfd.reject(e);
   974→    this._completeQueryOnce(q, hash, r.dfd);
   975→  }
   976→
   977→  _setAttrs(attrs) {
   978→    this.attrs = new s.AttrsStoreClass(
   979→      attrs.reduce((acc, attr) => {
   980→        acc[attr.id] = attr;
   981→        return acc;
   982→      }, {}),
   983→      this._linkIndex,
   984→    );
   985→
   986→    this.notifyAttrsSubs();
   987→  }
   988→
   989→  // ---------------------------
   990→  // Queries
   991→
   992→  getPreviousResult = (q) => {
   993→    const hash = weakHash(q);
   994→    return this.dataForQuery(hash)?.data;
   995→  };
   996→
   997→  _startQuerySub(q, hash) {
   998→    const eventId = uuid();
   999→    this.querySubs.updateInPlace((prev) => {
  1000→      prev[hash] = prev[hash] || { q, result: null, eventId };
  1001→      prev[hash].lastAccessed = Date.now();
  1002→    });
  1003→    this._trySendAuthed(eventId, { op: 'add-query', q });
  1004→
  1005→    return eventId;
  1006→  }
  1007→
  1008→  subscribeTable(q, cb) {
  1009→    return this._syncTable.subscribe(q, cb);
  1010→  }
  1011→
  1012→  /**
  1013→   *  When a user subscribes to a query the following side effects occur:
  1014→   *
  1015→   *  - We update querySubs to include the new query
  1016→   *  - We update queryCbs to include the new cb
  1017→   *  - If we already have a result for the query we call cb immediately
  1018→   *  - We send the server an `add-query` message
  1019→   *
  1020→   *  Returns an unsubscribe function
  1021→   */
  1022→  subscribeQuery(q, cb, opts) {
  1023→    if (!this.config.disableValidation) {
  1024→      validateQuery(q, this.config.schema);
  1025→    }
  1026→    if (opts && 'ruleParams' in opts) {
  1027→      q = { $$ruleParams: opts['ruleParams'], ...q };
  1028→    }
  1029→
  1030→    const hash = weakHash(q);
  1031→
  1032→    const prevResult = this.getPreviousResult(q);
  1033→    if (prevResult) {
  1034→      cb(prevResult);
  1035→    }
  1036→
  1037→    this.queryCbs[hash] = this.queryCbs[hash] ?? [];
  1038→    this.queryCbs[hash].push({ q, cb });
  1039→
  1040→    this._startQuerySub(q, hash);
  1041→
  1042→    return () => {
  1043→      this._unsubQuery(q, hash, cb);
  1044→    };
  1045→  }
  1046→
  1047→  queryOnce(q, opts) {
  1048→    if (!this.config.disableValidation) {
  1049→      validateQuery(q, this.config.schema);
  1050→    }
  1051→
  1052→    if (opts && 'ruleParams' in opts) {
  1053→      q = { $$ruleParams: opts['ruleParams'], ...q };
  1054→    }
  1055→
  1056→    const dfd = new Deferred();
  1057→
  1058→    if (!this._isOnline) {
  1059→      dfd.reject(
  1060→        new Error("We can't run `queryOnce`, because the device is offline."),
  1061→      );
  1062→      return dfd.promise;
  1063→    }
  1064→
  1065→    if (!this.querySubs) {
  1066→      dfd.reject(
  1067→        new Error(
  1068→          "We can't run `queryOnce` on the backend. Use adminAPI.query instead: https://www.instantdb.com/docs/backend#query",
  1069→        ),
  1070→      );
  1071→      return dfd.promise;
  1072→    }
  1073→
  1074→    const hash = weakHash(q);
  1075→
  1076→    const eventId = this._startQuerySub(q, hash);
  1077→
  1078→    this.queryOnceDfds[hash] = this.queryOnceDfds[hash] ?? [];
  1079→    this.queryOnceDfds[hash].push({ q, dfd, eventId });
  1080→
  1081→    setTimeout(
  1082→      () => dfd.reject(new Error('Query timed out')),
  1083→      QUERY_ONCE_TIMEOUT,
  1084→    );
  1085→
  1086→    return dfd.promise;
  1087→  }
  1088→
  1089→  _completeQueryOnce(q, hash, dfd) {
  1090→    if (!this.queryOnceDfds[hash]) return;
  1091→
  1092→    this.queryOnceDfds[hash] = this.queryOnceDfds[hash].filter(
  1093→      (r) => r.dfd !== dfd,
  1094→    );
  1095→
  1096→    this._cleanupQuery(q, hash);
  1097→  }
  1098→
  1099→  _unsubQuery(q, hash, cb) {
  1100→    if (!this.queryCbs[hash]) return;
  1101→
  1102→    this.queryCbs[hash] = this.queryCbs[hash].filter((r) => r.cb !== cb);
  1103→
  1104→    this._cleanupQuery(q, hash);
  1105→  }
  1106→
  1107→  _hasQueryListeners(hash) {
  1108→    return !!(this.queryCbs[hash]?.length || this.queryOnceDfds[hash]?.length);
  1109→  }
  1110→
  1111→  _cleanupQuery(q, hash) {
  1112→    const hasListeners = this._hasQueryListeners(hash);
  1113→    if (hasListeners) return;
  1114→    delete this.queryCbs[hash];
  1115→    delete this.queryOnceDfds[hash];
  1116→    delete this._dataForQueryCache[hash];
  1117→    this.querySubs.unloadKey(hash);
  1118→
  1119→    this._trySendAuthed(uuid(), { op: 'remove-query', q });
  1120→  }
  1121→
  1122→  // When we `pushTx`, it's possible that we don't yet have `this.attrs`
  1123→  // This means that `tx-steps` in `pendingMutations` will include `add-attr`
  1124→  // commands for attrs that already exist.
  1125→  //
  1126→  // This will also affect `add-triple` and `retract-triple` which
  1127→  // reference attr-ids that do not match the server.
  1128→  //
  1129→  // We fix this by rewriting `tx-steps` in each `pendingMutation`.
  1130→  // We remove `add-attr` commands for attrs that already exist.
  1131→  // We update `add-triple` and `retract-triple` commands to use the
  1132→  // server attr-ids.
  1133→  /**
  1134→   *
  1135→   * @param {s.AttrsStore} attrs
  1136→   * @param {any} muts
  1137→   * @param {number} [processedTxId]
  1138→   */
  1139→  _rewriteMutations(attrs, muts, processedTxId) {
  1140→    if (!attrs) return muts;
  1141→    if (!muts) return new Map();
  1142→    const findExistingAttr = (attr) => {
  1143→      const [_, etype, label] = attr['forward-identity'];
  1144→      const existing = s.getAttrByFwdIdentName(attrs, etype, label);
  1145→      return existing;
  1146→    };
  1147→    const findReverseAttr = (attr) => {
  1148→      const [_, etype, label] = attr['forward-identity'];
  1149→      const revAttr = s.getAttrByReverseIdentName(attrs, etype, label);
  1150→      return revAttr;
  1151→    };
  1152→    const mapping = { attrIdMap: {}, refSwapAttrIds: new Set() };
  1153→    let mappingChanged = false;
  1154→
  1155→    const rewriteTxSteps = (txSteps, txId) => {
  1156→      const retTxSteps = [];
  1157→      for (const txStep of txSteps) {
  1158→        const [action] = txStep;
  1159→
  1160→        // Handles add-attr
  1161→        // If existing, we drop it, and track it
  1162→        // to update add/retract triples
  1163→        if (action === 'add-attr') {
  1164→          const [_action, attr] = txStep;
  1165→          const existing = findExistingAttr(attr);
  1166→          if (existing && attr.id !== existing.id) {
  1167→            mapping.attrIdMap[attr.id] = existing.id;
  1168→            mappingChanged = true;
  1169→            continue;
  1170→          }
  1171→          if (attr['value-type'] === 'ref') {
  1172→            const revAttr = findReverseAttr(attr);
  1173→            if (revAttr) {
  1174→              mapping.attrIdMap[attr.id] = revAttr.id;
  1175→              mapping.refSwapAttrIds.add(attr.id);
  1176→              mappingChanged = true;
  1177→              continue;
  1178→            }
  1179→          }
  1180→        }
  1181→
  1182→        if (
  1183→          (processedTxId &&
  1184→            txId &&
  1185→            processedTxId >= txId &&
  1186→            action === 'add-attr') ||
  1187→          action === 'update-attr' ||
  1188→          action === 'delete-attr'
  1189→        ) {
  1190→          mappingChanged = true;
  1191→          // Don't add this step because we already have the newer attrs
  1192→          continue;
  1193→        }
  1194→        // Handles add-triple|retract-triple
  1195→        // If in mapping, we update the attr-id
  1196→        const newTxStep = mappingChanged
  1197→          ? instaml.rewriteStep(mapping, txStep)
  1198→          : txStep;
  1199→
  1200→        retTxSteps.push(newTxStep);
  1201→      }
  1202→
  1203→      return mappingChanged ? retTxSteps : txSteps;
  1204→    };
  1205→
  1206→    const rewritten = new Map();
  1207→    for (const [k, mut] of muts.entries()) {
  1208→      rewritten.set(k, {
  1209→        ...mut,
  1210→        'tx-steps': rewriteTxSteps(mut['tx-steps'], mut['tx-id']),
  1211→      });
  1212→    }
  1213→    if (!mappingChanged) {
  1214→      return muts;
  1215→    }
  1216→    return rewritten;
  1217→  }
  1218→
  1219→  _rewriteMutationsSorted(attrs, muts) {
  1220→    return sortedMutationEntries(this._rewriteMutations(attrs, muts).entries());
  1221→  }
  1222→
  1223→  // ---------------------------
  1224→  // Transact
  1225→
  1226→  /**
  1227→   * @returns {s.AttrsStore}
  1228→   */
  1229→  optimisticAttrs() {
  1230→    const pendingMutationSteps = [...this._pendingMutations().values()] // hack due to Map()
  1231→      .flatMap((x) => x['tx-steps']);
  1232→
  1233→    const deletedAttrIds = new Set(
  1234→      pendingMutationSteps
  1235→        .filter(([action, _attr]) => action === 'delete-attr')
  1236→        .map(([_action, id]) => id),
  1237→    );
  1238→
  1239→    const pendingAttrs = [];
  1240→    for (const [_action, attr] of pendingMutationSteps) {
  1241→      if (_action === 'add-attr') {
  1242→        pendingAttrs.push(attr);
  1243→      } else if (
  1244→        _action === 'update-attr' &&
  1245→        attr.id &&
  1246→        this.attrs?.getAttr(attr.id)
  1247→      ) {
  1248→        const fullAttr = { ...this.attrs.getAttr(attr.id), ...attr };
  1249→        pendingAttrs.push(fullAttr);
  1250→      }
  1251→    }
  1252→
  1253→    if (!deletedAttrIds.size && !pendingAttrs.length) {
  1254→      return this.attrs || new s.AttrsStoreClass({}, this._linkIndex);
  1255→    }
  1256→
  1257→    const attrs = { ...(this.attrs?.attrs || {}) };
  1258→    for (const attr of pendingAttrs) {
  1259→      attrs[attr.id] = attr;
  1260→    }
  1261→    for (const id of deletedAttrIds) {
  1262→      delete attrs[id];
  1263→    }
  1264→
  1265→    return new s.AttrsStoreClass(attrs, this._linkIndex);
  1266→  }
  1267→
  1268→  /** Runs instaql on a query and a store */
  1269→  dataForQuery(hash, applyOptimistic = true) {
  1270→    const errorMessage = this._errorMessage;
  1271→    if (errorMessage) {
  1272→      return { error: errorMessage };
  1273→    }
  1274→    if (!this.querySubs) return;
  1275→    if (!this.kv.currentValue.pendingMutations) return;
  1276→    const querySubVersion = this.querySubs.version();
  1277→    const querySubs = this.querySubs.currentValue;
  1278→    const pendingMutationsVersion = this.kv.version();
  1279→    const pendingMutations = this._pendingMutations();
  1280→
  1281→    const { q, result } = querySubs[hash] || {};
  1282→    if (!result) return;
  1283→
  1284→    const cached = this._dataForQueryCache[hash];
  1285→    if (
  1286→      cached &&
  1287→      querySubVersion === cached.querySubVersion &&
  1288→      pendingMutationsVersion === cached.pendingMutationsVersion
  1289→    ) {
  1290→      return cached;
  1291→    }
  1292→
  1293→    let store = result.store;
  1294→    let attrsStore = result.attrsStore;
  1295→    const { pageInfo, aggregate, processedTxId } = result;
  1296→    const mutations = this._rewriteMutationsSorted(
  1297→      attrsStore,
  1298→      pendingMutations,
  1299→    );
  1300→    if (applyOptimistic) {
  1301→      const optimisticResult = this._applyOptimisticUpdates(
  1302→        store,
  1303→        attrsStore,
  1304→        mutations,
  1305→        processedTxId,
  1306→      );
  1307→
  1308→      store = optimisticResult.store;
  1309→      attrsStore = optimisticResult.attrsStore;
  1310→    }
  1311→    const resp = instaql(
  1312→      { store: store, attrsStore: attrsStore, pageInfo, aggregate },
  1313→      q,
  1314→    );
  1315→
  1316→    return { data: resp, querySubVersion, pendingMutationsVersion };
  1317→  }
  1318→
  1319→  _applyOptimisticUpdates(store, attrsStore, mutations, processedTxId) {
  1320→    for (const [_, mut] of mutations) {
  1321→      if (!mut['tx-id'] || (processedTxId && mut['tx-id'] > processedTxId)) {
  1322→        const result = s.transact(store, attrsStore, mut['tx-steps']);
  1323→        store = result.store;
  1324→        attrsStore = result.attrsStore;
  1325→      }
  1326→    }
  1327→    return { store, attrsStore };
  1328→  }
  1329→
  1330→  /** Re-run instaql and call all callbacks with new data */
  1331→  notifyOne = (hash) => {
  1332→    const cbs = this.queryCbs[hash] ?? [];
  1333→    const prevData = this._dataForQueryCache[hash]?.data;
  1334→    const resp = this.dataForQuery(hash);
  1335→
  1336→    if (!resp?.data) return;
  1337→    this._dataForQueryCache[hash] = resp;
  1338→    if (areObjectsDeepEqual(resp.data, prevData)) return;
  1339→
  1340→    cbs.forEach((r) => r.cb(resp.data));
  1341→  };
  1342→
  1343→  notifyOneQueryOnce = (hash) => {
  1344→    const dfds = this.queryOnceDfds[hash] ?? [];
  1345→    const data = this.dataForQuery(hash)?.data;
  1346→
  1347→    dfds.forEach((r) => {
  1348→      this._completeQueryOnce(r.q, hash, r.dfd);
  1349→      r.dfd.resolve(data);
  1350→    });
  1351→  };
  1352→
  1353→  notifyQueryError = (hash, error) => {
  1354→    const cbs = this.queryCbs[hash] || [];
  1355→    cbs.forEach((r) => r.cb({ error }));
  1356→  };
  1357→
  1358→  /** Re-compute all subscriptions */
  1359→  notifyAll() {
  1360→    Object.keys(this.queryCbs).forEach((hash) => {
  1361→      this.querySubs
  1362→        .waitForKeyToLoad(hash)
  1363→        .then(() => this.notifyOne(hash))
  1364→        .catch(() => this.notifyOne(hash));
  1365→    });
  1366→  }
  1367→
  1368→  loadedNotifyAll() {
  1369→    this.kv
  1370→      .waitForKeyToLoad('pendingMutations')
  1371→      .then(() => this.notifyAll())
  1372→      .catch(() => this.notifyAll());
  1373→  }
  1374→
  1375→  /** Applies transactions locally and sends transact message to server */
  1376→  pushTx = (chunks) => {
  1377→    // Throws if transactions are invalid
  1378→    if (!this.config.disableValidation) {
  1379→      validateTransactions(chunks, this.config.schema);
  1380→    }
  1381→    try {
  1382→      const txSteps = instaml.transform(
  1383→        {
  1384→          attrsStore: this.optimisticAttrs(),
  1385→          schema: this.config.schema,
  1386→          stores: Object.values(this.querySubs.currentValue).map(
  1387→            (sub) => sub?.result?.store,
  1388→          ),
  1389→          useDateObjects: this.config.useDateObjects,
  1390→        },
  1391→        chunks,
  1392→      );
  1393→      return this.pushOps(txSteps);
  1394→    } catch (e) {
  1395→      return this.pushOps([], e);
  1396→    }
  1397→  };
  1398→
  1399→  /**
  1400→   * @param {*} txSteps
  1401→   * @param {*} [error]
  1402→   * @returns
  1403→   */
  1404→  pushOps = (txSteps, error) => {
  1405→    const eventId = uuid();
  1406→    const mutations = [...this._pendingMutations().values()];
  1407→    const order = Math.max(0, ...mutations.map((mut) => mut.order || 0)) + 1;
  1408→    const mutation = {
  1409→      op: 'transact',
  1410→      'tx-steps': txSteps,
  1411→      created: Date.now(),
  1412→      error,
  1413→      order,
  1414→    };
  1415→    this._updatePendingMutations((prev) => {
  1416→      prev.set(eventId, mutation);
  1417→    });
  1418→
  1419→    const dfd = new Deferred();
  1420→    this.mutationDeferredStore.set(eventId, dfd);
  1421→    this._sendMutation(eventId, mutation);
  1422→
  1423→    this.notifyAll();
  1424→
  1425→    return dfd.promise;
  1426→  };
  1427→
  1428→  shutdown() {
  1429→    this._log.info('[shutdown]', this.config.appId);
  1430→    this._isShutdown = true;
  1431→    this._transport?.close();
  1432→  }
  1433→
  1434→  /**
  1435→   * Sends mutation to server and schedules a timeout to cancel it if
  1436→   * we don't hear back in time.
  1437→   * Note: If we're offline we don't schedule a timeout, we'll schedule it
  1438→   * later once we're back online and send the mutation again
  1439→   *
  1440→   */
  1441→  _sendMutation(eventId, mutation) {
  1442→    if (mutation.error) {
  1443→      this._handleMutationError('error', eventId, {
  1444→        message: mutation.error.message,
  1445→      });
  1446→      return;
  1447→    }
  1448→    if (this.status !== STATUS.AUTHENTICATED) {
  1449→      this._finishTransaction('enqueued', eventId);
  1450→      return;
  1451→    }
  1452→    const timeoutMs = Math.max(
  1453→      6000,
  1454→      Math.min(
  1455→        this._inFlightMutationEventIds.size + 1,
  1456→        // Defensive code in case we don't clean up in flight mutation event ids
  1457→        this._pendingMutations().size + 1,
  1458→      ) * 6000,
  1459→    );
  1460→
  1461→    if (!this._isOnline) {
  1462→      this._finishTransaction('enqueued', eventId);
  1463→    } else {
  1464→      this._trySend(eventId, mutation);
  1465→
  1466→      setTimeout(() => {
  1467→        if (!this._isOnline) {
  1468→          return;
  1469→        }
  1470→        // If we are here, this means that we have sent this mutation, we are online
  1471→        // but we have not received a response. If it's this long, something must be wrong,
  1472→        // so we error with a timeout.
  1473→        this._handleMutationError('timeout', eventId, {
  1474→          message: 'transaction timed out',
  1475→        });
  1476→      }, timeoutMs);
  1477→    }
  1478→  }
  1479→
  1480→  // ---------------------------
  1481→  // Websocket
  1482→
  1483→  /** Send messages we accumulated while we were connecting */
  1484→  _flushPendingMessages() {
  1485→    const subs = Object.keys(this.queryCbs).map((hash) => {
  1486→      return this.querySubs.currentValue[hash];
  1487→    });
  1488→    // Note: we should not have any nulls in subs, but we're
  1489→    // doing this defensively just in case.
  1490→    const safeSubs = subs.filter((x) => x);
  1491→    safeSubs.forEach(({ eventId, q }) => {
  1492→      this._trySendAuthed(eventId, { op: 'add-query', q });
  1493→    });
  1494→
  1495→    Object.values(this.queryOnceDfds)
  1496→      .flat()
  1497→      .forEach(({ eventId, q }) => {
  1498→        this._trySendAuthed(eventId, { op: 'add-query', q });
  1499→      });
  1500→
  1501→    const muts = this._rewriteMutationsSorted(
  1502→      this.ensureAttrs(),
  1503→      this._pendingMutations(),
  1504→    );
  1505→    muts.forEach(([eventId, mut]) => {
  1506→      if (!mut['tx-id']) {
  1507→        this._sendMutation(eventId, mut);
  1508→      }
  1509→    });
  1510→
  1511→    this._syncTable.flushPending();
  1512→  }
  1513→
  1514→  /**
  1515→   * Clean up pendingMutations that all queries have seen
  1516→   */
  1517→  _cleanupPendingMutationsQueries() {
  1518→    let minProcessedTxId = Number.MAX_SAFE_INTEGER;
  1519→    for (const { result } of Object.values(this.querySubs.currentValue)) {
  1520→      if (result?.processedTxId) {
  1521→        minProcessedTxId = Math.min(minProcessedTxId, result?.processedTxId);
  1522→      }
  1523→    }
  1524→
  1525→    this._updatePendingMutations((prev) => {
  1526→      for (const [eventId, mut] of Array.from(prev.entries())) {
  1527→        if (mut['tx-id'] && mut['tx-id'] <= minProcessedTxId) {
  1528→          prev.delete(eventId);
  1529→        }
  1530→      }
  1531→    });
  1532→  }
  1533→
  1534→  /**
  1535→   * After mutations is confirmed by server, we give each query 30 sec
  1536→   * to update its results. If that doesn't happen, we assume query is
  1537→   * unaffected by this mutation and it’s safe to delete it from local queue
  1538→   */
  1539→  _cleanupPendingMutationsTimeout() {
  1540→    if (this._pendingMutations().size < this._pendingMutationCleanupThreshold) {
  1541→      return;
  1542→    }
  1543→
  1544→    const now = Date.now();
  1545→
  1546→    this._updatePendingMutations((prev) => {
  1547→      for (const [eventId, mut] of Array.from(prev.entries())) {
  1548→        if (
  1549→          mut.confirmed &&
  1550→          mut.confirmed + this._pendingTxCleanupTimeout < now
  1551→        ) {
  1552→          prev.delete(eventId);
  1553→        }
  1554→      }
  1555→    });
  1556→  }
  1557→
  1558→  _trySendAuthed(...args) {
  1559→    if (this.status !== STATUS.AUTHENTICATED) {
  1560→      return;
  1561→    }
  1562→    this._trySend(...args);
  1563→  }
  1564→
  1565→  _trySend(eventId, msg, opts) {
  1566→    if (!this._transport.isOpen()) {
  1567→      return;
  1568→    }
  1569→    if (!ignoreLogging[msg.op]) {
  1570→      this._log.info('[send]', this._transport.id, msg.op, msg);
  1571→    }
  1572→    switch (msg.op) {
  1573→      case 'transact': {
  1574→        this._inFlightMutationEventIds.add(eventId);
  1575→        break;
  1576→      }
  1577→      case 'init': {
  1578→        // New connection, so we can't have any mutations in flight
  1579→        this._inFlightMutationEventIds.clear();
  1580→      }
  1581→    }
  1582→    this._transport.send({ 'client-event-id': eventId, ...msg });
  1583→  }
  1584→
  1585→  _transportOnOpen = (e) => {
  1586→    const targetTransport = e.target;
  1587→    if (this._transport !== targetTransport) {
  1588→      this._log.info(
  1589→        '[socket][open]',
  1590→        targetTransport.id,
  1591→        'skip; this is no longer the current transport',
  1592→      );
  1593→      return;
  1594→    }
  1595→    this._log.info('[socket][open]', this._transport.id);
  1596→    this._setStatus(STATUS.OPENED);
  1597→
  1598→    this.getCurrentUser()
  1599→      .then((resp) => {
  1600→        this._trySend(uuid(), {
  1601→          op: 'init',
  1602→          'app-id': this.config.appId,
  1603→          'refresh-token': resp.user?.['refresh_token'],
  1604→          versions: this.versions,
  1605→          // If an admin token is provided for an app, we will
  1606→          // skip all permission checks. This is an advanced feature,
  1607→          // to let users write internal tools
  1608→          // This option is not exposed in `Config`, as it's
  1609→          // not ready for prime time
  1610→          '__admin-token': this.config.__adminToken,
  1611→        });
  1612→      })
  1613→      .catch((e) => {
  1614→        this._log.error('[socket][error]', targetTransport.id, e);
  1615→      });
  1616→  };
  1617→
  1618→  _transportOnMessage = (e) => {
  1619→    const targetTransport = e.target;
  1620→    const m = e.message;
  1621→    if (this._transport !== targetTransport) {
  1622→      this._log.info(
  1623→        '[socket][message]',
  1624→        targetTransport.id,
  1625→        m,
  1626→        'skip; this is no longer the current transport',
  1627→      );
  1628→      return;
  1629→    }
  1630→
  1631→    if (!this._wsOk && targetTransport.type === 'ws') {
  1632→      this._wsOk = true;
  1633→    }
  1634→    // Try to reconnect via websocket the next time we connect
  1635→    this._transportType = 'ws';
  1636→    if (Array.isArray(e.message)) {
  1637→      for (const msg of e.message) {
  1638→        this._handleReceive(targetTransport.id, msg);
  1639→      }
  1640→    } else {
  1641→      this._handleReceive(targetTransport.id, e.message);
  1642→    }
  1643→  };
  1644→
  1645→  _transportOnError = (e) => {
  1646→    const targetTransport = e.target;
  1647→    if (this._transport !== targetTransport) {
  1648→      this._log.info(
  1649→        '[socket][error]',
  1650→        targetTransport.id,
  1651→        'skip; this is no longer the current transport',
  1652→      );
  1653→      return;
  1654→    }
  1655→    this._log.error('[socket][error]', targetTransport.id, e);
  1656→  };
  1657→
  1658→  _scheduleReconnect = () => {
  1659→    // If we couldn't connect with a websocket last time, try sse
  1660→    if (!this._wsOk && this._transportType !== 'sse') {
  1661→      this._transportType = 'sse';
  1662→      this._reconnectTimeoutMs = 0;
  1663→    }
  1664→    setTimeout(() => {
  1665→      this._reconnectTimeoutMs = Math.min(
  1666→        this._reconnectTimeoutMs + 1000,
  1667→        10000,
  1668→      );
  1669→      if (!this._isOnline) {
  1670→        this._log.info(
  1671→          '[socket][close]',
  1672→          this._transport.id,
  1673→          'we are offline, no need to start socket',
  1674→        );
  1675→        return;
  1676→      }
  1677→
  1678→      this._startSocket();
  1679→    }, this._reconnectTimeoutMs);
  1680→  };
  1681→
  1682→  _transportOnClose = (e) => {
  1683→    const targetTransport = e.target;
  1684→    if (this._transport !== targetTransport) {
  1685→      this._log.info(
  1686→        '[socket][close]',
  1687→        targetTransport.id,
  1688→        'skip; this is no longer the current transport',
  1689→      );
  1690→      return;
  1691→    }
  1692→
  1693→    this._setStatus(STATUS.CLOSED);
  1694→
  1695→    for (const room of Object.values(this._rooms)) {
  1696→      room.isConnected = false;
  1697→    }
  1698→
  1699→    if (this._isShutdown) {
  1700→      this._log.info(
  1701→        '[socket][close]',
  1702→        targetTransport.id,
  1703→        'Reactor has been shut down and will not reconnect',
  1704→      );
  1705→      return;
  1706→    }
  1707→    this._log.info(
  1708→      '[socket][close]',
  1709→      targetTransport.id,
  1710→      'schedule reconnect, ms =',
  1711→      this._reconnectTimeoutMs,
  1712→    );
  1713→    this._scheduleReconnect();
  1714→  };
  1715→
  1716→  _startSocket() {
  1717→    // Reset whether we support websockets each time we connect
  1718→    // new networks may not support websockets
  1719→    this._wsOk = null;
  1720→    if (this._isShutdown) {
  1721→      this._log.info(
  1722→        '[socket][start]',
  1723→        this.config.appId,
  1724→        'Reactor has been shut down and will not start a new socket',
  1725→      );
  1726→      return;
  1727→    }
  1728→    if (this._transport && this._transport.isConnecting()) {
  1729→      // Our current websocket is in a 'connecting' state.
  1730→      // There's no need to start another one, as the socket is
  1731→      // effectively fresh.
  1732→      this._log.info(
  1733→        '[socket][start]',
  1734→        this._transport.id,
  1735→        'maintained as current transport, we were still in a connecting state',
  1736→      );
  1737→      return;
  1738→    }
  1739→    const prevTransport = this._transport;
  1740→    this._transport = createTransport({
  1741→      transportType: this._transportType,
  1742→      appId: this.config.appId,
  1743→      apiURI: this.config.apiURI,
  1744→      wsURI: this.config.websocketURI,
  1745→      EventSourceImpl: this._EventSource,
  1746→    });
  1747→    this._transport.onopen = this._transportOnOpen;
  1748→    this._transport.onmessage = this._transportOnMessage;
  1749→    this._transport.onclose = this._transportOnClose;
  1750→    this._transport.onerror = this._transportOnError;
  1751→    this._log.info('[socket][start]', this._transport.id);
  1752→    if (prevTransport?.isOpen()) {
  1753→      // When the network dies, it doesn't always mean that our
  1754→      // socket connection will fire a close event.
  1755→      //
  1756→      // We _could_ re-use the old socket, if the network drop was a
  1757→      // few seconds. But, to be safe right now we always create a new socket.
  1758→      //
  1759→      // This means that we have to make sure to kill the previous one ourselves.
  1760→      // c.f https://issues.chromium.org/issues/41343684
  1761→      this._log.info(
  1762→        '[socket][start]',
  1763→        this._transport.id,
  1764→        'close previous transport id = ',
  1765→        prevTransport.id,
  1766→      );
  1767→      prevTransport.close();
  1768→    }
  1769→  }
  1770→
  1771→  /**
  1772→   * Given a key, returns a stable local id, unique to this device and app.
  1773→   *
  1774→   * This can be useful if you want to create guest ids for example.
  1775→   *
  1776→   * Note: If the user deletes their local storage, this id will change.
  1777→   *
  1778→   */
  1779→  async getLocalId(name) {
  1780→    const k = `localToken_${name}`;
  1781→    if (this.kv.currentValue[k]) {
  1782→      return this.kv.currentValue[k];
  1783→    }
  1784→
  1785→    const current = await this.kv.waitForKeyToLoad(k);
  1786→    if (current) {
  1787→      return current;
  1788→    }
  1789→    const newId = uuid();
  1790→    this.kv.updateInPlace((prev) => {
  1791→      if (prev[k]) return;
  1792→      prev[k] = newId;
  1793→    });
  1794→    return await this.kv.waitForKeyToLoad(k);
  1795→  }
  1796→
  1797→  // ----
  1798→  // Auth
  1799→  _replaceUrlAfterOAuth() {
  1800→    if (typeof URL === 'undefined') {
  1801→      return;
  1802→    }
  1803→    const url = new URL(window.location.href);
  1804→    if (url.searchParams.get(OAUTH_REDIRECT_PARAM)) {
  1805→      const startUrl = url.toString();
  1806→      url.searchParams.delete(OAUTH_REDIRECT_PARAM);
  1807→      url.searchParams.delete('code');
  1808→      url.searchParams.delete('error');
  1809→      const newPath =
  1810→        url.pathname +
  1811→        (url.searchParams.size ? '?' + url.searchParams : '') +
  1812→        url.hash;
  1813→      // Note: In next.js, this will revert to the old state if user navigates
  1814→      //       back. We would need to allow framework specific routing to work
  1815→      //       around that problem.
  1816→      history.replaceState(history.state, '', newPath);
  1817→
  1818→      // navigation is part of the HTML spec, but not supported by Safari
  1819→      // or Firefox yet:
  1820→      // https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/API/Navigation_API#browser_compatibility
  1821→      if (
  1822→        // @ts-ignore (waiting for ts support)
  1823→        typeof navigation === 'object' &&
  1824→        // @ts-ignore (waiting for ts support)
  1825→        typeof navigation.addEventListener === 'function' &&
  1826→        // @ts-ignore (waiting for ts support)
  1827→        typeof navigation.removeEventListener === 'function'
  1828→      ) {
  1829→        let ran = false;
  1830→
  1831→        // The next.js app router will reset the URL when the router loads.
  1832→        // This puts it back after the router loads.
  1833→        const listener = (e) => {
  1834→          if (!ran) {
  1835→            ran = true;
  1836→            // @ts-ignore (waiting for ts support)
  1837→            navigation.removeEventListener('navigate', listener);
  1838→            if (
  1839→              !e.userInitiated &&
  1840→              e.navigationType === 'replace' &&
  1841→              e.destination?.url === startUrl
  1842→            ) {
  1843→              history.replaceState(history.state, '', newPath);
  1844→            }
  1845→          }
  1846→        };
  1847→        // @ts-ignore (waiting for ts support)
  1848→        navigation.addEventListener('navigate', listener);
  1849→      }
  1850→    }
  1851→  }
  1852→
  1853→  /**
  1854→   *
  1855→   * @returns Promise<null | {error: {message: string}}>
  1856→   */
  1857→  async _oauthLoginInit() {
  1858→    if (
  1859→      typeof window === 'undefined' ||
  1860→      typeof window.location === 'undefined' ||
  1861→      typeof URLSearchParams === 'undefined'
  1862→    ) {
  1863→      return null;
  1864→    }
  1865→    const params = new URLSearchParams(window.location.search);
  1866→    if (!params.get(OAUTH_REDIRECT_PARAM)) {
  1867→      return null;
  1868→    }
  1869→
  1870→    const error = params.get('error');
  1871→    if (error) {
  1872→      this._replaceUrlAfterOAuth();
  1873→      return { error: { message: error } };
  1874→    }
  1875→    const code = params.get('code');
  1876→    if (!code) {
  1877→      return null;
  1878→    }
  1879→    this._replaceUrlAfterOAuth();
  1880→    try {
  1881→      const currentUser = await this._getCurrentUser();
  1882→      const isGuest = currentUser?.type === 'guest';
  1883→      const { user } = await authAPI.exchangeCodeForToken({
  1884→        apiURI: this.config.apiURI,
  1885→        appId: this.config.appId,
  1886→        code,
  1887→        refreshToken: isGuest ? currentUser.refresh_token : undefined,
  1888→      });
  1889→      this.setCurrentUser(user);
  1890→      return null;
  1891→    } catch (e) {
  1892→      if (
  1893→        e?.body?.type === 'record-not-found' &&
  1894→        e?.body?.hint?.['record-type'] === 'app-oauth-code' &&
  1895→        (await this._hasCurrentUser())
  1896→      ) {
  1897→        // We probably just weren't able to clean up the URL, so
  1898→        // let's just ignore this error
  1899→        return null;
  1900→      }
  1901→      const message = e?.body?.message || 'Error logging in.';
  1902→      return { error: { message } };
  1903→    }
  1904→  }
  1905→
  1906→  async _waitForOAuthCallbackResponse() {
  1907→    return await this._oauthCallbackResponse;
  1908→  }
  1909→
  1910→  __subscribeMutationErrors(cb) {
  1911→    this.mutationErrorCbs.push(cb);
  1912→
  1913→    return () => {
  1914→      this.mutationErrorCbs = this.mutationErrorCbs.filter((x) => x !== cb);
  1915→    };
  1916→  }
  1917→
  1918→  subscribeAuth(cb) {
  1919→    this.authCbs.push(cb);
  1920→    const currUserCached = this._currentUserCached;
  1921→    if (!currUserCached.isLoading) {
  1922→      cb(this._currentUserCached);
  1923→    }
  1924→    let unsubbed = false;
  1925→    this.getCurrentUser().then((resp) => {
  1926→      if (unsubbed) return;
  1927→      if (areObjectsDeepEqual(resp, currUserCached)) return;
  1928→      cb(resp);
  1929→    });
  1930→    return () => {
  1931→      unsubbed = true;
  1932→      this.authCbs = this.authCbs.filter((x) => x !== cb);
  1933→    };
  1934→  }
  1935→
  1936→  async getAuth() {
  1937→    const { user, error } = await this.getCurrentUser();
  1938→    if (error) {
  1939→      throw new InstantError('Could not get current user: ' + error.message);
  1940→    }
  1941→    return user;
  1942→  }
  1943→
  1944→  subscribeConnectionStatus(cb) {
  1945→    this.connectionStatusCbs.push(cb);
  1946→
  1947→    return () => {
  1948→      this.connectionStatusCbs = this.connectionStatusCbs.filter(
  1949→        (x) => x !== cb,
  1950→      );
  1951→    };
  1952→  }
  1953→
  1954→  subscribeAttrs(cb) {
  1955→    this.attrsCbs.push(cb);
  1956→
  1957→    if (this.attrs) {
  1958→      cb(this.attrs.attrs);
  1959→    }
  1960→
  1961→    return () => {
  1962→      this.attrsCbs = this.attrsCbs.filter((x) => x !== cb);
  1963→    };
  1964→  }
  1965→
  1966→  notifyAuthSubs(user) {
  1967→    this.authCbs.forEach((cb) => cb(user));
  1968→  }
  1969→
  1970→  notifyMutationErrorSubs(error) {
  1971→    this.mutationErrorCbs.forEach((cb) => cb(error));
  1972→  }
  1973→
  1974→  notifyAttrsSubs() {
  1975→    if (!this.attrs) return;
  1976→    const oas = this.optimisticAttrs();
  1977→    this.attrsCbs.forEach((cb) => cb(oas.attrs));
  1978→  }
  1979→
  1980→  notifyConnectionStatusSubs(status) {
  1981→    this.connectionStatusCbs.forEach((cb) => cb(status));
  1982→  }
  1983→
  1984→  async setCurrentUser(user) {
  1985→    this.kv.updateInPlace((prev) => {
  1986→      prev[currentUserKey] = user;
  1987→    });
  1988→    await this.kv.waitForKeyToLoad(currentUserKey);
  1989→  }
  1990→
  1991→  getCurrentUserCached() {
  1992→    return this._currentUserCached;
  1993→  }
  1994→
  1995→  async _getCurrentUser() {
  1996→    const user = await this.kv.waitForKeyToLoad(currentUserKey);
  1997→    return typeof user === 'string' ? JSON.parse(user) : user;
  1998→  }
  1999→
  2000→  async getCurrentUser() {
  2001→    const oauthResp = await this._waitForOAuthCallbackResponse();
  2002→    if (oauthResp?.error) {
  2003→      const errorV = { error: oauthResp.error, user: undefined };
  2004→      this._currentUserCached = { isLoading: false, ...errorV };
  2005→      return errorV;
  2006→    }
  2007→    try {
  2008→      const user = await this._getCurrentUser();
  2009→      const userV = { user: user, error: undefined };
  2010→      this._currentUserCached = {
  2011→        isLoading: false,
  2012→        ...userV,
  2013→      };
  2014→      return userV;
  2015→    } catch (e) {
  2016→      return {
  2017→        user: undefined,
  2018→        isLoading: false,
  2019→        error: { message: e?.message || 'Error loading user' },
  2020→      };
  2021→    }
  2022→  }
  2023→
  2024→  async _hasCurrentUser() {
  2025→    const user = await this.kv.waitForKeyToLoad(currentUserKey);
  2026→    return typeof user === 'string' ? JSON.parse(user) != null : user != null;
  2027→  }
  2028→
  2029→  async changeCurrentUser(newUser) {
  2030→    const { user: oldUser } = await this.getCurrentUser();
  2031→    if (areObjectsDeepEqual(oldUser, newUser)) {
  2032→      // We were already logged in as the newUser, don't
  2033→      // bother updating
  2034→      return;
  2035→    }
  2036→    await this.setCurrentUser(newUser);
  2037→    // We need to remove all `result` from querySubs,
  2038→    // as they are no longer valid for the new user
  2039→    this.updateUser(newUser);
  2040→
  2041→    try {
  2042→      this._broadcastChannel?.postMessage({ type: 'auth' });
  2043→    } catch (error) {
  2044→      console.error('Error posting message to broadcast channel', error);
  2045→    }
  2046→  }
  2047→
  2048→  async syncUserToEndpoint(user) {
  2049→    if (!this.config.firstPartyPath) return;
  2050→    try {
  2051→      fetch(this.config.firstPartyPath + '/', {
  2052→        method: 'POST',
  2053→        body: JSON.stringify({
  2054→          type: 'sync-user',
  2055→          appId: this.config.appId,
  2056→          user: user,
  2057→        }),
  2058→        headers: {
  2059→          'Content-Type': 'application/json',
  2060→        },
  2061→      });
  2062→    } catch (error) {
  2063→      this._log.error('Error syncing user with external endpoint', error);
  2064→    }
  2065→  }
  2066→
  2067→  updateUser(newUser) {
  2068→    this.syncUserToEndpoint(newUser);
  2069→
  2070→    const newV = { error: undefined, user: newUser };
  2071→    this._currentUserCached = { isLoading: false, ...newV };
  2072→    this._dataForQueryCache = {};
  2073→    this.querySubs.updateInPlace((prev) => {
  2074→      Object.keys(prev).forEach((k) => {
  2075→        delete prev[k].result;
  2076→      });
  2077→    });
  2078→    this._reconnectTimeoutMs = 0;
  2079→    this._transport.close();
  2080→    this._oauthCallbackResponse = null;
  2081→    this.notifyAuthSubs(newV);
  2082→  }
  2083→
  2084→  sendMagicCode({ email }) {
  2085→    return authAPI.sendMagicCode({
  2086→      apiURI: this.config.apiURI,
  2087→      appId: this.config.appId,
  2088→      email: email,
  2089→    });
  2090→  }
  2091→
  2092→  async signInWithMagicCode({ email, code }) {
  2093→    const currentUser = await this.getCurrentUser();
  2094→    const isGuest = currentUser?.user?.type === 'guest';
  2095→    const res = await authAPI.verifyMagicCode({
  2096→      apiURI: this.config.apiURI,
  2097→      appId: this.config.appId,
  2098→      email,
  2099→      code,
  2100→      refreshToken: isGuest ? currentUser.user.refresh_token : undefined,
  2101→    });
  2102→    await this.changeCurrentUser(res.user);
  2103→    return res;
  2104→  }
  2105→
  2106→  async signInWithCustomToken(authToken) {
  2107→    const res = await authAPI.verifyRefreshToken({
  2108→      apiURI: this.config.apiURI,
  2109→      appId: this.config.appId,
  2110→      refreshToken: authToken,
  2111→    });
  2112→    await this.changeCurrentUser(res.user);
  2113→    return res;
  2114→  }
  2115→
  2116→  async signInAsGuest() {
