   225→        // Coming back online - connection will auto-reconnect
   226→        // Pending mutations will be flushed in handleInitOk after reconnection
   227→        InstantLog.debug("[InstantDB] Device is back online, connection will auto-reconnect")
   228→      }
   229→    }
   230→
   231→    connection.onMessage = { [weak self] message in
   232→      self?.handleServerMessage(message)
   233→    }
   234→
   235→    connection.onError = { error in
   236→      InstantLog.warning("[InstantDB] Error: \(error.localizedDescription)")
   237→    }
   238→
   239→    connection.onOpen = { [weak self] in
   240→      Task { @MainActor in
   241→        guard let self = self else { return }
   242→        await self.authManager.restoreAuth()
   243→        self.sendInitMessage()
   244→        // Resend room joins on reconnect
   245→        self.presence.resendRoomJoins()
   246→      }
   247→    }
   248→
   249→    // Set up query manager callback for removing queries
   250→    queryManager.onRemoveQuery = { [weak self] query in
   251→      self?.sendRemoveQuery(query)
   252→    }
   253→  }
   254→  
   255→  private func setupMessageHandlers() {
   256→    messageHandlers["init-ok"] = { [weak self] message in
   257→      self?.handleInitOk(message)
   258→    }
   259→
   260→    messageHandlers["add-query-ok"] = { [weak self] message in
   261→      self?.handleAddQueryOk(message)
   262→    }
   263→
   264→    messageHandlers["add-query-exists"] = { [weak self] message in
   265→      self?.handleAddQueryExists(message)
   266→    }
   267→
   268→    messageHandlers["remove-query-ok"] = { [weak self] message in
   269→      self?.handleRemoveQueryOk(message)
   270→    }
   271→
   272→    messageHandlers["transact-ok"] = { [weak self] message in
   273→      self?.handleTransactOk(message)
   274→    }
   275→
   276→    messageHandlers["refresh-ok"] = { [weak self] message in
   277→      self?.handleRefreshOk(message)
   278→    }
   279→
   280→    messageHandlers["error"] = { [weak self] message in
   281→      self?.handleError(message)
   282→    }
   283→    
   284→    // Presence/Room message handlers
   285→    messageHandlers["join-room-ok"] = { [weak self] message in
   286→      self?.handleJoinRoomOk(message)
   287→    }
   288→    
   289→    messageHandlers["refresh-presence"] = { [weak self] message in
   290→      self?.handleRefreshPresence(message)
   291→    }
   292→    
   293→    messageHandlers["patch-presence"] = { [weak self] message in
   294→      self?.handlePatchPresence(message)
   295→    }
   296→    
   297→    messageHandlers["server-broadcast"] = { [weak self] message in
   298→      self?.handleServerBroadcast(message)
   299→    }
   300→    
   301→    messageHandlers["room-error"] = { [weak self] message in
   302→      self?.handleRoomError(message)
   303→    }
   304→    
   305→    // Acknowledgment handlers (no action needed, just prevents "Unhandled" warnings)
   306→    messageHandlers["set-presence-ok"] = { _ in
   307→      // Acknowledgment that presence was set successfully
   308→    }
   309→    
   310→    messageHandlers["leave-room-ok"] = { _ in
   311→      // Acknowledgment that room was left successfully
   312→    }
   313→    
   314→    messageHandlers["client-broadcast-ok"] = { _ in
   315→      // Acknowledgment that a client broadcast was sent successfully
   316→    }
   317→  }
   318→  
   319→  /// Connect to InstantDB server
   320→  public func connect() {
   321→    connection.connect()
   322→  }
   323→  
   324→  /// Disconnect from InstantDB server
   325→  public func disconnect() {
   326→    connection.shutdown()
   327→    isAuthenticated = false
   328→    sessionID = nil
   329→    attributes = []
   330→    authInfo = nil
   331→  }
   332→  
   333→  private func sendInitMessage() {
   334→    let message = InitMessage(
   335→      clientEventId: UUID().uuidString,
   336→      appId: appID,
   337→      refreshToken: authManager.refreshToken
   338→    )
   339→
   340→    do {
   341→      try connection.send(message)
   342→    } catch {
   343→      InstantLog.warning("[InstantDB] Failed to send init message: \(error)")
   344→    }
   345→  }
   346→
   347→  private func sendRemoveQuery(_ query: [String: Any]) {
   348→    guard connectionState == .authenticated else { return }
   349→
   350→    let message = RemoveQueryMessage(
   351→      clientEventId: UUID().uuidString,
   352→      query: query
   353→    )
   354→
   355→    do {
   356→      try connection.send(message)
   357→      InstantLog.debug("[InstantDB] → Sent remove-query")
   358→    } catch {
   359→      InstantLog.warning("[InstantDB] Failed to send remove-query: \(error)")
   360→    }
   361→  }
   362→  
   363→  private func handleServerMessage(_ message: ServerMessage) {
   364→    InstantLog.debug("[InstantDB] ← Received: \(message.op)")
   365→    
   366→    if let handler = messageHandlers[message.op] {
   367→      handler(message)
   368→    } else {
   369→      InstantLog.warning("[InstantDB] Unhandled message type: \(message.op)")
   370→    }
   371→  }
   372→  
   373→  private func handleInitOk(_ message: ServerMessage) {
   374→    guard let sessionId = message.data["session-id"]?.value as? String else {
   375→      InstantLog.warning("[InstantDB] Init-ok missing session-id")
   376→      return
   377→    }
   378→    
   379→    Task { @MainActor in
   380→      self.sessionID = sessionId
   381→      
   382→      // Update presence manager with session ID
   383→      self.presence.sessionId = sessionId
   384→      
   385→      if let attrsData = message.data["attrs"]?.value {
   386→        do {
   387→          let data = try JSONSerialization.data(withJSONObject: attrsData)
   388→          let attrs = try JSONDecoder().decode([Attribute].self, from: data)
   389→          
   390→          let merged = self.mergingServerAttributes(attrs)
   391→          self.attributes = merged
   392→
   393→          if let localStorage {
   394→            do {
   395→              try await localStorage.saveAttrs(merged)
   396→            } catch {
   397→              InstantLog.warning("[InstantDB] Failed to persist attributes for offline mode: \(error)")
   398→            }
   399→          }
   400→        } catch {
   401→          InstantLog.warning("[InstantDB] Failed to decode attributes: \(error)")
   402→        }
   403→      }
   404→      
   405→      if let authData = message.data["auth"]?.value {
   406→        do {
   407→          let data = try JSONSerialization.data(withJSONObject: authData)
   408→          let auth = try JSONDecoder().decode(AuthInfo.self, from: data)
   409→          self.authInfo = auth
   410→          self.isAuthenticated = auth.user != nil
   411→          
   412→          if let user = auth.user {
   413→            try? self.authManager.saveAuth(user)
   414→          }
   415→        } catch {
   416→          InstantLog.warning("[InstantDB] Failed to decode auth info: \(error)")
   417→        }
   418→      }
   419→      
   420→      InstantLog.info("[InstantDB] ✓ Connected! Session: \(sessionId)")
   421→      InstantLog.info("[InstantDB] ✓ Loaded \(self.attributes.count) attributes")
   422→      
   423→      if let auth = self.authInfo {
   424→        InstantLog.info("[InstantDB] ✓ Authenticated as: \(auth.user?.email ?? "guest")")
   425→      }
   426→      
   427→      // Resend all active queries after reconnection
   428→      // This ensures data is refreshed after connection recovery
   429→      self.resendActiveQueries()
   430→
   431→      // Flush queued mutations after reconnect.
   432→      // We intentionally do this after resending queries so that refresh updates
   433→      // caused by these mutations can be delivered to active subscriptions.
   434→      await self.flushPendingMutations()
   435→    }
   436→  }
   437→  
   438→  /// Resend all active queries to the server
   439→  /// Called after reconnection to refresh data
   440→  private func resendActiveQueries() {
   441→    let activeQueries = queryManager.getActiveQueries()
   442→    
   443→    guard !activeQueries.isEmpty else {
   444→      InstantLog.debug("[InstantDB] No active queries to resend")
   445→      return
   446→    }
   447→    
   448→    InstantLog.debug("[InstantDB] ↻ Resending \(activeQueries.count) active queries after reconnection...")
   449→    
   450→    for (eventId, query) in activeQueries {
   451→      let message = AddQueryMessage(
   452→        clientEventId: eventId,
   453→        query: query
   454→      )
   455→      
   456→      do {
   457→        try connection.send(message)
   458→        if let namespace = query.keys.first {
   459→          InstantLog.debug("[InstantDB]   → Resent query for '\(namespace)'")
   460→        }
   461→      } catch {
   462→        InstantLog.warning("[InstantDB]   ✗ Failed to resend query: \(error)")
   463→      }
   464→    }
   465→    
   466→    InstantLog.debug("[InstantDB] ✓ All active queries resent")
   467→  }
   468→  
   469→  private func handleAddQueryOk(_ message: ServerMessage) {
   470→    if let resultValue = message.data["result"]?.value,
   471→         let jsonData = try? JSONSerialization.data(withJSONObject: resultValue, options: .prettyPrinted),
   472→         let jsonString = String(data: jsonData, encoding: .utf8) {
   473→        InstantLog.debug("[InstantDB] DEBUG add-query-ok full result:")
   474→        InstantLog.debug(jsonString)
   475→      }
   476→
   477→    if let processedTxValue = message.data["processed-tx-id"]?.value,
   478→       let processedTxId = parseInt64(processedTxValue) {
   479→      Task { @MainActor in
   480→        await self.persistAndCleanupProcessedTxId(processedTxId)
   481→      }
   482→    }
   483→    
   484→    // Parse result array
   485→    guard let resultArray = message.data["result"]?.value as? [[String: Any]] else {
   486→      InstantLog.warning("[InstantDB] Add-query-ok missing result array")
   487→      return
   488→    }
   489→
   490→    // Let QueryManager process the result with client-side sorting
   491→    // (QueryManager has access to the subscription's query which contains the order)
   492→    Task { @MainActor in
   493→      self.queryManager.handleQueryResult(
   494→        eventId: message.clientEventId,
   495→        rawResult: resultArray,
   496→        attributes: self.attributes
   497→      )
   498→    }
   499→
   500→    InstantLog.debug("[InstantDB] ✓ Query result delivered")
   501→  }
   502→  
   503→  private func handleAddQueryExists(_ message: ServerMessage) {
   504→    InstantLog.debug("[InstantDB] Query already exists, delivering cached data")
   505→
   506→    // The server sends add-query-exists when a query with the same hash already exists.
   507→    // This happens when we try to subscribe to the same query twice.
   508→    // The message contains the query ("q") but NOT the result data.
   509→    // We need to look up the existing subscription and deliver its cached result.
   510→    
   511→    guard let queryDict = message.data["q"]?.value as? [String: Any] else {
   512→      InstantLog.warning("[InstantDB] Add-query-exists missing query ('q')")
   513→      InstantLog.debug("[InstantDB] Available keys: \(message.data.keys)")
   514→      return
   515→    }
   516→    
   517→    Task { @MainActor in
   518→      // Find the existing subscription by query hash and deliver its cached result
   519→      self.queryManager.handleQueryExists(
   520→        eventId: message.clientEventId,
   521→        query: queryDict
   522→      )
   523→    }
   524→
   525→    InstantLog.debug("[InstantDB] ✓ Cached query result delivered")
   526→  }
   527→  
   528→  private func handleRemoveQueryOk(_ message: ServerMessage) {
   529→    InstantLog.debug("[InstantDB] ✓ Query removed from server")
   530→  }
   531→
   532→  private func handleTransactOk(_ message: ServerMessage) {
   533→    guard let txIdValue = message.data["tx-id"]?.value,
   534→          let txId = parseInt64(txIdValue) else {
   535→      InstantLog.warning("[InstantDB] Transact-ok missing tx-id")
   536→      return
   537→    }
   538→
   539→    guard let eventId = message.clientEventId else {
   540→      InstantLog.warning("[InstantDB] Transact-ok missing client-event-id")
   541→      return
   542→    }
   543→
   544→    inFlightMutationEventIds.remove(eventId)
   545→
   546→    if let localStorage {
   547→      Task { @MainActor in
   548→        do {
   549→          try await localStorage.markPendingMutationConfirmed(eventId: eventId, txId: txId)
   550→        } catch {
   551→          InstantLog.warning("[InstantDB] Failed to persist transact-ok for \(eventId): \(error)")
   552→        }
   553→      }
   554→    }
   555→
   556→    InstantLog.debug("[InstantDB] ✓ Transaction confirmed: \(txId)")
   557→  }
   558→  
   559→  private func handleRefreshOk(_ message: ServerMessage) {
   560→    InstantLog.debug("[InstantDB] refresh-ok received, data keys: \(message.data.keys)")
   561→    
   562→    guard let computations = message.data["computations"]?.value as? [[String: Any]] else {
   563→      InstantLog.warning("[InstantDB] Refresh-ok missing computations")
   564→      // Debug: print all available data
   565→      for (key, value) in message.data {
   566→        InstantLog.debug("[InstantDB]   \(key): \(type(of: value.value))")
   567→      }
   568→      return
   569→    }
   570→
   571→    var refreshedAttributes: [Attribute]?
   572→    if let attrsData = message.data["attrs"]?.value {
   573→      do {
   574→        let data = try JSONSerialization.data(withJSONObject: attrsData)
   575→        refreshedAttributes = try JSONDecoder().decode([Attribute].self, from: data)
   576→      } catch {
   577→        InstantLog.warning("[InstantDB] Failed to decode attributes from refresh: \(error)")
   578→      }
   579→    }
   580→
   581→    let processedTxId: Int64? = {
   582→      guard let value = message.data["processed-tx-id"]?.value else { return nil }
   583→      return parseInt64(value)
   584→    }()
   585→
   586→    InstantLog.debug("[InstantDB] refresh-ok has \(computations.count) computations")
   587→    for (index, computation) in computations.enumerated() {
   588→      InstantLog.debug("[InstantDB]   computation[\(index)] keys: \(computation.keys)")
   589→      if let query = computation["instaql-query"] as? [String: Any] {
   590→        InstantLog.debug("[InstantDB]   computation[\(index)] query namespaces: \(query.keys)")
   591→      }
   592→    }
   593→
   594→    Task { @MainActor in
   595→      if let refreshedAttributes {
   596→        let merged = self.mergingServerAttributes(refreshedAttributes)
   597→        self.attributes = merged
   598→        InstantLog.debug("[InstantDB] ✓ Updated \(merged.count) attributes from refresh")
   599→
   600→        if let localStorage {
   601→          do {
   602→            try await localStorage.saveAttrs(merged)
   603→          } catch {
   604→            InstantLog.warning("[InstantDB] Failed to persist refreshed attributes: \(error)")
   605→          }
   606→        }
   607→      }
   608→
   609→      if let processedTxId {
   610→        await self.persistAndCleanupProcessedTxId(processedTxId)
   611→      }
   612→
   613→      self.queryManager.handleRefresh(
   614→        computations: computations,
   615→        attributes: self.attributes
   616→      )
   617→    }
   618→
   619→    InstantLog.debug("[InstantDB] ✓ Real-time update delivered (\(computations.count) queries)")
   620→  }
   621→  
   622→  private func handleError(_ message: ServerMessage) {
   623→    let errorMsg = message.data["message"]?.value as? String ?? "Unknown error"
   624→    let hint = message.data["hint"]?.value as? [String: Any]
   625→
   626→    InstantLog.error("[InstantDB] ✗ Server error: \(errorMsg)")
   627→    if let hint = hint {
   628→      InstantLog.error("[InstantDB] ℹ Hint: \(hint)")
   629→    }
   630→    InstantLog.error("[InstantDB] ⚠ Learn more: https://www.instantdb.com/docs")
   631→
   632→    let error = InstantError.serverError(errorMsg, hint: hint)
   633→
   634→    if let eventId = message.clientEventId {
   635→      Task { @MainActor in
   636→        self.inFlightMutationEventIds.remove(eventId)
   637→
   638→        if let localStorage {
   639→          do {
   640→            try await localStorage.markPendingMutationErrored(eventId: eventId, error: errorMsg)
   641→          } catch {
   642→            InstantLog.warning("[InstantDB] Failed to persist pending mutation error for \(eventId): \(error)")
   643→          }
   644→        }
   645→
   646→        self.queryManager.handleQueryError(eventId: eventId, error: error)
   647→      }
   648→    }
   649→  }
   650→
   651→  
   652→  // MARK: - Presence Message Handlers
   653→  //
   654→  // These handlers use typed payloads from ServerMessagePayloads.swift.
   655→  // The CodingKeys in each payload struct map server keys to Swift properties,
   656→  // preventing bugs like the "sessions" vs "data" typo.
   657→  //
   658→  // TypeScript Reference: Reactor.js _handleReceive() method
   659→  
   660→  private func handleJoinRoomOk(_ message: ServerMessage) {
   661→    // Use typed payload - CodingKeys ensure correct key mapping
   662→    // TypeScript: Reactor.js line 778-793
   663→    guard let roomId = message.data["room-id"]?.value as? String else {
   664→      InstantLog.warning("[InstantDB] join-room-ok missing room-id")
   665→      return
   666→    }
   667→    
   668→    // Note: TypeScript doesn't process sessions in join-room-ok.
   669→    // It just sets room connected and flushes queued data.
   670→    // Sessions come via refresh-presence messages.
   671→    presence.handleJoinRoomOk(roomId: roomId, data: nil)
   672→    InstantLog.debug("[InstantDB] ✓ Joined room: \(roomId)")
   673→  }
   674→  
   675→  private func handleRefreshPresence(_ message: ServerMessage) {
   676→    // TypeScript: Reactor.js line 764-769
   677→    // Key mapping: RefreshPresencePayload.sessions maps to server's "data" key
   678→    // via CodingKeys, preventing the "sessions" vs "data" bug
   679→    InstantLog.debug("[InstantDB] handleRefreshPresence - raw data keys: \(message.data.keys)")
   680→    
   681→    guard let roomId = message.data["room-id"]?.value as? String else {
   682→      // This can happen when server sends a global refresh before room is joined
   683→      InstantLog.debug("[InstantDB] refresh-presence has no room-id, ignoring (global refresh)")
   684→      return
   685→    }
   686→    
   687→    // IMPORTANT: Server sends "data", not "sessions"
   688→    // See RefreshPresencePayload.CodingKeys where sessions = "data"
   689→    guard let sessions = message.data["data"]?.value as? [String: Any] else {
   690→      InstantLog.warning("[InstantDB] refresh-presence for room \(roomId) missing data")
   691→      return
   692→    }
   693→    
   694→    InstantLog.debug("[InstantDB] refresh-presence for room \(roomId) with \(sessions.count) sessions")
   695→    presence.handleRefreshPresence(roomId: roomId, sessions: sessions)
   696→    InstantLog.debug("[InstantDB] ✓ Presence refreshed for room: \(roomId)")
   697→  }
   698→  
   699→  private func handlePatchPresence(_ message: ServerMessage) {
   700→    // TypeScript: Reactor.js line 757-762
   701→    // Key mapping: PatchPresencePayload uses roomId = "room-id", edits = "edits"
   702→    InstantLog.debug("[InstantDB] handlePatchPresence - raw data keys: \(message.data.keys)")
   703→    
   704→    guard let roomId = message.data["room-id"]?.value as? String else {
   705→      InstantLog.warning("[InstantDB] patch-presence missing room-id")
   706→      return
   707→    }
   708→    
   709→    guard let edits = message.data["edits"]?.value as? [[Any]] else {
   710→      InstantLog.warning("[InstantDB] patch-presence for room \(roomId) missing edits")
   711→      return
   712→    }
   713→    
   714→    InstantLog.debug("[InstantDB] patch-presence for room \(roomId) with \(edits.count) edits")
   715→    presence.handlePatchPresence(roomId: roomId, edits: edits)
   716→    InstantLog.debug("[InstantDB] ✓ Presence patched for room: \(roomId)")
   717→  }
   718→  
   719→  private func handleServerBroadcast(_ message: ServerMessage) {
   720→    // TypeScript: Reactor.js line 771-776, 2393-2402
   721→    // The server sends: { "room-id", "topic", "data": { "peer-id", "data": <payload> } }
   722→    // Note: peer-id is INSIDE the data object, not at the top level!
   723→    InstantLog.debug("[InstantDB] handleServerBroadcast - raw data keys: \(message.data.keys)")
   724→    
   725→    guard let roomId = message.data["room-id"]?.value as? String,
   726→          let topic = message.data["topic"]?.value as? String,
   727→          let dataWrapper = message.data["data"]?.value as? [String: Any] else {
   728→      InstantLog.warning("[InstantDB] server-broadcast missing room-id, topic, or data")
   729→      return
   730→    }
   731→    
   732→    // peer-id is inside the data wrapper, along with the actual payload
   733→    // TypeScript: msg.data['peer-id'] and msg.data.data
   734→    let peerId = dataWrapper["peer-id"] as? String ?? "unknown"
   735→    let payload = dataWrapper["data"] as? [String: Any] ?? [:]
   736→    
   737→    InstantLog.debug("[InstantDB] server-broadcast for room \(roomId), topic: \(topic), peerId: \(peerId)")
   738→    presence.handleServerBroadcast(roomId: roomId, topic: topic, data: payload, peerId: peerId)
   739→    InstantLog.debug("[InstantDB] ✓ Broadcast received on topic: \(topic)")
   740→  }
   741→  
   742→  private func handleRoomError(_ message: ServerMessage) {
   743→    // TypeScript: Reactor.js line 800-804
   744→    // Key mapping: JoinRoomErrorPayload uses roomId = "room-id"
   745→    guard let roomId = message.data["room-id"]?.value as? String,
   746→          let errorMsg = message.data["message"]?.value as? String else {
   747→      InstantLog.warning("[InstantDB] room-error missing room-id or message")
   748→      return
   749→    }
   750→    
   751→    presence.handleRoomError(roomId: roomId, error: errorMsg)
   752→    InstantLog.error("[InstantDB] ✗ Room error for \(roomId): \(errorMsg)")
   753→  }
   754→}
   755→
   756→// MARK: - Type-Safe Query API
   757→
   758→extension InstantClient {
   759→
   760→  /// Create a type-safe query for an entity type
   761→  /// - Parameter type: The InstantEntity type to query
   762→  /// - Returns: A typed query builder
   763→  ///
   764→  /// Example:
   765→  /// ```swift
   766→  /// db.query(Goal.self)
   767→  ///     .where { $0.difficulty > 5 }
   768→  ///     .limit(10)
   769→  /// ```
   770→  public func query<T: InstantEntity>(_ type: T.Type) -> TypedQuery<T> {
   771→    TypedQuery<T>(namespace: T.namespace, client: self)
   772→  }
   773→
   774→  /// Subscribe to a type-safe query
   775→  /// - Parameters:
   776→  ///   - query: Typed query instance
   777→  ///   - callback: Called when query results arrive or update
   778→  /// - Returns: Subscription token that auto-cleans on deinit
   779→  ///
   780→  /// Example:
   781→  /// ```swift
   782→  /// class GoalsViewModel {
   783→  ///     private var subscriptions = Set<Subscription>()
   784→  ///
   785→  ///     func start() {
   786→  ///         try? db.subscribe(db.query(Goal.self)) { result in
   787→  ///             self.goals = result.data
   788→  ///         }
   789→  ///         .store(in: &subscriptions)
   790→  ///     }
   791→  /// }
   792→  /// ```
   793→  @discardableResult
   794→  public func subscribe<T: InstantEntity>(
   795→    _ query: TypedQuery<T>,
   796→    callback: @escaping TypedQueryCallback<T>
   797→  ) throws -> SubscriptionToken {
   798→    let instaqlQuery = query.toQuery()
   799→    let namespace = query.namespace
   800→
   801→    // Wrap callback to decode results automatically
   802→    let wrappedCallback: QueryCallback = { result in
   803→      if result.isLoading {
   804→        callback(.loading)
   805→        return
   806→      }
   807→
   808→      if let error = result.error {
   809→        callback(.failure(error))
   810→        return
   811→      }
   812→
   813→      // Decode data to type T
   814→      let decoded = result.decode(T.self, from: namespace)
   815→
   816→      // Parse pageInfo for this namespace
   817→      let pageInfo = PageInfo(from: result.pageInfo, namespace: namespace)
   818→
   819→      callback(.success(data: decoded, pageInfo: pageInfo))
   820→    }
   821→
   822→    let unsubscribe = queryManager.subscribe(query: instaqlQuery, callback: wrappedCallback)
   823→
   824→    // Get the subscription to send to server
   825→    // Use the same canonical hashing as QueryManager to ensure hash matches
   826→    let hash = hashQuery(instaqlQuery)
   827→    guard let subscription = queryManager.getSubscription(hash: hash) else {
   828→      throw InstantError.invalidQuery
   829→    }
   830→
   831→    let message = AddQueryMessage(
   832→      clientEventId: subscription.eventId,
   833→      query: instaqlQuery
   834→    )
   835→
   836→    if connectionState == .authenticated {
   837→      try connection.send(message)
   838→    } else {
   839→      // Defer sending until we receive init-ok and become authenticated.
   840→      //
   841→      // ## Why This Exists
   842→      // The server expects `init` to run before we send `add-query`. When a caller
   843→      // subscribes early (cold start, app foreground, network flap), we still want to:
   844→      // - Register the subscription locally (so cached results can be emitted immediately),
   845→      // - Avoid sending an invalid message order over the wire,
   846→      // - Let `resendActiveQueries()` send the query after init-ok.
   847→      InstantLog.debug("[InstantDB] subscribe: deferring add-query until authenticated")
   848→    }
   849→
   850→    return SubscriptionToken(onCleanup: unsubscribe)
   851→  }
   852→
   853→  // MARK: - Query Once API
   854→
   855→  /// Runs a query a single time and returns the first non-loading result.
   856→  ///
   857→  /// ## Why This Exists
   858→  /// `queryOnce` is intended for "fetch on demand" UX (e.g. pull-to-refresh,
   859→  /// background refresh, or imperative reads).
   860→  ///
   861→  /// ## Offline Semantics (Parity with JS Core)
   862→  /// - Subscriptions (`subscribe` / `TypedQuery.values()`) may emit cached results
   863→  ///   immediately for offline-friendly UX.
   864→  /// - `queryOnce` fails when offline so callers do not accidentally treat stale
   865→  ///   cached data as a successful fresh read.
   866→  ///
   867→  /// ## Last-Known Data
   868→  /// When offline (or when a request fails), the thrown `QueryOnceError` may carry
   869→  /// `lastKnownResult` (if available) so callers can render cached data in an error UI.
   870→  ///
   871→  /// - Parameters:
   872→  ///   - query: The InstaQL query dictionary.
   873→  ///   - timeout: Maximum time to wait for a server response.
   874→  /// - Returns: A `QueryResult` containing the query data and page info.
   875→  public func queryOnce(
   876→    _ query: [String: Any],
   877→    timeout: TimeInterval = 15.0
   878→  ) async throws -> QueryResult {
   879→    let hash = hashQuery(query)
   880→
   881→    if isOfflineForQueryOnce {
   882→      throw QueryOnceError.offline(
   883→        queryHash: hash,
   884→        lastKnownResult: loadCachedQueryResultData(hash: hash)
   885→      )
   886→    }
   887→
   888→    if let existing = queryManager.getSubscription(hash: hash), !existing.currentResult.isLoading {
   889→      return existing.currentResult
   890→    }
   891→
   892→    let isAuthenticated = await waitForAuthenticated(timeoutSeconds: min(timeout, 10.0))
   893→    guard isAuthenticated else {
   894→      if isOfflineForQueryOnce {
   895→        throw QueryOnceError.offline(
   896→          queryHash: hash,
   897→          lastKnownResult: loadCachedQueryResultData(hash: hash)
   898→        )
   899→      }
   900→
   901→      throw QueryOnceError.timedOut(
   902→        queryHash: hash,
   903→        seconds: timeout,
   904→        lastKnownResult: loadCachedQueryResultData(hash: hash)
   905→      )
   906→    }
   907→
   908→    return try await withCheckedThrowingContinuation { continuation in
   909→      var didFinish = false
   910→      var unsubscribe: (() -> Void)?
   911→
   912→      let callback: QueryCallback = { result in
   913→        guard !result.isLoading else { return }
   914→        guard !didFinish else { return }
   915→        didFinish = true
   916→
   917→        unsubscribe?()
   918→        unsubscribe = nil
   919→
   920→        if let error = result.error {
   921→          continuation.resume(
   922→            throwing: QueryOnceError.requestFailed(
   923→              queryHash: hash,
   924→              message: String(describing: error),
   925→              lastKnownResult: self.loadCachedQueryResultData(hash: hash)
   926→            )
   927→          )
   928→          return
   929→        }
   930→
   931→        continuation.resume(returning: result)
   932→      }
   933→
   934→      unsubscribe = self.queryManager.subscribe(query: query, emitCachedResult: false, callback: callback)
   935→
   936→      guard let subscription = self.queryManager.getSubscription(hash: hash) else {
   937→        didFinish = true
   938→        unsubscribe?()
   939→        unsubscribe = nil
   940→        continuation.resume(
   941→          throwing: QueryOnceError.requestFailed(
   942→            queryHash: hash,
   943→            message: "Failed to create query subscription.",
   944→            lastKnownResult: self.loadCachedQueryResultData(hash: hash)
   945→          )
   946→        )
   947→        return
   948→      }
   949→
   950→      do {
   951→        let message = AddQueryMessage(clientEventId: subscription.eventId, query: query)
   952→        try self.connection.send(message)
   953→      } catch {
   954→        didFinish = true
   955→        unsubscribe?()
   956→        unsubscribe = nil
   957→        continuation.resume(
   958→          throwing: QueryOnceError.requestFailed(
   959→            queryHash: hash,
   960→            message: String(describing: error),
   961→            lastKnownResult: self.loadCachedQueryResultData(hash: hash)
   962→          )
   963→        )
   964→        return
   965→      }
   966→
   967→      Task { @MainActor in
   968→        guard !didFinish else { return }
   969→        try? await Task.sleep(nanoseconds: UInt64(timeout * 1_000_000_000))
   970→        guard !didFinish else { return }
   971→        didFinish = true
   972→
   973→        unsubscribe?()
   974→        unsubscribe = nil
   975→
   976→        continuation.resume(
   977→          throwing: QueryOnceError.timedOut(
   978→            queryHash: hash,
   979→            seconds: timeout,
   980→            lastKnownResult: self.loadCachedQueryResultData(hash: hash)
   981→          )
   982→        )
   983→      }
   984→    }
   985→  }
   986→
   987→  /// Runs a typed query once and returns decoded entities.
   988→  ///
   989→  /// This is equivalent to calling `queryOnce(query.toQuery())` and decoding the result.
   990→  public func queryOnce<T: InstantEntity>(
   991→    _ query: TypedQuery<T>,
   992→    timeout: TimeInterval = 15.0
   993→  ) async throws -> TypedResult<T> {
   994→    let instaqlQuery = query.toQuery()
   995→    let namespace = query.namespace
   996→
   997→    let result = try await queryOnce(instaqlQuery, timeout: timeout)
   998→    let decoded = result.decode(T.self, from: namespace)
   999→    let pageInfo = PageInfo(from: result.pageInfo, namespace: namespace)
  1000→
  1001→    return .success(data: decoded, pageInfo: pageInfo)
  1002→  }
  1003→
  1004→  /// Computes a canonical hash for query matching.
  1005→  ///
  1006→  /// This must match the hashing algorithm in QueryManager to ensure
  1007→  /// we can look up subscriptions by hash after creating them.
  1008→  private func hashQuery(_ query: [String: Any]) -> String {
  1009→    QueryHashing.hash(query)
  1010→  }
  1011→
  1012→  private var isOfflineForQueryOnce: Bool {
  1013→    switch connectionState {
  1014→    case .disconnected:
  1015→      return true
  1016→    case .error:
  1017→      return true
  1018→    case .connecting, .connected, .authenticated:
  1019→      return false
  1020→    }
  1021→  }
  1022→
  1023→  private func waitForAuthenticated(timeoutSeconds: TimeInterval) async -> Bool {
  1024→    let deadline = Date().addingTimeInterval(timeoutSeconds)
  1025→    while Date() < deadline {
  1026→      if connectionState == .authenticated { return true }
  1027→      if isOfflineForQueryOnce { return false }
  1028→      try? await Task.sleep(nanoseconds: 100_000_000)
  1029→    }
  1030→
  1031→    return connectionState == .authenticated
  1032→  }
  1033→
  1034→  private func loadCachedQueryResultData(hash: String) -> Data? {
  1035→    guard let localStorage else { return nil }
  1036→    return try? localStorage.getCachedQueryResultSync(hash: hash)
  1037→  }
  1038→
  1039→  // MARK: - Local-first / Offline Support
  1040→
  1041→  private func loadPersistedSchemaIfAvailable() async {
  1042→    guard let localStorage else { return }
  1043→    guard attributes.isEmpty else { return }
  1044→
  1045→    do {
  1046→      let cached = try await localStorage.loadAttrs()
  1047→      guard !cached.isEmpty else { return }
  1048→      attributes = cached
  1049→    } catch {
  1050→      InstantLog.warning("[InstantDB] Failed to load persisted schema attributes: \(error)")
  1051→    }
  1052→  }
  1053→
  1054→  private func flushPendingMutations() async {
  1055→    guard connectionState == .authenticated else { return }
  1056→    guard let localStorage else { return }
  1057→
  1058→    // If we're already flushing, request another pass and return. The active
  1059→    // flush will see the flag and perform a second pass to pick up new enqueues.
  1060→    guard !isFlushingPendingMutations else {
  1061→      pendingMutationFlushRequested = true
  1062→      return
  1063→    }
  1064→
  1065→    isFlushingPendingMutations = true
  1066→    defer { isFlushingPendingMutations = false }
  1067→
  1068→    repeat {
  1069→      pendingMutationFlushRequested = false
  1070→
  1071→      do {
  1072→        // NOTE: `loadPendingMutations()` is ordered by `order_index` ascending.
  1073→        // We send in that order to ensure deterministic replay and to prevent
  1074→        // link-before-create failures after reconnect.
  1075→        let mutations = try await localStorage.loadPendingMutations()
  1076→
  1077→        for mutation in mutations where mutation.txId == nil && mutation.error == nil {
  1078→          let txSteps = mutation.txSteps.map { $0.map(\.value) }
  1079→          trySendPendingMutation(eventId: mutation.eventId, txSteps: txSteps)
  1080→        }
  1081→      } catch {
  1082→        InstantLog.warning("[InstantDB] Failed to load pending mutations for flush: \(error)")
  1083→        return
  1084→      }
  1085→    } while pendingMutationFlushRequested
  1086→  }
  1087→
  1088→  private func trySendPendingMutation(eventId: String, txSteps: [[Any]]) {
  1089→    guard connectionState == .authenticated else {
  1090→      return
  1091→    }
  1092→    guard !inFlightMutationEventIds.contains(eventId) else {
  1093→      return
  1094→    }
  1095→
  1096→    do {
  1097→      let message = TransactMessage(clientEventId: eventId, txSteps: txSteps)
  1098→      try connection.send(message)
  1099→      inFlightMutationEventIds.insert(eventId)
  1100→    } catch {
  1101→      InstantLog.warning("[InstantDB] Failed to send queued mutation \(eventId): \(error)")
  1102→    }
  1103→  }
  1104→
  1105→  private func persistAndCleanupProcessedTxId(_ processedTxId: Int64) async {
  1106→    guard let localStorage else { return }
  1107→
  1108→    do {
  1109→      try await localStorage.setValue(processedTxId, forKey: "processedTxId")
  1110→      try await localStorage.cleanupProcessedMutations(processedTxId: processedTxId)
  1111→    } catch {
  1112→      InstantLog.warning("[InstantDB] Failed to persist processed-tx-id \(processedTxId): \(error)")
  1113→    }
  1114→  }
  1115→
  1116→  private func parseInt64(_ value: Any) -> Int64? {
  1117→    if let int64 = value as? Int64 { return int64 }
  1118→    if let int = value as? Int { return Int64(int) }
  1119→    if let double = value as? Double { return Int64(double) }
  1120→    if let string = value as? String { return Int64(string) }
  1121→    return nil
  1122→  }
  1123→
  1124→  // MARK: - Pending Mutations Access
  1125→
  1126→  /// Returns all pending mutations that haven't been confirmed by the server.
  1127→  ///
  1128→  /// ## Why This Exists
  1129→  /// When the app restarts, the sharing-instant Reactor needs to restore pending
  1130→  /// mutations to its local TripleStore for immediate display. Without this,
  1131→  /// optimistic updates made before app restart won't be visible until the server
  1132→  /// confirms them (which requires network connectivity).
  1133→  ///
  1134→  /// This follows the TypeScript SDK pattern where `pendingMutations` are merged
  1135→  /// into query results before display.
  1136→  ///
  1137→  /// ## Usage
  1138→  /// ```swift
  1139→  /// let pending = await client.getUnconfirmedPendingMutations()
  1140→  /// for mutation in pending {
  1141→  ///   // Apply to local store for immediate display
  1142→  ///   applyOptimisticUpdate(mutation.txSteps)
  1143→  /// }
  1144→  /// ```
  1145→  ///
  1146→  /// - Returns: Pending mutations with `txId == nil` (not yet confirmed)
  1147→  public func getUnconfirmedPendingMutations() async -> [PendingMutation] {
  1148→    guard let localStorage else { return [] }
  1149→    do {
  1150→      let all = try await localStorage.loadPendingMutations()
  1151→      return all.filter { $0.txId == nil && $0.error == nil }
  1152→    } catch {
  1153→      InstantLog.warning("[InstantDB] Failed to load pending mutations: \(error)")
  1154→      return []
  1155→    }
  1156→  }
  1157→}
  1158→
  1159→// MARK: - Transaction API
  1160→
  1161→extension InstantClient {
  1162→
  1163→  /// Merges attribute updates into the in-memory schema cache.
  1164→  ///
  1165→  /// ## Why This Exists
  1166→  /// Some transactions include schema repairs (e.g. adding a missing `reverse-identity`)
  1167→  /// by emitting an `add-attr` step that reuses an existing attribute ID.
  1168→  ///
  1169→  /// If we only ever append, we can end up with duplicate attribute IDs in memory.
  1170→  /// More importantly, we would keep using stale schema until the next server refresh.
  1171→  private func mergeAttributesById(_ incoming: [Attribute]) {
  1172→    guard !incoming.isEmpty else { return }
  1173→
  1174→    var indexById: [String: Int] = [:]
  1175→    for (index, attr) in attributes.enumerated() {
  1176→      indexById[attr.id] = index
  1177→    }
  1178→
  1179→    for attr in incoming {
  1180→      if let index = indexById[attr.id] {
  1181→        attributes[index] = attr
  1182→      } else {
  1183→        attributes.append(attr)
  1184→      }
  1185→    }
  1186→  }
  1187→
  1188→  /// Returns a merged view of server attributes over the current schema cache.
  1189→  ///
  1190→  /// ## Why This Exists
  1191→  /// InstantDB's query processor performs client-side joins for links, which requires
  1192→  /// accurate attribute metadata (`value-type` and `reverse-identity`).
  1193→  ///
  1194→  /// In practice, we sometimes synthesize "repaired" attributes locally (e.g. when a
  1195→  /// link operation implies a field is a `ref`, but the server schema is still `blob`).
  1196→  ///
  1197→  /// If we overwrite `self.attributes` with every server refresh, UIs can "flip":
  1198→  /// - optimistic/link-aware data shows correctly
  1199→  /// - a later refresh rehydrates from the normalized store using server attrs
  1200→  /// - links resolve to `nil` because the server attrs are missing link metadata
  1201→  ///
  1202→  /// We therefore merge server attributes with the existing cache and prefer the
  1203→  /// most complete definition for link hydration.
  1204→  private func mergingServerAttributes(_ serverAttributes: [Attribute]) -> [Attribute] {
  1205→    guard !serverAttributes.isEmpty else { return attributes }
  1206→
  1207→    var mergedById: [AttributeID: Attribute] = [:]
  1208→    mergedById.reserveCapacity(serverAttributes.count)
  1209→
  1210→    for attr in serverAttributes {
  1211→      mergedById[attr.id] = attr
  1212→    }
  1213→
  1214→    for local in attributes {
  1215→      if let server = mergedById[local.id] {
  1216→        mergedById[local.id] = merge(serverAttribute: server, localAttribute: local)
  1217→      } else {
  1218→        mergedById[local.id] = local
  1219→      }
  1220→    }
  1221→
  1222→    return Array(mergedById.values)
  1223→  }
  1224→
  1225→  private func merge(serverAttribute: Attribute, localAttribute: Attribute) -> Attribute {
  1226→    let mergedReverseIdentity: [String]? = {
  1227→      let serverReverseCount = serverAttribute.reverseIdentity?.count ?? 0
  1228→      let localReverseCount = localAttribute.reverseIdentity?.count ?? 0
  1229→
  1230→      if serverReverseCount >= 3 { return serverAttribute.reverseIdentity }
  1231→      if localReverseCount >= 3 { return localAttribute.reverseIdentity }
  1232→
  1233→      return serverAttribute.reverseIdentity ?? localAttribute.reverseIdentity
  1234→    }()
  1235→
  1236→    let mergedValueType: ValueType = {
  1237→      if serverAttribute.valueType == .ref { return .ref }
  1238→      if localAttribute.valueType == .ref { return .ref }
  1239→      return serverAttribute.valueType
  1240→    }()
  1241→
  1242→    return Attribute(
  1243→      id: serverAttribute.id,
  1244→      forwardIdentity: serverAttribute.forwardIdentity.isEmpty
  1245→        ? localAttribute.forwardIdentity
  1246→        : serverAttribute.forwardIdentity,
  1247→      reverseIdentity: mergedReverseIdentity,
  1248→      valueType: mergedValueType,
  1249→      cardinality: serverAttribute.cardinality,
  1250→      unique: serverAttribute.unique ?? localAttribute.unique,
  1251→      indexed: serverAttribute.indexed ?? localAttribute.indexed,
  1252→      checkedDataType: serverAttribute.checkedDataType ?? localAttribute.checkedDataType
  1253→    )
  1254→  }
  1255→
  1256→  /// Send a transaction to the server using transaction chunks
  1257→  /// - Parameter chunks: Transaction chunks built using the tx builder
  1258→  ///
  1259→  /// Example:
  1260→  /// ```swift
  1261→  /// try db.transact([
  1262→  ///   db.tx.goals[newId()].update(["title": "Get fit"]),
  1263→  ///   db.tx.todos[todoId].link(["goals": goalId])
  1264→  /// ])
  1265→  /// ```
  1266→  public func transact(_ chunks: [TransactionChunk]) throws {
  1267→    // Transform high-level operations into tx-steps format
  1268→    let (txSteps, newAttributes) = try TransactionTransformer.transform(chunks, attributes: attributes)
  1269→
  1270→    // Add new attributes to local schema (optimistically)
  1271→    mergeAttributesById(newAttributes)
  1272→
  1273→    if let localStorage, !newAttributes.isEmpty {
  1274→      Task { @MainActor in
  1275→        do {
  1276→          try await localStorage.saveAttrs(newAttributes)
  1277→        } catch {
  1278→          InstantLog.warning("[InstantDB] Failed to persist new attributes from transaction: \(error)")
  1279→        }
  1280→      }
  1281→    }
  1282→
  1283→    try transact(txSteps)
  1284→  }
  1285→
  1286→  /// Send a transaction to the server using transaction chunks
  1287→  /// - Parameter chunk: A single transaction chunk
  1288→  public func transact(_ chunk: TransactionChunk) throws {
  1289→    try transact([chunk])
  1290→  }
  1291→
  1292→  /// Execute transactions using result builder syntax
  1293→  ///
  1294→  /// Example:
  1295→  /// ```swift
  1296→  /// try db.transact {
  1297→  ///     Goal.create(title: "Get fit", difficulty: 5)
  1298→  ///     Todo.update(id: todoId, done: true)
  1299→  ///     Goal.delete(id: oldGoalId)
  1300→  /// }
  1301→  /// ```
  1302→  /// - Parameter build: Result builder closure that returns transaction chunks
  1303→  public func transact(@TransactionBatchBuilder _ build: () -> [TransactionChunk]) throws {
  1304→    let chunks = build()
  1305→    try transact(chunks)
  1306→  }
  1307→
  1308→  // MARK: - Local-first Transaction API
  1309→
  1310→  /// Applies a transaction locally-first and queues it for sending when online.
  1311→  ///
  1312→  /// ## Semantics
  1313→  /// This mirrors JS core Reactor behavior:
  1314→  /// - The mutation is persisted immediately.
  1315→  /// - If the client is not yet authenticated/online, the mutation is queued.
  1316→  /// - Once the WebSocket session is authenticated, queued mutations are flushed.
  1317→  ///
  1318→  /// - Returns: The client-event-id used to track this mutation on the wire.
  1319→  @discardableResult
  1320→  public func transactLocalFirst(_ chunks: [TransactionChunk]) async throws -> String {
  1321→    await loadPersistedSchemaIfAvailable()
  1322→
  1323→    let (txSteps, newAttributes) = try TransactionTransformer.transform(chunks, attributes: attributes)
  1324→
  1325→    if !newAttributes.isEmpty {
  1326→      mergeAttributesById(newAttributes)
  1327→
  1328→      if let localStorage {
  1329→        do {
  1330→          try await localStorage.saveAttrs(newAttributes)
  1331→        } catch {
  1332→          InstantLog.warning("[InstantDB] Failed to persist new attributes for offline mode: \(error)")
  1333→        }
  1334→      }
  1335→    }
  1336→
  1337→    return try await transactLocalFirst(txSteps)
  1338→  }
  1339→
  1340→  @discardableResult
  1341→  public func transactLocalFirst(_ chunk: TransactionChunk) async throws -> String {
  1342→    try await transactLocalFirst([chunk])
  1343→  }
  1344→
  1345→  @discardableResult
  1346→  public func transactLocalFirst(@TransactionBatchBuilder _ build: () -> [TransactionChunk]) async throws -> String {
  1347→    let chunks = build()
  1348→    return try await transactLocalFirst(chunks)
  1349→  }
  1350→
  1351→  /// Persists a tx-steps transaction and attempts to send it if connected.
  1352→  ///
  1353→  /// This is the primitive used by `transactLocalFirst(_ chunks:)` after
  1354→  /// transforming high-level operations into wire-format steps.
  1355→  @discardableResult
  1356→  public func transactLocalFirst(_ txSteps: [[Any]]) async throws -> String {
  1357→    let eventId = UUID().uuidString
  1358→
  1359→    guard let localStorage else {
  1360→      guard connectionState == .authenticated else {
  1361→        throw InstantError.notAuthenticated
  1362→      }
  1363→
  1364→      // DEBUG: Log tx-steps being sent when localStorage is nil
  1365→      InstantLog.debug("[InstantDB] transactLocalFirst (no localStorage) - Sending \(txSteps.count) steps:")
  1366→      for (index, step) in txSteps.enumerated() {
  1367→        InstantLog.debug("[InstantDB]   Step \(index): \(step)")
  1368→      }
  1369→
  1370→      let message = TransactMessage(clientEventId: eventId, txSteps: txSteps)
  1371→      try connection.send(message)
  1372→      return eventId
  1373→    }
  1374→
  1375→    _ = try await localStorage.enqueuePendingMutation(

     1→/// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
     2→/// SharedMutations.swift
     3→/// Explicit mutation methods for @Shared InstantDB collections
     4→/// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
     5→///
     6→/// This file provides explicit mutation methods (create, delete, update, link, unlink)
     7→/// that bypass the diff-based save() mechanism. These methods generate specific
     8→/// transaction chunks and send them directly to the server.
     9→///
    10→/// ## Why This Exists
    11→///
    12→/// The default `$collection.withLock { }` approach triggers `save()` which computes
    13→/// diffs between local and server state. This causes issues:
    14→/// - Race conditions when multiple subscriptions exist for the same namespace
    15→/// - Ghost deletions on app start
    16→/// - Re-sync of deleted items when creating new items
    17→///
    18→/// ## How It Works
    19→///
    20→/// Instead of computing diffs, these methods:
    21→/// 1. Apply the change optimistically to local state
    22→/// 2. Generate a specific transaction chunk for the operation
    23→/// 3. Send the chunk directly to the server via `directTransact()`
    24→///
    25→/// ## Usage
    26→///
    27→/// ```swift
    28→/// @Shared(.instantSync(Schema.goals)) var goals: [Goal]
    29→///
    30→/// // Create - explicit operation, no diff
    31→/// try await $goals.create(Goal(id: id, title: "New Goal"))
    32→///
    33→/// // Delete - explicit operation, no diff
    34→/// try await $goals.delete(id: goalId)
    35→///
    36→/// // Update - explicit operation, no diff
    37→/// try await $goals.update(id: goalId) { $0.title = "Updated" }
    38→///
    39→/// // Link - explicit operation
    40→/// try await $goals.link(goalId, "creator", to: profileId, namespace: "profiles")
    41→/// ```
    42→///
    43→/// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
    44→
    45→import Dependencies
    46→import Foundation
    47→import IdentifiedCollections
    48→import InstantDB
    49→import Sharing
    50→
    51→// MARK: - Mutation Callbacks
    52→
    53→/// TanStack Query-style callbacks for mutation operations.
    54→///
    55→/// These callbacks provide hooks into the mutation lifecycle, allowing you to
    56→/// respond to different stages of a mutation operation.
    57→///
    58→/// ## Why This Exists
    59→///
    60→/// TanStack Query popularized this callback pattern for mutations because it provides:
    61→/// - **Optimistic UI updates** via `onMutate` (before the server responds)
    62→/// - **Success handling** via `onSuccess` (update UI, show toast, navigate)
    63→/// - **Error handling** via `onError` (show error, revert optimistic update)
    64→/// - **Cleanup** via `onSettled` (always runs, like `finally`)
    65→///
    66→/// ## Example
    67→///
    68→/// ```swift
    69→/// $posts.createPost(
    70→///   content: "Hello world",
    71→///   callbacks: MutationCallbacks(
    72→///     onMutate: {
    73→///       print("Creating post...")
    74→///     },
    75→///     onSuccess: { post in
    76→///       print("Created post: \(post.id)")
    77→///     },
    78→///     onError: { error in
    79→///       print("Failed: \(error)")
    80→///     },
    81→///     onSettled: {
    82→///       print("Done (success or failure)")
    83→///     }
    84→///   )
    85→/// )
    86→/// ```
    87→public struct MutationCallbacks<T: Sendable>: Sendable {
    88→  /// Called immediately before the mutation is executed.
    89→  /// Use this for optimistic updates or loading states.
    90→  public var onMutate: (@Sendable () -> Void)?
    91→  
    92→  /// Called when the mutation succeeds.
    93→  /// Receives the result of the mutation (e.g., the created/updated entity).
    94→  public var onSuccess: (@Sendable (T) -> Void)?
    95→  
    96→  /// Called when the mutation fails.
    97→  /// Receives the error that occurred.
    98→  public var onError: (@Sendable (Error) -> Void)?
    99→  
   100→  /// Called after the mutation completes, regardless of success or failure.
   101→  /// Use this for cleanup, like dismissing loading states.
   102→  public var onSettled: (@Sendable () -> Void)?
   103→  
   104→  public init(
   105→    onMutate: (@Sendable () -> Void)? = nil,
   106→    onSuccess: (@Sendable (T) -> Void)? = nil,
   107→    onError: (@Sendable (Error) -> Void)? = nil,
   108→    onSettled: (@Sendable () -> Void)? = nil
   109→  ) {
   110→    self.onMutate = onMutate
   111→    self.onSuccess = onSuccess
   112→    self.onError = onError
   113→    self.onSettled = onSettled
   114→  }
   115→}
   116→
   117→// MARK: - MutationCallbacks Convenience Methods
   118→
   119→extension MutationCallbacks {
   120→  /// Create callbacks with only an error handler.
   121→  ///
   122→  /// This is the most common use case for fire-and-forget mutations where
   123→  /// you only care about logging errors.
   124→  ///
   125→  /// ## Example
   126→  /// ```swift
   127→  /// $posts.updateTitle(id, to: "New Title", callbacks: .onError { error in
   128→  ///     print("Failed: \(error)")
   129→  /// })
   130→  /// ```
   131→  public static func onError(_ handler: @escaping @Sendable (Error) -> Void) -> MutationCallbacks {
   132→    MutationCallbacks(onError: handler)
   133→  }
   134→
   135→  /// Create callbacks with only a success handler.
   136→  ///
   137→  /// ## Example
   138→  /// ```swift
   139→  /// $posts.createPost(title: "Hello", callbacks: .onSuccess { post in
   140→  ///     print("Created: \(post.id)")
   141→  /// })
   142→  /// ```
   143→  public static func onSuccess(_ handler: @escaping @Sendable (T) -> Void) -> MutationCallbacks {
   144→    MutationCallbacks(onSuccess: handler)
   145→  }
   146→
   147→  /// Create callbacks with only a settled handler.
   148→  ///
   149→  /// ## Example
   150→  /// ```swift
   151→  /// $posts.deletePost(id, callbacks: .onSettled {
   152→  ///     isLoading = false
   153→  /// })
   154→  /// ```
   155→  public static func onSettled(_ handler: @escaping @Sendable () -> Void) -> MutationCallbacks {
   156→    MutationCallbacks(onSettled: handler)
   157→  }
   158→}

   160→// MARK: - Explicit Mutation Methods for Shared Collections
   161→
   162→extension Shared {
   163→  
   164→  // MARK: - Create
   165→  
   166→  /// Create a new entity and sync to InstantDB.
   167→  ///
   168→  /// This method follows the TypeScript InstantDB SDK pattern:
   169→  /// 1. Sends transaction to Reactor which applies optimistic update
   170→  /// 2. Reactor notifies subscriptions to update @Shared value
   171→  /// 3. Server transaction is sent
   172→  ///
   173→  /// Unlike `withLock { $0.append(entity) }`, this does NOT compute diffs.
   174→  /// It sends exactly one transaction for the new entity.
   175→  ///
   176→  /// ## Example
   177→  ///
   178→  /// ```swift
   179→  /// @Shared(.instantSync(Schema.goals)) var goals: [Goal]
   180→  ///
   181→  /// let newGoal = Goal(id: UUID().uuidString, title: "Learn Swift")
   182→  /// try await $goals.create(newGoal)
   183→  /// ```
   184→  ///
   185→  /// - Parameter entity: The entity to create
   186→  /// - Throws: If the transaction fails
   187→  @MainActor
   188→  public func create<Element: EntityIdentifiable & Encodable & Sendable>(
   189→    _ entity: Element
   190→  ) async throws where Value: RangeReplaceableCollection, Value.Element == Element {
   191→    @Dependency(\.instantReactor) var reactor
   192→    @Dependency(\.instantAppID) var appID
   193→    
   194→    // Generate explicit transaction chunk
   195→    let namespace = Element.namespace
   196→    let attrs = try encodeEntityAttributes(entity)
   197→    
   198→    let chunk = TransactionChunk(
   199→      namespace: namespace,
   200→      id: entity.id,
   201→      ops: [["update", namespace, entity.id, attrs]]
   202→    )
   203→    
   204→    // Send to Reactor which handles optimistic update + server transaction
   205→    try await reactor.transact(appID: appID, chunks: [chunk])
   206→  }
   207→  
   208→  // MARK: - Delete
   209→  
   210→  /// Delete an entity by ID and sync to InstantDB.
   211→  ///
   212→  /// This method follows the TypeScript InstantDB SDK pattern:
   213→  /// 1. Sends transaction to Reactor which applies optimistic update
   214→  /// 2. Reactor notifies subscriptions to update @Shared value
   215→  /// 3. Server transaction is sent
   216→  ///
   217→  /// Unlike `withLock { $0.remove(id:) }`, this does NOT compute diffs.
   218→  /// It sends exactly one delete transaction.
   219→  ///
   220→  /// ## Example
   221→  ///
   222→  /// ```swift
   223→  /// @Shared(.instantSync(Schema.goals)) var goals: [Goal]
   224→  ///
   225→  /// try await $goals.delete(id: goal.id)
   226→  /// ```
   227→  ///
   228→  /// - Parameter id: The ID of the entity to delete
   229→  /// - Throws: If the transaction fails
   230→  @MainActor
   231→  public func delete<Element: EntityIdentifiable & Sendable>(
   232→    id: String
   233→  ) async throws where Value: RangeReplaceableCollection, Value.Element == Element {
   234→    @Dependency(\.instantReactor) var reactor
   235→    @Dependency(\.instantAppID) var appID
   236→    
   237→    // Generate explicit delete chunk
   238→    let namespace = Element.namespace
   239→    
   240→    let chunk = TransactionChunk(
   241→      namespace: namespace,
   242→      id: id,
   243→      ops: [["delete", namespace, id]]
   244→    )
   245→    
   246→    // Send to Reactor which handles optimistic update + server transaction
   247→    try await reactor.transact(appID: appID, chunks: [chunk])
   248→  }
   249→  
   250→  // MARK: - Update
   251→  
   252→  /// Update an entity's fields and sync to InstantDB.
   253→  ///
   254→  /// This method follows the TypeScript InstantDB SDK pattern:
   255→  /// 1. Reads current entity, applies modification
   256→  /// 2. Sends transaction to Reactor which applies optimistic update
   257→  /// 3. Reactor notifies subscriptions to update @Shared value
   258→  /// 4. Server transaction is sent
   259→  ///
   260→  /// **Important**: This method sends only the CHANGED fields, not the entire entity.
   261→  /// This prevents concurrent updates from clobbering each other (e.g., updating
   262→  /// `text` and `words` simultaneously on a transcription segment).
   263→  ///
   264→  /// ## Example
   265→  ///
   266→  /// ```swift
   267→  /// @Shared(.instantSync(Schema.goals)) var goals: [Goal]
   268→  ///
   269→  /// try await $goals.update(id: goal.id) { goal in
   270→  ///   goal.title = "Updated Title"
   271→  ///   goal.completed = true
   272→  /// }
   273→  /// ```
   274→  ///
   275→  /// - Parameters:
   276→  ///   - id: The ID of the entity to update
   277→  ///   - modify: A closure that modifies the entity
   278→  /// - Throws: If the entity is not found or the transaction fails
   279→  ///
   280→  /// ## Why We Read From TripleStore
   281→  /// See the IdentifiedArrayOf version for detailed explanation. In short:
   282→  /// we read from TripleStore to get optimistic updates that may not have
   283→  /// propagated to wrappedValue yet due to AsyncStream timing.
   284→  @MainActor
   285→  public func update<Element: EntityIdentifiable & Encodable & Sendable>(
   286→    id: String,
   287→    _ modify: (inout Element) -> Void
   288→  ) async throws where Value: RangeReplaceableCollection, Value.Element == Element {
   289→    @Dependency(\.instantReactor) var reactor
   290→    @Dependency(\.instantAppID) var appID
   291→
   292→    // Read from TripleStore directly to get optimistic updates that may not have
   293→    // propagated to wrappedValue yet. Fall back to wrappedValue for backward compat.
   294→    var entity: Element
   295→    if let storeEntity: Element = await reactor.getEntity(id: id) {
   296→      entity = storeEntity
   297→    } else if let wrappedEntity = wrappedValue.first(where: { $0.id == id }) {
   298→      entity = wrappedEntity
   299→    } else {
   300→      throw InstantMutationError.entityNotFound(id: id, namespace: Element.namespace)
   301→    }
   302→
   303→    // Encode BEFORE modification to compare
   304→    let beforeAttrs = try encodeEntityAttributes(entity)
   305→
   306→    // Apply modification locally
   307→    modify(&entity)
   308→
   309→    // Encode AFTER modification
   310→    let afterAttrs = try encodeEntityAttributes(entity)
   311→
   312→    // Compute only the changed fields (field-level update)
   313→    // This prevents concurrent updates from clobbering each other
   314→    let changedAttrs = computeChangedFields(before: beforeAttrs, after: afterAttrs)
   315→
   316→    guard !changedAttrs.isEmpty else {
   317→      // No actual changes - nothing to do
   318→      return
   319→    }
   320→
   321→    // Generate explicit update chunk with ONLY changed fields
   322→    let namespace = Element.namespace
   323→
   324→    let chunk = TransactionChunk(
   325→      namespace: namespace,
   326→      id: id,
   327→      ops: [["update", namespace, id, changedAttrs]]
   328→    )
   329→
   330→    // Send to Reactor which handles optimistic update + server transaction
   331→    try await reactor.transact(appID: appID, chunks: [chunk])
   332→  }
   333→  
   334→  // MARK: - Link
   335→  
   336→  /// Link an entity to another entity.
   337→  ///
   338→  /// This method sends an explicit "link" transaction to the server.
   339→  /// It does NOT modify local state (the link will be reflected when
   340→  /// the subscription receives the updated data).
   341→  ///
   342→  /// ## Example
   343→  ///
   344→  /// ```swift
   345→  /// @Shared(.instantSync(Schema.posts.with(\.author))) var posts: [Post]
   346→  ///
   347→  /// // Link a post to its author
   348→  /// try await $posts.link(post.id, "author", to: profile.id, namespace: "profiles")
   349→  /// ```
   350→  ///
   351→  /// - Parameters:
   352→  ///   - id: The ID of the entity to link from
   353→  ///   - label: The link label (e.g., "author", "creator")
   354→  ///   - targetId: The ID of the entity to link to
   355→  ///   - namespace: The namespace of the target entity
   356→  /// - Throws: If the transaction fails
   357→  @MainActor

   359→    _ id: String,
   360→    _ label: String,
   361→    to targetId: String,
   362→    namespace targetNamespace: String
   363→  ) async throws where Value: RangeReplaceableCollection, Value.Element == Element {
   364→    @Dependency(\.instantReactor) var reactor

   366→    
   367→    let namespace = Element.namespace
   368→    
   369→    let chunk = TransactionChunk(
   370→      namespace: namespace,
   371→      id: id,
   372→      ops: [["link", namespace, id, [label: ["id": targetId, "namespace": targetNamespace]] as [String: Any]]]
   373→    )

   376→  }

   475→// MARK: - IdentifiedArray Support
   476→
   477→extension Shared {
   478→  
   479→  /// Create a new entity and sync to InstantDB (IdentifiedArray version).
   480→  ///
   481→  /// ## How This Works (TypeScript SDK Pattern)
   482→  ///
   483→  /// Following the TypeScript InstantDB SDK architecture:
   484→  /// 1. Generate a transaction chunk with the entity data
   485→  /// 2. Send to Reactor.transact() which:
   486→  ///    - Applies optimistic update to triple store
   487→  ///    - Notifies subscriptions via handleOptimisticUpsert()
   488→  ///    - Sends transaction to server
   489→  /// 3. The subscription's AsyncStream yields the new value
   490→  /// 4. InstantSyncKey.subscribe() updates the @Shared value
   491→  ///
   492→  /// We do NOT use withLock here because:
   493→  /// - withLock triggers save() which computes diffs
   494→  /// - Diff computation can race with other mutations and generate incorrect deletes
   495→  /// - The TypeScript SDK never uses diff-based saves for explicit mutations
   496→  @MainActor
   497→  public func create<Element: EntityIdentifiable & Encodable & Sendable>(
   498→    _ entity: Element
   499→  ) async throws where Value == IdentifiedArrayOf<Element> {
   500→    @Dependency(\.instantReactor) var reactor
   501→    @Dependency(\.instantAppID) var appID
   502→
   503→    // 1. Generate explicit transaction chunk
   504→    let namespace = Element.namespace
   505→    let attrs = try encodeEntityAttributes(entity)
   506→
   507→    let chunk = TransactionChunk(
   508→      namespace: namespace,
   509→      id: entity.id,
   510→      ops: [["update", namespace, entity.id, attrs]]
   511→    )
   512→
   513→    // 2. Send to Reactor which handles:
   514→    //    - Optimistic update to triple store
   515→    //    - Subscription notification (updates @Shared value)
   516→    //    - Server transaction
   517→    try await reactor.transact(appID: appID, chunks: [chunk])
   518→  }
   519→  
   520→  /// Delete an entity by ID and sync to InstantDB (IdentifiedArray version).
   521→  ///
   522→  /// Following TypeScript SDK pattern - no withLock to avoid triggering diff-based save.
   523→  @MainActor
   524→  public func delete<Element: EntityIdentifiable & Sendable>(
   525→    id: String
   526→  ) async throws where Value == IdentifiedArrayOf<Element> {
   527→    @Dependency(\.instantReactor) var reactor
   528→    @Dependency(\.instantAppID) var appID
   529→    
   530→    // Generate explicit delete chunk
   531→    let namespace = Element.namespace
   532→    
   533→    let chunk = TransactionChunk(
   534→      namespace: namespace,
   535→      id: id,
   536→      ops: [["delete", namespace, id]]
   537→    )
   538→    
   539→    // Send to Reactor which handles optimistic update + server transaction
   540→    try await reactor.transact(appID: appID, chunks: [chunk])
   541→  }
   542→  
   543→  /// Update an entity's fields and sync to InstantDB (IdentifiedArray version).
   544→  ///
   545→  /// Following TypeScript SDK pattern - we need to read the current entity to apply
   546→  /// the modification, but we don't use withLock to avoid triggering diff-based save.
   547→  ///
   548→  /// **Important**: This method sends only the CHANGED fields, not the entire entity.
   549→  /// This prevents concurrent updates from clobbering each other (e.g., updating
   550→  /// `text` and `words` simultaneously on a transcription segment).
   551→  ///
   552→  /// ## Why We Read From TripleStore
   553→  /// The `wrappedValue` is updated asynchronously via AsyncStream. When `create()`
   554→  /// and `update()` are called in rapid succession:
   555→  /// 1. `create()` applies optimistic update to TripleStore (synchronous)
   556→  /// 2. `create()` yields to AsyncStream (asynchronous delivery)
   557→  /// 3. `update()` reads `wrappedValue` → entity not found (stream not consumed yet)
   558→  ///
   559→  /// By reading from the TripleStore directly, we get the latest state including
   560→  /// optimistic updates that haven't yet flowed through to `wrappedValue`.
   561→  @MainActor
   562→  public func update<Element: EntityIdentifiable & Encodable & Sendable>(
   563→    id: String,
   564→    _ modify: (inout Element) -> Void
   565→  ) async throws where Value == IdentifiedArrayOf<Element> {
   566→    @Dependency(\.instantReactor) var reactor
   567→    @Dependency(\.instantAppID) var appID
   568→
   569→    // Read from TripleStore directly to get optimistic updates that may not have
   570→    // propagated to wrappedValue yet. Fall back to wrappedValue for backward compat.
   571→    var entity: Element
   572→    if let storeEntity: Element = await reactor.getEntity(id: id) {
   573→      entity = storeEntity
   574→    } else if let wrappedEntity = wrappedValue[id: id] {
   575→      entity = wrappedEntity
   576→    } else {
   577→      throw InstantMutationError.entityNotFound(id: id, namespace: Element.namespace)
   578→    }
   579→
   580→    // Encode BEFORE modification to compare
   581→    let beforeAttrs = try encodeEntityAttributes(entity)
   582→
   583→    // Apply modification locally
   584→    modify(&entity)
   585→
   586→    // Encode AFTER modification
   587→    let afterAttrs = try encodeEntityAttributes(entity)
   588→
   589→    // Compute only the changed fields (field-level update)
   590→    // This prevents concurrent updates from clobbering each other
   591→    let changedAttrs = computeChangedFields(before: beforeAttrs, after: afterAttrs)
   592→
   593→    guard !changedAttrs.isEmpty else {
   594→      // No actual changes - nothing to do
   595→      return
   596→    }
   597→
   598→    // Generate explicit update chunk with ONLY changed fields
   599→    let namespace = Element.namespace
   600→
   601→    let chunk = TransactionChunk(
   602→      namespace: namespace,
   603→      id: id,
   604→      ops: [["update", namespace, id, changedAttrs]]
   605→    )
   606→
   607→    // Send to Reactor which handles optimistic update + server transaction
   608→    try await reactor.transact(appID: appID, chunks: [chunk])
   609→  }
   610→
   611→  /// Update a single field of an entity without reading the full entity first.
   612→  ///
   613→  /// This is the safest method for concurrent updates because it:
   614→  /// 1. Does NOT read the current entity (avoids stale snapshots)
   615→  /// 2. Sends ONLY the specified field to the server
   616→  /// 3. Cannot clobber other fields being updated concurrently
   617→  ///
   618→  /// ## Example
   619→  ///
   620→  /// ```swift
   621→  /// // Update just the text field - safe even if words is being updated concurrently
   622→  /// try await $segments.updateField(id: segmentId, field: "text", value: "New text")
   623→  /// ```
   624→  ///
   625→  /// - Parameters:
   626→  ///   - id: The ID of the entity to update
   627→  ///   - field: The field name to update
   628→  ///   - value: The new value for the field
   629→  /// - Throws: If the transaction fails
   630→  @MainActor
   631→  public func updateField<Element: EntityIdentifiable & Sendable>(
   632→    id: String,
   633→    field: String,
   634→    value: Any
   635→  ) async throws where Value == IdentifiedArrayOf<Element> {
   636→    @Dependency(\.instantReactor) var reactor
   637→    @Dependency(\.instantAppID) var appID
   638→
   639→    let namespace = Element.namespace
   640→
   641→    let chunk = TransactionChunk(
   642→      namespace: namespace,
   643→      id: id,
   644→      ops: [["update", namespace, id, [field: value]]]
   645→    )
   646→
   647→    try await reactor.transact(appID: appID, chunks: [chunk])
   648→  }
   649→
   650→  /// Update multiple fields of an entity without reading the full entity first.
   651→  ///
   652→  /// This method sends ONLY the specified fields, preventing concurrent updates
   653→  /// from clobbering each other.
   654→  ///
   655→  /// ## Example
   656→  ///
   657→  /// ```swift
   658→  /// try await $segments.updateFields(id: segmentId, fields: [
   659→  ///   "text": "New text",
   660→  ///   "endTime": 1.5
   661→  /// ])
   662→  /// ```
   663→  @MainActor
   664→  public func updateFields<Element: EntityIdentifiable & Sendable>(
   665→    id: String,
   666→    fields: [String: Any]
   667→  ) async throws where Value == IdentifiedArrayOf<Element> {
   668→    @Dependency(\.instantReactor) var reactor
   669→    @Dependency(\.instantAppID) var appID
   670→
   671→    guard !fields.isEmpty else { return }
   672→
   673→    let namespace = Element.namespace
   674→
   675→    let chunk = TransactionChunk(
   676→      namespace: namespace,
   677→      id: id,
   678→      ops: [["update", namespace, id, fields]]
   679→    )
   680→
   681→    try await reactor.transact(appID: appID, chunks: [chunk])
   682→  }
   683→  
   684→  /// Link an entity to another entity (IdentifiedArray version).
   685→  @MainActor

   687→    _ id: String,

   689→    to targetId: String,

   701→    )

   748→
   749→// MARK: - Errors
   750→
   751→/// Errors that can occur during explicit mutations.
   752→public enum InstantMutationError: Error, LocalizedError {
   753→  case entityNotFound(id: String, namespace: String)
   754→  case encodingFailed(Error)
   755→  
   756→  public var errorDescription: String? {
   757→    switch self {
   758→    case .entityNotFound(let id, let namespace):
   759→      return "Entity not found: \(namespace)/\(id)"
   760→    case .encodingFailed(let error):
   761→      return "Failed to encode entity: \(error.localizedDescription)"
   762→    }
   763→  }
   764→}
   765→
   766→// MARK: - Helpers
   767→
   768→/// Compute only the fields that changed between two encoded attribute dictionaries.
   769→///
   770→/// This is critical for preventing concurrent update clobbering. When two updates
   771→/// run simultaneously:
   772→/// - Update A reads entity, modifies `text`, encodes all attrs including stale `words`
   773→/// - Update B reads entity, modifies `words`, encodes all attrs including stale `text`
   774→///
   775→/// Without field-level diffing, whichever update arrives at the server last
   776→/// clobbers the other's changes.
   777→///
   778→/// With field-level diffing:
   779→/// - Update A sends only `{text: "new text"}`
   780→/// - Update B sends only `{words: [...]}`
   781→/// - Both updates succeed without clobbering
   782→private func computeChangedFields(
   783→  before: [String: Any],
   784→  after: [String: Any]
   785→) -> [String: Any] {
   786→  var changed: [String: Any] = [:]
   787→
   788→  for (key, afterValue) in after {
   789→    if let beforeValue = before[key] {
   790→      // Field existed before - check if it changed
   791→      if !valuesAreEqual(beforeValue, afterValue) {
   792→        changed[key] = afterValue
   793→      }
   794→    } else {
   795→      // New field
   796→      changed[key] = afterValue
   797→    }
   798→  }
   799→
   800→  // Also check for removed fields (set to nil)
   801→  for key in before.keys {
   802→    if after[key] == nil {
   803→      changed[key] = NSNull()
   804→    }
   805→  }
   806→
   807→  return changed
   808→}
   809→
   810→/// Compare two values for equality.
   811→///
   812→/// This handles the various types that can appear in encoded entity attributes.
   813→private func valuesAreEqual(_ lhs: Any, _ rhs: Any) -> Bool {
   814→  // Handle NSNull
   815→  if lhs is NSNull && rhs is NSNull {
   816→    return true
   817→  }
   818→
   819→  // Handle primitives
   820→  if let l = lhs as? String, let r = rhs as? String {
   821→    return l == r
   822→  }
   823→  if let l = lhs as? Double, let r = rhs as? Double {
   824→    return l == r
   825→  }
   826→  if let l = lhs as? Int, let r = rhs as? Int {
   827→    return l == r
   828→  }
   829→  if let l = lhs as? Bool, let r = rhs as? Bool {
   830→    return l == r
   831→  }
   832→
   833→  // Handle arrays (JSON fields like `words`)
   834→  if let l = lhs as? [Any], let r = rhs as? [Any] {
   835→    guard l.count == r.count else { return false }
   836→    for (i, lVal) in l.enumerated() {
   837→      if !valuesAreEqual(lVal, r[i]) {
   838→        return false
   839→      }
   840→    }
   841→    return true
   842→  }
   843→
   844→  // Handle dictionaries (nested objects)
   845→  if let l = lhs as? [String: Any], let r = rhs as? [String: Any] {
   846→    guard l.count == r.count else { return false }
   847→    for (key, lVal) in l {
   848→      guard let rVal = r[key], valuesAreEqual(lVal, rVal) else {
   849→        return false
   850→      }
   851→    }
   852→    return true
   853→  }
   854→
   855→  // Different types = not equal
   856→  return false
   857→}
   858→
   859→/// Encode an entity's attributes to a dictionary for the transaction.
   860→///
   861→/// This extracts all properties except `id` and link properties (which are
   862→/// handled separately via link operations).
   863→///
   864→/// ## Why We Use a Custom Encoder
   865→///
   866→/// The naive approach of `JSONEncoder` + `JSONSerialization.jsonObject()` has a critical bug:
   867→/// `JSONSerialization` uses `NSNumber` for both numbers and booleans, and Swift's bridging
   868→/// can interpret `0`/`1` as `false`/`true`. This causes InstantDB server errors like:
   869→/// "Invalid value type for tiles.x. Value must be a number but the provided value type is boolean."
   870→///
   871→/// Instead, we use a custom `DictionaryEncoder` that preserves type information.
   872→private func encodeEntityAttributes<E: Encodable>(_ entity: E) throws -> [String: Any] {
   873→  let encoder = DictionaryEncoder()
   874→  let dict = try encoder.encode(entity)
   875→
   876→  // Filter out id (handled separately)
   877→  // Note: We NO LONGER filter out arrays/objects - they can be JSON fields!
   878→  // The TypeScript SDK sends JSON arrays (like `words: [{text, startTime, endTime}]`)
   879→  // as regular attributes, not as links.
   880→  var attrs: [String: Any] = [:]
   881→  for (key, value) in dict {
   882→    // Skip id - it's handled separately
   883→    if key == "id" { continue }
   884→
   885→    // Skip nil values
   886→    if case Optional<Any>.none = value { continue }
   887→    if value is NSNull { continue }
   888→
   889→    attrs[key] = value
   890→  }
   891→
   892→  return attrs
   893→}
   894→
   895→// MARK: - Dictionary Encoder
   896→
   897→/// A custom encoder that encodes `Encodable` values directly to `[String: Any]` dictionaries.
   898→///
   899→/// Unlike `JSONEncoder` + `JSONSerialization`, this preserves type information correctly:
   900→/// - `Double` values stay as `Double` (not converted to `NSNumber` which might be interpreted as `Bool`)
   901→/// - `Bool` values stay as `Bool`
   902→/// - `Int` values stay as `Int`
   903→///
   904→/// This is critical for InstantDB which strictly validates types.
   905→private class DictionaryEncoder {
   906→  func encode<T: Encodable>(_ value: T) throws -> [String: Any] {
   907→    let encoder = _DictionaryEncoder()
   908→    try value.encode(to: encoder)
   909→    guard let dict = encoder.result as? [String: Any] else {
   910→      throw InstantMutationError.encodingFailed(
   911→        NSError(domain: "SharingInstant", code: -1, userInfo: [
   912→          NSLocalizedDescriptionKey: "Failed to encode entity to dictionary"
   913→        ])
   914→      )
   915→    }
   916→    return dict
   917→  }
   918→}
   919→
   920→private class _DictionaryEncoder: Encoder {
   921→  var codingPath: [CodingKey] = []
   922→  var userInfo: [CodingUserInfoKey: Any] = [:]
   923→  var result: Any?
   924→  
   925→  func container<Key: CodingKey>(keyedBy type: Key.Type) -> KeyedEncodingContainer<Key> {
   926→    let container = _KeyedEncodingContainer<Key>(encoder: self, codingPath: codingPath)
   927→    return KeyedEncodingContainer(container)
   928→  }
   929→  
   930→  func unkeyedContainer() -> UnkeyedEncodingContainer {
   931→    return _UnkeyedEncodingContainer(encoder: self, codingPath: codingPath)
   932→  }
   933→  
   934→  func singleValueContainer() -> SingleValueEncodingContainer {
   935→    return _SingleValueEncodingContainer(encoder: self, codingPath: codingPath)
   936→  }
   937→}
   938→
   939→private class _KeyedEncodingContainer<Key: CodingKey>: KeyedEncodingContainerProtocol {
   940→  private let encoder: _DictionaryEncoder
