   152→
   153→/// Cached query result with version tracking for invalidation.
   154→///
   155→/// ## TypeScript SDK Parity
   156→/// Matches the caching pattern from Reactor.js `dataForQuery()` (lines 1224-1261).
   157→/// The cache key is a hash of the query parameters (namespace, orderBy, includedLinks).
   158→/// The cache is valid only when both storeVersion and pendingMutationsVersion match.
   159→public struct CachedQueryResult: Sendable {
   160→    /// The cached entity data as dictionaries (serialized form)
   161→    public let data: [[String: AnySendable]]
   162→
   163→    /// Store version when this cache was created
   164→    public let storeVersion: Int
   165→
   166→    /// Pending mutations version when this cache was created
   167→    public let pendingMutationsVersion: Int
   168→
   169→    /// The processedTxId from the server (for pending mutation cleanup)
   170→    public let processedTxId: Int?
   171→}
   172→
   173→public actor Reactor {
   174→  // public static let shared = Reactor() // Removed for DI
   175→
   176→
   177→  private let store: SharedTripleStore
   178→  private let clientInstanceID: String
   179→  private var activeSubscriptions: [UUID: SubscriptionHandle] = [:]
   180→
   181→  // MARK: - Garbage Collection
   182→
   183→  /// Garbage collector for the TripleStore.
   184→  ///
   185→  /// ## TypeScript SDK Parity
   186→  /// Matches the GC system in PersistedObject.ts which manages memory via:
   187→  /// - Sacred keys (entities in active subscriptions that cannot be evicted)
   188→  /// - Age-based eviction (entities not accessed recently)
   189→  /// - Size limits (maxEntries, maxSize)
   190→  private let gc: TripleStoreGC
   191→
   192→  // MARK: - Version Tracking for Query Result Caching
   193→
   194→  /// Version counter for the TripleStore. Incremented when store receives updates.
   195→  ///
   196→  /// ## TypeScript SDK Parity
   197→  /// Matches `querySubs.version()` in Reactor.js line 1231.
   198→  /// Used to detect when cached query results are stale due to store changes.
   199→  private var storeVersion: Int = 0
   200→
   201→  /// Version counter for pending mutations. Incremented when mutations are added/removed/confirmed.
   202→  ///
   203→  /// ## TypeScript SDK Parity
   204→  /// Matches `kv.version()` in Reactor.js line 1233 (kv stores pendingMutations).
   205→  /// Used to detect when cached query results are stale due to mutation changes.
   206→  private var pendingMutationsVersion: Int = 0
   207→
   208→  /// Cache of query results keyed by query hash.
   209→  ///
   210→  /// ## TypeScript SDK Parity
   211→  /// Matches `_dataForQueryCache` in Reactor.js line 1239.
   212→  /// Each entry is invalidated when storeVersion or pendingMutationsVersion changes.
   213→  private var queryResultCache: [String: CachedQueryResult] = [:]
   214→
   215→  // MARK: - Pending Mutation Cleanup (TypeScript SDK Parity)
   216→
   217→  /// Maps query hash to the processedTxId received from the server.
   218→  ///
   219→  /// ## TypeScript SDK Parity
   220→  /// Matches the pattern in Reactor.js `_cleanupPendingMutationsQueries()` (lines 1461-1476).
   221→  /// Each query subscription tracks the latest processedTxId from server responses.
   222→  /// When cleaning up, we find the minimum processedTxId across all queries.
   223→  private var queryProcessedTxIds: [String: Int] = [:]
   224→
   225→  /// Threshold for triggering timeout-based cleanup.
   226→  ///
   227→  /// ## TypeScript SDK Parity
   228→  /// Matches `_pendingMutationCleanupThreshold` in Reactor.js.
   229→  /// Timeout cleanup only runs when pending mutation count exceeds this threshold.
   230→  private let pendingMutationCleanupThreshold = 200
   231→
   232→  /// Timeout in seconds for confirmed mutations before cleanup.
   233→  ///
   234→  /// ## TypeScript SDK Parity
   235→  /// Matches `_pendingTxCleanupTimeout` in Reactor.js (30000ms = 30 seconds).
   236→  /// Mutations confirmed more than this many seconds ago are cleaned up.
   237→  private let pendingTxCleanupTimeoutSeconds: TimeInterval = 30
   238→
   239→  /// The app ID for the current Reactor instance.
   240→  /// Set when first subscription is created, used for cleanup operations.
   241→  private var currentAppID: String?
   242→
   243→  /// Tracks whether we've restored pending mutations from SQLite.
   244→  ///
   245→  /// ## Why This Exists
   246→  /// When the app restarts, pending mutations (optimistic updates that haven't been
   247→  /// confirmed by the server) are persisted in SQLite but not in the in-memory
   248→  /// SharedTripleStore. Without restoring them, the UI would show stale data until
   249→  /// the server confirms the mutations (which requires network connectivity).
   250→  ///
   251→  /// This flag ensures we only restore once per app launch to avoid duplicate
   252→  /// application of the same mutations.
   253→  private var hasRestoredPendingMutations: Bool = false
   254→
   255→  public init(
   256→    store: SharedTripleStore,
   257→    clientInstanceID: String = "default",
   258→    gcConfig: TripleStoreGCConfig = .default
   259→  ) {
   260→    self.store = store
   261→    self.clientInstanceID = clientInstanceID
   262→    self.gc = TripleStoreGC(store: store, config: gcConfig)
   263→  }
   264→
   265→  /// Starts background garbage collection.
   266→  ///
   267→  /// Call this after the Reactor is initialized to begin periodic GC.
   268→  /// GC will run at intervals specified by the config, evicting entities
   269→  /// that are not in active subscriptions and haven't been accessed recently.
   270→  ///
   271→  /// ## Usage
   272→  /// ```swift
   273→  /// let reactor = Reactor(store: store)
   274→  /// await reactor.startGC()
   275→  /// ```
   276→  public func startGC() async {
   277→    await gc.start()
   278→  }
   279→
   280→  /// Stops background garbage collection.
   281→  ///
   282→  /// Call this when the app is backgrounded or when GC is no longer needed.
   283→  public func stopGC() async {
   284→    await gc.stop()
   285→  }
   286→
   287→  /// Returns diagnostic information about the GC state.
   288→  public func getGCDiagnostics() async -> GCDiagnostics {
   289→    await gc.diagnostics()
   290→  }
   291→
   292→  /// Manually triggers a garbage collection run.
   293→  ///
   294→  /// Useful for testing or when immediate memory cleanup is needed.
   295→  ///
   296→  /// - Returns: GCResult with metrics about what was cleaned up
   297→  @discardableResult
   298→  public func runGC() async -> GCResult {
   299→    await gc.runGC()
   300→  }
   301→
   302→  // MARK: - Version Tracking & Cache Methods
   303→
   304→  /// Increments the store version when the TripleStore receives updates.
   305→  ///
   306→  /// ## When to Call
   307→  /// - After `store.addTriples()` in `handleDBUpdate()`
   308→  /// - After `applyOptimisticUpdate()` modifies the store
   309→  ///
   310→  /// ## TypeScript SDK Parity
   311→  /// In TypeScript, `querySubs.version()` is incremented via `PersistedObject.updateInPlace()`.
   312→  public func incrementStoreVersion() {
   313→    storeVersion += 1
   314→  }
   315→
   316→  /// Increments the pending mutations version when mutations change.
   317→  ///
   318→  /// ## When to Call
   319→  /// - After adding a new pending mutation
   320→  /// - After confirming a pending mutation
   321→  /// - After removing a pending mutation
   322→  ///
   323→  /// ## TypeScript SDK Parity
   324→  /// In TypeScript, `kv.version()` is incremented via `PersistedObject.updateInPlace()`.
   325→  public func incrementPendingMutationsVersion() {
   326→    pendingMutationsVersion += 1
   327→  }
   328→
   329→  /// Gets current store version (for cache validation).
   330→  public func getStoreVersion() -> Int {
   331→    return storeVersion
   332→  }
   333→
   334→  /// Gets current pending mutations version (for cache validation).
   335→  public func getPendingMutationsVersion() -> Int {
   336→    return pendingMutationsVersion
   337→  }
   338→
   339→  /// Retrieves a cached query result if it exists and is still valid.
   340→  ///
   341→  /// ## TypeScript SDK Parity
   342→  /// Matches the cache lookup in Reactor.js `dataForQuery()` lines 1239-1246.
   343→  ///
   344→  /// - Parameter queryHash: The hash identifying the query
   345→  /// - Returns: The cached result if valid, nil if cache miss or stale
   346→  public func getCachedResult(queryHash: String) -> CachedQueryResult? {
   347→    guard let cached = queryResultCache[queryHash] else {
   348→      return nil
   349→    }
   350→
   351→    // Cache is valid only if both versions match
   352→    if cached.storeVersion == storeVersion &&
   353→       cached.pendingMutationsVersion == pendingMutationsVersion {
   354→      return cached
   355→    }
   356→
   357→    // Cache is stale, return nil
   358→    return nil
   359→  }
   360→
   361→  /// Stores a query result in the cache with current versions.
   362→  ///
   363→  /// ## TypeScript SDK Parity
   364→  /// Matches the cache update in Reactor.js `notifyOne()` line 1281.
   365→  ///
   366→  /// - Parameters:
   367→  ///   - queryHash: The hash identifying the query
   368→  ///   - data: The entity data as dictionaries
   369→  ///   - processedTxId: The processedTxId from the server (for pending mutation cleanup)
   370→  public func setCachedResult(queryHash: String, data: [[String: AnySendable]], processedTxId: Int? = nil) {
   371→    queryResultCache[queryHash] = CachedQueryResult(
   372→      data: data,
   373→      storeVersion: storeVersion,
   374→      pendingMutationsVersion: pendingMutationsVersion,
   375→      processedTxId: processedTxId
   376→    )
   377→  }
   378→
   379→  /// Clears all cached query results.
   380→  ///
   381→  /// ## When to Call
   382→  /// - When the user signs out
   383→  /// - When the app enters background (optional, for memory pressure)
   384→  public func clearCache() {
   385→    queryResultCache.removeAll()
   386→  }
   387→
   388→  /// Clears a specific cached query result.
   389→  ///
   390→  /// - Parameter queryHash: The hash identifying the query to clear
   391→  public func clearCachedResult(queryHash: String) {
   392→    queryResultCache.removeValue(forKey: queryHash)
   393→  }
   394→
   395→  // MARK: - Pending Mutation Restoration
   396→
   397→  /// Restores pending mutations from SQLite to the in-memory SharedTripleStore.
   398→  ///
   399→  /// ## Why This Exists
   400→  /// When the app restarts, pending mutations are persisted in SQLite but not in
   401→  /// the in-memory SharedTripleStore. This method re-applies those mutations so
   402→  /// users see their changes immediately, even before the server confirms them.
   403→  ///
   404→  /// This matches the TypeScript SDK behavior where `pendingMutations` are merged
   405→  /// into query results via `_applyOptimisticUpdates()`.
   406→  ///
   407→  /// - Parameter client: The InstantClient to load pending mutations from
   408→  private func restorePendingMutationsIfNeeded(client: InstantClient, appID: String) async {
   409→    guard !hasRestoredPendingMutations else {
   410→      reactorDebugLog("restorePendingMutations: SKIPPED - already restored")
   411→      return
   412→    }
   413→    hasRestoredPendingMutations = true
   414→
   415→    reactorDebugLog("restorePendingMutations: START", data: [
   416→      "activeSubscriptionCount": activeSubscriptions.count,
   417→      "subscriptionNamespaces": activeSubscriptions.values.map { $0.namespace }
   418→    ])
   419→
   420→    let pending = await client.getUnconfirmedPendingMutations()
   421→    guard !pending.isEmpty else {
   422→      reactorDebugLog("restorePendingMutations: no pending mutations to restore")
   423→      return
   424→    }
   425→
   426→    reactorDebugLog("restorePendingMutations: found \(pending.count) pending mutations", data: [
   427→      "mutationEventIds": pending.map { $0.eventId }
   428→    ])
   429→
   430→    // Get current attributes for cardinality information
   431→    let attrs = await MainActor.run { client.attributes }
   432→    reactorDebugLog("restorePendingMutations: got attributes", data: [
   433→      "attrCount": attrs.count
   434→    ])
   435→    if !attrs.isEmpty {
   436→      store.updateAttributes(attrs)
   437→    }
   438→
   439→    // Track all entity IDs we're restoring so we can notify subscriptions properly
   440→    var restoredEntityIds: [(namespace: String, id: String)] = []
   441→
   442→    // Apply each pending mutation to the local store
   443→    for mutation in pending {
   444→      let entityIds = applyPendingMutationToStore(mutation)
   445→      restoredEntityIds.append(contentsOf: entityIds)
   446→    }
   447→
   448→    reactorDebugLog("restorePendingMutations: applied to store", data: [
   449→      "restoredEntityCount": restoredEntityIds.count,
   450→      "restoredEntityIds": restoredEntityIds.map { "\($0.namespace):\($0.id)" }
   451→    ])
   452→
   453→    // CRITICAL: We must notify with specific entity IDs, not just notifyAll()
   454→    // because notifyAll() uses "__notifyAll__" sentinel which doesn't add to currentIDs.
   455→    // If currentIDs is empty (no server data yet), the subscription yields nothing.
   456→    for (namespace, id) in restoredEntityIds {
   457→      await notifyOptimisticUpsert(namespace: namespace, id: id)
   458→    }
   459→
   460→    reactorDebugLog("restorePendingMutations: notified subscriptions", data: [
   461→      "notifiedCount": restoredEntityIds.count
   462→    ])
   463→
   464→    // Also do a full notifyAll to ensure any complex queries recompute
   465→    await notifyAll()
   466→
   467→    reactorDebugLog("restorePendingMutations: COMPLETE", data: [
   468→      "restoredCount": pending.count,
   469→      "entityIds": restoredEntityIds.map { $0.id }
   470→    ])
   471→  }
   472→
   473→  /// Applies a single pending mutation's tx-steps to the local TripleStore.
   474→  ///
   475→  /// This parses the raw tx-steps format and applies creates/updates/deletes
   476→  /// to the SharedTripleStore, making the data immediately visible to subscriptions.
   477→  ///
   478→  /// - Returns: Array of (namespace, entityId) tuples for entities that were modified
   479→  private func applyPendingMutationToStore(_ mutation: PendingMutation) -> [(namespace: String, id: String)] {
   480→    let timestamp = ConflictResolution.optimisticTimestamp()
   481→    var modifiedEntities: [(namespace: String, id: String)] = []
   482→
   483→    for step in mutation.txSteps {
   484→      // CRITICAL FIX: step is [AnyCodableValue], not [Any].
   485→      // We must access .value on each element to get the underlying value.
   486→      guard step.count >= 1,
   487→            let action = step[0].value as? String else {
   488→        continue
   489→      }
   490→
   491→      switch action {
   492→      case "add-triple":
   493→        // Format: ["add-triple", entityId, attrId, value, ...]
   494→        guard step.count >= 4,
   495→              let entityId = step[1].value as? String,
   496→              let attrId = step[2].value as? String else {
   497→          continue
   498→        }
   499→        let rawValue = step[3].value
   500→        let value = convertToTripleValue(rawValue)
   501→
   502→        let triple = Triple(
   503→          entityId: entityId,
   504→          attributeId: attrId,
   505→          value: value,
   506→          createdAt: timestamp
   507→        )
   508→        let attr = store.attrsStore.getAttr(attrId)
   509→        let hasCardinalityOne = attr?.cardinality == .one
   510→        let isRef = attr?.valueType == .ref
   511→        store.addTriple(triple, hasCardinalityOne: hasCardinalityOne, isRef: isRef)
   512→
   513→        // Extract namespace from attrId (format: "namespace/field")
   514→        let namespace = attrId.components(separatedBy: "/").first ?? "unknown"
   515→        if !modifiedEntities.contains(where: { $0.id == entityId }) {
   516→          modifiedEntities.append((namespace: namespace, id: entityId))
   517→        }
   518→
   519→      case "retract-triple":
   520→        // Format: ["retract-triple", entityId, attrId, value, ...]
   521→        guard step.count >= 4,
   522→              let entityId = step[1].value as? String,
   523→              let attrId = step[2].value as? String else {
   524→          continue
   525→        }
   526→        let rawValue = step[3].value
   527→        let value = convertToTripleValue(rawValue)
   528→
   529→        let triple = Triple(
   530→          entityId: entityId,
   531→          attributeId: attrId,
   532→          value: value,
   533→          createdAt: timestamp
   534→        )
   535→        let attr = store.attrsStore.getAttr(attrId)
   536→        let isRef = attr?.valueType == .ref
   537→        store.retractTriple(triple, isRef: isRef)
   538→
   539→        let namespace = attrId.components(separatedBy: "/").first ?? "unknown"
   540→        if !modifiedEntities.contains(where: { $0.id == entityId }) {
   541→          modifiedEntities.append((namespace: namespace, id: entityId))
   542→        }
   543→
   544→      case "delete-entity":
   545→        // Format: ["delete-entity", namespace, entityId]
   546→        guard step.count >= 3,
   547→              let namespace = step[1].value as? String,
   548→              let entityId = step[2].value as? String else {
   549→          continue
   550→        }
   551→        store.deleteEntity(id: entityId)
   552→        // Don't add to modifiedEntities since it's deleted
   553→
   554→      default:
   555→        // Skip add-attr, update-attr, etc. - they're handled by the server
   556→        break
   557→      }
   558→    }
   559→
   560→    reactorDebugLog("applyPendingMutationToStore: processed mutation", data: [
   561→      "eventId": mutation.eventId,
   562→      "stepCount": mutation.txSteps.count,
   563→      "modifiedEntities": modifiedEntities.map { "\($0.namespace):\($0.id)" }
   564→    ])
   565→
   566→    return modifiedEntities
   567→  }
   568→
   569→  /// Converts a raw value from tx-steps to a TripleValue.
   570→  private func convertToTripleValue(_ rawValue: Any) -> TripleValue {
   571→    switch rawValue {
   572→    case let s as String:
   573→      return .string(s)
   574→    case let i as Int:
   575→      return .double(Double(i))
   576→    case let i as Int64:
   577→      return .double(Double(i))
   578→    case let d as Double:
   579→      return .double(d)
   580→    case let b as Bool:
   581→      return .bool(b)
   582→    case is NSNull:
   583→      return .null
   584→    default:
   585→      // For complex types, try to represent as string
   586→      return .string(String(describing: rawValue))
   587→    }
   588→  }
   589→
   590→  // MARK: - Schema Readiness
   591→  
   592→  private enum SubscriptionFilter: Sendable, Equatable {
   593→    case matchAll
   594→    case idEquals(String)
   595→    case unsupported
   596→  }
   597→  
   598→  private struct SubscriptionHandle: Sendable {
   599→    let namespace: String
   600→    let filter: SubscriptionFilter
   601→    let upsert: @Sendable (String) async -> Void
   602→    let delete: @Sendable (String) async -> Void
   603→    /// Callback to get the current entity IDs for this subscription.
   604→    /// Used for GC sacred entity tracking.
   605→    let getCurrentEntityIds: @Sendable () async -> Set<String>
   606→  }
   607→
   608→  private func waitForAttributes(
   609→    client: InstantClient,
   610→    timeoutSeconds: TimeInterval,
   611→    logContext: [String: Any]
   612→  ) async -> [Attribute] {
   613→    let deadline = Date().addingTimeInterval(timeoutSeconds)
   614→
   615→    while Date() < deadline {
   616→      let attrs = await MainActor.run { client.attributes }
   617→      if !attrs.isEmpty { return attrs }
   618→      try? await Task.sleep(nanoseconds: 50_000_000)
   619→    }
   620→
   621→    let attrs = await MainActor.run { client.attributes }
   622→    if attrs.isEmpty {
   623→      let contextDescription = logContext
   624→        .map { "\($0.key): \(String(describing: $0.value))" }
   625→        .sorted()
   626→        .joined(separator: ", ")
   627→
   628→      await MainActor.run {
   629→        InstantLogger.warning(
   630→          """
   631→          Reactor timed out waiting for schema attributes.
   632→
   633→          WHAT HAPPENED:
   634→            The client reported an authenticated WebSocket connection, but the schema
   635→            attributes were not available yet. Without attributes, we cannot normalize
   636→            InstaQL trees into triples reliably.
   637→
   638→          WHY THIS MATTERS:
   639→            Without schema, the triple store drops unknown fields, which can lead to
   640→            missing required fields when decoding entities from the store.
   641→
   642→          HOW TO FIX:
   643→            • Ensure the server's `init-ok` includes `attrs`.
   644→            • If this is a race, increase the wait window or refactor to await the
   645→              SDK's init processing before subscribing/transacting.
   646→
   647→          CONTEXT:
   648→            \(contextDescription)
   649→          """,
   650→          json: nil
   651→        )
   652→      }
   653→    }
   654→
   655→    return attrs
   656→  }
   657→
   658→  private func subscriptionFilter(whereClause: [String: Any]?) -> SubscriptionFilter {
   659→    guard let whereClause else { return .matchAll }
   660→    
   661→    if let id = whereClause["id"] as? String {
   662→      return .idEquals(id)
   663→    }
   664→    
   665→    if let dict = whereClause["id"] as? [String: Any],
   666→       let eq = dict["$eq"] as? String {
   667→      return .idEquals(eq)
   668→    }
   669→    
   670→    return .unsupported
   671→  }
   672→  
   673→  /// Notifies ALL active subscriptions to recompute their data from the store.
   674→  ///
   675→  /// ## Why This Exists (TypeScript Parity)
   676→  /// The TypeScript SDK's `notifyAll()` (Reactor.js lines 1303-1310) recomputes ALL
   677→  /// subscriptions after any mutation. This ensures:
   678→  /// - Cross-namespace consistency (e.g., a link mutation affects both sides)
   679→  /// - Correct filtering (subscriptions with complex WHERE clauses recompute)
   680→  /// - No missed updates (even if we can't predict which subscriptions are affected)
   681→  ///
   682→  /// ## Performance Note
   683→  /// This is intentionally aggressive. The TypeScript SDK does the same because
   684→  /// correctness trumps optimization. Each subscription reads from the normalized
   685→  /// store which is fast, and deduplication happens at the UI layer.
   686→  private func notifyAll() async {
   687→    for (_, handle) in activeSubscriptions {
   688→      // Trigger a recompute by calling upsert with a sentinel ID.
   689→      // The SubscriptionState will re-read from the store and yield new values.
   690→      await handle.upsert("__notifyAll__")
   691→    }
   692→  }
   693→
   694→  private func notifyOptimisticUpsert(namespace: String, id: String) async {
   695→    let matchingHandles = activeSubscriptions.values.filter { $0.namespace == namespace }
   696→    reactorDebugLog("notifyOptimisticUpsert", data: [
   697→      "namespace": namespace,
   698→      "id": id,
   699→      "totalSubscriptions": activeSubscriptions.count,
   700→      "matchingSubscriptions": matchingHandles.count,
   701→      "allNamespaces": activeSubscriptions.values.map { $0.namespace }
   702→    ])
   703→
   704→    for (_, handle) in activeSubscriptions where handle.namespace == namespace {
   705→      switch handle.filter {
   706→      case .matchAll:
   707→        reactorDebugLog("notifyOptimisticUpsert: calling upsert (matchAll)", data: [
   708→          "namespace": namespace,
   709→          "id": id
   710→        ])
   711→        await handle.upsert(id)
   712→      case .idEquals(let expectedId):
   713→        guard expectedId == id else { continue }
   714→        reactorDebugLog("notifyOptimisticUpsert: calling upsert (idEquals)", data: [
   715→          "namespace": namespace,
   716→          "id": id
   717→        ])
   718→        await handle.upsert(id)
   719→      case .unsupported:
   720→        continue
   721→      }
   722→    }
   723→  }
   724→
   725→  private func notifyOptimisticDelete(namespace: String, id: String) async {
   726→    for handle in activeSubscriptions.values where handle.namespace == namespace {
   727→      switch handle.filter {
   728→      case .matchAll:
   729→        await handle.delete(id)
   730→      case .idEquals(let expectedId):
   731→        guard expectedId == id else { continue }
   732→        await handle.delete(id)
   733→      case .unsupported:
   734→        continue
   735→      }
   736→    }
   737→  }
   738→  
   739→  public func subscribe<Value: EntityIdentifiable & Codable & Sendable>(
   740→    appID: String,
   741→    configuration: SharingInstantSync.CollectionConfiguration<Value>
   742→  ) -> AsyncStream<[Value]> {
   743→    AsyncStream { continuation in
   744→      let task = Task {
   745→        // Start subscription immediately so cached results can be delivered
   746→        // even when offline (JS core semantics).
   747→        await self.startSubscription(
   748→          appID: appID,
   749→          namespace: configuration.namespace,
   750→          orderBy: configuration.orderBy,
   751→          limit: nil,
   752→          whereClause: configuration.whereClause,
   753→          linkTree: configuration.linkTree,
   754→          includedLinks: configuration.includedLinks,
   755→          continuation: continuation
   756→        )
   757→      }
   758→
   759→      continuation.onTermination = { _ in
   760→        task.cancel()
   761→      }
   762→    }
   763→  }
   764→
   765→  /// Subscribes to a query and returns a stream of results (Read-only version).
   766→  public func subscribe<Value: EntityIdentifiable & Codable & Sendable>(
   767→    appID: String,
   768→    configuration: SharingInstantQuery.Configuration<Value>
   769→  ) -> AsyncStream<[Value]> {
   770→    AsyncStream { continuation in
   771→      let task = Task {
   772→          await self.startSubscription(
   773→            appID: appID,
   774→            namespace: configuration.namespace,
   775→            orderBy: configuration.orderBy,
   776→            limit: configuration.limit,
   777→            whereClause: configuration.whereClause,
   778→            linkTree: configuration.linkTree,
   779→            includedLinks: configuration.includedLinks,
   780→            continuation: continuation
   781→          )
   782→      }
   783→      
   784→      continuation.onTermination = { _ in
   785→        task.cancel()
   786→      }
   787→    }
   788→  }
   789→
   790→  /// Performs a transaction (write) to InstantDB.
   791→  ///
   792→  /// ## Local-first Semantics
   793→  /// - Applies an optimistic update to the local triple store immediately so subscribers can see
   794→  ///   their own writes without waiting for a server round trip.
   795→  /// - Persists the mutation via the Instant iOS SDK and enqueues it when offline.
   796→  /// - Automatically flushes queued mutations once the WebSocket session reconnects.
   797→  ///
   798→  /// - Parameters:
   799→  ///   - appID: The App ID.
   800→  ///   - chunks: The transaction chunks to execute.
   801→  /// Reads an entity directly from the local TripleStore.
   802→  ///
   803→  /// ## Why This Exists
   804→  /// The `update()` mutation method needs to read the current entity state before
   805→  /// applying modifications. However, `wrappedValue` is updated asynchronously via
   806→  /// AsyncStream, which creates a race condition:
   807→  ///
   808→  /// 1. `create()` applies optimistic update to TripleStore
   809→  /// 2. `create()` yields to AsyncStream
   810→  /// 3. **AsyncStream consumer hasn't run yet**
   811→  /// 4. `update()` reads `wrappedValue[id: id]` → entity not found!
   812→  ///
   813→  /// By reading directly from the TripleStore (which IS updated synchronously in
   814→  /// step 1), we avoid this race condition.
   815→  ///
   816→  /// - Parameters:
   817→  ///   - id: The entity ID to read
   818→  /// - Returns: The entity if found and decodable, nil otherwise
   819→  public func getEntity<T: Decodable>(id: String) -> T? {
   820→    store.get(id: id)
   821→  }
   822→
   823→  public func transact(
   824→    appID: String,
   825→    chunks: [TransactionChunk]
   826→  ) async throws {
   827→    // #region agent log - H10: Trace transact timing
   828→    let transactStart = Date()
   829→    let chunkIds = chunks.map { $0.id }
   830→    reactorDebugLog("transact START", data: ["chunkIds": chunkIds])
   831→    // #endregion
   832→    
   833→    let client = await MainActor.run { InstantClientFactory.makeClient(appID: appID, instanceID: self.clientInstanceID) }
   834→    // #region agent log
   835→    reactorDebugLog("transact: got client", data: ["elapsed_ms": Date().timeIntervalSince(transactStart) * 1000])
   836→    // #endregion
   837→
   838→    // Ensure connected
   839→    let isDisconnected = await MainActor.run { client.connectionState == .disconnected }
   840→    if isDisconnected {
   841→      await MainActor.run { client.connect() }
   842→    }
   843→    // #region agent log
   844→    reactorDebugLog("transact: checked connection", data: ["elapsed_ms": Date().timeIntervalSince(transactStart) * 1000, "wasDisconnected": isDisconnected])
   845→    // #endregion
   846→
   847→    let initialAttrs = await MainActor.run { client.attributes }
   848→    if !initialAttrs.isEmpty {
   849→      store.updateAttributes(initialAttrs)
   850→    }
   851→    // #region agent log
   852→    reactorDebugLog("transact: got attrs", data: ["elapsed_ms": Date().timeIntervalSince(transactStart) * 1000, "attrCount": initialAttrs.count])
   853→    // #endregion
   854→
   855→    // Optimistic Update
   856→    // We apply the changes to the triple store immediately so callers can read their
   857→    // writes locally while the server transaction is in-flight.
   858→    await applyOptimisticUpdate(chunks: chunks)
   859→    // #region agent log
   860→    reactorDebugLog("transact: applied optimistic", data: ["elapsed_ms": Date().timeIntervalSince(transactStart) * 1000])
   861→    // #endregion
   862→
   863→    // Persist + enqueue mutations while offline, and flush automatically on reconnect.
   864→    _ = try await client.transactLocalFirst(chunks)
   865→    // #region agent log
   866→    reactorDebugLog("transact END", data: ["elapsed_ms": Date().timeIntervalSince(transactStart) * 1000, "chunkIds": chunkIds])
   867→    // #endregion
   868→  }
   869→
   870→  /// Explicitly sign in as a guest.
   871→  /// Useful for testing or anonymous usage.
   872→  public func signInAsGuest(appID: String) async throws {
   873→      let client = await MainActor.run { InstantClientFactory.makeClient(appID: appID, instanceID: self.clientInstanceID) }
   874→      
   875→      // Perform sign in on MainActor
   876→      // Perform sign in (AuthManager is @MainActor, so this hops automatically)
   877→      let authManager = await client.authManager
   878→      _ = try await authManager.signInAsGuest()
   879→      
   880→      // Loop until authenticated (or error)
   881→      var authenticated = false
   882→      let deadline = Date().addingTimeInterval(10)
   883→      while !authenticated && Date() < deadline {
   884→          let isAuthenticated = await MainActor.run { client.connectionState == .authenticated }
   885→          if isAuthenticated {
   886→              authenticated = true
   887→          } else {
   888→             let isError = await MainActor.run { 
   889→                 if case .error = client.connectionState { return true }
   890→                 return false
   891→             }
   892→             if isError {
   893→                  throw InstantError.connectionFailed(NSError(domain: "Reactor", code: -1, userInfo: [NSLocalizedDescriptionKey: "Connection failed"]))
   894→             }
   895→          }
   896→          if !authenticated { try? await Task.sleep(nanoseconds: 100_000_000) }
   897→      }
   898→      guard authenticated else { throw InstantError.notAuthenticated }
   899→  }
   900→
   901→  private func applyOptimisticUpdate(chunks: [TransactionChunk]) async {
   902→    let timestamp = ConflictResolution.optimisticTimestamp()
   903→
   904→    // Track affected entities for targeted notifications
   905→    var affectedNamespaces: Set<String> = []
   906→    var upsertedIds: [(namespace: String, id: String)] = []
   907→    var deletedIds: [(namespace: String, id: String)] = []
   908→
   909→    for chunk in chunks {
   910→      for op in chunk.ops {
   911→        guard let action = op.first as? String else { continue }
   912→
   913→        let namespace = (op.count > 1 ? op[1] as? String : nil) ?? chunk.namespace
   914→        let id = (op.count > 2 ? op[2] as? String : nil) ?? chunk.id
   915→        affectedNamespaces.insert(namespace)
   916→
   917→        switch action {
   918→        case "create", "update":
   919→          guard op.count > 3, let payload = op[3] as? [String: Any] else { continue }
   920→          var entity = payload
   921→          entity["id"] = id
   922→
   923→          let triples = Normalization.normalize(
   924→            data: entity,
   925→            namespace: namespace,
   926→            attrsStore: store.attrsStore,
   927→            createdAt: timestamp
   928→          )
   929→          store.addTriples(triples)
   930→          upsertedIds.append((namespace: namespace, id: id))
   931→
   932→        case "link":
   933→          guard op.count > 3, let payload = op[3] as? [String: Any] else { continue }
   934→          var entity: [String: Any] = ["id": id]
   935→          for (key, value) in payload {
   936→            entity[key] = value
   937→          }
   938→
   939→          let triples = Normalization.normalize(
   940→            data: entity,
   941→            namespace: namespace,
   942→            attrsStore: store.attrsStore,
   943→            createdAt: timestamp
   944→          )
   945→          store.addTriples(triples)
   946→          upsertedIds.append((namespace: namespace, id: id))
   947→
   948→        case "unlink":
   949→          guard op.count > 3, let payload = op[3] as? [String: Any] else { continue }
   950→          applyOptimisticUnlink(
   951→            namespace: namespace,
   952→            entityId: id,
   953→            payload: payload,
   954→            timestamp: timestamp
   955→          )
   956→          upsertedIds.append((namespace: namespace, id: id))
   957→
   958→        case "delete":
   959→          store.deleteEntity(id: id)
   960→          deletedIds.append((namespace: namespace, id: id))
   961→
   962→        default:
   963→          continue
   964→        }
   965→      }
   966→    }
   967→
   968→    // Increment store version after all modifications
   969→    // This invalidates any cached query results
   970→    incrementStoreVersion()
   971→
   972→    // Also increment pending mutations version since we're applying optimistic updates
   973→    // (the mutation was just added to the pending queue)
   974→    incrementPendingMutationsVersion()
   975→
   976→    // Notify subscriptions of the specific changes
   977→    // This ensures currentIDs gets updated with the new entity IDs
   978→    for (namespace, id) in upsertedIds {
   979→      await notifyOptimisticUpsert(namespace: namespace, id: id)
   980→    }
   981→    for (namespace, id) in deletedIds {
   982→      await notifyOptimisticDelete(namespace: namespace, id: id)
   983→    }
   984→
   985→    // Also notify all subscriptions to ensure cross-namespace consistency
   986→    // (e.g., a link mutation affects both sides of the relationship)
   987→    // See Reactor.js pushOps() line 1367: this.notifyAll()
   988→    await notifyAll()
   989→  }
   990→
   991→  private func applyOptimisticUnlink(
   992→    namespace: String,
   993→    entityId: String,
   994→    payload: [String: Any],
   995→    timestamp: Int64
   996→  ) {
   997→    for (label, rawValue) in payload {
   998→      if let attr = store.attrsStore.getAttrByForwardIdent(entityType: namespace, label: label) {
   999→        guard attr.valueType == .ref else { continue }
  1000→
  1001→        for targetId in referencedEntityIDs(from: rawValue) {
  1002→          let triple = Triple(entityId: entityId, attributeId: attr.id, value: .ref(targetId), createdAt: timestamp)
  1003→          store.retractTriple(triple, isRef: true)
  1004→        }
  1005→        continue
  1006→      }
  1007→
  1008→      if let attr = store.attrsStore.getAttrByReverseIdent(entityType: namespace, label: label) {
  1009→        guard attr.valueType == .ref else { continue }
  1010→
  1011→        for sourceId in referencedEntityIDs(from: rawValue) {
  1012→          let triple = Triple(entityId: sourceId, attributeId: attr.id, value: .ref(entityId), createdAt: timestamp)
  1013→          store.retractTriple(triple, isRef: true)
  1014→        }
  1015→      }
  1016→    }
  1017→  }
  1018→
  1019→  private func referencedEntityIDs(from rawValue: Any) -> [String] {
  1020→    if let id = rawValue as? String {
  1021→      return [id]
  1022→    }
  1023→
  1024→    if let dict = rawValue as? [String: Any], let id = dict["id"] as? String {
  1025→      return [id]
  1026→    }
  1027→
  1028→    if let array = rawValue as? [Any] {
  1029→      return array.flatMap { referencedEntityIDs(from: $0) }
  1030→    }
  1031→
  1032→    return []
  1033→  }
  1034→  
  1035→  // Helper to pass non-Sendable data to MainActor
  1036→  private struct QueryOptions: @unchecked Sendable {
  1037→      let orderBy: OrderBy?
  1038→      let limit: Int?
  1039→      let whereClause: [String: Any]?
  1040→      let linkTree: [EntityQueryNode]
  1041→      let includedLinks: Set<String>
  1042→  }
  1043→  
  1044→  private func startSubscription<Value: EntityIdentifiable & Codable & Sendable>(
  1045→    appID: String,
  1046→    namespace: String,
  1047→    orderBy: OrderBy?,
  1048→    limit: Int?,
  1049→    whereClause: [String: Any]?,
  1050→    linkTree: [EntityQueryNode],
  1051→    includedLinks: Set<String>,
  1052→    continuation: AsyncStream<[Value]>.Continuation
  1053→  ) async {
  1054→    let client = await MainActor.run { InstantClientFactory.makeClient(appID: appID, instanceID: self.clientInstanceID) }
  1055→
  1056→    // Connect if needed
  1057→    let isDisconnected = await MainActor.run { client.connectionState == .disconnected }
  1058→    if isDisconnected {
  1059→      await MainActor.run { client.connect() }
  1060→    }
  1061→
  1062→    // NOTE: Pending mutation restoration is done AFTER subscription registration
  1063→    // so that the subscription can be notified of restored entities.
  1064→    // See the call to restorePendingMutationsIfNeeded below.
  1065→
  1066→    let attrs = await waitForAttributes(
  1067→      client: client,
  1068→      timeoutSeconds: 5,
  1069→      logContext: [
  1070→        "appID": appID,
  1071→        "namespace": namespace,
  1072→        "orderBy": orderBy?.field as Any,
  1073→        "limit": limit as Any,
  1074→        "whereClause": whereClause as Any,
  1075→        "includedLinks": includedLinks.sorted(),
  1076→        "linkTreeCount": linkTree.count,
  1077→      ]
  1078→    )
  1079→    if !attrs.isEmpty {
  1080→      store.updateAttributes(attrs)
  1081→    }
  1082→    
  1083→    // Manage state with a dedicated actor to handle concurrency between DB callbacks and Store callbacks
  1084→    // TypeScript SDK Pattern: Pass appID/clientInstanceID so handleStoreUpdate() can fetch
  1085→    // pending mutations at query time (see Reactor.js dataForQuery -> _applyOptimisticUpdates)
  1086→    let subscriptionState = SubscriptionState<Value>(
  1087→      continuation: continuation,
  1088→      store: store,
  1089→      namespace: namespace,
  1090→      orderByIsDescending: orderBy?.isDescending ?? false,
  1091→      includedLinks: includedLinks,
  1092→      appID: appID,
  1093→      clientInstanceID: self.clientInstanceID
  1094→    )
  1095→
  1096→    let handleId = UUID()
  1097→    activeSubscriptions[handleId] = SubscriptionHandle(
  1098→      namespace: namespace,
  1099→      filter: subscriptionFilter(whereClause: whereClause),
  1100→      upsert: { id in
  1101→        await subscriptionState.handleOptimisticUpsert(id: id)
  1102→      },
  1103→      delete: { id in
  1104→        await subscriptionState.handleOptimisticDelete(id: id)
  1105→      },
  1106→      getCurrentEntityIds: {
  1107→        await subscriptionState.getCurrentEntityIds()
  1108→      }
  1109→    )
  1110→
  1111→    // TypeScript SDK Pattern: Pending mutations are now applied at query time in handleStoreUpdate().
  1112→    // We still call restorePendingMutationsIfNeeded to populate the TripleStore for linked entity
  1113→    // resolution and ensure data is available for store.get() calls.
  1114→    await restorePendingMutationsIfNeeded(client: client, appID: appID)
  1115→
  1116→    // Trigger initial yield to show any pending mutation data immediately
  1117→    // (TypeScript SDK does this via initial dataForQuery call)
  1118→    await subscriptionState.handleStoreUpdate()
  1119→
  1120→    // Subscribe to InstantDB
  1121→    // Use QueryOptions to pass non-Sendable data to MainActor
  1122→
  1123→    
  1124→    let options = QueryOptions(
  1125→        orderBy: orderBy,
  1126→        limit: limit,
  1127→        whereClause: whereClause,
  1128→        linkTree: linkTree,
  1129→        includedLinks: includedLinks
  1130→    )
  1131→    
  1132→    let sharedStore = store
  1133→
  1134→
  1135→    let token = await MainActor.run {
  1136→        // Build Query
  1137→        var q = client.query(Value.self)
  1138→        
  1139→        if let orderBy = options.orderBy {
  1140→          q = q.order(by: orderBy.field, orderBy.isDescending ? .desc : .asc)
  1141→        }
  1142→        if let whereClause = options.whereClause {
  1143→            q = q.where(whereClause)
  1144→        }
  1145→        if let limit = options.limit {
  1146→            q = q.limit(limit)
  1147→        }
  1148→        
  1149→        // Include links
  1150→        if !options.linkTree.isEmpty {
  1151→           let includeDict = convertLinkTreeToInstaQL(options.linkTree)
  1152→           q = q.including(includeDict)
  1153→        } else if !options.includedLinks.isEmpty {
  1154→           q = q.including(options.includedLinks)
  1155→        }
  1156→        
  1157→        // #region agent log
  1158→        // HYPOTHESIS C: Log the query being sent to InstantDB
  1159→        // NOTE: Disabled by default - enable with INSTANT_DEBUG_LOG=1
  1160→        #if DEBUG
  1161→        if ProcessInfo.processInfo.environment["INSTANT_DEBUG_LOG"] == "1" {
  1162→          let whereClauseStr = options.whereClause.map { dict -> String in
  1163→            let pairs = dict.map { "\($0.key): \(String(describing: $0.value))" }
  1164→            return "[\(pairs.joined(separator: ", "))]"
  1165→          } ?? "nil"
  1166→
  1167→          let whereClauseJson: String
  1168→          if let wc = options.whereClause,
  1169→             let jsonData = try? JSONSerialization.data(withJSONObject: wc, options: [.sortedKeys]),
  1170→             let str = String(data: jsonData, encoding: .utf8) {
  1171→            whereClauseJson = str
  1172→          } else {
  1173→            whereClauseJson = "nil or failed to serialize"
  1174→          }
  1175→
  1176→          let payload: [String: Any] = [
  1177→            "location": "Reactor.swift:startSubscription",
  1178→            "message": "HYPOTHESIS_C: Query being sent to InstantDB",
  1179→            "data": [
  1180→              "namespace": namespace,
  1181→              "whereClause": whereClauseStr,
  1182→              "whereClauseJson": whereClauseJson,
  1183→              "hasDotNotation": (options.whereClause?.keys.contains(where: { $0.contains(".") }) ?? false),
  1184→              "includedLinks": Array(options.includedLinks),
  1185→              "linkTreeCount": options.linkTree.count
  1186→            ],
  1187→            "timestamp": Date().timeIntervalSince1970 * 1000,
  1188→            "sessionId": "debug-session",
  1189→            "hypothesisId": "C"
  1190→          ]
  1191→          if let jsonData = try? JSONSerialization.data(withJSONObject: payload) {
  1192→            var request = URLRequest(url: URL(string: "http://127.0.0.1:7243/ingest/b61a72ba-9985-415b-9c60-d4184ed05385")!)
  1193→            request.httpMethod = "POST"
  1194→            request.setValue("application/json", forHTTPHeaderField: "Content-Type")
  1195→            request.httpBody = jsonData
  1196→            let task = URLSession.shared.dataTask(with: request) { _, _, _ in }
  1197→            task.resume()
  1198→          }
  1199→        }
  1200→        #endif
  1201→        // #endregion
  1202→        
  1203→	        return try? client.subscribe(q) { [weak subscriptionState] result in
  1204→              if result.isLoading {
  1205→                return
  1206→              }
  1207→
  1208→	            if let error = result.error {
  1209→                  // #region agent log
  1210→                  // HYPOTHESIS C: Log subscription errors
  1211→                  // NOTE: Disabled by default - enable with INSTANT_DEBUG_LOG=1
  1212→                  #if DEBUG
  1213→                  if ProcessInfo.processInfo.environment["INSTANT_DEBUG_LOG"] == "1" {
  1214→                    let payload: [String: Any] = [
  1215→                      "location": "Reactor.swift:subscribe",
  1216→                      "message": "HYPOTHESIS_C: Subscription error",
  1217→                      "data": [
  1218→                        "namespace": namespace,
  1219→                        "error": "\(error)",
  1220→                        "whereClause": String(describing: options.whereClause)
  1221→                      ],
  1222→                      "timestamp": Date().timeIntervalSince1970 * 1000,
  1223→                      "sessionId": "debug-session",
  1224→                      "hypothesisId": "C"
  1225→                    ]
  1226→                    if let jsonData = try? JSONSerialization.data(withJSONObject: payload) {
  1227→                      var request = URLRequest(url: URL(string: "http://127.0.0.1:7243/ingest/b61a72ba-9985-415b-9c60-d4184ed05385")!)
  1228→                      request.httpMethod = "POST"
  1229→                      request.setValue("application/json", forHTTPHeaderField: "Content-Type")
  1230→                      request.httpBody = jsonData
  1231→                      let task = URLSession.shared.dataTask(with: request) { _, _, _ in }
  1232→                      task.resume()
  1233→                    }
  1234→                  }
  1235→                  #endif
  1236→                  // #endregion
  1237→	                Task { @MainActor in
  1238→	                  InstantLogger.error("Reactor subscription callback error.", error: error)
  1239→	                }
  1240→	                return
  1241→	            }
  1242→            
  1243→            sharedStore.updateAttributes(client.attributes)
  1244→
  1245→            let data = result.data
  1246→            
  1247→            // #region agent log
  1248→            // HYPOTHESIS C: Log subscription results
  1249→            // NOTE: Disabled by default - enable with INSTANT_DEBUG_LOG=1
  1250→            #if DEBUG
  1251→            if ProcessInfo.processInfo.environment["INSTANT_DEBUG_LOG"] == "1" {
  1252→              let dataPayload: [String: Any] = [
  1253→                "location": "Reactor.swift:subscribe",
  1254→                "message": "HYPOTHESIS_C: Subscription result received",
  1255→                "data": [
  1256→                  "namespace": namespace,
  1257→                  "resultCount": data.count,
  1258→                  "resultIds": data.map { $0.id },
  1259→                  "whereClause": String(describing: options.whereClause),
  1260→                  "hasDotNotation": (options.whereClause?.keys.contains(where: { $0.contains(".") }) ?? false)
  1261→                ],
  1262→                "timestamp": Date().timeIntervalSince1970 * 1000,
  1263→                "sessionId": "debug-session",
  1264→                "hypothesisId": "C"
  1265→              ]
  1266→              if let jsonData = try? JSONSerialization.data(withJSONObject: dataPayload) {
  1267→                var request = URLRequest(url: URL(string: "http://127.0.0.1:7243/ingest/b61a72ba-9985-415b-9c60-d4184ed05385")!)
  1268→                request.httpMethod = "POST"
  1269→                request.setValue("application/json", forHTTPHeaderField: "Content-Type")
  1270→                request.httpBody = jsonData
  1271→                let task = URLSession.shared.dataTask(with: request) { _, _, _ in }
  1272→                task.resume()
  1273→              }
  1274→            }
  1275→            #endif
  1276→            // #endregion
  1277→            
  1278→            Task {
  1279→                // 1. Merge to Store and Update Subscription State
  1280→                // `subscriptionState` is an actor, so we can call its methods.
  1281→                await subscriptionState?.handleDBUpdate(data: data)
  1282→            }
  1283→        }
  1284→    }
  1285→    
  1286→    // Keep alive until cancelled
  1287→    // Note: When the subscription is cancelled, we need to exit cleanly without
  1288→    // throwing CancellationError because XCTest/Swift Testing intercepts thrown errors

/// Actor to manage the state of a single subscription.
///
/// ## Query-Level Reactivity (TypeScript SDK Pattern)
/// This actor applies pending mutations at query evaluation time, matching the TypeScript
/// SDK's `dataForQuery()` -> `_applyOptimisticUpdates()` pattern.
///
/// Instead of persisting pending mutations to the store once, we merge them on-the-fly
/// every time `handleStoreUpdate()` is called. This ensures pending mutations are ALWAYS
/// visible, regardless of subscription lifecycle or store state.
///
/// See: instant-client/src/Reactor.js - dataForQuery(), _applyOptimisticUpdates()
private actor SubscriptionState<Value: EntityIdentifiable & Codable & Sendable> {
    private var currentIDs: [String] = [] // Keep order for consistent results
    private let continuation: AsyncStream<[Value]>.Continuation
    private let store: SharedTripleStore
    private let namespace: String
    private let orderByIsDescending: Bool

    /// Links to include when resolving entities from the store.
    /// This controls which linked entities are fetched during entity resolution.
    /// Without this, bidirectional links cause exponential memory growth.
    private let includedLinks: Set<String>

    /// For fetching pending mutations at query time (TypeScript SDK pattern).
    private let appID: String
    private let clientInstanceID: String

    /// IDs that have been introduced by local optimistic writes, but have not yet been
    /// observed in a server query result.
    ///
    /// ## Why This Exists
    /// SharingInstant applies optimistic writes to the local `TripleStore` immediately.
    /// However, InstantDB subscriptions can emit a server refresh *before* the mutation
    /// has round-tripped and appears in the query result. If we overwrite our `currentIDs`
    /// with the server-provided IDs in that window, the UI appears to "revert" or drop
    /// newly created entities, which is the exact "it gets overridden" symptom.
    ///
    /// By tracking optimistic IDs separately, we can keep them in `currentIDs` until the
    /// server eventually includes them (at which point they become confirmed and we can
    /// stop treating them as optimistic).
    private var optimisticIDs: [String] = []

    init(
      continuation: AsyncStream<[Value]>.Continuation,
      store: SharedTripleStore,
      namespace: String,
      orderByIsDescending: Bool,
      includedLinks: Set<String>,
      appID: String,
      clientInstanceID: String
    ) {
        self.continuation = continuation
        self.store = store
        self.namespace = namespace
        self.orderByIsDescending = orderByIsDescending
        self.includedLinks = includedLinks
        self.appID = appID
        self.clientInstanceID = clientInstanceID
    }
    
    func handleDBUpdate(data: [Value]) async {
        // 1. Merge data into store (Normalize Tree -> Triples)
        // Use manual dictionary merge to convert to Dict
        let dicts = data.compactMap { try? $0.asDictionary() }

        var allTriples: [Triple] = []
        for dict in dicts {
            // Normalize: dict -> triples
            let triples = Normalization.normalize(data: dict, namespace: namespace, attrsStore: store.attrsStore)
            allTriples.append(contentsOf: triples)
        }
        store.addTriples(allTriples)

        let serverIDs = data.map(\.id)
        let serverIDLowercasedSet = Set(serverIDs.map { $0.lowercased() })

        // Once the server has included an ID, it is no longer "optimistic".
        optimisticIDs.removeAll { serverIDLowercasedSet.contains($0.lowercased()) }

        let pendingOptimisticIDs = optimisticIDs.filter {
          !serverIDLowercasedSet.contains($0.lowercased())
        }
        let mergedIDs: [String]
        if orderByIsDescending {
          mergedIDs = pendingOptimisticIDs + serverIDs
        } else {
          mergedIDs = serverIDs + pendingOptimisticIDs
        }

        currentIDs = mergedIDs

        // Yield from the normalized store rather than the raw DB response.
        //
        // ## Why This Exists
        // - Ensures linked entities hydrate consistently from the same source of truth.
        // - Prevents server refreshes from temporarily "overriding" optimistic additions
        //   that have not yet round-tripped into the server query result.
        await handleStoreUpdate()
    }
    
    func handleStoreUpdate() async {
        reactorDebugLog("SubscriptionState.handleStoreUpdate", data: [
          "namespace": namespace,
          "currentIDsCount": currentIDs.count,
          "currentIDs": currentIDs,
          "optimisticIDsCount": optimisticIDs.count,
          "optimisticIDs": optimisticIDs
        ])

        // TypeScript SDK Pattern: Apply pending mutations at query time
        // See Reactor.js dataForQuery() -> _applyOptimisticUpdates()
        //
        // 1. Get pending mutations from SQLite
        let client = await MainActor.run {
            InstantClientFactory.makeClient(appID: appID, instanceID: clientInstanceID)
        }
        let pendingMutations = await client.getUnconfirmedPendingMutations()

        // 2. Extract entity data from pending mutations for our namespace
        var pendingEntityData: [String: [String: Any]] = [:]
        var pendingEntityOrder: [String] = [] // Maintain insertion order

        for mutation in pendingMutations {
            for step in mutation.txSteps {
                guard step.count >= 4,
                      let action = step[0].value as? String,
                      action == "add-triple",
                      let entityId = step[1].value as? String,
                      let attrId = step[2].value as? String else {
                    continue
                }

                // Resolve attribute ID to namespace and field name
                // attrId can be either:
                // 1. A UUID that needs lookup in attrsStore
                // 2. A "namespace/field" format string (legacy/fallback)
                let attrNamespace: String
                let fieldName: String

                if let attr = store.attrsStore.getAttr(attrId),
                   attr.forwardIdentity.count >= 3 {
                    // forwardIdentity = [attrId, namespace, label]
                    attrNamespace = attr.forwardIdentity[1]
                    fieldName = attr.forwardIdentity[2]
                } else {
                    // Fallback: try parsing as "namespace/field"
                    let parts = attrId.components(separatedBy: "/")
                    guard parts.count >= 2 else { continue }
                    attrNamespace = parts[0]
                    fieldName = parts[1]
                }

                // Check if this triple belongs to our namespace
                guard attrNamespace == namespace else { continue }

                let rawValue = step[3].value

                // Initialize entity data if needed
                if pendingEntityData[entityId] == nil {
                    pendingEntityData[entityId] = ["id": entityId]
                    pendingEntityOrder.append(entityId)
                }

                // Store the field value
                pendingEntityData[entityId]?[fieldName] = rawValue
            }
        }

        reactorDebugLog("SubscriptionState.handleStoreUpdate: pending mutations extracted", data: [
          "namespace": namespace,
          "pendingEntityCount": pendingEntityData.count,
          "pendingEntityIds": pendingEntityOrder
        ])

        // 3. Merge currentIDs with pending entity IDs (maintaining order)
        // Pending entities that aren't in currentIDs are new optimistic creates
        var allIDs = currentIDs
        for entityId in pendingEntityOrder {
            if !allIDs.contains(entityId) {
                if orderByIsDescending {
                    allIDs.insert(entityId, at: 0)
                } else {
                    allIDs.append(entityId)
                }
            }
        }

        // 4. Build result by merging store data with pending mutations
        var values: [Value] = []

        for id in allIDs {
            var entityDict: [String: Any]

            // Get base data from store (if exists)
            // CRITICAL: Pass includedLinks to only resolve explicitly requested links.
            if let val: Value = store.get(id: id, includedLinks: includedLinks) {
                entityDict = (try? val.asDictionary()) ?? ["id": id]
            } else {
                entityDict = ["id": id]
            }

            // Merge pending mutation data (overwrites store data for same fields)
            // This is the key TypeScript SDK pattern - pending mutations take precedence
            if let pendingData = pendingEntityData[id] {
                for (key, value) in pendingData {
                    entityDict[key] = value
                }
            }

            // Decode back to Value type
            if let data = try? JSONSerialization.data(withJSONObject: entityDict),
               let val = try? JSONDecoder().decode(Value.self, from: data) {
                values.append(val)
            }
        }

        reactorDebugLog("SubscriptionState.handleStoreUpdate: yielding", data: [
          "namespace": namespace,
          "valueCount": values.count,
          "valueIds": values.map { $0.id },
          "pendingMutationCount": pendingMutations.count
        ])

        continuation.yield(values)
    }

    func handleOptimisticUpsert(id: String) async {
        reactorDebugLog("SubscriptionState.handleOptimisticUpsert", data: [
          "namespace": namespace,
          "id": id,
          "currentIDsCount": currentIDs.count,
          "optimisticIDsCount": optimisticIDs.count
        ])

        // Handle notifyAll() sentinel - just trigger a store update without modifying tracking
        if id == "__notifyAll__" {
          await handleStoreUpdate()
          return
        }

        if !optimisticIDs.contains(id) {
          if orderByIsDescending {
            optimisticIDs.insert(id, at: 0)
          } else {
            optimisticIDs.append(id)
          }
        }

        if !currentIDs.contains(id) {
          if orderByIsDescending {
            currentIDs.insert(id, at: 0)
          } else {
            currentIDs.append(id)
          }
        }

        reactorDebugLog("SubscriptionState.handleOptimisticUpsert: after update", data: [
          "namespace": namespace,
          "id": id,
          "currentIDs": currentIDs,
          "optimisticIDs": optimisticIDs
        ])

        await handleStoreUpdate()
    }
    
    func handleOptimisticDelete(id: String) async {
        currentIDs.removeAll { $0 == id }
        optimisticIDs.removeAll { $0 == id }
        await handleStoreUpdate()
    }

    /// Returns the current set of entity IDs in this subscription.
    ///
    /// Used by GC to determine which entities are "sacred" (in active subscriptions).
    func getCurrentEntityIds() -> Set<String> {
        Set(currentIDs)
    }

    func cleanup() async {
        // No observers to clean up - query-level reactivity doesn't use per-entity observers
    }
}

extension Encodable {
    func asDictionary() throws -> [String: Any] {
        let data = try JSONEncoder().encode(self)
        guard let dictionary = try JSONSerialization.jsonObject(with: data, options: .allowFragments) as? [String: Any] else {
            throw NSError()
        }
        return dictionary
    }
}

import Foundation
@preconcurrency import InstantDB
import Dependencies
import Sharing
@preconcurrency import Combine

/// Adapted from: instant-client/src/client_db.ts (Reactor logic)
///
/// The central coordinator for InstantDB data.
///
/// The Reactor manages:
/// 1. Connections to InstantDB (via InstantClient).
/// 2. Subscriptions to queries.
/// 3. The Shared TripleStore.

// #region agent log
/// Debug logging helper for Cursor debug mode - sends via HTTP to Mac
/// Logs are queued and persisted to disk, then sent when network is available.
///
/// To use:
/// 1. Run: python3 Scripts/debug-log-server.py 7248
/// 2. Update the IP below to your Mac's local IP
private let debugLogServerURL = "http://192.168.68.111:7248/ingest/debug"

/// Actor to manage thread-safe debug log queue with persistence
private actor DebugLogQueue {
    static let shared = DebugLogQueue()

    private let fileURL: URL
    private var isFlushing = false

    init() {
        let docs = FileManager.default.urls(for: .documentDirectory, in: .userDomainMask).first!
        self.fileURL = docs.appendingPathComponent("debug-logs-queue.jsonl")
    }

    func enqueue(_ jsonData: Data) {
        // Append to file (JSONL format - one JSON object per line)
        if let line = String(data: jsonData, encoding: .utf8) {
            let lineWithNewline = line + "\n"
            if let lineData = lineWithNewline.data(using: .utf8) {
                if FileManager.default.fileExists(atPath: fileURL.path) {
                    if let handle = try? FileHandle(forWritingTo: fileURL) {
                        handle.seekToEndOfFile()
                        handle.write(lineData)
                        try? handle.close()
                    }
                } else {
                    try? lineData.write(to: fileURL)
                }
            }
        }

        // Try to flush immediately
        Task {
            await flush()
        }
    }

    func flush() async {
        guard !isFlushing else { return }
        isFlushing = true
        defer { isFlushing = false }

        guard FileManager.default.fileExists(atPath: fileURL.path),
              let content = try? String(contentsOf: fileURL, encoding: .utf8) else {
            return
        }

        let lines = content.components(separatedBy: "\n").filter { !$0.isEmpty }
        guard !lines.isEmpty else { return }

        guard let ingestURL = URL(string: debugLogServerURL) else { return }

        var successCount = 0

        for line in lines {
            guard let jsonData = line.data(using: .utf8) else {
                successCount += 1 // Skip malformed
                continue
            }

            var request = URLRequest(url: ingestURL)
            request.httpMethod = "POST"
            request.setValue("application/json", forHTTPHeaderField: "Content-Type")
            request.httpBody = jsonData
            request.timeoutInterval = 5

            do {
                let (_, response) = try await URLSession.shared.data(for: request)
                if let httpResponse = response as? HTTPURLResponse, httpResponse.statusCode == 200 {
                    successCount += 1
                } else {
                    break // Server error, stop
                }
            } catch {
                // Network error - stop trying, will retry later
                break
            }
        }

        // Remove successfully sent logs by rewriting file with remaining lines
        if successCount > 0 {
            let remainingLines = Array(lines.dropFirst(successCount))
            if remainingLines.isEmpty {
                try? FileManager.default.removeItem(at: fileURL)
            } else {
                let remainingContent = remainingLines.joined(separator: "\n") + "\n"
                try? remainingContent.write(to: fileURL, atomically: true, encoding: .utf8)
            }
        }
    }
}

private func reactorDebugLog(_ message: String, data: [String: Any] = [:], hypothesisId: String = "RESTORE", file: String = #file, line: Int = #line) {
    #if DEBUG
    let fileName = (file as NSString).lastPathComponent.replacingOccurrences(of: ".swift", with: "")
    let location = "\(fileName):\(line)"

    // Print to Xcode console for local debugging
    let dataStr = data.isEmpty ? "" : " | \(data.map { "\($0.key): \($0.value)" }.joined(separator: ", "))"
    print("[RESTORE] [\(location)] \(message)\(dataStr)")

    // Queue for HTTP delivery (persisted to disk, sent when online)
    // Convert to JSON Data immediately to make it Sendable
    let payload: [String: Any] = [
        "location": location,
        "message": message,
        "data": data,
        "timestamp": Date().timeIntervalSince1970 * 1000,
        "sessionId": "debug-session",
        "hypothesisId": hypothesisId
    ]

    if let jsonData = try? JSONSerialization.data(withJSONObject: payload) {
        Task {
            await DebugLogQueue.shared.enqueue(jsonData)
        }
    }
    #endif
}

/// Call this when the app comes back online to flush queued logs
public func flushDebugLogs() {
    #if DEBUG
    Task {
        await DebugLogQueue.shared.flush()
    }
    #endif
}
// #endregion

/// Cached query result with version tracking for invalidation.
///
/// ## TypeScript SDK Parity
/// Matches the caching pattern from Reactor.js `dataForQuery()` (lines 1224-1261).
/// The cache key is a hash of the query parameters (namespace, orderBy, includedLinks).
/// The cache is valid only when both storeVersion and pendingMutationsVersion match.
public struct CachedQueryResult: Sendable {
    /// The cached entity data as dictionaries (serialized form)
    public let data: [[String: AnySendable]]

    /// Store version when this cache was created
    public let storeVersion: Int

    /// Pending mutations version when this cache was created
    public let pendingMutationsVersion: Int

    /// The processedTxId from the server (for pending mutation cleanup)
    public let processedTxId: Int?
}

public actor Reactor {

///
/// These tests exercise the `@Shared` property wrapper API to verify that
/// memory and performance fixes work end-to-end. They specifically test:
///
/// 1. **Cycle Detection**: Circular entity references (A -> B -> A) don't cause
///    infinite loops or exponential memory growth during resolution.
///
/// 2. **Memory Stability**: Rapid updates (similar to real-time transcription)
///    don't cause unbounded memory growth.

final class CycleDetectionSharedTests: XCTestCase {

  ///
  /// The cycle detection should break this loop and return without hanging.

    let profileId = UUID().uuidString.lowercased()
    let postId = UUID().uuidString.lowercased()

      createdAt: Date().timeIntervalSince1970 * 1000,
      displayName: "CycleTest",
      handle: "cycletest"
    )
    try await $profiles.create(profile)

    try await Task.sleep(nanoseconds: 2_000_000_000)

    // Step 2: Create a post with author link (creates bidirectional link)

    var posts: IdentifiedArrayOf<Post> = []

    try await Task.sleep(nanoseconds: 2_000_000_000)

  @MainActor

    @Shared(.instantSync(Schema.transcriptionSegments))

    let startMemory = getMemoryUsage()
    TestLog.log("[MemoryTest] Starting memory: \(formatMemory(startMemory))")

    // Create segments with rapid updates (similar to RapidTranscriptionDemo)
    var segmentIds: [String] = []

    for i in 0..<segmentCount {
      let segmentId = UUID().uuidString.lowercased()
      segmentIds.append(segmentId)

      let segment = TranscriptionSegment(
        id: segmentId,
        startTime: Double(i) * 0.1,

      }
    }

    // Wait for all updates to settle
    try await Task.sleep(nanoseconds: 2_000_000_000)

    // Measure ending memory
    let endMemory = getMemoryUsage()
    let memoryGrowth = endMemory - startMemory

    TestLog.log("[MemoryTest] Final memory: \(formatMemory(endMemory))")
    TestLog.log("[MemoryTest] Memory growth: \(formatMemory(memoryGrowth))")

    // Assert memory growth is reasonable (<50MB for 100 segments)
    // This is a generous limit - the actual growth should be much smaller
    // if GC and caching are working correctly
    let fiftyMB = 50_000_000
    XCTAssertLessThan(
      memoryGrowth,
      fiftyMB,
      "Memory grew excessively: \(formatMemory(memoryGrowth)). Expected < 50MB"
    )

    for segmentId in segmentIds {

    try await $runs.delete(id: runId)

    var foundUser = false
    let collectTask = Task {
      for await users in stream {
        if users.contains(where: { $0.id.lowercased() == userId1.lowercased() }) {
          foundUser = true
          break
        }
      }
    }

    // Wait for result or timeout
    try await Task.sleep(nanoseconds: 10_000_000_000) // 10 seconds
    collectTask.cancel()

    // If we got here without hanging, the test passed
    TestLog.log("[SelfRefTest] Query completed - cycle detection working")

    // Cleanup
    let delete1 = TransactionChunk(namespace: "$users", id: userId1, ops: [["delete", "$users", userId1]])
    let delete2 = TransactionChunk(namespace: "$users", id: userId2, ops: [["delete", "$users", userId2]])
    try await reactor.transact(appID: Self.testAppID, chunks: [delete1, delete2])
  }

  // MARK: - Memory Measurement Helper

  /// Get current memory usage in bytes.
  ///
  /// Uses Mach task_info to get resident memory size.
  private func getMemoryUsage() -> Int {
    var info = mach_task_basic_info()
    var count = mach_msg_type_number_t(MemoryLayout<mach_task_basic_info>.size) / 4
    let result = withUnsafeMutablePointer(to: &info) {
      $0.withMemoryRebound(to: integer_t.self, capacity: Int(count)) {
        task_info(mach_task_self_, task_flavor_t(MACH_TASK_BASIC_INFO), $0, &count)
      }
    }
    return result == KERN_SUCCESS ? Int(info.resident_size) : 0
  }

  /// Format memory size for display.
  private func formatMemory(_ bytes: Int) -> String {
    let mb = Double(bytes) / 1_000_000.0
    return String(format: "%.2f MB", mb)
  }
}

Now I need to modify the `TripleStoreGC` to call `updateSacredEntities` periodically. The cleanest approach is to have GC update sacred entities automatically before each GC run. Let me update the `TripleStoreGC` to accept a callback for updating sacred entities:

Actually, looking at the code more carefully, I realize that since `runGC()` in the Reactor already calls `updateSacredEntities()` before running GC, and periodic GC happens inside the `TripleStoreGC` actor, we need a way for the GC to notify the Reactor to update sacred entities.

A cleaner approach is to have the GC periodically call a delegate/callback that the Reactor provides. Let me update the `TripleStoreGC`:

    37→    func enqueue(_ jsonData: Data) {
    38→        // Append to file (JSONL format - one JSON object per line)
    39→        if let line = String(data: jsonData, encoding: .utf8) {
    40→            let lineWithNewline = line + "\n"
    41→            if let lineData = lineWithNewline.data(using: .utf8) {
    42→                if FileManager.default.fileExists(atPath: fileURL.path) {
    43→                    if let handle = try? FileHandle(forWritingTo: fileURL) {
    44→                        handle.seekToEndOfFile()
    45→                        handle.write(lineData)
    46→                        try? handle.close()
    47→                    }
    48→                } else {
    49→                    try? lineData.write(to: fileURL)
    50→                }
    51→            }
    52→        }
    53→
    54→        // Try to flush immediately
    55→        Task {
    56→            await flush()
    57→        }
    58→    }
    59→
    60→    func flush() async {
    61→        guard !isFlushing else { return }
    62→        isFlushing = true
    63→        defer { isFlushing = false }
    64→
    65→        guard FileManager.default.fileExists(atPath: fileURL.path),
    66→              let content = try? String(contentsOf: fileURL, encoding: .utf8) else {
    67→            return
    68→        }
    69→
    70→        let lines = content.components(separatedBy: "\n").filter { !$0.isEmpty }
    71→        guard !lines.isEmpty else { return }
    72→
    73→        guard let ingestURL = URL(string: debugLogServerURL) else { return }
    74→
    75→        var successCount = 0
    76→
    77→        for line in lines {

    79→                successCount += 1 // Skip malformed
    80→                continue
    81→            }
    82→
    83→            var request = URLRequest(url: ingestURL)
    84→            request.httpMethod = "POST"
    85→            request.setValue("application/json", forHTTPHeaderField: "Content-Type")
    86→            request.httpBody = jsonData
    87→            request.timeoutInterval = 5

    89→            do {
    90→                let (_, response) = try await URLSession.shared.data(for: request)
    91→                if let httpResponse = response as? HTTPURLResponse, httpResponse.statusCode == 200 {
    92→                    successCount += 1
    93→                } else {
    94→                    break // Server error, stop
    95→                }
    96→            } catch {
    97→                // Network error - stop trying, will retry later
    98→                break
    99→            }
   100→        }

   107→            } else {

   110→            }
   111→        }
   112→    }

   299→    // Update sacred entities before running GC
   300→    await updateSacredEntities()
   301→    return await gc.runGC()
   302→  }
   303→
   304→  /// Updates the GC's sacred entities based on current active subscriptions.
   305→  ///
   306→  /// Sacred entities are those currently being viewed in active subscriptions.
   307→  /// These entities will not be evicted by GC.
   308→  ///
   309→  /// This is called automatically before GC runs, but can be called manually
   310→  /// to ensure the sacred set is up to date.
   311→  public func updateSacredEntities() async {
   312→    var allSacredIds = Set<String>()
   313→
   314→    // Collect entity IDs from all active subscriptions
   315→    for (_, handle) in activeSubscriptions {
   316→      let ids = await handle.getCurrentEntityIds()
   317→      allSacredIds.formUnion(ids)
   318→    }
   319→
   320→    // Replace the GC's sacred entity set
   321→    // First unmark all, then mark the current set
   322→    let currentSacred = await gc.currentSacredEntities
   323→    await gc.unmarkSacred(currentSacred)
   324→    await gc.markSacred(allSacredIds)
   325→  }
   326→
   327→  /// Records access for the given entity IDs.
   328→  ///
   329→  /// Call this when entities are read from or written to the store.
   330→  /// This updates the LRU tracking for GC.
   331→  ///
   332→  /// - Parameter entityIds: Set of entity IDs that were accessed
   333→  public func recordEntityAccess(_ entityIds: Set<String>) async {
   334→    await gc.recordAccess(entityIds: entityIds)
   335→  }
   336→
   337→  /// Records access for a single entity with its triple count.
   338→  ///
   339→  /// - Parameters:
   340→  ///   - entityId: The entity that was accessed
   341→  ///   - tripleCount: Number of triples for this entity
   342→  public func recordEntityAccess(entityId: String, tripleCount: Int) async {
   343→    await gc.recordAccess(entityId: entityId, tripleCount: tripleCount)
   344→  }
