   157→/// The cache key is a hash of the query parameters (namespace, orderBy, includedLinks).
   158→/// The cache is valid only when both storeVersion and pendingMutationsVersion match.
   159→public struct CachedQueryResult: Sendable {
   160→    /// The cached entity data as dictionaries (serialized form)
   161→    public let data: [[String: AnySendable]]
   162→
   163→    /// Store version when this cache was created
   164→    public let storeVersion: Int
   165→
   166→    /// Pending mutations version when this cache was created
   167→    public let pendingMutationsVersion: Int
   168→
   169→    /// The processedTxId from the server (for pending mutation cleanup)
   170→    public let processedTxId: Int?
   171→}
   172→
   173→public actor Reactor {
   174→  // public static let shared = Reactor() // Removed for DI
   175→
   176→
   177→  private let store: SharedTripleStore
   178→  private let clientInstanceID: String
   179→  private var activeSubscriptions: [UUID: SubscriptionHandle] = [:]
   180→
   181→  // MARK: - Garbage Collection
   182→
   183→  /// Garbage collector for the TripleStore.
   184→  ///
   185→  /// ## TypeScript SDK Parity
   186→  /// Matches the GC system in PersistedObject.ts which manages memory via:
   187→  /// - Sacred keys (entities in active subscriptions that cannot be evicted)
   188→  /// - Age-based eviction (entities not accessed recently)
   189→  /// - Size limits (maxEntries, maxSize)
   190→  private let gc: TripleStoreGC
   191→
   192→  // MARK: - Version Tracking for Query Result Caching
   193→
   194→  /// Version counter for the TripleStore. Incremented when store receives updates.
   195→  ///
   196→  /// ## TypeScript SDK Parity
   197→  /// Matches `querySubs.version()` in Reactor.js line 1231.
   198→  /// Used to detect when cached query results are stale due to store changes.
   199→  private var storeVersion: Int = 0
   200→
   201→  /// Version counter for pending mutations. Incremented when mutations are added/removed/confirmed.
   202→  ///
   203→  /// ## TypeScript SDK Parity
   204→  /// Matches `kv.version()` in Reactor.js line 1233 (kv stores pendingMutations).
   205→  /// Used to detect when cached query results are stale due to mutation changes.
   206→  private var pendingMutationsVersion: Int = 0
   207→
   208→  /// Cache of query results keyed by query hash.
   209→  ///
   210→  /// ## TypeScript SDK Parity
   211→  /// Matches `_dataForQueryCache` in Reactor.js line 1239.
   212→  /// Each entry is invalidated when storeVersion or pendingMutationsVersion changes.
   213→  private var queryResultCache: [String: CachedQueryResult] = [:]
   214→
   215→  // MARK: - Pending Mutation Cleanup (TypeScript SDK Parity)
   216→
   217→  /// Maps query hash to the processedTxId received from the server.
   218→  ///
   219→  /// ## TypeScript SDK Parity
   220→  /// Matches the pattern in Reactor.js `_cleanupPendingMutationsQueries()` (lines 1461-1476).
   221→  /// Each query subscription tracks the latest processedTxId from server responses.
   222→  /// When cleaning up, we find the minimum processedTxId across all queries.
   223→  private var queryProcessedTxIds: [String: Int] = [:]
   224→
   225→  /// Threshold for triggering timeout-based cleanup.
   226→  ///
   227→  /// ## TypeScript SDK Parity
   228→  /// Matches `_pendingMutationCleanupThreshold` in Reactor.js.
   229→  /// Timeout cleanup only runs when pending mutation count exceeds this threshold.
   230→  private let pendingMutationCleanupThreshold = 200
   231→
   232→  /// Timeout in seconds for confirmed mutations before cleanup.
   233→  ///
   234→  /// ## TypeScript SDK Parity
   235→  /// Matches `_pendingTxCleanupTimeout` in Reactor.js (30000ms = 30 seconds).
   236→  /// Mutations confirmed more than this many seconds ago are cleaned up.
   237→  private let pendingTxCleanupTimeoutSeconds: TimeInterval = 30
   238→
   239→  /// The app ID for the current Reactor instance.
   240→  /// Set when first subscription is created, used for cleanup operations.
   241→  private var currentAppID: String?
   242→
   243→  /// Tracks whether we've restored pending mutations from SQLite.
   244→  ///
   245→  /// ## Why This Exists
   246→  /// When the app restarts, pending mutations (optimistic updates that haven't been
   247→  /// confirmed by the server) are persisted in SQLite but not in the in-memory
   248→  /// SharedTripleStore. Without restoring them, the UI would show stale data until
   249→  /// the server confirms the mutations (which requires network connectivity).
   250→  ///
   251→  /// This flag ensures we only restore once per app launch to avoid duplicate
   252→  /// application of the same mutations.
   253→  private var hasRestoredPendingMutations: Bool = false
   254→
   255→  public init(
   256→    store: SharedTripleStore,
   257→    clientInstanceID: String = "default",
   258→    gcConfig: TripleStoreGCConfig = .default
   259→  ) {
   260→    self.store = store
   261→    self.clientInstanceID = clientInstanceID
   262→    self.gc = TripleStoreGC(store: store, config: gcConfig)
   263→  }
   264→
   265→  /// Starts background garbage collection.
   266→  ///
   267→  /// Call this after the Reactor is initialized to begin periodic GC.
   268→  /// GC will run at intervals specified by the config, evicting entities
   269→  /// that are not in active subscriptions and haven't been accessed recently.
   270→  ///
   271→  /// ## Usage
   272→  /// ```swift
   273→  /// let reactor = Reactor(store: store)
   274→  /// await reactor.startGC()
   275→  /// ```
   276→  public func startGC() async {
   277→    // Set up callback to refresh sacred entities before each GC run
   278→    await gc.setSacredEntityRefreshCallback { [weak self] in
   279→      guard let self else { return Set() }
   280→      return await self.collectSacredEntityIds()
   281→    }
   282→    await gc.start()
   283→  }
   284→
   285→  /// Collects all entity IDs currently in active subscriptions.
   286→  /// These entities are "sacred" and cannot be evicted by GC.
   287→  private func collectSacredEntityIds() async -> Set<String> {
   288→    var allSacredIds = Set<String>()
   289→    for (_, handle) in activeSubscriptions {
   290→      let ids = await handle.getCurrentEntityIds()
   291→      allSacredIds.formUnion(ids)
   292→    }
   293→    return allSacredIds
   294→  }
   295→
   296→  /// Stops background garbage collection.
   297→  ///
   298→  /// Call this when the app is backgrounded or when GC is no longer needed.
   299→  public func stopGC() async {
   300→    await gc.stop()
   301→  }
   302→
   303→  /// Returns diagnostic information about the GC state.
   304→  public func getGCDiagnostics() async -> GCDiagnostics {
   305→    await gc.diagnostics()
   306→  }
   307→
   308→  /// Manually triggers a garbage collection run.
   309→  ///
   310→  /// Useful for testing or when immediate memory cleanup is needed.
   311→  ///
   312→  /// - Returns: GCResult with metrics about what was cleaned up
   313→  @discardableResult
   314→  public func runGC() async -> GCResult {
   315→    // Update sacred entities before running GC
   316→    await updateSacredEntities()
   317→    return await gc.runGC()
   318→  }
   319→
   320→  /// Updates the GC's sacred entities based on current active subscriptions.
   321→  ///
   322→  /// Sacred entities are those currently being viewed in active subscriptions.
   323→  /// These entities will not be evicted by GC.
   324→  ///
   325→  /// This is called automatically before GC runs, but can be called manually
   326→  /// to ensure the sacred set is up to date.
   327→  public func updateSacredEntities() async {
   328→    var allSacredIds = Set<String>()
   329→
   330→    // Collect entity IDs from all active subscriptions
   331→    for (_, handle) in activeSubscriptions {
   332→      let ids = await handle.getCurrentEntityIds()
   333→      allSacredIds.formUnion(ids)
   334→    }
   335→
   336→    // Replace the GC's sacred entity set
   337→    // First unmark all, then mark the current set
   338→    let currentSacred = await gc.currentSacredEntities
   339→    await gc.unmarkSacred(currentSacred)
   340→    await gc.markSacred(allSacredIds)
   341→  }
   342→
   343→  /// Records access for the given entity IDs.
   344→  ///
   345→  /// Call this when entities are read from or written to the store.
   346→  /// This updates the LRU tracking for GC.
   347→  ///
   348→  /// - Parameter entityIds: Set of entity IDs that were accessed
   349→  public func recordEntityAccess(_ entityIds: Set<String>) async {
   350→    await gc.recordAccess(entityIds: entityIds)
   351→  }
   352→
   353→  /// Records access for a single entity with its triple count.
   354→  ///
   355→  /// - Parameters:
   356→  ///   - entityId: The entity that was accessed
   357→  ///   - tripleCount: Number of triples for this entity
   358→  public func recordEntityAccess(entityId: String, tripleCount: Int) async {
   359→    await gc.recordAccess(entityId: entityId, tripleCount: tripleCount)
   360→  }
   361→
   362→  // MARK: - Version Tracking & Cache Methods
   363→
   364→  /// Increments the store version when the TripleStore receives updates.
   365→  ///
   366→  /// ## When to Call
   367→  /// - After `store.addTriples()` in `handleDBUpdate()`
   368→  /// - After `applyOptimisticUpdate()` modifies the store
   369→  ///
   370→  /// ## TypeScript SDK Parity
   371→  /// In TypeScript, `querySubs.version()` is incremented via `PersistedObject.updateInPlace()`.
   372→  public func incrementStoreVersion() {
   373→    storeVersion += 1
   374→  }
   375→
   376→  /// Increments the pending mutations version when mutations change.
   377→  ///
   378→  /// ## When to Call
   379→  /// - After adding a new pending mutation
   380→  /// - After confirming a pending mutation
   381→  /// - After removing a pending mutation
   382→  ///
   383→  /// ## TypeScript SDK Parity
   384→  /// In TypeScript, `kv.version()` is incremented via `PersistedObject.updateInPlace()`.
   385→  public func incrementPendingMutationsVersion() {
   386→    pendingMutationsVersion += 1
   387→  }
   388→
   389→  /// Gets current store version (for cache validation).
   390→  public func getStoreVersion() -> Int {
   391→    return storeVersion
   392→  }
   393→
   394→  /// Gets current pending mutations version (for cache validation).
   395→  public func getPendingMutationsVersion() -> Int {
   396→    return pendingMutationsVersion
   397→  }
   398→
   399→  /// Retrieves a cached query result if it exists and is still valid.
   400→  ///
   401→  /// ## TypeScript SDK Parity
   402→  /// Matches the cache lookup in Reactor.js `dataForQuery()` lines 1239-1246.
   403→  ///
   404→  /// - Parameter queryHash: The hash identifying the query
   405→  /// - Returns: The cached result if valid, nil if cache miss or stale
   406→  public func getCachedResult(queryHash: String) -> CachedQueryResult? {
   407→    guard let cached = queryResultCache[queryHash] else {
   408→      return nil
   409→    }
   410→
   411→    // Cache is valid only if both versions match
   412→    if cached.storeVersion == storeVersion &&
   413→       cached.pendingMutationsVersion == pendingMutationsVersion {
   414→      return cached
   415→    }
   416→
   417→    // Cache is stale, return nil
   418→    return nil
   419→  }
   420→
   421→  /// Stores a query result in the cache with current versions.
   422→  ///
   423→  /// ## TypeScript SDK Parity
   424→  /// Matches the cache update in Reactor.js `notifyOne()` line 1281.
   425→  ///
   426→  /// - Parameters:
   427→  ///   - queryHash: The hash identifying the query
   428→  ///   - data: The entity data as dictionaries
   429→  ///   - processedTxId: The processedTxId from the server (for pending mutation cleanup)
   430→  public func setCachedResult(queryHash: String, data: [[String: AnySendable]], processedTxId: Int? = nil) {
   431→    queryResultCache[queryHash] = CachedQueryResult(
   432→      data: data,
   433→      storeVersion: storeVersion,
   434→      pendingMutationsVersion: pendingMutationsVersion,
   435→      processedTxId: processedTxId
   436→    )
   437→  }
   438→
   439→  /// Clears all cached query results.
   440→  ///
   441→  /// ## When to Call
   442→  /// - When the user signs out
   443→  /// - When the app enters background (optional, for memory pressure)
   444→  public func clearCache() {
   445→    queryResultCache.removeAll()
   446→  }
   447→
   448→  /// Clears a specific cached query result.
   449→  ///
   450→  /// - Parameter queryHash: The hash identifying the query to clear
   451→  public func clearCachedResult(queryHash: String) {
   452→    queryResultCache.removeValue(forKey: queryHash)
   453→  }
   454→
   455→  // MARK: - Pending Mutation Restoration
   456→
   457→  /// Restores pending mutations from SQLite to the in-memory SharedTripleStore.
   458→  ///
   459→  /// ## Why This Exists
   460→  /// When the app restarts, pending mutations are persisted in SQLite but not in
   461→  /// the in-memory SharedTripleStore. This method re-applies those mutations so
   462→  /// users see their changes immediately, even before the server confirms them.
   463→  ///
   464→  /// This matches the TypeScript SDK behavior where `pendingMutations` are merged
   465→  /// into query results via `_applyOptimisticUpdates()`.
   466→  ///
   467→  /// - Parameter client: The InstantClient to load pending mutations from
   468→  private func restorePendingMutationsIfNeeded(client: InstantClient, appID: String) async {
   469→    guard !hasRestoredPendingMutations else {
   470→      reactorDebugLog("restorePendingMutations: SKIPPED - already restored")
   471→      return
   472→    }
   473→    hasRestoredPendingMutations = true
   474→
   475→    reactorDebugLog("restorePendingMutations: START", data: [
   476→      "activeSubscriptionCount": activeSubscriptions.count,
   477→      "subscriptionNamespaces": activeSubscriptions.values.map { $0.namespace }
   478→    ])
   479→
   480→    let pending = await client.getUnconfirmedPendingMutations()
   481→    guard !pending.isEmpty else {
   482→      reactorDebugLog("restorePendingMutations: no pending mutations to restore")
   483→      return
   484→    }
   485→
   486→    reactorDebugLog("restorePendingMutations: found \(pending.count) pending mutations", data: [
   487→      "mutationEventIds": pending.map { $0.eventId }
   488→    ])
   489→
   490→    // Get current attributes for cardinality information
   491→    let attrs = await MainActor.run { client.attributes }
   492→    reactorDebugLog("restorePendingMutations: got attributes", data: [
   493→      "attrCount": attrs.count
   494→    ])
   495→    if !attrs.isEmpty {
   496→      store.updateAttributes(attrs)
   497→    }
   498→
   499→    // Track all entity IDs we're restoring so we can notify subscriptions properly
   500→    var restoredEntityIds: [(namespace: String, id: String)] = []
   501→
   502→    // Apply each pending mutation to the local store
   503→    for mutation in pending {
   504→      let entityIds = applyPendingMutationToStore(mutation)
   505→      restoredEntityIds.append(contentsOf: entityIds)
   506→    }
   507→
   508→    reactorDebugLog("restorePendingMutations: applied to store", data: [
   509→      "restoredEntityCount": restoredEntityIds.count,
   510→      "restoredEntityIds": restoredEntityIds.map { "\($0.namespace):\($0.id)" }
   511→    ])
   512→
   513→    // CRITICAL: We must notify with specific entity IDs, not just notifyAll()
   514→    // because notifyAll() uses "__notifyAll__" sentinel which doesn't add to currentIDs.
   515→    // If currentIDs is empty (no server data yet), the subscription yields nothing.
   516→    for (namespace, id) in restoredEntityIds {
   517→      await notifyOptimisticUpsert(namespace: namespace, id: id)
   518→    }
   519→
   520→    reactorDebugLog("restorePendingMutations: notified subscriptions", data: [
   521→      "notifiedCount": restoredEntityIds.count
   522→    ])
   523→
   524→    // Also do a full notifyAll to ensure any complex queries recompute
   525→    await notifyAll()
   526→
   527→    reactorDebugLog("restorePendingMutations: COMPLETE", data: [
   528→      "restoredCount": pending.count,
   529→      "entityIds": restoredEntityIds.map { $0.id }
   530→    ])
   531→  }
   532→
   533→  /// Applies a single pending mutation's tx-steps to the local TripleStore.
   534→  ///
   535→  /// This parses the raw tx-steps format and applies creates/updates/deletes
   536→  /// to the SharedTripleStore, making the data immediately visible to subscriptions.
   537→  ///
   538→  /// - Returns: Array of (namespace, entityId) tuples for entities that were modified
   539→  private func applyPendingMutationToStore(_ mutation: PendingMutation) -> [(namespace: String, id: String)] {
   540→    let timestamp = ConflictResolution.optimisticTimestamp()
   541→    var modifiedEntities: [(namespace: String, id: String)] = []
   542→
   543→    for step in mutation.txSteps {
   544→      // CRITICAL FIX: step is [AnyCodableValue], not [Any].
   545→      // We must access .value on each element to get the underlying value.
   546→      guard step.count >= 1,
   547→            let action = step[0].value as? String else {
   548→        continue
   549→      }
   550→
   551→      switch action {
   552→      case "add-triple":
   553→        // Format: ["add-triple", entityId, attrId, value, ...]
   554→        guard step.count >= 4,
   555→              let entityId = step[1].value as? String,
   556→              let attrId = step[2].value as? String else {
   557→          continue
   558→        }
   559→        let rawValue = step[3].value
   560→        let value = convertToTripleValue(rawValue)
   561→
   562→        let triple = Triple(
   563→          entityId: entityId,
   564→          attributeId: attrId,
   565→          value: value,
   566→          createdAt: timestamp
   567→        )
   568→        let attr = store.attrsStore.getAttr(attrId)
   569→        let hasCardinalityOne = attr?.cardinality == .one
   570→        let isRef = attr?.valueType == .ref
   571→        store.addTriple(triple, hasCardinalityOne: hasCardinalityOne, isRef: isRef)
   572→
   573→        // Extract namespace from attrId (format: "namespace/field")
   574→        let namespace = attrId.components(separatedBy: "/").first ?? "unknown"
   575→        if !modifiedEntities.contains(where: { $0.id == entityId }) {
   576→          modifiedEntities.append((namespace: namespace, id: entityId))
   577→        }
   578→
   579→      case "retract-triple":
   580→        // Format: ["retract-triple", entityId, attrId, value, ...]
   581→        guard step.count >= 4,
   582→              let entityId = step[1].value as? String,
   583→              let attrId = step[2].value as? String else {
   584→          continue
   585→        }
   586→        let rawValue = step[3].value
   587→        let value = convertToTripleValue(rawValue)
   588→
   589→        let triple = Triple(
   590→          entityId: entityId,
   591→          attributeId: attrId,
   592→          value: value,
   593→          createdAt: timestamp
   594→        )
   595→        let attr = store.attrsStore.getAttr(attrId)
   596→        let isRef = attr?.valueType == .ref
   597→        store.retractTriple(triple, isRef: isRef)
   598→
   599→        let namespace = attrId.components(separatedBy: "/").first ?? "unknown"
   600→        if !modifiedEntities.contains(where: { $0.id == entityId }) {
   601→          modifiedEntities.append((namespace: namespace, id: entityId))
   602→        }
   603→
   604→      case "delete-entity":
   605→        // Format: ["delete-entity", namespace, entityId]
   606→        guard step.count >= 3,
   607→              let namespace = step[1].value as? String,
   608→              let entityId = step[2].value as? String else {
   609→          continue
   610→        }
   611→        store.deleteEntity(id: entityId)
   612→        // Don't add to modifiedEntities since it's deleted
   613→
   614→      default:
   615→        // Skip add-attr, update-attr, etc. - they're handled by the server
   616→        break
   617→      }
   618→    }
   619→
   620→    reactorDebugLog("applyPendingMutationToStore: processed mutation", data: [
   621→      "eventId": mutation.eventId,
   622→      "stepCount": mutation.txSteps.count,
   623→      "modifiedEntities": modifiedEntities.map { "\($0.namespace):\($0.id)" }
   624→    ])
   625→
   626→    return modifiedEntities
   627→  }
   628→
   629→  /// Converts a raw value from tx-steps to a TripleValue.
   630→  private func convertToTripleValue(_ rawValue: Any) -> TripleValue {
   631→    switch rawValue {
   632→    case let s as String:
   633→      return .string(s)
   634→    case let i as Int:
   635→      return .double(Double(i))
   636→    case let i as Int64:
   637→      return .double(Double(i))
   638→    case let d as Double:
   639→      return .double(d)
   640→    case let b as Bool:
   641→      return .bool(b)
   642→    case is NSNull:
   643→      return .null
   644→    default:
   645→      // For complex types, try to represent as string
   646→      return .string(String(describing: rawValue))
   647→    }
   648→  }
   649→
   650→  // MARK: - Schema Readiness
   651→  
   652→  private enum SubscriptionFilter: Sendable, Equatable {
   653→    case matchAll
   654→    case idEquals(String)
   655→    case unsupported
   656→  }
   657→  
   658→  private struct SubscriptionHandle: Sendable {
   659→    let namespace: String
   660→    let filter: SubscriptionFilter
   661→    let upsert: @Sendable (String) async -> Void
   662→    let delete: @Sendable (String) async -> Void
   663→    /// Callback to get the current entity IDs for this subscription.
   664→    /// Used for GC sacred entity tracking.
   665→    let getCurrentEntityIds: @Sendable () async -> Set<String>
   666→  }
   667→
   668→  private func waitForAttributes(
   669→    client: InstantClient,
   670→    timeoutSeconds: TimeInterval,
   671→    logContext: [String: Any]
   672→  ) async -> [Attribute] {
   673→    let deadline = Date().addingTimeInterval(timeoutSeconds)
   674→
   675→    while Date() < deadline {
   676→      let attrs = await MainActor.run { client.attributes }
   677→      if !attrs.isEmpty { return attrs }
   678→      try? await Task.sleep(nanoseconds: 50_000_000)
   679→    }
   680→
   681→    let attrs = await MainActor.run { client.attributes }
   682→    if attrs.isEmpty {
   683→      let contextDescription = logContext
   684→        .map { "\($0.key): \(String(describing: $0.value))" }
   685→        .sorted()
   686→        .joined(separator: ", ")
   687→
   688→      await MainActor.run {
   689→        InstantLogger.warning(
   690→          """
   691→          Reactor timed out waiting for schema attributes.
   692→
   693→          WHAT HAPPENED:
   694→            The client reported an authenticated WebSocket connection, but the schema
   695→            attributes were not available yet. Without attributes, we cannot normalize
   696→            InstaQL trees into triples reliably.
   697→
   698→          WHY THIS MATTERS:
   699→            Without schema, the triple store drops unknown fields, which can lead to
   700→            missing required fields when decoding entities from the store.
   701→
   702→          HOW TO FIX:
   703→            • Ensure the server's `init-ok` includes `attrs`.
   704→            • If this is a race, increase the wait window or refactor to await the
   705→              SDK's init processing before subscribing/transacting.
   706→
   707→          CONTEXT:
   708→            \(contextDescription)
   709→          """,
   710→          json: nil
   711→        )
   712→      }
   713→    }
   714→
   715→    return attrs
   716→  }
   717→
   718→  private func subscriptionFilter(whereClause: [String: Any]?) -> SubscriptionFilter {
   719→    guard let whereClause else { return .matchAll }
   720→    
   721→    if let id = whereClause["id"] as? String {
   722→      return .idEquals(id)
   723→    }
   724→    
   725→    if let dict = whereClause["id"] as? [String: Any],
   726→       let eq = dict["$eq"] as? String {
   727→      return .idEquals(eq)
   728→    }
   729→    
   730→    return .unsupported
   731→  }
   732→  
   733→  /// Notifies ALL active subscriptions to recompute their data from the store.
   734→  ///
   735→  /// ## Why This Exists (TypeScript Parity)
   736→  /// The TypeScript SDK's `notifyAll()` (Reactor.js lines 1303-1310) recomputes ALL
   737→  /// subscriptions after any mutation. This ensures:
   738→  /// - Cross-namespace consistency (e.g., a link mutation affects both sides)
   739→  /// - Correct filtering (subscriptions with complex WHERE clauses recompute)
   740→  /// - No missed updates (even if we can't predict which subscriptions are affected)
   741→  ///
   742→  /// ## Performance Note
   743→  /// This is intentionally aggressive. The TypeScript SDK does the same because
   744→  /// correctness trumps optimization. Each subscription reads from the normalized
   745→  /// store which is fast, and deduplication happens at the UI layer.
   746→  private func notifyAll() async {
   747→    for (_, handle) in activeSubscriptions {
   748→      // Trigger a recompute by calling upsert with a sentinel ID.
   749→      // The SubscriptionState will re-read from the store and yield new values.
   750→      await handle.upsert("__notifyAll__")
   751→    }
   752→  }
   753→
   754→  private func notifyOptimisticUpsert(namespace: String, id: String) async {
   755→    let matchingHandles = activeSubscriptions.values.filter { $0.namespace == namespace }
   756→    reactorDebugLog("notifyOptimisticUpsert", data: [
   757→      "namespace": namespace,
   758→      "id": id,
   759→      "totalSubscriptions": activeSubscriptions.count,
   760→      "matchingSubscriptions": matchingHandles.count,
   761→      "allNamespaces": activeSubscriptions.values.map { $0.namespace }
   762→    ])
   763→
   764→    for (_, handle) in activeSubscriptions where handle.namespace == namespace {
   765→      switch handle.filter {
   766→      case .matchAll:
   767→        reactorDebugLog("notifyOptimisticUpsert: calling upsert (matchAll)", data: [
   768→          "namespace": namespace,
   769→          "id": id
   770→        ])
   771→        await handle.upsert(id)
   772→      case .idEquals(let expectedId):
   773→        guard expectedId == id else { continue }
   774→        reactorDebugLog("notifyOptimisticUpsert: calling upsert (idEquals)", data: [
   775→          "namespace": namespace,
   776→          "id": id
   777→        ])
   778→        await handle.upsert(id)
   779→      case .unsupported:
   780→        continue
   781→      }
   782→    }
   783→  }
   784→
   785→  private func notifyOptimisticDelete(namespace: String, id: String) async {
   786→    for handle in activeSubscriptions.values where handle.namespace == namespace {
   787→      switch handle.filter {
   788→      case .matchAll:
   789→        await handle.delete(id)
   790→      case .idEquals(let expectedId):
   791→        guard expectedId == id else { continue }
   792→        await handle.delete(id)
   793→      case .unsupported:
   794→        continue
   795→      }
   796→    }
   797→  }
   798→  
   799→  public func subscribe<Value: EntityIdentifiable & Codable & Sendable>(
   800→    appID: String,
   801→    configuration: SharingInstantSync.CollectionConfiguration<Value>
   802→  ) -> AsyncStream<[Value]> {
   803→    AsyncStream { continuation in
   804→      let task = Task {
   805→        // Start subscription immediately so cached results can be delivered
   806→        // even when offline (JS core semantics).
   807→        await self.startSubscription(
   808→          appID: appID,
   809→          namespace: configuration.namespace,
   810→          orderBy: configuration.orderBy,
   811→          limit: nil,
   812→          whereClause: configuration.whereClause,
   813→          linkTree: configuration.linkTree,
   814→          includedLinks: configuration.includedLinks,
   815→          continuation: continuation
   816→        )
   817→      }
   818→
   819→      continuation.onTermination = { _ in
   820→        task.cancel()
   821→      }
   822→    }
   823→  }
   824→
   825→  /// Subscribes to a query and returns a stream of results (Read-only version).
   826→  public func subscribe<Value: EntityIdentifiable & Codable & Sendable>(
   827→    appID: String,
   828→    configuration: SharingInstantQuery.Configuration<Value>
   829→  ) -> AsyncStream<[Value]> {
   830→    AsyncStream { continuation in
   831→      let task = Task {
   832→          await self.startSubscription(
   833→            appID: appID,
   834→            namespace: configuration.namespace,
   835→            orderBy: configuration.orderBy,
   836→            limit: configuration.limit,
   837→            whereClause: configuration.whereClause,
   838→            linkTree: configuration.linkTree,
   839→            includedLinks: configuration.includedLinks,
   840→            continuation: continuation
   841→          )
   842→      }
   843→      
   844→      continuation.onTermination = { _ in
   845→        task.cancel()
   846→      }
   847→    }
   848→  }
   849→
   850→  /// Performs a transaction (write) to InstantDB.
   851→  ///
   852→  /// ## Local-first Semantics
   853→  /// - Applies an optimistic update to the local triple store immediately so subscribers can see
   854→  ///   their own writes without waiting for a server round trip.
   855→  /// - Persists the mutation via the Instant iOS SDK and enqueues it when offline.
   856→  /// - Automatically flushes queued mutations once the WebSocket session reconnects.
   857→  ///
   858→  /// - Parameters:
   859→  ///   - appID: The App ID.
   860→  ///   - chunks: The transaction chunks to execute.
   861→  /// Reads an entity directly from the local TripleStore.
   862→  ///
   863→  /// ## Why This Exists
   864→  /// The `update()` mutation method needs to read the current entity state before
   865→  /// applying modifications. However, `wrappedValue` is updated asynchronously via
   866→  /// AsyncStream, which creates a race condition:
   867→  ///
   868→  /// 1. `create()` applies optimistic update to TripleStore
   869→  /// 2. `create()` yields to AsyncStream
   870→  /// 3. **AsyncStream consumer hasn't run yet**
   871→  /// 4. `update()` reads `wrappedValue[id: id]` → entity not found!
   872→  ///
   873→  /// By reading directly from the TripleStore (which IS updated synchronously in
   874→  /// step 1), we avoid this race condition.
   875→  ///
   876→  /// - Parameters:
   877→  ///   - id: The entity ID to read
   878→  /// - Returns: The entity if found and decodable, nil otherwise
   879→  public func getEntity<T: Decodable>(id: String) -> T? {
   880→    store.get(id: id)
   881→  }
   882→
   883→  public func transact(
   884→    appID: String,
   885→    chunks: [TransactionChunk]
   886→  ) async throws {
   887→    // #region agent log - H10: Trace transact timing
   888→    let transactStart = Date()
   889→    let chunkIds = chunks.map { $0.id }
   890→    reactorDebugLog("transact START", data: ["chunkIds": chunkIds])
   891→    // #endregion
   892→    
   893→    let client = await MainActor.run { InstantClientFactory.makeClient(appID: appID, instanceID: self.clientInstanceID) }
   894→    // #region agent log
   895→    reactorDebugLog("transact: got client", data: ["elapsed_ms": Date().timeIntervalSince(transactStart) * 1000])
   896→    // #endregion
   897→
   898→    // Ensure connected
   899→    let isDisconnected = await MainActor.run { client.connectionState == .disconnected }
   900→    if isDisconnected {
   901→      await MainActor.run { client.connect() }
   902→    }
   903→    // #region agent log
   904→    reactorDebugLog("transact: checked connection", data: ["elapsed_ms": Date().timeIntervalSince(transactStart) * 1000, "wasDisconnected": isDisconnected])
   905→    // #endregion
   906→
   907→    let initialAttrs = await MainActor.run { client.attributes }
   908→    if !initialAttrs.isEmpty {
   909→      store.updateAttributes(initialAttrs)
   910→    }
   911→    // #region agent log
   912→    reactorDebugLog("transact: got attrs", data: ["elapsed_ms": Date().timeIntervalSince(transactStart) * 1000, "attrCount": initialAttrs.count])
   913→    // #endregion
   914→
   915→    // Optimistic Update
   916→    // We apply the changes to the triple store immediately so callers can read their
   917→    // writes locally while the server transaction is in-flight.
   918→    await applyOptimisticUpdate(chunks: chunks)
   919→    // #region agent log
   920→    reactorDebugLog("transact: applied optimistic", data: ["elapsed_ms": Date().timeIntervalSince(transactStart) * 1000])
   921→    // #endregion
   922→
   923→    // Persist + enqueue mutations while offline, and flush automatically on reconnect.
   924→    _ = try await client.transactLocalFirst(chunks)
   925→    // #region agent log
   926→    reactorDebugLog("transact END", data: ["elapsed_ms": Date().timeIntervalSince(transactStart) * 1000, "chunkIds": chunkIds])
   927→    // #endregion
   928→  }
   929→
   930→  /// Explicitly sign in as a guest.
   931→  /// Useful for testing or anonymous usage.
   932→  public func signInAsGuest(appID: String) async throws {
   933→      let client = await MainActor.run { InstantClientFactory.makeClient(appID: appID, instanceID: self.clientInstanceID) }
   934→      
   935→      // Perform sign in on MainActor
   936→      // Perform sign in (AuthManager is @MainActor, so this hops automatically)
   937→      let authManager = await client.authManager
   938→      _ = try await authManager.signInAsGuest()
   939→      
   940→      // Loop until authenticated (or error)
   941→      var authenticated = false
   942→      let deadline = Date().addingTimeInterval(10)
   943→      while !authenticated && Date() < deadline {
   944→          let isAuthenticated = await MainActor.run { client.connectionState == .authenticated }
   945→          if isAuthenticated {
   946→              authenticated = true
   947→          } else {
   948→             let isError = await MainActor.run { 
   949→                 if case .error = client.connectionState { return true }
   950→                 return false
   951→             }
   952→             if isError {
   953→                  throw InstantError.connectionFailed(NSError(domain: "Reactor", code: -1, userInfo: [NSLocalizedDescriptionKey: "Connection failed"]))
   954→             }
   955→          }
   956→          if !authenticated { try? await Task.sleep(nanoseconds: 100_000_000) }
   957→      }
   958→      guard authenticated else { throw InstantError.notAuthenticated }
   959→  }
   960→
   961→  private func applyOptimisticUpdate(chunks: [TransactionChunk]) async {
   962→    let timestamp = ConflictResolution.optimisticTimestamp()
   963→
   964→    // Track affected entities for targeted notifications
   965→    var affectedNamespaces: Set<String> = []
   966→    var upsertedIds: [(namespace: String, id: String)] = []
   967→    var deletedIds: [(namespace: String, id: String)] = []
   968→
   969→    for chunk in chunks {
   970→      for op in chunk.ops {
   971→        guard let action = op.first as? String else { continue }
   972→
   973→        let namespace = (op.count > 1 ? op[1] as? String : nil) ?? chunk.namespace
   974→        let id = (op.count > 2 ? op[2] as? String : nil) ?? chunk.id
   975→        affectedNamespaces.insert(namespace)
   976→
   977→        switch action {
   978→        case "create", "update":
   979→          guard op.count > 3, let payload = op[3] as? [String: Any] else { continue }
   980→          var entity = payload
   981→          entity["id"] = id
   982→
   983→          let triples = Normalization.normalize(
   984→            data: entity,
   985→            namespace: namespace,
   986→            attrsStore: store.attrsStore,
   987→            createdAt: timestamp
   988→          )
   989→          store.addTriples(triples)
   990→          upsertedIds.append((namespace: namespace, id: id))
   991→
   992→        case "link":
   993→          guard op.count > 3, let payload = op[3] as? [String: Any] else { continue }
   994→          var entity: [String: Any] = ["id": id]
   995→          for (key, value) in payload {
   996→            entity[key] = value
   997→          }
   998→
   999→          let triples = Normalization.normalize(
  1000→            data: entity,
  1001→            namespace: namespace,
  1002→            attrsStore: store.attrsStore,
  1003→            createdAt: timestamp
  1004→          )
  1005→          store.addTriples(triples)
  1006→          upsertedIds.append((namespace: namespace, id: id))
  1007→
  1008→        case "unlink":
  1009→          guard op.count > 3, let payload = op[3] as? [String: Any] else { continue }
  1010→          applyOptimisticUnlink(
  1011→            namespace: namespace,
  1012→            entityId: id,
  1013→            payload: payload,
  1014→            timestamp: timestamp
  1015→          )
  1016→          upsertedIds.append((namespace: namespace, id: id))
  1017→
  1018→        case "delete":
  1019→          store.deleteEntity(id: id)
  1020→          deletedIds.append((namespace: namespace, id: id))
  1021→
  1022→        default:
  1023→          continue
  1024→        }
  1025→      }
  1026→    }
  1027→
  1028→    // Increment store version after all modifications
  1029→    // This invalidates any cached query results
  1030→    incrementStoreVersion()
  1031→
  1032→    // Also increment pending mutations version since we're applying optimistic updates
  1033→    // (the mutation was just added to the pending queue)
  1034→    incrementPendingMutationsVersion()
  1035→
  1036→    // Notify subscriptions of the specific changes
  1037→    // This ensures currentIDs gets updated with the new entity IDs
  1038→    for (namespace, id) in upsertedIds {
  1039→      await notifyOptimisticUpsert(namespace: namespace, id: id)
  1040→    }
  1041→    for (namespace, id) in deletedIds {
  1042→      await notifyOptimisticDelete(namespace: namespace, id: id)
  1043→    }
  1044→
  1045→    // Also notify all subscriptions to ensure cross-namespace consistency
  1046→    // (e.g., a link mutation affects both sides of the relationship)
  1047→    // See Reactor.js pushOps() line 1367: this.notifyAll()
  1048→    await notifyAll()
  1049→  }
  1050→
  1051→  private func applyOptimisticUnlink(
  1052→    namespace: String,
  1053→    entityId: String,
  1054→    payload: [String: Any],
  1055→    timestamp: Int64
  1056→  ) {
  1057→    for (label, rawValue) in payload {
  1058→      if let attr = store.attrsStore.getAttrByForwardIdent(entityType: namespace, label: label) {
  1059→        guard attr.valueType == .ref else { continue }
  1060→
  1061→        for targetId in referencedEntityIDs(from: rawValue) {
  1062→          let triple = Triple(entityId: entityId, attributeId: attr.id, value: .ref(targetId), createdAt: timestamp)
  1063→          store.retractTriple(triple, isRef: true)
  1064→        }
  1065→        continue
  1066→      }
  1067→
  1068→      if let attr = store.attrsStore.getAttrByReverseIdent(entityType: namespace, label: label) {
  1069→        guard attr.valueType == .ref else { continue }
  1070→
  1071→        for sourceId in referencedEntityIDs(from: rawValue) {
  1072→          let triple = Triple(entityId: sourceId, attributeId: attr.id, value: .ref(entityId), createdAt: timestamp)
  1073→          store.retractTriple(triple, isRef: true)
  1074→        }
  1075→      }
  1076→    }
  1077→  }
  1078→
  1079→  private func referencedEntityIDs(from rawValue: Any) -> [String] {
  1080→    if let id = rawValue as? String {
  1081→      return [id]
  1082→    }
  1083→
  1084→    if let dict = rawValue as? [String: Any], let id = dict["id"] as? String {
  1085→      return [id]
  1086→    }
  1087→
  1088→    if let array = rawValue as? [Any] {
  1089→      return array.flatMap { referencedEntityIDs(from: $0) }
  1090→    }
  1091→
  1092→    return []
  1093→  }
  1094→  
  1095→  // Helper to pass non-Sendable data to MainActor
  1096→  private struct QueryOptions: @unchecked Sendable {
  1097→      let orderBy: OrderBy?
  1098→      let limit: Int?
  1099→      let whereClause: [String: Any]?
  1100→      let linkTree: [EntityQueryNode]
  1101→      let includedLinks: Set<String>
  1102→  }
  1103→  
  1104→  private func startSubscription<Value: EntityIdentifiable & Codable & Sendable>(
  1105→    appID: String,
  1106→    namespace: String,
  1107→    orderBy: OrderBy?,
  1108→    limit: Int?,
  1109→    whereClause: [String: Any]?,
  1110→    linkTree: [EntityQueryNode],
  1111→    includedLinks: Set<String>,
  1112→    continuation: AsyncStream<[Value]>.Continuation
  1113→  ) async {
  1114→    let client = await MainActor.run { InstantClientFactory.makeClient(appID: appID, instanceID: self.clientInstanceID) }
  1115→
  1116→    // Connect if needed
  1117→    let isDisconnected = await MainActor.run { client.connectionState == .disconnected }
  1118→    if isDisconnected {
  1119→      await MainActor.run { client.connect() }
  1120→    }
  1121→
  1122→    // NOTE: Pending mutation restoration is done AFTER subscription registration
  1123→    // so that the subscription can be notified of restored entities.
  1124→    // See the call to restorePendingMutationsIfNeeded below.
  1125→
  1126→    let attrs = await waitForAttributes(
  1127→      client: client,
  1128→      timeoutSeconds: 5,
  1129→      logContext: [
  1130→        "appID": appID,
  1131→        "namespace": namespace,
  1132→        "orderBy": orderBy?.field as Any,
  1133→        "limit": limit as Any,
  1134→        "whereClause": whereClause as Any,
  1135→        "includedLinks": includedLinks.sorted(),
  1136→        "linkTreeCount": linkTree.count,
  1137→      ]
  1138→    )
  1139→    if !attrs.isEmpty {
  1140→      store.updateAttributes(attrs)
  1141→    }
  1142→    
  1143→    // Manage state with a dedicated actor to handle concurrency between DB callbacks and Store callbacks
  1144→    // TypeScript SDK Pattern: Pass appID/clientInstanceID so handleStoreUpdate() can fetch
  1145→    // pending mutations at query time (see Reactor.js dataForQuery -> _applyOptimisticUpdates)
  1146→    let subscriptionState = SubscriptionState<Value>(
  1147→      continuation: continuation,
  1148→      store: store,
  1149→      namespace: namespace,
  1150→      orderByIsDescending: orderBy?.isDescending ?? false,
  1151→      includedLinks: includedLinks,
  1152→      appID: appID,
  1153→      clientInstanceID: self.clientInstanceID
  1154→    )
  1155→
  1156→    let handleId = UUID()
  1157→    activeSubscriptions[handleId] = SubscriptionHandle(
  1158→      namespace: namespace,
  1159→      filter: subscriptionFilter(whereClause: whereClause),
  1160→      upsert: { id in
  1161→        await subscriptionState.handleOptimisticUpsert(id: id)
  1162→      },
  1163→      delete: { id in
  1164→        await subscriptionState.handleOptimisticDelete(id: id)
  1165→      },
  1166→      getCurrentEntityIds: {
  1167→        await subscriptionState.getCurrentEntityIds()
  1168→      }
  1169→    )
  1170→
  1171→    // TypeScript SDK Pattern: Pending mutations are now applied at query time in handleStoreUpdate().
  1172→    // We still call restorePendingMutationsIfNeeded to populate the TripleStore for linked entity
  1173→    // resolution and ensure data is available for store.get() calls.
  1174→    await restorePendingMutationsIfNeeded(client: client, appID: appID)
  1175→
  1176→    // Trigger initial yield to show any pending mutation data immediately
  1177→    // (TypeScript SDK does this via initial dataForQuery call)
  1178→    await subscriptionState.handleStoreUpdate()
  1179→
  1180→    // Subscribe to InstantDB
  1181→    // Use QueryOptions to pass non-Sendable data to MainActor
  1182→
  1183→    
  1184→    let options = QueryOptions(
  1185→        orderBy: orderBy,
  1186→        limit: limit,
  1187→        whereClause: whereClause,
  1188→        linkTree: linkTree,
  1189→        includedLinks: includedLinks
  1190→    )
  1191→    
  1192→    let sharedStore = store
  1193→
  1194→
  1195→    let token = await MainActor.run {
  1196→        // Build Query
  1197→        var q = client.query(Value.self)
  1198→        
  1199→        if let orderBy = options.orderBy {
  1200→          q = q.order(by: orderBy.field, orderBy.isDescending ? .desc : .asc)
  1201→        }
  1202→        if let whereClause = options.whereClause {
  1203→            q = q.where(whereClause)
  1204→        }
  1205→        if let limit = options.limit {
  1206→            q = q.limit(limit)
  1207→        }
  1208→        
  1209→        // Include links
  1210→        if !options.linkTree.isEmpty {
  1211→           let includeDict = convertLinkTreeToInstaQL(options.linkTree)
  1212→           q = q.including(includeDict)
  1213→        } else if !options.includedLinks.isEmpty {
  1214→           q = q.including(options.includedLinks)
  1215→        }
  1216→        
  1217→        // #region agent log
  1218→        // HYPOTHESIS C: Log the query being sent to InstantDB
  1219→        // NOTE: Disabled by default - enable with INSTANT_DEBUG_LOG=1
  1220→        #if DEBUG
  1221→        if ProcessInfo.processInfo.environment["INSTANT_DEBUG_LOG"] == "1" {
  1222→          let whereClauseStr = options.whereClause.map { dict -> String in
  1223→            let pairs = dict.map { "\($0.key): \(String(describing: $0.value))" }
  1224→            return "[\(pairs.joined(separator: ", "))]"
  1225→          } ?? "nil"
  1226→
  1227→          let whereClauseJson: String
  1228→          if let wc = options.whereClause,
  1229→             let jsonData = try? JSONSerialization.data(withJSONObject: wc, options: [.sortedKeys]),
  1230→             let str = String(data: jsonData, encoding: .utf8) {
  1231→            whereClauseJson = str
  1232→          } else {
  1233→            whereClauseJson = "nil or failed to serialize"
  1234→          }
  1235→
  1236→          let payload: [String: Any] = [
  1237→            "location": "Reactor.swift:startSubscription",
  1238→            "message": "HYPOTHESIS_C: Query being sent to InstantDB",
  1239→            "data": [
  1240→              "namespace": namespace,
  1241→              "whereClause": whereClauseStr,
  1242→              "whereClauseJson": whereClauseJson,
  1243→              "hasDotNotation": (options.whereClause?.keys.contains(where: { $0.contains(".") }) ?? false),
  1244→              "includedLinks": Array(options.includedLinks),
  1245→              "linkTreeCount": options.linkTree.count
  1246→            ],
  1247→            "timestamp": Date().timeIntervalSince1970 * 1000,
  1248→            "sessionId": "debug-session",
  1249→            "hypothesisId": "C"
  1250→          ]
  1251→          if let jsonData = try? JSONSerialization.data(withJSONObject: payload) {
  1252→            var request = URLRequest(url: URL(string: "http://127.0.0.1:7243/ingest/b61a72ba-9985-415b-9c60-d4184ed05385")!)
  1253→            request.httpMethod = "POST"
  1254→            request.setValue("application/json", forHTTPHeaderField: "Content-Type")
  1255→            request.httpBody = jsonData
  1256→            let task = URLSession.shared.dataTask(with: request) { _, _, _ in }
  1257→            task.resume()
  1258→          }
  1259→        }
  1260→        #endif
  1261→        // #endregion
  1262→        
  1263→	        return try? client.subscribe(q) { [weak subscriptionState] result in
  1264→              if result.isLoading {
  1265→                return
  1266→              }
  1267→
  1268→	            if let error = result.error {
  1269→                  // #region agent log
  1270→                  // HYPOTHESIS C: Log subscription errors
  1271→                  // NOTE: Disabled by default - enable with INSTANT_DEBUG_LOG=1
  1272→                  #if DEBUG
  1273→                  if ProcessInfo.processInfo.environment["INSTANT_DEBUG_LOG"] == "1" {
  1274→                    let payload: [String: Any] = [
  1275→                      "location": "Reactor.swift:subscribe",
  1276→                      "message": "HYPOTHESIS_C: Subscription error",
  1277→                      "data": [
  1278→                        "namespace": namespace,
  1279→                        "error": "\(error)",
  1280→                        "whereClause": String(describing: options.whereClause)
  1281→                      ],
  1282→                      "timestamp": Date().timeIntervalSince1970 * 1000,
  1283→                      "sessionId": "debug-session",
  1284→                      "hypothesisId": "C"
  1285→                    ]
  1286→                    if let jsonData = try? JSONSerialization.data(withJSONObject: payload) {
  1287→                      var request = URLRequest(url: URL(string: "http://127.0.0.1:7243/ingest/b61a72ba-9985-415b-9c60-d4184ed05385")!)
  1288→                      request.httpMethod = "POST"
  1289→                      request.setValue("application/json", forHTTPHeaderField: "Content-Type")
  1290→                      request.httpBody = jsonData
  1291→                      let task = URLSession.shared.dataTask(with: request) { _, _, _ in }

<summary>Tool use: **Bash**</summary>
 Commit cycle detection changes

```bash
git add Sources/SharingInstant/Extensions/TripleStore+Extensions.swift && git commit -m "$(cat <<'EOF'
feat: Add cycle detection to entity resolution in TripleStore

Problem:
The resolve() function in TripleStore+Extensions.swift uses depth limiting
but lacks cycle detection. When entities have circular references (e.g.,
A -> B -> A), the resolver would traverse the cycle repeatedly up to
maxDepth, causing exponential memory growth and performance degradation.

Solution:
Add a `visited: inout Set<String>` parameter to track entity IDs currently
being resolved in the current path. When a cycle is detected (ID already
in visited set), return early with just ["id": id] to break the cycle.

Key implementation details:
- Use `defer { visited.remove(id) }` pattern to allow the same entity to
  be visited in different resolution branches. For example, if entities
  A and B both link to C, C can be fully resolved for both independently.
- Reduce default maxDepth from 10 to 5 for additional safety on mobile
  devices with limited memory.
- Add convenience overload without visited parameter for backward
  compatibility - it creates the visited set internally.
- All recursive calls (forward refs, string refs, reverse links) now
  pass the visited set through.

TypeScript SDK Parity:
TypeScript's InstaQL doesn't need explicit cycle detection because its
query-driven approach naturally limits resolution scope. The Swift
implementation needs explicit protection because it can resolve ALL
links when includedLinks is nil.

Co-Authored-By: Claude <noreply@anthropic.com>
EOF
)" 2>&1
```

  /// Mutations confirmed more than this many seconds ago are cleaned up.
  private let pendingTxCleanupTimeoutSeconds: TimeInterval = 30

  /// The app ID for the current Reactor instance.
  /// Set when first subscription is created, used for cleanup operations.
  private var currentAppID: String?

  /// Tracks whether we've restored pending mutations from SQLite.
  ///
  /// ## Why This Exists
  /// When the app restarts, pending mutations (optimistic updates that haven't been
  /// confirmed by the server) are persisted in SQLite but not in the in-memory
  /// SharedTripleStore. Without restoring them, the UI would show stale data until
  /// the server confirms the mutations (which requires network connectivity).
  ///
  /// This flag ensures we only restore once per app launch to avoid duplicate
  /// application of the same mutations.
  private var hasRestoredPendingMutations: Bool = false

  public init(
    store: SharedTripleStore,
    clientInstanceID: String = "default",
    gcConfig: TripleStoreGCConfig = .default
  ) {
    self.store = store
    self.clientInstanceID = clientInstanceID
    self.gc = TripleStoreGC(store: store, config: gcConfig)
  }

Author: Michael Lustig <lustig@knophy.com>
Date:   Mon Jan 19 14:57:07 2026 -0500

    feat: Add cycle detection to entity resolution in TripleStore
    
    Problem:
    The resolve() function in TripleStore+Extensions.swift uses depth limiting
    but lacks cycle detection. When entities have circular references (e.g.,
    A -> B -> A), the resolver would traverse the cycle repeatedly up to
    maxDepth, causing exponential memory growth and performance degradation.
    
    Solution:
    Add a `visited: inout Set<String>` parameter to track entity IDs currently
    being resolved in the current path. When a cycle is detected (ID already
    in visited set), return early with just ["id": id] to break the cycle.
    
    Key implementation details:
    - Use `defer { visited.remove(id) }` pattern to allow the same entity to
      be visited in different resolution branches. For example, if entities
      A and B both link to C, C can be fully resolved for both independently.
    - Reduce default maxDepth from 10 to 5 for additional safety on mobile
      devices with limited memory.
    - Add convenience overload without visited parameter for backward
      compatibility - it creates the visited set internally.
    - All recursive calls (forward refs, string refs, reverse links) now
      pass the visited set through.
    
    TypeScript SDK Parity:
    TypeScript's InstaQL doesn't need explicit cycle detection because its

The implementation is complete. Here's a summary of what was done:

## Summary

I implemented **Priority 1: Cycle Detection in Entity Resolution** by modifying `/Users/mlustig/Development/personal/instantdb/sharing-instant/Sources/SharingInstant/Extensions/TripleStore+Extensions.swift`.

### Changes Made

1. **Added `visited: inout Set<String>` parameter** to the main `resolve()` function to track entity IDs currently being resolved in the current resolution path.

2. **Cycle detection logic** at the start of `resolve()`:
   - Check if the ID is already in the visited set
   - If so, return `["id": id]` immediately to break the cycle
   - Add the ID to visited at the start
   - Use `defer { visited.remove(id) }` to remove it when exiting (this allows revisiting the same entity in different branches of the resolution tree)

3. **Reduced default maxDepth from 10 to 5** for additional safety on mobile devices with limited memory.

4. **Created a convenience overload** without the `visited` parameter that creates the visited set internally, ensuring backward compatibility for existing callers.

5. **Updated all recursive calls** (forward refs at line 90, string refs at line 102, and reverse links at lines 155-162) to pass the `visited` set through.

### Why This Matters

Without cycle detection, circular entity references like `A -> B -> A` would cause the resolver to traverse the cycle multiple times (up to maxDepth), leading to:
- Exponential memory growth
- Performance degradation
- Potential crashes on memory-constrained devices

The `defer { visited.remove(id) }` pattern is important because it allows the same entity to appear in different branches of the resolution tree. For example, if entities A and B both link to C, C should be fully resolved for both A and B independently.

### Commit

The changes were committed with hash `de3b329` with a detailed commit message explaining the problem, solution, and implementation details.

// #endregion

public actor Reactor {
  // public static let shared = Reactor() // Removed for DI


  private let store: SharedTripleStore
  private let clientInstanceID: String
  private var activeSubscriptions: [UUID: SubscriptionHandle] = [:]

  /// Tracks whether we've restored pending mutations from SQLite.
  ///
  /// ## Why This Exists
  /// When the app restarts, pending mutations (optimistic updates that haven't been
  /// confirmed by the server) are persisted in SQLite but not in the in-memory
  /// SharedTripleStore. Without restoring them, the UI would show stale data until
  /// the server confirms the mutations (which requires network connectivity).
  ///
  /// This flag ensures we only restore once per app launch to avoid duplicate
  /// application of the same mutations.
  private var hasRestoredPendingMutations: Bool = false

  public init(store: SharedTripleStore, clientInstanceID: String = "default") {
    self.store = store
    self.clientInstanceID = clientInstanceID
  }

  // MARK: - Pending Mutation Restoration

  /// Restores pending mutations from SQLite to the in-memory SharedTripleStore.
  ///
  /// ## Why This Exists
  /// When the app restarts, pending mutations are persisted in SQLite but not in
  /// the in-memory SharedTripleStore. This method re-applies those mutations so
  /// users see their changes immediately, even before the server confirms them.
  ///
  /// This matches the TypeScript SDK behavior where `pendingMutations` are merged
  /// into query results via `_applyOptimisticUpdates()`.
  ///
  /// - Parameter client: The InstantClient to load pending mutations from
  private func restorePendingMutationsIfNeeded(client: InstantClient, appID: String) async {
    guard !hasRestoredPendingMutations else {
      reactorDebugLog("restorePendingMutations: SKIPPED - already restored")
      return
    }
    hasRestoredPendingMutations = true

    reactorDebugLog("restorePendingMutations: START", data: [
      "activeSubscriptionCount": activeSubscriptions.count,
      "subscriptionNamespaces": activeSubscriptions.values.map { $0.namespace }
    ])

    let pending = await client.getUnconfirmedPendingMutations()
    guard !pending.isEmpty else {
      reactorDebugLog("restorePendingMutations: no pending mutations to restore")
      return
    }

    reactorDebugLog("restorePendingMutations: found \(pending.count) pending mutations", data: [
      "mutationEventIds": pending.map { $0.eventId }
    ])

    // Get current attributes for cardinality information
    let attrs = await MainActor.run { client.attributes }
    reactorDebugLog("restorePendingMutations: got attributes", data: [
      "attrCount": attrs.count
    ])
    if !attrs.isEmpty {
      store.updateAttributes(attrs)
    }

    // Track all entity IDs we're restoring so we can notify subscriptions properly
    var restoredEntityIds: [(namespace: String, id: String)] = []

    // Apply each pending mutation to the local store
    for mutation in pending {
      let entityIds = applyPendingMutationToStore(mutation)
      restoredEntityIds.append(contentsOf: entityIds)
    }

    reactorDebugLog("restorePendingMutations: applied to store", data: [
      "restoredEntityCount": restoredEntityIds.count,
      "restoredEntityIds": restoredEntityIds.map { "\($0.namespace):\($0.id)" }
    ])

    // CRITICAL: We must notify with specific entity IDs, not just notifyAll()
    // because notifyAll() uses "__notifyAll__" sentinel which doesn't add to currentIDs.
    // If currentIDs is empty (no server data yet), the subscription yields nothing.
    for (namespace, id) in restoredEntityIds {
      await notifyOptimisticUpsert(namespace: namespace, id: id)
    }

    reactorDebugLog("restorePendingMutations: notified subscriptions", data: [
      "notifiedCount": restoredEntityIds.count
    ])

    // Also do a full notifyAll to ensure any complex queries recompute
    await notifyAll()

    reactorDebugLog("restorePendingMutations: COMPLETE", data: [
      "restoredCount": pending.count,
      "entityIds": restoredEntityIds.map { $0.id }
    ])
  }

  /// Applies a single pending mutation's tx-steps to the local TripleStore.
  ///
  /// This parses the raw tx-steps format and applies creates/updates/deletes
  /// to the SharedTripleStore, making the data immediately visible to subscriptions.
  ///
  /// - Returns: Array of (namespace, entityId) tuples for entities that were modified
  private func applyPendingMutationToStore(_ mutation: PendingMutation) -> [(namespace: String, id: String)] {
    let timestamp = ConflictResolution.optimisticTimestamp()
    var modifiedEntities: [(namespace: String, id: String)] = []

    for step in mutation.txSteps {
      // CRITICAL FIX: step is [AnyCodableValue], not [Any].
      // We must access .value on each element to get the underlying value.
      guard step.count >= 1,
            let action = step[0].value as? String else {
        continue
      }

      switch action {
      case "add-triple":
        // Format: ["add-triple", entityId, attrId, value, ...]
        guard step.count >= 4,
              let entityId = step[1].value as? String,
              let attrId = step[2].value as? String else {
          continue
        }
        let rawValue = step[3].value
        let value = convertToTripleValue(rawValue)

        let triple = Triple(
          entityId: entityId,
          attributeId: attrId,
          value: value,
          createdAt: timestamp
        )
        let attr = store.attrsStore.getAttr(attrId)
        let hasCardinalityOne = attr?.cardinality == .one
        let isRef = attr?.valueType == .ref
        store.addTriple(triple, hasCardinalityOne: hasCardinalityOne, isRef: isRef)

        // Extract namespace from attrId (format: "namespace/field")
        let namespace = attrId.components(separatedBy: "/").first ?? "unknown"
        if !modifiedEntities.contains(where: { $0.id == entityId }) {
          modifiedEntities.append((namespace: namespace, id: entityId))

    func handleStoreUpdate() async {
        reactorDebugLog("SubscriptionState.handleStoreUpdate", data: [
          "namespace": namespace,
          "currentIDsCount": currentIDs.count,
          "currentIDs": currentIDs,
          "optimisticIDsCount": optimisticIDs.count,
          "optimisticIDs": optimisticIDs
        ])

        // TypeScript SDK Pattern: Apply pending mutations at query time
        // See Reactor.js dataForQuery() -> _applyOptimisticUpdates()
        //
        // 1. Get pending mutations from SQLite
        let client = await MainActor.run {
            InstantClientFactory.makeClient(appID: appID, instanceID: clientInstanceID)
        }
        let pendingMutations = await client.getUnconfirmedPendingMutations()

        // 2. Extract entity data from pending mutations for our namespace
        var pendingEntityData: [String: [String: Any]] = [:]
        var pendingEntityOrder: [String] = [] // Maintain insertion order

        for mutation in pendingMutations {
            for step in mutation.txSteps {
                guard step.count >= 4,
                      let action = step[0].value as? String,
                      action == "add-triple",
                      let entityId = step[1].value as? String,
                      let attrId = step[2].value as? String else {
                    continue
                }

                // Resolve attribute ID to namespace and field name
                // attrId can be either:
                // 1. A UUID that needs lookup in attrsStore
                // 2. A "namespace/field" format string (legacy/fallback)
                let attrNamespace: String
                let fieldName: String

                if let attr = store.attrsStore.getAttr(attrId),
                   attr.forwardIdentity.count >= 3 {
                    // forwardIdentity = [attrId, namespace, label]
                    attrNamespace = attr.forwardIdentity[1]
                    fieldName = attr.forwardIdentity[2]
                } else {
                    // Fallback: try parsing as "namespace/field"
                    let parts = attrId.components(separatedBy: "/")
                    guard parts.count >= 2 else { continue }
                    attrNamespace = parts[0]
                    fieldName = parts[1]
                }

                // Check if this triple belongs to our namespace
                guard attrNamespace == namespace else { continue }

                let rawValue = step[3].value

                // Initialize entity data if needed
                if pendingEntityData[entityId] == nil {
                    pendingEntityData[entityId] = ["id": entityId]
                    pendingEntityOrder.append(entityId)
                }

                // Store the field value
                pendingEntityData[entityId]?[fieldName] = rawValue
            }
        }

        reactorDebugLog("SubscriptionState.handleStoreUpdate: pending mutations extracted", data: [
          "namespace": namespace,
          "pendingEntityCount": pendingEntityData.count,
          "pendingEntityIds": pendingEntityOrder
        ])

        // 3. Merge currentIDs with pending entity IDs (maintaining order)
        // Pending entities that aren't in currentIDs are new optimistic creates
        var allIDs = currentIDs
        for entityId in pendingEntityOrder {
            if !allIDs.contains(entityId) {
                if orderByIsDescending {
                    allIDs.insert(entityId, at: 0)
                } else {
                    allIDs.append(entityId)
                }
            }
        }

        // 4. Build result by merging store data with pending mutations
        var values: [Value] = []

        for id in allIDs {
            var entityDict: [String: Any]

            // Get base data from store (if exists)
            // CRITICAL: Pass includedLinks to only resolve explicitly requested links.
            if let val: Value = store.get(id: id, includedLinks: includedLinks) {
                entityDict = (try? val.asDictionary()) ?? ["id": id]
            } else {
                entityDict = ["id": id]
            }

            // Merge pending mutation data (overwrites store data for same fields)
            // This is the key TypeScript SDK pattern - pending mutations take precedence
            if let pendingData = pendingEntityData[id] {
                for (key, value) in pendingData {
                    entityDict[key] = value
                }
            }

            // Decode back to Value type
            if let data = try? JSONSerialization.data(withJSONObject: entityDict),
               let val = try? JSONDecoder().decode(Value.self, from: data) {
                values.append(val)
            }
        }

        reactorDebugLog("SubscriptionState.handleStoreUpdate: yielding", data: [
          "namespace": namespace,
          "valueCount": values.count,
          "valueIds": values.map { $0.id },
          "pendingMutationCount": pendingMutations.count
        ])

        continuation.yield(values)

        var values: [Value] = []
        var cacheData: [[String: AnySendable]] = []

        for id in allIDs {
            var entityDict: [String: Any]

            // Get base data from store (if exists)
            // CRITICAL: Pass includedLinks to only resolve explicitly requested links.
            if let val: Value = store.get(id: id, includedLinks: includedLinks) {
                entityDict = (try? val.asDictionary()) ?? ["id": id]
            } else {
                entityDict = ["id": id]
            }

            // Merge pending mutation data (overwrites store data for same fields)
            // This is the key TypeScript SDK pattern - pending mutations take precedence
            if let pendingData = pendingEntityData[id] {
                for (key, value) in pendingData {
                    entityDict[key] = value
                }
            }

            // Decode back to Value type
            if let data = try? JSONSerialization.data(withJSONObject: entityDict),
               let val = try? JSONDecoder().decode(Value.self, from: data) {
                values.append(val)

                // Convert to sendable dictionary for cache
                var sendableDict: [String: AnySendable] = [:]
                for (key, value) in entityDict {
                    sendableDict[key] = AnySendable(value)
                }
                cacheData.append(sendableDict)
            }
        }

        // 5. Update cache with computed results
        // TypeScript SDK Pattern: Cache the result for future lookups
        // See Reactor.js notifyOne() line 1281
        await reactor.setCachedResult(queryHash: queryHash, data: cacheData, processedTxId: nil)

        reactorDebugLog("SubscriptionState.handleStoreUpdate: yielding (cache miss)", data: [
          "namespace": namespace,
          "valueCount": values.count,
          "valueIds": values.map { \$0.id },
          "pendingMutationCount": pendingMutations.count,
          "queryHash": queryHash
        ])

        continuation.yield(values)
    }

  // MARK: - Pending Mutation Cleanup

  /// Cleans up pending mutations that all queries have processed.
  ///
  /// ## Algorithm (TypeScript Parity)
  /// 1. Find minimum processedTxId across all active query subscriptions
  /// 2. Remove mutations where txId <= minProcessedTxId
  ///
  /// This works because:
  /// - Server sends `processedTxId` with each query result
  /// - If ALL queries have processedTxId >= mutation's txId, the mutation is in server state
  /// - We can safely remove it from pending queue
  ///
  /// ## TypeScript Reference
  /// See `instant/client/packages/core/src/Reactor.js` lines 1461-1476
  private func cleanupPendingMutationsQueries() async {
    guard let appID = currentAppID else { return }
    guard !queryProcessedTxIds.isEmpty else { return }

    // Find minimum processedTxId across all queries
    guard let minProcessedTxId = queryProcessedTxIds.values.min() else { return }

    let client = await MainActor.run {
      InstantClientFactory.makeClient(appID: appID, instanceID: clientInstanceID)
    }

    // Get all pending mutations (including confirmed ones)
    let allMutations = await client.getAllPendingMutations()

    var removedCount = 0
    for mutation in allMutations {
      // Only remove mutations that have been confirmed (have txId) and
      // whose txId is <= the minimum processedTxId (all queries have seen it)
      guard let txId = mutation.txId, Int(txId) <= minProcessedTxId else { continue }

      await client.removePendingMutation(eventId: mutation.eventId)
      removedCount += 1
    }

    if removedCount > 0 {
      pendingMutationsVersion += 1
      reactorDebugLog("cleanupPendingMutationsQueries: removed \(removedCount) mutations", data: [
        "minProcessedTxId": minProcessedTxId,
        "activeQueryCount": queryProcessedTxIds.count
      ])
    }
  }

  /// Cleans up old pending mutations that have been confirmed but not processed by queries.
  ///
  /// ## Algorithm (TypeScript Parity)
  /// - Only run if pendingMutations.count >= threshold (200)
  /// - Remove mutations confirmed > 30 seconds ago
  /// - These mutations probably don't affect any active queries
  ///
  /// ## TypeScript Reference
  /// See `instant/client/packages/core/src/Reactor.js` lines 1483-1500
  private func cleanupPendingMutationsTimeout() async {
    guard let appID = currentAppID else { return }

    let client = await MainActor.run {
      InstantClientFactory.makeClient(appID: appID, instanceID: clientInstanceID)
    }

    // Get all pending mutations
    let allMutations = await client.getAllPendingMutations()

    // Only run if threshold exceeded
    guard allMutations.count >= pendingMutationCleanupThreshold else { return }

    let now = Date()
    var removedCount = 0

    for mutation in allMutations {
      // Only remove mutations that have been confirmed
      guard let confirmedAt = mutation.confirmedAt else { continue }

      // Remove if confirmed more than timeout seconds ago
      if now.timeIntervalSince(confirmedAt) > pendingTxCleanupTimeoutSeconds {
        await client.removePendingMutation(eventId: mutation.eventId)
        removedCount += 1
      }
    }

    if removedCount > 0 {
      pendingMutationsVersion += 1
      reactorDebugLog("cleanupPendingMutationsTimeout: removed \(removedCount) mutations", data: [
        "totalMutations": allMutations.count,
        "threshold": pendingMutationCleanupThreshold,
        "timeout": pendingTxCleanupTimeoutSeconds
      ])
    }
  }

  /// Called when a query receives results from server.
  /// Updates processedTxId tracking and triggers cleanup.
  ///
  /// ## TypeScript Reference
  /// This method combines the tracking of processedTxId per query (implicit in TypeScript's
  /// querySubs.currentValue) with explicit cleanup calls.
  ///
  /// - Parameters:
  ///   - queryHash: The hash identifying the query
  ///   - processedTxId: The processedTxId from the server response
  public func updateQueryProcessedTxId(queryHash: String, processedTxId: Int) async {
    queryProcessedTxIds[queryHash] = processedTxId

    // Run cleanup after processing
    await cleanupPendingMutationsQueries()
    await cleanupPendingMutationsTimeout()
  }

  /// Called when a query subscription ends.
  /// Removes processedTxId tracking for this query.
  ///
  /// - Parameter queryHash: The hash identifying the query to remove
  public func removeQueryProcessedTxId(queryHash: String) {
    queryProcessedTxIds.removeValue(forKey: queryHash)
  }

ENDOFMETHODS

// #endregion

public actor Reactor {
  // public static let shared = Reactor() // Removed for DI


  private let store: SharedTripleStore
  private let clientInstanceID: String
  private var activeSubscriptions: [UUID: SubscriptionHandle] = [:]

  /// Tracks whether we've restored pending mutations from SQLite.
  ///
  /// ## Why This Exists
  /// When the app restarts, pending mutations (optimistic updates that haven't been
  /// confirmed by the server) are persisted in SQLite but not in the in-memory
  /// SharedTripleStore. Without restoring them, the UI would show stale data until
  /// the server confirms the mutations (which requires network connectivity).
  ///
  /// This flag ensures we only restore once per app launch to avoid duplicate
  /// application of the same mutations.
  private var hasRestoredPendingMutations: Bool = false

  public init(store: SharedTripleStore, clientInstanceID: String = "default") {
    self.store = store
    self.clientInstanceID = clientInstanceID
  }

  // MARK: - Pending Mutation Restoration

  /// Restores pending mutations from SQLite to the in-memory SharedTripleStore.
  ///
  /// ## Why This Exists
  /// When the app restarts, pending mutations are persisted in SQLite but not in
  /// the in-memory SharedTripleStore. This method re-applies those mutations so
  /// users see their changes immediately, even before the server confirms them.
  ///
  /// This matches the TypeScript SDK behavior where `pendingMutations` are merged
  /// into query results via `_applyOptimisticUpdates()`.
  ///
  /// - Parameter client: The InstantClient to load pending mutations from
  private func restorePendingMutationsIfNeeded(client: InstantClient, appID: String) async {
    guard !hasRestoredPendingMutations else {
      reactorDebugLog("restorePendingMutations: SKIPPED - already restored")
      return
    }
    hasRestoredPendingMutations = true

    reactorDebugLog("restorePendingMutations: START", data: [
      "activeSubscriptionCount": activeSubscriptions.count,
      "subscriptionNamespaces": activeSubscriptions.values.map { $0.namespace }
